text.body:
<1.1>
brahmāḥ bhagavan yogayuktasya niśreyasamudīritam| puruṣasya dayāsindho jñāninaḥ puruṣottama|| 1.1 || sa yogaḥ kathyatāṃ bhūya śśrotavyaṃ yadi madvidhaiḥ| yadi nānugrahosmāsu bhajamāneṣu vidyate|| 1.2 || śrībhagavān avyākulasya cittasya bandhanaṃ viṣaye kvacit| yatsayogaścaturvaktrasa ca dvaividhyamaśnute|| 1.3 || karma kartavyami tyevaṃ vihiteṣveva karmasu| bandhanaṃ manaso nityaṃ karmayogassa ucyate|| 1.4 || yattu cittasya satatamarthe śreyasi bandhanam| jñānayogassa vijñeya ssarvasiddhikaraśśubhaḥ|| 1.5 || yasyoktalakṣaṇe yoge dvividhe'vasthitaṃ manaḥ| sa yāti paramaṃ śreyo mokṣalakṣaṇamañjasā|| 1.6 || yamādiraṅgaṃ pūrvasya vairāgyādi parasyatu| aṣṭau yamādayo yogāḥ yamo'hiṃsādilakṣaṇaḥ|| 1.7 || ahiṃsā satyamasteyaṃ brahmacaryaṃ dayārjavam| kṣamādhṛtirmitāhāro śaucaṃ ceti yamā daśa|| 1.8 || tapaḥ prabhṛtirūpastu niyamaḥ kathyate punaḥ| tapaśca tuṣṭirāstikyaṃ dānamārādhanaṃ hareḥ|| 1.9 || siddhāntaśravaṇaṃ hrīśca japa ityādilakṣaṇaḥ| āsanādīni sarvāṇi svastikādīni saṃprati|| 1.10 || varṇyante svastikaṃ pādatalayorubhayorapi| pūrvottare jānunī dve kṛtvā''sanamudīritam|| 1.11 || sīvanyā dakṣīṇe pārśve savyaṃ savye tu dakṣiṇam| gulphaṃ kṛtyā''sanaṃ tacca svastikaṃ kathyate budhaiḥ|| 1.12 || āropya corvoścaraṇau tadaṅguṣṭhadvayaṃ punaḥ| vyutkrameṇaiva hastābhyāṃ gṛhṇīyāttatta dāsanam|| 1.13 || baddhapadmāsanaṃ jñeyamāsaneṣu supūjitam| ekaṃ caraṇamanyasminnūrāvāropya niścalaḥ|| 1.14 || āste yadidamenoghnaṃ vīrāsanamudāhṛtam| sivinīṃ gulphadeśābhyāṃ nipīḍya vyutkrameṇa tu|| 1.15 || prasārya jānunorhastāvāsanaṃ siṃhapūrvakam| gulphau ca vṛṣaṇasyādhassīvanyubhayapārśvayoḥ|| 1.16 || niveśya pādau hastābhyāṃ dṛḍhaṃ badhvā yadā sanam| bhadrāsanaṃ tadvijñeyaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam|| 1.17 || gulphaṃ savyetaraṃ savye vṛṣṭhasārśve vidhāya ca| gulphaṃ tathetaraṃ vṛṣṭhapārśva'nyasminnidhāya ca|| 1.18 || āsanaṃ gomukhaṃ yadvadghomukhāsanamiṣyate| sīvanīpārśvamubhayaṃ gulphābhyāṃ vyutkrameṇatu|| 1.19 || nipīḍyāsana metacca muktāsana mudāhṛtam| meḍhrasyo pari nikṣipya savyaṃ gulphaṃ tathetaram|| 1.20 || niveśyopari gulphasya yadvā muktāsanaṃ bhavet| avaṣṭabhya dharāṃ samyaktalābhyāṃ hastayordvayoḥ|| 1.21 || kūrparau nābhipārśve ca sthāpayitvā mayūravat| samunnamya śiraḥ pādau mayūrāsanamiṣyate|| 1.22 || iti śripāñcarātre mahopaniṣadi pādmasaṃhitāyāṃ yogapāde āsanabhedalakṣaṇaṃ nāma prathamo'dhyāyaḥ |
<1.2>
śrībhagavān yamaiśca niyamaiścaiva yogāṅgairāsanai rapi| susaṃyato nāḍīśuddhau prāṇāyāmo vidhīyate|| 2.1 || dehamānaṃ svāṅgulībhiṣṣaṇṇavatyaṅgulāyatam| prāṇaśśarīrādadhiko dvādaśāṅgulamānataḥ|| 2.2 || dehasthamanilaṃ dehasamudbhū tena vahninā| nyūnaṃ samaṃ vā yogena kurvanprahmavidiṣyate|| 2.3 || dehamadhye śikhisthānaṃ taptajāmbūnadaprabham| trikoṇaṃ dvipadāmanyaccaturaśraṃ catuṣpadām|| 2.4 || vṛttaṃ vihaṅgamānāṃ tu ṣaḍaśraṃ jalajanmanām| aṣṭāśraṃ svedajānāṃ tu tasmin dīpavadujjvalaḥ|| 2.5 || vai śvānaro'gniḥ pacati prāṇāpānasamā yutaḥ| catuṣprakāramaśanaṃ dehamadhye'bhadhīyate|| 2.6 || apānādvaṅgulādūrdhvamadho meḍhrasya vāmataḥ| dehamadhyaṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ meḍhramadhyaṃ catuṣpadām|| 2.7 || itareṣāṃ tundamadhyaṃ sarveṣāmeva padma ja| kandasdhānaṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ dehamadhye navāṅgulam|| 2.8 || caturaṅgalamutsedhaṃ caturaṅgula māyatam| aṇḍākṛti stiraścāṃ ca dvipadāṃ ca catuṣpadām|| 2.9 || tundhamadhyaṃ tadiṣṭaṃ vai tanmadhyaṃ nābhiriṣyate| tatra cakraṃ dvādaśāraṃ āhūrmāsā narāṇi tu|| 2.10 || viṣṇvādi mūrtayasaiṣu dvādaśa dvādaśasvapi| āhaṃ tatra sthitaṃ cakraṃ bhrāmayāmi svamāyayā|| 2.11 || areṣu bhramate jīvaḥ krameṇa kamalāsana| tantupaññaramadhyapthā yathā bhramati lūtikā|| 2.12 || prāṇārūḍhaścarati ca jīvastena vinā na hi| tasyordhve kuṇḍalīsthānaṃ nābhestiryagathordhvataḥ|| 2.13 || aṣṭaprakṛtirūpā sā cāṣṭadhā kuṇḍalīkṛtā| yathāvadvāyucāraṃ ca jvalanādi ca nityaśaḥ|| 2.14 || paritaḥ kandapāśvetu nirudhyaiva sadā sthitā| mukhenai va samāveṣṭya brahmarandhramukhaṃ tadā|| 2.15 || yogakāle ca marutā nāgninā coditā satī| sphuritā hṛdayākāśe nāgarūpā mahojvalā|| 2.16 || vāyurvā yumukhenaiva tato yāti suṣumnayā| kandamadhye sthitā nāḍī suṣumnā supratiṣṭhitā|| 2.17 || padmasūtrapratīkāśā ṛjurūdhva pravartinī| brahmaṇo vivaraṃ yāvadvidyudābhā sanālikā|| 2.18 || vaiṣṇavī brahmanāḍī ca nirvāṇaprāpti padthatiḥ| iḍā ca piṅgalācaiva tasyāssavyetaresthite|| 2.19 || iḍā samutthitā kandādvāmanāsāpuṭāvadhi| piṅgalā cotthitā tasmādanyanāsā puṭāvadhi|| 2.20 || gāndhārī hastijihvā ca dve cānye nāḍike sthite| purataḥ vṛṣṭhata stasyā vāmetaradṛśau prati|| 2.21 || pūśā yaśasvinī nāḍyau tasmādeva samutthite| sarvetaraśrutyavadhi pāyumūlāttvalambusā|| 2.22 || adhomukhā kuhūnāḍī meḍhrāntāvadhirāyatā| pādāṅguṣṭhāvadhiḥ kanthā dyathā yātā ca keśinī|| 2.23 || daśapradhānabhūtāntāḥ kathitāḥ kandasambhavāḥ| tanmūlā bahavo nāḍyaḥ sthūlāssūkṣmāstu nāḍikāḥ|| 2.24 || dvisaptatisahasrāṇi sthūlāssūkṣmāstu padmaja| saṃkhyātuṃ vaiva śakyanai sthūlamūlāḥ vṛthagvidhāḥ|| 2.25 || yathāśvatdhadale sūkṣmāḥ sthūlaśca vitatā stathā| prāṇo'pānansamānaśca udāno vyāsa eva ca|| 2.26 || nāgaḥ kūrvaśca kṛkaro devadatto dhanañjayaḥ| caranti daśa nāḍīṣu daśa prāṇādi vāyavaḥ|| 2.27 || prāṇādipañcakaṃ teṣu pradhānāṃ tatra ca dvayam| prāṇa evāthavā śreṣṭho jīvātmānaṃ bhibhartiyaḥ|| 2.28 || āsyanāsikayormadhyaṃ hṛdayaṃ nābhimaṇḍalam| pādāṅguṣṭhamiti prāṇasthānāni kamalāsana|| 2.29 || apānaścarati brahman gudameḍhrorujānuṣu| samānassarvagā treṣu sarvavyāpī vyavasthitaḥ|| 2.30 || udānassarvasandhisthaḥ pādayorhastayorapi| vyānaśśrotrorukaṭyāṃ ca gulphaskandhagaleṣu ca|| 2.31 || nāgādivāyavaḥ pañca tvagasthyādiṣu saṃsthitāḥ| tundasthaṃ jalamannaṃ ca rasanāgni samikṛtā|| 2.32 || tundamadhyagataḥ prāṇāntāni kuryātpṛthakpṛthak| ityādiceṣṭayā prāṇaḥ karoti vapuṣi sthitim|| 2.33 || apānavāyurmūtrādeḥ karoti ca vasarjanam| prāṇāpānādi ceṣṭadi kriyate vyāsavāyunā|| 2.34 || ujjīryate śarīrasthamudānena nabhasvatā| poṣaṇādiśarīrasya samānaḥ kurute sadā|| 2.35 || udgārādikriyā nāgaḥ kūrmākṣyādinimīlanam| kṛkarastu kṣutaḥ kartā datto nidrādikarmakṛt|| 2.36 || mṛtagātrasya śobhadi dhanaṃjaya udāhṛtaḥ| nāḍībhedaṃ marudbhedaṃ marutāṃ sthānameva ca|| 2.37 || ceṣṭāśca vividhā steṣāṃ jñātvaivaṃ kamalāsana| śuddhau yateta nāḍīnāṃ vakṣyamāṇena vartmanā|| 2.38 || iti śrīpāñcarātre mahopaniṣadi pādmasaṃhitāyāṃ yogapāde nāḍīsvarūpakathanaṃ nāma dvitīyo’dhyāyaḥ|
<1.3>
śrībhagavān traivarṇika ssvavarṇoktai rāśramānuguṇai stathā| ācārai rācaranyuktai rvāsudevārcane rataḥ|| 3.1 || viviktaṃ deśamāsādya sarvasaṃbādhavarjitam| yogāṅgadravyasampūrṇaṃ tatra dārumaye śubhe|| 3.2 || āsane kalpite darbhavāsaḥ kṛṣṇājinādibhiḥ| tālamātrasamutsedhe tāladvayasamāyute|| 3.3 || upaviśyāsane vaśye svastikādi yathāruci| badhvā prāgānanassamyak ṛjukāyassamāhitaḥ|| 3.4 || nāsāgravyastanayano dantairdantānasaṃspṛśan| rasanāṃ tāluni vyasya ślathabāhudvayānvitaḥ|| 3.5 || ākuñcataśirāḥ riñcit nibadhnan yogamudrayā| hastau yadhokta vidhinā prāṇāyāmaṃ samācaret|| 3.6 || recanaṃ pūraṇaṃ vāyoḥ rodhanaṃ recanaṃ tathā| caturbhiḥ kleśanaṃ vāyoḥ prāṇāyāma udīritaḥ|| 3.7 || hastena dakṣiṇenai va pīḍayannāsikāpuṭam| iḍayāpūra yedantarvā yumātmani kumbhayet| śanaiśśanai ratha bahiḥ kṣipetpiṅgalayānilam|| 3.8 || dvātriṃśanmātrayaṭā kukṣau pūrayediḍayānilam| bhūyaṣṣoḍaśamātrābhiścatuṣṣaṣṭhyātu mātrayā|| 3.9 || sampūrṇakumbhavaddhehaṃ pūrayenmātariśvanā| pūraṇānnāḍayassarvāḥ pūryante mātariśvanā|| 3.10 || evaṃ kṛtesati brahman carantidaśa vāyavaḥ| hṛdayāmbhoruhaṃ cāpi vyākocaṃ bhavati sphuṭam|| 3.11 || pūraṇena tathā kumbhī karaṇā dunmukhaṃ sthitam| galakūpavirūḍhaṃ tu tadadhomukhamambhujam|| 3.12 || nālaṃ tālanibhaṃ tasya dalāṣṭakasamanvitam| kadalī puṣpasaṅkāśaṃ candrakāntasamaprabham|| 3.13 || sandhyayormadhyarātre ca prāṇāyāmāṃstu ṣoḍaśa| ekāhamātraṃ kurvāṇassarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate|| 3.14 || kimanyairbhahubhiḥ proktaiḥ prāṇāyāmaparāyaṇāḥ| nirdhūtasarvapāpmāno vatsaratrayapūraṇe|| 3.15 || paśyanti māmapi brahman hṛdayāmbhoruhesthitam| saṃvatsaratrayādūdhvaṃ prāṇāyāmaparo naraḥ|| 3.16 || yogasiddho bhavedyogī vāyujidvijitendriyaḥ| alpāśī svalpanidraśca tejasvī balavānbhavet|| 3.17 || apamutyumatikramya dīrghamāyuravāpnu yāt| prasvedajananaṃ yasya prāṇāyāmeṣu so'dhamaḥ|| 3.18 || kampanaṃ vapuṣo yasya prāṇāyāmeṣu madhyamaḥ| utthānaṃ vapuṣo yasya sa uttama udāhṛtaḥ|| 3.19 || adhame vyādhipāpānāṃ nāśassyānmadhyame punaḥ| pāparogamahāvyādhi nāśassyāduttame punaḥ|| 3.20 || alpamūtro lpaviṣṭhaśca laghudeho mitāśanaḥ| vaśyendriyaḥ paṭumatiḥ kālatrayavidātmavān|| 3.21 || recakaṃ pūrakaṃ muktvā kumbhīkaraṇamevayaḥ| karoti triṣulokeṣu naiva tasyāstidurlabham|| 3.22 || nābhakande ca nāsāgre pādāṅguṣṭhe ca yatnavān| dhārayanmanasā prāṇān sandhyākāleṣu sarvadā|| 3.23 || sarvarogavinirmukto bhavedyogī gataklamaḥ| kukṣirogavināśassyāt nābhikandeṣu dhāraṇāt|| 3.24 || nāsāgre dhāṇāddhīrṣu māyuṣyaṃ dehalāghapam| pādāṅgaṣṭhe bhaveddhṛtyā vāyoḥ kamalasaṃbhava|| 3.25 || vāyumākṛṣya jihvāgre pibannaśramadāhābhāk| brāhme muhorte saṃprāptevāyumākṛṣyajihvayā|| 3.26 || pibata striṣumāneṣu vāksisdhirmahatībhavet| ābhyasyataścaṣaṇmāsā nmahārogavināśanam|| 3.27 || yatra yatra dhṛto vāmuraṅge rogādidūṣite| dhāraṇādeva marutastattadārogyamaśrute|| 3.28 || manaso dhāraṇādeva śvasano dhārito bhavet| manasthsāpanā heturucyate kamalāsana|| 3.29 || karaṇāni samāhṛtya viṣayebhyassamāhitaḥ| apānamūrdhvamākṛṣya vasterupari dhārayet|| 3.30 || badhnankarābhyāṃ śrotrāti karaṇāni yathātatham| yuññānasya yadhoktena vartmanā svavaśaṃ manaḥ|| 3.31 || manaspṛṣṭassavai vāyussvava śesthāpyate sadā| nāsikāpuṭayoḥ prāṇaḥ paryāyeṇa pravartate|| 3.32 || tisraśca nāḍikāḥ prāṇastāvatyaśca caratyayam| śaṃkhinīvivare yāmye prāṇaḥ prāṇabhṛtāṃ satām|| 3.33 || tāvantaśca punaḥ kālaṃ saumye carati santatam| itthaṃ krameṇa caratā vāyunā vāyujinnaraḥ|| 3.34 || ahaśca rātriṃ pakṣaṃ ca māsaṛtvayanādikam| antarmukho vijānīyātkālabhedanaṃ samāhitaḥ|| 3.35 || aṅguṣṭhādisvāvayavasphuraṇādarśanairapi| ariṣṭairjīvitasyāpi jānīyātkṣayamātmanaḥ|| 3.36 || jñātvā yateta kaivalyaprāptaye yogavittamaḥ|| iti śrī pāñcarātre mahopaniṣadi pādmasaṃhitāyāṃ yogapāde pañcabhūtasthānanirṇayo nāma tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ |
<1.4>
brahmāḥ bhagavan kānyariṣṭāni kathaṃ tairjīvitakṣayaḥ| sūcyate saṃśayasyāsya chedane kāraṇaṃ bhavān|| 4.1 || śrībhagavān pādāṅguṣṭhe karāṅguṣṭhe sphuraṇaṃ yasya naśyati| tasyasaṃvatsarādūrdhvaṃ jīvitasya kṣayo bhavet|| 4.2 || maṇibandhe tathā gulphe sphuraṇaṃ yasya naśyati| ṣaṇmāsāvadhiretasya jīvitasya sthitirbhavet|| 4.3 || kūrparesphuraṇaṃ yasya tasya traimāsikī sthitiḥ| kakṣe mehanapāśve ca sphuraṇādyupalambhane|| 4.4 || mānāvadhirjīvitasya tadardhaṃ svedadarśane| aśrute jāṭhare ghoṣe dināni daśa jīvitam|| 4.5 || jyotiḥ khadyotavadyasya tadardhaṃ tasya jīvitam| jihvāyā darśane trīṇi dināni sthitirātmanaḥ|| 4.6 || nāsāgrā darśane mṛtyuḥ dvidine naiva saṃśayaḥ| evamādīnyariṣṭāni dṛṣṭvāyuḥ kṣayakāraṇam|| 4.7 || niśreyasāya yuñjīta japadhyānaparāyaṇaḥ| manasā tmanyanuṣṭhānaṃ yadidaṃ nityakarmaṇām|| 4.8 || pratyāhārassavijñeyo yogāṅgatvena sevitaḥ| yadvāṣṭādaśabhedeṣu marmasthāneṣu dhāraṇam|| 4.9 || sthānāt sthānaṃ samākṛṣya sā pratyāhṛti riṣyate| pādāṅguṣṭhaṃ tathāgulphaṃ jaṅghāmadhyaṃ tathaiva ca|| 4.10 || madhyamūrvośca mūlaṃ ca pāyuḥ hṛdayamevaca| mehanaṃ dehamadhyaṃ ca nābhiṃ ca galakūbaram|| 4.11 || tālumūlaṃ ca mūlaṃ ca ghrāṇasyākṣṇośca maṇḍalam| bhruvormadhyaṃ lalāṭaṃ ca mūrdhācāpi tataḥ param|| 4.12 || mūlaṃ ca karmayormūlaṃ marmūṇyetāni padmaja| pañcabhūtamaye dehe bhūteṣveteṣu pañcasu|| 4.13 || manaso dhāraṇaṃ yattadyuktasya ca yanūdibhiḥ| dhāraṇā sā ca saṃsārasāgarotāra kāraṇam|| 4.14 || ājānupādaparyantaṃ pṛthivīsthānamiṣyate| pittalā caturaśrā ca vasudhā vajralāñcitā|| 4.15 || smartavyā pañcaghaṭikā statrāropya prabhañjanam| tasyoparyūrumūlāntaṃ vāristhānaṃ caturmukha|| 4.16 || ardhacandrasamākāraṃ śvetamambujalāñcitam| smartavyamaṅge śvasanamāropya daśa nāḍikāḥ|| 4.17 || ānābhidehamadhyānta magnisthānamudāhṛtam| tatra sindhūravarṇo'gni styraśrāṅko daśa pañca ca|| 4.18 || smartavyo nāḍikāḥ prāṇaṃ kṛtvākumbhai kadhāritam| nā bherupari nāsāntaṃ vāyusthānaṃ tu tatravai|| 4.19 || vedikākāravaddhūmro balavānbhūtamārutaḥ| smartavyaḥ kumbhake naiva prāṇamāropya mārutaḥ|| 4.20 || ghaṭikā viṃśatistasmādghrāṇādbrahmabilāvadhi| vyomasthānaṃ nabhantatra bhinnāññanasamaprabham|| 4.21 || dhyāyonmārutamāropya kuṃbhakenaina yatnavān| viśvambharāṃśe dehasya caturbāhumalaṅkṛtam|| 4.22 || aniruddhaṃ hariṃ yogī yajeta bhavamuktaye| abaṃśe pūrayedyogī nārāyaṇamudagradhīḥ|| 4.23 || pradyumnamagnau vāyvaṃśe saṅkarṣaṇamataḥ param| vyomāṃ śe paramātmānaṃ vāsudevaṃ samarcayet|| 4.24 || acirādevatatprāpti ryuñjānasya na saṃśayaḥ|| iti śrī pāṃcarātre mahopaniṣadi pādmasaṃhitāyāṃ yogapāde pañcabhūtasthāvanirṇayo nāma caturtho'dhyāyaḥ |
<1.5>
śrībhagavān badhvāyogāsanaṃ pūrvaṃ hṛddheśe racitāñjaliḥ| nāsāgravyastanayano jihvāṃ kṛtvāca ca tāluni|| 5.1 || dantairdattānasaṃspṛśya ūrdhvakāyassamāhitaḥ| saṃharedindriyagrāmaṃ tato buddhyā viśuddhayā|| 5.2 || cintanaṃ vāsudevasya parasya paramātmanaḥ| sarūpasyāpyarūpasya svahṛdamburuhāsane|| 5.3 || yattaddhyānaṃ praśaṃsanti kaivalyaphaladaṃ sadā| yāmamātraṃ vāsudevaṃ cintayetkumbhakena yaḥ|| 5.4 || saptajanmakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ tasya vaśyati yoginaḥ| nābhikandātsamārabhya yāvaddhṛdayagocaram|| 5.5 || jāgradvṛttiṃ vijāniyātkaṇṭhasthaṃ svapramuttamaṃ| nuṣuptaṃ tālumadhyasthaṃ turyaṃ bhrūmadhyasaṃsthitam|| 5.6 || turyātītaṃ paraṃ brahma brahmarandhre tu lakṣayet| jāgradvṛ taissamārabhya yāvadbrahmabilā ntaram|| 5.7 || tatrodayaṃ turīyaṃ syāttu ryānte viṣṇurucyate | dhyāye ccaivaṃ samāyuktaḥ vyomni cātyantanirmale|| 5.8 || sūryakoṭidyutidharaṃ nityoditamadhokṣajam| hṛdayāmbhuruhāsinaṃ dhyāyedvā viśvarūpiṇam|| 5.9 || anekākārakhacitaṃ anekavadanānvitam|| anekabhujasaṃyukta manekāyudhamaṇḍitam|| 5.10 || nānārūpadharaṃ devaṃ śāntamugramudāyudham| aneka nayānākīrṇaṃ sūryakoṭisamabrabham|| 5.11 || dhyāyato yoginassarvaṃ yato'jñānaṃ vinaśyati| hṛtpuṇḍarīka madhyasthaṃ caitanyaṃ jyotiravyayam|| 5.12 || kadamba mukulākāraṃ turyāntānmaṇḍalātparam|| anantamānandamayaṃ cinmayaṃ bhāsvaraṃ vibhum|| 5.13 || nivātadīpasadṛśamakṛtrima maṇiprabham| dhyāyato yogina stasya muktiḥ karatale sthitā|| 5.14 || viśvarūpasya devasya rūpaṃ yatkiñcidevahi| sthavīyassūkṣmamanyadpā paśyan hṛdayapaṅgaje|| 5.15 || dhyāyato yogino vastu nākṣādeva prakāśate| aṇimādiphalaṃ caiva sakalaṃ kā kathā pare|| 5.16 || jīvātmanaḥ parasyāpi yadaikya mubhayorapi| samādissatu vijñeya ssādhvarthānāṃ prasādhakaḥ|| 5.17 || ahameva paraṃbrahma taditi dhyānamāsthitaḥ| sthāṇubhūto dṛḍhaśśaśvadviṣayā nnāvabudhyate|| 5.18 || yathā bāhyajalaṃ vārāṃ praviṣṭaṃ niścalaṃ nidhim| calasvabhāvaṃ tyajati tathājīvaḥ pralīyate|| 5.19 || paramātmani vaikuṇṭhe samādhisthasya yoginaḥ| acirātparame tatve hyabhilāṣaḥ pravartate|| 5.20 || tamupāyaṃ pravakṣyāmi śrūyatāṃ kamalāsana| dvādaśākṣaramabhyasya paramātmadhiyā harim|| 5.21 || asūryabhūmau likhīte cakrapadme sulakṣaṇe| tasyopari suvistīrṇe samāsīnaḥ kuśāsane|| 5.22 || badhvā padmāsanaṃ yogī site pakṣe tathottare| ayane śvasanaṃ pūrvaṃ dhārayitvā yathāpuram|| 5.23 || dehamadhyasthitaṃ vahniṃ dīpayitvā samujjvalam| hṛtpuṇḍarīka madhyasthaṃ smaranbrahma sanātanam|| 5.24 || vidyatsahasra saṅkāśaṃ yugāntānalasannibham| tanmayaṃ ca svacaitanyaṃ kṛtvā tadvahniraśmibhiḥ|| 5.25 || bhūtadehaṃ dahetkṛtsnaṃ dagdhvā mantra svarūpadhṛk| muktāṇḍa iva pakṣīśa āsīnaṃ cantayecchanaiḥ|| 5.26 || śanaiḥ pariṇatāṃ mantratanuṃ tejomayīṃ sadā| cinmayīṃ sarvagāṃ śabdasvarūpāṃ bhāvayannapi|| 5.27 || śanaiśśanai rasthirāṃ ca vinivārya tata ssvayam| brahma saṃpadyate yogī na bhūyassaṃsare diha|| 5.28 || ityevaṃ yogasaro'yaṃ kathitaḥ kamalāsana| nityaṃ kriyā tatparāṇāṃ saṃsāracakitātmanām|| 5. 29 || madbhaktānāṃ dīkṣitānāṃ vācyo'yamupasīdatām|| idaṃ bhavaharaṃ puṇyaṃ yogaṃ sarvārthasiddhidam|| 5.30 || yo dhīte gurvanujñātassayāti paramāṃ gatim|| iti śrī pāñcarātre mahūpaniṣadi pādmasaṃhitāyāṃ yogapade yogalakṣaṇaṃ nāma pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ |
yogapādassamāptaḥ |
<2.1>
brahmāḥ bhagavan devadeveśa śajkhacakragadādhara| jñānayogau ca kārtsnyena nirvāṇaphaladau śrutau|| 1.1 || tayo raviduṣāṃ deva nādhikāraḥ kadācana| ajñānināṃ ca bhaktānāṃ gatiṃ cāpīcchatāṃ nṛṇām|| 1.2 || yenopāyena nirvaṇa phalaṃ svargādicetarat| bhavatyupāyaṃ tamṛjumupadeṣṭuṃ tvamarhasi|| 1.3 || idamanyacca vaktavyaṃ yadi mayyastyanugrahaḥ| tvadarcane ko'bhyupāyaḥ kathyatāṃ madhusūdana|| 1.4 || śrībhagavān kṛtvā pratinidhiṃ samyagdhāruloha śīlādibhiḥ| tat sthāpayitvā matthyāne śāstradṛṣṭena vartmanā|| 1.5 || yajasva māṃ vakṣyamāṇa vidhinā kamalāsana| karṣaṇādipratiṣṭhānta kriyāvidhimataśśruṇu|| 1.6 || vakṣyāmi yena vadhinā prasīdāmyacarādaham| adhītino yevidyāsu śāstrāṇi śrutapūrviṇaḥ|| 1.7 || te māṃ bhajante puruṣā jñānayogaparāyaṇāḥ| anyeṣāmapyaviduṣāṃ bhaktānāṃ bahusampadām|| 1.8 || jāyate siddhiracirāt sthāne sthāpayatāṃ ca mām| jñānaṃ yogaśca yadidaṃ kevalaṃ mukti kāraṇam|| 1.9 || sthāpayutvā tu māṃ sthāne puruṣassatvamaśnute| yo māṃ saṃsthāpya sadane samārādhayati svayam|| 1.10 || na tasya kevalaṃ sidthiḥ sthānābhyarṇajuṣāmapi| tasmātsarvā brahman sthāne māṃ sthāpayetpumān|| 1.11 || dvividhaṃ sthānamākhyātaṃ siddhāsiddhaprabhedataḥ| mūle mūrdani śailānāṃ nadyāstīre ca saṅgame|| 1.12 || samudratīre puline hrade tīrttheca kānane| e teṣu nirmitaṃ sthānaṃ siddhākhyaṃ viśvakarmaṇā|| 1.13 || masuṣyairnimitaṃ sthānaṃ nagarādi kṛtaṃ mama| asiddhāyatanaṃ viddhi grāmādisthiti hetukam|| 1.14 || śraddhāvānāstiko bhakto dhanadhānya samṛddhimān|| 1.15 || mahotsāhaśśucirdakṣaḥ kṛtajño lo bhavarjitaḥ| brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyo vaiśva śśūdro vāpyanulomajaḥ|| 1.16 || jānīhi yahamā naṃ taṃ sarvaissamuditaṃ guṇaiḥ| pañcarātravidaṃ śāntaṃ siddhānteṣu kṛtaśramam|| 1.17 || bhagavadvaṃśajaṃ śuddha malolupamadāmbhikam| apāpamṛjumavyādhi madṛṣṭaparamāstikam|| 1.18 || taṃ bhāgavatamācāryāṃ prathamaṃ varayotsudhīḥ| ācāryo yajamānaśca daivajñena śubhe dine|| 1.19 || grāmādi sthāpanāyādau nimittāni parīkṣayet| śubhe nimitte grāmādīnārabheta vicakṣaṇaḥ|| 1.20 || bhūparīkṣādikaṃ sarvaṃ rathakāreṇa vai saha| ācāryaḥ pañcarātrajñaḥ kuryādabhyuditakramāt|| 1.21 || supadmā bhadrakā pūrṇā dhumrā ceti caturvidhā| bhūmistu lakṣaṇaṃ tāsāṃ krameṇopadiśāmi te|| 1.22 || campakāgugurakarphūra kadambatilakārjanaiḥ| kramukairnāli keraiśca kuśakāśaissamāvṛtā|| 1.23 || padmotpala samākīrṇā prāgudakpravaṇā śubhā| yā ca toyāvṛtā bhūmissā supadmeti kīrtitā|| 1.24 || nadīsāgara pārśvasthā tīrthāyatanamāśritā| kṣīra vṛkṣasamākīrṇā phalavṛkṣa samākulā|| 1.25 || udyānopavano petā latāgulma samāvṛtā| yajñavṛkṣāḥ kuśāḥ kāśāḥ vrīhikṣetraṃ tu yatra vai|| 1.26 || adhojalasamopetā bhadrakā iti sāsmṛtā| kuluttha nimbaniṣpāva kodravaśyāmakānvitā|| 1.27 || girisārśva sthitā caiva gireśśikharamāśritā| aprabhūtodakā bhūmi ssā pūrṇeti prakīrtitā|| 1.28 || yavaveṇvādisaṅkīrṇā snuhiśleṣmātakānvitā| vibhītakārkasaṅkīrṇā kaṭhinā śarkarānvitā|| 1.29 || vāyasaśyenagṛdhrāḍhyā gomāyuvṛkasaṅkulā| ūṣarādyessamopetā sā dhumreti prakrīrtitā|| 1.30 || supadmā śāntidā bhūmi ssakhadā bhadrakābhavet| supūrṇā puṣidā pūmiḥ kṣayadādhūmrakā bhavet|| 1.31 || daṇḍamātrāyatāṃ bhūmiṃ tāvadvistārasaṃyutām| jānumātraṃ khanedbhūmi mṛdbistābhiśca pūrayet|| 1.32 || adhike cottamā bhūmissamaṃ cenmadhyamā bhavet| nyūne'dhamāṃ vijānīyā ttāṃ bhūmiṃ varjayedhbudhaḥ|| 1.33 || śālimudgayavādīnā muptvābhījāni vai bhuvi| parīkṣakaḥ parīkṣeta praśastāmathavetarām|| 1.34 || aṅkaro jāyate yatra trirātrā bhyantare mahīm| tāmuttamāṃ vijānīyā tpañcarātriṣu madhyamām|| 1.35 || adhamāsaptarātre syā dadṛśye vā tadaṅkure| varjayedadhamāṃ bhūmiṃ sthāpayedanyayordvayoḥ|| 1.36 || kuśapālāśahariṇā ssanti yatra svayaṃ bhuvi| adhamāmapi tāṃ viddhi praśastāṃ kamalāsana|| 1.37 || rasena madhureṇorvī muttamāṃ kaṭukātmikām| madhyamāmadhamāmalpāṃ rasairanyaiśca viddhitām|| 1.38 || śveta rṇottamābhūmi rmadhyamā pītalohinī| adhamā kṛṣṇavarṇā syādityetadbhūmilakṣaṇam|| 1.39 || vāstuvidyāsu kṛtinā kriyāsu nipuṇena ca| rathakāreṇa sahitaḥ kuśalaḥ pañcarātravit|| 1.40 || ācāryaḥ prathamaṃ kuryātpraveśabalimuttamam| ācāryo yajamānena sahito vāstusīmani|| 1.41 || nṛttairvādyaiśca tūryaiśca tathā maṅkalapaṭhakaiḥ| pūrṇakumbhai stathā dīpai rdhvajacchatrasamanvitaiḥ|| 1.42 || brāhmaṇai rjñānasampannai radhīyānairbahuśrutaiḥ| pradakṣiṇaṃ parikramya mantrai ssvastyayanairapi|| 1.43 || vidikṣu dikṣu pūrvādibaliṃ kuryātsamantataḥ| bhūtānāṃ ca piśācānāṃ rakṣasāṃ ditijasmanām|| 1.44 || grahāṇāmapi nāgānā manyeṣāṃ ca baliṃ kṣipet| brahmasthāne prayatnena pāyasena mahīsuraḥ|| 1.45 || baliṃ prakṣipya tadanu mantrametamudīrayet| bhūtāḥ piśācā nāgāśca asurā rākṣasā grahāḥ|| 1.46 || sarve te vyapagacchantu balituṣṭā yathāyatham| devānāṃ ca dvijānāṃ ca sthānāṃ samyakkaromyaham|| 1.47 || vāsudevasya devasya sarvabhūtātmakasya ca| āstramantraiṇa saṃsiddhān siddhārthān sarvataḥ kṣīpet|| 1.48 || kṛtvā baliṃ yathāśāstraṃ sūtrāṇyapi ca pātayet| śilāssaṃsthāpaye ttatra sutrasandhiṣu sarvataḥ|| 1.49 || adhomukhaṃ prākchirasaṃ vinyasedvāstupūruṣam| prasārya pāṇipadau dvau koṇabhūṣu prakalpitau|| 1.50 || evaṃ dhyātvā samabhyarccya puruṣaṃ vāstukalpitam| tasya dakṣiṇapārśve tu vāstuhomaṃ prakalpayet|| 1.51 || sthaṇḍile dīpayitvā'gniṃ pañcopaniṣadā ghṛtam| sahasraṃ vā śataṃ vāpi juhuyādvāstuśāntaye|| 1.52 || apāmārgasya śamyāśca khadirasya yathākramam| yakṣarakṣaḥ piśācānāṃ samidho juhuyātsvayam|| 1.53 || hutvā tu mulamantrābhyāṃ pṛthagaṣṭottaraṃ śatam| vāstunāthasya mantreṇa caruṇā juhuyācchatam|| 1.54 || pūrṇāhutiṃ tato hutvātvindhrādīnāṃ baliṃ kṣipet| dikṣvaṣṭasu yathā tmīyamevaṃ grāmādi kalpayet|| 1.55 || iti śrī pāñcarātre mahopaniṣadi padmetantre kriyāpāde grāmasvīkāro nāma prathamo'dhyāyaḥ|
<2.2>
krāmādīnāṃ caturvarga phaladānāṃ yathākramam| svarūpaṃ tatra bhedaṃ ca vakṣyāmi tava sāmpratam|| 2.1 || vasanti brāhmaṇā yatra sthāne grāmassa ucyate| agrahāraśca tasyaina nāmadhe yamiti smṛtam|| 2.2 || kṣatriyāṇāṃ tathā vāsaḥ puraṃ nagaramityapi| vaiśyānāṃ pattanaṃ vāso malikā kulamityapi|| 2.3 || daṇḍakaṃ svastikaṃ caiva prastaraṃ ca prakīrṇakam| nandyāvartaṃ patākaṃ ca padmaṃ ca śrīpratiṣṭhitam|| 2.4 || grāmādi ṣu prabhedo'sau śruṇu te ṣāṃ ca lakṣaṇam| pūrvāgra muttarāgraṃ ca yāvanmānaṃ bhavedatha|| 2.5 || daṇḍavattu bhavedvīdhī taddhaṇḍakamudāhṛtam| purvāgra muttarāgraṃ ca kṛtvā vīdhī dvayaṃ punaḥ|| 2.6 || dakṣiṇābhimukho bhūtvā pūrvavīdhyāṃ tu nirgamaḥ| paścimābhimukho bhutvā dakṣiṇena tu nirgamaḥ|| 2.7 || uttarābhimukho bhūtvā paścimena tu nirgamaḥ| prāṅmukhastu tato bhūtvā saumyavīdhyā tu nirgamaḥ|| 2.8 || evaṃ prakalpito grāmassvastikāhvaya iṣyate| evameva tu sarveṣāṃ grāmādīnāṃ tu nirgamaḥ|| 2.9 || dvicatuḥ pañcaṣaṭsapta vīdhayaścedudaṅmukhāḥ| prāṅmukhaistu tribhiryuktaḥ prastaraḥ parikīrtyate|| 2.10 || pūrvāgra muttarāgraṃ ca rathyābhistisṛbhiryutam| prakīrṇakamidaṃ jñeya mabhipretārthasādhanam|| 2.11 || vūrve tu dakṣiṇe caiva paścime cottare tathā| grāmasya nirgamaścaiva caturdikṣu vidhīyate|| 2.12 || trayodaśādyairvīdhībhi rektekamadhikaṃ bhavet| nandyāvartaṃ bhavetpañca pañcabhiḥ prāṅmukhai ryutam|| 2.13 || aṣṭādāśādhyairekaikaṃ vardhate pañcabhistathā| udaṅmukhaiḥ patākam syāt prāṅmukhaiṣṣaḍbhireva ca|| 2.14 || trayoviṃśativīdhīnā mādyaiḥ pañcāpyudaṅmukhaiḥ| naptabhiḥ prāñmukheryuktaṃ padmagrāma mudāhṛtam|| 2.15 || aṣṭāviśativīdhīnāṃ pūrvābhiścā pyudaṅmukhaiḥ| aṣṭabhiḥ prāṅmukhairyuktaṃ śripratiṣṭhita mucyate|| 2.16 || evamaṣṭā vidhāḥ proktā grāmādīnāṃ samānataḥ| grāmādiṃ pañcadhā kṛtvā bhāgamekaṃ bahistyajet|| 2.17 || brāhmaṃ daivaṃ mānuṣaṃ ca paiśācamiti tatpunaḥ| catuṣṭayīṃ vijānīyādbhāgānāṃ tatra daivike|| 2.18 || mānuṣe ca dvijātīnāṃ gṛhāṇi parikalpayet| peśāce dai vadhiṣṇyāni dikṣvaṣṭāsu ca madhyame|| 2.19 || grāmasya garbhavinyāso dvijānāṃ sthāpanātpurā| madhye kuryāt purāṇāṃ tu diśyaindadryāṃ pattaneṣu ca|| 2.20 || kauberyāṃ diśi garbhasya nyāsa evamudāhṛtaḥ| dhātulohāni ratnāni kandaṃ bījaṃ mṛdaṃ tathā|| 2.21 || bhājane lohaje kṛtvā dārave mṛṇmaye'pivā| upoṣitaśśucissnātvā navavastrottarīyakaḥ|| 2.22 || rātrau muhūrte samprāpai garbhādhānaṃ samācaret| ādāya bhājanaṃ paścātsvamātmānaṃ hariṃ smaret|| 2.23 || dhyātvā tu vasudhāṃ devīṃ mantrametamudīrayet| sarvabhūtadhare kānte parvatastana maṇḍite|| 2.24 || samudraparidhānīye devi garbhaṃ samāśraya| śvabhraṃ mṛdbhistatassamya kpūrayitvā samantataḥ|| 2.25 || pañcarātraṃ trirātraṃ vā rakṣāṃ kuryādatandhritaḥ| śataniṣkaṃ tadardhaṃ vā tadardhamathavāpi vā|| 2.26 || śraddhayā dakṣiṇāṃ dadyādācāryāyāgrahārakṛt| dviguṇaṃ triguṇaṃ niṣkaṃ purādau dakṣiṇā smṛtā|| 2.27 || garbhanyāse kṛte paścāt dvajān saṃveśayedgṛhe | vāstudevān yathānyāyaṃ krameṇa sthāpayetsudhīḥ|| 2.28 || sthāpayedgrāmamadhye tu pañcamūrtimayaṃ harim| viprāṇāṃ pañcayajñoyameva sāphalyamaśnute|| 2.29 || cāturāśramyasaṃddhyardhaṃ caturmūrtimathāpi vā| sarvārthamekamūtiṃ vā grāmamadhye samarcayet|| 2.30 || yoginaṃ bhoginaṃ vāpi kārayedacyutaṃ prabhum| āsīnaṃ vā śayānaṃ vā tiṣṭhantaṃ vā samarcayet|| 2.31 || sṛṣṭikṛdbhogaśayanaṃ devadevasya kīrtyate| saṃhāraṃ bhogaśayanam tathā sanaharervapuḥ|| 2.32 || viśvarūpadharaṃ devaṃ jāmadagnyaṃ ca nārcayet| prāgdvāraṃ sukhadaṃ viddhi paścimaṃ puṣṭivardhanam|| 2.33 || dhanadaṃ cottaraṃ dvāraṃ yāmyaṃ ca mokṣadam| aindretu bhāskarasthānaṃ pratyagdvāraṃ tu kalpayet|| 2.34 || pāvake madanasthānaṃ pratyagdhvāraṃ prakalpayet| subrahmaṇyasya yāmye syātpūrvadvārani ketanam|| 2.35 || nairṛte vighna rāhasya pūrvadvāraṃ prakalpayet| vāruṇyāṃ sthāpayedvīṣṇuṃ śrībhūmisahitaṃ sthitam|| 2.36 || āsīnaṃ vā śriyo petaṃ garuḍārūḍhameva vā| viśvarūpadharaṃ bhogaśayanaṃ vā prakalpayet|| 2.37 || prāṅmukhaṃ tu prakurvīta paścime viṣṇumandiram| paścime tu śrīyasthsānamatha vā kalpayedbhudhaḥ|| 2.38 || vāyavyāṃ prāṅmukhaṃ sthānaṃ durgāyai parikalpayet| dhānadaṃ cottare sthānaṃ jṛmbhalādisamanvitam|| 2.39 || aiśānyāmaiśvaraṃ sthānaṃ someśānāntare'pi vā| ingreśānāntare vāpi nānyatra parikalpayet|| 2.40 || āgreyyāṃ ca mahāmoṭīṃ grāmāddhūratare sthitām| nairṛte caiva śāstāraṃ grāmāddhūratare sthitam|| 2.41 || grāmasya cottare vārśve kiñciddhūratare sthitam| mātṛsthānaṃ bhavettatra sarvāstāścottarānanāḥ|| 2.42 || aiśānā vātha mātṝṇāṃ nātidūre gṛhaṃ bhavet| āgneyyāṃ vā guhaṃ durgāṃ vāyusomāntare'pi vā|| 2.43 || rajju pāta śriśūlasūtrasandhyādiṣu devasthāna gṛhādīnāṃ niṣedhaḥ| rajjupā teṣu sarvatra triśūle sūtrasandhaṣu| devasthānaṃ na kartavyaṃ vīdhyagreṣu viśeṣataḥ|| 2.44 || gṛhāśca naiva kartavyāstatra vaṃśarddhimacchatā| pramādāstuṣu kuryāccet grāmādīnāṃ kṣayo bhavet|| 2.45 || mantrahānau kriyāhānau havyavyādi karmasu| prāyaścittaṃ bhavettasya grāmamadhyārcanaṃ hare|| 2.46 || ārādhane bhāskarasya grāme rogo na jāyate| saubhāgyasaumyasaundharyaguṇāḥ kāmasya pūjanāt|| 2.47 || bhūtādayo nṛṇāṃ naiva bhaveyurguha pūjanāt|| sarvavighnā vinaśyanti vighna rājasya pūjanāt|| 2.48 || vāruṇyāṃ pūjayedviṣṇuṃ bhuktimukti phalapradam| durgāṃ sampūjayeddevīṃ nityamāyurvivṛddhaye|| 2.49 || dhanadhānyamṛddhissyātku bera paricaryayā| jñānavanto narāssarve bhaveyuśśivapūjanāt|| 2.50 || moṭīpūjanayā caiva bālānāṃ na vipadbhavet| śāstuḥ pūjanayā caiva puṣanti grāmavāsinaḥ|| 2.51 || mātṛpūjanayā nityaṃ piśācā naiva pīḍakāḥ| pure ca malikāyāṃ ca madhye na sthāpayeddharim|| 2.52 || vāse'nulomajānāṃ ca madhyena harimarcayet| śūdrāṇāṃ pratilomānāṃ sa vāstu na ca devatā|| 2.53 || yadi syādavivekena rājā rāṣṭraṃ ca naśyati| devotsavārdhe grāmādau vāttedevānna kalpayet|| 2.54 || aṅgino naiva svāṅgāni kalpayanti svata ntravat| kalpayeyuḥ prajā nāṃ ca rāṣṭrasya pratikūlakāḥ|| 2.55 || mūrtīnāṃ keśavādīnāṃ matsyādīnāṃ tathaiva ca| antarāleṣu sarvaṣu dikṣu caiva vidakṣu ca|| 2.56 || sarvatra bhagavadgehaṃ grāmādau kārayetsudhīḥ| grāmaprekṣaṃ na kurvīta ugramugrāyudhodyatam|| 2.57 || jāmadagnyaṃ nṛsiṃhaṃ ca saṃhāraśayanaṃ tathā| sarvatra bhogaśayanaṃ bhogasthānaṃ tadhaiva ca|| 2.58 || bhogāsanaṃca sarvatra śayanaṃ sṛṣṭhisaṃjñitam| yānakaṃ ca kriyopetaṃ sarvatraivatu kārayet|| 2.59 || grāmāntare na kūrvīta sthānaṃ deśasya śūlinaḥ| vinaśyatyacirādghrāmo rājā rāṣṭraṃ tathaiva ca|| 2.60 || tassāddhūratare kuryāt grāmādīnamumāpatim| evaṃ saṃsthāpya digdevān pūjakaḥ pūjayetkramāt|| 2.61 || viṣṇorbhāgavataireva pañcarātraparāyaṇaiḥ| pūjā kāryā na sāmānya devatāmātṛpūjakaiḥ|| 2.62 || śīvasya śivaśāstrajñaiḥ pūjanaṃ ca śivadvijaiḥ| somapābhi rdvijaśreṣṭhaiḥ kāryaṃ dinaka rārcanam|| 2.63 || madanaṃ gaṇanāthaṃ ca subrahmaṇyaṃ śivadvijaḥ| pūjayeddhanadādīnāṃ pūjako vipra iiṣyate|| 2.64 || durgāṃ sampūjayeddhevīṃ sadā bhāgavatassvayam| mātṝṇāmarcanaṃ kāryaṃ tat jñaiḥ pāraśavaistathā|| 2.65 || śāstāraṃ ca māhāmoṭīṃ kulālaḥ pūjayetsadā| svarṇāmbhaṣṭhakalābhijñān grāmasyāntaḥ prakalpayet|| 2.66 || anyeṣāṃ pratilomānāṃ bahirgrāmātprakalpayet| prācyāṃ diśyanulomānāṃ sthāpanaṃ karmiṇāṃ bhavet|| 2.67 || sarveṣāṃ pratilomānāṃ dakṣiṇādiṣu kalpanam| śreṇībhyo'pi bahirdūre caṇḍālā nairṛte smṛtāḥ|| 2.68 || grāmasya cottare dūreśmaśānaṃ udakāśaye| yāmye taṭe taṭākasya śśaśānaṃ syāddvijanmanām|| 2.69 || sarveṣāmanulomānāṃ dāhaḥ prācyādirodhasaṃ| anyeṣāṃ pratilomānāṃ diśaḥ prācyādayo viduḥ| itthaṃ prakalpayedgrāmaṃ nagaraṃ kulameva vā|| 2.70 || muktimāpnoti puruṣaḥ punarnehopajāyate| upakurvantī ye martyā dravyairvā mānasena vā|| 2.71 || svargaloke vasantyete kālaṃ kalpāvasānikam| rakṣanti ye yathāklṛptaṃ grāmādīn pṛthivīśvarāḥ|| 2.72 || te ya…
<2.3>
śrībhagavān brahman mandiranirmāṇaṃ tava vakṣyāmi tacchruṇu| pūrvoktāṃ bhūmimāsātya praveśabalipūrvakam|| 3.1 || bhūmiṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā mantrametamudīrayet| yakṣāḥ piśācā nāgāśca ye'tra tiṣṭhanti sarvadā|| 3.2 || sarve'pa yāntu te'nyatra viṣṇoḥ sthānaṃ karomyahaṃ| tatrāstramantrasaṃsiddhān siddhārthān sarvataḥ kṣipet|| 3.3 || lūrvavadvāstuhomaṃ ca kuryādvāstubaliṃ tathā| tato bhāgavatācāryo ha lena vilikhedbhuvam|| 3.4 || brāhmaṇo yajamānassyā daऩḍvān gauravarṇakaḥ| kṣatriyo lohito vaiśyaḥ pītaśśūdrastu mecakaḥ|| 3.5 || yathokta varṇālābhetu kapilo gaura eva vā| ṛṣabhau raktavarṇau tu mahantau sabalau matau|| 3.6 || kṣālayetkhuraśṛṅgādīn bhūṣayetkanakādibhiḥ| halaṃ yugaṃ ca pālāśaṃ bhrāhmaṇasya vidīyate|| 3.7 || nyagrodhaṃ kṣatriyasya syāt plākṣaṃ viṭchūdrayo rbhavet| nyagrodhapippalau syātāṃ sarveṣāṃ yugalāṅgalau|| 3.8 || sarveṣāmeva varṇānāṃ sauvarṇaḥ kuśiko bhavet| rājataṃ tāmramathavā yoktraṃ teṣāṃ yathākramam|| 3.9 || kuśā dhanurjyā vīraṇyaḥ kāśā rajjuśca tanmayī| halabhūtaṃ ca medhiṃ ca kārayedekayonikam|| 3.10 || snāto navāmbaradhara ssoṣṭhīṣaśśucirātmavān| mālyānulepa nāyuktassottarīyaparicchadaḥ|| 3.11 || bhūṣitassvayamācāryaḥ padau prakṣālayettataḥ| ācamyāyamya ca prāṇā nnyāsaṃ kṛtvā yathāvidhi|| 3.12 || dvijendrairabhyanujñātaḥ karṣaṇaṃ prārabhettataḥ| puṇyāhaṃ vācayitvātu vaiṣṇavairmantravittamaiḥ|| 3.13 || yojayedvṛṣabhaskandhe yugaṃ vai mūlavidyayā| lāṅgalaṃ ca yugenaiva yojayedvidyayā tayā|| 3.14 || sumuhurte sulagne ca karṣayetprāṅmukhasthsitaḥ| bherīpaṭahaśaṅkhādīn ghoṣayetsarvadikṣu ca|| 3.15 || sūktaṃ śākunakaṃ viprāḥ paṭheyussarvaśāntidam| hṛtsaroje ca māṃ dhyāyedvidyārūpeṇa cakṣuṣā|| 3.16 || daṇḍaṃ pravayaṇaṃ kuryātpālāśādimahīruhām| ādāya todanaṃ paścātpīḍa yet huṃphaḍādinā|| 3.17 || prāṅmukhaḥ prathamaṃ brahman karṣayenmūlavidyayā| sūktena pauruṣeṇaiva dvatīyaṃ bhūmikarṣaṇam|| 3.18 || tṛtīyaṃ viṣṇusūktena tadgāyatyrā turīyakam| nārāyaṇāsuvākena karṣaṇaṃ pañcamaṃ smṛtam|| 3.19 || pāñcopaniṣadairmantraiṣṣaṣṭhaṃ syādbhūmikarṣaṇam| saptamaṃ bhūmisū ktena karṣayeddeśikottamaḥ|| 3.20 || pradakṣiṇakrameṇaiva sītā syātkamalāsana| dakṣiṇettarata stadvatkarṣayetpañca rātravit|| 3.21 || nimittāni parīkṣeta tatkāle deśikottamaḥ| deśikasya manastuṣṭistatkāle śarmaṇe bhavet|| 3.22 || viparyaye kṣayaṃ viddhi prāsāda yajamānayoḥ| anaḍvacchayane caiva yoktrādīnāṃ ca bhedane|| 3.23 || vyatyāse bhramaṇe caiva durnimittoda yetathā| ardhacchedo bhavetsūtrau svāmino maraṇaṃ dhruvam|| 3.24 || tṛtīyabhāge ccede ca rāṣṭrakṣobho bhaveddhruvam| vicchede'pi caturbhāge prayoktṛbhraṃśa ucyate|| 3.25 || pañcopaniṣadā kuryācchataṃ vārān ghṛtāhatīḥ| śāmyanti doṣāste sarve nārtimṛcchetprayojakaḥ|| 3.26 || ācāryo yajamānastu brāhmaṇān bhojayeddhanaiḥ| kṛṣṭā bhuvaṃ samīkuryādyatnena mahatāvṛtaḥ|| 3.27 || ālavālān pṛthakkṛtvā jalakulyāsamanvitān| śālimudgamavādīni tatra bījāni vāpayet|| 3.28 || siktaṃ pratidinaṃ kṣetraṃ toyena mahātā bhavet| rakṣāṃ ca kuryā dyatnena paripākāsānikam|| 3.29 || pakvaṃ lunīyāttatkṣetramāna yedgo kulāni tat| phale mahati taddhāma dīrghakālaṃ bhaviṣyati|| 3.30 || alpe tvalpataraṃ kālaṃ prāsāde sannidhirhareḥ| phalahīne bhaveddhāma prakṣīṇadhanadhānyakam|| 3.31 || brāhmaṇān bhojayettatra sahasraṃ śatameva vā| bhuktavadbhyo dhanaṃ dadyādbhrāhmaṇebhyo gavādikam|| 3.32 || prokṣayetpaṃcagavyena pañcopaniṣadā bhuvam| kuddhālairvā khanitrervā yāvadambhaḥ khanet kṣitim|| 3.33 || prathamāvaraṇaṃ yāvattāvadvistāra iṣyate| daṇḍamātrāyataṃ khātaṃ khanedvākamalāsana|| 3.34 || kṣetradoṣānurūpeṇa mandiro cchrayaṇe pi vā| bhutale khanyamāne tu bhasmāṅgāratuṣādikam|| 3.35 || duṣṭasatvopalambhe tu krimikīṭādirśane| juhuyācchāntaye teṣāmācāryassarpirādinā|| 3.36 || brāhmaṇebhyo yathā śakti dadyāddhemādikaṃ dhanam| rantādidarśane dhāma samṛddhaṃ sarvadā bhavet|| 3.37 || khātyā homaṃ bahiḥ khātāt sthaṇḍile caturaśrake| sthāpayitvāgni mādīpya kuryādājyena deśikaḥ|| 3.38 || mūlamantreṇa sūktena pauruṣeṇa caruṃ punaḥ| guggulaṃ tilanīvāraṃ juhuyānmūlavidyayā|| 3.39 || puṇyāhaṃ vācayitvā tu śāliṃ khāte vinikṣipet| kumbhānupari śālīnāṃ sūtravastrādiveṣṭhitān|| 3.40 || kurmbhā lohamayāḥ proktā stadabhāve tu mṛṇmayā| ādhāraśaktiṃ sauvarṇīṃ kṛtvā kurmbhe vinikṣipet|| 3.41 || madhyame tadanu prācyāṃ kurmbhe bījāni nikṣipet| āgneyyāṃ sarvalohāni sarvadhātūni dakṣiṇe|| 3.42 || puṇyatīrdha mṛdaṃ kumbhe nairṛte vāruṇe punaḥ| madhunā pūrayetkumbhaṃ vāyavīyaṃ tu sarpiṣā|| 3.43 || ratnairdhāneśvare kumbhe aiśāne śailamṛttikām| nikṣipenmadhyakurmbhe tu śālikṣetramṛdaṃ tathā|| 3.44 || aśoṣyahradasambhūtāṃ valmīkabhavamṛttikām| kandāni cotpalādīnāṃ prakṣipetpraṅmukhaḥ sthitaḥ|| 3.45 || loharatnāni ca tathā nidadhyā ddharbhakūrcakam 15| apidadhyāccharāveṇa krameṇa pari pūjayet|| 3.46 || kumbhasyopari madhyasya kumbhamanyaṃ niveśayet| vidhāya kurmaṃ kālāgniṃ sauvarṇaṃ tatra nikṣipet|| 3.47 || kumbhaṃ tṛtīyaṃ vinyasya tatrānantākṛtiṃ kṣipet| caturthaṃ vasudhādhāramupariṣṭādghaṭaṃkṣipet|| 3.48 || gandhodakena tatkumbhān pūrayitvā samarcayet| khātamṛdbhiśca puṇyābhiraspṛṣṭābhiśca duṣaṇaiḥ|| 3.49 || pūrayedvālukābhiśca jalaiścopari pūrayet| hāsti pādairdhrṛḍhaṃ kṛtvā punastoyaiśca pūrayet|| 3.50 || iti śrī pāñca rātre mahopaniṣadi pādmasaṃhitāyāṃ kriyāpāde karṣaṇavidhirnāma tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ |
<2.4>
brahmāḥ ārabhyamāṇe prāsāde grāmādau ca janārdana| ye vighnakāriṇo daityayakṣarākṣasadānavāḥ|| 4.1 || teṣāṃ bhavedyathāśāntastadbhrūhi bhagavanmama| śrībhagavān kṛtvā bālagṛhaṃ pūrvaṃ tatra māmarcayetsudhīḥ|| 4.2 || pratyūhakāriṇassarve tena śāmyanti te dhruvam| grāmādiścācirādeva niṣṭratyūhaṃ samāpyate|| 4.3 || indreśānānta re vāpi someśānāntare'pi vā| indrāgnimadhye vā madhye pāvakasya yamasya ca|| 4.4 || yamasya nirṛ termadhye nirṛtervaruṇasyavā| madhye varuṇavāyorvā vāyossomasya vāntare|| 4.5 || yathābhimatameteṣāmārambhāyatanaṃ prati| sthāne bālagṛhaṃ vidyātsaptapañcatrihastakam|| 4.6 || dhāmne mūlasya valabhiddhiśi yatra prakalpitam| dvāraṃ bālālayasyāpi tatraina parikalpayet|| 4.7 || bimbhaṃ bālālaye lohamāśmanaṃ vā'tha dāravam| śaṅkacakragadā padmadivyāyudhacaturbhujam|| 4.8 || utsedhantasya bimbasya hrāse pañcāṅgulo bhavet| trayaśca viṃśatiścaiva vṛddhāvaṅgulayaḥ smṛtāḥ|| 4.9 || mānaṃ sukhāvahaṃ yatsyādyajamānasya tadbhavet| matsyādiṣvavatāreṣu kalpeṣvārabhya mandire|| 4.10 || bālālaye'pi tadvatsyādviśvarūpe caturbhujaḥ| yānake yānakaṃ vāpi sthāpanaṃ vāpi kalpayet|| 4.11 || jale'dhivāsya tadbimbaṃ maṇḍape cādhivāsayet| bālālayasya madhye vā bhāge divye'pi vāṃśake|| 4.12 || mekhalātrayasaṃ yuktāṃ vediṃ hastasamucchritām| kṛtvāprabhāte vimale muhūrte śobhane guruḥ|| 4.13 || mūlamantreṇa vedyāṃ tu bālabimbhaṃ niveśayete| sthāpayitvā hariṃ tatra mantraṃ nyasyedyathāvidhi|| 4.14 || prārthayeta harestatra sannidhiṃ bālamandire| āmūladhāmanirvṛtti samayā ddeśikottamaḥ|| 4.15 || pūjāṃ gṛhṇīṣva bhagavannasmiṃstvaṃ bāla sadmani| śamayan mūladhiṣṇasya vighnakṛddhaityasantatim|| 4.16 || iti vijñāpya natyā ca parivārān prakalpayet| dvāre caṇḍaṃ pracaṇḍaṃ ca kṣetrapālaṃ khageśvaram|| 4.17 || indrādīn lokapālāṃśca svāsu dikṣu prakalpayet| seneśamīśakoṇe tu gaṇeśaṃ nairṛte yajet|| 4.18 || āśarīragatān devān sthaṇḍile pūjayedbhudhaḥ| sthaṇḍilaṃ hastamātraṃ tu mekhalātrayasaṃyutam|| 4.19 || vṛttaṃ vā caturaśraṃ vā kṛtvā tatra samarcayet| kumudādigaṇān sarvān mahāpīṭhe samarcayet|| 4.20 || evaṃ saṃsthāpya medhāvī kuryādantemahotsavam| dhvajārohaṇapūrvaṃ syātpuṣpayāgāvasānikam|| 4.21 || ekāhamathavā kuryādutsavaṃ bālamandire| lohajaṃ bālabhimbaṃ cettenai votsavamācaret|| 4.22 || nityaṃ naimittikaṃ kāmyaṃ karma bālālaye bhavet| utsavārthaṃ na cedbimbaṃ bālenai votsavo bhavet|| 4.23 || na kuryāttatra vinyāsaṃ caturthasnapanaṃ tathā| ārabheta sthapatibhissākaṃ rathakṛdālayam| mukhyaṃ śilāmayaṃ gehaṃ madhyamaṃ ceṣṭakādikam|| 4.24 || jaghanyaṃ dārujaṃ vidyānmṛṇmayaṃ heyamucyate| miśrai śśailādibhirdavyairekānekatvayogataḥ|| 4.25 || sañcitāsañcite syātāmupasañcitameva vā| dravyeṇai kena yaddhāma sthūpyantaṃ parikalpitam|| 4.26 || śreṣṭhaṃ tatsañcitaṃ vidyāddravyayugmamasañcitam| sadanaṃ madhyamaṃ tatsyānmṛdbhirdārvādibhiḥ kṛtam|| 4.27 || upasañcitamākhyātamadhamaṃ dhāma tadbhavet| garbhayuktaśilādāru varjayeddhevatā'laye|| 4.28 || kuryāccedāmayī sa syādyajamāno na saṃśayaḥ| devatā ntarasadmasthaṃ na guhṇīyācchilādikam|| 4.29 || tenaiva sadanaṃ kurvannāśayedvaṃśamātmanaḥ| pacyate narake ghore jāyate ca śvayoniṣu|| 4.30 || maṭhakūpataṭākāderapyagrāhyaṃ śilādikam| narake pacyate ghore jāyate nirdanaśca saḥ|| 4.31 || vāsudevālayāddhāru ṣāṣāṇaṃ vā tadiṣṭakān| guhītvā dhiṣṇyanimān ṇe kartā duḥkhai kabhājanam|| 4.32 || paryāyeṇa prajedghorān narakānbhṛśadāruṇān| pacyate teṣu dukheṣu paryāyeṇa sadā naraḥ|| 4.33 || nyāyena sañcitairdravyai rnirmite sadane hareḥ| phalamakṣayayāpnoti yajamāno na saṃśayaḥ|| 4.34 || anyāyopārjitairdravyairasurairbhujyate phalam| jalena nayatāṃ vīkṣya vinyasya prakṛtiṃ kṣītau| tasminnādhāya phalakān prathamān śāstracakṣuṣā| sudhayā tāṃ draḍhīkṛtya jānīyātsamatāṃ jalaiḥ|| 4.35 || kṛtvopapīṭhamupari svādadhiṣṭhānamuttamam| vinā vāpyupapīṭhena syādadhiṣṭhānakalpanam|| 4.36 || athavā kalpayetpūrvamadhiṣṭhāna mupāvahāt| pādaṃ ca prastaraṃ caiva grīvāṃ ca śīkharaṃ tathā|| 4.37 || kuryādvathākramaṃ yāvattṛpyeran talakalpane| dvitale dhāmnyadhiṣṭhānaṃ caraṇaṃ prastaraṃ tathā|| 4.38 || kūṭaṃ caśālāṃ saṃsthānaṃ pañcaraṃ prastaraṃ punaḥ| vediṃ grīvāṃ ca śikharaṃ krameṇa parikalpayet|| 4.39 || tritalādivimānānā mādvādaśatalāvadhi| evaṃ prakalpya śāstrokta mitareṣvapi kalpayet|| 4.40 || upānaṃ jagatīṃ caiva kumudaṃ paṭṭikāṃ tathā| kaṇṭhaṃ ca paṭṭikācaiva caraṇaṃ ca talottaram|| 4.41 || haṃsamālā kapotaśca pratiśca prativedikā| kaṇṭhaṃ ca śikharaṃ caivakrameṇāṣṭādaśāṅgakam|| 4.42 || dhāmnasthūpyantamatha vā yajamānānurūpataḥ| kuryātpaṭādau nirmāṇāṃ kṛtvā pūrvaṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ|| 4.43 || iti śrī pāñcarātre mahopaniṣadi pādmasaṃhitāyaṃ kriyāpāde śikharanirmāṇaṃ nāma caturtho'dhyāyaḥ |
<2.5>
śrībhagavān prācīṃ parīkṣayetpūrvaṃ diśaṃ śāstroktavartmanā| prācyādididvibhāgena dvārādividhiriṣyate|| 5.1 || hastamānāyataṃ śaṅkuṃ dvādaśāṅgulameva vā| kṣīravṛkṣajamaṅguṣṭha pariṇāha mṛjuṃ śubham|| 5.2 || prāsādasthānamadhye tu sthāpayenmūlavidyayā| śaṅkordiguṇamānena parito maṇḍalaṃ likhet|| 5.3 || maṇḍalānte likhecchāyāṃ śaṅkoḥ purvāparāhṇayoḥ| nyasya bindudvayaṃ sūtraṃ prākrṛtyakyaṃsthitaṃ likhet|| 5.4 || bindudvayāntaraṃ grāhyaṃ kacchapānanapucchagam| jātaprāksaumyadiksūtramevaṃsūtre samīkṛte|| 5.5 || sīmāsutramiti bhrāntamuttarādyaṃ padaṃ likhet| aṣṭadiṣu yathānyāyaṃ sīmāsutraṃ tathā likhet|| 5.6 || triṣañpasaptahastaṃ vā adhikaṃvā yathecchayā| kuryāttatsūtrivinyāsaṃ grāmyāsthānasamṛddhaye|| 5.7 || diksūtraṃ bhramaṇenai va caturaśraṃ nayetpunaḥ| aṣṭadikṣu yathānyāyyaṃ śaṅkusthāpanamācaret|| 5.8 || śaṅkusaṃsthāpanākāle nimittāni ca lakṣayet| śubhaṃ cetsiddhimāpnoti aśubhe śāntimācaret|| 5.9 || caturaśraṃ suvṛttaṃ ca caturaśrāyataṃ tu vā| vṛttāyataṃ vā kurvīta prāsādaṃ tu caturvidham|| 5.10 || sthityāsanāni yānāni caturaśre ca vṛttake| vṛtrāyate suvṛttevā caturaśrāyate'pi vā|| 5.11 || śayanaṃ tatra kurvīta viśvarūpaṃ tathaiva ca| lokākrāntaṃ sureśeśaṃ tatra kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥ|| 5.12 || evaṃ bimbhānusāreṇa prāsādaṃ kārayedbudhaḥ| ārabhya caikahastādi daśahastāntameva hi|| 5.13 || ayugmenaiva hastena kuryādāyatanaṃ hareḥ| yugmaṃ vā mokṣakāmasya amugmaṃ bhuktikā ṅkṣiṇaḥ|| 5.14 || a dvādaśatalāntaṃ vai yathā vittānusārataḥ| mānayitvā vidhānena vimānaṃ tatra kārayet|| 5.15 || kṛtyaivaṃ vāstuśāstrajño hyārabhetprathameṣṭakām| iṣṭhakāstrividhāḥ proktāśśilākāṣṭhajamṛṇmayāḥ|| 5.16 || śailajeṣu vimāneṣu śilā syātprathameṣṭakā| kāṣṭhena dhamanirmāṇe tenaiva prathameṣṭakā|| 5.17 || nupakveṣṭakayā kuryādvimānaṃ tviṣṭakāmaye| āmeṣṭakacite dhiṣṭhye tathaiva prathameṣṭakā|| 5.18 || śai leṣṭakābhyāṃ racite śilāsyātprathameṣṭakā| iṣṭakā kāṣṭhayukai tu iṣṭakā prathameṣṭakā|| 5.19 || śilāsaṅgrahaṇe deśe sādhivāsapurassaram| saṅgṛhya tu śilāṃ tatra pulliṅgādi parīkṣayet|| 5.20 || upānadādistū pyantaṃ pullaṅgiśilayā bhavet| strīliṅgaśilayā caiva kārayatprathamāṃ śilām|| 5.21 || pratimā dāruvadgrāhyā nirdoṣā guṇavattarā|| 5.22 || ayathā vihitairliṅgai rlobhādajñānato'pivā| tartuḥ kārayiturnāśo rājño rāṣṭrasya niścitaḥ|| 5.23 || idāniṃ samprapakṣyāmi mṛṇmaye tviṣṭakāvidhim| rathakāreṇa nirdiṣṭaṃ deśamāsādya deśikaḥ|| 5.24 || tatrāpi jvalite vahnau sarpiṣā juhuyācchatam| aṣṭau ca mūlamanraiṇa nṛsū ktena caruṃ punaḥ|| 5.25 || mūlamantreṇa samitho yājñiko juhuyāttathā| kuryācca caruṇā bhūyo viṣṇupāriṣadāhutīḥ|| 5.26 || kṣetrapālasya bhūtānāṃ vāstunāthasya ca svayam| devatānāmṛṣīṇāṃ ca tathādevagaṇasya ca|| 5.27 || yathāliṅgena mantreṇa svāhāntena vicakṣaṇaḥ| bhūrādibhirvāhṛtibhirhutvāpurṇāsutiṃ carum|| 5.28 || caturdikṣu ca pūrvādvaṃ caruṇā balikarmaca| kuryādanena mantreṇa namontena yathākramam|| 5.29 || viṣṇupāriṣa debhyaśca sarvabhūtebhya eva ca| vāstunāthāya ca tathā kṣetrapālāya copari|| 5.30 || kṛtvāgni mutsṛjede vamagre homādikekṛte| kulālaḥ prāṅmukhaḥ kuryāttatra bhūmṛttikeṣṭakām|| 5.31 || pulliṅgādivibhāgena tadvibhāgo vidhīyate| rekha ṛjurayugmā vā yatra pauṃsnī tadiṣṭakā|| 5.32 || tiraścī vāthā vā yugmā rekhā straiṇī tadiṣṭakā| napuṃsakaśca nirlekhā rekhā vāgre'tha karṇayoḥ|| 5.33 || na pulliṅgeṣṭakā tāvat garbhādhāne vidhīyate| strīliṅgeṣṭakayā kuryādgarbhādhānādipīṭhīkām|| 5.34 || pullīṅgeṣṭakayā kuryātprāsādaṃ tadvicakṣaṇaḥ| caturvviṃśāṅgulāyāmā śreṣṭhā syānmadhyamā punaḥ|| 5.35 || aṣṭādaśāṅulāyāmā kaniṣṭhā ṣoḍaśāṅgulā| ardhāyāmaṃ tu vistāraṃ tadardhaṃ ghanamiṣyate|| 5.36 || āyāmasamavistārā syādācchādanikeṣṭakā| evamādīṣṭakāmānaṃ kuryādbhūmivaśādbhudhaḥ|| 5.37 || mahāmānamidaṃ vidyādalpamānamudīryate| prāsādapādavistāratulyo vistāra iṣyate|| 5.38 || vistāraddhiguṇāyāmāḥ kalpayediṣṭakā budhaḥ| evaṃ śilānāṃ dārūṇāṃ mānaṃ dāruśilāyame|| 5.39 || supakvā susvarā pakvabimbābhā sudṛḍhā samā| ekavarṇā praśastā syādiṣṭakā prathamāhitā|| 5.40 || kālamaṇḍālasaṃyuktāṃ chinnāṃbhinnāmathānṛjum| sphuṭitāṃ varjayedbrahman prāsādāmambhaṇeṣṭakām|| 5.41 || catasraḥ prathamāḥ kuyādiṣṭakā devatālaye| āvāse pañca martyānāṃ kalpayetprathameṣṭakāḥ|| 5.42 || pakveṣṭakacite dhāmni pakvā syātprathameṣṭakā| ādyeṣṭaka cite'gāre prathamā nānyathā bhavet|| 5.43 || aṅku rānarpa yetpūrvamadhirvavadhivasanakarmaṇi| diśāṃ catasṛṇāṃ dhāmnaḥ pūrvāyāṃ diśi ca kvacit|| 5.44 || praphāṃ darbhasrajaṃ kuryāt ṣoḍaśastambhasaṃyutām| saptatālāyatāṃ tatra vediṃ hastasamunnatām|| 5.45 || madhye kṛtvā tataḥ pīṭhaṃ śālibhārai stibhiḥ kṛtam| vṛttaṃ vā caturaśraṃ vā kuryācceṣṭaṃ caturmukha|| 5.46 || dvābhyāṃ madhyamamekena jaghanyaṃ parikalpitam| sūtrādiveṣṭitaṃ kumbhaṃ dhānyapīṭhe nidhāpayet|| 5.47 || paritaḥ kalaśānyaṣṭau cāṣṭadikṣu vinikṣipet| kumbhasyottaratastasya vāripūrṇasya deśikaḥ|| 5.48 || tāvatpramāṇaṃ kurvīta dhānyapīṭhaṃ tathāvidham| tadardhaṃ taṇḍulayutaṃ tadardhaṃ tilasaṃyutam|| 5.49 || ā stīrṇadarbhasaṃbādhaṃ navavastrapariṣkṛtam| tadiṣṭakādhivāsārthaṃ kutvaivaṃ deśikottamaḥ|| 5.50 || snāpayediṣṭa kāḥ pūrvaṃ sthāpayetkalaśānnava| vrihīpīṭhe sunihite madhye caivāṣṭadikṣuca|| 5.51 || madhyame kala śesarpiḥ prācye kṣīraṃ vinikṣipet| āgneye dadhi yāmye tu guḍaṃ nairṛtadiśyapi|| 5.52 || pañcagavyaṃ phalarasaṃ vāruṇe mātariśvani| gandhavāri tathā saumyo lohaloyaṃ śive madhu|| 5.53 || vinyasya navastreṇa veṣṭayitvāsamarcayet| sthāpayitveṣṭakāḥ piṭhe snāpayetkalaśaiḥ kramāt|| 5.54 || payoghṛtena sāmnāgre snāpayetpayasā tataḥ| snāpayedikṣutoyena madhuvātetimantrataḥ|| 5.55 || phalinītyanuvākena snāpayetphalavāriṇā| hiraṇyagarbhamamantreṇa snāpayollohavāriṇā|| 5.56 || dadhikrāṇvetiyajuṣā dadhnā saṃsnāpayettataḥ| snāpayetpañcagavyena pañcavāruṇiketya taḥ|| 5.57|| gandhadvāreti mantreṇa snāpayedgandhavāriṇā| madhuvā tetimantrema madhusnānaṃ samācaret|| 5.58 || ghṛtasāmneti sāmnā vaighṛtena snāpaye ttataḥ| ekaikaṃ navavastreṇa darbhayuktena veṣṭayet|| 5.59 || parigṛhyeṣṭakāssarvāśśayanopari nikṣīpet| toraṇaṃ dvārakumbhāṃśca dhvajāṃśca paripūrayet|| 5.60 || eṣṭavyo madhyame kumbha parimātmā caturmukha| aṣṭāsvanyeṣu kumbhaṣu viṣṇvādīnaṣṭa pūjayet|| 5.61 || nivedayenmahākumbhe payasaṃ vā guḍodanam| pūrvasyāmuttarasyaṃ vā diśi kurṇḍān prakalpayet|| 5.62 || sthaṇḍile vāgniyānīya juhuyā tsamidādibhiḥ| samidājya tilaṃ puṣpaṃ pṛthagaṣṭottaraṃ śatam|| 5.63 || juhuyānmūlamantreṇa sūkaina ca caruṃ punaḥ| sparśayediṣṭakāssarvāssampātāhyena deśikaḥ|| 5.64 || hemasūtraiḥ pratisarairastra mantreṇa bandhayet| vibhavāsuguṇairvānyaiḥ kārpāsarajatādibhiḥ|| 5.65 || svapnādhipatimantreṇa juhuyātsarpiṣā śatam| svapnārthaṃ guruṇā sārthaṃ yajamānastu saṃviśet|| 5.66 || dussvapnadarśane jahyānnirmāṇaṃ tasya sadmanaḥ| svapne śubhe tu sadanaṃ prārabhetāvilambitam|| 5.67 || śvobhūte śobhane lagne sthāpayi tveṣṭakā guruḥ| prāveśayecca prāsādamiṣṭakāstāssupūjitāḥ|| 5. 68 || klṛptasya dvāradeśasya dakṣiṇe deśikottamaḥ| pādamūlādadhastāttāḥ kṣipettūryādi ghoṣayet|| 5.69 || svastikaṃ vācayitvātu brāhmaṇān dhanatoṣitān| prādakṣiṇye'pi cendādisomāntaṃ deva sadmani|| 5.70 || mamaṣyāṇāṃ tu madhyāntaṃ mūlamantreṇa daivate| nadadhyādiṣṭakā dhāmni mānuṣāṇāṃ niketane|| 5.71 || śrīsū kteneṣṭakādhānāṃ devīnāmadhidevatā| iṣṭakānāṃ caturmūrtiḥ pañcamūrtistu mānuṣe|| 5.72 || yāmyavāruṇayo rmūlamagramindradhaneśayoḥ| iṣṭakānāṃ bhave nnyāse upānadviṣamaṃ bhavet| kṛte cenmohato'jñānādvaiṣamyabhayakāraṇam|| 5.73 || tanmātupānatsadṛśīriṣṭakāḥ prathamaṃ kṣipet| ādidaivaṃ samabhyarcya śvabhraṃ lo yena pūrayet|| 5.74 || ratnairdhānyaiścalohaiśca kusumaiśca pṛdhaśvidhaiḥ|| pūrite subhṛśaṃ śvabhre jalāvartaṃ parīkṣayet|| 5.75 || śūbhaṃ pradakṣiṇāvartaṃ savyāvartamathāśubham| śvabhre vinihitaṃ toyaṃ sadyaśśoṣaṃ vrajedyadi|| 5.76 || ārabdhamapi taddhāma na samāptiṃ samṛcchati| mriyate yajamāno vā bhavedvā rāṣṭraviplavaḥ|| 5.77 || nimitaiṣvaśubheṣvevaṃ śubheṣu tu śubhaṃ bhavet| deśikasya manastusṭissarvasampatkarī sadā|| 5.78 || vipatkarī viturṣissyādrathakārasya vai tathā| durnimitaiṣu sarveṣu śāntyarthaṃ juhuyādguruḥ|| 5.79 || brāhmaṇānbhojayoddadyātsuvarṇaṃ śaktyapekṣayā| utpalasyāravindasya kandaṃ garte vinikṣipet|| 5.80 || puṇyatīrthasya śāleyakedārasya ca mṛtsnayā| mūlamantreṇa tadgartaṃ pūrayecchādayecca tat|| 7.81 || ācāryadakṣiṇāṃ dadyācchata niṣkānvitā nṛpaḥ| anyeṣāmapi sarveṣāṃ daśaniṣkāvarā bhavet|| 5.82 || ārambhaṇa …
<2.6>
śrībhagavān garbhanyānavadhiṃ brahman vakṣyāmi śrūyatāmasau| gṛhṇīyānmṛttikāṃ pūrvaṃ sthāneṣu daśasu kramāt|| 6.1 || śaile hrade puṇyatīrthe valmīke karkaṭāśaye| nadyāṃ vṛṣaviṣāṇāgre dantidante payonidhau|| 6.2 || hale caiteṣu sambhūtā praśastā mṛttikā tataḥ| kumudasyāravindasya kaśerūtpula yostathā|| 6.3 || nīlotpalasya pañcaitānkandānapi samāharet| manaśśilā harītālamañjanaśyāmasīsakam|| 6.4 || saurāṣṭraṃ rocanāṃ caiva gairikaṃ pāradaṃ tathā| ādāya dhātūn ratnāni vajravaiḍhūrya mauktikam|| 6.6 || sphaṭikaṃ puṣyakaṃ śaṅkaṃ padmarāgaṃ tathā param| candrakāntaṃ mahānilaṃ navaitāni samāharet|| 6.7 || śālinīvārakaṅgūṃśca priyaṅgutilamāṣakān| mudgāṃśca yavaveṇūṃśca gṛhṇīyānnavadhānyakam|| 6.8 || hiraṇyaṃ rajataṃ tāmramāyasaṃ trapu sisakam| sauvarṇaṃ kūrmarūpaṃ ca sauvarṇaṃ śaṅkhacakrakam|| 6.9 || etān sarvān samānīya nikṣipedgarbhabhājane| bhājanaṃ dhānyarāśau tu nyanya vastreṇa veṣṭayet|| 6.10 || gandhādibhissamabhyarcya viṣṇugāyatriyā tataḥ| kuṇḍe vā sthaṇḍile vāgniṃ samānīya samidhya ca|| 6.11 || sarpiṣā ca samidbhiśca viṣṇudaivatyayā tayā tayā| aṣṭhottaraśataṃ hutvā sampātāhyaṃ tu saṅgrahet|| 6.12 || caruṇā narasū ktena jūhuyāt podaśāhutīḥ| indrādilokapālebhyo bhuvanebhyastathaiva ca|| 6.13 || parvatebhyassamudrebhya ādi tyebhyastathaiva ca| vasubhyaśca marudbhyaśca ṛṣibhyastadana ntaram|| 6.14 || vedebhyassarvaśāstrebhyaḥ purāṇebhyastathaiva ca| pātālebhyaśca digbhyaśca nāgebhyastadanantaram|| 6.15 || gaṇebhyassarvabhūtebhyo narendrebhya stathaiva ca| grahebhyaścaiva sarvebhyassvāhāntaṃ juhuyātpṛthak|| 6.16 || tilājyamiśracaruṇā juhuyāttebhya eva ca| saṃpātājyaṃ samānīya niṣiñcedgarbhabhājane|| 6.17 || niśāyāmeva kurvīta garbhasya nyasanaṃ guruḥ| sumuhūrte sunakṣatrasupakṣakaraṇairyute|| 6.18 || śaṅkhabheryādi ghoṣaiśca sahamaṅgalapāṭhakaiḥ| dvijendravedaghoṣaiśca āsphoṭakṣvelitairapi|| 6.19 || ādāya bhājanaṃ paścāddevāgāraṃ pradakṣiṇam| gatvā garbhagṛhaṃ samyagbraṇaissaha saṃviśet|| 6.20 || dvārasya dakṣiṇe pārśve prārabhyaṃ pādapārśvataḥ| devānāṃ paṭṭikāyāṃ tu garbhanyāsaḥ praśasyate|| 6.21 || viprāṇāṃ paṭṭikādhastānnṛpāṇāṃ kumudopari| vaiśyānāṃ kumude caiva śūdrāṇāṃ jagatopari|| 6.22 || nī ce duḥkhaṃ bhavenni tyamucchrite dravyanāśanam|| 6.23 || sthānabhraṃśakaraṃ dvāre bhavatyeva na saṃśayaḥ| tasmādyatnena kartavyaṃ suguptaṃ bhittimadhyataḥ|| 6.24 || mañjūṣāṃ mukhyalohena kṛtvā tālapramāṇataḥ| navagartasamāyuktaṃ vidhānena samanvitam|| 6.25 || dārujaṃ tadabhāve syādgartā varaṇasaṃyutam| puṇyāhaṃ vācayitvā tu pañcagarvyena śodhayet|| 6.26 || dhyāyanbhūmaṇḍalaṃ sarvaṃ sādridvīpasamudrakam| diggajo ttambhitaṃ śeṣaphaṇindraśikharasthitam|| 6.27 || manasyāveśya vasudhāṃ dvihastāṃ śyāmalāṃ śubhām| ākalpitāmṛtusnā tāmādadhyādgarbha saṃpadam|| 6.28 || ātmānaṃ keśavaṃ dhyātvā sarvābharaṇa bhūṣitam| mṛdaṃ gṛhītvāsāmudrīṃ parikuryātpradakṣiṇam|| 6.29 || pārvatīṃ pūrvato syasyettīrthajāṃ dakṣiṇe tathā| nadījāṃ paścime bhāge hradajāmuttare tathā|| 6.30 || kulīramṛdamāgreyyāṃ nairṛte vālmikīṃ mṛdam| halajāṃ diśi mārutyāmaiśānyāṃ hastidantajām|| 6.31 || vṛṣabhasya niṣāṇasthāṃ brahmasthāne niveśayet| kandamautpalamaindre syādyamadiśyatha kaumudam|| 6.32 || nailotpalaṃ pratīcīne kāśeravamudaggiśi| brahmasthāne bhavetpādmaṃ tato dhātūnvinikṣipait|| 6.33 || purva manaśśilāṃ yāmye haritālaṃ ca vāruṇe| aññanaṃ dhanadāśāyāmāgneyyāṃ diśi sīsakam|| 6.34 || saurāṣṭraṃ nairṛte bhāge vāyavīye tu rocanāṃ | īśāne gairikaṃ madhye pāradaṃ brahmaṇaḥ pade|| 6.35 || vajraṃ pūrve bhavedyāmye vaiḍūryaṃ paścime maṇiḥ| kaubere puṣyakaṃ bhāge sphaṭikaṃ jvalane bhavet|| 6.36 || nairṛte mauktikaṃ vāyau candrakāntaśilā tathā| māheśvare mahānīlaṃ padmarāgaṃ tu madhyame|| 6.37 || śālibījaṃ bhavetprācyāṃ nīvāraṃ dakṣiṇe tathā| kaṅguṃ pratīcyāṃ dhanadepriyaṅguṃ jvalane tathā|| 6.38 || māṣo nairṛtabhāge syāttilo mudgastu mārute| aiśāne veṇudhānyaṃ syādyavaṃ syādbrahmaṇaḥ pade|| 6.39 || hiraṇyaṃ purvadigbhāge dakṣiṇe rajataṃ bhavet| paścime tāmramādhāya nikṣipetudagāyasam|| 6.39 || āgneye trapu rākṣasyāṃ kāṃsyaṃ mārutadiśyapi| sauvarṇaṃ kūrmamaiśānyāṃ daradaṃ hemanirmitam|| 6.40 || cakraṃ jāmbūnadaṃ madhye vinyasesmūlavidyayā| mahīṃ devīṃ tato dhyātvā mantrametamudīrayet|| 6.41 || sarvabhūtadhare kānai parvatastanamaṇḍite| samudraparidhāniye deva garbhaṃ samāśraya|| 6.42 || evamuktvā tataśśvabhraṃ gomūtreṇa pariplutam| ācchādayedvidhānena sudhayā dārḍhyamācaret|| 6.43 || gurave dakṣiṇāṃ dadyātpūrvoktadravyasaṅkhyayā| rakṣāṃ samantataḥ kuryādgarbhasya skhalanaṃ yadi|| 6.44 || pāyaścattaṃ tataḥ kuryāddhurnimitte ca pūrvavat| akṛtvā garbhavinyāsaṃ grāmaṃ prāsādameva vā|| 6.45 || yadi kuryātkṣayaṃ yāyādacirādvāstu dhāma vā| taddhāma vāstunorhemnā garbhamādau samācaret|| 6.46 || dhāmaikahastamaparaṃ śatahastaṃ paraṃ smṛtam| ekabhūmyaparaṃ dhāma paraṃ dvādaśabhūmikam|| 6.47 || vistārāddviguṇotsedhamutsedhānuguṇaṃ talam| vittānurodhaṃ cocchrāyaḥ kartavyaḥ kamalāsanaḥ|| 6.48 || sraṣṭurdevasya śayanamādibhūmau vidhīyate| āsanaṃ śrīdharāyuktaṃ dvitīye tu tale bhavet|| 6.49 || sthānaṃ tathā tṛtīye syāccaturthe yānamiṣyate| pañcame yegaśayanaṃ ṣaṣṭe bhogāsanaṃ bhavet|| 6.50 || yogasthitissaptame syādaṣṭame tārkṣyavāhanam| navame bhogaśayanaṃ bhogāssya rdaśame bhavet|| 6.51 || sthitirekādaśe bhoktuṃ dvādaśe viśvarūpavān| iti śrīpāñcarātre mahopaniṣadi pādmasaṃhitāyāṃ kriyāpāde garbhanyāsavidhānaṃ nāma ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ |
<2.7>
śrībhagavān adhastādupapīṣṭhaṃ syādadhiṣṭhānasya dhārakam| śobhārthaṃ rakṣaṇārthaṃ ca samucchrāyārthamena vā|| 7.1 || adhiṣṭhānasamo tsedhamardhaṃ vā syāttripādakam| pādāṃśaṃ vā tribhāgaṃ vā sārdhāṃśaṃ vā sapādākam|| 7.2 || dviguṇaṃ triguṇaṃ vāpi kartavyamupapīṣakam| utsedhaṃ daśadhā kṛtvā bhāgenai kena varthanāt|| 7.3 || pañcamāṃśamadhiṣṭhānaṃ dhāmno bāhye tu nirgamaḥ| daṇḍaṃ vā sārthadaṇḍaṃ vā dvidaṇḍaṃ vā tridaṇḍakam|| 7.4 || adhiṣṭhānaṃ jagatyā vā samantātpādabāhyakam| vedībhadraṃ pradībhadraṃ subhadraṃ catridhāmatam|| 7.5 || ucchrāye bhanubhāge dvyaṃśe sopānamīritam| padmamaṃśaṃ tadurdhverdhaṃ kṣepaṇaṃ pāñcabhāgikam|| 7.6 || grīvamardhena kampaṃ syādbhāgai kena mbujaṃ bhavet| śeṣāṃśaṃ vājanaṃ kaṃpa maṣṭāṃga mupapīṭhakam|| 7.7 || ṣaḍaṅgaṃ vā vidhātavyamū rdvā dhastādbhūjānvitam| vedibhadraṃ dvidhā proktaṃ sarvaharmyeṣu yogyakam|| 7.8 || anīdṛkca śivāṃśaistu bhānubhāgāṃśakāṃśakaiḥ| tyraṃśaikāṃśaikabhāge tu dvābhyāmaṃśena yojayet|| 7.9 || jagato vājanāntaṃ tu tuṅgetrinavabhāgake| pādukaṃ paṅkajaṃ kampaṃ pīṭhamuttaramambujam|| 7.10 || kapotapālikāntādi prativājanamucyate| pratibhadramidaṃ nāmnā sarvālaṅkārasaṃyutam|| 7.11 || yugmecākṣāṃśakāṃśaistu dvekāṣṭhāṃśāṃśakāṃśakaiḥ| tyraṃśakenāṃśakai rdvābhyāmeke naivātra yojayet|| 7.12 || pādukāṃ paṅkajaṃ caiva māliṅgāntaritaṃ tathā| pratyūrdhva vājanaṃ kaṇṭha muttarāntaṃ kapotakam|| 7.13 || āliṅgāntaritaṃ cordhve pratiśchaivordhva vājanam| dvividhaṃ pratibhradraṃ syādekabhāgādikaṃ tataḥ|| 7.14 || trisaptāṃ śe tadutsedhe dvābhyāṃ janma tathāmbujam| ardhena kaṇṭhamardhena padmaṃ dvyaṃśena vājanam|| 7.15 || ardhenārdhaṃ tathā kampaṃ kaṇṭhamaṣṭāṃśamīritam| aṃśenottaramardhena padmaṃ copānahaṃ tribhiḥ|| 7.16 || bhāgārdhamūrdhvakampaṃ syādetannāmnā subhadrakam| janmadvyaṃśaṃ triyaṃ śena padmamaṃ śena kandharam|| 7.17 || dvābhyāṃ vājaname ke nakampamaṣṭāṃśakairgalam| aṃśena kampakaṃ dvābhyāṃ vājanaṃ kampamaṃśakam|| 7.18 || subhadraṃ dvividhaṃ proktaṃ sarvālaṅgārasaṃyutam| siṃhebhamakarairvālai rbhūtādyai rapyalaṃkṛtam|| 7.19 || prativaktraṃ jhaṣāsyaṃ syā dbālenārūḍhamastakam| arpitānārpite harmye sarvatra parikalpayet|| 7.20 || aṅgamaṅgaṃ prati prājñervṛddhihīnaṃ tathocyate| taddhāma sūkaraṃ nāma yuñcīyādupapīṭhake|| 7.21 || murtādhiṣṭhāna tuṅācca dviguṇaṃ vā samaṃ bhavet| sārdhaṃ vārdhaṃ tribhāgaṃ ca kuryādatropapīṭhakam|| 7.22 || sapratyaṅgaṃ samaṃ cārdhaṃ vājanaṃ tadidaṃ bhavet| upapīṭhamidaṃ proktaṃ samāsātkamalāsana|| 7.23 || adhiṣṭhānamatho vakṣye devāgārasya diddhaye| stambhāyāmaṃ tribhāgai kamadhiṣṭhānaṃ pramāṇataḥ|| 7.24 || stambhāyāmāṣṭabhāgaikaṃ prabhādhiṣṭhānakampakam| padāyāmaṃ talotsedhaṃ samadhiṣṭhānakottamam|| 7.25 || vitastinyūnakaṃ vāpi athavāpi ṣaḍaṅgulam| evaṃ tridhā vibhajyanai prabhādhiṣṭhānakampakam|| 7.26 || tadurdhve vāṣṭabhāgaikaṃ rāgādidhiṣṭhānakampakam| upānavargādhiṣṭhāna mupāna miha paṭhyate|| 7.27 || upānaṃ jagatī padmakaṇṭhaṃ kampaṃ ca paṭṭikā| nidrikāpadmakopetaṃ skandhamantaritaṃ bhavet|| 7.28 || ityevaṃ dvādaśāṅgāni adhiṣṭhānāni kalpayet| pādabandhaṃ pratībandhaṃ dvividhaṃ yonimūlakam|| 7.29 || pādānāṃ bandhanatvācca pādabandha namiṣyate| vṛtena pratibadhnīyā tpratibandhanamiṣyate|| 7.30 || chedyaṃ tatpādabandhaṃ syādacchedyaṃ pratibandhanam| tadaṅgaṃ paritaśchedyamardhacchedyaṃ na kārayet|| 7.31 || aṅgacchedyaṃ śubhaṃ proktaṃ artha cchedyaṃ yaśaskaram| homastatpādabandanaṃ syātpratestambhaṃ pratikriyā|| 7.32 || pratibandhamadhiṣṭhānaṃ chedyamānaṃ na kārayet| yadi kuryā llabheddoṣānekavṛddikulakṣayam|| 7.33 || prākāragopuradvāraṃ syadadhiṣṭhānachedanam| evaṃ mārgavidhiṃ śastaṃ kāraye dvāstuśāstrataḥ|| 7.34 || upāna vintṛtaṃ tacca caturdaṇḍaṃ tridaṇḍakam| dvidaṇḍaṃ caikadaṇḍaṃ ca sā rdhārdhaṃ pādabāhyataḥ|| 7.35 || evaṃ pañca vidhākāramupānaṃ homa nirgamam| daṇḍaṃ caiva dvidaṇḍaṃ ca ardhārdhaṃ ca tripādakam|| 7.36 || taccārdhaṃ daṇḍamānaṃ vā homāyāṃ caiva mānataḥ| prakṛteruparisthaṃ yaddhomāyāmaṃ ca mānataḥ|| 7.37 || vimānādhāra homāyāṃ bahula stambhamucchrayam| tāvanmānāvagāḍhaṃ ca yojayettatra padmaja|| 7.38 || janmabhūmyāstvadhiṣṭhānaṃ tatrādau kārayedbudhaḥ| devānāṃ cāpyadhiṣṭhānaṃ catvāriṃśattu tadbhavet|| 7.39 || adhiṣṭhānaṃ tu kartavyaṃ vastubhiśca śilādibhiḥ| padmabandhādyadhiṣṭhānaṃ vakṣye'laṅkāra pūrvakam|| 7.40 || tatpadmapatracitrairvā sabhādhiṣṭhānakottamam| vitastinyūnakaṃ vāpi hīnaṃ vāpi ṣaḍaṅgulam|| 7.41 || evaṃ tridhā vibhajya nte sabhādhiṣṭhāna kampakam| tadūrdhve cāṣṭabhāgaika prabhādhiṣṭāna kampakam|| 7.42 || navādhiṣṭhānamucchrāya madhiṣṭhānādi kalpayet| pādasyārddha mathotsedha madhiṣṭhānaṃ tu ṣoḍaśa|| 7.43 || upānasyārdhamutsedhaṃ padmācca catrukaśaram| ādhāraṃ paṭṭikasyāṃśaṃ śeṣaṃ padmakamucchrayam|| 7.44 || dvyardhāṃśaṃ madhyakumbhaṃ syādekārdhaṃ codhvaṃpadmakam| skandhāntaraṃ dvibhāge tuprathamādvyaṃśabhinnakam|| 7.45 || prativājanamekāṃśaṃ padmabaṃdhamiti smṛtaṃ| yasyādhiṣṭhānamutsedhaṃ pañcādaśavibhāgikam|| 7.46 || prathamaścaikabhāgastu pañcāṃśaṃ jagatībhavet| kumudaṃ taccaturthāṃśaṃ skandhaṃ tadvyaṃśamaṃśakam|| 7.47 || dvyaṃśaṃ ca pratirutsedhaṃ vājanaṃ caikabhāgikam| pratibandhamidaṃ nāmnā kīrtitaṃ kamalodbhava|| 7.48 || yasyādhiṣṭhānamutsedhaṃ triyoviṃśatibhāgikam|| dvyardhaṃ tadupadhānoccaṃ pañcārdhaṃ jagatī bhavet|| 7.49 || pañcāṃśaṃ kumudestedhaṃ ekāṃśoparipaṭṭikā| tyraṃśakaṃ grīvamutsedhaṃ kampaṃ nidrā dviyaṃśakam|| 7.50 || kapotasadanaṃ nāmnāsadaneṣu supūjitam| upopānaṃ tu bhāgena jagatī sapta bhāgikam|| 7.51 || vaprakaṃ tu ṣaḍaṃśaṃ syādvetraṃ pādādhikāṃśakam| tathaivāntaritotsedhaṃ dvyaṃśārdhaṃ pratirucchrayaḥ|| 7.52 || prativājanamekāṃśaṃ bhāgairvaśatibhiryutam| pratīmukhaṃ kāribhūtaṃ nāgavaktrasamāyatam|| 7.53 || pratibandhamidaṃ nāmnā sarva bhūteṣu yogyakam| dvibhāgābhyāmupopānaṃ saptāṃ śai rjagatī bhavet|| 7.54 || ṣaḍaṃśaiḥ kumutetsedhaṃ dhārāvapraṃ suvṛttakam| āliṅāntaritaṃ dvābhyāṃ tadardhaṃ cādhikaṃ bhavet|| 7.55 || tadvayārdhaṃ pratimukhaṃ sarvāvayavaśobhitam| siṃhaiśca makarai rvyālairvallīpa trairalaṅkṛtam|| 7.56 || pramukhaṃ makarāsyaṃ syānmakaradadhvajasaṃ yutam| makarāsyebhaniṣkrāntaṃ vyālavidyādharīgaṇāḥ|| 7.57 || śeṣāṃśaṃ vājanopetaṃ kesarāgrasamanvitam| ekaviṃśatibhāgai kayuktaṃ nānāpratikramam|| 7.58 || athotsedha madhiṣṭhānaṃ pañcādaśavibhāgikam| janmasyārdhavibhāgena jagatīścaturaṃśakam|| 7.59 || srakpadmavedibandhena yuktaṃ kumbhaṃ triyaṃśakam| madmabandhena tasyordhve tripādenordhvapaṭṭikā|| 7.60 || tathaiva paṭṭiko tsedhaṃ dvyaṃśābhyāṃ pratirucchrayaḥ| ardhena vājanaṃ kuryā darddha paṭṭārdhabhāgikam|| 7.61 || padyabandhamidaṃ nāmna devānā mabhayaṃ param| yadadhiṣṭhānamānaṃ hi bhavedvāviṃśati kramāt|| 7.62 || aṃśena paṭṭikāṃ kuryāddvyaṃśenai vāmbujaṃ bhavet| tadaṃ śenordhva paṭṭaṃ syātṣaḍaṃśairjagatī bhavet|| 7.63 || caturthaṃ kumudotsedhaṃ tasyordhvaikāṃśapaṭṭikā| kaṇṭhassyāttribhiraṃ śena ardhenoparipaṭṭikā|| 7.64 || ardhenordhvambujaṃ kuryānmahāpaṭṭaṃ triyaṃśakam| ardhenopari padma syātkampamardhena kārayet|| 7.65 || pratibandhamidaṃ nāmnā sarvadhāmasu yojayet| homastambhaṃ prati stambhaṃ dvividhaṃ pādadhairghikam|| 7.66 || prakṛtestu talādū rdhve homastambhaṃ prakalpayet| pratistambhaṃ praterurdhvamuttarāntaḥ prapādakam|| 7.67 || pādāyāmārdhamutsedhaṃ adhiṣṭhānapramāṇataḥ| vai śeṣikapramāṇaṃ syādviśeṣotpattibhāṣitam|| 7.68 || adhiṣṭhānotsedhamānaṃ ṣaḍaṣṭa navabhiḥ kramāt| rudrāṃ śaissūryābhāgaṃ syāddaśa bandhāmśamānataḥ|| 7.69 || ekāṃ śenāṅkasutraṃ syātsaptamānapramāṇataḥ| śeṣāṃśaṃ pādadairghyaṃ syārdgrīvā vā saptamānataḥ|| 7.70 || devaharmyādyadhiṣṭhāne sabhāyāṃ maṇṭape'pi vā| pañpavargāgraharyāṃ syaccaturvargāgrahamyakam|| 7.71 || tata staddharmyamānaṃ syādadhiṣṭhānapramāṇataḥ| devālaye sabhāsthāne ādhārasya pramāṇataḥ|| 7.72 || narāvāse na kartavyaṃ kartṛbhartṛvināśanam| pādabandhaṃ pratībandhaṃ dvividhaṃ bandhamucyate|| 7.73 || etaddevālaye kṛtyamakṛtyaṃ manujālaye| upānaniṣkramaṃ proktaṃ caturdaṇḍaṃ tridaṇḍakam|| 7.74 || tridaṇḍārdhaṃ dvidaṇḍaṃ ca dvyardhardhaṃ caikamucyate| ityevaṃ homaniṣkrāntaṃ diksaṅkhyāpādabāhyataḥ|| 7.75 || mūlapādastu vistāra …
<2.8>
śrībhagavān prabhedamadhunāvakṣye vimānānāṃ salakṣaṇam| ānantyāttatprabhedānāṃ kiñcideva pradarśyate|| 8.1 || vimānāni ca bhidyante talādiṣṭānabhedataḥ| grīvā ca mastakaṃ ca dve vṛttaṃ cedvaijayantakam|| 8.2 || mūle mūlo yadi sthūlamagre'gre sūkṣmamadbhutam| purobhāge mahaghoṇaṃ tridikṣu svalpanāsikam|| 8.3 || stūpīcatuṣkaṃ sānāyāṃ vimāne cobhayorapi| vṛttāyatavimānaṃ taddṛḍhadhāmābhipūjitam|| 8.4 || sakarṇakūṭaṃ śrībhogaṃ madhye bhadraṃ tathāvidham| śrīviśālamitiproktaṃ vasvasraṃ svastibandhanam|| 8.5 || śrīkaraṃ caturaśraṃ tu ṣoḍaśāśrayutaṃ punaḥ| vimānaṃ puṣpakamidaṃ vimāneṣu supūjitam|| 8.6 || bhadreṇa sahitaṃ madhye mastake karṇa kandharam| koṣṭhakaṃ bhadranāsyaṅgaṃ suvṛttaṃ galamastakam|| 8.7 || vimānaṃ kesaramidaṃ sarvālaṅkāraśobhitam| mukhe mukhe samāvṛttaṃ śirastu dvitrinetravat|| 8.8 || saumukhyaṃ karkarībhūtaṃ vṛttagarbhagṛhānvitam| mukhe tasya mahāghoṇaṃ vimānaṃ co bhayorapi|| 8.9 || stūpīyugmamayugmaṃ vā nāsikālpaṃ tridikṣu ca| vṛttāyataṃ suvṛttaṃ vā nāmnaitatsyā tsudarśanam|| 8.10 || caturaśramadhiṣṭhānaṃ tadvatkaṇṭhaṃ ca mastukam| catuṣkūṭasamāyuktaṃ catuṣkoṣṭhasamanvitam|| 8.11 || śikharaṃ ca mahadikṣu mahānāsābhiranvitam| tolaṇai rvedibhadrādyairnānācatrairvacitratam|| 8.12 || nāmnaitatsvastikaṃ proktaṃ vimāneṣu supūjitam| tadeva sauṣṭhikaṃ nimnamunnataṃ koṣṭhakaṃ yadi|| 8.13 || antaḥ prastarasaṃyuktame tadvipulasandaram| aṃśamaṃśadvayaṃ satripādāṃśaṃ svāṃghribhāgikam|| 8.14 || bhāgadvayaṃ vibhaktāṅghri prastaragrīvamastakam| pādodaye navāṃśe tu dvitalādivimānake|| 8.15 || antaraprastaropetaṃ kūṭaśālābhiranvitam| nānālañārasaṃyuktaṃ nānāpādairalaṅkṛtam|| 8.16 || vimānaṃ parvataṃ proktaṃ vimāneṣu supūjitam| tadeva tartulaṃ vedikandharaṃ śikharaṃ ghaṭam|| 8.17 || aṣṭhakūṭaṃ catuśśālāyuktaṃ sastāṣṭhanāsikam| koṣṭhakaṃ nirgamaṃ madhye dvitri daṇḍena soṣṭakam|| 8.18 || samagrīvaśiropetaṃ kūṭakoṣṭha samanvitam| nānādiṣṭhānasaṃyuktaṃ nānāpādairalaṅkṛtam|| 8.19 || caturaśraṃ suvṛttaṃ vā nābhibhirbahubhiryutam| nāmnaita nmaṃdaraṃ proktaṃ vimānaṃ kamalāsana|| 8.20 || tadeva śikhare sārdhakoṣṭhakaṃ tu catuṣṭayam| caturaśraśiroyuktaṃ catuṣkūṭasamanvitam|| 8.21 || nānādiṣṭhānasaṃyuktamanekatalasaṃyutam| nāsībhiśca sahastraistu tadardhaṃ pādameva vā|| 8.22 || nāmnaitatvastibandhaṃ syānnānāvayavaśobhitam| tadeva sauṣṭhikaṃ kauṣṭhamantaraprastarai ryutam|| 8.23 || hārālpaṃ kandharaṃ nimnaṃ na nāṣpairvālpanāsikam| nānālaṅkārasaṃyuktametatkalyāṇamiṣyate|| 8.24 || tadevaśikhare sārdhakoṣṭhakaṃ rahitaṃ tu cet| caturnāsīsamāyuktametatpāñcālamiṣyate|| 8.25 || tadevāṣṭāśrakaṃ vediṃ kaṇṭhaṃ ca śikharaṃ ghaṭam| śikhareṣṭamahānāsi nāmnaitadviṣṇukāntakam|| 8.26 || tadevakūṭaśālānāmantaraprastarairvinā| taccaturbhegamadhikamāyataṃ caturaśrakam|| 8.27 || āyatāśraṃ tathā vediṃ karṇaṃ ca śikharaṃ ghaṭam| stūpītrayasamāyuktametannāmnā sumaṅgalam|| 8.28 || tadevāyatavṛttaṃ cedvedikā jaṭharaṃ śiraḥ| sarvāvayavasaṃyuktameta tkāntāramiṣyate|| 8.29 || tārādardhāṃśamadhikamāyataṃ caturaśrakam| dvyaśrayuktaṃ śiroyuktaṃ netraśālāmukhānvitam|| 8.30 || vimānaṃ puṣkaraṃ proktaṃ sarvaharmyeṣu pūjitam| caturaśramadhiṣṭhānavṛttagarbhagṛhānvitam|| 8.31 || sarvālaṅkārasaṃyuktametannāmnā manoharam| tadeva caturaśraṃ syādgarbhageha masūkaram|| 8.33 || vartulaṃ janmatastūpī kāntaṃ jedvṛttaharmyakam| āyatāśramadhiṣṭhānaṃ ṣaḍaśraṃ kandharaṃ śiraḥ|| 8.34 || nānālaṅkārasarayuktaṃ nāmnā kauberakāntaram| nānādhiṣṭhānasaṃyuktaṃ nānāpādairalaṅkṛtam|| 8.35 || pādopari samāsīnasyastikābandaśobhitam| anekatalasaṃyuktaṃ nānālaṅkārasaṃyutam|| 8.36 || nāsībhirbahubhiryuktaṃ stūpībhirbahubhiryutam| bhardakoṣṭhamidaṃ nāmnā āyataṃ caturaśrakam|| 8.37 || tadeva vartulaṃ karṇakūṭakarṇaśirastathā| caturnāsīsamāyuktaṃ vṛttakūṭamidaṃ bhavet|| 8.38 || tadevāṣṭhāṃśamādhikyamāyataṃ caturaśrakam| karṇakūṭaṃ tathā karṇa māyataṃ vṛttamastakam|| 8.39 || koṣṭhabhadramidaṃ vidyātsarvaharmeṣu pūjitam| tadeva vartulaṃ vedi karṇaṃ ca śikharaṃ ghaṭam|| 8.40 || śeṣaṃ pūrvavaduddhiṣṭaṃ nāmnā śrībhogamiṣyate| vṛtte vṛttāyate caiva nāsibhirbahubhiryatam|| 8.41 || anekatalasaṃyuktaṃ nānālaṅkārasaṃyutam| vimānādhirakai ryuktameta tpuṣkaramiṣyate|| 8.42 || jalasthalaṃ vihāyordhve āyataṃ caturaśrakam| karṇaṃ ca śikharaṃ tadvaccaturnāsīsamanvitam|| 8.43 || vimānādhārakai ryuktaṃ bahustūpīsamanvitam| nānālaṅkārasaṃyuktaṃ lambapañjaramīpitam|| 8.44 || nānāmasūrakastambhavedikājālatoraṇam| nānālaṅkārasaṃyuktaṃ nānācitrairvicitritam|| 8.45 || sopaṣīṣamadhiṣṭhānaṃ kevalāṃga masūkaram| svastikākārasaṃyuktaṃ nāsikābhiralaṅkṛtam|| 8.46 || āyataṃ caturaśraṃ ca anekatalasaṃyutam| nānānāṭaka saṃyuktame tannāmnā jayāvaham|| 8.47 || tadevānyairalaṅkārai rvedāśraṃ kandharaṃ śiraḥ| nānāmasūrakastambhavedikā dyairalaṅkṛtam|| 8.48 || nāmnā vandikamityuktaṃ viṣṭhomandiramuttamam| āyatāśraṃ sabhākāraṃ śirassarvāyatāśrakam|| 8.49 || anekatalasaṃyuktaṃ stūpītrayasamanvitam| stūpīcatuṣkayuktaṃ vā caturnāsīsamanvitam|| 8.50 || saubhadrakamitijñeyaṃ varṣasthalavivarjitam| caturaśramadhiṣṭhānaṃ caturaśragalaṃ tathā|| 8.51 || kumbhākāraṃ galādūrdhva manekatalasaṃyutam| vimānametaddevasya jñeyaṃ kamalamaṇḍalam|| 8.52 || mahāpaṭṭatribhāgena mukhe bhavati nāsikā| śatadukpṛṣṭhapārśve tu āśreyaṃ tritalacchadam|| 8.53 || indubhadramidaṃ nāmnā bhavaneṣu supūjita m| paṭṭikāmbhuja sragvetravetradṛkpaṭṭikānvitam|| 8.54 || prāṅkaṇaṃ tu caturbhedaṃ śukanāsāsamanvitam| caturaśraṃ candraśālā mukhe mahati nāsikā|| 8.55 || ekapañcārdhapañcārdha caturbhāgairadhaḥ kramāt| nāmnā dhavalikāntaṃ syātpadmādhiṣṭhānasaṃyutam|| 8.56 || caturaśrādi bhūpetamuparyaṣṭāśrasaṃyutam| tadūrdhvaṃ samavṛttaṃ tu prāguktānyakrīyānvitam|| 8.57 || saumyaṃ nāmnā ca sādhāraṃ śikharaṃ kaṇṭhakūṭadhṛk| karṇakūṭaṃ suvṛttābhaṃ grīvākāraṃ sakuṇḍalam|| 8.58 || śikhareṇa samāyuktaṃ nāmnā lalitabhadrakam| āyatāśramadhaśchandhaṃ vyānākhyaṃ śaktibandhanam|| 8.59 || dhīrghaṃ kamalabandhaṃ tu vṛttargīvā tathā śiraḥ| pañcakoṣṭhaka pādādyagrahapiṇḍimapiṇḍitam|| 8.60 || arpitānarpitāṅgaṃ ca śailacchaṃdasamāhvayam| viśālaṃ ca śiroyuktametadevajayāvaham|| 8.61 || nimnaśāloccakūṭaṃ tu caturaṣṭrāśravṛttavat| nāsikābahusaṃyuktaṃ mūlamadhyāgrakūṭakam|| 8.62 || vṛttagarbhagṛhaṃ nāmnā madhye bhadramitismṛtam| etannāmnāśriyaṃ candhaṃ caturaśrāntarālayam|| 8.63 || etadeva triraśraṃ cecchākhākāraṃ śirogalam| mukhāntamunnatamukhaṃ śeṣaṃ tadvṛttakarṇakam|| 8.64 || vṛṣṭhataścāśra yuktaṃ tat śrāntakeśaprakoṣṭhakam| samavṛttaśiroyuktaṃ yogānandanamucyate| āyatāṣṭāṣṭaśikharagrīvamaṣṭāṣṭanāsikaṃ|| 8.65|| saukaryaṃ saukumāryaṃ ca ṣadaṣṭaśikharānvitaṃ| ghaṭākṛti samākāraṃ karṇakūṭollasadgalaṃ|| 8.66 || ṣaḍadraśikharaṃ grīvaṃ nāmnā taddhaṃsatārakaṃ| ayatāgrākṛtiśśālā śiraśśālā mukhe mukhe|| 8.67 || dvicandraśālakaṃ pṛṣṭhametannāmnā mahendrakaṃ| caturaśrāṅgasaṃyuktaṃ caturaśramasūkaraṃ|| 8.68 || nava trayodaśaṃ dhīrghaṃ hrasvakāraṃ ca maṇḍalaṃ | śālā mukhe mukhe pṛṣṭhe tatpā rśve ṣvaṣṭanāsikaṃ|| 8.69 || grahapiṇḍaṃ caturviṃśannāsikābhiralaṅkṛtaṃ| nāmnaitatsūryakāntaṃ syādvṛttāyataśirogalaṃ|| 8.70 || saurabhyaṃ pārśva pādāntaṃ madhyamaṃ sordhvaṃpañjaraṃ| maṅgalāspadamityuktaṃ nāmnā śeṣaṃ puroktavat|| 8.71 || daśabhāgaṃ caturbhāgaṃ vyāsavṛttāntamāyataṃ| caturaśraṃ bahucchandaṃ śālāyāṃ ca mukhe mukhe|| 8.72 || mahānāsīdvayopetaṃ mukhe ca caturaṣṭakaṃ| śiraḥ padmāsane pasthāḥ padmakuṇḍalasannibhaṃ|| 8.73 || viṃśatidvārikā nāsīni drānidrasamanvitaṃ| dvibhāgaṃ ca caturbhāgaṃ vṛdhyādīrghā śramulakaṃ|| 8.74 || pāguktaṃ caturaśraṃ tu śālāpañcarasaṃyutaṃ| śatanāsīnamāyuktaṃ tathā caiva tu viṃśatiḥ|| 8.75 || prāṅmukho madhyamārabhya kuṭamanyatpuroktavat| udārasārametattu dīrghaṃ vṛttaṃ tu sāravat|| 8.76 || ardhānyaṣṭāśra saṃyukta madhastāccaturāyataṃ| ujvalaṃ prajvalaṃ bhūmi caturaśrāṣṭamaṇḍalaṃ|| 8.77 || ardharaṃ ca tathā grīvaṃ śikharaṃ yuganāsikaṃ| vijayaṃ nāma ṣaṭsaptabhāgārdhārdhasamanvitaṃ|| 8.78 || caturardhaṃ caturṣkoṣṭha vṛttāṣṭhāśraśirogalaṃ| amalāṅgamidaṃ nāmnā navasaptapadesthitaṃ|| 8.79 || yuktaṃ dvādaśabhiḥ koṣṭhairaṣṭābhiśca prakoṣṭhakaiḥ| aṣṭordhvapañjarairaṣṭa nāsikāśikharānvitaṃ|| 8.80 || anekatalasaṃpannaṃ nāmnaitadvimalākṛti| mahāpīṭhaṃ tu garbhaṃ syādardhārīṃ cordhvapaṭṭikā|| 8.81 || maṇḍūkai rdhārikābhāsādāsane parikalpya ca| koṣṭhairdvādaśabhiryuktaṃ sauṣṭhikābhiradhāṣṭakaiḥ|| 8.82 || vyaktaiḥ pañjaraśālābhidvārāgraśikharairgalaṃ| aṣṭordhvaṃ paṃjaraṃ viṃśacchataistu vimaledahaṃ || 8.83 || suvṛttaṃ śikhiragrīvaṃ kapotenāṣṭhanāsikaṃ| ardhādhike catuṣkoṇe maṅgalākārakuṭṭimaṃ|| 8.84 || etaddhi vimalaṃ dhāma tridheyaṃ vimalākṛti| viṃśatrayodaśāṃkaṃ vā aṣṭāṃśaṃ dvādaśāṃśake|| 8.85 || dvātraṃśattriṃśataṃ vāpi garbhaṃ syāccaturāyatam|| ardhādhikādhikaṃ dvyaṅaṃ karkarīkṛtanāsikam|| 8.86 || tathā vinyastasarvāṅgaṃ śālākṛtiśironvitam| śikharāṣṭaṃ mahānāsi śālāpaṃjarasaṃ yutam|| 8.87 || etacchrīdharamityuktaṃ śriyaṃ dadati dehinam| etadvṛttāyatākāraṃ karkarīkṛtanāsikam|| 8.88 || śeṣaṃ pūrvoktavatsarvaṃ candrakāntamidaṃ smṛtam| mukhe mukhe sabhavaktraṃ śirasastadvinetravat|| 8.89 || saumukhyaṃ karkarībhutaṃ vṛttagarbhagṛhānvitam| vṛttāyata vimāneṣu mukhe mahati nāsikā|| 8.90 || nāsikāpṛṣṭhataścāpi stūpītrayastamanvitam| caturaśratalacchandaṃ vṛttagarbhagṛhānvitam|| 8.91 || suvṛttaṃ śikharākāraṃ nāsībhiḥ pañcabhiryutam| navāṃśaṃ vāṣṭasaṃyuktaṃ śrīpratiṣṭhitamucyate|| 8.92 || mahānāsyā catasrassyu śśālāpaṃjarasaṃyutam| taccatuścārdhasaṃyuktaṃ vṛttamurdhvaśirodharam|| 8.93 || sañcitaṃ sañcitāṅgaṃ ca sopānānāṃ catuṣṭayaiḥ| kapotamālayāyuktaṃ dvāreṇaiva patākayā|| 8.94 || antaḥ prastarasaṃyuktamunnatāṅgasamanvitam| prāsādamadhyakarṇasthaiḥ nīlīkṛtaviśālakaiḥ|| 8.95 || śālāpañjarakūṭaiśca yuktaṃ prāsādamastakam| adhiṣṭānādibhirvargai rūhapratyūhamaṇḍanaiḥ|| 8.96 || nandyāvartākṛtiṃ prāptaissaupānānāṃ catuṣṭayaiḥ| yuktaṃ bahutalopetaṃ śuddhasvastikamucyate|| 8.97 || iti śripāñcarātre mahopaniṣadi pādmasaṃhitāyāṃ kriyāpāde prāsadabhedo nāma aṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ|
<2.9>
śrībhagavān nāgaraṃ drāmiḍaṃ caiva vesaraṃ ceti tattridhā| ā stūpīkarṇa mārabhya caturaśraṃ prakalpitam|| 9.1 || dhāmā yatāśramathavā nāgaraṃ tadudāhṛtam| vasvaśramāyataṃ dhiṣṇyaṃ ṣaḍaśramathavāyatam|| 9.2 || uktaṃ taddhāmiḍāhvānaṃ vṛttaṃ vṛttāyataṃ punaḥ| vesarākhyaṃ tadākhyātamevaṃ trividhamiṣyate|| 9.3 || murdheṣṭakāvidhiṃ brahman śruṇu vakṣyāmi sāṃpratam| bhavanasya punaḥ pūrvaṃ pūrvavatkārayetprapām|| 9.4 || tanmadhye vedikāṃ kuryātsarvālaṅkārasaṃyutām| yanmayyo yādṛśāḥ pūrvaṃ kalpitāḥ prathameṣṭakāḥ|| 9.5 || mūrdheṣṭakāśca tanmayyaścatasrastādṛśāḥ smṛtāḥ| snāpayetpūrvavattāśca dhānyarāśiṣu nikṣipet|| 9.6 || dvārakumbhān dhvajān samyaktoraṇāni samarcayet| saṃsthāpayenmahākunbhaṃ tasminnāvāhya pūjayet|| 9.7 || vedikāyāścaturdikṣu homaḥ pūrvavadiṣyate| dikṣvaṣṭāsu tathā dhāmna śśāntihomaṃ prakalpayet|| 9.8 || pūrvavacceṣṭakāssūtrairveṣṭayet prayato'bjaja| dhānyarāśiṣu saṃsthāpya kalaśānpañcaviṃśatīḥ|| 9.9 || maṇihemādisaṃyuktān sūtravastādiveṣṭhitān| arcayedgandhapuppādyairācāryaśśāstracakṣuṣā|| 9.10 || upoṣitaśśucissnāto navavastrāṅgulīyakaḥ| tatraiva darbhānāstīrya śayīta vijitendriyaḥ|| 9.11 || mūrdheṣṭakāsāmādhātā tathaiva guruṇā saha| yajamānena śuddhātmā sopavāpo jitendriyaḥ|| 9.12 || vasettatraiva darbheṣu dhyāyan paramapūruṣam| evaṃ rātrau prakurvīta yathoktaṃ sarvamakṣatam|| 9.13 || śvobhūte vimale śuddhe muhūrte gururātmavān| uddhṛtya kalaśān sarvān snāpayenmūlavidyayā|| 9.14 || mahākumbhasthatoyena bhuyastān snāpayedguruḥ| abhyarcya mūlamantreṇa veṣṭayennavavāsasā|| 9.15 || ādāya ceṣṭakāssarvā ṛtvijassamalaṅkṛtāḥ| dhāma pradakṣiṇīkṛtya tūryaghoṣasamanvitam|| 9.16 || āropayeyustāssarvā vimānasyoparisthale| puṇyāhaṃ vācayettatra ṛtvigbhinsahito guruḥ|| 9.17 || mūrdheṣṭakānāmādhātā prāṅmukhassusamāhitaḥ| dhyāyannārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ hṛtpadme praṇavaṃ japet|| 9.18 || ādadhyādiṣṭakā ssarvāḥ pūrvādikramamāśritaḥ| strī śūdrāssānulomāśca tūṣṇīmādhānamācaret|| 9.19 || pāparogayutān brahman patitān pratilomajān| varjayedyatnamāsthāya maryyain mūrdheṣṭakāvidau|| 9.20 || praṇamya śirasā bhūmau yajamāno guraṃ punaḥ| pastraiśca dhanadhānyaiśca gobhūmikanakai stathā|| 9.21 || pañcāṅgabhūṣaṇaṃ dadvāddhāsīdāsāṃ stathaivaca| vāhanaṃ hastituragaṃ chatropanahameva ca|| 9.22 || tasmaica guruve sarvaṃ prayacche daviśaṅkitaḥ| toṣayedrathakārāṃśca vastānnādhanadhānyakaiḥ|| 9.23 || stūpikākīlamadhunā vakṣyāmi kamalāsana| lohajaṃ dārujaṃ vāpi stupikākīlamiṣyate|| 9.24 || ūrdhvabhūmyaṅghrītulitaṃ vistārāyāmasaṃmitam| stūpikākīlametatpyādagramaṅgula saṃyutam|| 9.25 || vimānakaṇṭhatulitamadhyardhaṃ dviguṇaṃtuvā| evaṃ caturvadhaṃ proktaṃ stūpikākīlamuttamam|| 9.26 || tadvṛttaṃ caturaśraṃ vā pañcāśraṃ va prakalpayet| vṛttāyate vimāne tu caturaśrāyate pi ca|| 9.27 || yugmaṃ syāt stūpikākīlamapunarbhavakāṅkṣīṇām| itareṣāmayugmaṃ syāt stūpikākīlakalpanam|| 9.28 || yāvadviṃśatiyugmaṃ syādayugmaikonaviṃśatiḥ| caturaśre ṣaḍaśre ca aṣṭāśre samavṛttake|| 9.29 || stūpikākīlamevaṃ syātsarvakāma samṛddhidam| kṛtvaivaṃ stūpikākīlamadhivāsaṃ prakalpayet|| 9.30 || snāpanādikriyāssarvā yāvadāropaṇakriyā| mūrdheṣṭakāvatkartavyā viśeṣastu vidhīyate|| 9.31 || āropite tataḥ kīle vimānāgre sthitastudhīḥ| puṇyāhaṃ vācayedgarte navaratnaṃ vinikṣipet|| 9.32 || pūrvādimadhyamāntaṃ syāt dhātubījaṃ salohakam| kṣiptvagarte tatastūpīṃ prāṅmukho mulavidyayā|| 9.33 || ācāryasthāpayet stūpīṃ pañcāṅgākalpabhuṣitaḥ| hāropavītakaṭakaiḥ keyūrairaṅgulīyakaiḥ|| 9.34 || pañcāṅgabhuṣaṇai retai rbhūṣitassottarīyakaḥ| nudhayā stūpikāgartaṃ dṛḍhīkuryādanantaram|| 9.35 || sthāpanīyā ṛjustūpī vakrā cedpahudoṣadā| saurarṇī rājatī tāmrī stupī dārumayī tathā|| 9.36 || pūrvapūrvā bahuphalā paścimā paścimālpadā| guruve dakṣiṇā deyā hemasaṅkhyā ca pūrvavat|| 9.37 || śikhākumbhaṃ suvarṇaṃ vā rājataṃ tāmrameva vā| paittalaṃ mṛṇmayaṃ vāpi sthāpaye ttatkṣaṇe śubhe|| 9.38 || vṛttedhāmani vṛttaṃ syādaśriyukte'śriyucca tat| nānāratnaiśca lohaiśca śikhākumbhaṃ ca pūrayet|| 9.39 || ghaṭāgraṃ mukulākāraṃ dīpākāramadhāpi vā| kuryānmanoharaṃ hṛdya madhastāttasya paṅkajam|| 9.40 || mahānāsottamāṅgeṣu cakraṃ vā śūlameva vā| sthāpayellohajaṃ vāpi dārujaṃ vā tathā bhavet|| 9.41 || tale tale vimānānāṃ dikṣu devānprakalpayet| indramaindryāṃ kumāraṃ vā dakṣiṇasyāmumāpatim|| 9.42 || dakṣiṇāmūrtimatha vā pratīcyāṃ nṛhariṃ harim| śrīdharaṃ vā tathodīcyāṃ brahmāṇaṃ vā dhanadhipam|| 9.43 || athavā''divarāhassyāt prācyāṃ naraharistathā| tato nu śrīdharo devaḥ tato hayaśirāḥ smṛtaḥ|| 9.44 || prācyādiṣvatha vā dikṣu naro nārāyaṇo hariḥ| kṛṣṇaścatvāra ete nyurathavā puruṣaḥ paraḥ|| 9.45 || satyo dakṣiṇataḥ paścādacyuto'nanta uttare| vāsudevādayo vāsyurdikṣu pūrvādiṣukramāt|| 9.46 || śrīdharaṃ pūrvadigbhāge varāhaṃ dakṣiṇe tathā| nṛsiṃhaṃ paścame bhāge anantaṃ cottare tathā|| 9.47 || dhruvabhere sthite dikṣu mūrtayopi sthitā stathā| asīne tadvadāsīnaśśayāne tubhayaṃ bhavet|| 9.48 || yānārūḍhepradhāne tu yānārūḍhā sthsitāścate| viśvarūpe tu tadvatsyāt sthitā vā syuścaturbhujāḥ|| 9.49 || indrādayaśca digdevāḥ āsīnā eva te sadā| vimāna śailaje dikṣu śailajā eva devatāḥ|| 9.50 || toyādhivāsanaṃ kutvā maṇṭape cādhivāsya ca| muhūrte sthāpayeddhikṣu varṇālepaṃ samācaret|| 9.51 || śūlāni sthāvayeddhikṣu vimānetviṣṭakāmaye| toyādhivāsanaṃ kṛtvā adhivāsya vyapetkramāt|| 9.52 || trivastukamayaṃ kṛtvā varṇālepaṃ samācaret| yo varṇo yasya śāstrokta stenai vālepanaṃ bhavet|| 9.53 || vyatyāse brāhmaṇādīnāṃ varṇānāṃ saṅkarobhavet| sarve ca bhittibhāgastāḥ padmaviṣṭapamāsthitāḥ|| 9.54 || ardhacitrāḥ kṛtāssarve citrābhāsena vā bhavet| ekanāsāsamāyukai ekā diṅmūrtiriṣyate|| 9.55 || caturbhujo vā dvibhujassaumyavaktraḥ smitānanaḥ| vimāne nāsikāhīne diṅmūrtirapi neṣyate|| 9.56 || caturaśrāyate vṛtte dhāmni vṛttāyate pi ca| vīlasenassu ṣeṇaśca vīranāthassubhadrakaḥ|| 9.57 || āgneyādividikṣvete bāhubhissadmadhāriṇaḥ| viṣyupāriṣadāḥ sthāpyāḥ karālavadanānvitāḥ|| 9.58 || caturaśrāyate dhāmni nāsikādvayasaṃyute| dakṣiṇottaratastasya puraṣau pūrṇapuṣkarau|| 9.59 || śaṅkhacakradharau sthāpyau hastau yavanikāspṛśau| tale tale vimānasya surā vidyādharāḥ smṛtāḥ|| 9.60 || nṛtyanto bahudhā veṇuvīṇāpaṇavadhāriṇaḥ| kalpanīyāstathānye ca kinnaroragajātayaḥ|| 9.61 || mamāvatārāssarvatra kalpyāstaśceṣṭitāni ca| kapoteṣu kapoteṣu taleṣu ca taleṣu ca|| 9.62 || haṃsamālāṃ prakalpeta bhūtamālāṃ tathaiva ca| anyonya mukhamālokya sthitāgaganayāyinaḥ|| 9.63 || bhūtāni nānā nṛtyanti vikṛtānanabhañjica| praterupari kaṇṭhasyāpyadhastātkoṇabhūmiṣu|| 9.64 || garuḍānkalpa yetsiṃhān saṃviṣṭānathavā sthitān| tadunnataṃ kaṇṭhapātraṃ pādamātramathāpi vā|| 9.65 || adurdhaṃ vā tripādaṃ vā nānyadhocchrāyamiṣyate| adhastāttadadhiṣṭhāne kalpayeddhevatāḥ kramāt|| 9.66 || agneye hastivadanamīśaṃ dakṣiṇato'thavā| dakṣiṇāmūrtimṛṣibhissevitaṃ vaṭamāśritam|| 9.67 || viśvarūpaṃ pratīcīne kamalāsanamuttare| aiśānyāṃ vasudhāṃ devīṃ stāpayettu vicakṣaṇaḥ|| 9.68 || athavā pūrvavatsarvā diṅmūrtīḥ parikalpayet| adhastādutapīṭhe'pi pūrvauktā dikṣu devatāḥ|| 9.69 || athavā tatkathopetā nprādurbhāvānprakalpayet| pāṣāṇaśarkarā takrasudhayā triḥ prakārayā|| 9.70 || piṣṭayā triphalāmbhobhissakṛddvistiśca yatnataḥ| khadirārjunajai stoyaiśśalmalyāḥ kṣīraśākhinaḥ|| 9.71 || miśrī kṛtyāvaṭe samyaktoyabhāvitayā tathā| abhiṣicyaparikvāthaṃ saṃmiśrībhūtayā punaḥ|| 9.72 || gulapākarasaistaiśca punaḥ kvathitayā bhaśam| dhāma liṃpetkrameṇaiva sthūlāditrividhātmanā|| 9.73 || cirasthāyi bhavedevaṃ kalpite mandiraṃ tu tat| pāṣāṇaśarkarā takrasugandhaṃ cūrṇayetpurā|| 9.74 || taccūrṇe pīṣṭamāne tadviguṇāṃ vālukāṃ kṣīpet| piṣṭaṃ tadekavāraṃ cet sthūlaṃ dviḥ piṣṭamucyate|| 9.75 || sūkṣmaṃ triścetparijñeyaḥ sthūlādyā lepanakramaḥ| pañcavarṇaistataḥ kuryācchobhitaṃ śāstracakṣuṣā|| 9.76 || upānahādistūpyastaṃ bhuṣa yetkanakādibhiḥ| muktā maṇihiraṇyasrakkiṅkiṇījāla ketubhiḥ|| 9.77 || bhuṣayetsadanaṃ viṣṇoryathāvittānusārataḥ| iti śrīpāñcarātre mahopaniṣadi pādmasaṃhitāyāṃ kriyāpade mūrdheṣṭakāvidhivimāna devatākalpanaṃ nāma navamo'dhyāyaḥ |
<2.10>
śrībhagavān parivāraniveśārthaṃ śobhārthaṃ mandirasya ca| rakṣaṇārthaṃ ca paritaḥ prākāraṃ parikalpayet|| 10.1 || antarmaṇḍalanāmānaṃ prākāraṃ prathamaṃ viduḥ|| antarhāraṃ tato vapraṃ madhyāhāramanantaram|| 10.2 || anantaraṃ ca maryādā mahatī nāma pañcakam| pañcaite caturaśrāssussamupetakhalūrikāḥ|| 10.3 || pañcabhedāśca tantreṣu candrikābhūmirantimā | ekāstambhāvalī kalpyā dvayī vā kamalāsana|| 10.4 || upānadādipañcauṅga madhiṣṭhānaṃ prakalpayet| daṇḍastadardhaṃ pādosaṃ tasyotsedhassamīritaḥ|| 10.5 || adhiṣṭhāne kṛte tasmiṃstambhamālā vidhīyate| antarālaṃ mahīmāhurdhā māntarmaṇḍalākhyayā|| 10.6 || pañcahastāṃ caturhastaṃ dvihastāṃ vā yatheccayā| āntarāvaraṇasyāsya pañcaprāsādagumbhitaḥ|| 10.7 || vicchinne cānta reṣāṃ tu sālānāmantarālabhūḥ| ekadvitricaturhastaiḥ kramaśe vardhito bhavet|| 10.8 || mandirasya mahānāsāsamassālasamucchrayaḥ| grīvagratulito vā syātpratisammita eva vā|| 10.9 || uparīṭhasamāyukto sālodaṇḍastrirucchrayaḥ| catuḥ pañca dvidaṇḍo vā sālānāmucchrayaṃ viduḥ|| 10.10 || upariṣṭācca sālānāṃ siṃho garuḍa eva vā| kalpanīyaḥ prayatnena dhvajayaṣṭissamantataḥ|| 10.11 || prāsādāgre prakartavya sta daṅga ścārdhamaṇḍapaḥ| caturdhā dhāmani kṛte pādo vārdhamathāpi vā|| 10.12 || tripādvā dhāma tulyaṃ vā adhyardhaṃ vā yathāruci| dviguṇaṃ vā caturva ktrayadvā harmyapramāṇataḥ|| 10.13 || ekahastaṃ dvihastaṃ vā trihastaṃ vā samāyatam| caturhastaṃ pañcahastaṃ kārayenardhamaṇḍapam|| 10.14 || antarālaṃ tayoḥ kāryāṃ tālaṃ yadvā karāyatam| daṇḍamadhyardhamatha vā dviguṇaṃ vā vināpi vā|| 10.15 || hīne'rdhe maṇḍape dhāmni pārśvābhyāṃ nirgamaḥ smṛtaḥ| agrataḥ pṛṣṭhataścāpi bhavetāṃ pārśvavartmanī|| 10.16 || catvāri gopurāṇi syurdhāma cetsopapīṭhakam| agre tu maṇḍapasyārdhe vipule vṛttamaṇḍapaḥ|| 10.17 || samucchṛtaṃ pratisamamadhikaṃ vā yathecchayā| ekadvitricatuḥ pañcahastau vṛttārdhamaṇḍapau|| 10.18 || sāntarālaṃ samuddhiṣṭaṃ pārśvābhyaṃ nirgamaḥ smṛtaḥ | sopānapaṅtkayaḥ kāryāḥ pārśva yorubhayorapi|| 10.19 || devālayeṣu yugmāssyu ṣṣaḍaṅgulasamucchrayāḥ| tāvadvistārayuktāścaṃ dvyaṅgula vobhayaṃ bhavet|| 10.20 || sopānaparśvayo rhastihastaṃ kuryāt sthavīyasaḥ| yadvā rathāṅgaṃ virvīta dvirataṃ pārśvavāhikam|| 10.21 || dvāraṃ vātāyanaṃ vāpi bhittibandhaṃ na jūtu cit| kulakṣaye vināśaśca vyādharvā bhittabandhane|| 10.22 || yadvārdhamaṇḍapādardhaṃ tripādaṃ pādameva vā| tattulyaṃ vāntarāṃ tu antarālāntaraṃ bhavet|| 10.23 || vistāro hrāsayettasya astarālasya pārśvayoḥ| hastaṃ tālaṃ tadardhaṃ vā hrāsayetpārśvayorapiḥ|| 10.24 || yugmastambha samo petaṃ tālabandhamathāpi vā| lāṅgalaṃ vā prakurvīta ubhayaṃ vā vinā bhavet|| 10.25 || caturaśrāyataṃ vā syāccaturdvāraṃ caturdaśam| vātāyanaṃ vā yugmetu na kuryādbhittibandhanam|| 10.26 || antarāvaraṇasyānta rbahirvobhayatopi vā| āyāmo maṇḍapasya syādayugmaṃ
