tu pramāṇataḥ|| 10.27 || āṣoḍaśāntaṃ yugme syādadhāyugme trayodaśa| maṇḍapāyāmamuddiṣṭaṃ hastaiḥ kamalasambhava|| 10.28 || yadvā mūlālayasamamardhamaṇḍapasaṃmitam| tadardhaṃ pādamevātha yadvālayasamaṃ bhavet|| 10.29 || adhyardhaṃ dviguṇaṃ vātha sapādaṃ vālayasya ca| maṇṭapāyāmamuddiṣṭaṃ vistāre kamalāsana|| 10.30 || mūlālayasamaṃ vāpi tālahastaṃ ca vādhikam| upānādyaṅgasaṃyuktaṃ sarvālaṅkārasaṃyutam|| 10.31 || nānānāṭakasaṃyukta manta stambhavivarjitam| utsedhaṃ maṇṭapasyāhurardhamaṇṭapasaṃmitam|| 10.32 || adhikaṃ vā tadutsedhaṃ maṇṭapasya caturmukha| yadvā prāgyāmyasopanaṃ pāśve tannirgamo bhavet|| 10.34 || kalpayecchilpaśāstrajño bhittayaḥ koṇabhūmiṣu| sthalabandhaṃ tadūrdhve tu lāṅgalaṃ vā prakalpayet|| 10.35 || koṇeṣu garuḍaṃ kuryātsiṃhiṃ vā kamalāsana| sabhāṃ vā tatprakurvīta yathā vittānusārataḥ|| 10.36 || prākārasya caturdikṣu gopurāṇi prakalpayet| dhāmāgravṛṣṭhayorvā syādagre caikaṃ prakalpayet|| 10.37 || talairdvādaśabhiryuktamuttamaṃ dvitalādiṣu| mūrdheṣṭakāṃ stūpikāṃ ca pūrvavatkalpayetkramāt|| 10.38 || diṅmūrtayaḥ pūrvavatsyuḥ pūrvavadgaruḍādikam| prākāreṣu ca sarveṣu maṇḍapāsyussamantataḥ|| 10.39 || ṣaḍviṃśatidhanurmānaṃ maṇḍapaṃ cottamaṃ viduḥ| aṣṭādaśadhanurmānaṃ maṇḍapaṃ padhyamaṃ viduḥ|| 10.40 || adhamaṃ dvādaśadhanumaṇḍapaṃ saṃpracakṣate| pūrvoktahastasaṅkhyaṃ vā kuryādāsthānamaṇḍapam|| 10.41 || uttamaṃ daśabhirhastairmadhyamaṃ cāṣṭahastakaṃ| ṣaḍḍhastamadhamaṃ vidhyāt kṣudraṃ hastatrayāyatam|| 10.42 || dakṣīṇottarataḥ pṛṣṭhe bhittiṃ tasya prakalpayet| stambhāṣṭakayutaṃ tatra sopānaṃ parikalpayet||10.43 || dīrghaśālāmadhaḥ kuryā dyūpācchādanasaṃyutām| maṇṭapāḥ prāṅmukhāssarve sarvāvaraṇasaṃsthitāḥ|| 10.44 || āsthānamaṇṭapānsarvān prakuryātsarvato mukhān| prāsādāraṃbhavatsarvaṃ bhūmi saṃśodhanādikam|| 10.45 || kṛtvā hastinakhaṃ caiva maṇṭapaṃ caiva kalpayet| garbhanyāsastu koṇe syādagrermaṇṭapakarmaṇi|| 10.46 || gopurekriyamāṇe tu dakṣiṇasyāṃ diśismṛtaḥ| kavāṭayugmaṃ saṃsthāpya dvāre dvāre dṛḍhaṃyathā|| 10.47 || lohajaṃ dārujaṃ vāpi vicitraṃ turagādibhiḥ| uttarāṅgaṃ śilādāru vā harecchilpissaha|| 10.48 || rathakṛttakṣayitvā tu sarveṇa kṣālayeddrutaḥ| puṇyāhaṃ vācayitvātha muhorte śobhane guruḥ|| 10.49 || rathakṛcchilpibhissārthaṃ dvārasyopari nikṣipet| śākhācatuṣkaṃ kurvīta tathai vaśilayāpi vā|| 10.50 || śākhākavāṭau prakṣālya pañcopaniṣadā jalaiḥ| navavastreṇa saṃveṣṭya dhānyarāśiṣu nikṣipet|| 10.51 || mahākumbhārcanaṃ kuryātpūrvavacchāstracoditam| kṛtvā prabhāte vimale muhorte śobhane guruḥ|| 10.52 || khāte lohādi vinyasya kārayecchilpinā saha| puṇyāhaṃ vācayitvā ca pañcagavyairvilepayet|| 10.53 || mahākumbhajalai rdevān nyasetkūrcena tat kṣaṇāt| adhaśśāntiṃ dakṣiṇato vāgdevīmupari śriyam|| 10.54 || ratimuttarataśśāsvevaṃ catasṛṣu kramāt| kavāṭe dakṣiṇe sthāpyo viśvadhṛgbhūtanāyakaḥ|| 10.55 || kavāṭe cottare sthāpyo viśvavaktraḥ prātāpavān| avatārāṃśca tatra sthān prokṣayetsvasya vidyayā|| 10.56 || devaśāstrapurāṇāni vetreṣu nivasantica| nārāceṣu trayastriṃśaddevāḥ kīleṣu carkṣayaḥ|| 10.57 || kavāṭapaṭṭikāyāṃ ca bhūtanāthaḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ| kavāṭanandapaṭṭe syāte saṃsthāpyo viśva bhāvanaḥ|| 10.58 || evaṃ kumbhajale dhyātvā vinyasetsarvadevatāḥ| ācāryadakṣiṇāṃ dadyāt niṣkasaṅkhyā tu pūrvavat|| 10.59 || sauvarṇo rājatastāmraḥ kavāṭo dārujasmṛtaḥ| pūrvaḥ pūrvaḥ phalāya syāt bhūyase kalpate nṛṇām|| 10.60 || kavāṭaṃ dārajaṃ svarṇaiḥ rañjayanpūhyate suraiḥ| stambhān pādaśilāsveva ratnanyāsādi pūrvavat|| 10.61 || na sthāpyā brahmaṇasthsāne teṣāmupari potikāḥ| kalpyāstā ssūttarāropo vājanādisamanvitā|| 10.62 || tulāmāropayetpaścāt bandhayecceṣṭakādibhiḥ| talabandhaṃ tataḥ kuryāt brahman vittānusārataḥ|| 10.63 || yūpacchādavakaṃ vāpi kuryācchāstrāsusārataḥ| caṇḍapracaṇṭau kartavyau dvāre garbhagṛhasyatu|| 10.64 || dakṣiṇottarapārśvasthau muniveṣau sahastriyau| daṃṣṭrākarālavadanau bhīmau vā daṇḍa dhāriṇau|| 10.65 || kāntāviyuktau vikaṭau karaṇḍi makuṭojvalau| ardhamaṇṭapakadvāre śaṅkhacakrottamāṅginau|| 10.66 || antarmaṇḍalasaṃjñasya sālasya dvārapārśśayoḥ| jayaśca vijaya ścaiva kartavyau tasya gopure|| 10.67 || evameveṣyate'nyeṣāṃ caturdikṣu ca gopuram| antarhārasya pūrvasyāṃ dvāri padmagadādharau|| 10.68 || khaḍgaśārṅgadharau dvāri dakṣiṇasyāṃ prakalpayet| pratīcyāṃ vajramusaladhāriṇau diśi kalpayet|| 10.69 || pāśāṅkuśadharau brahmannuttarasyāṃ diśi sthitau| madhyāntarhārasālasya prācyādiṣu yathākramam|| 10.70 || dikṣu dhātṛvidhātārau tato bhadrasubhadrakau| kṛtāntāsuravidhvaṃsau kuberākṣakuberakau|| 10.71 || prācyādiṣu tathā dikṣu maryādā sālagopurau| durjayaprabalau kāryau viśvabhāvanapuṣkarau|| 10.72 || sambhavaprabhavau syātāṃ subhobhanasubhadrakau| jaghanyāvaraṇadvāre prācyādau kumudādayaḥ|| 10.73 || kumudagi kumudākṣaśca puṇḍarīko'dha vāmanaḥ| śaṅkukarṇassarva netrassumukhassapratiṣṭhitaḥ|| 10.74 || aṣṭau dvau dvau pratidvāraṃ kalpanīyā yathāvidhi| viṣṇupāriṣadāssarve senabhiḥ koṭibhirvṛtāḥ|| 10.75 || daṇḍahastā virūpākṣāḥ karaṇḍamukuṭānvitāḥ| phaṇikaṅkaṇamālāḍhyāḥ bhrukuṭīkuṭilekṣaṇāḥ|| 10.76 || vyatyastahastacaraṇāḥ rakṣanti dvāramāśritāḥ| caturthāvaraṇe kuryātpākasthānaṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ|| 10.77 || prathamāvaṇe vāpi dvitīyāvaraṇe'pi vā| tṛtīyāvaraṇe vāpi yathādeśānukūlataḥ|| 10.78 || indrāgnimadhye vāgneye tasya sthānaṃ vidhīyate| khilūrikā samāyuktaṃ madhye cāṅkaṇasaṃyutam|| 10.79 || caturaśrāyate bhāge pracīnasyāśma kāntakam| yugtmerhastapramāṇaiścadīrgha culyena vā yutam || 10. 80 || madhyegniyamayoḥ kuṇḍaṃ nityahomāya kalpayet| apūpapacanasthānaṃ madhye naiṛtayāmyayoḥ|| 10.81 || phalāni nikṣipenmadhye nirṛtervaruṇasya ca| dvāraṃ prakalpayetprak madhye vāyujaleśayoḥ|| 10.82 || marīcyādi nidhānaṃ syādvāyusomāntare bhavet | sarpirādidravasthānaṃ madhyeśarvaśacīśayoḥ|| 10.83 || kṣālanaṃ taṇḍulādīnāṃ kūpontarbahi reva vā| dhūmanirgamamārgāśca yugmāssyuḥ kuṭilāsa thā|| 10.84 || majjanambhogṛhaṃ yāmye tābbūlī dhāma nairute| vāruṇe vāsanāṃ sthānaṃ mārute puṣpamaṇṭapaḥ|| 10.85 || saumye cai kāntināṃ bhuktisthānamīśe dhanālayaḥ| bahīrāvaraṇe kuyān dāgneye dhānyasaṃgraham|| 10.86 || avaghātagṛhaṃ yāmye gośālāsyādumāpatau| tṛtīyāvaraṇesthānaṃ bhatrādīnāṃ vibhāvasau|| 10.87 || śibhikādisthitiścaindre pānīyaṃ vāruṇe bhavet| utsave devayajanaṃ somaśānāntare bhavet || 10.88 || indreśānāntare vāpi madhyevāgnisureśayoḥ| yamāgnimadhye vā kuryādutsaveyāga maṇṭapam|| 10.89 || sthānamīśe sarasvatyāḥ vādyasthānaṃ tu vāya ve| yathoktāvaraṇābhāve vadyamāne kvacidbhavet|| 10.90 || vāruṇe vā bhavetyaumye kūpaṃ śārvepi vā bhavet| yatra vāpāṃ sirāgsanti tatrakūpaṃ prakalpayet|| 10.91 || aṣṭadikṣu yathā yogaṃ taṭākaṃ kārayenmaham| prākārāṇāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ bahiṣṭhā dīrghakā bhavet|| 10.92 || śāstraśravaṇayuktānāṃ vedadhyayanaśālinam| yatīnāmitareṣāṃ ca paṭhaḥ kāryo bahirbhavet|| 10.93 || sadanāni ca kāryāṇi devamāśritya tiṣṭhatām| udyānaṃ puṣpavāṭīṃ ca parito dhāma kalpayet|| 10.94 || ekāvaraṇayukta sya parivārānimān śṛṇu| pradhānaberābhimukhaḥ kalpanīyo vihaṅgarāṭ|| 10.95 || nṛttārdhamaṇṭapyasāgre tasya dhāma ca kalpayet| gopurasyotta re sāle mandirābhimukho raviḥ|| 10.96 || tasyaiva dakṣiṇe sāle sudhāṃśuṃ parikalpayet| vahnau kāmo yame brahmanaiṛte syādgajānanaḥ|| 10.97 || vāraṇe ṣaṇmukho durgāvāyau saumye dhanādhipaḥ| īśāne śaṅkarastatra kṣetrapālastathā bhavet|| 10.98 || someśayorantarāle viṣvaksenaṃ prakalpayet| aṅkaṇe kakṣiṇe sapta mātaraśśrīstu naiṛte|| 10.99 || indrādayo lokapālāḥ pūhyassvāśāsu cāṅkaṇe| gopurasya bhavedantarbahirvā balipīṭhakam|| 10.100 || antarhārāhvāyopete viśeṣo dhāmmi kathya te| sūryācandramasoḥ sthāne saṃsthāpyau puruṣācyutau|| 10.101 || suryācandramasau kalpau dvitīyāvaraṇe tathā| hayagrīvaḥ smarassthāne sthāne saṅkarṣa ṇo vidheḥ|| 10.102 || varāhū vighnarāṭ sthāne pradyumnaśśarajanmanaḥ| kātyāyanyāmanantasyādaniruddho narāsane|| 10.103 || nṛ kesarī śaṅka resyādaṅkaṇe pīṭhikāsu cet| indrādayassamabhyarcyā steṣāṃ sthāne yathākramam|| 10.104 || cakrī musalavān śaṅkhī khaḍgīcaiva gadādharaḥ| śārṅga padmī tathā vajrī pūjyā divyāstradhāriṇaḥ|| 10.105 || prathamāvaraṇe yeṣāṃ sthāne nye samudīritāḥ| jñeyā dvitīye te sarve parivārā yathoktayā|| 10.106 || madhyāntarhārasāle tu gopurobhayapārśvayoḥ| ādityā dvādaśārādyāḥ madhye manmathavethaso|| 10.107 || vasavaḥ pūjinīyāsyurvidhivighna kṛtoḥ punaḥ| madye pitṛgaṇāḥ pūjyāṣṣaḍānanagaṇeśayoḥ|| 10.108 || viśve devāssamārādyāḥ maruto guhadurgayoḥ| saptarṣayaḥ pūjanīyā madhye durgākuberayoḥ|| 10.109 || kubereśāna yormadhye rudrā ekādaśa smṛtāḥ| tatraiva ca kṣetrapālāḥ prāṅkaṇe kumudādayaḥ|| 10.110 || indrādipīṭhikāsthāne sabhājyāḥ kamalāsana| maryādavaraṇe sthāpyā aṣṭādaśa gaṇeṣu ye|| 10.111 || uttamāḥ parivārāste prāṅkaṇorvītale punaḥ| upendrapramukhāḥ pūjyā dikṣu prācyādiṣu kramāt|| 10.112 || upendraḥ prākṛtaḥ puṇyaḥ puṣkaro viśvabhāvanaḥ| asuraghnaḥ kṛtāntaśca bhutanātho'ṣṭamaḥ smṛtaḥ|| 10.113 || maryādāyāṃ mahatyāṃ tu madhyamā ye gaṇeṣu te| parivārāḥ prakartavyāḥ viśvādyā vāsavādiṣu|| 10.114 || aṅkaṇeṣu samarcyā ye vakṣye tānanupūrvaśaḥ | viśveśo vaśvikṛdviśvo viśvātmā viśvalocanaḥ|| 10.115 || viśvapādo viśvabhujastathā vai viśvakarmakṛt| aṣṭādasagaṇān vakṣyetān budhyasva kramoditān|| 10.116 || ādityā vasavo rudrāḥ sādyāśca maruta stathā| viśve devāśca pitaro mātaro guhadevatāḥ|| 10.117 || aṅgirāścāśvinīdevau tathā strīdevātāgaṇāḥ| lokeśā vāstudevāśca nakṣatrāṇi ca pārṣadāḥ|| 10.118 || tatvānāṃ patayaścaiva uttamāḥ parikīrtitāḥ | siddhāśca ṛṣayo nāgāḥ asurā rākṣasā api|| 10.119 || yakṣavidyadharāścaiva saurabheyāśca guhyakāḥ| gandharvāpsarasaścaiva vrajānāṃ patayastathā|| 10.120 || martyāścaivātha rohiṇyo gaṇāste madhyamāḥ smṛtāḥ| bhūtāḥ pretāḥ piśācāśca kūśmāṇḍāḥ pramathā api|| 10.121 || skando bālagrahāścaiva taitalāścaiva bhairavāḥ| kinnarāścaiva vetālā apasmārāstathaiva ca|| 10.122 || yoginyaścaiva ḍhākinyaśśākinyaścaiva cārikāḥ| mohinyaśceva sarveṣu jaghanyāḥ parikīrtatāḥ|| 10.123 || dhātā'ryamā vidhātā ca matriśca varuṇa stathā| bhago vivasvān pūṣā ca savitā ca ravistathā|| 10.124 || tvaṣṭā viṣṇuriti proktāḥ dvādaśaite'ditessutāḥ| dharo dhruvaśca somaśca āpaścaivānilo'valaḥ|| 10.125 || pratyūṣaśca prabhāsaśca vasavaśśāntavarcasaḥ| mṛgavyādhaśca śarvaśca nirṛtirdhvaja ekapāt|| 10.126 || ahirbudhnyaḥ pinākī ca yavaṣaśca tathaiva ca| sthāṇurbhavaḥ kapālī ca rudrāścai kādaśa smṛtāḥ|| 10.127 || triṇetrā rudrasadṛśāḥ jaṭāmukuṭadhāriṇaḥ| āvaho vivahaścaiva udvahassaṃvahastathā|| 10.128 || nivaho'nuvahaśceva pravahaśca tathaiva ca| saptaite marutaḥ proktāssapta sastādribhedinaḥ|| 10.129 || alo raviśca rudraśca agnirāpastathaiva ca| pañcaitetu samākhyātāḥ gaṇāssādhyasamāhvayāḥ|| 10.130 || rudro'gnissavitā viṣṇurviśve devagaṇāḥ smṛtāḥ| kavyavāḍavalassomo yama evāryamā tathā|| 10.131 || agniṣvāttāssomapāśca tathā barhiṣadopi ca| ete pitṛgaṇāḥ proktāssaptaite lokapūjitāḥ|| 10.132 || kraturdakṣaḥ kālakākhyo vasussatyaśśucī ruci| purūravā rdvaścaiva viśve deva ime smṛtāḥ|| 10.133 || nāsatyadassamubhayamaśvinau parikīrtitau| anyonyasadṛśau devau pīyūṣa kalaśodbhavau|| 10.134 || ravisomāṅgārabudhaguruśukraśanaiścarāḥ| rāhuketū tathā śliṣṭau kīrta tāstu navagrahāḥ|| 10.135 || śakrāgni yamarakṣāṃsi varuṇo vāyureva ca| soma īśāna ityaṣṭau lokapālāḥ prakīrtitāḥ|| 10.136 || brahmā marīciratriśca vinasvān vṛthivīśvaraḥ| āpaścai vāpavatsaśca savitā ca savitrakaḥ|| 10.137 || rudro rudrajayaścaiva indra indrajaya stathā| iśaścaivātha parjanyo jayantaśca mahondrakaḥ|| 10.138 || bhānussatyo bhṛguśceva antarikṣaśca pūrvataḥ| agniḥ pūṣā kṛśobhanurbṛhat kṣatro yamastathā|| 10.139 || gandharvo bhṛṅgarājaśca mṛgaścaiva tu yāmyataḥ| pitṛdauvārikā ścaiva sukrīvaḥ puṣpadantakaḥ|| 10.140 || varuṇaśca bhṛśaścāpo cakṣumaśca manojavaḥ| roganāthaśca mṛtyanto bhallāṭassoma eva ca|| 10.141 || aditirvāstunāthaśca vāsudevagaṇāḥ smṛtāḥ| agnirvāyaḥ prajāsaktaścatvāro'ṅgirasaḥ smṛtāḥ|| 10.142 || tiṣṭhanti munirupeṇa devarūpeṇa ca dvidhā| lakṣmīssarasvatī vighnā tisrastu gṛhadevatāḥ|| 10.143 || ityete'ṣṭādaśa proktāḥ gaṇā madhyottamādhamāḥ| uttamā madhyamā ścāpi parivāreṣu saṃmatāḥ|| 10.144 || rudrālayādiṣvadhamāḥ parivārāḥ prakīrtitāḥ| iti śrīpāñcarātre mahopaniṣadi pādmasaṃhitāyāṃ kriyāpāde parivārādidevatākalpanaṃ nāma daśamo'dhyāyaḥ|
<2.11>
śrībhagavān ataḥ paraṃ pratikṛterdravyasya vidhirucyate| yanmayaṃ pratimādravyaṃ tadanekaṃ pracakṣate|| 11.1 || ratnaṃ lohaṃ śilā mṛcca dāru sphaṭika eva ca| ṣaḍdravyāṇi prakṛtayo yanmayāḥ pratimāḥ smṛtāḥ|| 11.2 || māṇikyapramukhai ratnairarcāmavayavairyutām| vidadhyādardhacitraṃ vā kevalaṃ vā samarcayet|| 11.3 || nirdoṣā ratnajāssarvāssarvakāmaphalapradāḥ| suvarṇaṃ rajataṃ tāmraṃ trividhaṃ lohamiṣyate|| 11.4 || hiraṇmayī pratikṛtissarva saṃpatkarī bhavet| vittaṃ yaśaśca vijayo vijñānaṃ rājatīphalam|| 11.5 || buddhiśśāntaśca saubhāgyamaudumbaryā'rcayābhavet| śilā caturvidhā brahman varṇabhedaissitādibhiḥ|| 11.6 || śubhrā śilā brāhmaṇasya kṣatriyasya tu pāṭalā| vaiśyasya pītā śūdrasya kṛṣṭhā mukhyā yathoditā|| 11.7 || brāhmaṇasya catasrassyastisro rājño viśo dvayī| ekaiva syāccaturdhasya gauṇo'yaṃ vidhirīritaḥ|| 11.8 || śaṅkhacakragadāpadmaśakti candanamālikāḥ| siṃhamātaṅgasāraṅgavarāhakuśakuṇḍikāḥ|| 11.9 || śrīvatsacāmaracchatradhvajamatsya vihaṅgamāḥ| śīlāsu yatra dṛśyanai tilataṇḍulavālukāḥ|| 11.10 || tāśśubhā yajamānasya śubhadāḥ pārthivasya ca| garbhavatyaśśilā varjyā garbhā hyantaravasthitāḥ|| 11.11 || yathopalabdhuṃ śakyante taṃ prakāramimaṃ śṛṇu| navanītaṃ māhiṣajaṃ śṛṅgaṃ meṣasya cūrṇitam|| 11.12|| cūrṇaṃ ca kuruvindasya sampeṣya payasā gavāṃ| limpecchilāṃtathā dāru garbhavyaktistato bhavet|| 11.13 || vīdhikā yadi dṛśyante maṇḍalāvartakāni ca| dhvaniśca śithilo yāsu sparśe cauṣṇyamathāpi vā|| 11.14 || tāsu garbhāsspuṭaṃ santi yatnenotpāṭayettu tāḥ| pāṭale maṇḍale paṃsūn pāṭalān śvetapaṅkaje|| 11.15 || śvetapāṃsūn sthitāvantargarbharūpeṇa saṃsthitān| nirdiśetkapile varṇe snigdhe ca kamaṭhaṃ sthitam|| 11.16 || gaulīṃ kapote māñjiṣṭhe varṇe lohitadarduram| śuklaṃ ḍiṇḍīravarṇe tu raktapīte kacchapam|| 11.17 || kusumbhapītavarṇe tu pītaṃ varṣābhuvaṃ sthitam| śuklahemanibhevarṇe garbhe kṣudravihaṅgamam|| 11.18 || kālāyasasame varṇe godhāmantaravasthitām| guḍavarṇe tu pāṣāṇakhadyotaṃ madhusanni bhe|| 11.19 || sāraṅgasadṛśe varṇe vṛścikaṃ ṅaḍgasanni bhe| salilaṃ śalabhaṃ nīle rūkṣe phenakameva ca|| 11.20 || mūṣikāṃ kapile kṛṣṭhe kaṣṇāhiṃ śaṣpasannibhe| matsyamevaṃ vidhaṃ garbhaṃ maṇḍale varṇabhedataḥ|| 11.21 || budho niścinuyātsarvamuddharecca prayatnataḥ| garbhavaddāruśilayā pratimāṃ kurute yadi|| 11.22 || ajñānādvā'tha lobhādvāyajamāna stvarānvitaḥ| samulaghātaṃ hanyacca sa kulā nyātmanāmaja|| 11.23 || rājā ca rāṣṭrāmacirāt sthāpakaśca vinaśyati| garbhāgarekṛte paścājjuhuyācchāntaye guruḥ|| 11.24 || bhojayeddakṣiṇāṃ dadyādbrāhmaṇebhyassvaśaktitaḥ| bimbhaṃ śītalayā kuryācchilayā yadi sādaram|| 11.25 || devasya sannidhissākṣātsaṃpacca varado hariḥ| strīpuṃnapuṃsakaṃ ceti śailaṃ trividhamucyate|| 11.26 || kāṃsyaghaṇḍādhvaniprakhyaśchedane jāyate dhvaniḥ| śiraḥ pradeśe madhye tu kāṃsyadhvanisamobhavet|| 11.27 || mūle tāladhvanisamo yatra sā syācchilā pumān| nyūnastasmāddhvaniḥ kiṃcicchidrato yatrasā'dhamā|| 11.28 || śilā nādavihīnā tu napuṃsakamudāhṛtam| bimbaṃ puṃśilayā kāryaṃ pīṭhaṃ strī śilayā bhavet|| 11.29 || ratnanyāsastu kartavyo na śilāyāmiti kramat| devīnāṃ ca śrīyādīnāṃ nirmāṇe strī śīlā varā|| 11.30 || puṃśilā pādapīṭhe syādratnanyāso napuṃpake| saumyā śilā śītalāsyādvaiṣṇavī na mahāphalā|| 11.31 || uṣṇā''gneyī śilā rodrī sā rogasyāspadaṃ bhavet| saumyā jñeyobhayātmā tu brahmīsṛṣṭikari bhavet|| 11.32 || śītalā gharmakāle yā mahoṣṇā jaladāgame| ekavarṇā śilā śuddhā sā bhavetpratimāvidhau|| 11.33 || saṃkīrṇānekavarṇā tu sā śilā rogadā sadā| parvateṣu prasiddheṣu gṛhṇīyātpratimāśilām|| 11.34 || bhūgatā vā śilā śastā ninditā na kadācana| yā puṣpavanasaṅkīrṇā jalāśayasamāvṛtā|| 11.35 || sā bhūmirvāruṇī jñaiyā tatratyāḥ kāmadāśśilāḥ| toyamuttarato yasyāḥ kṣetraṃ dakṣiṇato mahat|| 11.36 || pratyakca kṣīriṇo vṛkṣāssā māhendrī kṣamā matā| tatratyā puṣṭidā nityaṃ śilā bahumatā tataḥ|| 11.37 || pūrvadakṣiṇato yasyāḥ kāśmaryaḥ khadirādayaḥ| jhallikā ṭiṭṭibhā gṛdhravarāhaśvāpadādayaḥ|| 11.38 || toyamantargataṃ svalpaṃ yatrāgneyī bhavediyam| śilā tatrodbhavā svalpavibhavā tadasaṃmatā|| 11.39 || vibhītakādayo vṛkṣā mṛgā hiṃstrāśca santatam| yatra tyaktodakatṛṇā kaṇṭakadrumasaṃvṛtā|| 11.40 || yā ca sā vāyavī bhūmistasyāṃ śūnyapradā śilā| naditaṭe hṛdataṭe bhūtibhumau catuṣpathe|| 11.41 || grāme śmaśāne valmīke lavaṇodakapīḍite| amedhyabhūmau śabaracaṇḍālādiniṣevite|| 11.42 || śarkarotkarasaṃbādhe nistṛṇe jalavarjite| devālayasamīpe ca tapte vātātapāgnibhiḥ|| 11.43 || deśe marjyāśśilāssarvā gṛhitāścedanarthadāḥ| puṇyakṣetre śubhe deśe brahmavṛkṣanirantare|| 11.44 || kuśakāśodakayute mṛgaiḥ kṛṣṇairniṣevite| padmotpalasamākīrṇe vrīhikṣetranirantare|| 11.45 || hintālapūgapunnāganālikeranirantare| tapasvijanasaṃ bādhe deśe grāhyā śilā bhavet|| 11.46 || varjyā varjyāṃ viditvaivaṃ guṇadoṣau nirūpya ca| deśabhedāṃśca bhūbhedān jñātvā liṅgabhidā stathā|| 11.47 || sītādivarṇa bhedāṃśca gṛhṇīyācchubhadāṃ śilām| puṇyarkṣatithivāreṣu yajamānānukūliṣu|| 11.48 || śakunādinimittānāmānukūlyena cānvitaḥ| yahamāno guruścaiva śraddhayā parayānvitaḥ|| 11.49 || rathakāreṇa sahitaḥ sthipatināṃ gaṇaissaha| brāhmaṇān bhojayitvādau taiśca svastyādi vācitaḥ|| 11.50 || śilāsaṃgraṇe deśe kāraye nmahatīṃ prasām| kṛtvā'ṅkurārpaṇaṃ tatra brahmacārī haviṣyabhuk|| 11.51 || ācaryo yājānena sārdhaṃ tatra vasecchuciḥ| śālibhāraṃ kṣipettasmin prapāmadhye savedike|| 11.52 || tasmi nnyasyenmahākumbhaṃ sūtravastrādiveṣṭitam| nyastakūryaṃ praticchannamaśvatthanavapallavaiḥ|| 11.53 || vinyastaratnalohāḍhyaṃ vidyayā parameṣṭhinaḥ| tasyāṣṭadikṣu ca sya syetkumbhān sūtreṇa veṣṭitān|| 11.54 || mahākumbhasya tasyaiva pārśve nyasyecca vardhanīm| astramantreṇa saṃsiddhān siddhārdhān dikṣu pātayet|| 11.55 || puṇyāhaṃ vācayitvātu cakramudrāṃ pradarśayete| mahāmudrāṃ pradarśyātha praṇamyāñjalimudrayā|| 11.56 || āvāhayettato devaṃ mūrtimantreṇa sarvagam| mahākumbhe pratiṣṭhāpya pūjayeddeśikaḥ kramāt|| 11.57 || vardhanya mantrarājānaṃ kumbheṣvaṣṭasu pūjayet| viṣṇvādimūrtīstadanu paramānnaṃ nivedayet|| 11.58 || homaṃ kuryāccaturdikṣu kuṇḍe vā sthaṇḍile'pi vā| pālāśasamidhaḥ puṣpaṃ phalamājyaṃ sapallavam|| 11.59 || juhuyānmulamantreṇa vṛthagaṣṭottaraṃ śatam| caruṇā ca nṛsuktena vṛthakkuṇḍacatuṣṭaye|| 11.60 || prācinakuṇḍe juhuyātsarpiṣā vanadevatāḥ| parvatān gaṇḍaśailāṃśca tatra śṛṅgāṇi nirjharān|| 11.61 || samudrāṃśca tathā vṛkṣānoṣadhīśca vanaspatīn| jarāyujānaṇḍajāṃśca svedajānudbhijastathā|| 11.62 || tathā sarvāṇi bhūtāni mantraistaddhevtāparaiḥ| svāhāntaistairvyāhṛtibhiḥ pūrṇāhutyantamabjaja|| 11.63 || palalaṃ rajanīcūrṇaṃ lājāpūpāḥ karambhiṇaḥ|66 carastairbaliṃ dravyairbhūtebhyo nikṣipedguruḥ|| 11.64 || hotavyaṃ svapnapataye sarpiṣā'ṣṭottaraṃ śatam| vādyaistathā brahmaghoṣairvato ghoṣayenniśi|| 11.65 || upoṣya darbhaśayyāyāṃ śucirniyatamānasaḥ| japannaṣṭottaraśataṃ svapnādipatimātmavān|| 11.66 || svapetsvapne tataśśailaṃ yadi paśyetsamujvalam| prātareva śilāgrāhyā śāntiṃ kuryādadarśane|| 11.67 || durdarśane vā purvoktadurnimittodaye tathā| śilāṃ muhūrte saṃpaśyecchobhave deśikottamaḥ|| 11.68 || yakṣāḥ piśācā nāgādyāḥ yatra tiṣṭhanti nityaśaḥ| sarve te hyapagacchantu sannidhattāṃ sadāhariḥ|| 11.69 || ityuktvā mantrasaṃsiddhān siddhārdhāṃ statra nikṣipet| baliṃ dadyācca bhūtebhyaḥ pratyāśaṃ sarvamantrataḥ|| 11.70 || puṇyāhaṃ vācayitvā ca pauruṣeṇa śilāḥ spṛśet| mūlamantreṇa datvā'rghyaṃ japedaṣṭottaraṃ śatam|| 11.71 || prāsādasyānurūpeṇa pātayotsūtramañjasā| śilā sthsapatayaśchindyuḥ rathakārasya śāsanāt|| 11.72 || śāntidā dakṣiṇa sirā prāksirā jayadāyinī| śrīkarī paścimasirā puṣṭiṃ dadyādudaksirā|| 11.73 || varjayetkoṇasirasaṃ yadi kuryātkulakṣayaḥ| yasyāṃ diśi mukhaṃ dhāmna stasyāṃ pratikṛteśśiraḥ|| 11.74 || vyatyāse yajamānasya rājño rāṣṭrasya vāstutaḥ| ālayasya ca sarveṣāmacirātkalpate vipat|| 11.75 || mūlabhāgaścilānāṃ cetupariṣṭādbhavettathā| adhastācchecchirobhāgo vipatsyādrājarāṣṭrayoḥ|| 11.76 || mahākumbhasthatoyena snāpayeduddhṛtāṃ śilām| viṣṇvādikumbhateyaiśca pauruṣaṃ sūktamuccaran|| 11.77 || pariṣiñcecchilāṃ bhūyo vardhanīsthena vāriṇā| devīnāṃ bimba śuddhyardhaṃ pṛthakevādhivāsayet|| 11.78 || madhyakumbhercayeddhevīṃ śriyaṃ trailokyamātaram| aṣṭakumbheṣu sampūjyā devyaścāṣṭau yathākramam|| 11.79 || homādi pūrvavatkṛtvā bimbarthā strīśilā bhavet| astrīyā śilayā devyo vihitāścetpramādataḥ|| 11.80 || lobhana mahatā yuktā hanyussvaviṣayāḥ prajāḥ| tasminneva kṣaṇe grāhyāḥ parivāśilāśśubhāḥ|| 11.81 || śilāsaṅgrahaṇaṃ kuryātteṣāṃ mantrairyathākramam| śilāṃ gṛhītvātāṃ samyagāropyaśakaṭādiṣu|| 11.82 || nītvā dhāmni sthapatayo rathakāramatānugāḥ| kuryurarcāṃ yathāśāstraṃ coditairlakṣaṇairyutām|| 11.83 || śīlāsaṅgrahaṇe karma yaduktaṃ bahirālayāt| tatsarvamathavā kuryādaṅkurādikamālaye|| 11.84 || śilā gṛhītvā vidhavattyaktāṃ kartumaśaktitaḥ| anyārthamapitāṃ viddhi śuddhāṃ bhuyo'dhivāsanāt|| 11.85 || kārtikādyaṣṭamāneṣu praśasto dārusaṅgrahaḥ| praśastaṃ sarvamāneṣu śilāsaṃgrahaṇaṃ matam|| 11.86 || candanaścāguruścaiva kāsmaryo haricandanaḥ| kesaraḥ khatiraścaiva kuravaścāsana stathā|| 11.87 || madhuko devadāruśca jātirbilvaśśamī tathā| śākaśca panasaścaiva kadambastilakastathā|| 11.88 || nameruḥ phalinī caiva surabhiścampaka sathā| śiṃśupā kṣīrikā sālo bhījakaḥ kuruvidandakaḥ|| 11.89 || tiniśaścandanaścūtastamālastaralo'rjunaḥ| kuṭajaḥ karakelīca saptaparṇo madhuṣṭhilaḥ|| 11.90 || varaṇo niculaścaiva punnāgaḥ khadirastathā| rājavṛkṣaśca ityete pratimārthamudāhṛtāḥ|| 11.91 || sāravanto ghanopetā ssarvadoṣavivarjitāḥ| etaiḥ kāryā pratikṛtirva rjitairnakadācana|| 11.92 || varjanīyānapi tarūnabhidhānsāmi tān śuṇu| svayaṃ śuṣkāśca dagdhāśca svayaṃ bhagnā hatatvacaḥ|| 11.93 || vakrā ghuṇakṣatāścaiva koṭarāḥ pakṣisevitāḥ| caṇḍālādyadhamaiśśaśvatsevitāḥ pratilomajaiḥ|| 1.94 || nivāsavṛkṣāścaityasthāḥ devatādhiṣṭhitāstathā| śmaśānasthāśca mārgasthā devālayasamīpagāḥ|| 1.95 || kūpasthāśca taṭākasthā vikṛtāścaiva varjitāḥ| varjitai starubhiḥ kuryātpratimāṃ cetpramādataḥ|| 10.96 || kartā kārayitā cobhau sānvavāyau vinaśyataḥ| dārusaṃgrahaṇe deśe pūrvavacchādhivāsanam|| 10.97 || śilāgrahaṇavaddhomassarvaḥ kāryo yathāvidhi| anokahānāmaṅgāni pravālādīni pūrvavat|| 10.98 || juhuyādagnikuṇḍe ca prācīne deśikottamaḥ| prakṣālayedvṛkṣamūlaṃ vāsanā taṃ prakoṇakam|| 10.99 || ācchādayetsadarbheṇa mūlamantraṃ samuccharan| mūrtibhiśca dvādaśabhiḥ matsyādibhiranukramāt|| 10.100 || hutvā vyāhṛtibhiḥ paścādupatiṣṭheta bhūruham| karmaṇā pūrvavṛtteva sthāvarākāramāśśitam|| 10.101 || vṛṇomi viṣṇorbimbārthaṃ sarvasaṃpatkaraṃ tava| sthāvaratvādito gaccha divyaṃ rūpamanuttamam|| 10.102 || bhuṅkṣva bhogāṃśca vipulān vāsudevaprasādataḥ| hinasmi nāhaṃ vṛkṣa tvāṃ kintu muñcāmi janmataḥ|| 10.103 || ityupasthāya mantreṇa rakṣāsūtreṇa veṣṭayet| anuktamanyatkartavyaṃ śilāgrahaṇavanniśi|| 10.104 || prabhāte deśika ssnātvā muhūrte śobhane śuciḥ| chindyādvṛkṣaṃ kuṭhāreṇa prāṅmukhaḥ puruṣātmanā|| 10.105 || rathakārastato vṛkṣaṃ chedayedgurvanujñayā| prācyāmudīcyāṃ patitastarurabhyudayāvahaḥ|| 10.106 || kuryādbimbaṃ prakāṇḍena śākhayā cānurupayā| kumbhedakena taṃ siñceddhyātvā tatrasthitāṃ harim|| 10.107 || mūlamantreṇa paritaspiñcetkaravāriṇā| gurave dakṣiṇāṃ dadyātpurvavatkamalāsana|| 10.108 || devālaye drumaṃ nītvā rathakāreṇa kārayet| bimbamatyadbhutākāraṃ dhāmamānānusārataḥ|| 10.109 || ālaye cādhivāsādi sthāpayitvā drumaṃ bhuvi| kuryādbhahirvane yadvatsarvaṃ tadvadyathāvidhi|| 10.110 || asaṃskṛtena taruṇā yathoktavidhinā yadi| kuryātpratikṛtiṃ mohāttadanardhāya kevalam|| 10.111 || tasmādyadoktataruṇā kṛtamabhyudayāvaham|| iti śrīpāñcarātre mahopaniṣadi pādmasaṃhitāyāṃ krīyāpāde śilādārusaṃgrahavidhānaṃ nāma ekādaśo'dhyāyaḥ |
<2.12>
śrībhagavān athātatsaṃpravakṣyāmi mūlaberasamucchrayam| garbhavistāramānaṃ vā dvāradairghyamathāpi vā|| 12.1 || prāsādapādamānaṃ vā hastamānamathāpi vā| yajamānapramāṇaṃ vā stambhamānamathāpi vā|| 12.2 || kuryāddhuvapratikṛtiṃ grāmāderanukūlikām| pratimāgarbhavistāra tulyā śreṣṭhā caturmukha|| 12.3 || navābhāgai kahīnā tu pratimā madhyamā bhavet|| pañcabhāgaikahīnā tu jaghanyā parikīrtatā|| 12.4 || saptadā gararbhavistāraṃ vibhajya dvau vivarjayet| śiṣṭabhāga samucchrāyā śroṣṭhā syādathavābjaja|| 12.5 || madhyamā pañcasūtryaṃśaiḥ tribhadvābhyā kanīyasī| dvārādhyārdhasamucchrāyā śroṣṭhā pādādhikā punaḥ|| 12.6 || madhyamā dvāramātrā tu kaniṣṭhā madhyamā bhavet| dvāraṃ ṣoḍaśadhā kṛtvā nyunai kadvitrabhiḥ kramāt|| 12.7 || śreṣṭhā madhyā kaniṣṭhā syāditthaṃ pādādiṣu kramāt| uttamā pañcabhirhasteḥ tribhirekena cetare|| 12.8 || sthitasya kautukasyāya mucchrasassamudīritaḥ| garbagehasya vistāraṃ tridhā bhaṅtkvā dvayī bhavat|| 12.9 || uttamā pañcadhātryaṃśaiḥ madhyamārdha kanīyasī| āsīnā cāthavā śreṣṭhā garbhavistāra sammitā|| 12.10 || navabhāgaikahīnā tu madhyamā pañcadhā kṛte| ekenā caramā proktā saptadhā ṣaḍbhiruttamā|| 12.11 || saptathaiva tribhirmadhyā tridhā dvābhyāṃ kanīyasī| dvārādiṣu sthitasyaiva samāsīnonnati kramāt|| 12.12 || hastaissastabhirāsīnā śroṣṭhā madhyā tu pañcabhiḥ| tribhirjaghanyā vakṣyāmi śayanasyāpi connatim|| 12.13 || āyāmaṃ garbhagehasya bhaṅtkvā ṣoḍaśadhā punaḥ| avaśiṣṭadaśāṃ śena śayitasyottamonnatiḥ| āyāmamaṣṭadā kṛtvā hitvādvau mūndhnapārśvataḥ|| 12.14 || ekamaṃśaṃ caraṇataśśiṣṭāṃ śenaiva madhyamā| āyāmaṃ saptadhā kṛtvā mūrdhna dvāvekamaṅghritaḥ|| 12.15 || hitvā kaniṣṭhāśeṣeṇa śayānasyākṛtirbhavet| vistāre vā caturdhā tu kṛte teṣvekamuddharet|| 12.16 || śiṣṭena dviguṇena syācchayanasyottamonnatiḥ| kṛtvaivaṃ pañcabhāgena syācchayānasya madhyamā|| 12.17 || garbha vistāramānena śayānasyādhamā bhavet| dviguṇā dvāramānena śayānasyottamonnatiḥ|| 12.18 || adhyardhamānai rmadhyā syātsapādā caramā bhavet| uttamādikramo yādṛgdvāramāśritya kīrtataḥ|| 12.19 || dhruvaberasya yādṛksyāt stambhadyāśrayaṇe'pi ca| saptabiḥ pañcabhirha staistrsibhiśśreṣṭhā yathākramam|| 12.20 || yāne'pyāsanavanmānaṃ viśvarūpaṃ sthitāṃ yathā| garbhagehaṃ tridhā kṛtvā dvibhāgaṃ cottamaṃ bhavet|| 12.21 || pañcadā tu kṛte tasmin tribhago madhyamo bhavet| garbhārdhamadhamaṃ dhāmnā sarvasādhāraṇe vidhiḥ|| 12.22 || yajamānādyanuguṇe vidhiradyābhidīyate| labdhāṃśamaṅgulīkuryātprāsādasya caturmukha|| 12.23 || tatrāṅgulividhiṃ vakṣye yathātadavadhāraya| paṃcadhāṅgulirākhyātā ucyante tā vidhāḥ kramāt|| 12.24 || mānaṃ mānā ntaraṃ mātrā muṣṭirdeha stathaiva ca| vakṣyamāṇakrameṇaiṣāṃ bhedānāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ śṛṇu|| 12.25 || vātāyanapathaṃ prāpya ye yānti raviraśmayaḥ| teṣu sūkṣmā visarpanti reṇavaḥ paramāṇavaḥ|| 12.26 || te'ṣṭau keśāhvaya ste'ṣṭau līkṣo yūkastadaṣṭakam| tadaṣṭakaṃ yavā ste'ṣṭauvaṅgu lissamudāhṛtā|| 12.27 || taduttamāṅgulissapta yavā ssaiva tu madhyamā| yavāṣṣaḍadhamā proktā mānāṅgulamidaṃ bhavet|| 12.28 || vinyastaistiryagaṣṭābhiryavai rmānāntarāgulam| śālībhirvā ṛjunya staistribhirmānā ntaraṃ bhavet|| 12.29 || ācāryadakṣiṇakare madhyamāṅgulimadhyame| parvaṇorantaraṃ dīrghaṃ mātrāṅgulamudāhṛtam|| 12.30 || caturdhā vibhajedeko bhāgo muṣṭyaṅguliḥ smṛtā| yatkiñcitkautukāyāmaṃ vibhajya daśadhā punaḥ|| 12.31 || ekaṃ dvādaśadhā bhāgaṃ kṛtvā teṣvekamaṅgulam| ucchrāyaḥ pratimāyāssyā nmahāmānāṅgulāśrayaḥ|| 12.32 || prāsādādīṃśca tenaiva kuryunmānāntareṇa vā| vedikā pīṭhaśibikā rathādīnāṃ vidhiḥ punaḥ|| 12.33 || mānāntarāṅgulenai va bhavennanyena kevacit| yāgopakaraṇānāṃ ca kuryānmātrāṅgulena ca|| 12.34|| homāṅgāni sruvādīni kuṇamuṣṭyaṅgulāśrayaḥ| dehalabdhāṅgulenaiva pratimāṅgāni kalpayet|| 12.35 || yairyāvadbhirvibhāgāṃ śairarcyamānamudāhṛtam| mānāṅgulena tanmānamaṅgulīkṛtya tatpuvaḥ|| 12.36 || āyavyayādau saṃyojya grāmāderyacchubhaṃ bhavet|| tattathā vakṣyate brahman idānīmavadhāryatām|| 12.37 || laldhāṃśamaṅgulīkṛtya tadaṅgulamathāṣṭabhiḥ | vardhayeddhrāsayeccaiva punardvādaśasaṅkhyayā|| 12.38 || āyaṃ śiṣṭāṅgu laṃ jñeyaṃ vyayairnavabhiredhayet| daśabhiḥ kṣapayecchiṣṭamaṅgulaṃ vyayasaṃjñitam|| 12.39 || āyassamagraśubhado vyasassvalpaśubhāvahāḥ| pratikūle viparyāse grāmādeḥ kamalāsana|| 12.40 || tribharvṛddhau kṣayo'ṣṭābhiśśiṣṭaṃ yonirudāhṛtā| dhvajo dhūmastathā saṃhaśśvāvṛṣo gardabhaḥ karī|| 12.41 || kāka ityucyate yoni ssā śubhā śubhalakṣaṇā| dhvajassiṃho gajo'vaḍvān śubhayoniśśubhāvahaḥ|| 12.42 || dhūmadhvāṅkṣakharaśvānaḥ pratikūlā viyonayaḥ| aṣṭābhirvardhate hānau saptaviṃśatisaṅkhyayā|| 12.43 || śiṣṭamṛkṣamiti proktaṃ grāmāde stacchubhaṃ bhavet| navabhirvardhate hānau pastabhiśśiṣṭamaṅgulam|| 12.44 || vārāste śubhadāssaumyāḥ krūrāssyurbhayadāyinaḥ| vṛddhau caturbhirnavabhiśśiṣṭaṃ hānavathāṃśakam|| 12.45 || taskaro bhuktiśaktiśca dhanyo naravatiḥ klibaḥ| sunītiḥ prīṃrāyuṣmān eteṃśāssamudīritāḥ|| 12.46 || mānāṅgulai rdvādaśabhiḥ mānaṃ tālāhyayaṃ matam| dvautālau kathito hastasai hyaṣṭau dhanurucyate|| 12.47 || sa eva daṇḍassayugaḥ krośastaiḥ paṃca bhiśśataiḥ| krośaiścaturbhirgaupānaṃ yojanaṃ taccaturgaṇam|| 12.48 || grāmasya yajamānasya rājño janapadasya ca| āyādiranukūlaścetpratimāssarvasiddhidāḥ|| 12.49 || āyādireṣa vijñeyo mūlaberasamāśrayaḥ| na tadaṅgeṣu bimbeṣu lohajeṣvitareṣu vā|| 12.50 || śraddhābimbeṣu vijñeyastathā bhavanakautuke| prasthā dīnā tuṃ maryādā prasaṅgāducyate'dhunā|| 12.51 || catvāro vrīyaḥ kuñjāste'ṣṭau mañjiṣṭha ucyate| te śataṃ ṣaṣṭiradhikaṃ niṣkaṃ niṣkāṣṭakaṃ phalam|| 12.52 || phalāni pañca kuḍubhaṃ prasthaṃ syāttu caturgaṇam| taccaturguṇakaṃ vidyādāḍhakaṃ tadvayaṃ śivam|| 12.53 || taddvayaṃ droṇamuditaṃ khārī tadvitayaṃ bhavet| tatkhārītritayaṃ bhāraṃ parimāṇamudīritam|| 12.54 || etena parimāṇena paricchedyaṃ ghṛtādikam| iti śrīpāñca rātre mahopaniṣadi pādmasaṃhitāyaṃ kriyāpade dhruvaberapramāṇānukūlyanirṇayo nāma dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ |
<2.13>
śrībhagavān athātatsaṃpravakṣyāmi śūlasya sthāpanāvidhim| sthirāṇi candanādīni dārūṇi ghanavanti ca|| 13.1 || adhivāsya yathāpūrvaṃ gṛyāhṇīddeśikottamaḥ| vṛkṣajātīyayā vyaktyā śūlaṃ yadyekayā bhavet|| 13.2 || uttamaṃ tadvijānīyāt parvabhiryadi madhyamam| nānājātīyayā tacchedadhamaṃ kamalāsana|| 13.3 || śilpibhistakṣayitvā tu asāraṃ vyavanīya tu| sāreṇa kārayecchūlaṃ prāmāṇaṃ tasya kathya te|| 13.4 || aṅgulīnāṃ caturviṃśacchataṃ kautukamunna tam| dvyadhikā ṣaṣṭirāyāmo vaṃśadaṇḍasya kathya te|| 13.5 || tasya mūlāgramadhyāni vistīrṇāni yathākramam| tasyāryaṅgulamānāni sārdhāni trīṇi tāni ca|| 13.6 || yavāṣṣaṭca tathā nāhaṣṣodaśāṅgulasamitaḥ| mūlasya syāttathā madhye nāhaḥ pañcadaśāṅgulaḥ|| 13.7 || caturdaśāṅgulo nahastadagre kamalāsana| vakṣodaṇḍaścatustriṃśadaṅgulasyatsamāyataḥ|| 13.8 || caturaṅgulavistāraṣṣodaśāṅgulamānataḥ| dviśikhaṃ triśikhaṃ vāpi śikhā kiṃśukakuṭmalaḥ|| 13.9 || āyāmo bāhudaṇḍasya pañcaviṃśāṅgulo bhavet| sārdhaṃ tyaṅgulakaṃ mūlaṃ vistīrṇaṃ tasya madhyamam|| 13.10 || dvyaṃgulaṃ tryaṃgulaṃ sardhamagraṃ tasya caturmukha| prakoṣṭhamāyataṃ viṃśatyaṃgulaṃ dviyavādhikam|| 13.11 || mūlamadhyāgravistāraḥ dvyaṃgulastryaṃgulo'pi vā| sārdhastathāṃgulāni syustrīṇi vidyādyathākramam|| 13.12 || suṣiraṃ bāhumūlaṃ syādagraṃ bāhuprakoṣṭhayoḥ| vithunaṃ kalpanīyaṃ syānnī cabāhurapīdṛśaḥ|| 13.13 || āyāmaḥ kalpadaṇḍasya ṣodaśāṃgulasammitaḥ| vistārastasya madye syāccaturaṃgulasaṃmitaḥ|| 13.14 || ṣoḍaśāṃgulanāhaśca tasya madhyaḥ prakīrtitaḥ | āyāmaḥ pārśpadaṇḍasya kāryo dvāttriṃśadaṃgulaḥ|| 13.15 || pārśvadaṇḍaparīṇāhaścaturaṅgulasaṃmitaḥ| dviśikhaśca kaṭīdaṇḍo vakṣodaṇḍo niyogataḥ|| 13.16 || daṇḍayoḥ pārśvayossamyagūrdhvadaṇḍasya cāyatiḥ| ekaviṃśāṃgulo daṇḍo jaṅghādaṇḍasamo bhavet|| 13.17 || madhyāgramūlavistāraḥ krameṇa paripaṭhyate| tryaṃgulo'rdhādhikassārdho dvyaṃgulaścaturaṃgulaḥ|| 13.18 || jaṅghāyāstryaṃgulaṃ mūlaṃ sārdhadvyaṃgulamantaram| ardhaṃ ca dvyagulaṃ tatra triguṇaṃ sahanaṃ matam|| 13.19 || ūrumūlaṃ ca suṣiraṃ dvyaṃgulaṃ ṣaḍyavādhikam| ūrujaṅghāgrayorante mithunaṃ parikalpayet|| 13.20 || vaṃśadaṇḍamuraḥ kaṭyāḥ madhye nimne niveśayet| śūlapramāṇamuditaṃ śūlasaṅkhyādhunocyate|| 13.21 || vaṃśadaṇḍaḥ kaṭīdaṇḍo vakṣodaṇḍastathaiva ca| bāhudaṇḍāśca catvāraḥ prakoṣṭhena tathā vidhaḥ|| 13.22 || jaṅghādaṇḍaśca ityete śūladaṇḍāstrayodaśa| śleṣayettadyathāyegaṃ suṣiraṃ naivakārayet|| 13.23 || na ca kīlaṃ vidhatavyaṃ śilpibhiśśūlakarmaṇi| vaṃśadaṇḍaṃ kirīṭāntaṃ mūrdhāntaṃ vā pracakṣate|| 13.24 || pādāntaṃ vā yathāsthairyaṃ tathā kuryādvilakṣaṇaḥ| lohapaṭṭena sanīnāṃ bandhanaṃ dṛḍhamācaret|| 13.25 || lohajāśśūladalḍāsyurathavā vibhave sati| vaṃśamūlaṃ catuṣkoṇamaṣṭāśraṃ madhyamiṣyate|| 13.26 || agraṃ muvṛttaṃ śūlāni vṛttānyanyāni vā vyathā| vaṃśadaṇḍajamānasya ganādarvāgṛjurbhavet|| 13.27 || upariṣṭādyathāyogaṃ kiñcidbhugnaṃ caturmukha| pratimānāṃ yathābhāgaṃ vaṃśadaṇḍasthitirbhavet|| 13.28 || vakṣodaṇḍaḥ kaṭīdaṇḍaḥ kiñcidbhugnaśikho bhavet| bhujorudaṇḍayormūlaṃ nimnaṃ kṛtyā yathā śikham|| 13.29 || mukhaṃ sārthaṃ kirīṭasya śūladviguṇameva vā|| maulimūlasya vistārastryaṅgulaṃ vā yavatrayam|| 13.30 || triyavaṃ tryaṃgulaṃ madhyaṃ sārdhatryaṃgulasammitam| bāhvantamūlaberasya devīnāṃ śayane sati|| 13.31 || śūlamanyatra yānādau nāsikāntamathāpi vā| cibukāntaṃ yathoccrāyaṃ brahmaṇaśśayane sati|| 13.32 || śūlaṃ jānvantamanyatra bahusīmāntamiṣyate| bhṛgvādiparivārāṇāṃ bāhusīmāntamucyate|| 13.33 || jalādhivāsanaṃ caiva sthāpanaṃ maṇḍape tathā| homaṃ kumbhārcanaṃ dvārapūjā brāhmaṇatarpaṇam|| 13.34 || śuddhiśca śoṣa ṇādīni śūlānāṃ bimbavat smṛtam| na divā piṇḍikāṃ rātrau adhivāsya samāhitaḥ|| 13.35 || śvobhūte vāstunā homaṃ dadyādvāstubaliṃ tathā| śodhayergarbhagehaṃ ca mārjanālepanādibhiḥ|| 13.36 || sūtraṃ candanato yona siktamāsphālayetkramāt| sūtrāṇyudaṅgukhānyasṭau prāṅgukhāni tathaiva ca|| 13.37 || koṣṭhānyekonapañcāśannyūnādhikavivarjitāḥ| brāhmaṇo madhyamo bhāgaḥ daivikastu tadantaraḥ|| 13.38 || tratīye mānuṣasturyaḥ pai śāco bhāga iṣyate| arcanāpīṭhikā brāhme bhāge dhaive sthitirbhavet|| 13.39 || mānuṣe parivārāssyurāyudhāni caturthake| kiñcinmānuṣamāśritya daive syādāsanaṃ bhavet|| 13.40 || divyamānuṣayeśśayyā pai śāce yānamiṣyate| &daive devyasthsitā vāstyurāsane tasya pārśvataḥ|| 13.42 || śayane 'pi yathāyogaṃ yānārūḍhe'pi vai tathā| udaṅmukhāni sūtrāṇi daśa tāvannipātayet|| 13. 43 || pāṅmukhānyapi koṣṭhānāmekāśītirbhavettataḥ|| madhyamo brahmaṇo bhāgaḥ daivassyāttadanantaraḥ|| 13.44 || tṛtīyaḥ paitṛkasturyo mānuṣaḥ pañcamaḥ punaḥ| paiśāca iti vā bhāgān kalpayedgarbhamandire|| 13.45 || ekaberavidhirbrāhme bahubheraṃ tu daivike| daive ca mānuṣe bhāge dvayorāsanamiṣyate|| 13.46 || daivamānuṣapityreṣu śayanaṃ triṣu kārayet| paiśāce mānuṣe caiva dvayoryānaṃ vidhīyate|| 13.47 || uktasthānaviparyāse rājā rāṣṭraṃ ca naśyati| tasmādyathoktabhege syusthsāpyā ṛddhimabhīppubhiḥ|| 13.48 || catasraḥ sthāpanābhūmi kṛtvā madhye pade punaḥ| muktikāmo'rcayeddhevaṃ pade tu tadanantare|| 13.49 || divye bhogābhilāṣaścetsannānārdhī tu mānuṣe| paśvādikāmaḥ pai śāce padeṣvevaṃ yathākramam|| 13.50 || prāsādadvāravistāraṃ tribhāgīkṛtya madhyamam| bhāgaṃ tu saptadhā kṛtvā pañcabhāgāṃstu dakṣiṇe|| 13.51 || apohyānantare bhāge brāhme sūtramudāhṛtam| na kuryādbrahmaṇassūtre bhittastaṃbhādikaṃ sudīḥ|| 13.52 || ājñānādyadi kurvīta pratyavāyo mahān bhavet| ekabheraṃ bhavettatra brahmasūtre śilāmayam|| 13.53 || ratnaloha śilākāṣṭhamṛdbhistadvā trivastubhiḥ| bahuberaṃ bhavedardacitraṃ sābhāsamiṣyate|| 13.54 || sthitāsīnaśayānānāṃ dravyairatnādibhirbhavet| nirmāṇaṃ sarvamurtīnāṃ ṛddhikṛnnaiva doṣakṛte|| 13.54 || garbhagehe tato bhāge yathoktadharaṇīṃ khanet| hastamātreṇa tattreva napuṃsakaśilāṃ kṣipet|| 13.55 || śilāyāṃ tatra ratnāni lohairbhījaiśca dhātubhiḥ| saha vā tairvanā vāpi nikṣipeccoditaḥ kramāt|| 13.56 || pidhāya yoṣicchilayā dṛḍhaṃ kuryātsudhādibhiḥ| mañjūṣāṃ lohajāṃ kṛtvā yadvā ratnāni nikṣipet|| 13.57 || ratnanyāsasthitassaiṣaḥ pādamūle vidhīyate| anyeṣāṃ pṛṣṭhataḥ kuryādratnanyāsaṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ|| 13.58 || vṛttaṃ vā caturaśraṃ vā pādapīṭhaṃ tu tadbhavet| pratimāyāṃ śilāmayyāṃ śilāyāṃ ca sthitirbhavet|| 13.60 || sthāne pādaśilāyāṃ ca śūlārdhaṃ suṣiradvayam| iṣṭakābhistathā kuryātpīṭhikāṃ ca śilopari|| 13.61 || utsedhaścāpi cāyāmo bhūmibhāgapramāṇataḥ| dvāraṣṭabhāgamathavā pādāṣṭakamathāpi vā|| 13.62 || pratimāṣṭāṃśamathavā pādaphīṭhapramāṇakam| vṛttaṃ vā caturaśraṃ vā pādapīṭhaṃ yathābhavet|| 13.63 || vṛtai ca caturaśre ca padmaṃ copari kalpayet| sthānakeṣu vidhirhyeṣa āsīne dviguṇaṃ bhavet|| 13.64 || śayane tāvadutsedhaṃ pratimāyāmasammitam| padmādipīṭhamathavā dehalabdhāṅgulaiḥ punaḥ|| 13.65 || kuryāddvādaśabhiḥ prāṃśuṃ vistīrṇaṃ dviguṇāṅgulaiḥ| pañcaviṃśaddalayutaṃ yadvā ṣoḍaśa bhiryutam|| 13.66 || dalairdvādaśabhiryadvā yuktamaṣṭabhireva vā| aṅghrimānavaśenaiva dalānāṃ drāghimā bhavet|| 13.67 || ūrdhvacchadamuyuktaṃ tato'lpadalasaṃyutam| madhye karṇikayā yuktaṃ kiñcitphullāmbubajākutim|| 13.68 || divye bhāgesthitasyaiṣa viṣṭarassamudīritaḥ| ekabere tadāyāmaṃ tridhā kṛtyaikabhāgikām|| 13.69 || vediṃ kuryāccaturthā vā turyāṃ śena prakalpayet| utsedho'yaṃ snānavedervṛttā vṛttāyatā tuvā|| 13.70 || caturaśāyatā vāpi ṣaḍaśāṣṭāśrikāpi vā| upānakaṭisaṃyuktā kartavyā dvādaśāṃgulā|| 13.71 || āyataṃ nālametasya caturbhirathavāṅgulaiḥ| viṃśatyā cāyataṃ tasya mukhaṃ makaravaktravat|| 13.72 || kiñcinnimnaṃ ya thātasmānnālaṃ tiryagathosthitam| upariṣṭācca tadvedervalayaṃ ca turaṅgulam|| 13.73 || unnataṃ kārayettāvadvistāraṃ kamalāsana| vedikānuguṇaṃ yadvā padmamevākhilaṃ bhavet|| 13.74 || pratyaṅmukhasya devasya prāṅmukhasya tathā bhavet| praṇālyudaṅmukhā kāryādakṣiṇedaṅmukhasya tu|| 13.75 || praṇālī prāṅmakhā kāryā nānyatra vidhiriṣyate| dhārārulyā ca kartavyā yāvacchidraṃ bahisthitam|| 13.76 || hastihastādibhiśśvabhre jaladhārāṃ nipātayet| vṛttaṃ vā caturaśraṃ vā śvabhraṃ kuryācchilādibhiḥ|| 13.77 || manoharamagādhaṃ ca bahi staddhevatālayāt| āsīnasyābhidhāsyāmi pramāṇaṃ siṃhaviṣṭare|| 13.78 || dehalabdhaṃgulaiṣṣaḍbhirutsedhaṃ triṃśatāpi ca| dviguṇai rāyataṃ tasya siṃhairaṣṭābhirāsanam|| 13.79 || dhriyamāṇaṃ caturbhirvā teṣāṃ vaktrāṇi saṃhinat| śiṣṭaṃ vapuḥ puruṣavaccaturbharbahubhiryutam|| 13.80 || bibhrāṇau viṣṭaraṃ dvābhyāṃ dvābhyāṃbadhvā jalaṃ hṛdi| ratnaiḥ pariṣkṛtaṃ pīṭhaṃ siṃhairvā kevalai ryutam|| 13.81 || gajāṅghribhirvā tadyuktaṃ kuryānnaivānyathā vidhiḥ| bhogaśayyāśayānasya vakṣyāmi kamalāsana|| 13.82 || vṛttāyataṃ yathāyogaṃ tathā trirmaṇḍalīkṛtam| prādakṣiṇyena valayaiḥ pañcabhirvādha saptabhiḥ|| 13.83 || dehāṅgalaiścatustālamutsedhaṃ bhegamaṇḍalam| madhyataḥ pādataḥ proktaṃ mūrdhanyadhikamaṃgulaiḥ|| 13.84 || tribhirdiguṇitairyadvā valayāste yathoditāḥ| paścātprabhṛti caikaikaṃ kiñcitkiñcitsamunnatam|| 13.85 || phaṇairayugmairnavabhissaptabhirvātha paṃcabhiḥ| upetamuttamaṃ madhyamadhamaṃ saṃpracakṣate|| 13.86 || tritālamunnataṃ ṣaḍbhiraṃgulai rmadhyamaṃ phaṇam| aṣṭāṃgulaṃ phaṇānāṃ syurantarālaṃ phaṇāstu te|| 13.87 || nimnāḥ krameṇa kartavyāḥ nyūnāḥ pañcacatustrībhiḥ| aṃgulaiḥ kramaśasteṣāṃ vāstāro madhyamaḥ phaṇāḥ|| 13.88 || dvātriṃśadaṃgulā stasya phaṇāḥ pārśve caturmukha| viṃśatpaṃ ca caturbhiśca vistīrṇaṃ dvyaṃgulairapi|| 13.89 || viṃśatyaṃgulavistārau śeṣau dvau phaṇinaḥ paṇau| itareṣvapi sarveṣu hānirūhyā yathākramam|| 13.90 || bidālavaktravadvaktraṃ daṃṣṭrayā pariśobhitam| mīrdhninyastamahāratnaṃ tīkṣṇaśṛṅgasamanvitam|| 13.91 || śanaiśśanairadho vaktaṃ yāvanmaulyagramānakam| sarpakaṇṭhātphaṇotsedhaṃ catustālaṃ daśāṃgulam|| 13.92 || athavā śayanotsedhaṃ dāduśaṃ saṃpracakṣate| kotukadvāracaraṇasamutsedhe tridhā kṛte|| 13.93 || ekāṃ śena samutsedhaṃ bhogamaṇḍalamiṣyate| caturthāṃ śena vā kuryādhbhegino bhogamaṇḍalam|| 13.94 || bhogapanasamutsedho bhogaśayyāvadiṣyate| suvṛttaṃ devadevasya vṛṣṭhabhege samunnatam|| 13.95 || phaṇānāṃ maṇḍalaṃ yadvacchatraṃ tadvacca śobhanam| devasya yaulerupari viṃśatyaṃgulamunnatam|| 13.96 || caturaśrāyataṃ pīṭhamathavā śayanaṃbhavet|| prāguktaiścaraṇai ryaktaṃ upadhānādisaṃmitam|| 13.97 || āsanaṃ padmamātraṃtu viśvamūrtervidhīyate| yāne garutmato'dhantātpadmamāsanamiṣyate| tasminvidadhyātpakṣīndraṃ devayāmārdhasaṃyutam|| 13.98 || bṛhadbhujaṃ garutmantamāruhya sthitamacyutaṃ| kuryāddevaṃ sthitādīnāmāsanāni prakalpayet|| 13.99 || tato mūhūrte saṃprāpai śobhane deśikottamaḥ| adhivāsitaśūlāni hyuddhṛtyādhyaryubhissaha|| 13.100 || dhama pradakṣīṇīkṛtya tūryaghoṣamudīrya ca| śūlāni sthāpayecchvabhre ratnanyāse yathodite|| 13.101 || sthānāsthāpane caiva tathāsaṃsthāpanā'pi ca| prasthāpanā pratiṣṭhā ca pratiṣṭhā paṃcakaṃ smṛtam|| 13.102 || yā pratiṣṭhā bhavet sthāne sthāpanā sā prakīrtatā| yā pratiṣṭhāsane proktā sā cāsthāpanasaṃjñitā|| 13.103 || śayane yā pratiṣṭhā ca sā ca saṃsthāpanā matā| yāne ca yā pratiṣṭhā sā nāmnā prasthāpanā bhavet|| 13.104 || pratimā yā'rcanā pīṭhe karmārceti prakīrtitā| tasyāṃ yā ca kriyā proktā sāpratiṣṭheti kīrtitā|| 13.105 || ācāryasthsāpayecchūlaṃ sthānakaṃ parameṣṭhinaḥ| asīnaṃsthāpayetpuṃsā viśvena śayitaṃ tathā|| 13.106 || sarveṇa viśvarūpaṃ tu nivṛtyā yānakaṃ bhavet| devīśūlaṃ tathā sthāpya ratnanyāsopari kramāt|| 13.107 || brahmādi devatānāṃ tu śūlānyātmīyavidyayā| evaṃ saṃsthāpya śūlāni bhittiśūlaṃ vinikṣipet|| 13.108 || kakude vṛṣṭhapārśve tu sthānakasya samācaret| āsīnasya tathā kṛtvā śayāvasyocyate'dhunā|| 13.109 || śayānādhāraśūle vai kuryādhūrdhvamukhe sthite| divyamānuṣayormadhye vaṃśadaṇḍaṃ nidhāpayet|| 13.110 || vṛṣṭhapārśve tu kakude śayanādhāraśūlakam| śayanādhāra śūledve kuryādūrdhva mukhesthite|| 13.111 || divyamānuṣayormadhye śayitādhāraśūlakam| ādhāraśūlaṃ śayane sthale kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥ|| 13.112 || ādhāraśūlamanyeṣāṃ bhittisaṃsthaṃ ca kārayet| ādhāraśūlarahite sarvatra sthāpane kṛte|| 13.113 || varapradhānaṃ sānnidhyamadhikaṃ bhavati dhruvam| mahākumbhādi kumbhānāṃ vāribhirmūlavidyayā|| 13.114 || prokṣayeddarbhakūryena śūlāni sthāpitānyatha| dakṣiṇāṃ guravedadyādyathā tuṣṭirbhavedguroḥ|| 13.115 || daśa niṣkaṃ suvarṇaṃ tu tasyārdhaṃ vā pradāpayet| ṛtvijāmapi sarveṣāṃ daśaniṣkaṃ pradāpayet|| 13.116 || kāle tasmin samāhūya rathakāraṃ dvijottamaḥ| preṣayottoṣayeccāpi yajamāno dhanairbhṛ śam|| 13.117 || kulālaṃ kuśalaṃ śāntaṃ vyādhihīnamadūṣitam| rathakāro niyuñjita śāstrokte sarvakarmaṇi|| 13.118 || tadabhāve pāraśavaṃ yāvannayanamokṣaṇam| rathakāro ktavidhinā kuśalassarvamācaret|| 13.119 || sthāpitaṃ nordharecchūlaṃ samuddhāre mahadbhayam| kartuḥ kārayituścāpi bhavatyeva sa saṃśayaḥ|| 13.120 || aṅgabhede'ṅgahānissyādyajamānasya niścitam| śūlasthāpanamātreṇa yajamāno mahatphalam|| 13.121 || aśrute mānuṣān daivanathavā na samāpitam| iti śrīpāñcarātre mahopaniṣadi pādmasaṃhitāyāṃ kriyāpāde śūlasthāpanavidhirnāma triyodaśo'dhyāyaḥ |
<2.14>
śrībhagavān bimbanirmāṇamadhunā vakṣyāmi kamalāsana| lohapaṭṭena śūlānāṃ sandhiṃ badhvā dṛḍhaṃ yathā|| 14.1 || aṣṭabandhena śūlāni limpetsarvāṇi sarvataḥ| rajjubhirveṣṭayettāni dṛḍhāni cchidravarjitam|| 14.2 || yathāsirābhirbahubhiśśarīraṃ badhyate tathā| śūlānyasthīni mṛnmāṃsaṃ sirāḥ pāśāstvacaḥ paṭāḥ|| 14.3 || mṛdbhirālepanaṃ kuryādapakvābhiśca turmukha| pakvābhirvarjayedbimbaṃ gṛhe devālaye'pi vā|| 14.4 || apakvāssarvaphaladāḥ pakvāstu badoṣadāḥ| mṛdā kevalayā bimbaṃ kuryādvadvā trivastubhiḥ|| 14.5 || mṛṇmaye kautuke purṇe sāṅgopāṅgaṃ yathāvidhi| trivastuke mṛdālipte kaṅkaśarkarayā tathā|| 14.6 || paṭenācchādya sarvāṅgaṃ varṇalepaṃ samācaret| puṇyakṣetre nadītīre kāntāre parvate'pi vā|| 14.7 || mṛdaṃ samagrāṃ gṛhṇīyātsarvadoṣavivarjitām| nīcai radhyāsitāṃ caityaśmaśānādi vivarjitām|| 14.8 || khadiraudumbarāśvattha nyagrodhārjuna bhūruhām| samuddhṛtya tvacassarvā māsaṃ vāriṣu nikṣipet|| 14.9 || to yairmāsoṣitairmṛtsnāṃ miśrayetpīḍayecca tām| tāṃ nūtanaiṣu bhāṇḍeṣu nikṣipyācchādya yatnataḥ|| 14.10 || chāyāyāṃ nikṣipedbhāṇḍānyathā vātādi na spṛśet| dhātukīyāstrayobhāgāṣṣaḍguṇā ca harītakī|| 14.11 || dhātrī ca dvādaśavidhā bhāgāṃstānekaviṃśatīḥ| adhivāsyaikamāsaṃ tu bhāṇḍeṣu kamalāsana| triphalena punarvārā tāṃ mṛdaṃ miśrayetsudhiḥ|| 14.12 || chāyāyāṃ nātiśuṣkāṃ tāṃ viṃśatyekonayā mṛdam| miśrayedvakṣyamāṇānāṃ puṇyakṣetrādi janmanām|| 14.13 || puṇyakṣetre nadītīre parvate puline hṛde| nirjharesaṅgame goṣṭhe devikakorvarayostathā|| 14.14 || śālikṣetre devakhā te śṛṅge ca vṛṣa hastinoḥ| varāhakṛṣṭe valmīke kulīravasatau tathā|| 14.15 || nalinyāṃ dīrghikāyāṃ ca mṛtsnāmekonaviṃśatim| mṛtsnābhirmuṣṭimātrābhiḥ purvoktāṃ miśrayenmṛdam|| 14.16 || pūrvoktamānaistriphalā cūrṇaistāṃ miśrayetpuvaḥ| tattribhāgaikabhāgaiśca kaṭaśarkaracūrṇitaiḥ|| 14.17 || nādeyaiślakṣṇapāṣāṇaiḥ mṛtturyāṃ śaiśca curṇitaiḥ| candanaṃ kuṅkumaṃ koṣṭhaṃ śrīveṣṭaṃ haricandanam|| 14.18 || gulgaluṃ ca niśāṃ śuṣkāṃ haritālaṃ manaśśilām| tamālapatrāṇyetāni candanādīni cūrṇayet|| 14.19 || mṛdviṃśatyekabhāgai staiścūrṇaistattulyasaikataiḥ| sūkṣmaiśca miśrayenmṛtsnāṃ kapittharasaturyakaiḥ|| 14.20 || cūrṇitairloharatnaiśca miśrayitvā tu mṛttikām| madhutai ladadhikṣīra ghṛtaiśśuktipramāṇakaiḥ|| 14.21 || atasītaila saṃmiśraiḥ punassaṃmiśrayenmṛdam| itthaṃ tu saṃskṛtāṃ mṛtsnāṃ nikṣipya navabhājane|| 14.22 || ācchādya navavastreṇa bhāṇḍaṃ dhānyeṣu nikṣipet| arcayemmālamantreṇa mṛdbhāṇḍān deśikottamaḥ|| 14.23 || sarpiṣā juhuyādagnau mūlonāṣṭottaraṃ śatam| catuṃ puruṣasū ktena pratyṛcaṃ juhuyādbhudhaḥ|| 14.24 || saṃpātājyena siṃcettāṃ mṛdaṃ bhājanasaṃsthitām| sadyo vā niśi vā mṛtsnā madhivāsya yathāvidhi|| 14.25 || muhūrte śobhane bimbe pralimpenmṛttikāṃ guruḥ| amaulikaṇṭhaparyantamālimpedyvoma vidyayā|| 14.26 || ākaṇṭhanābhiparyastaṃ viliṃ pedvāyuvidhyayā| ānābhikaṭiparyantaṃ lepayedvahnividyayā|| 14.27 || ākaṭerjānupaya ntamāliṃ pedvārividyayā| ājānukaṭiparyantaṃ praliṃ pedbhūmividyayā|| 14.28 || ānābhikaṇṭhamālimpetpunaśśvasanavidyayā| nābhyādiguhyaparyantamālimpeccikhilividyayā|| 14.29 || guhyādijānuparyantamāliṃpedvārividyayā| jānuprabhṛtipādāntamālimpatkṣitividyayā|| 14.30 || devīnāṃ ca śriyādīnāṃ brahmādīnāṃ tathaiva ca| ālevanaṃ prakurvīta kāle'smin bhūtavidyayā|| 14.31 || gurave dakṣiṇā deyā sa yathātuṣṭimāpnuyāt| bimbhasya nāhamānaṃ yacchūlamūnamapohya tat|| 14.32 || aṣṭadhākṛtya teṣu trin rajvācā veṣṭayedguṇān| mṛdbhirālepayetyraṃśaṃ dyauvastrakaṭaśarkaraiḥ|| 14.33 || nārikelatvacā mṛtsnāṃ dvitīyāṃ miśrayetpunaḥ| krameṇaparimāṇaṃ ca mukhabāhūruvakṣasām|| 14.34 || nāḍīmiḍāṃ piṅgalāṃ ca suṣumnāṃ tastubhiḥ kṛtām| sitapītāruṇaistābhirveṣṭayedviṣṇu vigraham|| 14.35 || nālikeratvacaṃ sūkṣmaṃ chitvācchitvā ca mṛttikām| tṛtīyāṃ miśrayettāṃ ca lepayetpūrvaśoṣaṇe|| 14.36 || hastaṃ ca sāṃgulopetaṃ kṛtvālohena bandhayet| karṇāvartaṃ tataḥ kutvālohena parivinyaset|| 14.37 || śarīra poṣaṇaṃ kuryādbhedarandhravivarjitam| hastena mṛttikā dadyātkūrcena kaṭaśa rkarām|| 14.38 || kaṭaśarkaracūrṇāni triphalākṛṣitāmbunā| piṣṭvā pūpākṛtiṃ kṛtvāśoṣayedātapena tāḥ|| 14.39 || punassampeṣayetpiṇḍān kapittharasavāriṇā| catustriḥ pañcakṛtvo vā kṛtvaivaṃ peṣayetpunaḥ|| 14.40 || kārpāsatūlami litān kapittharasavāriṇā| tāvatsampeṣa yedyāvadbāhubhyāṃ bāhṛmātrakam|| 14.41 || pratrikāyāssamuddhāre peṣaṇī na patedyapi| kalkaṃ supiṣṭaṃ kūrcena śanai reva parāmṛśet|| 14.42 || tataḥ karaṇḍikāgreṇa listāṅgāni ca lepayet| pūrṇeṣvaṅgeṣu sarveṣu paṭenācchādayeddhṛḍham|| 14.43 || kārpāpajaṃ dṛḍhaṃ celaṃ lomādibhiradūṣitam| dhyānyarāśiṣu saṃsthāpya vācayitvā śiṣaṃ punaḥ|| 14.44 || dhyānena śuddhiṃ sampādya pujayedvāyuvidyayā| mūlamantreṇa juhuyatsamidājyena vai śatam|| 14.45 || caruṃ puruṣasūktena juhuyātṣoḍaśāhutīḥ| muhūrteśobhane prāpte paṭenācchādyalepayet|| 14.46 || yā śarkarā paṭe tasmin tayaivākalpayettataḥ| śuklamṛttikayā lepaḥ kapittharasamiśrayā|| 14.47 || varṇālepaṃ tataḥ kuryācchilpiśāstravicakṣaṇaiḥ| śvetaṃ pītaṃ tathā raktaṃ haritaṃ kṛṣṇameva ca|| 14.48 || paṃcavarṇaṃ vṛthivyādi varṇānāmadhidevatāḥ| uttamā dhātavaḥ proktāḥ madhyamā vṛkṣasambhavāḥ|| 14.49 || saṃyogajāssyuradhamāstraividyamaparaṃ śṛṇu| varṇaṃ cāpyanuvarṇaṃ ca saṃskāraṃ ca tathaivaca|| 14.50 || trividho varṇasaṃyogaśśāstreṣu samudīritaḥ| varṇa ityucyate śuddho rājavattāni kārayet|| 14.51 || ānukāre ca ye varṇāḥ prāyaśaśśuddhivarjitāḥ| anuvarṇā ime proktāssaṅkirṇān kathayāmi te|| 14.52 || śūklo raktaśca pītaśca kṛṣṇaścaiva caturvidhaḥ| saṅkarāste ca catvāraḥ pratyekaṃ dvividhāḥ smṛtāḥ|| 14.53 || śuklaścaiva valarkṣaśca śveto dvividha ucyate| śakhṅagokṣīrakundābhaśśukla ityabhi saṃṅñitaḥ|| 14.54 || muktāsphaṭika cavdrābho valarkṣa iti saṃjñitaḥ| raktaścāpyaruṇaśśoṇa iti bhedena kathyate|| 14.55 || japāśoṇitasaṅkā śo raktamarṇe'ruṇomataḥ| kiṃśukāśokasaṅkā śaśśoṇa ityabhidhīyate|| 14.56 || haritaścaiva pītaśca pītavarṇo dvidhā bhavet| manaśśilāharītālanibho harita ucyate|| 14.57 || haridrākuṅkumābhastu pīta ityabhi saṃjñitaḥ| śyāmaśca kṛṣṇa varṇaśca kṛṣṇavarṇo dvidhā bhavet|| 14.58 || dūrvāmaratakābhaśca śyāma ityabhi saṃjitaḥ| isdranīlanibhaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ kṛṣṇavarṇaḥ prakīrtitaḥ|| 14.59 || śuklena miśrito rakto babhrurityabhidīyate| śuklena miśritaḥ kāṣo varṇakaḥ parikīrtitaḥ|| 14.60 || pītena miśrataḥ kṛṣṇaḥ kāla ityarbhidhīyate| pītakṛṣṇayutaśśuklaḥ karburassamudāhṛtaḥ|| 14.61 || enaṃ saṅkarajānvarṇānuhāpohena yojayet| uktoyaṃ varṇasaṃkṣepastaiḥ kuryā ccoditaiḥ kramāt|| 14.62 || prathamo dārusaṅghāto dvitīyaṃ rajjuveṣṭanam| mṛdālepastṛtiyastu turiyaṃ nādibandanam|| 14.63 || pañcamo rajjuveṣṭassyānnālikeratvacā punaḥ| miśritā muttikā ṣaṣṭhīsaptamaṃ rajjuveṣṭanam|| 14.64 || aṣṭamaśśarkarālepo navamaṃ paṭayojanam| bhūṣaṇaṃ daśamaṃ proktaṃ ekadaśamataḥ param|| 14.65 || śūklālepanamuddiṣṭaṃ dvādaśaṃ varṇayojanam| dvādaśaite ca nirdiṣṭāḥ pratimākaraṇe'bjaja|| 14.66 || kālena varṣamātreṇa vastu śuṣyati nānyathā| sahasraṃ vatsarān yāti māsairdvādaśabhiḥ kṛtaiḥ|| 14.67 || dvābhyāmayutamāyutsyāttribhirlakṣaṃ pratiṣṭhitam| hemnaiva poṣaṇaṃ sarvaṃ varṇānāṃ dīptikārakam|| 14.68 || ālekhye ca paṭe bhittau likhite phalakepi ca| varṇa yogassamuddiṣṭo dravyotpattistatheva ca|| 14.67 || mūrtīnāṃ yugabhedena varṇabhedo vidhīyate| kṛte valarkṣasraitāyāmaruṇo dvāpare punaḥ|| 14.68 || pītaḥ kalau ghanaśyāmaḥ vāsudevaḥ varaḥ pumān| raktassaṅkarṣaṇo devaḥ pradyumnaḥ kanakaprabhaḥ|| 14.69 || śyāmo niruddhaḥ kathitaḥ kṛtādiṣu caturṣvapi| keśavaḥ kanakaprakhyassyā darjunasamākṛtiḥ|| 14.70 || nārāyaṇaśśyāmavarṇo mādhavassphaṭikaprabhaḥ| govindaḥ padmakiṃjalkanibho viṣṇurudāhṛtaḥ|| 14.71 || aruṇāmbujasaṅkāśo madhusūdana ucyate| trivakramaśśikhinibho vāmano bhālasūryavat|| 14.72 || śrīdhara ssitapadmābho hṛṣīkeśastaṭitprabhaḥ| padmanābhaśśyāmavarṇo bandhūkakusumacchaviḥ|| 14.73 || dāmodaro dvādaśai te kathitāḥ keśavādayaḥ| vāsudevādimūrtīnāṃ yo varṇaḥ pūrvamīritaḥ|| 14.74 || sa eva vāsudevādicaturṇāṃ tadbhuvāma pi| śuddhaspaṭikasaṅkāśo vijñeyaḥ puruṣottamaḥ|| 14.75 || adhokṣajaśśyāmavarṇo nṛsiṃho hemasannibhaḥ| pītavarṇo'cyutotīva raktavarṇojanārdanaḥ|| 14.76 || upendraśśyāmalaḥ prokto hariḥ pītanibhaḥ smṛtaḥ| kṛṣṇaḥ kṛṣṇāmbudaprakhyaścaturviṃśatimūrtiyaḥ|| 14.77 || suvarṇa nikaṣābhā śrīśśyāmā bhūrarjunacchaviḥ| sarasvatī titā raktā pritiśśyamanibhā kṛtiḥ|| 14.78 || kīrtī raktā bhavecchāntissphaṭikābhā samīritā| tuṣṭiḥ pītā bhavetpuṣṭiśśyāmā devyasmsṛtā stutā|| 14.79 || matsyassphaṭikasaṅkāśaḥ kūrmaḥ kāñcanasannibhaḥ| varāhaśśāmalanibho valarkṣakṛtireva vā|| 14.80 || nṛsiṃhaścandravarṇābhaḥ prahlādaḥ kāñcanaprabhaḥ| vāvanaśśyā malanibhaḥ kālavarṇo mahābaliḥ|| 14.81 || jāmadagnyassuvarṇābhaḥ rāghavaśśyāmalākṛtiḥ| bharataśśyāmalo varṇo lakṣmaṇaḥ kanakaprabhaḥ|| 14.82 || śatrughno raktavarṇābhassītā hemanibhākṛtiḥ| māṇḍavīraktavarṇābha ūrmīlā śyāmalaprabhāḥ|| 14.83 || śrutakīrtissitāṅgī ca hanūmān kanakaprabhaḥ| aṅgado raktavarṇābhassugrīvo hemapihgalaḥ|| 14.84 || guhaśca nilavarṇābhaḥ kālavarṇo vibhīṣaṇaḥ| nīlo nīlanibhaḥ prokto jāmbhavan kanakaprabhaḥ|| 14.85 || balaḥ kṣīranibhaścaivaraktavarṇā ca revatī| meghaśyāmo bhavetkṛṣṭo rukmiṇī kanakaprabhāḥ|| 14.86 || satyabhāmā bhavet śyāmā kalkī raktanibhaḥ smṛtaḥ| anantaḥ kṣīrasaṅkaśaḥ yadvā hemasamākṛtiḥ|| 14.87 || garuḍaḥ kanakaprakhyo brahmā kanakasannibhaḥ| viṣṇu śśyāmanibhaḥ proktaḥ rudraśśoṇitasannibhaḥ|| 14.88 || hayagrīvo valarkṣassyātsenānī śśyāmalākṛtiḥ| raktavarṇo bhaveccaṇḍaḥ pracaṇḍaśśveta sannibhaḥ|| 14.89 || jayaḥ pītastataśśyāmo vijayaḥ padmasannibhaḥ| padmī gadādhāro hemaḥ kṛṣmaḥ khaḍgadharo bhavet|| 14.90 || śārṅgadhārī hemanibhaśśvato vajradharo mataḥ| śyāmo musaladhārī syātpāśadhṛkkanakaprabhaḥ|| 14.91 || kṛṣṇo'ṅkuśadharo dhātā raktapītavapurdharaḥ| vidhātā dhavalo bhadrassubhadro hyāruṇacchavi|| 14.92 || kṛtāntaśśyāmalo raktassuravidhyaṃsanaḥ smṛtaḥ| kubherākṣo bhavetpītaḥ kubhero rakta dehabhṛt|| 14.93 || durjayaḥ kṛṣṇavarṇābhaḥ prabhavaśśvetasannibhaḥ| syādviśvabhānano raktaḥ puṣkaraśśvetadehabhṛt|| 14.94 || sambhavaśśyāmalaḥ proktaḥ prabhavo raktasannibhaḥ| suśobhano bhavet śyāmassubhadra śśyāma varṇabhak|| 14.95 || kumudaśśvetavarṇābhaḥ kumudākṣognisannibhaḥ| puṇḍarīkastitaḥ proktaḥ vāmanaśśyāmalākṛtiḥ|| 14.96 || rakto bhavet śaṅkukarṇassarvanetro'sitaprabhaḥ| sumukhaśśyāmalaḥ proktaḥ raktābhassupratiṣṭhitaḥ|| 14.97 || raktassūryassitaścandro bhomo raktassito budhaḥ| bṛhaspatissuvarṇā bhaśśukraśśuklaśśanaiścaraḥ|| 14.98 || kṛṣṇastāmrastathā rāhuḥ ketuḥ kuṣṇa udāhṛtaḥ| kāmo raktassito hastivaktro raktaṣṣaḍānanaḥ|| 14.99 || durgā śyamā suvarṇābhaḥ dhanadaḥ kṣetrapālakaḥ| nīlo brāhmī suvarṇābhā raktā māheśvarī bhavet|| 14.100 || kaumārī rakta varṇābhā vaiṣṇavī śyāmalaprabhā| vārāhī śyāmavarṇabhā indrāṇī śyāmalā kṛtiḥ|| 14.101 || cāmuṇḍā raktavarṇābhā vīrabhadro 'ruṇadyutiḥ| jyeṣṭhā nīlā bhavedindraśśyāmo'gniraruṇa prabhaḥ|| 14.102 || yamaḥ kālo dhanirṛtirnīlasśyāmaḥ pracetanaḥ| vāyurdhūmrassīta ścenduḥ rakto rudra udāhṛtaḥ|| 14.103 || puruṣaśśyāmalo hemadyutissyādacyutassmṛtaḥ| sito raktastathā pītaśśyāmo raktassitaprabhaḥ|| 14.104 || babhruḥ pīto dharādīnāṃ vasūnāṃ varṇasaṅgrahaḥ| raktaśśyetaḥ prabhā pītaśśyāmaśśyeto ruṇaprabhaḥ|| 14.105 || babhruḥ pitṝṇāṃ varrṇo'yaṃ krameṇa samudāhṛtaḥ| dhūmro raktastadhā pītaśśyāmaśśveto' ruṇo'sitaḥ|| 14.106 || varṇo'yaṃ marutāmuktassaptānāmānupūrvaśaḥ| kanakaśśyāmalaḥ pītaḥ kṛṣṇo caraktassito'sitaḥ|| 14.107 || varṇaḥ krameṇa saptānāmṛṣīṇāṃ samudāhṛtaḥ| raktaḥ pītassitaśśyāmo raktapitassi tā sitaḥ|| 14.108 || viśvādiparivārāṇāṃ varṇānukramaṇaṃ kṛtam| śvetābhā kanakābhā ca śyāmā ca kanakaprabhā|| 14.109 || raktā kṛṣṇā ca pītā ca rūpamapsarasāṃ matam| raktaḥ pīto'ruṇaśśyāmaśśveto babhruśca karburaḥ|| 14.110 || varṇato haritaśśveta śoṇaḥ kundanibhastathā| ādityānāmayaṃ varṇo dvādasānāṃ kramāt smṛtaḥ|| 14.111 || śoṇaśca harito nīla śvetaśśyāmaladīdhitiḥ| pītaḥ kālastatā babhruḥ varṇakaḥ pāṭalo'sitaḥ|| 14.112 || ekadaśānāṃ rudrāṇāṃ varṇo'yaṃ samudīritaḥ| aśvinau cāruṇau pītau mārkaṇḍeyastathā bhavet|| 14.113 || nāradassphaṭikaḥ pīto bhṛgurdakṣastathāsitaḥ| rakto manussanandaśca śyāmalaḥ kanakastathā|| 14.114 || pītassavatkumāraśca rakto hāhā ca pītalaḥ| hūhūraktastathā śyāmaḥ mumbharuḥ kinnaraśśukaḥ|| 14.115 || raktaḥ kiṃpuruṣaśśyāmaścitrasena stathā bhavet| pīto viśvāvasuḥ prokto madhuśca madhuvarṇakaḥ|| 14.116 || kaiṭabhaśśyamalaḥ prokto varṇonukto'vagamyatām| iti śri pāñcarātre mahapaniṣadi pādmasaṃhitāyāṃ kriyapade devatārarṇavidhirnāma caturdaśo'dhyāyaḥ |
<2.15>
śrībhagavān bhedanathāto vakṣyāmi pratimānu sthitādiṣu| sthitā mūrti stathāsīnā yānārūḍhā tathaiva ca|| 15.1 || tāptisro dvividhāḥ proktā bhogayegaprabhedataḥ| śayānasya tu pūrvoktau sargasaṃhārakāriṇau|| 15.2 || dvau cāparau caturbhedaśśayānaḥ kamalāsana| ekaikā dvitridhā bhedā uttamādhamamadhyamāḥ|| 15.3 || divye bhoge sthitaṃ devaṃ śaṅkhacakragadādharam| śrībhūmisahitaṃ yuktamarcanā pīṭhaparśvayoḥ|| 15.4 || sanandasanakarṣibhyaṃ kṛtāñjalipuṭau sthitau| utthitau vāmajānubhyāmitarābhyāṃ pratiṣṭhitau|| 15.5 || pādayorubhayo rugre tavubhau kārayetsudhīḥ| arcanāpīṭhikā pārśvabhūtaleṣvevamāsanam|| 15.6 || dakṣiṇottarayorbhitti pāśvayorbrahmaśaṅkarau| vṛṣataḥ puṣpavantautau dakṣiṇottarapārśvayoḥ|| 15.7 || bhittiṃ samāśritau kuryātsavandasanakau tathā| bālaveṣadharau vāmaṃ prasārya caraṇaṃ sthitau|| 15.8 || nikuñcya dakṣiṇaṃ pādaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ karamutkṣipan| sanālamambujaṃ phūllaṃ vāmahastatale dadhat|| 15.9 || sanakarṣissanandastu yathoktādanyathāsthitiḥ| sūryācandramasau cāpi karapādakramāttathā|| 15.10 || cāmaravyajane bhittau śvetacchatre ca mauktike| bhittipārśve prabhāṃ kuryādyathālakṣaṇasaṃyutām|| 15.11 || kalpakānokahaṃ vṛṣṭhe bhittipārśve prakalpayet| bhittipārśva tu purato ratiśāntī prakalpayet|| 15.12 || saṃvījayantyau taṃ devaṃ cāmarābhyāṃ caturmukha| hāhāhūhūśca gandharvau garudo nāradastathā|| 15.13 || devatāścāpi munayassanti yatra niketane| bhogasthānaṃ tu tadvidyāduttamaṃ kamalāsana|| 15.14 || mahīsthāne patattrīndraṃ mahīṃ ca sanakāsane| mārkaṇḍeyāsanāntetu ābhesau brahmaśaṅkarau|| 15.15 || anye ca yatra pūrvoktāḥ bhogasthāne sa madyamaḥ| devaścaturbhujassārdhaṃ śrīdharābhyāmavasthitaḥ|| 15.16 || dakṣiṇe varadaṃ vāmaṃ siṃhakarṇamathāpi vā| ūrumūlāśritaṃ vāpi śaṅkhacakradharau parau|| 15.17 || brahmeśānau tu sābhāsau sarvamanyadyathoditam| bhogasthāne yatra bhavejjaghanyaṃ tatpracakṣate|| 15.18 || śrībhūmisahito devaśśaṅkacakragadādharaḥ| arcanāpīṭhikāpārśve mārcaṇḍeyo bhṛgustathā|| 15.19 || sarvamanyadyathoktaṃ ca yogasthānaṃ taduttamam| nārado druhiṇasthāne śivasthāne khageśvaraḥ|| 15.20 || arcanāpīṭhapārśvetu brahmeśānau kṛtāñjalī| yatho ktamanyatsarvaṃ ca yogasthāne sa madhyamaḥ|| 15.21 || devaścaturbhujo divye bhāge brāhme'thavā yadi| abhayaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ hastaṃ varadaṃ svāgataṃ tu vā|| 15.22 || ūrumūlāśrayaṃ vāmaṃ sapallavamathāpi vā| gadāmudramatho vāpi śaṅkhacakradharau parau|| 15.23 || brahmeśānādirahitaṃ nīca sā yogasaṃsthitiḥ| sthānaprabhedaḥ kathitassaṃpratyāsīna ucyate|| 15.24 || śrībhūmibhyāṃ sahāsīvassiṃhaviṣṭaramāśritaḥ| brahmeśānau bhittapārśve sthitau yadvā sukhāsanau|| 15.25 || bhuguṃ ca nāradaṃ ca dvau bhittipārśve samācaret| ārcanāpīṭhikāpārśve ratiśāntī kṛtāñjalī|| 15.26 || vṛṣṭhataścandrasūryādi sarvamanyadyathoditam| bhogasanaṃ taduccaissyā dāsīnassiṃhaviṣṭare|| 15.27 || vāmotsaṅge śriyaṃ devīṃ samāropya caturbhujaḥ| vāmahastena cāśliṣya yadvā bhūmiṃ yatho ditam|| 15.28 || sābhāsāvardhacitrau vā brahmeśau bhittipārśvayoḥ| pūjāsikāmubhayataḥ kāryau ca bhṛgulāradau|| 15.29 || dakṣaścaiva manuścaubau sacāmarakarau sthitau| pṛṣṭhataścandrasūryādi bhoge madhyamamāsanam|| 15.30 || āsīnassahadevībhyāṃ brahmeśau bhittipārśvayoḥ| bhittipārśve ratiśśāntissavālavyajane sthite|| 15.31 || bhogāsanaṃ tadadhamaṃ yogāsanamathocyate| siṃhāsane sukhāsīnaṃ brahmeśau bhittirśvayoḥ|| 15.32 || ratissarasvatī ca dve sitavāladhivījane| arcanāpīṭhikāpārśve śrībhūmī ca kṛtāñjalī|| 15.33 || pṛṣṭhataścandrasūryādi yāgāsanamidaṃ varam| siṃhāsane sukhāsīnāṃ brahmeśau bhittipārśvayoḥ|| 15.34 || āśīne śrī mahīdevyau sacāmarakaresthite| arcanāpīṭhikāpārśve śrībhūmyau ca kṛtāñjalī|| 15.35 || dakṣaścaiva manuścaiva bhittipārśve kṛtāñjalī| pṛṣṭhataścandrasūryādi yoge tanmadhyamāsanam|| 15.36 || siṃhāsane sukhāsīno deva ekaścaturbhujaḥ| tyaktvāsarvaṃ parikaraṃ candrasūryādi vṛṣṭhataḥ|| 15.37 || divye brāhme'thavā bhāge yoge tannīcamāsanam| śoṣāsanamatho vakṣye yathāvadavadhāraya|| 15.38 || suvṛttaṃ bhogino bhogaṃ maṇḍalena sthitaṃ trivṛt| kīñcidvṛttāyataṃ vā tu samunnamya sthitaṃ śiraḥ|| 15.39 || tatra śrībhūmisahito viṣṭare tu sukhasanaḥ| ratissarasvatī ca dve pūjāviṣṭarapārśvayoḥ| devai rdevagaṇaiścaiva ṛṣibhirbhittipārśvayo||15.40 || kṛtāñjalipuṭāssarve śeṣāsanamidaṃ param| devaścaturbhujāsīnaḥ vāmotsaṅgārpitapriyaḥ|| 15.41 || mārkaṇḍeyo mahī caiva pūjā viṣṭarapārśvayoḥ| bhṛguśca nāradaścaiva tiṣṭhatastitacāmarau|| 15.42 || pṛṣṭhataścandrasūryādi śeṣe tanmadhyamāsanam| śriyā devya samāsīnaḥ pūjāpīṭhasya pārśvayoḥ|| 15.43 || brahmā ca vasudhā caiva dharmo devo vṛṣaddhajaḥ| devasya puraśśrīmān mārkaṇḍeyaḥ kṛtāñjaliḥ|| 15.44 || pṛṣṭhataścandrasuryādi śeṣe tannīcamāsanam| sthityāsanabhidaḥ proktāḥ śayanasya bhidāṃ śṛṇu|| 15.45 || anantabhogaśayane mṛdvāstaraṇakalpite| sopadhāne śiraḥ pārśve pādapārśva tathaiva ca|| 15.46 || śīrṣe'sminbhogamāsthāya paramātmā sanātanaḥ| devyorutsaṅgayoḥ pādau prasārya sukhavāhanau|| 15.47 || devyau devasya vaktābjaṃ vīkṣamāṇe sukhāsane| arcanāpīṭhapārśve tu ratiśāntī kutāṃjalī|| 15.48 || indrādīn pādaparśve tu bhittau ca parikalpayet| pṛṣṭhato bhittipārśve tu śaṅkhārdin dehasaṃyutān|| 15.49 || devasya maulipārśve tu bhittau brahmādimūrtayaḥ| sanandasanakādyanyān yathāpūrvaṃ prakalpayet|| 15.50 || devasya purato bhittau hāhāhūhūstathaiva ca| citrasenaścatraratho nṛttagītakriyāparau|| 15.51 || viṣṇulokodbhavāḥ kanyāḥ brahmalokasamudbhavāḥ| rudrādilokajaḥ kanyā nānāvibhramasaṃyutāḥ|| 15.52 || tumbhururnaradaścaiva garuḍaḥ kinnarastathā| vīṇādibhirvādayantastathoparimāharṣayaḥ|| 15.53 || citrarūpeṇa sarve syuśśayane bhagamuttamam| śri mahyau mūrndha pārśve tu bāhvūrmūlaṃ samāśrite|| 15.54 || pādapārśve ratiśśāntaḥ pādaspṛṣṭe sukhāsane| sanatkumārasanakau arcanāpīṭhapārśvayoḥ|| 15.55 || ardhacitreṇa bhittisthau bhāgaśayyā tu madhyamā| śrīḥ pādapadmayugalaṃ karābhyāṃ vāhayetsukham|| 15.56 || arcanāpīṭhikāpārśve ratiścaiva vasundharā| citrābhāsena kuḍyasthe bhogaśayyā'dhamābhavet|| 15.57 || anantabhogaśayane tyaktasarvaparigrahaḥ| yogamāsthāya śayitassvayameva paraḥ pumān|| 15.58 || śrīvatsāṅkaḥ prasannāsyaḥ nilajīmūtasannibhaḥ| dvibhujo yegaśayanamuttamaṃ samudāhṛtam|| 15.59 || sevito vainateyena sanniviṣṭena pārśvataḥ| caturbhujaḥ parikarairanyaissarvairvivarjitaḥ|| 15.60 || madhyamaṃ yogaśayanamucyate taccaturmukha| dvābhyāṃ bhujābhyāṃ sahitastyaktasarvaparigrahaḥ|| 15.61 || arcanāpīṭhikāpārśve śrībhūmī tu kṛtāṃjalī| adhamaṃ yogaśayanaṃ saṃhāraśayanaṃ śṛṇu|| 15.62 || anantabhogaśayane anantaphaṇamaṇḍite| śayito'ṣṭabhujo devaḥ bhrukuṭīkaṭilānanaḥ|| 15.63 || daṃṣṭrākarālaṃ bibhrāṇo mukhamekaṃ bhayānakam| pralayāmbhodhinirghoṣagabhīrabhayadadhvanim|| 15.64 || vamantamāntaraṃ vahniṃ mukhavāyusamīritam| saṃhāraśayanaṃ śreṣṭhamidamāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ|| 15.65 || daṃṣṭrākarālavadanaṃ bhrukuṭīkuṭilekṣaṇam| caturbhujaṃ gadākhaḍgaśaṅkhamadmavibhūṣitam|| 15.66 || arcanāpīṭhikāpārśve śrīkhagaundrau kṛtāṃjalī| madhyamā saṃhṛtau śayyā kaniṣṭhaṃ śayanaṃ śṛṇu|| 15.67 || keśairalakasaṅghaiśca virājitaśubhānanam| nīlajīmūtasaṅkāśaṃ madhye haritapaṅkajam|| 15.68 || sargaśayyā caturdikṣu bhittau vārinidhaṃ likhet| brahmāṇaṃ ca catustāle śayanādbhittipārśvataḥ|| 15.69 || upariṣṭhādabhimukhaṃ nābhernārāyaṇasya ca| caturmukhaṃ caturbāhuṃ jaṭāmukuṭasaṃyutam|| 15.70 || dvābhyāṃ karābhyāṃ mukhyābhyāṃ kṛtāṃjalipuṭaṃ sthitam| darśayantaṃ karābhyāṃ vā yogamudrāṃ caturmukha|| 15.71 || uttarābhyāmudastābhyā makṣamālāṃ sakuṇḍikām| dhārayantaṃ sarasije svastikāsanabandhanam|| 15.72 || devasya śirasaḥ pṛṣṭhe śriyaṃ tasyākṣilakṣikām| vāmajānuṃ samunnamya dakṣiṇena pratiṣṭhitām|| 15.73 || dakṣiṇaṃ puṣpahastaṃ tu vāmahastaṃ vasupradam| anantaśayane'dhastātpūjāpīṭhasya pārśvayoḥ|| 15.74 || nāradaṃ sanakaṃ caiva mānuṣe tu kṛtāṃjalī| pādapārśve mahīṃ devīṃ pādaspṛṣṭāṃ tu kārayet|| 15.75 || upariṣṭātsamudrāṇāṃ śaṅkhādīn dehasaṃyutān| devasya pṛṣṭhabhittau tu dehalabdhāṅgulena ca|| 15.76 || caturviṃśāṅgulotsedhān śaṅkhādyāyudhadhāriṇaḥ| śaṅkhacakragadākhaḍgadhanuḥ pañcāyudhāni ca|| 15.77 || dvihastān puruṣākārān svacihnāṅkitamastakān| śaṅkādhāraṃ prakurvīta lambakukhiṃ sitaprabham|| 15.78 || raktavarṇaṃ vivṛttākṣaṃ kuryāccakradharaṃ param| gadādhāraṃ mahākāyaṃ vṛttākṣaṃ pītalaprabham|| 15.79 || strīveṣā khaḍgadhārī tu sustavā śyāmalaprabhā| śārṅgadhṛgghemavarṇābhaḥ mahākāyo mahodaraḥ|| 15.80 || vaina teyassuvarṇābhaḥ pakṣamaṇḍalamaṇḍitaḥ| nānākañcuka saṃyuktāḥ nānāmbaradharā ime|| 15.81 || daṃṣṭrākarālavadanāḥ bhrukuṭīkuṭilekṣaṇāḥ| karaṇḍikāmukuṭinassarvābharaṇabhūṣitāḥ|| 15.82 || vāmaiḥ karaistarjayantaḥ itarairbaddhamuṣṭayaḥ| dhāvanto'bhimukhaṃ sarve madhukaiṭabhayordayoḥ|| 15.83 || adhastātpādayoḥ pārśve kārayenmadhukaiṭabhau| madhuśyāmau mahākāyau karaṇḍimukuṭojjvalau|| 15.84 || jānumātraṃ samudrasthau khaṇḍadaṇḍāyudhodyatau| daṃṣṭrākarālavadanau bhrukuṭīkaṭilekṣaṇau|| 15.85 || anantaphaṇivaktrāgnijvālābhiḥ pari tāpitau| bhītau palāyitau vajrakalpairmuṣṭhibhirāhatau|| 15.86 || devasya pūrvabhittau tu prādurbhāvanprakalpayet| puṣṭistuṣṭhistathā kīrtī ratiśśāntassarasvatī|| 15.87 || prasūnamañjarīhastāstitacāmaravījanāḥ| sarveṣāmupariṣṭhāttu kuryājjaladapaddhatim|| 15.88 || upariṣṭhācca meghānāṃ devāśca ṛṣayastathā| indrāyadaśca dikpālāḥ ṛṣaya ssaptadaṇḍinaḥ|| 15.89 || sottarīyāśca sarve te racitāṃjalayaḥ sthitāḥ| mūrndhi pārśve ca viṣṇuśca rudraścaiva caturbhujau|| 15.90 || devasya purato bhittau kuryānmegha pathopari| hāhāhūhūśca gandharvau kinnarastumburustathā|| 15.91 || sarve cāpsarasaṅghātā nṛttagītaratāssadā| anantaśayane ramye pūrvavattatra kalpite|| 15.92 || caturbhujaśśyāmavarṇaśśaṅkhacakragadādhāraḥ| pītāmbaradhassaumyaḥ karṇāntāyatalocanaḥ|| 15.93 || dakṣiṇe ca bhuje mauliṃ prasāritatalāṅgulau| nidhāya maulipaṭṭāntaṃ prasāritabhujetaraḥ|| 15.94 || śayito rājavaddhevaḥ kiñciddvāranirīkṣakaḥ| sarve citreṇa rūpeṇa bhittisthāḥ pūrvamīritāḥ|| 15.95 || uttamaṃ sṛṣṭiśayanametadāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ| bāhudvayasamopetaśśyāmalaḥ komalākṛtiḥ|| 15.96 || pṛṣṭhatasskandhapārśve tu prākca padmā pratiṣṭhitā| brahmāṇaṃ bhittipārśve tu citreṇaiva prakalpayet|| 15.97 || sanakaṃ ca mahīṃ caiva pūjāpīṭhisya pārśvayoḥ| ardhacitreṇa śeṣāssyussṛṣṭiśayyā tu madhyamā|| 15.98 || śiyraṃ mahīmadhastācca bhūtale pīṭhapārśvayoḥ| brahmāṇaṃ bhittipārśve tu citrābhāsena kalpayet|| 15.99 || bhajadvayasamopetaḥ padmanābhaścaturmukha| pralayodadhimadhyasthaśśayitā viśvakāraṇam|| 15.100 || abhāsenai va kuḍyasthā sargaśayyā kanīyasī|| iti śrīpāñcārātre mahopaniṣadi pādmasaṃhitāyāṃ kriyāpāde sthityāsanādi bhedhanirṇayo nāma paṃcadaśo'dhyāyaḥ |
<2.16>
śrībhagavān yānārūḍasya bhodo'yaṃ adhunā saṃpradarśyate| vaina teyaṃ suvarṇābhaṃ pakṣamaṇḍalamaṇḍitam|| 16.1 || nīlāgranāsāsaṃyuktaṃ nāgendrābharaṇai ryutam| skandhe cāruhyā caraṇaṃ vāmamākuñcya dakṣiṇam|| 16.2 || prasārya caraṇaṃ devo bhujāṣṭakasamanvitaḥ| cakrapadmāsiviśikhān dhārayan daṇiṇaiḥ karaiḥ|| 16.3 || śaṅkhaṃ kaumodakīṃ carma cāpamanyaiḥ karairdadhat| pṛṣṭhato bhittipārśve tu ātapatraṃ suradrumam|| 16.4 || savandasanakau bhittau pārśvayoścandrabhāskarau| yathā svāvāhane devassamāruhya sthitā yadi|| 16.5 || arcanāpīṭhikāpārśve śrīmahyau tu kṛtāṃjalī| surāsuramunīn nāgān siddhavidyādharāṃ stathā|| 16.6 || gandarvāpsaraso meghān kārayodbhittibhūmiṣu| sarve citreṇa saṃyuktā yānārohaṇamuttamam|| 16.7 || devaṃ caturbhujaṃ kṛtvā śaṅkhacakragadādharam| vāmotsaṅge samāropya ratiṃ dāḍimasannibhām|| 16.8 || pāśāṅguśadharāṃ devīṃ kāmavihvalalocanām| arcanāpīṭhikāpārśve śriyaṃ bhūmiṃ ca kārayet|| 16.9 || nāradaśca bhṛguścaiva kṛḍye cāmaradhāriṇau| prītaṃ sarasvatīṃ śāntiṃ kalpayet yāmyabhūmiṣu|| 16.10 || puṣṭhiṃ tuṣṭiṃ ca kīrtaṃ ca kuḍye vāme ca kārayet| puṣpamañjarihastāśaaca sitacāmaravījanāḥ|| 16.11 || ardhacitreṇa vā sarve ābhāsenaiva vā vidhiḥ| madhyamo vāhanārohaśśṛṇunīcaṃ caturmukha|| 16.12 || caturbhujaṃ viśālākṣaṃ bhinnāñjanacayaprabham| mukhyābhyāṃ caiva hastābhyāṃ śārṅkhapañcaśarānapi|| 16.13 || ūrdhvābhyāmitarābhyāṃ ca śaṅgaṃ cakraṃ ca dhārayan| niṣṭaptakanakaprakhyāṃ vāmotsaṅgasamarpitām|| 16.14 || lāvaṇyāmṛtatoyena siñcantīmiva sarvataḥ| dakṣiṇaṃ puṣpahastaṃ vā vāmahastaṃ vasupradam|| 16.15 || arcanāpīṭhikāpārśve ratiṃ śāntiṃ ca kārayet| citrābhāsena kuḍyasthāḥ nīcaṃ yānādhirohaṇam|| 16.16 || viśvarūpaṃ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇu paṅkajasambhava | dvipādamekakaṇṭhaṃ ca caturdikṣu caturmukham|| 16.17 || vāsudevamukhādūrdhvaṃ sarvadevamukhāni tu| saṅkarṣaṇamukhādūrdhvaṃ sarvarṣīṇāṃ mukhāni ca|| 16.18 || pradyumnasya mukhādūrdhvaṃ dai tyadānavarakṣasām| aniruddhamukhādūrdhvaṃ nāgagandharvakinnarāḥ|| 16.19 || mukhānyetāni cānyāni yathāvibhavamādarāt| kartavyāni caturvaktra samarthāni vicakṣaṇaiḥ|| 16.20 || upariṣṭācca vaktrāṇāṃ kirīṭamatiśobhanam| kuryādyugapadudbhūtaṃ sahasrādityavarcasam|| 16.21 || anekabhujasaṃyuktaṃ anekāyudhabhūṣitam| arcitaṃ brahmarudrābhyāṃ bhittibhūmiṣu devatāḥ|| 16.22 || citreṇa sarve vihitāḥ viśvarūpassa uttamaḥ| sarve yathoktāḥ kuḍyasthāḥ ardhacitreṇa cetkṛtāḥ|| 16.23 || savandasanakau kuryātpūjāpiṭhasya pārśvayoḥ| madhyamā viśvamūrtassyāt jaghanyāmapisaṃśṛṇu|| 16.24 || ābhāsenaiva kuḍyasthāḥ devyau pūjāsane sthite| caturbhirbāhubhiryuktaḥ vāsudevaśca śāśvataḥ|| 16.25 || mukhyābhyāṃ dhārayan sarvadakṣiṇābhyāṃ gadāmbuje| ūrdhvābhyāmitarābhyāṃ tu śaṅkhacakre yathāratham|| 16.26 || athavā dakṣiṇo hastaḥ parado'bhayadopi vā| gadāṃ vinā vāmahastaḥ kaṭideśāvalambitaḥ|| 16.27 || dvibhujo vā bahubhujo yukto nekai stathānanaiḥ| ekena vā sito varṇe vāsudevassanātanaḥ|| 16.28 || evaṃ nārāyaṇo'nādirnīlanīradasannibhaḥ| caturviṃśatimūrtīnāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ vakṣyate'dhunā|| 16.29 || keśavasyāmbujaṃ śaṅkhaṃ cakraṃ daṇḍastathāyudham| prādakṣiṇyena bāhūnāmanyeṣāmucyate kramāt|| 16.30 || nārāyaṇaśśaṅkhapadmagadācakradharaḥ smṛtaḥ| madhavo gadayā sārdhaṃ cakraśaṅkhambujāyudhaḥ|| 16.31 || govindaścakradaṇḍābjaśaṅkhāyudhadharo bhavet| viṣṇurgadābjaśaṅkhāridharassyānmadhusūdanaḥ|| 16.32 || cakraśaṅkhābjadaṇḍāstradharaḥ kāryastrivikramaḥ| padmadaṇḍāriśaṅkhāstro vāmanaśśaṅkhacakradhṛk|| 16.33 || gadābjapāṇiścatathā śrīdharo dhṛtavārijaḥ| sārdhaṃ cakragadāśaṅkhaiḥ hṛṣīkeśamataśśṛṇu|| 16.34 || gācakrābjaśaṅkhāstradharaḥ paṅkaja nābhakaḥ| padmacakrāmbujagadādharo dāmodaraḥ smṛtaḥ|| 16.35 || abjaśaṅkhagadācakradharo dvādaśamūrtayaḥ| etāḥ kaumodakīśaṅkhacakrāmbhojadharāḥ smṛtāḥ|| 16.36 || vāsudevo jagadvonissaṅkarṣaṇamataśśṛṇu| gadāśaṅkhābjacakrāṇi dhārayantaṃ caturbhujam|| 16.37 || pradyumnaścakraśaṅkhābhyāṃ saha daṇḍasarojavān| aniruddho’ridaṇḍābja padmapāṇiścaturbhujaḥ|| 16.38 || cakramadmāmbujaissārdhaṃ gadāvān puruṣottamaḥ| adhokṣajaḥ padmadaṇḍaśaṅkhacakradharaḥ smṛtaḥ|| 16.39 || nṛsiṃhaścakrajalajagadaśaṅkhadharaḥ smṛtaḥ| acyuto daṇḍapadmāriśaṃkhahastaścaturbhujaḥ|| 16.40 || janārdanaḥ padmacakraśaṃkhadaṇḍaścaturbhujaḥ| upendra śśaṅkhadaṇḍāripadmāyudhavibhūṣitaḥ|| 16.41 || śaṃkhacakrābjadaṇḍāstraḥ harissyatkamalāsana| kṛṣṇaśśaṃkhagadāpadmacakrapāṇiścaturbhujaḥ|| 16.42 || dakṣiṇaṃ hastamārabhya pādakṣiṇyena kārayet| mūrticihnāni śaṃkhādīnyāyudhāni vicakṣaṇaḥ|| 16.43 || vāsudevaḥ padmanābhaḥ nārāyaṇajanārdanau| eteṣāṃ varṇabheto'sti na viśeṣosti cāyudhaiḥ|| 16.44 || pītāmburadharāssarvāścaturviṃśatimūrtayaḥ| śrīvatsakaustubhākalpavanamālāvibhūṣitāḥ|| 16.45 || bhogārthina ścedbhittisthān devībhyāṃ sthāpayetsaha| vinā tābhyāṃ mokṣakāmāḥ sthāpayeyuryathā vidhi|| 16.46 || āsanasthānaśayanayānādiṣu yathāvidhi| aṣṭau vakṣye parā yūrtīstānu brāhmī praśasyate|| 16.47 || prājāpatyā dvitīyā tu tṛtīyā vaiṣṇavī matā| daivī caturthī tadanu mūrtarārṣīcaturmukha|| 16.48 || ṣaṣṭhī tu mānuṣī jñeyā saptamī mūrtarāsurī| pai śācī mūrtaranyā syāttāsāṃ lakṣaṇamucyate|| 16.49 || prathamāṣṭabhujā taptatapanīyasamadyutiḥ| bhujeṣu mukhyo varado dakṣiṇeṣvitaretrayaḥ|| 16.50 || cakrāsibhāṇaissaṃyukto vāme hastacatuṣṭaye| śaṅkhaṃ gadāṃ tathā carma śārṅgaṃ kuryāccaturmukha|| 16.51 || pītāmbaradharo devaḥ vanamālāvibhūṣitaḥ| marīcinā ca bhṛguṇā pūjitaśca maharṣiṇā|| 16.52 || śaṃkhakundenduvarṇābhaḥ pītavāsāścaturbhujaḥ| śaṃkhacakragadāpāṇirabhayena virājitaḥ|| 16.53 || vanamālādharassaumyassanakena supūjitaḥ| sanatkumāreṇa tathā mūrtireṣā prajāpateḥ|| 16.54 || bhinnāñjanacayassaumyaśśaṃkhacakragadādharaḥ| pītāmbaradharo devo vanamālāvibhūṣitaḥ|| 16.55 || varado dakṣiṇo hastassvāgatā bhayato'pi vā| vāmena spṛṣṭakaṭābhūśśrībhūmibhyāṃ saha sthitaḥ|| 116.56 || nāradenāpi bhṛguṇā vaiṣṇavī mūrtirarcitā| śaṃkhacakragadāpadmaṃ dhārayantaṃ caturbhujam|| 16.57 || śyāmalaṃ pītavasanaṃ vanamālāvibhūṣitam| arcitaṃ brahmarudrābhyāṃ daivī mūrtarasau bhavet|| 16.58 || śuddhasphaṭikasaṅkāśā pītavastrā caturbhujā| dakṣiṇe jñānamudrā ca śaṃkhacakragadādharā|| 15.59 || śrīvatsāṅkā prasannasyā vanamālāvibhūṣitā| sanandasanakābhyāṃ ca pūjitā mūrtirāṛṣī|| 15.60 || mānuṣī mūrtiradhunā kathya te kamalāsana| caturaśrāyate dhāmni divye bhāge bhujadvayam|| 15.61 || śaṃkhacakradharaṃ saumyaṃ sthāpayenmukuṭojvalam| devasya dakṣiṇe pārśve śriyaṃ devīṃ prakalpayet|| 15.62 || tasyā dakṣiṇa to bhāge balabhadraṃ tu kārayet| dakṣiṇe balabhadrasya pradyumnamapi kārayet|| 16.63 || devasya vāmapārśve tu aniruddhaṃ prakalpayet| tasya pārśve tu vāme tu sāmbhaṃ kuryāccaturmukha|| 16.64 || brahmāṇaṃ dakṣiṇe kuḍye sarve tu vinatātmajam| sthānake sthānakāḥ proktā āsīne'pi tathā bhavet|| 16.65 || caturbhujā tu karmārcā dvibhujā vāpi sā bhavet| utsarvārcā pratikṛtissarvācaiva caturbhujā|| 16.66 || mānuṣyaṃ vāsudevasya proktaṃ sajkṣepato vidhiḥ| āsurī mūrtirasitā ekavaktrā caturbhujā|| 16.67 || daṃṣṭrākarālavadanā bhrukuṭī kuṭilekṣaṇā| mukhye karadvaye bhāṇaṃ dhanurudhye'riśaṃkhakam|| 16.68 || śārṅgahastaṃ lalāṭānta muddharedbhāṇahastakam| nābhyantaṃ kaṭisūtrāntaṃ bhaṅgatrayasamanvitam|| 16.69 || paiśācīmūrtirādyā tu khaḍgakaumodakī tathā| varadābhayadaṃ mukhyaṃ kālavarṇaṃ karadvayam|| 16.70 || daṃṣṭrākarālavadanaṃ bhrukuṭīkuṭilekṣaṇam| aṣṭau ca mūrtayassarvāssarvābharaṇabhūṣitāḥ|| 16.71 || śrīvassakaustabhoraskāḥ vanamālā vibhūṣitāḥ| sthāpitā brahmaṇomūrtiḥ brahmabhūyāya kalpate|| 16.72 || prājāpatya pratiṣṭhāyāṃ prajābhirvardhate bhṛśam| ante prajāpatipadaṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ|| 16.73 || sthāpitā vaiṣyavīmūrtiracirānmokṣadā bhavet| daivī devatvaphaladā sarvakāmasamṛddhidā|| 16.74 || ārṣī mūrtarmaharṣitva prāptaye bhavati dhruvam| śāpānugrahasāmardhyamapi tasya bhaviṣyati|| 16.75 || mānuṣī mūrtiracurādyaśase mahate bhavet| trailokyaiśvaryasampacca sarvakālaṃ bhaviṣyati|| 16.76 || āsurīṃ mūrtimārādhya rakṣasāṃ ditijanmanām| bhūtādīnāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ ādhipatyaṃ samaśnute|| 16.77 || paiśācamūrtayajane piśācāsurarākṣasāḥ| vaśyā bhavanti sarve ca sarvakāmasamṛddhidāḥ|| 16.78 || iti śrīpāñcarātre mahopaniṣadi pādmasaṃhitāyāṃ kriyāpāde yānārūḍha viśvarūpādilakṣaṇaṃ nāma ṣodaśo'dhyāyaḥ |
<2.17>
śrībhagavān matsyātidaśamūrtināṃ lakṣaṇaṃ kathyate'dhunā| īṣadvaisthūla citrāṇi taistairva ktrairyutāni ca || 17.1 || tatra matsyasya kāyaśca dairghyādvai ṣoḍaśāṅgulam| daśāṅgulaṃ tu vaipulyānmīnākhyaṃ parikalpayet|| 17.2 || śūlaṃ matsyākṛtiṃ kṛtvā śilāmṛtkāṣṭhajaṃ tu vā| ardhacitreṇa vākuryāccitrābhāsena vā punaḥ|| 17.3 || samudraṃtu likhedbhittau padmasyopari kalpayet| pañcāyudhān likhedbhittau chatrādīnparikalpayet|| 17.4 || nāradenāpi manunā samabhyarcitamādarāt| karmārcādīni biṃbāni saumyavaktrāścaturbhujāḥ|| 17.5 || āsīvā vā sthitā vāpi śaṃkhacakragadādharāḥ| kūrmavatkūrma mūrtiṃ tu kalpayetkamalāsana|| 17.6 || tapanīyanibhaṃ kūrmaṃ vistāraṃ dvādaśāṅgulam| śilāmṛtkāṣṭhajaṃ padmapīṭhe saṃsthāpayetprabhum|| 17.7 || ābhāse vārdhacitre vā kṣīrodamathanaṃ likhet| kacchapendrasya pṛṣṭho tu mandaraṃ parvato tamam|| 17.8 || tasya dakṣiṇapārśve tu vāsudevaṃ sanātanam| mandarasya gireragre nyastahastaṃ jagadgurum|| 17.9 || vāmapārśva girestasya brahmāṇaṃ saha śaṅkaram| vāsu keḥ pūrvabhāgaṃ tu gṛhṇantya surarākṣasāḥ|| 17.10 || pucchabhāgaṃ tu gṛhṇanti vākerdevatāgaṇāḥ| karmārcādīni bimbāni saumyavaktrāścaturbhujāḥ|| 17.11 || viṣṇormahāvarāhasya nirmāṇamadhunocyate| naravatkaṇṭhaparyantaṃ vaktrasṛṣṭhirvarāhavat|| 17.12 || caturbhujaṃ śaṅkhacakradhāriṇaṃ sphaṭikaprabham| pītavastraṃ mukuṭinaṃ śyāmalākṛtimeva vā|| 17.13 || satiryaksaṃsthitaṃ sūtre daivike sthāpayetpade| śayanaṃ yānakaṃ caiva varāhasya tu neṣyate|| 17.14 || sthāpayedekaberaṃ tu śaṅkacakragadādhāram| āsane'pi tathā rūpaṃ brahmasthāne ṛjurbhavet|| 17.15 || divye tu sthānake caiva ṛjvaṅgaṃ naiva kārayet| uddhṛtya dharaṇīṃ devīṃ vāvahastasya kūrpare|| 17.16 || kaṭipradeśamālambya pāṇinā dakṣiṇena tu| jighran devyāḥ stanaṃ devaśśrīvatsāṅkaḥ kirīṭavān|| 17.17 || kṛtāñjalipuṭā devī śyāmavarṇā sumadhyamā| kalpanīyā mahī devī deve tiṣṭhati padmaja|| 17.18 || āsīne tu tathāsīnā puṣpahastā vasundharā| vāme pārśve pratiṣṭhāpyā varāhavapuṣo hareḥ|| 17.19 || āropitavyā devasya vāmotsaṅge vasundharā| āliṅgitā ca hastena vāmena prekṣitānanā|| 17.20 || karmārcanādipratimā āsīnā vā sthitāpi vā| devyā saha kroḍavaktrā saumyavaktrā caturbhujā|| 17.21 || nṛsiṃhāmūrtirbahudhā tatra kācitpra darśyate| vaktaṃ kesariṇo vaktraṃ vyāttāsyaṃ daṃṣṭrayā yutam|| 17.22 || bhrukuṭīkuṭilaṃ bhīmaṃ triṇetraṃ mukuṭojjvalam| aṅgāntaraṃ narasyeva caturbhujamudā yudham|| 17.23 || raktakañcukasaṃyuktaṃ śrīvatsāṅkavirājitam| śuddhasphaṭikasaṃkāśaṃ śaṅkhacakravirājitam|| 17.24 || paryaṅkabandasaṃyuktamāsīnaṃ samyagāsane| prasārya jānunorhastau mukhyau vistāritāṅgulī|| 17.25 || dambholibhīmanakhinau bhāge divye pratiṣṭitam|| ekabheravidhānaṃ cedāsīno vā sthito'pi vā|| 17.26 || śaṅkhacakragadāpāṇiḥ sthita ścetkamalāsana| athavā daivike bhāge siṃhaviṣṭaraviṣṭhitam|| 17.27 || śrībhīmibhyāṃ sahāsīnāṃ baddhaparyaṅkabandanam| yadvā bhūmitale pādamekaṃ saṃsthāpyadakṣiṇam|| 17.28 || apareṇa sukhāsīno viṣṭare vipule dṛḍham| yadvā prasārya jānūrdhvamutkṣipyopari jānunaḥ|| 17.29 || vāhastaṃ prasāryānyahastaṃ kṛtvā'bhayapradam| dakṣiṇaṃ jānuno'dhastāt sthāpayitvā tathāsane|| 17.30 || śrībhūmisahito divye tirṣṭhabhāge yathāpuram| yadvāṣṭabhūjasaṃyuktaṃ nṛsiṃhaṃ parikalpayet|| 17.31 || cakraṃ khaḍgaṃ ca bāṇaṃ ca abhayaṃ dakṣiṇe bhuje| pāñcajanyaṃ gadāṃ śārṅgaṃ vāma bāhṛṣu kārayet|| 17.32 || jānūpari tathā vāmaṃ hastamekaṃ prasārayet| yadvā bhujayugaṃ jānudvayasyopari kalpayet|| 17.33 || athavā soḍaśabhujo narasiṃhaḥ praśasyate| cakraṃ khaḍgaṃ saparaśuraṃ śūlaṃ bāṇaṃ tathāṅkuśam|| 17.34 || vajraṃ ca dakṣiṇabhujapradeśeṣvitapeṣvapi| śaṅkhaṃ carma gadāṃ śaktiṃ śārṅgaṃ pāśaṃ ca tomaram|| 17.35 || śiṣṭau karau yathāpūrvaṃ sthāpayejjānunordvayoḥ| vāma jānūrdhvakaṃ kuryādadhastāditaraṃ punaḥ|| 17.36 || utsaṅge devadevasya hiraṇyakaśipuṃ ripum| nakhairvidāritoraskaṃ sravadrudhira paṅkilam || 17.37 || rudhirastomasaṃbhūta sirāṇāṃ grāmasaṅkulam| kuryācca dakṣiṇe pārśve vidhimanyatra śaṅkaram|| 17.38 || prahlādaṃ garuḍaṃ cāpi pārśvayo statra kārayet| svatantre narasiṃhe tu karmabimbāni kārayet|| 17.39 || caturbhujaṃ vā sarvatra cāsīnāṃ susthitaṃ tu vā| śrībhūmisahitaṃ vāpi rahitaṃ vāpi kārayet|| 17.40 || karmārcanādipratimāṃ saumyavaktrāṃ caturbhijāṃ| vāmanasya harermūrtaṃ bahudhā saṃpracakṣate|| 17.41 || vāmanaṃ vāmanākāraṃ śyāmalaṃ daṇḍadhāriṇam| dvibhujaṃ mekhalādāmaśobhitaṃ śobhanākṛtim|| 17.42 || kaupīnācchādanadharaṃ mṛgājinadharaṃ vibhum| yajñopavītinaṃ kākapakṣa saṃyutakuntalam|| 17.43 || īṣatkuñcitasavyāṅghriṃ dakṣiṇena ṛju sthitam| dakṣiṇena tu hastena yācamānaṃ vastundharām|| 17.44 || śobhitaṃ śobhanākāraṃ sthitaṃ vā śayanāsanam| athavā garuḍārūḍhaṃ kalpayetkamalāsana|| 17.45 || ekaberavidhānaṃ cet sthāpayedbrahmaṇaḥ pade| bahuberavidhānaṃ tu trailokyākramaṇodyatam|| 17.46 || viṣṇuṃ prakalpayeddivye bhāge'ṣṭabhujasaṃyutam | caturbhujaṃ vā bahubhirbāhubhirvā samanvitam|| 17.47 || tasya dakṣiṇapārśve tu vāmanaṃ vāmanākṛtim| tasyāpasavye dai tyendraṃ baliṃ karakadhāriṇam|| 17.48 || bhuvanatrayadātāraṃ sabhāryaṃ sapurohitam| vāmapārśve tu pakṣīndraṃ muṣṭinā śukraghātinam|| 17.49 || vāmabhittau vidhātāra mupariṣṭādavasthitam| kramamāṇasya devasya savyāṅghrikṣālanodyatam|| 17.50 || pādodakasamudbhūtāṃ gaṅgāmākāśagāminīm| tarjanyā vāmayā cāpi nirdiśantaṃ samuddhṛtam|| 17.51 || caraṇaṃ savyamatyuccaiśśyāmalaṃ pītavāsanam| śaṅkhacakragadā khaḍgadhanuḥ pāśādidhāriṇam|| 17.52 || jāmbavantaṃ ca bhittau tu bherītāḍanatatparam| devarṣigaṇasaṅghātān kṛtāñjalipuṭān sthitān|| 17.53 || bhittau kṛtvātataḥ karmādyarcāṃ caiva caturbhujām| kuryādbhārgavarāmasya nirmāṇamadhunocyate| āsīnaṃ dvibhūjaṃ śāntaṃ jaṭāmukuṭadhāriṇam|| 17.54 || paraśuṃ saśaraṃ cāpaṃ dakṣiṇetarahastayoḥ| dhārayantaṃ suvarṇābhaṃ brāhmyā lakṣmyā virājitam|| 17.55 || śrīvatsenāṅkitoraskaṃ sopavīto ttarīyakam| sthitaṃ vā kalpayeddevamekaberaṃ vidheḥ pade|| 17.56 || bahubere pade divye devīṃ vāme prakalpayet| caturbhujā ca kamārcā jāmadagnyena vāsamā|| 17.57 || bhaṅgatrayasamepetaṃ trayastriṃśatsulakṣaṇam| yadvā caturbhujaṃ kuryājjāmadagnyaṃ caturmukha|| 17.58 || śaṅkhacakradharaṃ śārṅgaśarahastaṃ yathāpuram| rāmasya rāghavasyātha lakṣaṇaṃ vakṣyate'dhunā|| 17.59 || tribhaṅgaṃ dvibhujaṃ ramya śyāmavarṇaṃ kirīṭinam| śrīvatsāṅkaṃ prasannābhaṃ yadvā rāmaṃ caturbhujam|| 17.60 || ṛju sthitaṃ dakṣiṇena caraṇenetareṇa tu| kuñcitenāṅghriṇā stokaṃ śaraśārṅgadhanurdharam|| 17.61 || uddharecca lalāṭāntaṃ vāmahastaṃ dhanurdharam| antarālaṃ mukhamitaṃ śarahastaṃ tu dakṣiṇam|| 17.62 || kaṭisūtrasamaṃ kuryāsmukhamānaṃ sagolakam| antarālaṃ bhavesmuṣṭeḥ kaṭisūtrasya ca dvayoḥ|| 17.63 || aparābhyāṃ ca hastābhyāṃ śaṅkhaṃ cakraṃ ca dhārayet| mukhaṃ dakṣiṇato bhaṅgaṃ madhyakāyaṃ tu vāmataḥ|| 17.64 || kaṭyāṃ dakṣiṇato bhaṅgaḥ kiñcidbhaṅgatrayaṃ matam| kambugrīvaṃ mahūraskaṃ trayastriṃśatsulakṣaṇam|| 17.65 || pañcadīrghaṃ caturhrasvaṃ pañcasūkṣmaṃ ṣaḍunnatam| saptaraktaṃ trigambhīraṃ trivistīrṇaṃ praśasyate|| 17.66 || bāhū netrāntaraṃ caiva hanurnāsā tathaiva ca| stanayorantaraṃ caiva paṃcadīrghaṃ praśasyate|| 17.67 || grīvā prajananaṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ hrasve jaṅgha ca pūjyate| sūkṣmāṇyaṅguliparvāṇi keśadantanakhatvacaḥ|| 17.68 || imāni paṃca sūkṣmāṇi kathitāni mayā'nagha| kakṣaḥ kūkṣiśca vakṣaśca ghrūṇaṃ skandho lalāṭikā|| 17.69 || ṣaḍunnatamidaṃ proktaṃ saptaraktamataḥ śṛṇu| pāṇipādatalaṃ raktaṃ netrādyantaṃ nakhāni ca|| 17.70 || tālujihvā'dhareṣṭhaṃ ca saptaraktā ime smṛtāḥ| svarassatvaṃ ca nābhiśca trigambhīraṃ praśasyate|| 17.71 || uraśśiro lalāṭaśca trivisthiṇaṃ prakīrtatam| evaṃ lakṣaṇasaṃyuktaṃ sarvalokasukhāvaham|| 17.72 || kuryāddhāśarathiṃ rāmaṃ mānāditrayasaṃyutam| lakṣmaṇaṃ kārayodvāme tathā lakṣaṇalakṣitam|| 17.73 || jānakīṃ dakṣiṇe pārśve devīṃ vedisamusthitām| bharataṃ dakṣiṇe bhittau sasugrīvavibhīṣaṇ|| 17.74 || śatrughnaṃ cāṅgadaṃ caiva hanūmantaṃ ca vāmataḥ| divye bhāge sthitasyeva parivārādikalpanam|| 17.75 || bhadrāsane samāsīnaṃ tyaktvā tatsaśaraṃ dhanuḥ| abhayo dakṣiṇo hasto vāmastu varado bhavet|| 17.76 || jānakī tu sūkhāsīnā bhaveddakṣiṇapārśvataḥ| lakṣmaṇo vāmapārśve tu sthitaśca racitāñjaliḥ|| 17.77 || yadvā mahārhaśayane śayānaṃ parikalpayet| pṛṣṭhato maulipārśva tu jānakī syātsukhāsanā|| 17.78 || kuḍyasthāḥ pūrvavatsarve kartavyā
