lakṣmaṇādayaḥ| pavanātmajamārūḍho yānaṃ vā saśarāsanaḥ|| 17.79 || ekaberavidhāne tu rāghavo brahmaṇaḥ pade| śaracāpadharaṃ kuryāt sthitaṃ lakṣaṇalakṣitam|| 17.80 || athavā'bhayadaṃ hastaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ dakṣiṇetaram| kaṭispṛśaṃ karaṃ kuryādvaradaṃ vā yathāruci|| 17.81 || dakṣiṇottarayorbhittyauḥ parivārā yathāpuram| rāmasya bhrūpradeśāntaṃ bharataṃ parikalpayet|| 17.82 || lakṣmaṇaṃ ca kapolāntaṃ cubukāntamathāpi vā| śatrughnaṃ kaṇṭhamadhyāntaṃ sarve cāpaśarānvitāḥ|| 17.83 || bhaṅgādayaśca tadvatsyuḥ keśa bandhasanvitāḥ| mukhadviguṇā yāmamadhyardhaṃ vā samunnatam|| 17.84 || keśabandho bhavedeṣāṃ śrīvatsarahitā stathā| vāmaṃ yaṣṭidharaṃ hastaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ bharatasya vā|| 17.85 || vāmaṃ devyā bhuje nyastaṃ svātantye parikalpayet| śatrughno lakṣmaṇaśchāpi svātanyrai bharato yathā|| 17.86 || bharataśśyāmalākāro lakṣmaṇaḥ kanakaprabhaḥ| śatrughno raktavarṇābhaśśrīmallakṣaṇasaṃyutaḥ|| 17.87 || māṇḍavī bharatasya syādūrmilā lakṣmaṇasya tu| śrutakirtirbhaveddhevī śatrughnasyāmbujāsana|| 17.88 || sītā śrīriva kartavyā kalyāṇabahulakṣaṇā| karaṇḍikāmaulidharā kabarīvālakai ryutā|| 17.89 || bibhrāṇā vāmahastena narasīruhakuṭmalam| ūrupradeśaviśrāntavāmetarabhujā'thavā|| 17.90 || ūrupradeśaviśrāntasavyahastasaroruha| savyeta reṇa bibrāṇā raktakañcukabandhanā|| 17.91 || hiraṇyavarṇā sītā syānmāṇḍavī pāṭalaprabhā| ūrmilā śyāmavarṇābhā śrutakīrtassitaprabhā|| 17.92 || dhammillasaṃyutā devyo bharatādeścaturmukha| hanūmānvāranākāraḥ kartavyo hevasannibhaḥ|| 17.93 || kuñcitāgramahāvālaṃ prahvakāyamavasthitam| āsyaṃ pidhāya hastena dakṣiṇenetareṇa tu|| 17.94 || vastrapradeśamācchādya vinītapadavasthitam| keśabandhayutaṃ kuryāducchrāyastasya vakṣyate|| 17.95 || rāmasya bāhuparyānta munmānaṃ tyraṃśameva vā| ardhaṃ vā pādamathavā yathāvibhavamunnatiḥ|| 17.96 || sugrīvaṃ vānarākāraṃ rāmabāhusamucchrayam| prāñjaliṃ vetrasahitaṃ sthitaṃ mukuṭadhāriṇam|| 17.97 || hārādibhūṣaṇai ryuktaṃ kuryātkanakapiṅgalam| aṅgadaṃ vānarākāraṃ rāmamānārdhamunnatam|| 17.98 || kṛtāñjalipuṭaṃ vetrakṣurikāmaulidhāriṇam| keśabandhayutaṃ vāpi bandhujīvasamadyutim|| 17.99 || vibhīṣaṇaṃ mahākāyaṃ ghoraṃ kālāyasaprabhaṃ| daṃṣṭrākarālavadanaṃ bhrukuṭīkuṭilekṣaṇam|| 17.100 || raktākṣaṃ mukuṭopetaṃ kṛtāñjalipuṭaṃ sthitam| rāmasya bāhuparyantaṃ samucchrāyaṃ prakalpayet|| 17.101 || kṛtāṃjalipuṭaṃ saumyaṃ niṣādādhipatiṃ guham| nīla nīrada saṅkāśaṃ rāmamānārdhamunnatam|| 17.102 || svātantyraṃ pāratantyraṃ ca raghavasyobhayaṃ bhavet| divye bhāge'thavā brāhme garbhagehe sthito yadi|| 17.103 || svatantro rāghavaḥ proktaḥ pade pūrvodite yadi| caturbhujo garbagehe kalpitaḥ kamalāsana|| 17.104 || paścādvimānaśobhārthaṃ kalpitaḥ paravānayam| svatantre rāghave bhimbhān karmādyarthaṃ prakalpayet|| 17.105 || anyāṃstatsadṛśaṃ rāmaṃ lakṣmaṇaṃ janakatmajām| siṃhāsane sahaikasmin prabhayā ca pariṣkṛtān|| 17.108 || yadvā caturbhujānkuryā tkarmādyarcāṃ caturmu| dauvārikāṃśca svātanyrai kalpayeddvārapārśvayoḥ|| 17.109 || nalaṃ ca dakṣiṇe pārśve jāmbavantaṃ tathottare| jāmbavān svarṇavarṇābho nalaśśuklasamaprabhaḥ|| 17.110 || kṣurikāvetrahastau ca baddhanalyāṇakañcukau| nīlaṃ senāpatiṃ kṛtvā viṣvaksenapade nyaset|| 17.120 || guho vā tatra saṃsthāpyo viṣvakseno'thavā svayam| rāmasya purataḥ kalpyaḥ mārutirmukhamaṇḍape|| 17.121 || garuḍo vā yathāpūrvaṃ parivārān prakalpayet| rāmasya balabhadrasya lakṣaṇaṃ vakṣyate'dhunā|| 17.122 || dvibhujaṃ dhavalaṃ divye bhāge'tha parikalpayet| musalaṃ lāṅgalaṃ caiva prasavyetarahastayoḥ|| 17.123 || bibhrāṇamathavā nyastavāmahastaṃ kaṭisthale| dakṣiṇābhayadaṃ yadvā caturbhujamudāyudham|| 17.124 || halaṃ ca dakṣiṇe haste vāme ca musalāyudham| dhārayantaṃ vibhuṃ nilavasanaṃ śaṅkhacakriṇam|| 17.125 || kirīṭinaṃ baddhakeśamathavā vāmapārśvataḥ| revatīṃ kalpayeddevīṃ dakṣiṇe vā yathāruci|| 17.126 || karaṇḍikāmakuṭinīmathavā kabarīdharām| asitāṃ pāratantrya ca svātantrya ca yathāpuram|| 17.127 || iti śrīpāñcarātre mahopaniṣadi pādmasaṃhitāyāṃ kriyāpāde matsyādimurti lakṣaṇaṃ nāma saptadaśodhyāyaḥ |
<2.18>
śrībhagavān yādavasyātha kṛṣṇasya nirmāṇamadhunocyate| kalyāṇalakṣaṇayutaṃ tribhaṅgaṃ siṃhaviṣṭare|| 18.1 || tiṣṭhantaṃ rukmiṇītasyabhāmābhyāṃ sahitaṃ prabhum| īṣatkuñcitavāmāṅghriṃ susthitetaramadbhutam|| 18.2 || meghaśyāmaṃ viśālākṣaṃ pītavastraṃ caturbhujam| devīsavyabhujanyastavāmahastasaroruham|| 18.3 || adhomukhaṃ tu hastāgraṃ nābhisūtrasamanvitam| vāmetarakaraspṛṣṭakrīḍāyaṣṭimanoharam|| 18.4 || tatkaraṃ kaṭisūtrānta mudaste tu karadvayam| śaṅkhacakradharaṃ kuryāddvibhujaṃ vā yathoditam|| 18.5 || śrīvatsāṅkaṃ prasannābhaṃ vareṇyaṃ mukuṭojvalam| baddhālakabharaṃ vāpi bhāge divye prakalpayet|| 18.6 || rukmiṇīṃ dakṣiṇe pārśve satyabhāmāmathottare| vinatānandanaṃ vāpi satyāsthāne prakalpayet|| 18.7 || āsīnaṃ vā sukhaṃ sārdhaṃ devībhyāṃ saha viṣṭare| vāhastena varadaṃ dakṣiṇenābhayapradam|| 18.8 || yadvā śayīta nṛpavatparyaṅke śobhite bhṛśam| bhogīndraśayane vāpi mahāparyaṅkamaṇḍite|| 18.9 || pṛṣṭhato maulipārśva tu rukmiṇīṃ kārayetsudhīḥ| satyabhāmā bhavetpādasaṃvāhanasamudyatā|| 18.10 || saṃvahayaṃtyau vā devyau hastābhyāṃ pādapaṅkajam| tārkṣyārūḍhaṃ caturbāhuṃ bibhrāṇaṃ śarakārmukam|| 18.11 || mukhyābhyāmaparābhyāṃ ca śaṅkhaṃ cakraṃ caturmukha| āropya satyabhāmāṃ vā vāmotsaṅge caturbhujam|| 18.12 || āruhya yāntaṃ pakṣīndraṃ dvibhujaṃ vā yathāruci| yadvā'rjunasya sārathyaṃ kurvāṇaṃ parikalpayet|| 18.13 || rathasthitaṃ caturbāhuṃ pratodapragrahau dadhat| vāmahastena mukhyena dakṣiṇena kareṇa tu|| 18.14 || kapidhvajāya prahvāya paravidyāmudīrayan| aparābhyāṃ ca hastābhyāṃ śaṅkhacakradharaṃ prabhum|| 18.15 || kirīṭinaṃ viśālākṣaṃ śrīvatsāṅkitavakṣanam| dvibhujaṃ baddhakeśaṃ vā kuryātkamalasambhava|| 18.16 || pārthaṃ ca prāṃjaliṃ prahvaṃ seṣuṃ seṣudhikārmukam| kirīṭinaṃ śyāmavarṇaṃ kalpayetsyandhanasthitam|| 18.17 || viśvarūpaṃ tu vā kuryātkeśavaṃ keśisūdanam| bṛndāvanagataṃ kṛṣṇaṃ gavāmanucaraṃ prabhum|| 18.18 || īṣatkuñcitavāmāṅghrimitareṇa ṛju sthitam| gacchantamapi gāyantaṃ vaṃśena paramādbhutam|| 18.19 || īkṣamāṇaṃ manāksavye pārśve puṣpāvataṃsitam| vicitrapuṣpagrathitavanamālāvibhūṣitam|| 18.20 || barhibarhaiśca rucirairvatsadāmavibhūṣaṇaiḥ| bhūṣitaṃ devagandharvasiddhacāraṇasevitam|| 18.21 || kadambamūle vā madhyaṃdine kṛtvā pratiṣṭhitam| vyatyāsena sthitaṃ padbhyāṃ vāmena ṛjunā sthitam|| 18.22 || dakṣiṇaprapade nānyapṛṣṭhabhāgaspṛśā sthitam| gobhissavatsairhariṇaiḥ pakṣibhiśca samāvṛtam|| 18.23 || ṛṣibhirdevagandharvaiḥ kinnarādyaiśca sevitam| phaṇīndraṃ kāliyaṃ yadvā phaṇāpañcakasaṃyutam|| 18.24 || purataḥ paruṣākāraṃ nāgākāraṃ ca pṛṣṭhataḥ| kṛtāñjaliṃ durādharṣamākramya śirasi sthitam|| 18.25 || vāmapādena gṛhṇantaṃ pucchaṃ vāmena pāṇinā| dakṣiṇābhayadaṃ hastaṃ nṛtyantaṃ kārayedbudhaḥ|| 18.26 || athavā kṛtatāṭaṃkaṃ kurvāṇaṃ nāṭyamadbhutam| mahiṣītaṃ nāgarājasya bhikṣamāṇāṃ svakaṃ patim|| 18.27 || kṛtāñjalipuṭāṃ devīṃ tatpārśve vepitāṃ sthitām| rāsamaṇḍalamadhyasthaṃ yadvākuryājjagadgurum|| 18.28 || devyorgṛhītvā hastābhyāṃ karāgraṃ madhyataḥ sthitam| nṛtyantaṃ bahusāhapragopakanyābhirāvṛtam|| 18.29 || navanītāya nṛtyantaṃ sarvena ṛjunā sthitam| uddhṛtya dakṣiṇaṃ pādaṃ viparītamathāpi vā|| 18.30 || kārayedvāmahastaṃ tu cubukāntasamucchrayam| abhītidaṃ dakṣiṇena varadaṃ vā yathāruci|| 18.31 || madhyataḥ stananābhyoścha varado hasta iṣyate| yādavendreṇa kṛṣṇena kriḍayā yadyathāśritam|| 18.32 || kalpayitvā vapuntattadārādhyāṃ vibhavārthibhiḥ| ekaberavibhānāṃ cet sthāpayedbrahmaṇaḥ pade|| 18.33 || karmārcādīni bimbāni kalpayedraghuvīravat| rukmiṇīsyabhāmābhyāṃ saha pīṭhe prakalpayet|| 18.34 || rukmiṇī kanakaprakhyā satyā'nyā śyāmalā bhavet| karaṇḍikāmakuṭinī yadvā dhammilladhāriṇī|| 18.35 || satyabhāmā kare padmaṃ dhārayeddakṣiṇe param| ūrau viśrāmayedanyaṃ dhārayedanyathā'thavā|| 18.36 || yathoktataravinyāsakalpanaṃ kamalāsana| bālye'pi yā yā devī syātyā sā kalpyā yathāvidhi|| 18.37 || nirmāṇamadhunā vakṣye kalki viṣṇormahātmanaḥ| piṅgaśmaśruṃ vivṛttākṣaṃ raktābhaṃ hayavahanam|| 18.38 || dvibhujaṃ carmavasanaṃ khaḍgakheṭakadhāriṇam| jaṭāmukuṭasaṃyuktaṃ brahmalakṣmyā virājitam|| 18.39 || paiśāce yānakaṃ kuryāddivye bhāge sthitirbhavet| yadvā caturbhujaṃ kuryānmukhyābhyāṃ khaḍgakheṭakau|| 18.40 || aparābhyāṃ śaṅkhacakraṃ hastābhyāṃ dadhataṃ harim| āsane kheṭakaṃ khaḍgaṃ na kurvīta kadācana|| 18.41 || abhayaṃ varadaṃ caiva karayugmaṃ prakalpayet| śayanaṃ neṣyate tanya kalpiviṣṇo rmahātmanaḥ|| 18.42 || ekaberavidhānaṃ cetkalpayedbrahmaṇaḥ pade| āsīnāṃ sthānakaṃ caiva bhāge divye prakalpayet|| 18.43 || tasya dakṣiṇapārśve tu yājñavalkyaṃ purohitam| nāradaṃ dakṣiṇe pārśve bhittibhūmiṣu devatāḥ|| 18.44 || kalpayejjaṅgamān bimbān dvijānvā caturbhujān| abhayaṃ varadaṃ caiva dvau bhūjau parikalpayet|| 18.45 || caturbhuje śaṅkhacakre dvayoraparayorbhavet| śrīvatsevāṅkitoraskān jaṭāmukuṭasaṃyutān|| 18.46 || kirīṭino vā kurvīta karmabimbāṃśca lohajān| viṣṇoraṃśāvatārāṇāṃ kamān rcādyāstu kautukāḥ|| 18.47 || kalpanīyāścaturhastāḥ dvibhujā vā yathāruci| daśatālena mīyantevarāhādyāścamūrtayaḥ|| 18.48 || bāhyāṃścābhyantarāṃścaiva parivārān prakalpayet| ādimūrteryathā tadvat na viśeṣostikaścana|| 18.49 || lakṣmīnārāyaṇaṃ kuryādbhujāṣṭakasamanvitam| yadvā caturbhujaṃ śaṅkhacakrādyāyudhabhūṣitam|| 18.50 || vāmabhāge tu hastābhyāṃ varadaṃ paṅkajaṃ tu vā| itarābhyāṃ ca hastābhyāmabhayaṃ cakrameva vā|| 18.51 || vapuṣo dakṣiṇe bhāge viṣṇurvāme saroruhā | pīnastanataṭo vāmaśśrī vatsāṅkastathetaraḥ|| 18.52 || vāmo hemanibhaśśyāmo dakṣiṇo bhāga iṣyate| āsīnaṃ vā śayānaṃ vā garuḍārūḍhameva vā|| 18.53 || sthitaṃ vā kalpayeddhevaṃ yajñamūrtimataśśṛṇu| tiśīrṣaṃ ca tripādaṃ ca catuśśṛṅgaṃ caturmukha|| 18.54 || saptahastaṃ japā tulyaṃ vanamālāvibhūṣitam| abhītido mukhyahasto dakṣiṇo'nyo varapradaḥ|| 18.55 || pañcautarakarāśca sruksruvādyāyudhabhūṣitāḥ| ekamūrtirvāsudve lakṣmīnārāyaṇaḥ paraḥ|| 18.56 || tau dvimūrtistrimūrtistu satyaścācyutapūruṣau| caturmurtirvāsudevo bhavetsaṅkarṣaṇa stathā|| 18.57 || pradyumnaścāniruddhaśca pañcamūrtimataśśṛṇu| satyācyutau tathānantaḥ vāsudevaśca pūruṣaḥ|| 18.58 || ṣaṇmūrtirannādhipatiśśaktīśaḥ kālanemijit| trailokyamohano yajñavarāhā śceti paṃcamaḥ|| 18.59 || śaṅkhodaro nṛsiṃhaśca saptamūrtirathocyate| catasro vāsudevādi mūrtayaḥ pūrvamīritāḥ|| 18.60 || pūṣādayastathā tisrassaptamūrtirudāhṛtā| hayagrīvo mukundaśca babhruścaiva vṛṣākapiḥ|| 18.61 || śauriśca dāśārhaścaiva vaikuṇṭhaḥ puruṣastathā| aṣṭamūrtiriti proktonavamūrtarathaucyate|| 18.62 || catasraḥ kathitāḥ pūrvaṃ vāsudevādaya stathā| nārāyaṇo hayagrīvo viṣṇurvṛharisūkarau|| 18.63 || ṣaḍanneśādayaḥ proktāḥ vāsudevādimūrtayaḥ| catasro daśamūrtissyādādimūrtirimā daśaḥ|| 18.64 || syādekādaśamūrtissyātproktā dvādaśamūrtayaḥ| catasro viṃśatiścaiva mūrtayaḥ pūrvamīnitāḥ|| 18.65 || paṃcamūrti … samudīryate| sthāpayedvāsudevābhyāṃ mūrtiṃ garbhaṃ gṛhe sudhīḥ|| 18.66 || divye bhāgethavā brāhme bahiḥ prāgdiśi pūruṣam| satyamūrtiṃ dakṣiṇasyāṃ pratīcyāmacyutaṃ yathā|| 18.67 || anantākhyamutīcīne calāṃ vā yativā'calām| dhāmne'ntarvāsudevassyāccaturmūrtiṣu pūrvavat|| 18.68 || saṅkarṣaṇaṃ dakṣiṇasyāṃ bahirdiśi niveśayet| pradyumnaṃ ca pratīcīne kauberyāmaniruddhakam|| 18.69 || yāṃ yāṃ diśamadhiṣṭhāya sthitāḥ pūrvo ktamūrtayaḥ| tattaddigābhimukhyena kalpayetkamalāsana|| 18.70 || dvāraṃ vātāyanaṃ vāpi kuryādbhittiṃna kalpayet| śaṅkhacakragadāyuktā mukhyairabhayadā karaiḥ|| 18.71 || iti śrīpāñcarātre mahopaniṣadi pādmasaṃhitāyāṃ kriyāpādo mūrtibeda kathanaṃ nāma aṣṭādaśo'dhyāyaḥ |
<2.19>
śrībhagavān karmārcādiprakṛtiprakāraḥ kathyate'dhunā| karmārcā cotsavārcā ca balyarcā ca tathaiva ca|| 19.1 || snānatīrthobhayārcā ca svāpotthānārcayā saha| pratimāṣṣaḍvidhātavyāḥ pūjāyāmuttamā bhavet|| 19.2 || tisṛbhirmadhyamā jñeyā ādyā yā caramā bhavet| bahubere vidhirayaṃ kathitaḥ kamalasana|| 19.3 || ekabere tu karmārcāsnapanārcā ca neṣyate| dhruvaberasamucchrāye vibhakte daśadā sati|| 19.4 || ekāṃ śena pratikṛteḥ karmārcāyāssamucchrayaḥ| dvādaśāṃ śena yadvā syāt ṣoḍaśāṃ śena vā bhavet|| 19.5 || yadvā'ṣṭādaśabhāgena caturviṃśāṃśameva vā| mahāberāṅgulāpekṣyā yadvā tasyāssamunnatiḥ|| 19.6 || caturviṃśāṅgulā yadvā bhavedaṣṭādaśāṅgulā| ṣoḍaśāṅgulamānā vā yadvā syāddvādaśāṅgulā|| 19.7 || aṣṭāṅgulā'thavā yadvā ṣaḍaṃgulasamucchrayā| caturaṅgulamānā vā yadvāmānāṃgulena tu|| 19.8 || pūrvoktāṃgulamānāni kartavyāni yathāruci| balitīrthapratikṛtiśśayanotthānakautukam|| 19.9 || karmārcāsaṃmitotsedhaḥ kathitaḥ kamalāsana| karmabimbasamutsedhastriguṇaḥ pariśiṣṭayoḥ|| 19.10 || snapanotsavakāryārthaṃ bimbayorubhayorapi| bhaṅktvā tidhā caturdhā vā dhruvaberasamucchrayam|| 10.11 || ekabhāge nalotsedhaṃ kuryādutsavakautuke| utsavārcātṛtīyāṃśaṃ turyāṃśaṃ vāmbujāsana|| 10.12 || karmakautukamānaṃ syādbahvarcā derayaṃ kramaḥ| ekabere tadardhā tu tattu ryāṃśakameva vā|| 10.13 || utsavārcātṛtīryāṃśasamutsedhau'thavā bhavet| sthānayānāsanavidhau dhruvabimbaṃ yathākṛtam|| 19.14 || karmārcādīni tadvatsyāt dhruve tu śayite punaḥ| tiṣṭhedvāsīta vā kāmaṃ karmādyarcā caturmukha|| 19.15 || arcāyāmaṃ tridhā kṛtvā padmemekena kalpayet|| 19.16 || upānahādipañcāṅgayuktaṃ vṛttaṃ sukhāvaham| caturaśraṃ manohāri vistāratulitāyati|| 19.17 || tṛtīyabhāgavihitaprabhaśaṅkudvayāṅkitam| pīṭhotsedhaṃ tidhā kṛtvā padmame kena kalpayet|| 19.18 || talairdvādaśabhiryuktamaṣṭābhivān yathāruci| tāvadūrdhvadalopetaṃ madhye vipulakarṇikam|| 19.19 || upacchadasamāyuktimīṣatphāmbhujākṛti| pādamānaṃ dalāyāmaṃ kevalaṃ vā saroruham|| 19.20 || pīṭhaṃ vā kevalaṃ vāpi suṣiraṃ naivakārayet| sthitasya kautukasyedaṃ pīṭhanirmāṇamīritam|| 19.21 || āsīnasyāyataṃ vṛttaṃ caturaśraṃ yadāyatam| pratimārdhasamutsedhaṃ tattratīyāṃśameva vā|| 19.22 || padmaṃ bahudalopetaṃ madhye vipulakarṇikam| sakuñcitaprasavyāṅghriradhastāllambitetaraḥ|| 19.23 || adhyāsītāsanaṃ devo yathoktaṃ kamalāsana| lambamānapadādhāraṃ kamalaṃ parikalpayet|| 19.24 || śrīrdakṣiṇe dharā vāme devyau devasya kalpayet| karmādibhimbaṣaṭkaṃ syācchrībhūmisahitaṃ sadā|| 19.25 || ekasminviṣṭare syātāṃ vṛthagvā vallabhe ubhe| vāmaṃ sañkṣipya caraṇamitaraṃ lambayedadhaḥ|| 19.26 || śrīrdharā tvavyathā sīnā sthite deve tathā sthitā| vṛttāṃ vṛttāyatāṃ vāpi prabhāṃ bimbānusārataḥ|| 19.27 || kṛryānmanoharāṃ yasmāttejorāśiḥ prabhā matā| dvyaṅgulaṃ kāṇḍamānaṃ syātpuṣpakṣetraṃ tadardhakam|| 19.28 || ardhāṅgulaṃ bhavetkṣetraṃ kāṇḍaṃ tadanupūrvavat | vetraṃ tadanu bhūyo'pi jvālāmāloparisthitā|| 19.29 || ardhāṅgulāntarālāssyurhvālāḥ pañcaśikhāstathā| triśikhā vā yathāyogaṃ dakṣiṇāvartaśobhitāḥ|| 19.30 || yugmā vā syurayugmā vā kāṇḍe kāṇḍe prakalpayet| daśāvatāramūrtīrvā mīnādyāḥ keśavādikāḥ|| 19.31 || prabhāyāḥ pārśvayoḥ pṛṣṭhe śaṅkunālaṃ prakalpayet| bimbe yānādhirūḍhe kartavyā toraṇaprabhā|| 19.32 || antarbahiśca dāḍyārthamāyasaṃ tu niveśayet| bimbaṃ prabhāmāsanaṃ vā lohajaṃ palikalpayet|| 19.33 || dvāvayitvā madhūcchiṣṭaṃ pratimāṃ tena kalpayet| dhānyārāśiṃ vinikṣipya tadūrdhve tilataṇḍulam|| 19.34 || cakrābjaṃ tu likhettasminprāgagrānnikṣipetkuśān| vastraṃ ca nūtalanaṃ tasminvistīrya pratimāṃ kṣipet|| 19.35 || prācīnaśirasaṃ paścājjuhuyādanale guruḥ| puṣpaissamidbhirlājaiśca sarpiṣāṣṭottaraṃ śataṃ|| 19.36 || juhuyānmūlamantreṇa nṛsūktena caruṃ punaḥ| hutvaivaṃ vidhinācāryassragvī kanakabhūṣaṇaḥ|| 19.37 || saṃpātājyena saṃsicyetpratimāṃ tatvapaddhatim| dhyāyettatra śubhe lagne pūjayenmūlavidyayā|| 19.38 || yajamāno guruṃ pūhya bahubhistoṣayoddhanaiḥ| brāhmaṇān viduṣo vittairbahubhiḥ paritoṣayet|| 19.39 || sthipatiḥ pratimāṃ kuryādrathakārābhyanujñayā| mānonmānapramāṇaistāṃ pratimāṃ kārayecchubhām|| 19.40 || mṛdā lepaṃ tataḥ kuryācchilpaśāstrānusārataḥ| suvarṇaṃ rajataṃ tāmraṃ viśuddhaṃ lohamuttamam|| 19.41 || ādhaya dhānya rāśyāṃ tu pūrvavannyāsakalpanam| pūrvavaccaiva juhuyādācāryāścoditakramāt|| 19.42 || drāvayitvā tataśśuddhaṃ lohaṃ nyāyasamārjitam| sthapatiḥ pratimāṃ tena kuryācchāstroktavartmanā|| 19.43 || lohajāṃ pratimāṃ caivaṃ kalpayetparamātmanaḥ| sa yāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ punarāvṛttivarjitam|| 19.44 || pratimāhastapādādivaikalye śāntimācaret| ācāryo danahūmādyaistataśśāntirbhaviṣyati|| 19.45 || samādadhyādavayavān vikalān sthapatiḥ punaḥ| citraṃ cāpyardhacitraṃ ca citrābhāsamiti tridhā|| 19.46 || kautukaṃ tatra dṛśyante yasminnavayavāssphuṭam| sarve samantāccitraṃ tu tadvijñeyaṃ caturmukha|| 19.47 || hastādyavayavā yasminpurobhāge samīkṣitum| śakyaṃ nāparabhāge tu tadardhaṃ citramiṣyate|| 19.48 || rūpitā pratimā yā tu varṇaireva sitādibhiḥ| kuḍyādau citramābhāsaṃ tatkautukamudāhṛtam|| 19.49 || citramutkṛṣṭamityukta mardhaṃ madhyamamucyate| ābhāsamadhamaṃ viddhi mandire vātha veśmani|| 19.50 || sthāpayeddhruvabhimbhārthaṃ pūrvālābhe yathottaram| ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi pratimāmānalakṣaṇam|| 19.51 || e kādidaśaparyantaṃ saṅkhyayopeyuṣāṃ bhidāma| tālānāmuttamādīnāṃ rūpāviṣkṛtipūrvakam|| 19.52 || yatkiñcitpratimāmānaṃ vibhajya daśadā punaḥ| ekaṃ dvādaśadā bhaṅtkra tatraikāṃśo'ṅgulaḥ smṛtaḥ|| 19.53 || aṅgulaṃ cāṣṭadhā kutvā tatraikāṃśo yavaḥ smṛtaḥ| tenai vāṅgulamānena aṅgapratyaṅgakalpanā|| 19.54 || dvādaśāṅgulakaṃ mānaṃ tālākhyamiha kathyate| dvādaśāṅgulakastālo mukhyaśceti pratīrtitaḥ|| 19.55 || dvyaṅgulaṃ golakaṃ jñeyaṃ kaleti vyapadiśyate| ekāṅgulaṃ bhavenmātrā bhāgo mātrācatuṣṭayam|| 19.56 || uttamādhamamadhyāni tālāni kamalāsana| ekādidaśaparyantaṃ saṅkhyayā cchedayanti ca || 19.57 || mīyate daśatālena vāsudevassanātanaḥ| savārdhatālau brahmeśau navatālena devatāḥ|| 19.58 || aṣṭārdhatālau dvārasthāḥ kumudādigaṇāstathā| āṣṭatālāṃśca manujān piśācādīṃśca saptakān|| 19.59 || ṣaṭtālān kubjakān viddhi paṃcatālāṃstu vāmanān| catustālāni bhūtāni titālāḥ kinnarāstathā|| 19.60 || matsyā dvitālakā jñeyāstālenai kena pannagāḥ| daśatālaṃ caturviṃśadaṅgulīnāṃ śataṃ bhavet|| 19.61 || uttamaṃ madhyamaṃ viṃśatkaniṣṭhaṃ ṣoḍaśa smṛtam| navatālaṃ tu tacchreṣṭhaṃ yacchataṃ dvādaśādhikam|| 19.62 || aṣṭādhikaṃ śataṃ madhyaṃ kanīyaścaturuttamam| aṣṭatālāṃ śataṃ śreṣṭhaṃ madhyamaṃ ṣaṇṇavatyapi|| 19.63 || caturthahīnamadhamamaṣṭatālaṃ prakīrtitam| uttamādikramo'nyeṣu saptatālādiṣūhyate|| 19.64 || catuścaturvihīnāṃ cetkramādaṅgulibhirbhavet| pūrvaṃ pūrvaṃ yathoktaṃ tattraividhyamavagamyatām|| 19.65 || trayodaśārdhāṅgulikaṃ daśatālottame mukham| ardhenāṅgulinā pīnaṃ madhyamaṃ saṃpracakṣate|| 19.66 || ardhenāṅgulinā hīnamekaikamitareṣvapi| dhruvāyāmuttamaṃ tālamarcāyāṃ madhyamaṃ bhavet|| 19.67 || adhamaṃ parivārāṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ kamalāsana| iti śrīpāñcarātre mahopaniṣadi pādmasaṃhitāyāṃ kriyāpāde lohajapratimā niryāṇa tālavibhāgo nāma ekonaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ |
<2.20>
śrībhagavān ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi pratimāmānamuttamam| mānaṃ pramāṇamunmānaṃ iti mānaṃ tridhā bhāvet|| 20.1 || mānamutsedhamānaṃ syādunmānaṃ nahanaṃ matam| mānaṃ ca tiryagūrdhvaṃ yattatpramāṇamihocyate|| 20.2 || tatra pratikṛtestāvattadaṅgānāṃ kathyate| utsedhamānaṃ mūrdhādi pādāntamanupūrvaśaḥ|| 20.3 || laddhānāṃ dehatastāvadaṅgulīnāṃ śatena tu| caturviṃśatimānena pratimāṃ parikalpayet|| 20.4 || uṣṇīṣamaṅgulamitaṃ keśāntaṃ tryaṅgulaṃ matam| dṛksūtrāntaṃ tadārabhyaṣaṭtriṃśadyavasammitam|| 20.5 || tadvannāsāpuṭāntaṃ syāttadvacca cibukāvadhi| tena keśāntamārabhya mukhamānaṃ caturmukha|| 20.6 || aṣṭottaraṃ yavaśataṃ cibukāvayavāvadhi| galamardhāṅgulaṃ sārdhaṃ tryaṃgulaṃ kaṇṭhamiṣyate|| 20.7 || hikkāsūtraṃ samārabhya hṛdayāntaṃ mukhe sthitam| tataḥ prabhṛti nābhyantaṃ sārdhaṃ satridaśāṅgulam|| 20.8 || tataḥ prabhṛti meḍhrāntaṃ tadvadutsedhamiṣyate| tanmūlājjānuparyantaṃ trinyūnaṃ tridaśāṃgulam|| 20.9 || caturaṅgulamutsedhaṃ jānumaṇḍalamiṣyate| akṣāntaṃ jānuno'dhantādūrutulyamitīritam|| 20.10 || tatastālāntamutsedhaṃ caturaṃgulasaṃmitam| dehāṅgulāni yāvanti daśa tāle'bhipūjite|| 20.11 || vibhajya tāvantyuktāni madhyame śrūyatāṃ kramaḥ| trayodaśāṃgulaṃ vaktraṃ tristhānaṃ ca tadaṃgulam|| 20.12 || ṣaḍviṃśatyaṃgulotsedhamurumānamudāhṛtam| tadvajjaṅghāsamutsedhaṃ uttareṇetaratsamam|| 20.13 || adhame daśatāle tu mukhaṃ śatayavaṃ matam| tristhānaṃ tāvadevasyādūruryavaśatadvayam|| 20.14 || jaṅghā ca tatsamotsodhā mukhyenānyatsamaṃ matam| viṃśadyavaśataṃ pādadrāghimā kamalāsana|| 20.15 || aṅguṣṭhaṃ vedamātraṃ syāttadāyāmā ca tarjanī| ekatriṃśadyavāyāmā madhyamāṅguliriṣyate|| 20.16 || triṃśadyavā'nāmikāsyātkaniṣṭhā tryaṃgulāpi ca| yavaiśca pañcabhiryaktā pārṣṇī ca caturaṅgulā|| 20.17 || hikkā tayoradho bāhuraṅgulī saptaviṃśatiḥ| tataśca maṇibandhāntaṃ ṣaḍviṃśatyaṃgulāyatam|| 20.18 || yavadvayena ca yutaṃ maṇibandhāttalaṃ punaḥ| madhyamāṃgulamūlāntaṃ pañcāśadyavasaṃmitam|| 20.19 || pañcāṃgulamathāṃṅguṣṭhaṃ tarjanī tadvadāyatā| ṣaḍyavai ścādhikāyāmā madhyamā tu ṣaḍaṃgulā|| 20.20 || āyatā ṣaḍyavai ścāpi tatsamānāmikā matā| kaniṣṭhāṅguṣṭhatulitā māṃpalagnavakhāvadhi|| 20.21 || ekāṅgulā sakhāyāmā śiṣṭā ṣaḍyavasaṃmitā| bāhuvaccopabāhussyāccaturaṅgulamāyataḥ|| 20.22 || caturyapaṃ cordhva kaṇaṃ nālaṃ cañcāṅgulāyatam| liṅgaṃ pañcāṅgulāyāmaṃ muṣkaṃ tu caturaṅgulam|| 20.23 || sārdhāṣṭāṅgulivistāraṃ lalāṭaṃ tadanantaram| dvādaśāṃgulavistāraṃ bālacandrasamā kṛti|| 20.24 || tatastu karṇayormadhyaṃ sārdhaṃ satridaśāṃgulam| daśāṃgulamadhastasya vistāraṃ cibukasya tu|| 20.25 || sapādaṃ dvyaṃgulaṃ pūrṇaṃ cāpatulyākṛtirbhavet| mūlamadhyāgravistāraḥ grīvāyāḥ kramaśo bhavet|| 20.26 || navāṃgulaṃ tathaikonaṃ sārdhaṃ saptāṃguli stathā| hikkāntato ratho bāhumūlayorantaraṃ bhavet|| 20.27 || yavaiścaturbhirvistīrṇaṃ sacatvāriṃśadaṃgulam| kakṣayormadhyavistārastryaṃgulassārdhaviṃśatiḥ|| 20.28 || aṣṭā daśāṃgulaṃ mānaṃ stanayorapi cāntaram| ṣoḍaśāṃguvilastāraṃ tundamadhyamudāhṛtam|| 20.29 || aṣṭādaśāṃgulā śroṇī radharodaramiṣyate| kaṭipradeśavistārastryāṅgulastārdhaviṃśatiḥ|| 20.30 || ūrumūlasya vistārassārdhaṃ satridaśāṅgulam| agramekāṃgulaṃ sārdhadvyaṃgulaṃ madhyamiṣyate|| 20.31 || dvyaṃgulo mūlavistāro liṅgasya samudāhṛtaḥ| vistīrṇaṃ tryaṃgulaṃ mūlaṃ madhyamarthādhikaṃ punaḥ| vistīrṇamagramuṣkasya dvātriṃśadyavasaṃmitam|| 20.32 || vistīrṇamekādaśabhiraṃgulai rūrumadhyamam| agraṃ daśabhi retasya vistīrṇaṃ kamalāsana|| 20.33 || savāṃgulaṃ jānucakraṃ pārśvamardhendusannibham| mūlaṃ navāṣṭau madhyaṃ syājjaṅghāgraṃ sārdhasaptakam| vistīrṇo nalakābhāgaḥ sārdhaiśca caturaṃgulaiḥ|| 20.34 || aṅghrimūlasya vistārastryaṃgulassacaturyavaḥ| sārdhapañcāṃgulaṃ madhyamagraṃ sārdhaṣaḍaṃgulam|| 20.35 || sārdhamaṣṭāṃgulaṃ mūlaṃ bāhū saptāṃgulau punaḥ| madhyāgre tulyavistāre prakoṣṭhāvayavaḥ punaḥ|| 20.36 || sārdhena saptabhirmūle vistīrṇaṃ sārdhapañcabhiḥ| madhye caturbhiragre syānmaṇibandhasya tūcyate|| 20.37 || paṃcāgulārdhasahitaḥ tadvatkaratalaṃ smṛtam| aṃguṣṭhe mūlavistāro dvyaṃgulo madhyamāṃguliḥ|| 20.38 || saṣaḍyavaṃ tu muṣṭyagramaṃgulenaiva saṃmitam|| tarjanyāmūlavistāro navabhispaṃmito yavaiḥ|| 20.39 || madhya mekāṃgulaṃ saptayavamagramudāhṛtam| mūlaṃ daśayavaṃ madhmaṃ madhyamāyā yavā nava|| 20.40 || agramekāṃgulaṃ proktamitarā tarjanīsamā| mūlamaṣṭau kaniṣṭhāyāḥ yavāssaptaikamadhyamā|| 20.41 || ṣaḍyavāṃgulamagrebhyaḥ pādonā sakhavistṛtiḥ| madhye karatale rekhā madhyamāmūlamutthitā|| 20.42 || kaniṣṭhāmūlamārabhya rekhā madhyamagā bhavet| madhyamāṃgulitarjanyornirmātavyā vicakṣaṇaiḥ|| 20.43 || aṃguṣṭhamūlamārabhya tarjanyantaśca madhyamā| tayośca rekhayormadhye tarjanīmūlagāminī|| 20.44 || rekhā kalpyā yathāśāstraṃ śāstrābhijñena śilpinā| lalāṭasya ca vistārassapādadvyaṃgulo bhavet|| 20.45 || tasyādhastādbhruvau kalpyau catvāriṃśadyavāyatau| madhye yavena vistīrṇe yūkāgre cāpasannibhe|| 20.46 || tayormadhyaṃ navayavaṃ aṣṭādaśayavāyatam| cakṣuḥ nīnikāyāmo vistāraśca yanaḥ smṛtaḥ|| 20.47 || aṃgulaṃ śvetabimbasya vistāraṃ kṛṣṭamaṇḍalam| yavonamaṃgulaṃ jyotistanmadhye yavasaṃmitam|| 20.48 || yākamānā tu tanmadhye dṛṣṭiḥ pakṣmāvalī punaḥ| ūrdhvā samanvitā sārdhatryaṃgulā daśabhiryavaiḥ|| 20.49 || vistīrṇātu yavāyāmā vistārastu tadardhakaḥ| aśītiḥ pakṣmaromāṇi vakrāgrāṇyasitāni ca|| 20.50 || dvyaṃgulaṃ cakṣuṣormadhyaṃ madhyaṃ ca śrutyapāṅgayoḥ| catvāriṃśadyavaṃ karṇavistāro dvyaṅgulo bhavet|| 20.51 || ūrdhvaṃ karṇasya cāyāmassahārdhacaturaṃgulaḥ| nālaṃ pañcāṃgulamitaṃ vistāraṣṣaḍyavaḥ punaḥ|| 20.52 || paścāccaturyavā nālī nālatulyaṃ caturmukha| śramaṇasya ca pippalyāḥ madhyagartaṃ caturyavam|| 20.53 || trivaktrakarṇapippalyā gallapātramiva sthitam| bandanaṃ tryaṃgulaṃ randhraṃ netrasūtra samunnatam|| 20.54 || nāsikāmūlamadhyāgravistāraḥ kathyate kramāt| aṃgulaṃ cāṃgulaṃ sārdhadvyaṃgulaṃ sacaturyavam|| 20.55 || aṃgulenonnataṃ mūlaṃ tena sārdhena madhyamam| dvābhyāṃ yavābhyāṃ mūlena dvyaṃgulenāgramunnatam|| 20.56 || ṣaḍyavaṃ suṣiraṃ tasya puṭamadhyaṃ caturyavam| puṭapārśvasya vistāro dviyavaḥ parikīrtitaḥ|| 20.57 || utsedho'rdhāṃgulastasya nāsikā tilapuṣpavat| uttaroṣṭhāyataṃ sārdhaṃ caturaṃgulamiṣyate|| 20.58 || vistāro'rdhāṃgulastasya paraṃ sārdhāṃgulāyatam| vistīrṇamaṃgulaṃ tasya pālī caikayavā matā|| 20.59 || cibukoṣṭhau daśayavau vistārāyāmasaṃmitau| gulphaṃ pādāṅgulotsedhaṃ darpaṇodarasannibham|| 20.60 || vistīrṇāvayavau tulyau rājadantau caturyavau| dvāttriṃśaddaśanāḥ kalpyāḥ yathāśāstroktavartmanā|| 20.61 || jihvā ṣaḍaṅgulāyāmā vistīrṇā tryaṅgulā bhavet| rekhātrayāṅkitā grīvā hikkā sūtrāt stanasthiti|| 20.62 || ekādaśāṃgulaṃ vṛttaṃ dvyaṃgulaṃ stavamaṇḍalam| caturyavaṃ cūcukaṃ syāt stanamaṇḍalamadhyagam|| 20.63 || caturyavaṃ nābhigartaṃ dakṣiṇāvartamiṣyate| adhyardhamaṃgulaṃ vṛtta makṣamardhāṃgulonnatam|| 20.64 || uṣṇīṣātpṛṣṭhakeśāntamekādikadaśāṃgulam| uṣṇīṣātparśvakeśāntaṃ dvādaśāṃgulamānakam|| 20.65 || karṇayorantaraṃ vidyāt sārdhaṃ satridaśāṅgulam| mulamadhyāgrabhāgeṣu pṛṣṭhagrīvā yathākramam|| 20.66 || vistīrṇā navabhistārdhenaṃgulairnavabhistathā| aṣṭābhiśca bhavettasyā adhastātka kudasthitiḥ|| 20.67 || āyāmotsedhavistāraiḥ kakudaṃ taccaturyavam| ṣaṭtriṃśadaṃgulaṃ bāhvo rmadhyaṃ vistārapṛṣṭhataḥ|| 20.68 || ṣaḍviṃśatiścāṃgulānāṃ kakṣayorantaraṃ bhavet| pṛṣṭhamadhyasya vistaro brahman saptadaśāṃgulaḥ|| 20.69 || vistīrṇā pañcaviṃśatyā śroṇī pārśvau tathāṃgulaiḥ| kaṭipradeśavistāraṣṣaḍviṃśatyaṃgulo bhavet|| 20.70 || ṣaṭtriṃśadaṅgulaṃ madhye kakudasya kaṭestathā| dvyaṃgulonnatametasya sphicau tanmadhyamaṃgulam|| 20.71 || aṅgulaṃ stanayormūlaṃ madhyaṃ saptāṅgulaṃ bhavet| agraṃ tryaṃgulavistāramūrvormūlādiṣu triṣu|| 20.72 || bhavetkrameṇa vistārassārdhassatridaśāṃgulaḥ| dvādaśāṃgulayuktasyāttathaiva dvādaśāṃgulaḥ| jānvaṣṭāṃgulavistāraṃ sārdhamaṣṭāṃgulaṃ bhavet|| 20.73 || jaṅghāmadhyaṃ suvistīrṇaṃ nālikā caturaṃgulā| caturyavādhikā caiva gulphaśca caturaṅgulaḥ|| 20.74 || vistāramānaṃ triguṇaṃ sarveṣāṃ nahanaṃ matam| abhitido vā varado mukhyo vāmetaraḥ karaḥ|| 20.75 || stanasūtrasamaṃ kāryaṃ aṅgulāgraṃ karasya tu| tayorbhavedantarālaṃ dvādaśāṅgulamabjaja|| 20.76 || aṃguṣṭhatarjanīmadhye sanālaṃ kamalaṃ bhavet| varade kamalākāraṃ likhetkaratalodare|| 20.77 || adhomukhe vāmahaste mukhye kuryādgadāṃ śubhām| catustālāyatāṃ mūle sthūlāmagre kṛśāmṛjum|| 20.78 || tryaṃgulaṃ mūlanahanamagre sahanamaṃgulam| dvyaṃgulaṃ sārdhamitaradgadāmadhyaṃ caturmukha|| 20.79 || kaṭiprasavyaṃ karayorantaraṃ dvyaṅgulaṃ bhavet| kaṭispṛśaṃ karaṃ kuryātpra savyaṃ gadayā vinā|| 20.80 || uddharedbāhusīmāntamūrdhvahastau dhṛtāyudhau| bāhuprakoṣṭhayormadhyaṃ mūlamaṣṭāṃgulaṃ bhavet|| 20.81 || madhyaṃ daśāṃgulamitamagramānaṃ mukhaṃ smṛtam| ūrdhve hastadvayāṅguṣṭho sahānāmikayā natam|| 20.82 || tarbhanīmadhyamābhyāṃ tu dhārayantaṃ tathāmbujam| cakraṃ sudarśanaṃ vṛttaṃ dvādaśāṅgulamānakam|| 20.83 || aṣṭāṃgulamarakṣetraṃ dvyaṃgulā cakrapiṇḍikā| tadvatsyānnemivalayaṃ caturjvālāsamanvitam|| 20.84 || nābhāpubhayato jvālā triśikhāvartaśobhitā| adhyardhadvyaṅgulotsedhā vistīrṇārdhādikāṃgulā|| 20.85 || arāṇi yavatulyāni netratulyāni vā punaḥ| aṣṭau dvādaśa vā ṣaḍvā ṣaḍjvālaṃ śaṅkhamiṣyate|| 20.86 || vistāro'ṣṭāṃgulastasya dvādaśāṃgulamāyatam| pradakṣiṇāvartayutaṃ jvālāgraṃ śaṅkhacakrayoḥ|| 20.87 || keśāntena samaṃ yadvā netrasūtreṇa tatsam| sārdhāṃgulāntarādūrdhvaṃ jānunī dvyaṃgulāntare|| 20.88 || jaṅghayorvaṃśatiyavamantarālaṃ praśasyate| akṣayostryaṃgulaṃ madhyaṃ tayossaptāṃgulaṃ bhavet|| 20.89 || caraṇāṃguṣṭhayormadhyaṃ navāṃgulamudāhṛtam| ṛjusthitasya caraṇaṃ śayyāyāṃ ṛju dakṣiṇam|| 20.99 || itaratkuṃcitaṃ saptaviṃśatyaṃgulamantaram| aṃguṣṭhayorgulphamadhyaṃ caturaṃgula miṣyate|| 20.91 || jānvantarālamuditaṃ sārdhaṃ satridaśāṃgulam| savyetarakaraṃ mauleragrāntaṃ viniveśayet|| 20.92 || prasārayedvāmahastaṃ ājānukamalāsana| dakṣiṇe kamalaṃ vāme gadāṃ haste prakalpayet|| 20.93 || bhidhyate pratimābhaṃgaistribhiretaiścaturmukha| abhaṅgasamabhaṅgābhyāmatibhaṅgena caiva hi| śiromadhye nāsikāgre āsyamadhye galasya ca|| 20.94 || madhye ca hṛdaye nābhau madhye liṅgasya vāmataḥ| bhāgeṣaḍaṅgule corau vāme madhye ca gulphayoḥ|| 20.95 || lambayetsutramābhaṅgaṃ bhinnā ca pratimā matā| yathokta pratimāmānā dūnā vā tribhiraṅgulaiḥ|| 20.96 || śikhāmaṇigataṃ sūtraṃ vāma pūrigamadhyagam| vāme lalāṭe makare vāme vāme ca cakṣuṣī|| 20.97 || nābhau madhye nalakayormadhye ca yadi lambayet| samabhaṅgaviśiṣṭhā sā nyūnaiṣā caturaṅgulaiḥ|| 20.98 || mūrdhni vāme lalāṭe ca vāmanetrasya madhyagam| āsyamadhye tathā nābhau dakṣiṇe gulphamadhyagam|| 20.99 || sūtraṃ pralambayedevaṃ atibhaṅgā tu sā matā| nyūnā pañcāṅgulai reṣā pratimā pūrvamā nataḥ|| 20.100 || atibhaṅgaśśayānāyāḥ praśastorāmakṛṣṇayoḥ| sahajānāṃ bhūṣaṇādikirīṭānāṃ caturmukha|| 20.101 || vakṣyāmi mānamadhunā yathātathamanukramāt| caturviṃśāṅgulāyāmaṃ yadvā pañcadaśāṅgulam|| 20.102 || mūlamadhyāgranahanaṃ kirīṭasya yathākramam| triṃśatā saptabhirdvābhyāṃ ekenāpi tathāṅgulaiḥ|| 20.103 || tasya madhye caturdikṣu pūritāni tathāṅgulaiḥ| tasya madhye caturdhikṣu pūritāni prakalpayet| śobhayecca mahāratnai ragre caikaśikhā maṇiṃ|| 20.104 || caturdaśāṅgulotsedhaṃ kalpayetkeśabandhanam| mūlapaṭṭaṃ kirīṭasya vistīrṇaṃ dvyaṃgulaṃ bhavet| ekāṃgulamamūṣyāgraṃ tryaṃgulaṃ ca śikhāmaṇiḥ|| 20.105 || padmamaṣṭadalaṃ kuryādadhastācca śikhāmaṇeḥ| dvigolakāyataṃ citrairanyairapica śobhayet|| 20.106 || śirasaḥ pṛṣṭhabhāge syācchiraścakraṃ tu cakravat| vinākṛtaṃ tu jvālābhiḥ padmaṃ yadvā yathāruci|| 20.107 || prakalpyaṃ madhyato dāma cakre golakamāyatam| nahasaṃ dvyaṃgulaṃ tasya nālaṃ syādgolakāyatam|| 20.108 || makaraṃ golakotsedhaṃ kuryā daṣṭhāṅgulāyatam| tadvaktrātsumanodāma nissṛtaṃ bālacandravat|| 20.109 || dvyaṅgulaṃ karṇasumanaḥ karṇadāma ca lambayet| hāraṃ tryaṃgulavistāramagrayornetrabandhanam|| 20.110 || mūktāvibhūṣitaṃ madhye mahāratnapariṣkṛtam| kuryācca dakṣiṇe vakṣasthasale śrīvatsamaṅgulam|| 20.111 || ardhādhikaṃ trikoṇaṃ ca tanmadhye kamalālayām| dvihastāmudyadambhejadhāriṇīṃ śriyamadbhutām|| 20.112 || aparābhyāṃ ca hastābhyāṃ varābhayasamanvitām| kirīṭahārakeyurasarvābharaṇabhūṣitām|| 20.113 || kuryādgolakavistāraṃ mukhe pañcāṅgulāyatam|| triguṇaṃ brahmasūtraṃ syānnābheścāpi pradakṣiṇam|| 20.114 || ekāṃgulaṃ cottarīyaṃ netrabandhena bandhayet| vistīrṇaṃ dvyaṅgulaṃ madhye tvagramekāṅgulaṃ bhavet|| 20.115 || muktādāmapariṣkāraṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitam| kukṣibandhanamāścaryaṃ netrabandhena yojayet|| 20.116 || muktādāma ca keyūraṃ kuryātpūritasannibham| saptāṅgulaiśca vistīrṇaṃ nānāratnapariṣkṛtam|| 20.117 || gulikāṃgulavistīrṇā āyatādvyaṃgulena ca| gulikānāṃ trayaṃ kuryānnetrabandhena bandhayet|| 20.118 || sarvaratnapariṣkārān valayāṃ strīn prakalpayet| ekāṅgulaparīṇāhān kaṭakaiścopaśobhitān|| 20.119 || sauvarṇānyaṃgulīyāni bandhānekamaṇīni ca| pariṇāho bhavetaiṣāṃ dviyavastriyavo pi vā|| 20.120 || madhyamāmaṅguliṃ naiva maṇḍayedaṅgulīyakaiḥ| tryaṃgulaḥ kaṭisūtrasya vistāro ratnaśobhitaḥ|| 20.121 || tanmadhye makarī caiva pañcāṃgulasamāyatā| cuturaṃgulavistārā daṃṣṭrākuṭilamānanam|| 20.122 || vṛttākṣaṃ bhrukuṭīyuktamāsyanissṛtamauktikam| kuryānmauktikadāmāni trīṇyāgulphaṃ prakalpayet|| 20.123 || pādākalpaṃ trikaṭakaṃ dvyaṃgulaṃ pariṇāhataḥ| nūpuraṃ ca tathā kuryātkiṅkiṇījālamaṇḍitam|| 20.124 || vastraṃ ca pītapūrvaṃ tadāgulphaṃ pārśvalambitam| kalpayedvanamālāṃ tu nānāpuṣpasamujjvalām|| 20.125 || nānāratnamayīṃ vāpi yadvā kevalapaṅkajām| karṇataścaraṇaṃ yāvallambayedadbhutākṛtim|| 20.126 || athavā vallikākārāṃ nāhataścaturaṅgulām| pradyotanasahasrābhaṃ dyotamānaṃ ca kaustubham|| 20.127 || lambayedurasi svacchamindirāsodaraṃ maṇim| rūpasyā bharaṇānāṃ ca niyamassaṃpradarśitaḥ|| 20.128 || na hyaśeṣeṇa rūpaṃ me pratikarmāṇi vā punaḥ| nirmātuṃ bhavatā śakyaṃ kimutānyaiḥ kuśilpibhiḥ|| 20.129 || tathāpi śāstrāṇyālocya tat jñaiśśāstraṃ vimṛśyaca| nyūnātirekarahitaṃ bimbaṃ kuryādyathātatham|| 20.130 || nyūnātireke vā doṣo mahān vaktuṃ na śakyate| iti śrīpāñcārātre mahopaniṣadi pādmasaṃhitāyāṃ kriyāpāde pratimāmāna vidhirvāma viṃśo'dhyāyaḥ |
<2.21>
śrībhagavān atha śriyādi devīnāṃ nirmāṇavidhirucyate| daśatālādinā yena tālamānena kalpyate|| 21.1 || devo devyaśśriyādyāstu kalpanīyā ścaturmukha| tadanantaratālena nādhikena samena vā|| 21.2 || yāvantyo yāśca yanmānā śśriyādeśśūlayaṣṭayaḥ| tanmānāstāśca tāvatyaḥ kathyante saṃprati kramāt|| 21.3 || pañcatālamitāyāmā vaṃśayaṣṭiścaturmukha| vistārastryaṅgulo mūle saha ṣaḍbhiryavairapi|| 21.4 || madhyatastryaṃgula ssārdhastryaṅgulaḥ punaragrataḥ| caturdaśāṃgulo madhye mūle pañcadaśāṃgulaḥ|| 21.5 || nāhogre vaṃśayaṣṭessyātsārdhaṃ satridaśāṃgulam| caturaśrassuvṛtto vā daṇḍaḥ kalpyaśca śilpibhiḥ|| 21.6 || aṅgulaissaptaviṃśatyā vakṣodaṇḍassamāyataḥ| vistāro madhyamastasya tryaṅgulaṣṣaḍyavādhikaḥ|| 21.7 || aṃgulairdaśabhirnāha ssaha pañcabhiraṃgulaiḥ| kiṃśukasyeva mukulaṃ tasyāgre dve prakalpayet|| 21.8 || bāhumūlaṃ caturviṃśatyaṃgulāyāmamiṣyate| tryaṃgulārdhādiko mūlavistārastasya kalpyate|| 21.9 || tryaṃgulo madhyavistārastasyāgraṃ dvyagulaṃ bhavet| aṣṭādaśāṃgulāyāmaḥ prakoṣṭhastasya mūlataḥ|| 21.10 || vistārastryaṃgulo madhye dvyaṃgulassacaturyavaḥ| dvyaṃgulogre tayormūlaśūlayossuṣiraṃ bhavet|| 21.11 || āyāmaḥ kaṭidaṇḍasya bhavetpañcadaśāṃgulaḥ| vistāro madhyamastasya tryaṃgulassahaṣaḍyavaḥ|| 21.12 || nahanaṃ madhyatastasya bhavetpañcadaśāṃgulam| ṣaḍaṃgulaḥ pārśvayaṣṭeḥ pariṇāhaḥ prakīrtitaḥ|| 21.13 || pārśvadaṇḍau kaṭivakṣaśśū layorviniyojayet| ṣaḍviṃśatyaṃgulāyāmamuraśśūlamudāhṛtam|| 21.14 || tryaṃgulo mūlavistārastasyāgraṃ dvyaṃgulaṃ bhavet| vistīrṇaṃ dvyaṃgulaṃ madhyaṃ śūlasya ca caturyavam|| 21.15 || pūruśūlasamāyāmaṃ jaṅghā śūlaṃ prakalpayet| suṣiraṃ ca tayormūlamagraṃ mithunametayoḥ|| 21.16 || anukta pariṇāhānāṃ triguṇaṃ nahanaṃ matam| trayodaśavidhaṃ śūlaṃ kṛtvā pūrvoktamānakam|| 21.17 || jalādhivāsādyakhilaṃ kuryārcchrīsthāpane yathā| svātanyraica pāratanyrai ratnanyāsaphurassaram|| 21.18 || śūlādisthāpayedrajjuveṣṭanādi yathāpuram| kuryādāvarṇalepāntaṃ mānāgyatha nidarśyate|| 21.19 || utsedhamaṃgulaśataṃ viṃśamāsthāya kathyate| uṣṇīṣamaṅgulamitaṃ tryaṃgulaṃ ca śirobhavet|| 21.20 || sārdhaṃ tribhiryavairakṣisūtrāntaṃ caturaṃgulam| saṅgamātpuṭasūtrāntaṃ tadvadambhoruhāsana|| 21.21 || cibukāntaṃ puṭādarvāksapādacaturaṃgulam| caturaṅgulamānāsyādgrīvā hikkā guṇāttataḥ|| 21.22 || trayodaśāṃgulamitaṃ stanasūtrāntamīritam| atonu nābhisīmāstaṃ bhavetpaṃcadaśāṅgulam|| 21.23 || śroṇī ṣaḍaṃgulāyāmā yonissārdhāṅgulitrayam| kaṭimānaṃ bhavetsārdhaṃ tryaṅgulaṃ corurāyatā|| 21.24 || aṅgulaiḥ paṃcaviṃśatyā sārdhairjaṅghā ca tatsamā| sārdhaṃ ca tryaṅgulaṃ jānustadvadakṣatalāvadhi|| 21.25 || vistāro'ṣṭāṅgulastasya dvādaśāṃgulamāyatam| pradakṣiṇāvartayutaṃ jvālāgraṃ śaṅkhacakrayoḥ|| 21.26 || keśāntena samā yadvā yadvā sūtreṇa tatsamam| sārdhāntarāṃśunā pūrvā guñjāni dvyaṅgulāntare|| 21.27 || jaṅghayorviṃśatiyavamantarālaṃ pracakṣate| akṣayostryaṃgulaṃ madhyaṃ stanayossaptamāṃgulam|| 21.28 || caraṇāṃguṣṭhayormadhyaṃ navāṃgulamudāhṛtam| akṣātparataraṃ tālamaṃguṣṭhaṃ tribhiraṃgulaiḥ|| 21.29 || ardhena cāyataṃ dhve ca tarjanī syādyavādhikā| yavonā madhyamānye dve yavahīne yathākramam|| 21.30 || pārṣṇipārśvaparicchodo bhavecca caturaṃgulaḥ| gulphaṃ tathāparimitaṃ tadviṃśatyaṃgulāyatam|| 21.31 || hikkāṃ tayoradho bāhussahārdhaikonaviṃśatiḥ| aṃgalāni prakoṣṭhaṃ syāttadāyāmaṣṣaḍaṃgulaḥ|| 21.32 || tadvacca madhyamā śiṣṭā sārdhapaṃca daśāṃgulā| daśāṃgulaṃ śiromānaṃ vistāro'ṣṭāguṃlo bhavet|| 21.33 || lalāṭasya puronu syādaśītiyavasaṃmitam| aṣṭāśītiyavaṃ mānaṃ tadanantaramiṣyate|| 21.34 || āyāmaśśravaṇasya syāddvātriṃśadyavasaṃmitaḥ| nālāyāmasta thācordhvaṃ pippalyā dviyavo mataḥ|| 21.35 || nālasya mūlavistāraṣṣaḍyavaistulito bhavet| agraṃ caturyāvaṃ grīvā mūlaṃ caiva ṣaṃgulam|| 21.36 || sārdhaṃ pañcāṃgu lārdhāgraṃ skaṃdhaṃ ca dvyaṃgula bhavet| hikkāntayoradho bāhvormūlaṃ dvātriṃśadaṃgulam|| 21.37 || aṣṭādaśāṃgulamurastanayorapi maṇḍalam| aṃgulaiḥ pañcadaśabhiḥ paricchinnaṃ yathātatham|| 21.38 || navāṃgulaṃ ca vistāra utsedhaścāpi tādṛśaḥ| dvādaśāṃgulavistārastanayormadhyamiṣyate|| 21.39 || kṛṣṇamaṇḍalavistāro dvyaṃgulaṃ caturānana| nāhastu kukṣimadhyasya syāttrayastriṃśadaṃgulaḥ|| 21.40 || śroṇīmadhyaparīṇāha ssaptapaṃcadaśāṃgulaḥ| kaṭimadhyaparīṇāho viṃśatyā saikayāṃgulaiḥ|| 21.41 || ṣaṭtriṃśadaṃgulo nāhastathā syādūrumūlayoḥ| triṃśadaṃgulanāhastu bhavedūrvostu madhyamaḥ|| 21.42 || caturbhissaha viṃśatyā jānunāhastathāṃgulaiḥ| sahanaṃ jaṅghayorekaviṃśatyaṃgulamiṣyate|| 21.43 || dvāviṃśatyaṃgulassārdho nāhamadhye ca jaṅghayoḥ| sahanaṃ jaṅghayoragraṃ bhavedekādaśāṃgulam|| 21.44 || ekādaśāṃgulaṃ cākṣavṛtta maṇḍalanāhanam| ekāṃgulaṃ cākṣavṛttaṃ madhyamaṃ nahanaṃ matam|| 21.45 || ṣaḍaṃgulaṃ talāgraṃ syādutsedhaścaturaṃgulaḥ| dvyaṃgulo'ṅguṣṭhavistārastarja nyekāṃgulā bhavet|| 21.46 || madhyamāditarāṃgulyo yavahīnāḥ kramātpūnaḥ| aṃguṣṭhanakhavistārastryaṃgulaḥ parikīrtataḥ|| 21.47 || tarjanī pādahīnā nyātkramādanyā yavonnatāḥ| aṣṭādaśāṅgulaṃ madhyaṃ mūlāṃ bāhvostrayādhikaṃ|| 21.48 || prakoṣṭhamūlanahanaṃ bhavetpaṃcadaśāṃgulam| dvādaśāṃgulamadhyāntaṃ maṇibandho navāṃgulaḥ|| 21.49 || vistīrṇaṃ tālamadhyardhaṃ caturaṃgulamiṣyate| aṃguṣṭhamūla madhyardhamaṃgulaṃ nakhamaṅgulam|| 21.50 || nissṛtaṃ triyavaṃ proktaṃ parvadvayasamanvitam| tarjanyaṃgulavistārassahāṣṭhāṃśāṃgulo bhavet|| 21.51 || sapādāṅgulavistārā madhyamāṅguliriṣyate| aṣṭasaptayavaiśśiṣṭestriparvā ca catuṣṭayī|| 21.52 || pārśve keśāntamuṣṇiṣādārabhya syāddaśāṃgulam| ārabhya pārśva keśāṃtātsa pāda dvyaṅgule bhruvau|| 21.53 || ṣaḍaṃgulā yathā bhrūssyādyavamadhyāgra yūkakā| antarālaṃ navayavaṃ bhruvo stryaṃgulamīkṣaṇam|| 21.54 || aṃgulāyāmavistārā veditavyā kanīnikā| yavonamaṃgulaṃ kṛṣṇajyotiryūka pramāṇakam|| 21.55 || paritaḥ kṛṣṇabimbasya aṃgulaṃ śvetamaṇḍalam| madhyatoṃgulavistāraṃ nayanaṃ śūrpamīnavat|| 21.56 || ūrdhvapakṣmāyatāsārdhatryaṃgulāpādavistarā| tryaṃgulāyāmamitaradvistāro yavasaṃmitaḥ|| 21.57 || aśītaḥ pakṣmaromāṇi śatāni kuṭilāni ca| dvyaṃgulaṃ cakṣuṣormadhyaṃ nāsikāmūlamaṃgulam|| 21.58 || vistīrṇamunnataṃ vāpi madhyamadhyardhamaṃgulam| agraṃ dvyaṅgulamadhyardhaṃ ṣaḍyavaṃ śuṣiraṃ bhavet|| āpāṅgātkarṇamūlāntaṃ catvāriṃśadyavaṃ matam|| 21.59 || dvyaṅgulaḥ karṇavistāro vivaraṃ ca caturyavam| caturaṅgulamaddhardhamoṣṭhamuttaramāyatam|| 21.60 || yavavistāramadharamekāṃgulasamāyatam| dvyaṅgulaṃ caiva vistāraṃ cibukaṃ dvyaṃgulāyatam|| 21.61 || āpīḍā nāsikāyuktā karaṇḍamukuṭānvitā| karṇikā maṇikeyūra kaṭakatrayahāriṇī|| 21.62 || ratnakūrpāsaraśanā puṣpāmbarapariṣkṛtāḥ| stanabandhatulākoṭī sarvābharaṇabhūṣitā|| 21.63 || lajjābhaṅgena devasya pārśve vāmetare sthitā| hasteva vāhijaṃ pullaṃ vāmena kila bibhratī|| 21.64 || ūrupradeśaviśrāntasavyetarakarāmbujā| yadvā syathāhastayosyānniṣṭaptakanakaprabhā|| 21.65 || āsane'bhayado hasto dakṣiṇo varado'paraḥ| dakṣiṇe padmamathavā savyaḥ kaṭakamudritaḥ|| 21.66 || pāratantye vidhirayaṃ svātantyaitūcyate yathā| caturbhujāṃ jaghanyābhyāṃ hastābhyāmajjadhāriṇīṃ|| 21.67 || śaṅkhacakradharāṃ vāpi mukhyābhyāṃ varadāyinīm| abhītidāṃ ca koṭīradhāriṇīṃ bhayavarjitām|| 21.68 || vasundharāhvayāṃ devīṃ dvihastāṃ kanakaprabhām| dakṣiṇābhayadāmanyahastena vasudāyinīm|| guhītadāḍimaphalāṃ yadvā vāmakareṇa vā|| 21.69 || cintāratnaṃ dhārayantīṃ hemasiṃhāsane sthitām| vāmapādena saṃspṛṣṭanidhikumbhāmalaṃkṛtām|| 21.70 || kalpakānokahacchāyāṃ samāśritya sthitāṃ tathā| vāme pārśve mahīṃ devīṃ dvihastāṃ śyāmalaṃprabhām|| 21.71 || stanabandha vihīnāṃ vā kuṇḍalāpīḍavarjitām| susthitāṃ savyapādena cānyena ptokakuñcitām|| 21.72 || puṣpaṃ dakṣiṇahasteva dhārayantīṃ śucismitām| ūrupradeśaviśrāntavāmahastā malaṃkṛtām|| 21.73 || sottarīyāṃ yathāyogaṃ svātantrye śrīrudāhṛtā| yogalakṣmīstu śrīvatsaṃ bhogalakṣmī rdvipārśvayo|| vīralakṣmīstu vai śeṣaṃ pṛthagbhavanakalpanam|| 21.74 || ratissarasvatī tuṣṭirdevyo devasya dakṣiṇe| ratissisdhūra sajkāśā sphaṭikābhā sarasvatī|| 21.75 || haritālanibhā tuṣṭiśśrīvadabharaṇādayaḥ| pāratanyre vidhirayaṃ svātaṃtrye tūcyate vidhiḥ|| 21.76 || ratyādayaśca turhastā mukhyau syātāṃ rateḥ karau| varadābhayadāvanyau pāśāṅguśadharau punaḥ|| 21.77 || mukhyau hastau sarasvatyā dakṣiṇo jñānamudritaḥ| vijñānapustakaṃ vāme jaghanye dakṣiṇekare|| 21.78 || akṣasūtra dharaṃ vāme sarve vajrādayaḥ sthitāḥ| tuṣṭeśca pūrvavanmukhyau jaghanyau śaṅkhamambujam|| 21.79 || kīrtaḥ prītiśca śāntiśca vāme devasya saṃsthitāḥ| vāmāṅghrayassusthitāssyarīṣadanyena kuñcitāḥ|| 21.80 || ūrupradeśaviśrāntā vāmāḥ puṣpadharāḥ pare| kīrtassphaṭikavarṇābhā nīlābhā prītiriṣyate|| 21.81 || śāntiśśyāmanibhā caiva sarvālaṅkāra śobhitā| pāratantrye vidhirayaṃ svātantr…
<2.22>
śrībhagavān rūpaṃ varṇaṃ tathākalpaṃ hastamudrāṃ tathaiva ca| hastasaṅkhyāṃ yathā yogamavyaccāpi caturmukha|| 22.1 || adhunā parivārāṇāṃ pravakṣyāmi yathātatham| hayagrīvaṃ caturbāhuṃ śuddhasphaṭikasannibham|| 22.2 || aśvavaktraṃ mukuṭinaṃ dhautavastrauttarīyakam| mukhyenai kena varadaṃ dakṣiṇenetareṇa tu|| 22.3 || vijñānapustakadharaṃ jaghanye ca karadvaye| akṣa sūtraṃ ca śaṅkhaṃ ca bibhrāṇaṃ supariṣkṛtam|| 22.4 || kalpayetpuruṣākāra manantaraṃ ca kirīṭinam| bhogibhoge sukhāsīnāṃ pṛṣṭhataḥ phaṇamaṇḍalaiḥ|| 22.5 || unnamadbhiḥ kṛtacchāyaṃ caturhastaṃ sitaprabham| yadvā tu śyāmalo varṇaṃ anavtasya prakīrtyate|| 22.6 || prakalpaye nmukhyahāstaṃ varadaṃ vāmahastakam| gadādhāraṃ kaṭīdeśamanalaṃbyātha vā sthitam|| 22.7 || jaghanyābhyāṃ ca hassābhyāṃ śaṅkha cakradharo bhavet| garuḍaṃ kanakaprakhyaṃ nīlanāsāgrasaṃyutam|| 22.8 || dakṣiṇetaravistīrṇaṃ vicitrapṛthuvakṣasam| daṃṣṭrākarālavadanaṃ bhrukuṭīkuṭīlekṣaṇam|| 22.9 || karaṇḍikā mukuṭināṃ sarvābharaṇa bhūṣitam| vicitrakañcukadharaṃ bhujageṃdrai ralaṃkṛtam|| 22.10 || hṛdipuṣpāṃjalidharaṃ sthitamāsīna meva vā| dakṣiṇetarayoreka pādayoḥ kuñcitaṃ bhavet|| 22.11 || pṛṣṭhato'nyo yathāyogaṃ yadvā padmāsanaṃ bhavet| mārtāṇḍaṃ dvibhujaṃ raktaṃ raktāmbaradharaṃ sthitam|| 22.12 || pṛṣṭhabhāge śiraścakraṃ sthāne vipulamaṇḍalam|| bibhrāṇaṃ kamaladvandvaṃ hastābhyāṃ ca kirīṭinam|| 22.13 || uraḥ pradeśe vipule syamantakamahāmaṇim| āsīnāṃ vā sukhaṃ bimbepadme'ṣṭadalasaṃyute|| 22.14 || pūrvādau vārijadale meṣaprabhṛtirāśibhiḥ| sevitaṃ kalpaye tsomaṃ dvābhyāṃ kumudadhāriṇam|| 22.15 || kāmaṃ raktanibhaṃ raktaprasavāmbaradhāriṇam| hastābhyāmaikṣaṃ cāpaṃ bibhrāṇaṃ sumanaśśarān|| 22.16 || caturbhujaṃ caturvaktraṃ jaṭāmukuṭadhāriṇam| varābhayapradaṃ mukhyahastābhyāmanyahastayoḥ|| 22.17 || kuṇḍikāmakṣasūtraṃ ca bibhrāṇaṃ ca sukhāsanam| gajānanaṃ caturbhāhuṃ lambakukṣiṃ sitaprabham|| 22.18 || karaṇḍikā mukuṭinaṃ lambayajñopavītinam| vāmahastena mukhyena saṃgṛhītamahāphalam|| 22.19 || itareṇa tu hastena bhagnadasantaparigraham| aparābhyāṃ ca hastābhyāṃ pāśāṅguśa dharaṃ prabhum|| 22.20 || ṣaṇmukhaṃ ca caturbāhuṃ dāḍimīkusumaprabham| varābhayapradau makhyau jaghanyau śaktito marau|| 22.21 || kalpayecchyāmalāṃ kātyāṃ caturbhirbāhubhiḥ kramāt| gadādharāmabhayadāṃ śaṅkhacakravarāyudhāṃ|| 22.22 || hārakeyūra mukuṭanūpurādivibhūṣitām| athavāṣṭabhujāṃ gurgāṃ dakṣiṇe doścatuṣṭaye|| 22.23 || abhītiśaravistriṃśa cakramaṇḍalamaṇḍitām| vāme gadā dhanuḥ khaḍgaśaṅkhayudha dharāṃ varāṃ|| 22.24 || athavā dvādaśabhujāṃ viśeṣassamudīryate| dakṣiṇe paraśuṃ śūlaṃ vāme pāśāṅguśau tathā|| 22.25 || ghaṇṭeti pañca pūrvāṇi yadvā dvādaśabāhukām| anuktamāyudhaṃ kalpyaṃ bhuje nyasmin catuṣṭaye|| 22.26 || dvātriṃśadapi vā hastā śastramūhyaṃ tu coditam| lambodaraṃ mahākāyaṃ kalpayeddhanadaṃ tataḥ|| 22.27 || niṣṭaptakanakaprakhyaṃ varadaṃ daṇḍinaṃ tathā| tasyadakṣiṇataḥ pārśve jṛmbhalo māṇibhradrakaḥ|| 22.28 || kalpyaśśaṅkhanidhiṃcaiva vāmepārśve tu kalpayet| nalakūbaramambhejanidhiṃ ca śibikuṇḍalam|| 22.29 || jṛmbhalo hemavarṇābho maṇibhadro maṇiprabhaḥ| nalakūbaranāmā tu śyāma varṇaḥ prakīrtitaḥ|| 22.30 || śibiḥ kuṇḍalavān raktassarve bhītivarapradāḥ| rudraṃ trinetramaruṇaṃ jaṭāmukuṭadhāriṇam|| 22.31 || caturbhujaṃ nīlakaṇṭhamindu rekhā vibhūṣitam| vai yyāghra carmavasanaṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitaṃ|| 22.32 || karābhyāmapi mukhyābhyāṃ varadābhayadaṃ sthitam| aparābhyāṃ ca hastābhyāṃ bhibhrāṇaṃ paraśuṃ mṛgam|| 22.33 || kṣetrapālaṃ caturbhāhuṃ karaṇḍimukuṭojvalam| daṃṣṭrākarālavadanaṃ bhrukuṭīkuṭilekṣaṇam|| 22.34 || vāme kare daṇḍadharaṃ mukhye vāmetarekare| dadhānaṃ tarjanīmudrāṃ pāśāṅguśamamukhyoḥ|| 22.35 || viṣvaksenaṃ caturbāhuṃ śyāmavarṇaṃ kirīṭinam| lambodaraṃ ca mukhyena kareṇābhayadāyinam|| 22.36 || dakṣiṇena prasarvyena samālambya kaṭiṃ sthitam| āsīnamaparābhyāṃ ca hastābhyāṃ śaṅkhacakriṇam|| 22.37 || athavā pūrvakarayorgadāmekatra kalpayet| anyatra tarjanīmudrāṃ yadvā dakṣiṇahastayoḥ|| 22.38 || mukhye'bhītiramukhye tu cakramanyatra hastayoḥ| gadāṃ mukhye jaghanye tu śaṅkhaṃ ca prikalpayet|| 22.39 || śaṅkhacakradharaṃ yadvā sthitaṃ mukhye karadvaye| bibrāṇaṃ kṣurikāṃ vetraṃ kṛtāñjalipuṭaṃ sthitam|| 22.40 || devīṃ ca viṣvaksenasya vāmapārśve pratiṣṭhitām| nāmnā puṣpadharāṃ kuryātkamalāmiva lakṣitām|| 22.41 || brāhmyadi mātarassarvā brahmādyātmīyaśaktayaḥ| rūpavarṇāyudhādīni brahmādīnāṃ bhajanti tāḥ|| 22.42 || rudrarūpī vīrabhadrastāsāṃ paścāt sthito bhavet| prāgbhāge vighnarāṭ tāsā magraṃ cāpi bhujadvayam|| 22.43 || pārśvataḥ sthitayossakhyornyasya skandhe sthitaṃbhavet| āsanna prasavāpārśve 'jāmukhāḥ puruṣāḥ sthitāḥ|| 22.44 || divyāyudhadharā hyaṣṭau svacihnāṅkitamastakāḥ| cakrī musalavān śaṅkhī khīḍgī caiva gadādharaḥ|| 22.45 || śārṅgī padvī tathāvajrī narākārā dvipāṇayaḥ| dakṣiṇe tarṅanīmudrā vā maḥ kaṭyavalambataḥ|| 22.46 || ādityā dvādaśa tathā tadrūpādi dineśavat| dvihastā vasavassarvekaraṇḍamukuṭānvitāḥ|| 22.47 || daṇḍinastomaradharāḥ pitaraśca dvipāṇayaḥ| daṇḍāyudhā vāmahaste dakṣiṇābhayadāśca te|| 22.48 || karaṇḍīkāmukuṭino viśvedavāśca tādṛśāḥ| atrirbhṛguśca kutsaśca vasiṣṭho gautamastathā|| 22.49 || kāśyapaścāṅgirāścaiva ete saptarṣayaḥ smṛtāḥ| saptarṣayaḥ kare sarve bibhrāṇā jñānapustakam|| 22.50 || vijñānamudrāmanya tra jaṭāmukuṭadhāriṇaḥ| lakṣmyā virājitā brāhmyā rudrāsvaikādaśa smṛtāḥ || 22.51 || kumudādyāstu viṣṇupāriṣadeśvarāḥ| karaiścaturbhirbhibhrāṇāśśaṅkhacakragadā stathā|| 22.52 || dakṣiṇe tarjanīmudrā pītavastrāḥ kirīṭinaḥ| upendrādyaṣṭakāṃ cāpi dvihastamariśaṅkhagam|| 22.53 || viśvādayaśca dvibhujā gadākhaḍgāstradhāriṇaḥ| karaṇjikāmukuṭinassarvābharaṇabhūṣitāḥ|| 22.54 || aśvinau sadṛśau raktau sudhākalaśadhāriṇau| karaṇḍikāmukuṭinau dvihastau bhuṣitau bhṛśam|| 22.55 || śyāmaḥ kirīṭī dvibhujo vāsavo vajridakṣiṇaḥ| vāmāvalambhitakaṭi ssarvākalpa pariṣkṛtaḥ|| 22.56 || jvālāmaṇḍalamadhyastho jvālano dvibhujo bhavet| varadaśśaktihastaśca karaṇḍimukuṭojvalaḥ|| 22.57 || vai vasvataśca dvibhujaḥ kirīṭi mecakacchaviḥ| dakṣiṇā bhayado daṇḍī nirṛtirbhīmadarśanaḥ|| 22.58 || daṃṣṭrākarālavadano bhrukuṭī kuṭilekṣaṇaḥ| dakṣiṇo bhītirutkhaḍgo karaṇḍimukuṭojvalaḥ|| 22.59 || varuṇaśśyāmalaḥ pāśahasto vāme'bhayapradaḥ| karaṃḍimukuṭaścaiva vāyurdhūmro dvibāhukaḥ|| 22.60 || aṅguṇo dakṣiṇe haste vāmaḥ kaṭyavalambanaḥ| maruto vāyunā tulyāssomaspomavadiṣyate|| 22.61 || īśāno rudravatkalpyasteṣāṃ vāhanamucyate| haṃso vidhārū rudrasya vṛṣassūryasyaghoṭakaḥ|| 22.63 || makaraśśūrpakārāteśśaktapāṇeśca barhiṇaḥ| durgāyāḥ kesarī prokto vighnarājasya mūṣakaḥ|| 22.64 || naro yakṣādhirājasya śunāpīrasya kuṃjaraḥ| aghnermeṣaḥ kṛtāṃ tasya lulāyo vāhanaṃ bhavet|| 22.65 || piśāco nirṛteryānaṃ makaro varuṇasya tu| prāṇasya hariṇaḥ proktassa eva marutāmapi|| 22.66 || ucchrāyaṃ mūlaberasya caturdhā vibhajettataḥ| tatraikabhāgamucchrāyaṃ parivāreṣu kalpayet|| 22.67 || mānāṅgulena vā yadvā dehalabdhāṅgulena vā| aṣṭāṅgula samucchrāyaṃ dvādaśāṅgulameva vā|| 22.68 || dviguṇaṃ vā yathāyogamucchrāyaṃ parikalpayet| sthāne mūlapratikṛteḥ parivārāśca te sthitāḥ|| 22.69 || āsīnāścāsane tasya śayyāyāṃ śayanaṃ vānā| asīnā vā sthitā vāpi kāmacārāścaturmukha|| 22.70 || pralambaphalakāyāma ghanavistāra nirṇayam| kathyate paṃcatālasyādāyāmo ghanamaṅgulam|| 22.71 || ardhāyāmaṃ ca vistāraṃ kuryā ttatsukṛtaṃ yathā| pratimāstadaṅgānāṃ kauṭilyārjavasiddhaye|| 22.72 || lambamānaṃ yaducchiṣṭaṃ tadardhaṃ kamalāsana| śikhāmaṇyādisuṣiramanekaṃ tatrakalpayet|| 22.73 || sūtrāṇi suṣiraistaistairlambayecca pṛthaksvayam| jānīyādārjavaṃ tena pratyaṅgamavicārayan|| 22.74 || iti śrīpāñcarātre mahopaniṣadi pādmasaṃhitāyāṃ kriyāpāde parivāra vidhirnāma dvāviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ |
<2.23>
śrībhagavān ārādhanopakaraṇaṃ tasya lakṣaṇameva vā| ucyate saṃprati brahman śrūyatāṃ tadaśeṣataḥ|| 23.1 || lohajān dīpikāstaṃbhān caturhastasamucchrayān| trihastānekahastānvā dvihastānvā yathābalam|| 23.2 || tāmrajānvā rājatīyānayugmaisnehadhāraṇaiḥ| yugmairvā vṛttivistīrṇai rbahvaśrairvā pariṣkṛtān|| 23.3 || snehadhārāgrataḥ klaptapadmakośairalaṃkṛtān| kuryādarghyādipātrāṇi sauvarṇānītarāṇi vā|| 23.4 || rājatānyubhayābhāve śuddhatāmramayāni vā| pai śācalohavarjyāni yathāvittānusārataḥ|| 23.5 || vyākoca paṃkajābhāni cakrādyaṅgāni madhyataḥ| prasthamānāvaradravyapūvayogyāntarāṇi ca|| 23.6 || śaṅkhaśuktisvabhāvāni yadvā pātrāṇi kalpayet| nai vedyapātrāṇi tathā sauvarṇānītarāṇi vā|| 23.7 || rajatasyobhayabhāve śuddhatāmramayāni vā| havirdravyapramāṇāni vṛttāni parikalpayet|| 23.8 || darvīṃ hastāyatāmagramūlayormaṇḍalākṛtim| pānīyapātraṃ sauvarṇamathavā kaladhautajam|| 23.9 || vṛttāyataṃ suvṛttaṃ vā bhavedāyatameva vā| prasthamātrapramāṇāmbhaḥ pūrayogyāntarāṃ śubhām|| pādamānānusāreṇa pāduke raimaye śubhe| yadvā raupyamaye tāmramaye vā pādasanni bhe| tadādhāraṃ ca tallohaṃ nṛttaṃmadhye kṛtāmbujam| pādāvanejanajalagrahaṇaṃ pātramadbhutam|| 23.10 || tripādvṛttaṃ sarojābhaṃ haimaṃ rājatameva vā|| 23.11 || tāmraṃ sacakracaraṇamapi vā pāvanaṃ satām| ācāmavārigrahaṇapātramuttamalohajam|| 23.12 || sarojakarṇikākāraṃ kuryādadbhutadarśanam| kaṅkataṃ kanakaṃ rūpyamapivā ṣṭāṅgulāyatam|| 23.13 || ṣaḍaṅgulāyataṃ yadvā tadardhāṅgulavistṛtam| viṃśatyā daśanai ryuktaṃ bhavedubhayato mukham|| 23.14 || yadvā ṣoḍaśabhirdantairaṣṭābhirvā triyaṃgulam| sauvarṇamaṃjanakṣodabhājanaṃ puṃmṛgākṛti|| 23.15 || sihmākāraṃ bhavedyadvā haṃsākāramathāpi vā| śirobilaṃ śalākā ca dvādaśāṅgulamāyatā|| 23.16 || aṣṭāṃgulā vā sauvarṇī bhavedubhayato mukhā| mukhaṃ ca kesaraphalapratimaṃ saṃhataṃ bhavet|| 23.17 || darpaṇaṃ pratimāyānaṃ tadardhaṃ vāsuśo bhanam| vṛttaṃ kāṃsyaṃmahāratnakhacitaṃ vā yathāvasu|| 23.18 || pādayuktamayuktaṃ vā mukhamānamathāpi vā| kārtasvaramayī vṛttā rājatī vā tha pāvanī|| 23.19 || aratnimānavistārā madhye'ṣṭadalasaṃyutā| pratipadmadalaṃ madhye suṣirāṇi śataṃ bhavet|| 23.20 || karṇikāyāṃ kesareṣu viṣṭareṣu śataṃ bhavet| aṣṭottaraśataṃ bhūyaḥ paryantadalamadhyataḥ| khacitaṃ ca mahāratnairenaṃ dhārāsahasrakam|| 23.21 || dhārāṣṭakena saṃyuktamabhiṣekāya kalpayet| bimbānuguṇamānaṃ vā tālamānāvarāntakam|| 23.22 || atha vakṣyāmi saṃkṣepātpatākālakṣaṇaṃ dvija| aṣṭatālāyataṃ vastraṃ daśatālāyataṃ tu vā|| 23.23 || āyāmasamavistīrṇa kṣaumaṃ kārpāsaṃjaṃ tu vā| suślakṣṇaṃ śobhanākāraṃ nānāvarṇavicitritam|| 23.24 || vidhāya sūtramārgeṇa caturaśraṃ purāsamam| vibhajya koṇasūtrābhyāṃ pūrvabhāgaṃ tu lopayet|| 23.25 || dakṣiṇottarapāścātyairbhāgai rekasitāṃ nayet| tasyāḥ paścimapārśve tu yaṣṭiṃ saṃskṛtyayaujayet|| 23.26 || vyākoca paṅkajākāraṃ śuddamuttamalohajam| aḍhakā pūramānāmbhaḥ pūrayogyamahābilam|| 23.27 || hastadīrghajalasrāvī pārśvamānopaśobhitam| kalpayedaparaṃ snānapātraṃ muktāpariṣkṛtam|| 23.28 || yadvā śaṅkhanibhākāramagratojalanālakam| dhūpapātraṃ sarojābhaṃ suvarṇādivinirmitam || 23.29 || hastamānāntarālaṃ syānnālayuktaṃ tripāt dvipāt| pādayorapi tattatsyādutsedhaścaturaṃgulaḥ|| 23.30 || aneka suṣitaṃ tasyavidhānaṃ sahajaṃ bhavet| atha vā vikasatpadma sadṛśākāraśobhitam|| 23.31 || indunālaṃ tathāṅghrau ca daṇḍāgre supratiṣṭhitam| dīpapātraṃ tathā nālamadhye kumudakuṭmalam|| 23.32 || vartyādhāraiśśatenāpi yuktamaṣṭabhireva vā| viśatyā vāṣṭabhiścaiva dvābhyāṃ vā daśabhiścatatam|| 23.33 || aṣṭabhirvā yathāśakti kalpayecchilpavittamaḥ| śabdabrahmamayī ghaṇṭā hastotsedhapramāṇikā|| 23.34 || brahmaṇḍagolakākārassaurāṣṭrāvayavo bhavet| adhomukhastālamānavistārotsedhasaṃmitaḥ|| 23.35 || pradīpatulyasaṃsthāna stīkṣṇābhyantaratālukaḥ| tālonadaṇḍamūle syādagre su sthitapakṣirāṭ|| 23.36 || cakrāgrāṃ paṅkajāgraṃ vā ghaṇṭaiṣā parikīrtitā| nālabandhāścasro'nyā ghaṇṭā pratidiśaṃ kṛtā|| 23.37 || etasyā meva ghaṇṭāyāṃ yadvā vittānusārataḥ| nīrājanakriyā pātyo hemādi dravyanirmitāḥ|| 23.38 || tritālāyata vistrīrṇā vṛttamadhyasaroruhaḥ| navavāsaptavā paṃca tisraścaikāpi bhavet|| 23.39 || balipātraṃ catustrālaṃ hemādi dravyanirmitam| vṛttaṃ vā caturaśraṃ vā bahvaśraṃ vā yathāruci|| 23.40 || madhyato'ṣṭadalāṃbhojamathavā ṣoḍaśacchadam| dvādaśacchadasaṃ yuktamapi vā parikalpayet|| 23.41 || muktātapatraṃ dhavalaṃ śaśibhimbasama prabham| sitātapatrāṇi tathā barhipatra mayāni ca|| 23.42 || ātapatrāṇyanekāni haimadaṇḍāni padmaja| vyajanāni ca bhūyāṃsi kalyāṇāni mahānti ca|| 23.43 || cāmarāṇi ca śubhrāṇi ratnākalpamayāni ca| catuṣṭa mekadaṃbhāni pūjāṅgāni yathāyatham|| 23.44 || kalpayennāga latikā dalapātraṃ ca rai mayam| aratnimānavistīrṇaṃ tanmānotsedhadaṇḍakam|| 23.45 || saparyāviṣṭaraṃ brahman hastamānonnataṃ śubham| tadvā nyūnasamutsedhaṃ yadvā vittānusārataḥ|| 23.46 || aratnimātra vistāraṃ tanmānāyāmakalpanam| saṃhmapādayutaṃ yadvā hastipāda catuṣṭayam|| 23.47 || śārdulapādamathavā hemaratna pariṣkṛtam| caturaśraṃ madhyaklṛpta sarasīruhacitritam|| 23.48 || sacakraṃ pīṭhasahitaṃ mārgayuktaṃ sagātrakam| yadvā cakravinirmuktaiṃ mārge hastaiḥ pariṣkṛtam|| 23.49 || tapanīyyamayaṃ yadvā rajatādivirmitam|| dārujaṃ vā maṇicchannaṃ svarṇa paṭṭairvirājitam|| 23.50 || snānāsanaṃ ca pūrvoktavistārotsedhasaṃmitaṃ| dviguṇaṃ cāyataṃ klaptaṃ makarāsyāmbunālakam|| 23.51 || caturaṅgulaparyantaṃ tālotsedhavirājitam| kuryāccapūrva vattasya darśanīyamanuttamam|| 23.52 || alaṅgārāsanaṃcāpi pūrvo ktacaraṇai ryutam| dviguṇāyāmavistāraṃ hemaratna vibhūṣitam|| 23.53 || pādahīnaṃ catustāla vistāraṃ dviguṇāyatam| ghanaṃ ca dvyaṃgulaṃ tasya bhojanāsanamīritam|| 23.54 || yātrāsanaṃ ca vistīrṇaṃ dvihastaṃ hrasvapādakam| dviguṇaṃ cāyataṃ tasya sālaṃ tālonnataṃ bhavet|| 23.55 || yānaviṣṭarasālasya madhye dvāraṃ prakalpayet| avatārakathopetaṃ hemaratnapariṣkṛtam|| 23.56 || āsanāni yathoktāni lohajāni caturmukha| dārujāni yathālābhaṃ kalpayecchilpavittamaḥ|| 23.57 || yadvā sanānāmāyāmo vistāraśconnatistathā| arcāpramāṇānuguṇaṃ kalpayediti nirṇayaḥ|| 23.58 || yatrāsanaṃ rathaṃ vāpi kuryādvittānusārataḥ| sitāsitāruṇāmiśratukulaparikalpitān|| 23.59 || dhvajān kārtasvaramayai rdaṃḍai ścāpi virājitān| vāhanāni ca devānāṃ daṇḍāgre parikalpayet|| 23.60 || plākṣānvā vaiṇavān daṇḍān kevalānparikalpayet| jaladroṇīṃ kaṭāhaṃ ca hemādi dravyanirmitam|| 23.61 || agādhamabhiṣekārthaṃ devasya parikalpayet| nānāvidhāni vādyāni vīṇādīni ca kalpayet|| 23.62 || arghyapādyādi pātrāṇāṃ pātramānānusārataḥ| caraṇāni suvarṇādi dravyaklaptāni kārayet|| 23.63 || iti śripāñcarātre mahopaniṣadi kriyāpāde pūjopakaraṇa lakṣaṇaṃ nāma trayoviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ |
<2.24>
śrībhāgavān ācāryalakṣaṇaṃ brahman kathayāmi yathātathām| ādau tu brāhmaṇo vidvān pañcarātraparāyaṇaḥ|| 24.1 || sarvadoṣavinirmuktamaśeṣaguṇabhājanam| ācāryaṃ varayetpūrvaṃ tadadhīnā hisiddhayaḥ|| 24.2 || nyūnātirekanirmuktakalyāṇāvayavaśśuciḥ| kalyāṇahastaśśrutavān vṛttavān śīlavānapi|| 24.3 || āmnāyecandasi tathā brāhmaṇo dharmavatsalaḥ| paṃca kālavidhānajñastakatkarmaniyataḥ kṣamīḥ|| 24.4 || jitendriyaḥ praśśrīmānuhāpohavicakṣaṇaḥ| ṣaṭkarmakṛt ṣaḍadhvajṣañṣaḍaṅgavidalolupaḥ|| 24.5 || ṣoḍaśanyācaturassaumyastiddhāntabhedavit| ṛjurdayāvān brahmajñatsatyavāk śiṣṭasaṃmataḥ|| 24.6 || vyākhyātā dhṛtimānāryaḥ pūrvabhāṣī priyaṃvadaḥ| smitapūrvābhibhāṣī ca sātviko nyāyavittamaḥ|| 24.7 || darśanīyo yuvā vādi vā deṣu ca vicakṣaṇaḥ| kuśāgrīyamatiśśāntaḥ nītijñodeśakālavit|| 24.8 || anasūyo jitadvandvassamassarveṣu jantuṣu| vyasanābhyudaye śaśvadekarūpassadavyayaḥ|| 24.9 || mitabhāṣī dhyānaparo dvādaśākṣaracintakaḥ| mānasārādhanaparaḥ paṃcarātraparāyaṇaḥ|| 24.10 || svatantro vṛddhasevī ca rūpavānapi cāstikaḥ| abrahmanindakassarvasmṛtimān kīrtimānapi|| 24.11 || sarvāpavādanirmaktassarvakalyāṇalakṣaṇaḥ| sarvaśāstrārthavettā ca dīkṣitaścakramaṇḍale|| 24.12 || gṛhastho brahmacārī ca vānaprastho'thavā bhavet| adhikārī bhavedeṣa yathoktaguṇabhājanam|| 24.13 || ācāryatve tathārtvihye tādṛśāneva bhūsurān| guṇaissarvaissamuditān karmanirvahaṇakṣamān|| 24.14 || varayedguruṇā sārdhaṃ yajamānaḥ prayatnavān| vaṭuryuvā samovṛddhaścaturthāparikathyate|| 24.15 || dvayorvibhāgitassamyaksavibhāgaśca kathyate| varṣāt ṣoḍaśakādarvāk vaṭurityabhidhīyate|| 24.16 || vaṭuryāvā samo vṛddho yogyo nityārcanāvidhau| nai mittike sāṅgure tu samaśśreṣṭhatamenavā|| 24.17 || samaye jamānastu gāṃ bhuvaṃ kāṃcanaṃ tathā| nālikeraṃ ca karmādavācāryāya pradāpayet|| 24.18 || ṛtvijaṣṣoḍaśa brahman yadvāṣṭau caturopi vā| ācāryoṇaya thokaina ṛtvigbhiśca yathoditaiḥ|| 24.19 || sthāpayenmandire viṣṇu yajamānaḥ prayatnavān| sarvān kāmānavāpnoti nātrikāryā vicāraṇā|| 24.20 || anyathā ceddhariṃ dhāmnisthāpayenmūḍhacetanaḥ| nai veṣṭaṃ phalamāpnoti mriyate cā cirātsvayam|| 24.21 || na ca dhāma cirasthāyi na ca rāṣṭraṃ narādhipaḥ| nasannidhatai bhagavān na ca prīṇāti cejyayā|| 24.22 || nai vādhikārī nasyāpī brāhmaṇo pyuktalakṣaṇaḥ| itarepi trayovarṇāḥ yajane vādhikāriṇaḥ|| 24.23 || na kuṇḍa golau nai vānye bhaveyuranulomajāḥ| karmādhikāriṇo naiva vrātyā vai brahmayonayaḥ|| 24.24 || nai teṣāmadikāro'sti sūtādīnāṃ caturmukha| pratiṣṭhā karmaṇaḥ pūrva maṅkurāropaṇaṃ bhavet|| 24.25 || na karmaphaladaṃ brahman aṅkararopaṇaṃ vinā| tasmādārabhyamāṇeṣu pratiṣṭhādiṣu karmasu|| 24.26 || prāgeva vāpayedbījān aṅkurārthaṃ yathāvidhi| dvādaśāhe navāhe vā sastāhe pañcame'hani|| 24.27 || tṛtīye'hani vā kuryātkarmārambhadinaṃ prati| pālikasu śarāveṣu ghaṭikāsu ca vāpayet|| 24.28 || aṅgurāṇi praśastāni pātreṣu trividheṣvapi| sāṅgulaṃ hastamutsedhaṃ pālikānāmathānanam|| 24.29 || ṣoḍaśāṅgulavistāraṃ bilaṃ saptāṃgulaṃ bhavet|| pādapīṭhasya vistāra madhaścaivāṃgulaṃ bhavet|| 24.30 || unmattakusumākāraṃ vaktramambojasannibham| dvāviṃśāṃgula māyāmo ghaṭikānāṃprakīrtitaḥ|| 24.31 || ghaṭikāḥ pañcavaktrāssyustanmadhye tu ghuṭākṛtiḥ| ṣaḍaṅgulaṃ ca vistirṇaṃ etānāṃ madhyamaṃ mukham|| 24.32 || catuṣṭayaṃ caturdikṣu caturaṃgulamānanam| viṃśatyaṃgulamutsedhaṃ vistāraṃ dvādaśāṃgulam|| 24.33 || śarāveṣu vijānīyādyadvā mānaṃ yathāvasu| hemādi lohajāssarvāḥ mṛṇmayā vā yathāvasu|| 24.34 || ṣaṭtriṃśatpālikāścaiva ṣaṭtriṃśadghaṭi kāstathā| śarāvāścāpi ṣaṭtriṃśadevamaṣṭottaraṃ śatam|| 24.35 || uttamā kl ptiruditā jaghanyā kl ptirucyate| pratyekaṃ ṣoḍaśa grāhyā bhaveyurdvādaśāpi vā|| 24.36 || aṣṭau vā syuścatasro vā śarāvaghaṭapālikāḥ| sarvārthe pālikā yadvāṣoḍaśāṣṭau yathābalam|| 24.37 || catasro vā tatastāsu maṅgalāṅgulakalpanā| ayugmā mānuṣe kāryā daiveyugmāstu pālikāḥ|| 24.38 || aṅgulāvāpanastāne maṇḍapaṃ parikalpayet| śubhe vivikte'bhimate deśe vai deśi kottamaḥ|| 24.39 || caturdikṣu caturdvāraṃ caturvadanamālikam| darbhamālāparikṣiptaṃ muktādāmavirājitam|| 24.40 || vitānakṣaumavistāraṃ gomayāliptabhūtalaṃ| pradīpamālāvitatamakṣataiścāpinarvataḥ|| 24.41 || sudhācūrṇaiśca dhavalai ścitritābhyantarasthalam| maṇḍapaṃ kalpayitvaivaṃ gṛhṇiyāttatramṛttikām|| 24.42 || khanitraṃ kṣālayitvādbhirācchādya navavāsasā| viṣvaksenamatho vāpi vainateyamathāpivā|| 24.43 || sumanobhiralaṃkṛtya ṛtvigbhirvāhayedguruḥ| gajaskandhaṃ rathaṃ vāśva mārūḍho vāhako nayet|| 24.44 || chatradhvajapatākābhissārdha maṅgurabhājanaiḥ| trividhairmaṅgalaistūryaiṃ rapicodghoṣyasarvataḥ|| 24.45 || bhaktairbhāgavataissārdhaṃ yatibhirmunibhistathā| niṣkramya śākunaṃ sūktaṃ pāṭhayan bhahvṛcānapi|| 24.46 || prācīmudīcīṃ vā dūrāṃ diśaṃgatvā manohare| śucau deśe mṛdaṃ śuddhāṃ khanitreṇa samuddharet|| 24.47 || astramantreṇa dharaṇīṃ saṃprokṣya prathamaṃ guruḥ| mahīsūktena saṃspṛśya dhāyanne kāgracetasā|| 24.48 || mūrtiṃ devasya vārāhīṃ abhyarca kusumairbhuvam| astrāmbunā praukṣitena puṣperabhyarcitena ca|| 24.49 || khanitreṇa khanedbhūmiṃ prāṅmukhaḥ kroḍavidyayā| lohaje bhājane mṛtsnāṃ vetraje vātha bhājane|| 24.50 || gṛhītvā mulamantreṇa veṣṭayitvā ca vāsasā| pratyagreṇa tathā nadyā vālukān gomayāṃ stathā|| 24.51 || gokulātpūrvanatpātre gṛhītvā cchādya cāṃśukaiḥ| yāne haye gaje vāpi samāropya guruspvayam|| 24.52 || ṛtvigbhissahitaistūktamadhīyānaiśca śākulam| śrīsūktaṃ bhūmisūktaṃ ca tūryāṇyapi ca ghoṣayet|| 24.53 || gatvā pradakṣiṇaṃ grāmaṃ praviśenmaṇṭapaṃ tataḥ| ācāryāmūrtipāścaiva nūtanakṣaumavāsasaḥ|| 24.54 || sottarīyāssvalaṃkārāssoṣṇīṣāssāṅgulīyakāḥ| surabhīkṛtasarvāṅgāssragviṇo mṛṣṭakuṇṭalāḥ|| 24.55 || śvetayā mṛtsnayā samyakparikṣiptordhvapuṇḍrakāḥ| pavitrapāṇayassnātāḥ prāṇāyāmaparāyaṇāḥ|| 24.56 || kṛtācāmāḥ kṛtanyāsāḥ japtamantrā yathātatham| tadarthamarthayitvā tu yajamānasamanvitāḥ|| 24.57 || bhagavantaṃ jagadvoniṃ pūjayitvā vidhanataḥ| saṃprokṣya pālikākṣetra madbhiśuddhābhirañjasā|| 24.58 || candanārdāṇi sūtrāṇi sphālayeyuranukramāt| prāgāyatāni prathamaṃ ṛjūni dvādaśa sphuṭam|| 24.59 || tathodagāyatāgrāṇi daśa pañca ca kalpayet| āśāsvaṣṭāsu madhyeca śaravaghaṭapālikāḥ|| 24.60 || dvādaśa dvādaśa sthāpyāśśatamaṣṭottaraṃ tathā| āgneye naiṛte bhāge tathā yamye ca pālikāḥ|| 24.61 || ghaṭikā vāruṇe brāhme tathā paurandare pi ca| śarā vā mārute saumyeraudre cāpi yathāvidhi|| 24.62 || prāgrāyatāni nava vā sūtrāṇi parikalpayet| dvādaśaivetarāṇu syuśśarāvaghaṭapālikāḥ|| 24.63 || aṣṭau ca catvāriṃśacca yadvā sūtrāṇi kalpayet| navaiva dviprakārāṇi ṣaṭ triṃśatpālikādayaḥ|| 24.64 || prāgāyatāni nava vā udhīcīnāyatāni ṣaṭ| caturviṃśatipātrāṇi yadvā prāgayatāni ca|| 24.65 || catvāri sūtrāṇyanyāni paṃca dvādaśa kalpane| sarvārthapakṣe prathame paṃcaiva dpividhānyapi|| 24.66 || yadvendukumbhaṃ paritaḥ pālikāṣṣoḍaśasthitāḥ| dvādaśāpi tathaivāṣṭau catasro vā diśaṃ prati|| 24.67 || sūtrapātreṣu sarvatra pratyaksomaghaṭasthitiḥ| śaktyapekṣaṃ pālikānāṃ pakṣabhedaḥ pradarśitaḥ|| 24.68 || prakṣālya viṣṇugāyatryā śaravaghaṭapālikāḥ| sahadevī ca dūrvā ca sārdhamaśvatthapallavaiḥ|| 24.69 || kaṇṭheṣu pālikādīnāṃ bandanīyāścaturmukha| kuśakāśatṛṇai saiṣāṃ bilamūlāni pūrayet|| 24.70 || bilāni prathamaṃ mṛdbhirvālukābhiranantaram| karīṣacūrṇairupari samṛddhaṃ pūrayedbilam|| 24.71 || pādeṣu pālikādīnāṃ śālinvrīhīnathāpi vā| āḍhakaṃ vā tadardhaṃ vā prasthaṃ vā tilataṇḍulān|| 24.72 || pratipādaṃ vinikṣipya caturaśramathāpi vā| vṛttaṃ vistārayetpūrvaṃ pālikārdīn tataḥ kramāt|| 24.73 || nyasetpādeṣu dhānyeṣu mantrairetai ryathākramam| sthāne yathokai ghaṭikāḥ pārameṣṭhyā tu vidyayā|| 24.74 || puruṣākhyena mantreṇa pālikāstadanantaram| śarāvānviśvamantreṇa pāṅmukho vāpyumaṅmukhaḥ|| 24.75 || brahmādīśānaparyantaṃ nyāsasaiṣāmanu kramāt| vāsobhirveṣṭayetsarvān pratyekaṃ mūlavidyayā|| 24.76 || prativyūhaṃ tu vā śaktau chādayedvāsasopari| sthāne paścāttu sarveṣāṃ somakumbhaṃ niveśayet|| 24.77 || dhānyarāśau yathāpūrvamāveṣṭya navāsasā| gandhodakena saṃpūrṇetasmin ratnāni vinyatet|| 24.78 || nīvārāśśālayo mudgāśśyāmākāśca priyaṅgavaḥ| yavāstilāśca godhūmāḥ yecānye yājñikā matāḥ|| 24.79 || teśāṃ bhījāni nikṣipya pātre mahati nutane| tatpātraṃ mūrdhni vinyasya tūryaghoṣapurassaram|| 24.80 || parītya mandiraṃ pātra śāli droṇārdhaśobhite| pāgdeśe pālikādīnāṃ niveśya susamāhitaḥ|| 24.81 || payobhiḥ kṣālayeddhānyabhījāni vividhāni ca| pracchādyanavavastreṇa purṇāhaṃ kāraye tpunaḥ|| 24.82 || śaṅkhabheryādinādena vādayitvā diśodaśa| dhyātyā ca pālikādīnāmadhidevānanukramāt|| 24.83 || ghaṭikānāṃ vidhātāraṃ pālikānāṃ janārdhanam| īśānaṃ ca śarāvāṇāṃ dyātvābhyarcya yathāvidhi|| 24.84 || toraṇāni dhvajāṃścaiva dvārakumbhāṃśca deśikaḥ| kumudādi gaṇāṃścaiva samabhyarcayathāvidhi|| 24.85 || rcayetpālikādīnāmadhi devānanukramāt| somakumbhe tatassomaṃ yajedāvāhya ca svayam|| 24.86 || nivedya pāyasaṃ havyaṃ juhuyātsarpiṣāśatam| catasrassamidhaścaina mūlamantreṇa mantravit|| 24.87 || caruṃ puruṣasūkaina pūrṇāhutyantamācaret| ghṛtena somamantreṇa juhuyācchatamāhutīḥ|| 24.88 || saṃpātājyena saṃsparśya sparśamantreṇa pālikāḥ| saṃpātājyāva śeṣaṃ ca bījapātre vinikṣipet|| 24.89 || somamantraṃ śataṃ vārān japtvā viprābhyasujñayā| muhūrteśobhane bhījān vāpayetpālikādiṣu|| 24.90 || brahmādīśānaparyantaṃ dvādaśākṣaravidyayā| ācāryānumatā ścānyevaiṣṇavā dhyānamāsthātāḥ|| 24.91 || āvapeyuramī tūrṣṇīṃ siñcetkumbhasthavāribhiḥ| pidhānaiścādayetsarvaṃ dadyāddikṣu baliṃtataḥ|| 24.92 || rakṣibhyaḥ kumudādibhyo baliṃ dadyāddivāniśam| yajeta somaṃ tatkumbhe pāyasena divāniśam|| 24.93 || dīpāṃścāropitānrakṣedanirvāṇāṃ yathā tathā| dvijendrāṃstoṣayediṣṭaistāmbūlaissumanaḥ phalaiḥ|| 24.94 || guruṃ ca toṣayedvattairyajamānaḥ prayatnavān| sadyo vā dhānyabhījāni yathoktavidhinā vapet|| 24.95 || haridrā vāribhissiñcedaṅkurāṇyabhi vṛddhaye| somakuṃbhajalenāpi nityaṃ siñcetapālikāḥ|| 24.96 || aṅgureṣu ca pīteṣu śukleṣu ca tathā śubham| vidyādṛjuṃ prarūḍheṣu viparīteṣu cāśubham|| 24.97 || karmārthamaṅku rāṇyādau yassamāropayedguruḥ| sa eva karmakārtsnyena kuryātprājño'pi netaraḥ|| 24.98 || anujñayā vā tatputraśśiṣyo vā tatsamācaret| ṛtvijo vāpitatkarma yadyaśaktogururbhavet|| 24.99 || iti śrīpāñcarātre mahopaniṣadi kriyāpāde ācāryalakṣaṇāṅkurārpaṇa vidhirnāma caturviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ |
<2.25>
śrībhagavān athātassaṃpravakṣyāmi pratiṣṭhāvidhimuttamam| ayanaṃ cottaraṃ mukhyaṃ jaghanyaṃ dakṣiṇāyanam|| 25.1 || sthāpanaṃ druvaberasya mukhya eva sadeṣyate| jaṅgamasthāpane mukhye jaghanye cāpi vā bhavet|| 25.2 || māghamāse bhādrapade pratiṣṭhaṃ māsi varjayet| gurāvastaṃ gate śukre vyatipāte ca varjayet|| 25.3 || saṅkrāntau durdinecaiva grahaṇe somasūryayoḥ| pārastācca purastācca ṣoḍaśāhāni varjayet|| 25.4 || aticāre tathā māse parvayugmayute tathā| apraśasteṣu yogeṣu kāṇasthūṇāndhabheṣu ca|| 25.5 || evamādiṣucānyeṣu garhiteṣu na talpayet| rājño rāṣṭrasyacānyasya grāmasya ca gurostathā|| 25.6 || yajamānasya dhiṣṇyasya śubheṣvanuguṇeṣu ca| tithinakṣatra vāreṣu muhūrteṣu śubheṣu ca|| 25.7 || prathamā ca dvitīyā ca pañcamī ca trayodaśi| tṛtīyā saptamī ṣaṣṭhīdvādaśyaikādaśī tathā|| 25.8 || daśamīpūrṇimāsī ca śuklapakṣe śubhāstvimāḥ| kṛṣṇe tu pañcimīyāvattithayapsaṃprakīrtitāḥ|| 25.9 || triṣūttareṣu revatyāmaśvinyāṃ rohiṇīṣu ca| puṣyepunarvasau cāpi haste ca śravaṇe tathā|| 25.10 || devasya sthāpanaṃ kuryādviṣṇorabhyudayā vaham| some bṛhaspatiścaiva bhārgavo'tha budhastathā|| 25.11 || ete saumyagrahāḥ proktāḥ praśastāḥ sthāpanaṃ prati| saiṃhike yārka vārāścarikto vā sthāpane pare|| 25.12 || rāśau tṛtīye ṣaṣṭhe vā sthitāścet śubhaśaṃsinaḥ| dvitīye ca tṛtīye ca tathā pañcamaṣaṣṭhayoḥ|| 25.13 || saptame navame caiva rāśau cai kādaśe punaḥ| sthitassukhakaraścandraḥ ṣaṭsaptadaśamasthitaḥ|| 25.14 || bhayakṛdbhārgavo jñeyaścandraḥ krūrairnirīkṣitaḥ| atithau vānyakāleṣu na praśastaścaturmukha|| 25.15 || bahunātra kimuktena saha mauhūrtikairguruḥ| sthāpanaṃ devadevasya kuryātkāle'bhipūjite|| 25.16 || prāsādasyāgrataḥ kuryādadhivāsana maṇṭapam| prathamāvaraṇe kuryāte dvitīyāvaraṇepi vā|| 25.17 || tṛtīyāvarṇe vāpi deśe yogyāvakāśake| āśāsvaṣṭāsvabhimate deśe maṇṭapakalpanam|| 25.18 || vistīrṇaṃ daśabhirhastaistāvadbhiścāyataṃ karaiḥ| caturdikṣucaturdvāraṃ maṇḍapaṃ parikalpayet|| 25.19 || tanmadhye pañcahastā syādvedī hasta samucchṛtā| caturaśreṣṭakacitā kuṇḍāni paritastataḥ|| 25.20 || devikāyāstritāle samāni viṣamāṇi vā| caturaśraṃ caturviṃśadaṅgulaṃ bhutalaṃ khanet|| 25.21 || vistārāyāmasadṛśaṃ paritaḥ khātabhūtalam| dvyaṃgulaṃ tadbahiḥ kalpyaṃ mekhalātrayamaiṣṭakam|| 25.22 || kuṇḍasya prakṛterarvāk catvāro mekhalāstu vā| kuṇḍavrakṛtirucchrāyamaṃgulānāṃ ca viṃśatiḥ|| 25.23 || adhastādunnatā tasya ṣoḍaśāṃgulamekhalā| tālotsedhamitāpūrvā madhyamāṣṭāṃgulonnatā|| 25.24 || tadandhenocchṛtā cānyā vistāraścaturaṃgulaḥ| sarvāsāṃ sātvikī cādyā madhyamā rājasī matā|| 25.25 || anyā ca tāmasī jñeyā tadanyā triguṇātmikā| paścime prakṛte rūrdhveyoniḥ pañcadaśāṃgulā|| 25.26 || āyatā mūlamārabhya vistīrṇā kramaśo bhavet| aṅgulairdaśabhiṣṣaḍbhiścaturbhirdvyaṅgulena ca|| 25.27 || ekena cāgre kalpyai va mekhalopari śobhanā| yonivatsanni veśena pippalacchadavadbhavet|| 25.28 || krameṇa nimnā pratyaksthā kuṇḍasyāgre niveśitā| agreca yone rnālaṃsyāt caturaṃgulamāyatam|| 25.29 || tryaṅgulaṃ nahanaṃ mūle mukhe caiva ṣaḍaṅgulam| kāhalākāravatkuryādyamasya diśi vā bhavet|| 25.30 || yoni rhotā yadi bhavedudīcīna mukhassvayam| vinā vā juhuyādyoni mokṣāya tvarate yadi|| 25.31 || kuṇḍamāne dvihastādau mekhalādi ca tādṛśam| yadvaikamekhalaṃ kuṇḍaṃ kartā satvarito yadi|| 25.32 || kuṇḍārdhaṃ koṇabhāgārdhaṃ dvayaṃ tenaiva saṃmitam| sūtramārabhya kuṇḍasya madhyaṃ dakṣiṇato diśi|| 25.33 || sthāpayitvā puraḥ paścātsūttārdhaṃ bhrāmayettataḥ| arthacandravadetena kuṇḍamāviṣkṛtaṃ bhavet|| 25.34 || kuṇḍārthādavaśiṣṭaṃ yatkoṇe tasyārdhameva ca| kuṇḍārdhaṃ ca dvayaṃ tena saṃmitaṃ sūtramāyatam|| 25.35 || tatkuṇḍamadhye saṃsthāpya sthāpayeddiṣu sarvataḥ| vṛttakuṇḍaṃ bhavettena sanniviṣṭaṃ sarojavat|| 25.36 || dalāni mekhalāsthāne kalpayedvādaśāṣṭa vā| vibhajya pañcadhā kuṇḍaṃ bahirbhāgaṃ dvayāyatam|| 25.37 || sūtraṃ kuṇḍasya madhye tu sthāpayitvā thapārśvayoḥ| gamayetsūtra pā tāntaṃ trikoṇaṃ tena kalpayet|| 25.38 || saṃvibhajyāṣṭadhā kuṇḍaṃ bhāgenai kena vardhayet| ubhābhyāmapi bhāgabhyāṃ tasmānmadhyaṃ pragṛhya ca|| 25.39 || lāñchayet ṣaṭsu koṇeṣu tatra ṣaṭsūtrapātalanam| kṛtvā tatra bhavetkuṇḍaṃ ṣaṭkoṇaṃ kamalāsana|| 25. 40 || caturviṃśati bhāgaṃ tu kṛtvā kṣetraṃ puroditam| ekabhāgaṃ bahiḥ paścāt sarvatraiva niveśayet|| 25.41 || madhyātkoṇādgṛhītvaivaṃ paścāttaddikṣu lāñcayet| tatastatsūtra saṃyogādaṣṭakoṇaṃ bhavet sphuṭam|| 25.42 || pañcakoṇa vibhāgena sūtrapāto vidhīyate| pañcādaśāṃgulaṃ sūtraṃ koṇe koṇe tu pātayet|| 25.43 || koṇāntarāṇi kurvīta aṣṭādaśabhiraṅgulaiḥ| sūtrayetpūrvadiksūtraṃ paṃcakoṇetu pātayet|| 25. 44 || daśāṅgulaṃ madhyamaṃ tu bhrāmayetsamasūtrakam| daśāṃṅgulaṃ tathāyoniṃ kuryādaśvatthapatravat|| 25.45 || yādṛgvidhaṃ bhavetkuṇḍaṃ tādṛgeva tu mekhalā| yoniṃ kuṇḍeṣu sarveṣu kalpayetkamalāsana|| 25.46 || yonikuṇḍena yonissyātpadmakuṇḍena paṅkajam| padmaṃ kuṇḍeṣu sarveṣu khātamadhye prakalpayet|| 25.47 || pūrvoktetudalasthāne arāṇi parikalpayet| cakrakuṇṭaṃ bhavettena padmakuṇḍaṃ tadeva tu|| 25.48 || tato'gulivaśādvadvā kuryātkuṇḍāni padmaja| pūrvadikcāpakuṇḍaṃ ca paścime jyāṃ prakalpayet|| 25.49 || caturviṃśāṅgulaṃ sūtraṃ vistārāyāma saṃyutam| caturaśrasamāyuktaṃ caturaśraṃ vidhīyate|| 25.50 || ṣaṣṭyaṅgulaṃ bhaveccāpaṃ jyātu ṣaṭtriṃśadaṃgulā| cāpakuṇḍaṃ bhavedevaṃ dvātriṃśatvaṅgulaṃ punaḥ|| 25.51 || pātayottriguṇe nata3 trikoṇaṃ vidyate sphuṭam| pañcādaśāṃgulaṃ sūtraṃ madhyato bhrāmayettataḥ|| 25.52 || vṛttakuṇḍaṃ bhavedevaṃ padmakuṇḍaṃ tadeva tu| padmaṃ padma samākāraṃ karṇakādalasaṃyutam|| 25.53 || yathā vṛttapramāṇaṃ hi tathā padmasya lakṣaṇam| caturaśraṃ bhavetkuṇḍaṃ vedyāḥ prācinabhutale|| 25.54 || kuṇḍaṃ dakṣiṇato vidyādardhacandrasamākṛti| vṛttaṃ tu paścime deśe uttare kamalākṛti|| 25.55 || yadvā trikoṇaṃ tatra syā ccatuṣkuṃḍaṃ prakalpayet| indreśānāstare padmaṃ yadvā ca caturaśrakam|| 25.56 || prākpratyakkamalaṃ kuṇḍaṃ pañcakuṃḍa vidhau bhavet| diśyagneryonikuṃṇḍaṃ syātrikoṇaṃ tu tricakṣuṣaḥ|| 25.57 || saptakuṇḍavidhāno'yaṃ prakāraḥ kamalāsana | caturaśraṃ bhavetprācyāmagnerdiśi bhagākṛti|| 25.58 || cāpākṛti yamasya syāt ṣaḍaśraṃ nirṛterbhavet| varuṇasya bhavedvṛttaṃ pañcāśaṃ mātariśvanaḥ|| 25.59 || trikoṇaṃ naravāhasya īśānasyāṣṭakoṇakam| caturaśrasya kuṇḍasya prāgdeśe kamalākṛti|| 25.60 || navakuṇḍavidau klptiriyaṃ viṣayama vahniṣu| samavarhniṣu pūrvādi dikṣu kuṇḍaṃ kramādbhavet|| 25.61 || caturaśraṃ tataścāpaṃ vṛttaṃ koṇatrayānvitam| catuṣkuṇḍavidhāne syāt ṣaṭkuṇḍe tūcyate vidhiḥ|| 25.62 || catvāri pūrvavatkṛtvā diśyagneryonikalpanam| ṣaḍaśraṃ diśi kuṇḍaṃ syātṣaḍardhanayanasya tu|| 25.63 || aṣṭakuṇḍe tvaṣṭadikṣu kuṇḍānyaṣṭau yathākramam| caturaśraṃ bhagākāraṃ cāpākāraṃ ṣaḍaśrakam|| 25.64 || vṛttaṃ pañcāśramuditaṃ trikoṇaṃ cāṣṭakoṇakam| trīṇi trīṇi ca kuṇḍāni yadvā diṣu prakalpayet|| 25.65 || kamalaṃ catrikoṇaṃ ca dikṣu kuṇḍasya pārśvayoḥ| kalpayecca caturdikṣu dviṣaṭke'gnivibhirbhavet|| 25.66 || pañcamūrti pratiṣṭhāyāṃ navāgniṃ parikalpayet| paṃcavāsaptavā vahniṃ caturmūtau tu kalpayet|| 25.67 || aṣṭaṣaḍvātha caturaḥ kalpayejjātavedasaḥ| athavā dvādaśāpyargnī kalpayetkamalāsana|| 25.68 || ekamūrtau vītihotrāḥ yugmāsyuratha vetare| prapāyāṃ vedimathavā mahatyāṃ kamalāsana|| 25.69 || ṣoḍaśaptambha paramāṃ prapāṃ yadvā prakalpayet| dvārāṇi dikṣu catvāri prapāyāḥ parikalpayet|| 25.70 || tiraskariṇyā paritaśchādayenmaṇḍapā ntaram| snānamaṇḍapamaiśānyāṃ diśi tasya prakalpayet|| 25.71 || snānavedī ca tatra syātprāgbhāge hastasaṃmitā| dvihastā vā trihastā vā ha stamātrasamucchrayā|| 25.72 || yadvā tālasamutsedhā caturśā manoharā| digbhāge jalakulyā tu saumye nimnā manoharā|| 25.73 || sruksravau lakṣaṇopetau homārthaṃ parikalpayet| pālāśīṃ khādirīṃ vāpi srucaṃ yadvā'vyavṛkṣajām|| 25.74 || yājñīyāṃ kalpayecchilpī bāhudaṇḍasamāyatām| hemādilohajaṃ vāpi dārujāṃ vāpi bhūṣitām|| 25.75 || dvitālasaṃmitāṃ vāpi sāṃgulāṃ kamalāsana| trithā vidhāyatāṃ bhūyastṛtīye'mśe dvidhā kṛte|| 25.76 || uparyaṃśaṃ punaḥ kuryāt pañcadhā caturaṃśakaiḥ| bhavetsruco'graṃ tanmūlaṃ vistāreṇa ṣaḍaṃgulaṃ|| 25.77 || agramekāṃgulaṃ kroḍavaktra vatparikalpayet| paṃcāṃ śenavaśiṣṭena bhāgena galakalpanam|| 25.78 || galaṃ dvyaṃgulaviptāramubhayostasya pārśvayoḥ| ardhāṃgulaṃ bhavennimnaṃ vistārāyāmatatsamam|| 25.79 || tyajedaṃśamaśeṣeṇa sūtrapātādbahiḥ sthitam| galasyādho'vaśiṣṭāṃśo vṛttau vā caturaśrakaḥ|| 25.80 || vistārāyāmasadṛśaṃ syādgarthaṃ tasya madhyataḥ| vṛttaṃ tṛtīyabhāgena saṃmitaṃ śobhanākṛti|| 25.81 || gadhāṃ vistārasadṛśaṃ gartasya parikīrtyate| gartabhāhyaṃ tridhā kṛtvā prathame'ṣṭadalasthiti|| 25.82 || madhyameṃśe caturdhā tu vibhajennābhimaṇḍalam| prathame parikalpyaṃ syādambhoruha niketana|| 25.83 || dvābhyāṃ tu madhyamāṃśābhyāṃ ṣaḍaraṃ dviguṇaṃ tu vā| avaśiṣṭena bhāgena nemimaṇḍalakalpanam|| 25.84 || śaṅkhāṃścaturṣu koṇeṣu caturaśra prakalpane| yavonnatā bahiḥ kāryā mekhalā ca caturya vā|| 25.85 || ārabhya garthamagrāntaṃ vivaraṃ sarpiṣo bhavet| sarojavṛṣṭhasamaṃ pṛṣṭhabhāgaṃ prakalpayet|| 25.86 || kūrmapṛṣṭhasamaṃ yadvā caturaśraṃ sapīṭhikā| adhasthādviguṇastasya daṇḍāyāmaṃ pracakṣate|| 25.87 || taddaṇḍamaṣṭadhā kṛtvā mūlabhāgena kalpayet| adhastātkumbhamardhena śiṣṭenopari paṃkajam|| 25.88 || mūlaṃ prakalpayedevaṃ padme daṇḍaḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ| ādhāraṃ vā vinā daṇḍo valayaistribhiraṅkitaḥ|| 25.89 || vṛtto'thavā tadardhāśrastadagramapi paṅkajam| tribhirvā valayairyuktaṃ nāhanaṃ cāṃgulaṃ bhavet|| 25.90 || sruvaṃ ca hastamānaṃ syāttadagraṃ dvyaṃgulaṃ bhavet| vāsaṃkāpuṭavadgartadvayayuktaṃ suvṛttakam|| 25.91 || gartamardhāṃgulaṃ nimnaṃ vistīrṇaṃ cārdhamaṅgulaṃ| aṃgulenāvaśiṣṭena parito golakalpanam|| 25.92 || bilayoḥ pṛṣṭhabhāgetu madhyurekhā yavonnatā| ayugmavalayaṃ kaṇṭhe yavamātronnataṃ śubham|| 25.93 || daṇḍaṃ ca pariśiṣṭena golāṅgūlākṛtirbhavet| mūlaṃ dvyaṃgulavistrīrṇaṃ lohajo dārujopivā|| 25.94 || sphūṭitaṃ saktimiṃ bhinnamūrdhvaśuṣkaṃ sakoṭaram| svayaṃ nipatitaṃ vṛkṣaṃ sruksruvārthe parityajet|| 25.95 || svīkuryācce tpramādena bhūyān doṣaḥ prasajyate| dvāreṣu maṇḍapasya syāttoraṇānāṃ catuṣṭayam|| 25.96 || aśvattho dumbharavaṭaklakṣaiḥ prāgādi toraṇāḥ| e kenavā yathoktenaalābhecandanadrumaḥ||25.97 || saptahastāyatāḥ pādāḥ pañcahastāyatāpi vā| ayugmairāyatāḥ pādāḥ hastenārdhena paṭṭikā|| 25.98 || trīṇi trīṇi ca śūlāni tolaṇaṃ tolaraṇaṃ prati| śūlāni ca dvitālāni nahaścāṣṭāṃgulo bhavet|| 25.99 || paṭṭikā pādanahanaṃ dvāviṃśatyaṃgulaṃ bhavet| vṛttānvā caturaśrānvā pādāṃśca parikalpayet|| 25.100 || kalaśaṃ dakṣiṇāvartaṃ śaṅkhaṃ cakraṃ dhvajaṃ tathā| paṭahaṃ kārmukaṃ nāgaṃ teṣu pādeṣu kalpayet|| 25.101 || kārayenmaṅgalānyaṣṭau phalakeṣu yathātatham| lohajeṣvathavā yajñavṛkṣajeṣu yathāvasu|| 25.102 || dvāviṃśatyaṃgulāyāmaṃ tadardhena ca vistṛtam| phalakaṃ dvyaṃgulaghanaṃ piṭhe piṭhe pratiṣṭhitam|| 25.103 || phalake ṣu likhettatra śrīvatsādyaṣṭamaṅgulam| śrīvatsaṃ pūrṇakumbhaṃ ca bherīṃ darpaṇamaṇḍalam|| 25.104 || matsyayugmaṃ ca śaṅkhaṃ ca cakraṃ kāśyapanandanam| padmāsanasthitaṃ saumyaṃ dvādaśāṃgulamāyatam|| 25.105 || tattadrūpānusāreṇa vistīrṇaṃ pārśvayordvayoḥ| pradīpaṃ cāmaraṃ mūrdhna chatraṃ ca parikalpayet|| 25.106 || bimbapramāṇānuguṇaṃ snānapīṭhamudumbaram| dṛṅmokṣapīṭhaṃ ca tathā jalādhi vasanasya ca|| 25.107 || pīṭhaṃ bimbhanuguṇyena kalpayedavicārayan| ṛtvijāṃ ca tathāpīṭhamācāryasya ca kalpayet|| 25.108 || pātuke pādasaduśe yajñavṛkṣeṇa kalpayet| upakumbhaṃ ca kalaśaṃ karakaṃ maṇikaṃ tathā|| 25.109 || dīpastambhān ghṛtādīni snāna dravyāṇyaśeṣataḥ| candanāni sugandhāni vastrāṇi vividhāni ca|| 25.110 || samitpuṣpakuśādīni dhyānyāni vividhāni ca| suvarṇa ratnalohāni gāssavatsā manoharāḥ|| 25.111 || sambhārānevamanyāṃśca sambhṛtyāvyagramānasaḥ| ārabheta yathāśāstraṃ pratiṣṭhāṃ deśikottamaḥ|| 25.112 || iti śrīpāñcarātre mahopaniṣadi pādmasaṃhitāyāṃ kriyāpāde pratiṣṭhopakaraṇaṃ nāma pañcaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ|
<2.26>
brahmāḥ vyāpivo devadevasya pratiṣṭhā kīdṛśī matā| bhagavan saṃśayānasya mama niścayato vada|| 26.1 || śrībhagavān sarvasya bhūtajātasya harirātmāsthito'pi nan| mantra vīryācca māhātmyāt sthāpakasya gurostathā|| 26.2 || pratimāyāṃ prakarṣeṇa sannidhatte harissvayam| kāmānaśeṣāṃstatrai va harimarthayate janaḥ|| 26.3 || tena pratiṣṭhā nā medamanvardhaṃ vartate bhuvi| yathā ca vahnirdahano na dahanvyāpya tiṣṭhati|| 26.4 || araṇīmathanādbhūyo jāyamānaḥ praduśyate| dahanādīni karmāṇi karoti ca yathātatham|| 26.5 || tathā sarvagato viṣṇuradṛśyaḥ prākṛtairjanaiḥ| dṛśyate ca pratikṛtau mantriṇo mantragauravāt|| 26.6 || tasmātsarvātmanā viṣṇuṃ pratiṣṭhāpyābhipūjayet| śilpibhirnirmite bimbe śāstradṛṣṭena vartanā|| 26.7 || karmārcā pīṭhikāyāṃ ca ratnādinyasane kṛte| udghāṭite nayane yathārhaṃ sarvaśāntide|| 26.8 || sthūlasūkṣmeṣu cānyeṣu pratimāṅgeṣu sarvataḥ| sukṛteṣu yathāśāstraṃ karmānte deśikottamaḥ|| 26.9 || rathakāreṇa viduṣā sunirūpya nirūpakaḥ| dhanaiśca karmānuguṇaṃ sthapatīn paritoṣyaca|| 26.10 || rathakāraṃ ca vividhairmanaḥ prītivivardhanaiḥ| gateṣu śilpiṣu tathā rathakāre ca nirgate|| 26.11 || antarbahiśca sadane śodhite mārjanādinā| prajvālitairdarbhapuṃ jaiḥ paryagnikaraṇe kṛte|| 26.12 || prākāre maṇḍape dhāmni gopure mārjanādinā| śuddhīkṛte tathā gavyaiḥ paṃcabhiḥ prokṣite sati|| 26.13 || puṇyāhaṃ vācayitvātha brahmaṇai rmantravittamaiḥ| abliṃgā bhiśca bhūyopi garbhagehaṃ bahistathā|| 26.14 || ṛgbhistaṃprobhayetsarvamācāryassa rvabhūsuraiḥ| pradīpitai rgoghṛtaiśca pradīpai rbajubhistathā|| 26.15 || sarvato dīpite dhāmni kālāgurumukhai stathā| gandadravyairdhūpayitvā sudhācūrṇai stathākṣataiḥ|| 26.16 || puṣpairdūrvāṅkuraiścāpi sarvato dhāmnibhūṣite| tato'parāhṇasamaye śāntihomaṃ samācaret|| 26.17 || mānonmānapramāṇāderhānirvā vṛddhireva vā| durvajñeyaṃ tadakhalaṃ homācchāmyati niścayam|| 26.18 || śamīpallava saṃyuktā nakṣatān deśikassvayam| saptavyāhṛtibhiścaivapratyekaṃ juhuyācchatam|| 26.19 || caruṃ nṛsūktena tathā juhuyāt ṣoḍaśāhutīḥ| pañcopaniṣadā caiva sarpiṣā juhuyācchatam|| 26.20 || pratimāsannidhāvenaṃ hutvā pūrṇāvasānikam| upatiṣṭheta tadanu mantreṇāneva deśikaḥ|| 26.21 || namastubhyaṃ bhagavate jātavedassvarūpiṇe| nārāyaṇāya havyasya kavyasya ca yathātatham|| 26.22 || hartre yaṣṭavyadevānāmātmane paramātmane| sannidhatsvaciraṃ deva pratimāyāṃ hitāyanaḥ|| 26.23 || vijñāpyādhokṣajaṃ devamevaṃ prāṃjalirānataḥ| sadarbhaṃ navavastreṇa pratimāṃ mūlavidyayā|| 26.24 || ācchādayeduttarīya mapidadhyāttathā guruḥ| arghyaṃ pādyaṃ tathācāmaṃ gandhaṃ dhūpaṃ tathaiva ca|| 26.25 || dīpaṃ sumanasassarvaṃ gāyatryā viṣṇupūrvayā| dadyācchrīyādidevīnāmuktaṃ sarvasvavidyayā|| 26.26 || brahmādiparivārāṇāmanyeṣāṃ ca svavidyayā| kautukaṃ dakṣiṇe haste badhnīyānmūlavidyayā|| 26.27 || tayaiva vidyayā sapta vārān kṛtvābhimantraṇam| badhvā samarcayeddevaṃ puṇṭarīkākṣavidyayā|| 26.28 || chāyādhivāsasidhyarthaṃ devasya puratastataḥ| jaladroṇīṃ kaṭāhāṃ vā sthāpayellohanirmitam|| 26.29 || mṛṇmayaṃ vā yathālābhaṃ bhājanaṃ dhānyasañcaye| pūrayedgandhato yona śuddhasphaṭikavarcasā|| 26.30 || jale ca nikṣipetkūrca maṣṭāviṃśatidarbhakam| arcayecca hariṃ kūrce bhāvayenmūla vidyayā|| 26.31 || saṃhāraktamamācāryāḥ smṛtvā kurcaṃ jale svayam| śāyayitvā prākchirasaṃ cakramudrāṃ pradarśayet|| 26.32 || kūrcaṃ śrīdharayorda rbhaistribhissyādrudravedhasoḥ| paṃcaviṃśatibhiḥ kāryaṃ dvābhyāmanyāmṛtāśināṃ|| 26.33 || rakṣākumbhaṃ ca tatraiva yamasya diśī kalpayet| saṃveṣṭya navavastrābhyāmekena karakaṃ tathā|| 26.34 || brahmāṇaṃ pūjayetkumbhe karake ca sudarśanam|| paritaḥ kalaśānaṣṭau nidadhyādvastraveṣṭitān|| 26.35 || sāpidhānān savastrāṃśca saratnān kūrcasaṃ yatān| indrādi dikpatīn teṣu pūjayedaṣṭa cāṣṭasu|| 26.36 || sarvārghīṇena vastreṇa navena pratimāṃ tadā| chādayitvā samantācca siddhārthān vikiretkṣitau|| 26.37 || rakṣohaṇeti mantreṇa rakṣāṃ muryātsamantataḥ| āropayedanirvāṇān pradīpānbahuvarcanaḥ|| 26.38 || pravartayettra yīghoṣaṃ brahmaṇai rvedapāragaiḥ| cakramantraṃ ca valaje vinyasyābhyarcayedguruḥ|| 26.39 || prādakṣiṇyena sadanāt niṣkrametsahamūrtipaiḥ| yasyāḥ pratikṛtessākṣānnādhivāso jale bhavet|| 26.40 || tasyāśchā yādhivāso yaṃ kathitaḥ kamalāsana| dāruloha śilāmayyaḥ pratimā yāḥ pṛthagvidhāḥ|| 26.41 || tāsāṃ jalādhivasanaṃ sākṣādevaṃ vidhīyate| lohajapratimānāṃ tu pūrvaṃ vāryadhivāsanāt|| 26.42 || kṛtvā saro jalaṃ khāta madhivāsaṃ samācaret| vṛttākāraṃ śālibhāraṃ nidhāyopari taṇḍulān|| 26.43 || tadardhamupariṣṭācca taṇḍulārdhaṃ tilān kṣipet| tileṣu padmavinyāsaṃ kṛtvāstīrya kuśān punaḥ|| 26.44 || prāgagraṃ nūtanapaṭaṃ teṣāmupari nikṣipet| sapadmaṃ
