kevalaṃ vāpi pīṭhaṃ vinyasya tatra tu|| 26.45 || ratnānyapi ca lohāni gāyatryā viṣṇupūrvayā| vivyasya juhuyādagnau sarpiṣāṣṭotraṃ śatam|| 26.46 || nṛsūktena caruṃ caiva puṇyāhaṃ caiva vācayet| devamāropayettasmin pīṭhe mantramudīrayet|| 26.47 || supratiṣṭhena manasā gururdhyāyejjagadgurum| pratiṣṭhito'sīti sāma paṭhecca tadanantaram|| 26.48 || dṛḍhabandhaṃ sthapatinā kārayetkamalāsana| udghāṭayecca nayane pratimāyāḥ yathāvidhiḥ|| 26.49 || toṣayedrathākārādīn dhanena mahatā punaḥ| śamīpatrākṣatairhomaṃ kṛtvābhyajya ca parpipā|| 26.50 || ghṛtasnāneti mantreṇa cūrṇai ścodvṛrtya sarvataḥ| prakṣālyavāribhiścoṣṇaiḥ kuśairnutanavāsasā|| 26.51 || saṃveṣṭayetpratikṛtiṃ yathāpūrvamanukramāt| upavītottarīyādipradānāni yathāpuram|| 26.52 || ācamya ca pratisaraṃ bandhayitvā ca maṅgalam| tato rathādike yāne samāropya ca mūrtipāḥ|| 26.53 || paṭheyussāma gānajñaissārdhamanyaiśca bhūsuraiḥ| rathantarādikaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ pauruṣaṃ sūktamuktamam|| 26.54 || nārāyaṇānuvākaṃ ca sūktaṃ śākunameva ca| āmaneyaḥ pratidiśaṃ sūktaṃ rakṣoghnameva ca|| 26.55 || pāṇḍareṇātapatreṇa cāmareṇa sitena ca| cīnāṃśukamayai śchatrairdhvajairbarhamayaistathā|| 26.56 || vyajanairapi kalyāṇairdhvajairnānāvidhairapi| tūryai rbahuvidhairnṛttairgeyaiścāpi samantataḥ|| 26.57 || mahatā janasaṅghena brāhmaṇānāmitastataḥ| nṛpopacārairaparai rupacarya yathāvidhi|| 26.58 || pratimāṃ grāmadhāmādi prādakṣiṇyena cānayet| jalādhivāsadeśāntamāsādya śibikādikāt|| 26.59 || avaropya jalābhyarṇe prapāyāṃ sihmaviṣṭare| prāṅmukhaṃ samavasthāpya yadvā sthāpya udaṅmukham|| 26.60 || nadīṣu dīrghikāyāṃ vā taṭāke nirjhare'pi vā| jalādhivāsanaṃ kuryātprasanne salile'pi vā|| 26.61 || alpatoye smaśānānte lavaṇo dakadūṣite | kaṣāye kaṭuke caiva tikte phenaiśca duṣite|| 26.62 || caityavṛkṣasamīpe ca nīcairadhyāsite tathā| ūṣare śaivalayute varṇāntarayute tathā|| 26.63 || evamādiṣu duṣṭeṣu pratimāṃ nādhivāsayet| jalamadhye prapāṃ kuryādbahustambhasamanvitām|| 26.64 || caturdvārasamopetāṃ catustoraṇabhūṣitām| vitānadhvajasaṃyuktāṃ darbhamālāpariṣkṛtām|| 26.65 || muktādāmasamāyuktāṃ sragviṇīṃ dīpadīpitām| phalairnānādidhairyuktāṃ tatrādhivasanaṃ caret|| 26.66 || puṇyāhava ca naṃ pūrvaṃ puvarnadvādiṣu sthitā| āpaḥ puruṣamantreṇa saṃśoṣya gururātmavān|| 26.67 || agnimantreṇa dagdhvā ca candrakoṭisamaprabham| nivṛtti mantraṃ taddhyāyettasmāddhyānādvinirgataiḥ|| 26.68 || jalairamṛtakalpaiśca puvarvadyādi pūrayet| tasmin jale mahāpīṭhaṃ caturaśraṃ samāyatam|| 26.69 || vinyasyāstaraṇopetaṃ sopadhānaṃ navaṃ śubhaṃ| prakalpayedyogapīṭhaṃ tasyopari yathākramam|| 26.70 || gandhapuṣpādinā pīṭhamarcayitvā samāhitaḥ| dvāratoraṇakumbhādi yaṣṭavyaṃ tadana ntaram|| 26.71 || paṭhadbhiśśākunaṃ sūktaṃ brāhmaṇaissahamūrtipaiḥ| ādāya pratimāṃ paścādācāryastīradeśataḥ|| 26.72 || saṃhārakramamācāryaḥ smṛtvā toye praveśayet| udaṅgukhaṃ prākchirasaṃ pratimāṃ śāyayettataḥ|| 26.73 || veṣṭitāṃ navavastreṇaṃ āpādatalamastakam| sthāpitān pūrvavartīre kumbhādīvapi pūjitān|| 26.74 || jale niveśayettadvardīre tadvadyathākramam| darśayeccakramudrāṃ ca rakṣāmudrāṃ ca darśayet|| 26.75 || tīre caturvidhaṃ vādyaṃ vādayetsarva toditam| ṛco yajūṃṣi sāmāni purāṇāni ca bhūsurāḥ|| 26.76 || āmaneyuranirvāṇān pradīpānapi kārayet| snāsapānādikaṃ sarvaṃ tataḥ prabhṛti nācaret|| 26.77 || ekarātraṃ trirātraṃ vā jalamadhye'dhivāsayet| yāmaṃ yāmārdhakaṃ vāpi jalavāsaṃ samācaret|| 26.78 || gṛhārcāsthāpane kāle sadya eva samācaret| jalādhivasane caiva tathā nayanamokṣaṇe|| 26.79 || śayane vedikāyāṃ ca na kālaḥ kamalāsana| pradoṣeṣvadhivāna syācchayanaṃ ca mahāniśi|| 26.80 || pratiṣṭhāṃ ca divā kuryānmuhūrte śāstracodite| nadyādyabhāve bimbasya jalādhivasanaṃ bhavet|| 26.81 || jaladroṇyāṃ kaṭāhe vā samuddhṛtya mahajjalam| yathāsambhavamanyasmin mṛṇyayādau vidhīyate|| 26.82 || sadyo vā toyavāsaṃ syātpūrastādadhivāsanāt|| iti śrīpāñcarātre mahopaniṣadi pādmasaṃhitāyāṃ kriyāpāde jalādhivāsavidhirnāma ṣaḍviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ |
<2.27>
śrībhagavān pratimāmadhivāsyevamapsu pūrvokta vartmanā| aparedyuḥ prabhātāyāṃ śarvaryāṃ maṇṭapādike|| 27.1 || śedhite rathakāreṇa śobhite ca yathātatham| toṣite rathakāre tu manaḥ prahmādanairdhanaiḥ|| 27.2 || ācāryo mūrti pāścaiva kṛtakṛtyā jitendriyāḥ| savāmbaradharāssarve dhṛtaphañcāṅga bhūṣaṇāḥ|| 27.3 || gandhamālyadharā bhadrāssottarīya pariccadāḥ| dhṛtordhvapūṇḍraracanāssoṣṇīṣā mṛṣṭakuṇḍalāḥ|| 27.4 || ādiṣṭā yajamānena jīvājīvātmakairdhanaiḥ| vāstuhomaṃ prakurvīran karma daivaṃ yathābhavet|| 27.5 || vāstu rnāma caturvaktrabhārgava ssvedasambhavaḥ| abhyadravatsurān haṃtumātmano baladarpitaḥ|| 27.6 || sadevaistāḍitastūrṇa mapitadbhūvi vihvālaḥ| vistastāṅgassa ca prāṇān dhārayatyeva vāstukaḥ|| 27.7 || adhomukhaṃ prākchirasaṃ vinyasedvāstupūruṣam| prasārya pāṇipādau dvau koṇabhūmiprakalpitau|| 27.8 || tamarcayetprayatnena karma daivaṃ yathā bhavet| anarcite vāstudeve kṛtaṃ karmāsuraṃ bhavet|| 27.9 || maṇṭape dakṣiṇe pārśve vāstudevaṃ likhedbhuvi| saptadarbha yutaṃ kūrcaṃ kṛtvā tatra vinikṣipet|| 27.10 || tatrārca yedvāstunāthaṃ gandhapuṣpādibhiḥ kramāt| vāstudevasya śirasi pūjayedaṃśumālinam|| 27.11 || jhuṣadhvajaṃ bāhumūle kumāraṃ kūrpare tathā| haste vināyakaṃ pādayugale cāśvidevate|| 27.12 || madhye candraṃ tathā vārṣṇyoḥ durgāṃ mātṝṃścarpare| bāhumūle tathā sthāṇuṃ hṛdaye māmavasthitam|| 27.13 || brahmāṇaṃ nābhideśe ca dikpālān svāsu dikṣu ca| kṣetreśamuttare pārśve vāstu devasya pūjayet|| 27.14 || paścime vāstunāthasya deśe ca juhuyādguruḥ| pañcopaniṣadā sarpissahasraṃ śatameva vā|| 27.15 || śamyapāmārgakhadirasamidbhirjuhuyāttataḥ| mūlamantreṇa tasmantravarṇasaṅkhyābhirātmavān|| 27.16 || caruṃ puruṣasū ktena juhuyāt ṣodaśāhutīḥ| caruṇā vāstudevānāṃ juhuyācca sakṛtsakṛt|| 27.17 || baliṃ ca datvā devebhyo kṣetrādhipataye tathā| karmārambhe pratiṣṭhāyāṃ maṇṭape sadane tathā|| 27.18 || vāstuyāga kramaḥ proktassarvatra kamalāsana| mārjanaṃ gomayālevaḥ prokṣaṇaṃ maṇṭape bhavet|| 27.19 || sudhācūrṇairakṣataiśca maṇḍayitvā bhuvasthalam| siddhārthān vikireddikṣu astramantrābhimantritān|| 27.20 || nāstikān bhinnamaryādān devabrāhmaṇa nindakān| pāparogayutān martyān ni nditān piśunāṃ stathā|| 27.21 || pāṣaṇḍino hīnavṛttīn pratilomān samatsarān| ludbhānmūrkhānaviduṣo bahirnirvāsaye ttadā|| 27.22 || sthūṇāṃśca maṇṭape tasmin vāsobhirveṣṭayennavaiḥ| vitānayecchubhervastraiḥ patākābhiśca bhūṣayet|| 27.23 || muktādāmabhiranyaiśca phalaiḥ puṣpaiśca pallavaiḥ| parito darbhamālābhirmaṇikāñcanabhūṣaṇaiḥ|| 27.24 || śobhayenmaṇṭapaṃ sarvaṃ yathāvittānusārataḥ| khātyā dvitālamavaṭaṃ toraṇāni caturdiśaṃ|| 27.25 || sthāpayedvāradeśeṣu pūrvādiṣu yathākramam| aśvatthatoraṇaṃ prācyāṃ audumbaramanantaram|| 27.26 || naiyyadrodhaṃ ca pāścātyaṃ plākṣaṃ ca tadanantaram| sartakairgāyakaiścaiva vaiṇikai rvaṃśakaistathā|| 27.27 || vāditrakuśalaiścānyaistathā vādavicakṣaṇaiḥ| śobhitaṃ sarvatodikṣubrahmaghoṣaiśca nāditam|| 27.28 || dīpaistathā pālikābhissāṅku rābhiśca sarvataḥ| candanāgarurpūra dhūpaiḥ parimalīkṛtam|| 27.29 || kṛtvaivaṃ maṇṭapaṃ samyagaparāhṇe gurussvayam| utthāpya bimbamudakātkumbhaṃ ca kalaśāna pi|| 27.30 || udvāsya devatā stasmāttadbimbaṃ tīraviṣṭare| prāṅmukhaṃ samavasthāpya vāribhaḥ kṣālaye ttadā|| 27.31 || lohajaṃ cedviśudhyarthaṃ tintriṇī phalavāriṇā| vastrābharaṇapuṣpādyairalaṃkṛtya manoharaiḥ|| 27. 32 || yānamāropya tadbimbaṃ yathā pūrvamaśeṣataḥ| kṛtvā maṅgulaturyādi gamayedyāgamaṇṭapam|| 27.33 || maṇṭapasyottarebhāge viṣṭare viniveśayet| ācaryo mūrtipaissārdhaṃ praviśedgarbhamandriram|| 27.34 || bahuberavidhānaṃ cedvidhireṣa vidhīyate| prākcādhivāsitaṃ kūrcaṃ jalāttasmātsamuddharet|| 27.35 || bimbāccavastrābharaṇamālyānyapanayedguruḥ| nayanonmīlanaṃ kṛtvādhru vaberasya śāstrataḥ|| 27.36 || darśayedaṣṭadhānyāni gāścakanyāssalakṣaṇāḥ| unmīlanaṃ śriyādīnāmeva śāstroktavartmanā|| 27.37 || kalaśaissaptadaśabhirghṛtādi dravyasaṃyutaiḥ| chāyāsnapanamādarśe sakūrce kalpayedguruḥ|| 27.38 || pṛthakchriyādhi devīnāṃ snapanaṃ navabhirghaṭaiḥ| brahmeśau saptakalaśaiḥ ṛṣīṇāmapi pañcabhiḥ|| 27.39 || tribhiśca devatānāṃ syādekena kalaśena vā| nīrājanā ntairvastrādyairupacāraissamarcayet|| 27.40 || dhruvaberasya hṛdaye tasya dīpamaṇi prabham| vinyasya mantramācāryo dvādaśākṣarasaṃjñitam|| 27.41 || biṃbamācchādayedvastraiḥ kambalairvā samantataḥ| evaṃ kuryācchri yādīnāṃ tato nirgatya mandirāt|| 27.42 || maṇṭapasthāṃ pratikṛtiṃ chādayetkambalādibhiḥ| raimayaṃ rājataṃ vāpi pātramāḍhakapūritam|| 27.43 || dhānyarāśau nidhāyāgre pūrayettadyathākramam| madhunā sarpiṣā caiva pūrayecchādayettataḥ|| 27.44 || vāsasā pariśuddhena prātrayoccha tayoḥ punaḥ| arcayedbhāskaraṃ pūrve paścime śaśinaṃ tathā|| 27.45 || mantreṇa madhuvāteti sarpirādyabhimantrayet| aṣṭāṅgulā śalākāsyādrai mayī cātha rājatī|| 27.46 || aṣṭadhānyāni paritaḥ pātreṣu viniveśayet| gāḥ kanyakāśca rucirāḥ bhūṣaṇaiścāpi bhūṣitāḥ|| 27.47 || ānīya sthāpayetpārśve brahmaghoṣaiśca ghoṣayet| madhvaktamukhayā netraṃ raimayyā ca śalākayā|| 27.48 || dakṣiṇaṃ prollikhedvāmaṃ sarpiṣāktaśalākayā| rājatyā vilikhennetraṃ taccakṣuriti saṃpaṭhan|| 27.49 || vyapohyācchādanapaṭaṃ darśayenmadhusarpiṣī| aṣṭadhānyāni gāścaiva kanyakāḥ purata sthitāḥ|| 27.50 || gurave gāḥ prayaccheta govindaḥ prīyatāmiti| pātrayugmaṃ śalāke ca dadyāddhānyāṣṭakaṃ tathā|| 27.51 || netronmīlanavelāyāṃ vādyaghoṣeṇa ghoṣayet| gurave dakṣiṇāṃ dadvājjīvājīvadhanātmikām|| 27.52 || kautukaṃ bandhayedbimbe snapanārthaṃ yathāvidhi| mūlamantreṇa tadbimbaṃ samutthāpya nayettataḥ|| 27.53 || ṛtvigbhiḥ śśākunaṃ sūktamadhīyānaiśca bhūsuraiḥ| snānamaṇṭapabhūbhāge tatrodumbaraviṣṭare|| 27.54 || kṣaumāstaraṇasaṃyukte sthāpayetpratya gānanam| bhadrādi mantramācāryāssvayamuccārya mantravit|| 27.55 || viṃśatyekonamṛdbhistu puṇyakṣetrādi janmabhiḥ| udaṅmukhaḥ sthito mṛdbhirālipya pratimāṃ tataḥ|| 27.56 || mūrdhānaṃ diva ityetāmṛcamuccārayecchubhaiḥ| jalairimaṃ me varuṇa ityuccārya samūrtipaḥ|| 27.57 || kṣālayetkautukaṃ sarvaṃ kalaśaisnāpayedguruḥ| devasya purataḥ sthāpya sūtravastrādi veṣṭitān|| 27.58 || sakūrcān pallavairyuktān kalaśān dhānyarāśiṣu| pādyābhiṣecanaṃ kuryādidaṃ viṣṇuritīrayan|| 27.59 || āpohiṣṭheti mantreti tathārghyeṇābhi ṣecanam| imaṃme varuṇa ityeva tathā ''camanavāriṇā|| 27.60 || pavitraṃ teti mantreṇa pañcagavyābhiṣecanam| ghṛtasnāteti sāmnā ca ghṛtevai vābhiṣecayet|| 27.61 || dadhikrāvṇeti mantreṇa dadhisnapanamācaret| prayovratena sāmnā ca payasā snapanaṃ bhavet|| 27.62 || madhuvā teti mantreṇa madhunā snapayedguruḥ | yajñāyajñeti mantreṇa kaṣāyāmbhobhi ṣecanam|| 27.63 || mānastoke tryicā toyairuṣṇaiścai vābhiṣecanam| vaṣaṭ te viṣṇavityādimantreṇa maṇivāriṇā|| 27.64 || phalanītyanuvākena snāpayettu phalāṃbhasā| hiraṇyagarbhamantreṇa snāpayellohavāriṇā|| 27.65 || śanno devīriti snānaṃ mantritairmārjanāmbhubhiḥ| gandhadvāreti mantreṇa dandhāmbakalaśena tu|| 27.66 || trātāramiti sāmnā ca bhavedakṣatavāriṇā| yavāmbukala śena syādidaṃ viṣṇuriti tyṛcā|| 27.67 || vṛsūktena ca śuddhābhiradbhirante'bhiṣecayet| upacāraiśca vastrādipradānādyaissamarcayet|| 28.68 || pūrve vā dakṣiṇebhāge śayyāṃ vedyāṃ prakalpayet| prokṣayedvedikāṃ pūrvaṃ dvādaśākṣaravidyayā|| 28.69 || prāgagrānudaga grānvā darbhān saṃptīryaṣuṣkalān| śālīnāṃ pañcabhārāṇi taṇḍulānardhasaṃmitān|| 27.70 || upariṣṭāt kṣipetteṣāṃ tilānupari nikṣipet| tadardhān caturaśrānvā vṛttānvā tānvikīrya ca|| 27.71 || carma vairyāghramupari tilānāmapi nikṣipet| tūlikāṃ nikṣīpettasmin mṛdvāstaraṇabhūṣitām|| 27.72 || kambalānupariṣṭācca kṣaumaṃ tadupari kṣipet| citrāṇi vastrāṇi tathā śuklāni ca tathopari|| 28.73 || kāṣṭhajaṃ sudṛḍhaṃ snigdhaṃ caturhastasamanvitam| catuṣpādasamāyuktaṃ caturaśrāyataṃ tataḥ|| 28.74 || khaṭvāsaṃjñitaparyaṅkaṃ tadūrdhpe sthāpayettataḥ| dukūlaṃ mṛdutalpaṃ ca vinyasetsoparicchadam|| 27.75 || upadhānāni citrāṇi śayanāṅgāni kalpayet| kastūrikādigandhaiśca sugandhairadhivāsitām|| 27.76 || sudandhapuṣpāstaraṇāṃ nānālahgāraśobhitām| śayyāṃ kṛtvaivametasyāṃ devamānīya sāyayet|| 27.77 || sūktāni pauruṣādīni praśastāni yathātatham| adhīyānairvipra varyaissārdhamanyaiśca maṅgulaiḥ|| 27.78 || tūryaśabdairyathāpūrvaṃ mūrtipāścagurussvayam| uttiṣṭhe tyādimantreṇa samutthāpya ca kautukam|| 27.79 || śayyāvedibhuvaṃ ninyurbahiḥ kuṇḍaṃ yathātatham| prādakṣiṇyena śanakai ścayyāyāṃ śāyayedguruḥ|| 27.80 || idaṃ viṣṇuriti procya viśvataścakṣurityapi| prākchiro dakṣiṇāvaktraṃ yadvā syānmandirānanam|| 27.81 || śiro vā dakṣiṇāśāyāmitthaṃ śayana kalpanam| kambalenāthavā vastraiścādayetpratimāmapi|| 27.82 || yuvāsuvāsā ityādi bruvanviṣvakcaturmukha| aśvatthatoraṇaṃ prācyāṃ yajeta tadanantaram|| 27.83 || ṛgrūpamindradaivatyaṃ suśobhanasamāhvayam| yāmye tvaudumbaraṃ syāttu yājuṣaṃ yamadaivatam|| 27.84 || nāmnā subhadraṃ vāruṇyāṃ nyagrodhaṃ somavāruṇam| nudandhasaṃjñaṃkauberyāṃ plakṣaṃ nāmnā suhotrakam|| 27.85 || somadaivatyamuddiṣṭaṃ yajedātharvaṇaṃ guruḥ| dhvajadvayaṃ dvārapārśva sthitaṃ ratnasamāhvayam|| 27.86 || dauvārikānmahābhāgān yajeta kamalāsana| kumudaḥ kumudākṣaśca dvārapālau puraḥ smṛtau|| 27.87 || dakṣiṇasyāṃ dhvajau pītau puṇḍharīkākṣavāmanau| dvārsthau pratīcyāṃ nīlabhau dhvajau dauvārikau punaḥ|| 27.88 || śaṅkukarṇassarvanetrastathodakpāṇḍārau dhvajau| sumukhaṃ supratiṣṭhaṃ ca dvārsthau dhyāyoddhvajāṃśute|| 27.89 || aṣṭau kumbhaṃśca pūrvādidvāreṣu viniveśayatet| dvau dvau savastān sāśvatthapallavān sapidhānakān|| 28.90 || dhanyarāśiṣu mantreṇa idaṃviṣṇuriti svayam| nāmāni teṣāṃ kramaśaḥ kathyaṃ te tāni saṃśṛṇu|| 28.91 || pūrṇaśca puṣkaraścaiva syātāmānandanandanau| rasenassu ṣeṇaśca sambhavaḥ prabhavastathā|| 28.92 || ratnāni cāṣṭau kramaśaḥ kumbheṣu viniveśayet| padmarāgaṃ pravālaṃ ca vajraṃ vaiḍūryameva ca|| 27.93 || puṣyarāgaṃ tathānīlamaṇiṃ maratakaṃ tathā| muktāsphaṭikamuddiṣṭaṃ sarvaṃ mantreṇa nikṣipet|| 27.94 || toraṇadhvaja kumbhādīn pūrvoktān vṛthagarcayet| toraṇāni ca vāsobhiḥ navairācchādayetpṛthak|| 27.95 || pūrvādau valaje viprān bahvṛcādhvaryu sāmagān| atharvāṅgirasābhijñān aparānvedapāragān|| 27.96 || tattadvedāradīyānān tattaddikṣu niveśayet| ācāryo hṛdaye devamacyutaṃ susamāhitaḥ|| 27.97 || dhyāyettūryādi ghoṣaiśaaca paritaḥ parighoṣayat| mūrtikumbhāṃśca paritassapidhānān navastrakān|| 27.98 || aṣṭau prāgādikāṣṭhāsu dhānyarāśiṣu pūritān| adbhiśśuddhābhiraśvatthapatrayuktān saratnakān|| 27.99 || teṣu śaṅkhaṃ ca cakraṃ ca gadāṃ padmaṃ dhvajaṃ tathā| śrīvatsaṃ garuḍaṃ kūrmaṃ jāmbunadamayaṃ kṣipet|| 27.100 || madhye madhye ca kumbhānāṃ śrivatsādyaṣṭamaṅgalam| pālikāssāṅkurā vediṃ paritaḥ sthāpayettataḥ|| 27.101 || viṣṇvādimūrtīraṣṭau ca kumbhe ṣvāvāhya pūjayet| mahākumbhaṃ ca devasya nikṣipetpaścimottare|| 27.102 || dhānyarāśau sāpidhānaṃ droṇaṃ gandhāmbupūritam| hemaratnādikaṃ yugmavastreṇācchāditaṃ punaḥ||| 27.103 || sakūrcapipphaladalāṃ pārśve tasya galantikām| sasūtravastrasañchannāṃ kūrcayuktāṃ niveśayet|| 27.104 || sāpidhānāṃ śivāmbhobhiḥ pūritāṃ nigamādinā| pāyasānnena ca tathā brāhmaṇān bhagavanmayān|| 27.105 || bhojayeddvādaśamitānadhikānvā yathāvasu| tilān vāsāṃsi sūkṣmāṇi suvarṇaṃ gāśca dakṣiṇāḥ|| 27.106 || tebhyo dadyādbhuktavadbhyo yajamānassamāhītaḥ| ārabheyustato homaṃ ṛtvijo gurvanujñayā|| 27.107 || aśvatthāccha śamīgarbhādaraṇī maharettataḥ| mathitvāgni mupādāya sūryakāntāśmano pi vā|| 17.108 || laukikaṃ vāgni mādāya dvādaśākṣaravidyayā| prokṣya dhyātvā ca davyāgniṃ pratyakkuṇḍe samindhayet|| 17.109 || paryagnikaraṇaṃ kuryātkuṇḍānāṃ darbhamuṣṭibhiḥ| kuṇḍeṣvanyeṣu dahanaṃ pratyakkuṇḍātsamuddharet|| 27.110 || agre saṃskṛtya dahanamanyakuṇḍe vihāyan ca| agni madhyasthapadmasthaṃ taṃ taṃ devamanusma ret|| 27.111 || vasudevaṃ catuṣkoṇe cāpe saṅkarṣaṇaṃ tathā| vṛtau pradyumna nāmānamaniruddhaṃ trikoṇake|| 27.112 || ito'dhikeṣu kuṇḍeṣu kalpiteṣu yathātatham| mugmeṣvayugmeṣu tathā devatāḥ pūrvamīritāḥ|| 27.113 || prāgādiṣu ca kuṇḍeṣu krameṇa samidhaḥ smṛtāḥ| pālāśadūrvakhadirabilvaudumbarabhūruhām|| 27.114 || āgneyādi vidhikṣu syuḥ pippalaplakṣasambhavāḥ| nyagrodhaprabhavāścaiva kāśmaryaprabhavāntathā|| 27.115 || pālāśasamidho'nyatra bhūyasāṃ palikpane| uktābhāve tu sarvatra pālāśa samido matāḥ|| 27.116 || catasro dhenavasthsāpyāḥ dakṣiṇadvāryudaṅmukhāḥ| gaṅgā sarasvatī godā yamunā rūpadhāriṇī|| 27.117 || dugdhaistadīyaiśśrapaṇaṃ carūṇāmahutīstathā| śrapayetpayasā pūrvaṃ śālitaṇḍulamāḍhakam|| 27.118 || kṛsarairdākṣiṇātyāgnau pāścātye guḍamiśritam| udīcyāgnau haridrannaṃ dugdhānna mitarāgniṣu|| 27.119 || samidbhirājyaiśca rubhirbijairhomaḥ kramāt smṛtaḥ| pratyekaṃ śatamaṣṭau ca homassyātsamidhādibhiḥ|| 27.120 || tilaśāliyavā veṇu homabījānyanukramāt| tilairitarakuṇḍeṣu tairvā sarvatra padmajaḥ|| 27.121 || hotāra ścasamāsīnāssottarīyāsvalaṃkṛtāḥ| prāṅgukhā juhuyussarve gurvādiṣṭena vartmanā| 27.122 || teṣu juhvatsu ṛtvikṣu yajeta gururātmavān| mahākumbhe paraṃ jyotiścetasya ghanamakṣaram|| 27.123 || sarvagaṃ mūlamantreṇa samāvāhyācyutaṃ harim| sakalīkṛtya cārghyādyairarcayennigamādinā|| 27.124 || sudarśanaṃ ca karake sahasrādityasannibham| sahasrāraṃ sahasreṇa jvālābhirabhiveṣṭitam|| 27.125 || āvahya svena mantreṇa pūjayetkamalāsana| svasti kāsanamābadhya śayānāṃ pratimāmanu|| 27.126 || āsīta deśikassṛṣṭisaṃhārakramavittamaḥ| ārcāṃ ca tāṃ bhūtamayāṃ maṃhārakramamāsthitaḥ|| 27.127 || punassṛṣṭikrameṇaiva sṛjettaddhyānamāsthitaḥ| prācinakuṇḍe juhuyāttattvāni kapilāghṛtaiḥ|| 27.128 || pratyekamaṣṭottaraśataṃ tatveśvāhutayaḥ smṛtāḥ| aṣṭottarā viṃśativān yadvāṣṭau śaktyapekṣayā|| 27.129 || jīvādikaḥ tatvahoma ssvāhāntaissvasvanāmabhiḥ| makāraṃ sphaṭikābhāsaṃ jīvaṃ vyāpakaṃmāditaḥ|| 27.130 || āhutyante pratikṛtau vinyase tpraṇavaṃ tataḥ| jīvo pādhiṃ bhakāraṃ tu sitaṃ nyasyedyadhāpuram|| 27.131 || bakāraṃ sphaṭikābhāsaṃ buddhitatvamanantaram| ahaṅkāraṃ pāṭalābhaṃ phakāraṃ hṛdi vinyaset|| 27.132 || manassitā sitanibhaṃ pakāraṃ hṛdaye tathā| nakāraṃ śabdatanmātraṃ śrotre śuklanibhaṃ tathā|| 27.133 || dhakāraṃ lohitaṃ sparśa tanmātraṃ pratimātvaci| dakāraṃ rūpatanmātraṃ dṛśorjyotirmayaṃ tathā|| 27.134 || thakāraṃ rasatanmātraṃ pāṇḍarābhaṃ ca tāluni| takāraṃ gandhatanmātraṃ nāsikāyāṃ tathāsitam|| 27.135 || ṇakāraṃ pālanibhaṃ śrotrātmānaṃ ca karṇayoḥ| ḍhakāraṃ hematulyābhaṃ tvagātmānaṃ tathā tvaci|| 27.136 || ḍakāraṃ netrayoḥ kṛṣṇaṃ netrātmānamanantaram| gauraṃ ṭhakāraṃ jihvāyāṃ jihvātmānaṃ caturmukha|| 27.137 || ṭa kāramasitaṃ ghrūṇa rūpaṃ ghrāṇendri yaṃ tadhā| sitaṃ ñakāraṃ vāgrūpaṃ nāgādhāre niveśayet|| 27.138 || raktaṃ jhakāraṃ karayoḥ karmātmānaṃ niveśayet| raktaṃ jakāraṃ padayoḥ padātmānaṃ niveśayet|| 27.139 || chakārasya caraktasya nyāsaḥ pāyau tadātmanaḥ| cakāraṃ mehane hemavarṇaṃ mohanarūpiṇam|| 27.140 || ṅakāraṃ pṛdhivītatvaṃ pītābhāṃ caturaśrakam| pādeca jānuparyante hutvānte viniveśayet|| 27.141 || ghakāra mardha śītāṃśuṃ tulyākāraṃ jalātmakam| sphaṭikābhaṃ tadūrdhvetu guhyānte viniveśayet|| 27.142 || gakāraṃ lohitaṃ koṇaistribhiryuktamuṣarbudham| guhyātprabhṛtinābhyantaṃ vinyaseddeśikottamaḥ|| 27.143 || khakāraṃ vedikākāraṃ dhūmrābhaṃ śvasanātmakam| nabheruparighoṇāntaṃ hutvānte viniveśayet|| 27.144 || nirākāraṃ kakāraṃ ca nabhoñjanaśīlā mayam| nāsikopari mūrdhāntamāhutyante niveśayet|| 27.145 || tatvahomaṃ ca tannyāsaṃ kṛtvaivaṃ tadanantaram| prāṇādi daśavāyūnāṃ nyasanaṃ syādiḍādiṣu|| 27.146 || brahmādi parivāreṣu devīṣu kamalādiṣu| tatvanyāso yathoktena mārgeṇa syāccaturmukha|| 27.147 || sudarśanādyāyudhāni vanamālādi kānyapi| nyasyedyathāyathaṃ mantreḥ pratikāryeṣu śārṅgiṇaḥ|| 27.148 || na jaṅgameṣu bimbeṣu ṣodaśanyāsamācaret| praṇavasya vyāhṛtīnāmakārādyakṣarasyaca|| 27.149|| ṛkṣāṇāmapi kālasya vāsarādyayanasya ca| brahmaṇā deścavarṇasya toyasya nigamasya ca|| 27.150 || devatānāṃ virājaśca kratūnāṃ ca guṇasya ca| satvādeścaiva mūrtīnāṃ śaktīnāṃ ṣuḍguṇasya ca|| 27.151 || lokānāṃ nyasanaṃ kuryāt ṣoḍaśānāmiti kramāt| akārādyātmakaṃ hutvāpravaṃ tadanantaraṃ|| 27.152 || akāraṃ hṛdaye viṣṇo rnyasyedbhāge tu dakṣiṇe| ukāraṃ brahmaṇo rūpaṃ vāme ntyaṃ śaṃkarātmakam|| 27.153 || homena tarpayitvāste praṇavaṃ viniveśayet| vyāhṛtīnāṃ ca tisṛṇāṃ pādehṛdi śirasyapi|| 27.154 || nyāsaṃ kuryā dakārādisvarānnyasyetkramādguruḥ| rasanāyāṃ mukhe dṛṣṭyośśrotrayo rnāsikāpuṭe|| 27.155 || dantapaṅtkau tathācoṣṭhadvaye cāsye lalāṭake| tālunyatha yakārā dernyāsaṃ kuryādatandritaḥ|| 27.156 || tvaci dṛṣṭyornāsikāyāṃ daśanāgre tathā śrutau| udare catathā kaṭyāṃ hṛdaye nābhimaṇḍale|| 27.157 || mehane tarpayitvānte homena syāsa iṣyate| pañca vārān kakārādīn aṅgulīṣu ca jaṅghayoḥ|| 27.158 || bhujayornyasanaṃ kuryādakṣaranyāsa īdṛśaḥ| suṣumnā piṅgulā pūṣā hasti jihvā yaśasvinī|| 27.159 || alambhusaiva gāndhārī kāśinī ca kuhūrapi| prāṇāpānasamānāśca vyānodanau ca pāyavaḥ|| 27.160 || nāgaḥ kūrmaśca kṛkaro devadatto dhanaṃjayaḥ| athanā mātṛkā nyāsameva meva samācaret|| 27.161 || akāraṃ tāluni nyasya mukhe cākārameva ca| i ī locanayornsyasya u ū śravaṇa yostathā|| 27.162 || e o daśanapaṅtkau ca oau oṣṭhagatau smaret| a mityeva lalāṭe tu aḥ kāraṃ rasane tathā|| 27.163 || yakāraṃ tvaggataṃ nyasya rephaṃ cakṣuṣi vinyaset| lakāraṃ nāsikāyāṃ tu vakāraṃ daśanāgrataḥ|| 27.164 || śrotre śakāraṃ vinyasya ṣakāramudare tathā| sakāraṃ kaṭideśetu hakāraṃ hṛdaye tathā|| 27.165 || kṣakāraṃ nābhideśe tu vinyaseddhvijasattamaḥ| pavargo bāhurekastu tavargastu dvitīyakaḥ|| 27.166 || ṭargaśca ṭavargaśca jaṅghaudvayamudāhṛtam| kanargo'ṅgulayassarvā vijñātavyā dvijottama|| 27.167 || ṛkṣāṇi rohiṇyādīni nyasedeṣu yathākramam| hṛdaye mūndhnikeṣeṣu lalāṭe vadane tathā|| 27.168 || nāsikāyāṃ ca danteṣu śrotre bāhvoḥ karadvaye| stanayorudare kaṭyāṃ mohane vṛṣaṇe tathā|| 27.169 || pāyāpūrvo rjaṅghayośca pādayoragrapādayoḥ| sūryādayo grahāścānye tathā saptarṣayodhruvaḥ|| 27.170 || etāśca vyomani yathā tathā deve niveśayet| truṭyādi kalphaparyantāḥ kālabhedāścaturmukha|| 27.171 || sthūlasūkṣmā yathāyogaṃ nyasanīyāssumedhasā| mukha bāhuru pādeṣu devasya brāhmaṇādayaḥ|| 27.172 || nyasanīyāssaritkūpavāpīto yādi nirgharāḥ| niveśanīyā devasya dehe vedā ṛgādayaḥ|| 27.173 || aṅgāni ca tadarthāni śāstrāṇi vividhāni ca| drevatāni tathā nyāni caturmukha mukhāni ca|| 27.174 || ṛṣīnapi tathā mukhyānanyaccāpi vibhūtimat| deve vineśayetsarvaṃ trailokya sacarācaram|| 27.175 || nvarlokaṃ śirasi nyasyenyetrayoścandrabhāskarau| nāsikāyāṃ tathāvāyuṃ diśo bhāhuṣu hṛdgatān|| 27.176 || ṛṣīṃśca vyomaca vapuṣyantarātmani devatāḥ| meghāśca keśā vijñeyāḥ nakṣatrāṇi ca bhūṣaṇam|| 27.177 || mukhamagnistathā vāṇī śuddhavarṇā sarasvatī| vairājanyā sa ityeṣaḥ kathitaḥ kamalāsana|| 27.178 || aśvamedhādayassarve kratavaśca yathātatham| sarvāṅgeṣu nidhātvyāstasmin kratumaye'cyute|| 27.179 || sattvaṃ rajastamaśceti nyasanīyaṃ guṇatrayam| matsyādi daśamūrtīnāṃ nyasanaṃ tadanantaram|| 27.180 || devīnāṃ ca śriyādīnāṃ nyāsaḥ kāryo yathākramam| vijñānādi guṇāṣṣaṭca viniveśyāssamādhinā|| 27.181 || lokāścaturdaśa tathā pādādiṣu yathākramam| mūrdha paryantamaṅgeṣu devadehe yathāvidhi|| 27.182 || nyasanīyāścaturvaktraguruṇā śāstracakṣuṣā| kṛtvaivaṃ ṣoḍaśanyāsaṃ śāntihomaṃ samācaret|| 27.183 || madhunā bhūriti prācye kuṇḍe hutvā śatāhutīḥ| saṃpātenaspṛśetpādau devasya bhuva ityataḥ|| 27.184 || dakṣiṇāgnau tathā hūtvā payasā jaṭharaṃ spṛśet| dadhnātu paścime kuṇḍe hutvā svariti saṃsphṛśet|| 27.185 || vaktraṃ samasainājyena hutvodīcīnapāvake| śīrasphṛśecca saṃpātairaṅgaṃ ca sakalaṃ hareḥ|| 27.186 || guḍevāhyena madhuvā kuṇḍe tasmin gurussvayam| hutvā ca viṣṇugāyatryā saṃpātena mukhaṃ sphṛśet|| 27.187 || pālāśa khādirāśvatthabilvaśākhābhiraṃbubhiḥ| siñcheyurmūrtapā ssamyagvedīdikkalaśasthitaiḥ|| 27.188 || … kuryādyadhākramaṃ mantrairbrāhmaṇāḥ prayatavratāḥ| trātāramityayāścāgne yatulūka iti kramāt|| 27.191 || āsanasteti ca tathā imaṃ me tyādivāruṇaiḥ| anoniyudbhiriti ca mantrassanai payāgeṃsi ca|| 27.192 || tamīśānamiti taistairmantrai rindrādi daivatāḥ| juhuyaḥ parivārārthāṃ brahmaṇāṃścāpi toṣayot|| 27.193 || piṇḍhikāmadhivāsthātha veṣṭayennavavāsasā| nikṣipya bhājane lohān saratnān dhātubījakān|| 27.194 || bhājanaṃ vāsasā veṣṭya dhānyarāśiṣu nikṣiṣet| bimbāni garuḍādīnāṃ snāpayenna vavāsasā|| 27.195 || ācchādayeddhānyarāśau śāyayecca yathāpuram| digdevatānāṃ pīṭhāni balyarthānyadhivāsayet|| 27.196 || śayanāṃ pratimāṃ vedyāmutthāpyādhini ketanam| arcayetpāyanadyannaṃ sanni vedya caturvidham|| 27.197 || nivedya ca mahākumbhe dikṣu dadyādbhaliṃ tataḥ| palalaṃ rajanīcūrṇaṃ salājaṃ dadhi saktukam|| 27.198 || balyanna metaissaṃyojya baligādhā imāḥ paṭhet| ādyāśca karmajāścaiva ye bhūtāḥ prāgdiśi sthitāḥ|| 27.199 || prasannāḥ parituṣṭāste guhṇaṃ tu bali kāṅkṣiṇaḥ| vṛkṣeṣu parvatāgreṣu ye vidikṣu ca saṃsthitāḥ|| 27.200 || bhūmau vyomni sthitā ye ca baliṃ gṛhṇaṃtu te'pi ca| vaināyakāḥ kṣetrapālāḥ ye cānye balikāṅkṣiṇaḥ|| 27.201 || pūṣādyāḥ pārṣadāścaiva pratigṛhṇa ntvimaṃ balim| caṇḍādyāḥ kumudādyāśca ye bhūtā ssarvadik sthatāḥ|| 27.202 || āgacchantu pade gṛhṇantu ta ime balim| svapnādhipati mantreṇa hutvā cāṣṭottaraṃ śatam|| 27.203 || hemasūtraṃ pratisaraṃ pratiṣṭhāvidhi sdhiye| puṇyāhapūrvaṃ badhnī yāddhaste devasya dakṣiṇe| bālabimbaṃ tu saṃpūjya tacchaktimapi deśikaḥ|| 27.204 || samāvāhya mahākumbhe dhānyarāśiṣu nikṣipet| pūrṇāhutiṃ ca juhuyuḥ kuṇḍe kuṇḍe ca mūrtipāḥ|| 27.205 || padmotpalavadāmedo dūmo hutabhujo yadi| raktaśvetastathā pīto dhumassyā cchubhado bhavet|| 27.206 || jvālāśca dakṣiṇāvarvāśśubhaṃ śaṃsanti niścitam| turyamaṅgalasannādairbrahmaghoṣaiśca ghoṣitaiḥ|| 27.207 || svāpayettāṃ niśāṃ sarvāṃ yajamāno guruśca tau| svapnārdhaṃ darbhaśayyāyāṃ śayīranmūrtipāścate|| 27.208 || iti śrīpāñcarātre mahopaniṣadi pādmasaṃhitāyāṃ kriyāpāde śayanādivāsādi vidhānādayo nāma saptaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ|
<2.28>
śrībhagavān tataḥ prabhāte vimale dṛṣṭe ca ravimaṇḍhale| puṇye mumūrte puṇyarkṣe puṇyavāre tathā tidhau || 28.1 || kalyāṇadarśane rātrāvārabhetāvicārayan| pratiṣṭhāṃ deva devasya dussvapne śāntimācaret || 28.2 || eka bere vāstuhomaṃ kuryāddvārasya dakṣiṇe| pārśve ca sthaṇḍilaṃ kṛtvā praviśedgarbhamandiram || 28.3 || tanmadhye caturaśrāṃ vā vṛttāṃ vā tacchilāṃ kṣipet| hastamātrāyatāṃ śuddhāṃ tāvadvastārasaṃyutām || 28.4 || caturāvaraṇāṃ nimnāṃ gāyatryā viṣṇupūrvayā| tayaiva vāstuhomāgnau carusarpissamicchataiḥ || 28.5 || juhuyādratna vinyāsasidhyarthaṃ deśikottamaḥ| pradhamāvarṇe bījanaṣṭau garteṣu nikṣipet || 28.6 || yavāśca vrīhayaścaiva niṣpāvāśca priyaṅgavaḥ| tilāśca māṣāśca tathā nīvārāśśālayattathā || 28.7 || vajrādīni ca ratnāni dvitīyavarṇe tathā| vajraṃ ca mauktikaṃ caiva vaiḍūryaṃ jalajaṃ tathā || 28.8 || sphaṭikaṃ puṣyakaṃ caiva candrakāntaṃ tathā param| indranīlaṃ ca pūrvādi ṣvāśāsu viniveṣayet || 28.9 || dhātūn tutīyāvaṇe tathaiva viniveśayet| manaśśilāṃ harītālamañjanaṃ tadanantaram || 28.10 || śyāmaṃ ca sīsakaṃ caiva sau rāṣṭraṃ ro canaṃ tathā| gairikaṃ cāṣṭakaṃ lohān caturthāvarṇe punaḥ || 28.11 || garteṣu nikṣipetsvarṇaṃ rūpyaṃ tāmraṃ tathaiva ca| ayaśca trapukaṃ caiva mūrmaṃ kanakanirmitaṃ || 28.12 || śaṅkhaṃ cakraṃ ca sauvarṇaṃ lohanyāso'yamīritaḥ| śālibhījaṃ pāradaṃ ca brahmarāgaṃ ca kāñcanam || 28.13 || madhye nyasye dgartabhāge tatastriśilayā dṛḍham| śrīsūkaina pithātavyaṃ sudhayā dārḍhyamācaret || 28.14 || puṇyāhaṃ vācayetpaścādvaiṣṇavairmantravittamaiḥ| strīśilā padmamadhyetu praṇavasyasanaṃ bhavet || 28.15 || karṇikāyāṃ svarannyāsaṃ vyaṃjananyasanaṃ dale| daleṣu śaktayaścāṣṭau navamī karṇikā bhuvi || 28.16 || vimalotkarṣiṇī jñānā kriyā yogeti śaktayaḥ| prahvī satyā tatheśānā'nugrahā navamīsmṛtā || 28.17 || piṇḍikāṃ pūjayetpaśchādgandhapuṣpādibhiḥ kramāt| ahataiścaiva vāsobhirlakṣmīrūpāṃ ca piṇḍikām|| 28.18 || pracchādya dvāri cāstrasya nyāsaṃ kṛtvā bahirguruḥ| nirgatyaśayyā vedyarthaṃ pūjayedratnavāriṇā|| 28.19 || dhvajatoraṇakumbhasthā devatā visṛjettataḥ| āropya cāgniṃ hṛdaye mahākumbhaṃ samuddharet|| 28.20 || mūrtikumbhāṃstathā cāṣṭau maṅgalānyastrakarkarīm| gṛhītvā mūrtipāssarve gaccheyurmandiraṃ prati|| 28.21 || ganantīnirgala dvāri dhārayā saṃtatotthayā| agratassecayenmārgaṃ brāhmaṇānāmanujñayā|| 28.22 || devamutthāpya hastyādau prādakṣiṇyena mandiram| ācāryapramukhāssarve viśeyurmūrtipā stathā|| 28.23 || chatradhvajapatā kādyairmaṅgalai rakhilaissaha| tūryavāditranirghoṣairbrahmaghoṣaiścaca ghoṣitaiḥ|| 28.24 || brāhmaṇaiścāpyanūcānairadhīyānaiśca mūrtapaiḥ| sārdhaṃ gurusspṛśanyāsaṃ praviśenmūlamandriram|| 28.25 || arghyapādyādibhirdevamarca yeddvāri deśikaḥ| antaḥ praveśayeddevaṃ pīṭhikāṃ ca pradakṣiṇam|| 28.26 || gatvā mūhurte saṃprāpte sthāpaye dviṣṇu mavyayam| pratiṣṭhāsīti vaisāmnā deśiko brahmaṇtessaha|| 28.27 || ātvāhārṣamiṣyetattūktaṃ ca sahamūrtipāḥ| dhruvā dyauriti mantreṇa paṭheyurgurvanujñayā|| 28.28 || ācāryaḥ purataḥ sthitvā sarveṇa sthāpayeddharim| pīṭhamadhyagate garte bimbaśaṅguṃ niveśayate|| 28.29 || ūrdhvalambitasūtreṇa paśvecca samatāṃ sthiteḥ| pīṭhikā nālarandraṃ ca aṣṭabandena pūrayet|| 28.30 || lākṣā sajjarasaṃ caiva guggulaṃ ca gulaṃ tathā| sarveṣāmardhatastailaṃ pācayenmṛduvahninā|| 28.31 || ghanacūrṇaṃ madhūcchiṣṭaṃ kuruvindaṃ ca gairikam| ekaikaṃ ca samāṃ śena grahyaṃ sajjarasaṃ tathā|| 28.32 || tailena pācitaṃ sārdhamaṣṭabandhana miṣyate| sthāpayitvādṛḍhaṃ tena puṇyāhamapi vācayet|| 28.33 || āvahayettato devaṃ tamasaḥ paramavyayam| ānandaṃ sarvagaṃ nityaṃ vyomātītaṃ parātparam|| 28.34 || parīci cakramadhyasthaṃ vāsu devamajaṃ vibhum| mūlamandreṇa viśveśamāvāhya gururātmavān|| 28.35 || brahmaranddheṇa bimbāntaḥ praviṣṭaṃ paricintayet| kumbhasthaṃ paramātmānaṃ pratimāyāṃ niveśayet|| 28.36 || mantrannyāsaṃ tataḥ kuryānmūlamantreṇa deśikaḥ| yā ceta devaṃ sānnidhyaṃ parivārān prakalpayet|| 28.37 || samārādhya tato devaṃ pāyasānnaṃ nivedayet| pracchādya nūtanairvastraiḥ pratimāṃ kambalena vā|| 28.38 || triyahaṃ bandhayeddvāraṃ kavāṭena susaṃvṛtam| devarṣipitarassiddhā stadhānye devayonayaḥ|| 28.39 || arcanti devaṃ triyahaṃ trirātrānte tu mānavāḥ| brāhmaṇāṃ stoyedvittairbhojanaiśca gavādibhiḥ|| 28.40 || caturthe'hani saṃprāpte snapanaṃ prātariṣyate| taddine dhvajamutthāpya prarabheta mahotsavam|| 28.41 || ekabere vidhiriyaṃ kathitaḥ kamālasana| bahuberavidhānaṃ cetkarmādyarcāṃ samuddharet|| 28.42 || mahākumbhaṃ ca tattāle maṅgalānyaṣṭa deśikaḥ| ṛtvigbhissaha vidvadbhirbhaktairbhāgavatairapi|| 28.43 || uddhṛtya cāstrakarakamagre gacchedgurussvayam| anudhārāpadenaiva devāgāraṃ praveśayet|| 28.44 || pratimā'cāryayoḥ kaścinnagacchedantarā pathi| dvāradeśe tu saṃprāpai dadyātpādyaṃ ca kautuke|| 28.45 || karmārcāmarcanāpīṭhe nṛsūktena niveśayet| utsavādyarthabimbhāni pārśvayorviniveśayet|| 28.46 || karmārcāṃ sthāpayedbrāhme vāme tu mukhakautukam| tīrdhaṃ snapanabimbaṃ vā uttare sthāpayedguruḥ|| 28.47 || śayanotthānabimbaṃ ca balibimbaṃ ca dakṣiṇe| lauhikīṃ lohajaṃ bimbaṃ sthāpayediṣṭabhumiṣu|| 28.48 || dhārāvaśiṣṭaṃ yattoyaṃ taccharāve vinikṣipet| śalākāmātrayā caiva dhārayā' chchidrayā punaḥ|| 28.49 || paritaḥ paripekaṃ ca vidadhyānmūlavidyayā| dhānyarāśiṣu kumbhaṃ śca vinyasyāvāhayeddharim|| 28.50 || āvahanaṃ mūlaberātkarmādyarcāsu kalpayet| muhūrte śobhane prāpai deśikaḥ kamalāsana|| 29.51 || purato mūlabherasya baddhapadmāsana sthitaḥ| prāṇānāyamya śuddhātmā dhyāyedbrahma sanātanam|| 29.52 || vāsudevamajaṃ śāntamujvalaṃ santatoditam| anādimadhyanidhana mekaṃ calaṃ sthiram|| 29.53 || cidghanaṃ paramānandaṃ tamasaḥ paramavyayam| jñānaśaktibalaiśvarya vīryatejassamanvitam|| 29.54 || apādapāṇimaspṛśyama cakṣu śśravaṇādikam| narvatra karavākpādaṃ sarvatokṣiśiromukham|| 29.55 || gatāgatavinirmuktaṃ ravikoṭisamaprabham| caitanyaṃ sarvagaṃ nityaṃ vyomātītaṃ tadadbhutam|| 29.56 || tatsāmānyaṃ jagatyasmimmāla mantrātmakaṃ param| evaṃ vidhaṃ sadāviṣṇumāhlādaṃ praṇavātmakam|| 28.57 || taṃ niyujya mahāviṣṇuṃ mataṃ viṣṇau niveśayet| viṣṇuṃ ca hṛdaye padme samāvāhyārcayetkramāt|| 28.58 || samāvāhya śriyā paścānmantreṇa puruṣātmanā| añjalisthe tataḥ pīṭhe dhyāyedvāśvātmanā guruḥ|| 28.59 || tejonidānamadhyeyaṃ nārāyaṇamajaṃ vibhum| nivṛttamantra mucchārya pratimāyāṃ niveśayet|| 28.60 || brahmarandhreṇa mārgeṇa praviṣṭaṃ pratimākṛtau| vyāpya sthātaṃ sma retsarvaṃ mantreṇa kamalāsana|| 28.61 || mahākumbhagatāṃ śakti devena sahayojayet| mūrtikuṃbhagatāṃścāpi tathā bāle ca kautuke|| 28.62 || yā śaktistāṃ ca devena yojaye tphratimātmanā| brahmarandhraṃ ca tā reṇa pidadhyā tphatimātmanaḥ|| 28.63 || ātmano'bhimukhaṃ kuryātpuṇḍarī kākṣavidyayā| praṇamya kiñcidutthāya darśayetsvāgataṃ guruḥ|| 28.64 || mantrannyāsaṃ tataḥ kuryānmūlamantreṇa deśikaḥ | sthatinyāsaḥ sthitau kārya ssṛṣṭinyāsastathāsane|| 28.65 || śayyāyāṃ saṃhṛtinyāsassaṃhāraśayanaṃ yadi| sṛṣṭinnyāso bhavetsṛṣṭiśayane kamalāsana|| 28.66 || bhoge yoge ca śayane sthitinyāsaḥ praśasyate| viśvarūpe sthitinyāsaḥ yānārūḍhe trayaṃ bhavet|| 28.67 || sthitinyāso'dhavā kāryassarvatraivāsanādiṣu| śriyādīnāṃ ca devīnāṃ brahmādīnāṃ tathaiva ca|| 28.68 || mahākumbhajalenaiva prokṣayetsvasvavidyayā| sṛṣṭiśca sarganyasanaṃ nyāso rudrasya saṃhṛtiḥ|| 28.69 || śriyādīnāṃ tathā nyeṣāṃ ṣaḍaṅganyāsamāca ret| mahākumbhaṃ samuddhṛtya deśiko mūrtipaissaha|| 28.70 || prokṣaṇaṃ tajjalaiḥ kuryāccaṇḍāderapi tat kṣaṇe| balīṭhe kṣipaittoyamavaśiṣṭaṃ gurussvayam|| 28.71 || mahānasāgniguṇḍe ca tathādhiśrapaṇeṣu ca| tathā ca gārjapatyāgniṃ sthāpayecchāstravartmanā|| 28.72 || devapārśvaṃ samāsādya daṇḍavatpraṇamet kṣitau| gādhāyudīraye denāṃ raci tāñjali saṃpuṭaḥ|| 28.73 || yajamānena sahitaḥ prahvastiṣṭhan gurussvayam| bhaktavatsala bhaktānāmabhipretārthasādhaka|| 28.74 || prārthaye tvāmahaṃ deva madanugraha kāmyayā| sannidhassva ciraṃ sthāne kalpite śraddhayā mayā|| 28.75 || prasīda deva deveśa pūjāmapi gṛhāṇa me| grāmasya rājño rāṣṭrasya prajānāmindirā vara|| 28.76 || dehi puṣṭiṃ ca tuṣṭiṃ ca gatiṃ ca paramāṃ tathā| iti nijñāpya devāya deśikastantrapāragaḥ|| 28.77 || madhuparkopacārānce gurvanujñāpurassaram| dadyādgobhūsurarṇādi yathāvittānu sārataḥ|| 28.78 || devasya dakṣiṇe haste to yapūrvaṃ yathāvidhi| bhaktinamreṇa śirasā pūjopakaraṇāni ca|| 28.79 || ātmānaṃ putrapautrādi dārān hastyādi vāhanam| dāsīdāsaṃ ca sarvasvaṃ dadyāddevasya pādayoḥ|| 28.80 || jīvājīvadhanairdevo dattairārādhyate yathā| yajamānena sarvasvairbagavān puruṣottamaḥ|| 28.81 || tathā bhāgavataṃ sarvairdhanairārādhayetsadā| sthāpako devadevasya yaḥ pūrvo deśikottamaḥ|| 28.82 || tenaivārādhanaṃ kāryaṃ tadvaṃśairapi nirguṇaiḥ| pūjāprītikarī saiva devasya kamalāsana|| 28.83 || vittānusārato vidyānkalpayoddhāma saṃpadam| athavā vibhavenaiva yajamānaḥ prakalpayet|| 28.84 || ādau vibhūtivistāro yādṛśaḥ pariklapitaḥ| saṅkocamantareṇaiva kuryāttādṛśasampadam|| 28.85 || deva bhūtyanusā reṇa rakṣeddevopajīvinaḥ| na kleśayedbhāgavartān tathaiva paricārakān|| 28.86 || pratiṣṭhānte ca devasya tūryairnānāvidhairapi| ghoṣayetsarvato dikṣu brahmaghoṣaiśca ghoṣayet|| 28.87 || nṛttairgeyaiśca vivirdhaistautrairnānāvidhairapi| toṣayeddeva deveśamupacāraiḥ vṛthagvidhaiḥ|| 28.88 || caturvidhaṃ tathā vānnaṃ nivedya vidhipūrvakam| nityāgniṃ ca pratiṣṭhāpya kuṇḍe ca caturaśrake|| 28.89 || hutyāgnau samidhājyānnairmūlena praṇavādinā| pūrṇāhutiṃ tato hutvā tattadavaraṇeṣu ca|| 28.90 || balipīṭhāni saṃskṛtya pratiṣṭhāpya yathākramam| teṣu nityaṃ baliṃ dadyādbhūtānāṃ ca yathākramam|| 28.91 || bahuberavidhāne tu kavāṭaṃ na ca bandhayet| devarṣipitarassiddhāntuvānā devayonayaḥ|| 28.92 || arcanti devaṃ triyahaṃ trirātrānte tu mānavāḥ| brāhmāṇāṃ stoṣayedvittairbhojanaiśca gavādibhiḥ|| 28.93 || caturthe divase prāpte snapanaṃ parikalpayet| uttamatritayevāpi madhyamatritayena vā|| 28.94 || kalaśaissnāpayeddevaṃ catusthānārcanaṃ bhavet| utsavaṃ kārayedante dhvajārohaṇapūrvakam|| 28.95 || ācāryaṃ pūjayettasnin pratiṣṭhādivase prabhuḥ| suvarṇakusumairvastrernūtanairaṅgalīyakaiḥ|| 28.96 || keyūrahāravalayairupavīto ttarīyakaiḥ| kṣetrārāmagṛhairvittairjīvājīva dhanaistathā|| 28.97 || dāsīdāsena catathā hastyaśvaśibhikādibhiḥ| evaṃ prakārairanyaiśca toṣayedgurumātmavān|| 28.98 || ātmānaṃ pratra pautrāṃśca deve tadvanni vedayet| mātṛtvena pitṛtvena bandhutvena gurūttamam|| 28.99 || kakhātmatvena sambhāvya praṇamya ca punaḥ punaḥ| sahasraṃ dhenavo deyāḥ dakṣiṇā guruve tadā|| 28.100 || sahasraniṣkamathavā dakṣiṇā cottamottamā| tadardhā madhyamā jñeyā tadardhā cādhamā matā|| 28.101 || athavā dakṣiṇā deyā śataṃ hemnāmanuttamam| daśaniṣkamaśaktarstu tadardhaṃ pādameva vā|| 28.102 || yathāvittānusāreṇa dakṣiṇā parikīrtitā| karmaṇāṃ karṣaṇādīnā maṅgatvena yadahṛtam|| 28.103 || tadiṣṭaśiṣṭaṃ sakalaṃ guro reva dhanaṃ bhavet| ṛtvijāmapi sarveṣāṃ tathāmnāyeṣvadhītinām|| 28.104 || brāhmaṇānāṃ ca viduṣāṃ bhaktānāṃ puruṣottame| tathaikāyananiṣṭhānāṃ dviṣaṭkaniyatātmanām|| 28.105 || vāsudevaikaniṣṭhānāṃ niṣanmārgavidāmapi| yatīnāṃ brahmacārīṇāṃ vanasthāśramavāsinām|| 28.106 || anyeṣāṃ viṣṇubhaktānāmasminnarthenuyāyinām| viṣṇvarkṣaniratānāṃ ca sadasyānāṃ ca dakṣiṇā|| 28.107 || deyā gobhūhiraṇyādi rūpā vittānusārataḥ| kālājñānāṃ tathā nṛttagītavādyādi kurvatām|| 28.108 || yathārhaṃ vittavāsobhiḥ kuryāttṛtpiṃ yathepsitam| guruḥ pātraṃ samānīya hemādidravyanirmitam|| 28.109 || prakṣālya viṣṇugāyatryā dhānyarāśau svamantrataḥ| devasya purataḥ sthāpya pūrayedgandhavāriṇā|| 28.110 || aṣṭhākṣa reṇābhimantrya ṣaḍarṇena dviraṣṭakam| pañcopaniṣadairmantrairāvāhyātmagataṃ vibhum|| 28.111 || praṇavena samabhyarcya gandhapuṣpākṣatādibhiḥ| tataḥ kartāramāhūya viśuddhaṃ devasanni dhau|| 28.112 || taṃ devābhimukhaṃ sthāpya praṇataṃ vinayānvitam| sādhitārghyajalāttasmātsārghyato yaṃprasūnakam|| 28.113 || tasya haste prapūryātha imāṃ gādhāmūdīrayet| tvayā vinā na mekiñcinmāṃ vinātavakastathā|| 28.114 || tasmānmā mātmasātkartuṃ prasīda parameśvara| bhūmau skhalitapādānāṃ bhūmi revāvalambanam|| 28.115 || tvayyeva pratipannānāṃ tvameva śaraṇaṃ vibho| iti vijñāpya deveśamācārya ssvasthamānasaḥ|| 28.116 || dvādaśākṣaramuccārya bhagavatpādapaṅkaje| nivedya karturātmānaṃ sārghya puṣpa purassaram|| 28.117 || trikṛtvaḥ praṇa meddevaṃ nivedyātmānamavyaye| sa tenānugṛhītassan saṃyāyādguruṇā bahiḥ|| 28.118 || namaskṛtvā guruṃ devaṃ kṛtakṛtyena cetasā| taṃ guruṃ yānamāropya turya ghoṣapurassaram|| 28.119 || nītvā pradakṣiṇaṃ gramaṃ svagṛhe sanniveśayet| ya itthaṃ sthāpanaṃ kuryāddheva devasya śārṅgiṇaḥ|| 29.120 || sa yāti paramaṃ sthānamakṣayaṃ kamalāsana| punāti vaṃśajāṃścaiva puruṣānekaviṃśatim|| 29.121 || niṣkāmā ye tu sadane puruṣāḥ puruṣottamam| sthāpayanni phalaṃ teṣāmapunarbha valakṣaṇam|| 29.122 || sakāmānāṃ tu martyānāṃ punarāvṛttilakṣaṇam| svargādi tattadbhoktavyamārambhe tattadiṣyate|| 29.123 || brahmahatyādi pāpānāmanyeṣāṃ niṣkṛtirmatā| upakurvanti ye martyāḥ vāṅmanaḥ kāyakarmabhiḥ|| 28.124 || āvṛttilakṣaṇaṃ teṣāṃ phalaṃ svargādiriṣyate| śriyādīnāṃ ca devīnāṃ devena saha kalpane|| 28.125 || nodvāhakarma kartavyaṃ pṛthak cet sthāpanaṃ tayoḥ| udvāhakarma śāstroktaṃ kuryādaṅgurapūrvakam|| 28.126 || bhaktiśaktivaśāddevaṃ yathāvittānusārataḥ| yathā ca sthāpanā bhaktaissāsmṛtā nugrahā iti|| 28.127 || iti śrīpāñcarātre mahopaniṣadi pādmasaṃhitāyāṃ kriyāpāde pratiṣṭhāvidhirnāma aṣṭāviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ|
<2.29>
śrībhagavān mīnādidaśamūrtīnāmadhunā sthāpanaṃ prati| viśeṣaḥ kathyate brahman upasthānādilakṣaṇaḥ|| 29.1 || sāmnā ca vāruṇenaiva sūktena puruṣātmanā| sthāpayenmīnavapuṣaṃ vāsudevamanāmayam|| 29.2 || āvahya tasmin deveśamupatiṣṭheta mantravit| mīnātmane namastubhyaṃ vedarakṣāvidhāyine|| 29.3 || pralayāryava durvāra vāripūravihāriṇe| vāruṇenteva suktena tathāṣṭhākṣaravidyayā|| 29.4 || sthāpayitvā mahākumbhaṃ tasminna vāhayeddharim| upatiṣṭheta karmānte gādhayā vakṣyamāṇayā|| 29.5 || tubhyaṃ namaskriyāṃ kurmaḥ kūrmarūpāya vedhase| dhāraṇā nmandarasyā drervibudhānandadāyine|| 29.6 || vāpayitvā ca vāhārīṃ mūrtimāvahayeddharim| kroḍātmane namastubhyaṃ yajñarūpāya vedhase|| 29.7 || daṃṣṭrāgra vidhṛtā śeṣa dhāriṇī dharaṇīdhara| nṛsiṃharūpiṇaṃ devaṃ sthāpayeddeśikottamaḥ|| 29.8 || yuñjītetyanuvā kena samāvāhya janāndanam| gadhāmudīraye denāṃ karmānte deśikottamaḥ || 29.9 || niśātanakhadambholi dalitāsuravakṣase| darśitāśritavātsalya nṛsiṃhavapuṣe namaḥ|| 29.10 || yuñjantītyanuvā kena sthāpayitvā ca vāmanam| tasminnā vāhya deveśamupatiṣṭheta deśikaḥ|| 29.11 || balidviṣe namastubhyaṃ yajñarūpāya vedhase| vāmanāya mahāmāyā vañcitāśeṣa mānava|| 29.12 || jāmadagnyaṃ nṛnūktena sthāpayitvājanārdanam| gādhayācopatiṣṭheta prāṃjaliḥ praṇataḥ sthitaḥ|| 2.13 || trissaptakṛtvaḥ kṣatrāṇāṃ nihantre tigmatejase| namastubhyaṃ bhavavate paraśvathavidhāriṇe|| 2.14 || rāmaṃ ca saha vaidehyā sahitaṃ lakṣmaṇādibhiḥ| sthāpayetkālabhedena yadvā sthāpanamācaret|| 2.15 || rāṃ puruṣasūktena sthāpayitvā yathāvidhi| gadhayā copatiṣṭheta rāmaṃ raghukulodbhanam|| 29.16 || namastubhyaṃ bhagavate rāghuvāya mahātmane| rāvaṇādi jagadvairi nibarhaṇa mahojase|| 29.17 || rāmamūrtaṃ pratiṣṭhāpya parivārātmanā tataḥ| vāyvādi devatanayān hanūmatpramukhān punaḥ|| 29.18 || tattaddevaṃ samabhyarcya sthāpayettadvadeva tān| vibhīṣaṇaṃ guhaṃ caiva pṛthageva hi devatāḥ|| 29.19 || sthāpayedviśvamantreṇa rāmaprītika rāpubhau| bharataṃ kalpayetprācyāṃ dakṣiṇe jānakīṃ punaḥ|| 29.20 || pratīcyāṃ jāmbavantaṃ ca uttare lakṣmaṇaṃ tathā| sugrīvaṃ cāgnikoṇe naiṛtyāṃ tu vibhīṣaṇam|| 29.21 || vāyavye tu nalaṃ nyasyedaiśānye śatrumardanam| vasiṣṭhādyṛṣimukhyānāṃ dvitīyāvaraṇe sthitiḥ|| 29.22 || tṛtīyāvaraṇe paścāllokapālān prakalpayet| sthāne khagādi rājasya hanūmantaṃ prakalpayet|| 29.23 || viṣvaksenapade nīlaṃ guhaṃ vā tatra kalpayet| rāghavasyārcanāyāṃ tu viśeṣo'yaṃ prakīrtataḥ|| 29.24 || khageśaṃ mārutiṃ vā'pi likhitvā dhvajamuddharet| utsave tu viśeṣo'yamīritaḥ kamalāsana|| 29.25 || rāmasya rauhiṇeyasya pratiṣṭhā ca yathāpuram| upasthāne viśeṣo'sti śrūyatāṃ sa ca kathyate|| 29.26 || baline balabhadrāya halasphurita bāhave| tubhyaṃ māleva mahatī bhūmiryena siroddhṛtā|| 29.27 || vasudevasutasyāpi sthāpanaṃ vāsudevavat| vṛṣṇivaryāya kṛṣṇāya namastubhyaṃ madhudviṣe|| 29.28 || bhūbhārabhūtakaṃ sādi mahāsuranighātine| satyabhāmādi devīnāṃ sthāpanodvāhanādikam|| 29.29 || śrībhūmyoriva kartavyaṃ viśeṣo'sti na kaścana| kalkiviṣṇu pratiṣṭhāpi yathāpuramudīritā|| 29.30 || upatiṣṭheta karmānte gādhayā stutirūpayā| mlecchānāmapi saṃhartre sādhūnāṃ sthitihetave|| 29.31 || namastubhyaṃ bhagavate bhūsurānvaya janmane| neṣyate ṣoḍaśanyāso mīnādi daśamūrtiṣu|| 29.32 || śilāmayādi mūrtīnāṃ varṇaiścitravidhiryadi| jalādhivāsanādyuktaṃ kṛtvā sarvamaśeṣataḥ|| 29.33 || nirmite citra karaṇe kuryādāvāhanādikam| dhruvabimbasthiteḥ paścātkarmādyarcāsthitiryadi|| 29.34 || siddhāntabhedabimbhānāṃ pṛthakchayanamiṣyate| abhede vedikāśayyā sahaiva syāccaturmukha|| 29.35 || neṣyate ṣoḍaśanyāso lohaje jaṅgame punaḥ| āvāhanaṃ mūlaberā tkarmādyarcāsu kalpayet|| 29.36 || karmārcāṃ sthāpayedbrahman yāmye tu mama kautukam| tīrthasnānādi bimbaṃ nā uttare sthāpayedguruḥ|| 29.37 || śayanotthānabimbaṃ ca balibimbaṃ ca dakṣiṇe| laukikaṃ lohajaṃ bimbaṃ sthāpayediṣṭabhūmiṣu|| 29.38 || yadvo dvahanabimbāni sthāpayeddvārapārśayoḥ| maṇṭape vā'bhiṣekārthe dakṣiṇābhimukhāni ca|| 29.39 || jalādhivāsane sākṣādayogyānāṃ caturmukha| citrābhāsārdha citrādi pratimānāṃ yathāyatham|| 29.40 || chāyādhivāsanaṃ kuryāt snānaṃ cādarśamaṇḍale| vedyāṃ śayana manyeṣāṃ kūrcadvāreṇa kalpayet|| 29.41 || avaśiṣṭaṃ yathāpūrvaṃ sakalaṃ parikalpayet| neṣyate ṣoḍaśanyāsaścaturthasnapanaṃ tathā|| 29.42 || māyāmaya mahāvṛkṣanyagrodha dalaśāyinaḥ| devasya sthāpanavidhau viśeṣaḥ kathyate'dhunā|| 29.43 || garbhodavasitadvāri likhitvopari vāridhim| tatra nyagrodhavṛkṣasya dale komalarūpiṇam|| 29.44 || śayānaṃ bālavapuṣaṃ śyāmalaṃ kamalekṣaṇam| mārkaṇḍeyaṃ mahīṃ devīṃ kārayetpādapārśayoḥ|| 29.45 || evaṃ vilikhite bāle bālaparyaṅmaśāyini| citrābhāsoktavidhinā sthāpayedgururātmavān|| 29.46 || devena devyau yugapa tpratiṣṭāyāṃ yathāpuram| sahaiva śayanaṃ vedyāṃ kālabhede tu tatpṛthak|| 29.47 || kuṇḍaṃ sarasijākāraṃ prācyāṃ cāpaṃ tu dakṣiṇe| vṛttāṃ tu paścime bhāge yo'nyākāra mudaktathā|| 29.48 || kuṇḍe viśeṣaḥ kathitassnapanaṃ ca tayoḥ punaḥ| śrīsūktena śriyaṃ devīṃ bhūsūktena bhuvaṃ tathā|| 29.49 || snāpayedarcanaṃ cāpi tayostābhyāṃ ca śāyayet| prāgādi toraṇe pūjyā balāki nyadhidevatā|| 29.50 || navamālālinyatho tatra samārādhya vibhīṣikām| śāṅkarī devatā paścāddvārakumbheṣvanukramāt|| 29.51 || devatādvandvayajanaṃ pratiṣṭhādīn samarcayet| prathamaṃ tadanu śraddhāṃ kāntiṃ ca tadanantaram|| 29.52 || kriyāṃ sṛṣṭiṃ ca paścāttu kṣamāṃ vṛddhiṃ ca devatām| prācyādiṣu patākāsu devātādvandvamarcayet|| 29.53 || dhṛtiṃ ca lajjāṃ ca puro jayāṃ māyādvayaṃ tataḥ| sāvitrīṃ ca kṣamāṃ ca dve śuddhāṃ śriddhāmanantaram|| 29.54 || lakṣmīssarasvatī caiva puṣṭistuṣṭiśca śaktayaḥ| prāgādi haumakuṇḍeṣu hotavyāḥ proktavartmanā|| 29.55 || vāgīśvarī kriyā kīrtarlakṣmīḥ sṛṣṭistathaiva ca| prahvī satyā tathā brāhmī yaṣṭavyāḥ kalaśeṣvimāḥ|| 29.56 || mahākumbhe śriyāṃ devīṃ yajeta kamalāsana| ṣoḍaśanyāsarahitaṃ śeṣaṃ prāgvatsamācaret|| 29.57 || asvātatantye vidhirhyeṣa sātantye tvabhidhīyate| grāme vā vagare vāpi paṭṭaṇe vā''laye'pi vā|| 29.58 || śriyaḥ sthānaṃ vidhātavyaṃ grāmādyabhimukhaṃ yathā| puṣṭhiṃ puṣṭhiṃ ca sāvitrīṃ vāgdevīṃ ca caturmukha|| 29.59 || vimānasya caturdiṣu diṅgūrtīḥ parikalpayet| koṇeṣu vainateyaṃ vā siṃhaṃ vā'pi yathāruci|| 29.60 || divye bhāge'tha vā brahme 'praticchāyāṃ śilādibhiḥ| sthāpayetparivārāṃśca dvārapārve yathākramam|| 29.61 || caṇḍīṃ caiva pracaṇḍīṃ ca prathamadvārapārśvayāḥ| tato'rdhamaṇḍapadvāre dakṣiṇe ca balākinīm|| 29.62 || vanamālāmudīcīne gopure prathame punaḥ| vibhīṣikāṃ śāṅkarīṃ ca dakṣiṇottarapārśvayoḥ|| 29.63 || dvitīye gopuradvāre śaṅkhapadmanidhī ubhe| śṛtīye gopuradvāre nalakūbalajṛmbhalau|| 29.64 || caturthe gopuradvāre dakṣiṇe śibikuṇḍalau| uttare māṇibhadraṃ ca kalpayetkamalāsana|| 29.65 || jayā ca vijayā caiva paścimadvārapālike| sumukhīṃ sthāpayedviṣvaksenasthāne caturbhujām|| 29.66 || vetrahastāṃ dakṣiṇena tarjanīṃ cā'pi kurvatīm| aparābhyāṃ dhārayantīṃ padmaṃ pītanibhaṃ tathā|| 29.67 || sthāpayedvainateyaṃ ca prāsādamukhamaṇḍape| ādimūrteriva bhavetpharivā prakalpanam|| 29.68 || anyāsāmapi devīnāṃ svātantrye vidhirīdṛśaḥ| caturdhasnapanaṃ kuryādutsavaṃ cā'pi devavat|| 29.69 || devīnāṃ ca śriyādīnāmitthaṃ yaḥ sthāpako naraḥ| sarvān kāmānavāpnoti paratre ha ca modate|| 29.70 || iti śrīpāñcarātre mahopariṣadi pādmasaṃhitāyāṃ kriyāpāde mīnādi pratiṣṭhāvidhirnāma ekonatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ |
<2.30>
śrībhagavān atha śriyā''di devīnāṃ pāṇigrahaṇamucyate| sarvakalyāṇajananaṃ sarvaduḥkha vināśanam|| 30.1 || āyurvṛddhakaraṃ nṝṇāṃ abhipretārtha sāthakam| yathoktadivase kuryādaṅkurāṇāṃ samarpaṇam || 30.2 || udvāhadivase prāpte muhūrte deśikottamaḥ| pṛthagdevasya devyośca badhnīyā tkarmakautukam|| 30.3 || ācchādyānāhatakṣaumaṃ sottarīyaṃ prasādhitam| āropya śibikāṃ grāmaṃ prādakṣiṇyena tāṃ nayet|| 30.4 || vaivāhikaṃ ca sadanamālayaṃ vā praveśayet| ārādhya devamaghyān dyairānīya sthaṇḍile'nalam|| 30.5 || praveśyāntargṛhe devamāsane viniveśayet|| ābhyarcya ca hariṃ tatra devīṃ nūtanapāsasā|| 30.6 || yuvā su itimantreṇa paridhāya pradakṣiṇam| bhūṣayecca śriyaṃ devīṃ puṣpairābharaṇaistathā|| 30.7 || devīṃ devena yuñjīta praṇavena gurussvayam| dadyācca devīṃ devāya vāripūrvaṃ yathāvidhiḥ|| 30.8 || yajamānassuvarṇorvīṃ gavādisahitāṃ tadā| svagotranāmnā kathitā mimāṃ śriyamanuttamām|| 30.9 || tataḥ pāṇigṛhītāṃ tāṃ devīṃ devaṃ ca mandirāt| nītvā vaivāhikaṃ sthānamuttarāśāmukho guruḥ|| 30.10 || krameṇāghārahomārdīn kuryādvidhyuktavartmanā| samidhaṃ ca nṛsūktena jūhuyāt ṣoḍaśāhutīḥ|| 30.11 || catuṇā viṣṇugāyatryā caturviṃ śāhutirbhavet| śrīnūktena ghṛtaṃ hutvā bhūmyāśca yugapadyadi|| 30.12 || ubhayośca vidhātavyaṃ pṛthagevāṅkurādikam| ubhayo rekakartṛtve prāpte paṅkajasambhava|| 30.13 || tatrā'pi pṛthagevā''bhyāṃ vaivāhikamathā''caret| ekakāle kriyāṃ tiṣṭhetparyā yādbhinnamācaret|| 30.14 || ānupūrvyavaśenaiva vibhaktaṃ syādyathā tathā| yadvā muhūrtabhinne tu bhinnaṃ vaivāhikaṃ bhavet|| 30.15 || muhūrte yaugapadye cedānupūrvyātkriyāṃ nayet| śrībhūmyorbhanna kartṛtve yaugapadyodvaho yadi|| 30.16 || tatrā'pi vidhi revaṃ syādubhābhyāṃ vidhireva hi| yaugapadyodvahe deve sakṛtpratisaraṃ bhavet|| 30.17 || ekā'gnau vā prakartavyaṃ bhinnā'gnau vā yathāruci| ullekhanā''diprāktantraṃ prāklṛptamakṛtaṃ na ca|| 30.18 || prativyakti kriyāṃ sarvāṃ pṛthageva samācaret| pūrvaṃ śriyaitato bhūmyai paryāyeṇa kriyāṃ nayet|| 30.19 || samidho mūlamantreṇa juhuyāt ṣoḍaśāhutīḥ| caruṇā viṣṇugāyatryā caturviṃ śāhutirbhavet|| 30.20 || ghṛtaṃ puruṣanuktena bhumisūktena vā punaḥ| lājahomaṃ tathā vahneḥ pradakṣiṇamanukramāt|| 30.21 || kṛtvā sarvamaśeṣeṇa lājaśeṣaṃ gurussvayam| praṇavena sakṛddhutvā pañcavāruṇikte stataḥ|| 30.22 || pañcopaniṣadairmantrairdvādaśākṣaravidyayā| pūrṇāhutyaṃtamakhilaṃ kṛtvā viprāṃśca toṣayet|| 30.23 || arghyādyairarcayeddevaṃ ghṛtāropaṇamāca ret| ghṛtaṃ dūrvāṅkuraṃ pātre candanaṃ śālitaṇḍulam|| 30.24 || karābhyāṃ sarvamādāya sarvecaiva sabhasadaḥ| devasya devyoścā'ṅgeṣu kṣipeyuriti maṅgalam|| 30.25 || ghṛtaṃ suśobhana miti siñcoyuḥ pādayostataḥ| kaṭyāṃ subhadramityuktvā mūrdhni caiva sumaṅgalam|| 30.26 || evaṃ dūrvādi sakalaṃ kṣipeyuranupūrvaśaḥ| madhuparkaṃ pradadyācca rasenā'smīti coccaret|| 30.27 || lakṣmīpatiṃ ca hārādyairalaṅkāraiḥ prasādhayet| mālyānulepanaiścā'pi yathā rhairapi pūjayet|| 30.28 || dhenuṃ ca dadyāddharaye yajamānaḥ praṇāmavān| ācāryāya yathāvittaṃ pradadyādātmanaḥ priyam|| 30.29 || nī rājanavidhānānte nikṣipeddikṣu piṇḍikāḥ| anyacca maṅgalaṃ sarvaṃ kuryāllaukikavartmanā|| 30.30 || śrībhūmisahitaṃ devaṃ kuryādgrāma pradakṣiṇam| āropya maṇṭape devyau devaṃ rājavadācaret|| 30.31 || mahāhavirvivedyānai brahmāṇānapi bhojayet| divase divase kuryā tsnānapūrvakamutsavam|| 30.32 || caturthāpararātre tu śeṣahomaṃ samācaret| samidhājya caruprāyairaṣṭottara śatāhutīḥ|| 30.33 || juhuyānmūlamandrābhyāṃ pañcopaniṣadairapi| dine tu pañcame devaṃ tailena'bhyañjayeddharim|| 30.34 || śrībhūmisahitaṃ devaṃ snāpayedvidhipūrvakam| mahāhavirnivedyā'nte grāme kuryānmahotsavam|| 30.35 || tatra śrībhūmisahitaṃ pratyahaṃ mandire'rcayet| devīnāmitarāsāṃ ca vivāhavidhirīdṛśaḥ|| 30.36 || jāmadagnyā'di devīnāṃ vivāhaḥ smārtavartmanā| vivahāmaṇṭapādīnāṃ pratiṣṭhāvidhirucyate|| 30.37 || prāsādasyāgrataḥ vṛṣṭhe pārśvayorvā yathāruci| vediṃ kuryāccaturhastāṃ hastocchrāyāṃ manoharām|| 30.38 || kuṇḍhāni parito vedyā aṣṭau catvāri vā punaḥ| toraṇadvārakalaśadhvajādīni yathāpuram|| 30.39 || kṛtvādiṅmūrtinayanānyunmīlya ca yathāvidhi| āśāmūrtiṃ vimānaṃ ca darpaṇe snāpayedguruḥ|| 30.40 || rājā cedyajamānassyātpātrāṇi kalaśāni ca| haimarājatatāmrāṇi yadvā kāryāṇi nā'nyathā|| 30.41 || brāhmaṇādiṣu varṇeṣu yajamāneṣu padmaja| mṛṇmayānyapi pātrāṇi yathā vibhavavistaraṃ|| 30.42 || vāsobhiśśobhanairdhāma ccādayedahetaistataḥ| vedimadhye vinikṣipya śālibhārānyathoditān|| 30.43 || taṇḍulāṃśca tilān sarvān pūrvoktapariṇāmakān| upariṣṭācca vinyasya mahākumbhaṃ hiraṇmayam|| 30.44 || mūrtikumbhāṃśca paritastanmayānaṣṭa nikṣipet| hema niṣkapramāṇaṃ ca pratimumbhaṃ vinikṣipet|| 30.45 || navaratnaṃ ca sūtrāti veṣṭi teṣu yatāyatham| arcayitvā ca tānaṣṭamaṅgalāni vinikṣipet|| 30.46 || mūrtiḥ homaṃ ca juhuyānmahākumbhe nivedanam| caturvidhasya haviṣastathā'nyadapi pūrvavat|| 30.47 || śodhite sadane tasmin śoṣaṇā'lepanādibhiḥ| dhyāyedratnasthalaṃ dhāma taptahemavinirmitam|| 30.48 || tatra jīvamapi dhyāyedvyāpakaṃ tadu pādhikam| buddhaṃ ca piṇḍakāṃ pādān ahaṅkāraṃ tathaiva ca || 30.49 || pādau pādaśilājaṅghe garbhagehaṃ tathodaram| stambhānbahūn kaṭiṃ cā'pi tathaiva kaṭimekhalām|| 30.50 || jihvā karṇaṃ tathā netraṃ pradītidvārśsa mehanam| apānaṃ jalaniryāṇaṃ nāsikā nāsikā matā|| 30.51 || gavākṣamakṣi grīvāṃ ca grīvān skandānkapolakau| śiraśca kalaśaṃ māṃsaṃ pralepaṃ sparśanaṃ sudhām|| 30.52 || asthīni ca śilā sthasthāḥ snāyurdāruśikhādhvajān| keśaromāṇi kūrcaṃ ca dhyāyeddhāma pumākṛtim|| 30.53 || hutvā hutvā ca śaktīnāṃ nyasanaṃ sadane hareḥ| pūrṇaśaktiṃ prakṛtyākhyāmupānahi vinikṣipet|| 30.54 || śāntiṃ jagatyāṃ kumude pṛthivīṃ tadanantaram| vāgīśvarīṃ gale caiva paṭṭikāyāṃ matiṃ tathā|| 30.55 || pañcāṅgakalpane śakti nyasanaṃ samudāhṛtam| dvādaśā'ṅge tu sadane śaktiṃ kīrtbhasaṃjñitām|| 30.56 || mahatyāṃ paṭṭikāyāṃ ca gale puṣṭimanantaram| mahīṃ ca vājane vedyāṃ tuṣṭiṃ sṛṣṭiṃ tathā'ṅghriṣu|| 30.57 || māyātmikāṃ kapoteṣu bhūtamālānu mohinīm| dvādaśā'ṅgevimāne tu śaktinyāsa udāhṛtaḥ|| 30.58 || aṣṭādaśāṅgasadane haressaṃprati kathyate| kūṭe nyasenmahālakṣmī mapare vasudhāṃ tathā|| 30.59 || śīlāyāṃ ca mahīśaktiṃ prastare cā'timohinīm| svāhāṃ vedyāṃ śriyaṃ dhāmni śaktinyāso'yamīritaḥ|| 30.60 || śāntihomādi sakalaṃ karma kāryaṃ yathāpuram| diṅmūrtīnāṃ ca sarvāsāṃ tatvanyāsādi pūrvavat|| 30.61 || brahmaṇānāṃ sahasrāṇi śataṃ vā'pi yathābalam| bhojayedbhuktavadbhyo'pi tebhyo dadyāddhanādikam|| 30.62 || vimānapaṭṭikāyāṃ tu pañcaviṃśati tantubhiḥ| badhnī yātkautukaṃ dikṣu dāmnaścatasṛṣu kṣipet|| 30.63 || baliṃ yathāpuraṃ brahmaghoṣairdikṣu ca ghoṣayet| tataḥ prabhātasamaye yuhūrte śobhane guruḥ|| 30.64 || mahākumbhaṃ samuddhṛtya prādakṣiṇyena mandiram| nītvā dakṣiṇataḥ kumbhaṃ sthāpayitvā samāhitaḥ|| 30.65 || udaṅmukho gururbhūtvā śaktiṃ kumbhajale sthitām| vimāne mūlamantraiṇa viniveśya caturmukhaḥ|| 30.66 || diṅmūrtīḥ svasvamantraiśca praukṣayetkumbhavāribhiḥ| anyeṣāmapi devānāṃ dhāma sthānaṃ yathāvidhi|| 30.67 || prokṣayetkumbha toyaiśca vidyayā ca svayā svayā| prāsādaṃ pūjayetpūrvaṃ diṅmūrtīśca yathātatham|| 30.68 || viṣṭhitāyāṃ pratiṣṭhāyāṃ prāsādasya yathāvidhi| ācāryāya śataṃ niṣkaṃ tadarthaṃ pādameva vā|| 30.69 || dadyācca dakṣiṇāmante yathāvittānusārataḥ| yajamāno mahīṃ paścātsahasraṃ svarṇadakṣiṇām|| 30.70 || uttamāṃ gurave dadyānmadhyamāṃ tu tadardhakām| ādhamāṃ pādamātraṃ tu mūrtipānapi toṣayot|| 30.71 || dhantervastrādibhiścaiva manaḥ prahlāda kāraṇaiḥ| bhūsurānitarāṃścāpi toṣayedbhojanādibhiḥ|| 30.72 || evaṃ yaḥ sthāpayedviṣṇorvimānaṃ phalanispṛhaḥ| tasya muktiḥ karatale sthitā naivā'tra saṃśayaḥ|| 30.73 || phalakāmanayā yastu sthāpayeddhāma vaiṣṇavam| tasya sampattiratulā manorathapathā'tikā || 30.74 || maṇḍapasthāpanāyāṃ tu vedinirmāṇapūrvakam| kriyāviśodhanādyantaṃ kṛtvā niravaśeṣataḥ|| 30.75 || prāsādasthāpanoktena vartmanā deśikottamaḥ| maṇṭapaṃ viśvakarmīyaṃ sarvaratnapariṣkṛtam|| 30.76 || sauvarṇairbahubhistambhai rnānāratnapariṣkṛtaiḥ| uttambhitaṃ gururdhyātvā śaktinyasanamācaret|| 30.77 || upānaṃ prakṛtiśśaktirjagatī ca vasundharā| vaprā caiva kriyāśaktirgrīvā vāgīśvarī matā|| 30.78 || prītiḥ kampaṃ tathā tuṣṭiḥ kumudaṃ paṭṭikā kṣamā| stambhapādaśilā brāhmī śaktistambhāśca vaiṣṇavī|| 30.79 || potikā kamalā śaktiruttarā śāntiriṣyate| ratiśca vājanaṃ māyā madīyā kamalāsana|| 30.80 || kīrtirmatā varṇapaṭṭistathā kaṃpaśca mohinī| tulā padmā tathā śāntiśśaktissopānapaṅtkayaḥ|| 30.81 || caturṣu maṇṭapadvārṣu toraṇāni samarcayet| śānti homādikaṃ sarvaṃ kathitaṃ kamalāsana|| 30.82 || tataḥ prabhāte kumbhapthāśśaktīstanmaṇṭape guruḥ| nyasya vyāpakarūpeṇa maṇṭapaṃ cintayettataḥ|| 30.83 || citrāṇi citrābhāsāni tatsthāni ghaṭavāriṇā| prokṣaye tsvena mantreṇa sarvaṃ nyasya yathāpuram|| 30.84 || gurave dakṣiṇāṃ dadyādyajamāno yathāpuram| maṇṭapasthāpanaṃ yastu karoti madhuvidviṣaḥ|| 30.85 || sa bhuktvā vipulānbhogā niha loke paratra ca| modate deva devasya prāsāda maṇi maṇṭape|| 30.86 || āsthānamaṇṭapādīnāṃ pratiṣṭhāvidhirucyate| vāstu yogo baliścaiva gavyaiḥ pañcabhirukṣaṇam|| 30.87 || paryagnikaraṇaṃ caiva tathā puṇyāvahacanam| sthāpanaṃ caiva kumbhasya agnau caikatra cāhutiḥ|| 30.88 || muhūrte prokṣaye tpaścātsadyo vā sakalaṃ caret| śataniṣkaṃ tadardhaṃ vā dakṣiṇā parikīrtitā|| 30.89 || phalaṃ ca pūrvavatkartuḥ kiñcīnyūnaṃ caturmukha| pratiṣṭhā gopurasyā'pi mandirasyeva nā'nyāthā|| 30.90 || prākārasya pratiṣṭhāyāṃ kṛtvā sarvaṃ yathāpuram| gharmamantreṇa kumbhasthavāriṇā prokṣayedguruḥ|| 30.91 || śataṃ tadardhaṃ pādaṃ vā svarṇaniṣkāṇi dakṣiṇā| balipīṭhasya nirmāṇaṃ sthāpanaṃ cā'dhunocyate|| 30.92 || garbhagehasamāyāmavistārā balipīṭhikā| tadardhā tatturīyā vā pañca saṅkhyaṃ śakā'pi vā|| 30.93 || yadvā navasvekabhāgā yadvā hastavaśādbhavet| ekahastā varā pañca paramā vā yathābalam|| 30.94 || vistāradviguṇotsedhā triguṇā'rdhā'dhikāpi vā| vistāratulyocchrāyā vā pañcāṅgaparikalpanā|| 30.95 || kapotabhūtahaṃsādi mālikā bhiralaṃkṛtā| tridhā kṛtvā'gravistāraṃ bhāgābhyāṃ paṅkajaṃ bhavet|| 30.96 || pīṭhakoṇeṣu garuḍān siṃhānvā parikalpayet| vighna rāṭ tasya janakaḥ pakṣirāṭ kanyakā'pi ca|| 30.97 || yathākrameṇa prāgādi dikṣu tanmūrtayaḥ smṛtāḥ| sopānapaṅtayaḥ pārśve kalpanīyā yathonnatiḥ|| 30.98 || gopuradvāravistārastriguṇā vā caturguṇā| bahiḥ purastāddvārasya balipīṭhasya kalpanam|| 30.99 || vāstu homādikaṃ sarvaṃ śāntihomāvasānikam| kriyākalāpamācāryaḥ kuryānmandiravat kramāt|| 30.100 || prabhātasamaye prāpte muhūrte śobhane guruḥ| kumbhasthavāribhiḥ pīṭhaṃ prokṣayenmūlavidyayā|| 30.101 || devatāścaiva tatrasthāḥ prokṣayedātmavidyayā| prokṣayotkarṇikāṃ cāpi namastetyādi vidyayā|| 30.102 || aṣṭānāṃ kumudādīnāṃ svaisvairanucaraissaha| prārthayeta tadā tatra sannidhi mantrapūrvakam|| 30.103 || pīṭhameva pratiṣṭhāpya kuryānnityotsavaṃ punaḥ| guruve dakṣiṇā deyā śataniṣkāvarātmikā|| 30.104 || evaṃ yaḥ sthāpayetpīṭhaṃ viṣṇubhūtā''layaṃ varam| sarvaduḥ khavinirmuktaḥ prāpnoti paramaṃ padam|| 30.105 || balipīṭhapratiṣṭhāṃ ca vakṣyāmi kamalāsana| tasyotsedhaṃ samuddiṣṭaṃ garbhāgāraṃ samantataḥ|| 30.106 || āyataṃ vistṛtaṃ vā'pi garbhāgārasya madhyame| utsedhe daśabhāge tu saptāṃśaṃ samudāhṛtam|| 30.107 || saptaviṃśatibhāge tu vibhaktetu samucchraye| dviyaṃśaṃ pādukaṃ jñeyaṃ jagatī caturaṃśikā|| 30.108 || triyaṃśaṃ yumudaṃ jñeyamekāṃśaṃ paṭṭikā bhavet| ṣaḍbhāgaṃ karṇamityuktaṃ dvyaṃśakaṃ galakampayoḥ|| 30.109 || caturaṃśairvibhāgaśca vaṃśaiścaivātra vartikā| dvyaṃśārdhaṃ padmapuṣpaṃ tu ekārdhaṃ pdapakarṇikā| evaṃ samyagviditvātu bhāge bhāge vinirdiśet|| 30.110 || tryaṃśahastapramāṇena trihastā cā'dhikā'pi vā| pañcahastā'dhikaṃ vā'pi gopurātprāgvidhīyate|| 30.111 || madhye bhūtaṃ ca kartavyaṃ catustālapramāṇataḥ| sukhāsīnamidaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ parāvṛttaṃ ca kārayet|| 30.112 || aniruddhāya dṛṣade vatsarāyeti hūyātām| tathāvaklṛptahastāya cāmuṇḍhāya tathaiva ca|| 30.113 || nainyāyeti varāyeti codarāya tataḥ param| tataivodarabandhāya nāḍibhyāmiti vai punaḥ|| 30.114 || vasuścaiva ca vāstubhyo vāstumuṣkāya vai punaḥ| prajanāya jiritrebhya śśroṇībhyāmiti vai punaḥ|| 30.115 || taṭākāya ca vaṃśāya vaṃśadhāribhya eva ca| prajāpataya ityuktvā dhṛṣṇaveti ca bhutayaḥ|| 30.116 || śukāya śukavāsibhya ūrubhyāmiti coccaran| sirābhyaścāsthibandhebhyo mukhebhyaśceti hūyatām|| 30.117 || sākṣibhyo jānu mūlebhyo jānumūlebhya ityapi| gulphebhyaścaiva pārṣṇibhyaścaraṇebhyastale'pivā|| 30.118 || pādāṅgulibhyaḥ pādebhyaścaraṇā'gratalāya ca| talāyordhvatalāyeti tvagbhyassvāheti hūyatām|| 30.119 || tvarāsibhyaśca hutvā tu juhuyācca tataḥ param| romakupebhya ityuktvā prasebhyo rasadāya ca|| 30.120 || ratnāya ratna vāsibhyo medase ca tathā punaḥ| jīvāya vāstune caiva asthimajjāya vai punaḥ|| 30.121 || juhuyānmajjavāsibhyo ttamāṅgāya vai punaḥ| dhātā vai caiva dātubhyo dhāturūpebhya ityapi|| 30.122 || juhuyādupadhātubhyaḥ paśvātvaca iti bruvan| sarvarūpāya grīvāya dhanadāya tathā''tmane|| 30.123 || sarveśvarāya yajñāya puraṣāya ca hūyatām| upapīṭhaṃ vinā pīṭhaṃ kartavyaṃ dvijasattama|| 30.124 || āmodaṃ prākpṛdhagyaṣṭvā tadbhūtaṃ bhuvanātmakam| pramomo yāmyadikpadme tadbhūtamanalātma ke|| 30.125 || pramukhaṃ paścime padme tadbhūtaṃ syājjalātmake| unmukhaṃ somadigbhāge vāyubhūtaṃ tadeva hi|| 30.126 || avighnaṃ karaṇordhvaṃ tu vyomātmakamudāhṛtam| bhūmyantarikṣasvargaṃ ca sarvabhūtaguṇātmakam|| 30.127 || tatsamātmakamityuktaṃ mahāpīṭhaṃ dvijottama| prāsādasya tu vistāraṃ yastu daṇḍa mivocyate|| 30.128 || mūlaharmyaṃ samārabhya ṣaṣṭhadaṇḍasamānataḥ| daśa dvādaśa daṇḍhairvā manudaṇḍāvasānakam|| 30.129 || ṣoḍaśairdvādaśairvā'pi mahāpīṭhaṃ prakalpayet| athavā'nyaprakāreṇa pīṭhasthānaṃ vidhīyate|| 30.130 || tṛtisāle catussāle pañcasāle'śramadhyame| mahāpīṭhaṃ prakartavyaṃ tasya lakṣaṇamucyate|| 30.131 || athavā vyomahastaṃ tu adhamaṃ piṭhavistṛtam| dvihastaṃ madhyamaṃ proktaṃ trihastaṃ śroṣṭamucyate|| 30.132 || tadvistarasamaṃ tuṅgaṃ tuṅgaṃ saptā'ṣṭaviṃśatiḥ| upānoccaṃ dvibhāgaṃ syātṣaḍaṃśaṃ jagatī bhavet|| 30.133 || kumudoccaṃ tu bhūtāṃśaṃ kampamekāṃśamucyate| vedāṃśaṃ kaṇṭhamānaṃ tu ūrdhvakampaṃ śivāṃśakam|| 30.134 mahāpaṭṭī guṇāṃśaṃ tu dvibhāgaṃ vā vi śeṣataḥ| vedāṃśaṃ padmabhāgaṃ tu dvibhāgaṃ karṇikodayam|| 30.135 || athavā karṇikotsedhaṃ guṇāṃśaṃ dvijasattama| padmoccaṃ padmabhāgaṃ tu mahāpaṭṭī dvibhāgikā|| 30.136 || upānoccaṃ śivāṃ śena śeṣaṃ pūrvavadeva hi| adhvā pīṭhoyaṃ vipra dharātālaṃ yathākuru|| 30.137 || tadurdhvo parimānaṃ tu pīṭhoccānyaṃśamucyate| adhiṣṭhānoktamārgeṇa veśaniṣkrāntamācaret|| 30.138 || padmatāre yugāṃśaṃ vā bhūtāṃśaṃ karṇikāyatam| pīṭhākāraṃ yugāgraṃ vā kartavyaṃ maṅgalāmbujam|| 30.139 || lohajaṃ śailajaṃ vā'pi iṣṭikāmaya meva vā| aṃśasyopari pīṭhocca mupapīṭhopanātkuru|| 30.140 || tadūrdhve tu mahāpīṭhaṃ uktavyaṃ sodayānvitam| upapīṭhe vinā pīṭhaṃ kartavyaṃ syāddvijottama|| 30.141 || netraṃ rasaṃ ca bhūtaṃ ca ekaṃ vedaṃ ca bhāgikam| guṇaṃ vedaṃ ca netraṃ ca upanādi pramāṇavat|| 30.142 || eka vedaguṇaṃ caiva karṇaṃ caikaṃ ca netravat| ekaṃ guṇagaṇaṃ caiva balipīṭhapramāṇataḥ|| 30.143 || prabhabhasyā'grataḥ kuryātprāsādātmā pramāṇavat| dvārasthānaṃ tadagre tu tanni pātraśivālayam|| 30.144 || ete vṛṣācalaṃ sarvaśāntaṃ vāme tu gopurāt| atha vakṣye viśeṣeṇa balipīṭhasya lakṣaṇam|| 30.145 || liṅgodayasamaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ tadardhaṃ kanyasaṃbhavet| tayormadhye'ṣṭadhā kṛtvā navamānaṃ prakīrtitam|| 30.146 || tathavā piṇḍikotsedhaṃ kanyasaṃ pīchavistṛtam| tattāramadhyamaṃ jñeyaṃ tannāsraṃcottamaṃ stṛtam|| 30.147 || tadardhamadhamaṃ jñeyaṃ tayormadhye'ṣṭabhājite| navadhā pīṭhavistāraḥ utsedhastatsame bhavet|| 30.148 || aṣṭa vā dvāravistāramadhamaṃ piṭhavistṛtam| dviguṇaṃ madhyamaṃ proktaṃ triguṇaṃ cottamaṃ bhavet|| 30.149 || athavā dvāratuṅgārdhaṃ kanyasaṃ pīṭhavistṛtam| tripādaṃ madhyamaṃ proktaṃ tatsamaṃ cottamaṃ bhavet|| 30.150 || adhamottamayormadhye navamānaṃ prakīrtitam| dharātalasamotsedhamadhamaṃ pīṭhavistṛtam|| 30.151 || triguṇaṃ madhyamaṃ proktaṃ tayormardhye'ṣṭabhājite| navadhā pīṭhatuṅgaṃ tu vistāraṃ tatsamaṃ bhavet|| 30.152 || trihantamuttamavyāsamekahastaṃ tu kanyasam| dvikaraṃ madhyamaṃ jñeyaṃ pīṭhavyāsaṃ prakīrtatam|| 30.153 || pañcaviṃśāṅgulārabhya dvidvyaṅgula vivardhanāt| e kāśītyaṅgulāntaṃ yatpīṭhavyāsaḥ prakīrtataḥ|| 30.154 || upāna bāhye vistāraḥ uttamassaṃprakīrtataḥ| jagatībavyavistāraḥ madhyamassaṃ prakīrtataḥ|| 30.155 || kumudānte prakartavyaṃ vistāramadhamaṃ smṛtam| prāsādoktakrameṇaiva mahāphīṭhodayaṃ tu vā|| 30.156 || mahāpīṭhodayaṃ sapta catvāriṃśadvibhājite| parvatāṃśaṃ jagatyuccaṃ saptaṃśaṃ kumudoccayam|| 30.157 || śivāṃśaṃ kampamānaṃ syādindrabhāgaṃ galodayam| kampatuṅgaṃ śīvāṃśaṃ syāttatsamaṃ tvambujodayam|| 30.158 || kapotoccaṃ tu vedāṃśaṃ dvibhāgaṃ prastarodaram| sārdhāṃśaṃ kampatuṅgaṃ syātsārdhaṣaṭkamalodayam|| 30.159 || vedāśaṃ karṇikotsedhaṃ dviguṇaṃ tasya vistaram| athavā pīṭhatuṅgaṃ tu pañcabhāgavibhājite|| 30.160 || e kāṃśaṃ vedikotsedhamekāṃśaṃ kumudodayam| śivāṃśaṃ karṇatuṅgassyādardhāṃśaṃ paṭṭikodayam|| 30.161 || e kāṃśaṃ kamalotsedhamardhāṃśaṃ karṇikodayam| dviguṇaṃ tasya vistāraṃ sapādādhikameva vā|| 30.162 || mahānasa pratiṣṭhāyāṃ vāstuhomādike kṛte| kumbhamekaṃ pratiṣṭhāpya dhānyarāśiṣu pūrvavate|| 30.163 || samidhājya caruṃ prāgvajjuhuyānmūlavidyayā| tatrasthadevatānāṃ tu tattvanyāsaṃ samācaret|| 30.164 || brāhmaṇān bhojayecchaktyā dadyāccaiva tu dakṣiṇām| peṣaṇādyaṅgajātāni kṣālayitvā'dhivāsayet|| 30.165 || tataḥ prabhātasamaye muhūrte śobhane guruḥ| agnimīḍeti mantreṇa cullīṣvagniṃ nidhāpayet|| 30.166 || paceyaḥ pācanādīni havīṃṣi paricārakāḥ| kuṇḍe ca nityahomārdhaṃ sthāpayedagnimagni mān|| 30.167 || prāguktenaiva mantreṇa purastānmantra pūrvakam| nyasetkumbhajalenaiva kramāccaṇḍādi devatāḥ|| 30.168 || dvāre caṇḍhaṃ pracaṇḍhaṃ ca kṣetrapālaṃ khageśvaram| dvārasya dakṣiṇe pārśve gaṇānāmapi nāyakaṃ|| 30.169 || jṛmbhalaṃ māṇibhadraṃ ca śibiṃ kuṇḍala meva ca| dvārasya cottare pārśve pārśveṣvanyeṣu cakramāt|| 30.170 || prāsādadvāravaddvare lakṣmyādi parikalpanam| culyāśca vāmetarayordharmādharyau ca pṛṣṭhataḥ|| 30.171 || vidhātāraṃ tathā dīrghaculyā ubhaya pārśvayoḥ| dharmādharmadvayaṃ nyasyetphātrāṇi samalānyapi|| 30.172 || śrīsūkaināmbhasā prokṣya maṅgulānyapi kārayet| gurave dakṣiṇāṃ dadyādyajamāno yathābalam|| 30.173 || yaḥ kalpayoddra savatīṃ bhaktīmānviṣṇumandire| sa bhuktvā vipurān bhogān pretya svargamavāpnuyāt|| 30.174 || dhānyāgāraṃ dhanāgāraṃ sārasvatagṛhaṃ tathā| tathā majjanaśālā ca puṣpapānīyamandiram|| 30.175 || tambhūlakalpanagṛhaṃ vādyasthānaṃ caturmakha| sthanaṃ ca yacca dhāmāṅgaṃ kalpitaṃ śilpavittamaiḥ|| 30.176 || ācāryo vāstuhomādi śāstroktavidhipūrvakam| kriyā kalāpa makhilaṃ kuryātpūrvoktayā diśā|| 30.177 || ācārya dakṣiṇācaiva deyā vittānusārataḥ| vāpīkūpataṭākānāṃ pratiṣṭhāne cikīrṣite|| 30.178 || teṣāṃ paścimadigbhāge vediṃ kuryā cca pūrvavat| jalādhidaivataṃ hṛdyamalpakāyavinirmitam|| 30.179 || lohajaiḥ kalaśaintatra snāpayeddeśikottamaḥ| mantrairvaruṇadaivatyaiśśayane śāyayettataḥ|| 30.180 || tamarcayenmahākumbhe caturṣvekatra vā punaḥ| kuṇḍeṣu juhuyānmantraistaddaivatyerghṛtādibhiḥ|| 30.181 || vāruṇāni ca sūktāni dikṣu pāṭhyāni bhūsuraiḥ| prabhāte śobhane lagne śobhite pūrva vajjalaiḥ|| 30.182 || puṇyāhaṃ vācayitvā'nai dhyāyedamṛtavāribhiḥ| pūritaṃ tattaṭākādīn kururekāgramānasaḥ|| 30.183 || mahākumbhajalaṃ tatra vāruṇaṃ ca vinikṣipet| mīnādi jalayonīṃśca lohajaṃ tatra nikṣipet|| 30.184 || gaṅgādisaritastatra mantrairāvāhayejjale| bhukteṣu brāhmaṇeṣvarthai starpiteṣu yathāvasu|| 30.185 || dakṣiṇā gurave deyā daśaniṣkāvarā tataḥ| karoti yastaṭākādi pratiṣṭhānaṃ jalāśaye|| sa nitya tṛtpassuciraṃ loke vasati vāruṇe|| 30.186 || iti śrīpāñcarātre mahopaniṣadi pādmasaṃhitāyāṃ kriyāpāde lakṣmyādipāṇigrahaṇavimānādipratiṣṭhāvidhirnāma triṃśo'dhyāyaḥ|
<2.31>
śrībhagavān kālāntare prabhādīnāṃ pratiṣṭhāvidhirucyate| jalādhivāsādyakhilaṃ karma kṛtvāyathāpuram|| 31.1 || dhyānakāle tu saṃprāpte dhyāye devaṃ gurussvayam| jvālāmālāsahaprāḍhyāṃ vidyutsaṅghātasannibhām|| 31.2 || prabhāṃ dhyātvāspṛśet śānti homānterahomasarpiṣā| prabhāte mūlamantreṇa prokṣayotkumbhavāriṇā|| 31.3 || muhūrte yojayeccāpi kārayecca mahotsavam| dakṣiṇā gurave deyā yathāvibhava mānataḥ|| 31.4 || prabhāyāṃ devadevyādīn yojayeduktavartma nā| sa tu sāyujyamāpnoti kāmānapi yathepsitān|| 31.5 || pīṭhaṃ saṃsthāpya tatraiva nyasyedyogāsanaṃ guruḥ| hutvāmantraiḥ kramātphadmasthāpane vidhirīdṛśaḥ|| 31.6 || yojaye ccāpi pīṭhādīn tatrasthāṃ samaye guruḥ| evaṃ pīṭhādi devārdaṃ yaḥ kalpayati mānavaḥ|| 31.7 || sa pratiṣṭhāmavāpnoti paratreha ca śāśvatīm| maṇṭāṃ ca pañcagavyena snāpayitvā yathoditaiḥ|| 31.8 || pañcavāruṇikairmantrairnava vavastreṇa veṣṭayet| sthaṇḍile śālibhāraṃ ca nikṣipya tilataṇḍulān|| 31.9 || tadūrdhve navavastraṃ ca sadarbhaṃ nyasya tatra vaiḥ| śāyayitvā ca tāṃ ghaṇṭāṃ chādayennavāvāsasā|| 31.10 || kumbhamekaṃ samabhyarcya kumbhe vā sthaṇḍhile'pivā | ghaṇṭāmantreṇa juhuyādācāryassamidhādibhiḥ|| 31.11 || śoṣaṇādīni kāryāṇi tāṃ yathoktaṃ vicintayet| śāntihomāvasāne ca spṛśettāṃ homasarpiṣā|| 31.12 || prabhāte mantratoyena tāmukṣenmantra pūrvakam| evaṃ susaṃskṛtāṃ ghaṇṭāṃ cālayetsarva karmasu|| 31.13 || udghāṭane kavāṭasya prastute pūjane tathā| āvahane'rghye snapane puṣpe dhūpe ca dīpake|| 31.14 || nī rājane yavanikāsamuddhāre nivedane| homa bhūtabalau karmaṇyudvāhe calanaṃ maṇeḥ|| 31.15 || utsādanaṃ piśācādeḥ prīṇanaṃ ca hareḥ param| sannidhanamamartyānāṃ ghaṇṭāyāścalanādbhavet|| 31.16 || asaṃskṛtāyāśaacalane grāmādeścalanaṃ bhavet| niṣphalā cāpi pūjā svātparasya paramātmanaḥ|| 31.17 || ghaṇṭāṃ prayaccheddharaye jāyate kīrtamānnaraḥ| ghaṇṭā saṃskāravaddhūpadīpa pātrasya saṃskṛtiḥ|| 31.18 || bheryādīnāṃ ca saṃśuddhiḥ pañcagavyaiḥ praśasyate| rathādiyānajātasya saṃśuddhiriyamiṣyate|| 31.19 || mantreṇa prokṣaṇācchuddhiśchatrādīnā mapīṣyate| narvatra bhojaye dviprān puṇyāhaṃcāpi kārayet|| 31.20 || dakṣiṇā cāpi gurave deyā vittānusārataḥ| akṣamālā pratiṣṭhāṃca tadbhedāṃśca yathātatham|| 31.21 || jape phalaṃ ca sakalamadhunā kathyate'bjaja| narvaratnaiśca lohaiśca sphaṭikaistrividhairapi|| 31.22 || jalajaistalajairvāpi kārayedakṣamālikāḥ| ākṣāsthimātrā maṇayaśśreṣṭhāssyurjapakarmaṇi|| 31.23 || dhātrīphalāsthimātrāstu madhyamāḥ kamalāsana| badarāsthi pramāṇāstu kaniṣṭhā maṇayaḥ smṛtāḥ|| 31.24 || aṣṭottara śataṃ saṅkhyā maṇīnāṃ śreyasī bhavet| tadardhasaṅkhyā kathitā madhyamā caramā punaḥ|| 31.25 || saptaviṃśatisaṅkhyā ca tairbhavedakṣamālikā| svargāpavargadaṃ ratnaṃ sauvarṇaṃ vibhavapradam|| 31.26 || rājataṃ kīrtadhanadaṃ tāmraṃ śāntikaraṃ bhavet| trāpuṣairmaṇibhi rjapyaṃ yakṣāṃścāpi vaśaṃ nayet|| 31.27 || sīsākṣamālayā rakṣo vaśe kuryāccaturmukha| pīḍayecca tathā śatrūn kāṃsyaissarvān vaśaṃ nayet|| 31.28 || āyasaiścā'pi bhūtāni jāpakassvavaśaṃ nayet| sphaṭikaṃ mokṣadaṃ japtussarvado dyumaṇermaṇiḥ|| 31.29 || indormaṇistathaiva syādakṣāssyu rjalajāḥ punaḥ| putradaḥ putradīpassyādindrākṣassarvakāmadaḥ|| 31.30 || vibhītakākṣarudrākṣa nimbākṣāścābhicārakāḥ| brahmavarcasakāmasya kuśagrandiḥ praśasyate|| 31.31 || rāhya kāmasya padmākṣairjaptussidhyati taddhruvam|| sitāmbho jākṣamālā tu japturnaśreyasapradāḥ|| 31.32 || bhuktimuktipradā śaṅkhā muktāmuktiphalapradā| jalajairmaṇibhirmālā japturisthaṃ phalapradā|| 31.33 || akṣānyathoktān saṃgṛhya vṛttān doṣavivarjitān| prakṣālya pañcabhirgavyaiḥ pañca vedāntavidyayā|| 31.34 || āropayeddhemasūtre triguṇaistriguṇīkṛte| sūtre vā rājate kṣaume śaṇa keśādivarjite|| 31.35 || kārpāse vā yathālābhaṃ kṣālite pariśodhite| pṛṣṭhena pṛṣṭhabhāge ca mukhabhāge mukhe na ca|| 31.36 || parasparoṇa saṃbaddhā maṇayassadṛśāśśūbhāḥ| sūtreṇa vā suvarṇena madhye baddhe tathāntaram|| 31.37 || protanūtreṣu taiḥ kalphyā mālikā kaṭakākṛtiḥ| maṇimanyaṃ tu badhnī yā nmālāgranthau mahattaram|| 31.38 || merusaṃjñā maṇestasya bha veddakṣiṇato gatiḥ| puṇyāhaṃ vācayitvā'nte mālāṃ sthāpyāmbhujodare|| 31.39 || vilipya kuṅkumādyaistāmakṣamālāṃ caturmukha| śālibhāraṃ ca nikṣipya tilataṇḍhulasaṃyutam|| 31.40 || likhitvā tatra cakrājbamā stīrya kuśavastrakam| tatrā'kṣamālāṃ vinyasya chādayennavavāsasā|| 31.41 || yajeta kumbhe tanmantraṃ hemavastrādi saṃyute| homamekatra kurvīta kuṇḍe vā sthaṇḍile'pi vā|| 31.42 || samiccatughṛtairaṣṭau śataṃ ca svasva vidyayā| dhyānena śoṣaṇādīni kṛtvā nyacca yathāpuram|| 31.43 || tanmadhye puruṣaṃ dyāyedbaddhāñjalimavasthitam| caturbhujaṃ valarkṣābhaṃ varadābhayahantakam|| 31.44 || akṣamālāṃ ca bibhrāṇaṃ śikhāgre kaṭakākṛtim| śāntihomāvasāne ca saṃspṛśe dakṣaṇālikām|| 31.45 || prāpte mūhūrte tattvāni nyasyetsṛṣṭikramādguruḥ| yā parā vaiṣṇavī śaktirabhinnā paramātmanaḥ|| 31.46 || tejasā''dityasaṅgāśāṃ prāgvat smṛtvā hṛdambhuje| dhyāyettato brahmarandhrā dudgacchantīṃ śanaiśśanaiḥ|| 31.47 || āvahya cā'kṣamālāyā mantreṇa svenamantravit| mūlamantreṇa kumbhasthavāriṇā prokṣayedguruḥ|| 31.48 || sannidhaṃ cā'kṣamālāyāṃ yāceta paramātmanaḥ| sannidhattāṃ bhavānasmin bhaktānugrahakāmyayā|| 31.49 || japā'kṣamālāvalaye gādhāmenāṃ samuccaran| tatrā'kṣamālāṃ bibhraṇaṃ dhyātvā devaṃ janārdhanam|| 31.50 || śiṣyasya yajamānasya haste dadyādgurussvayam| praṇamya pratigṛhṇīyāt śirasā tāṃ samāhitaḥ|| 31.51 || vidyāmiva yathāvittaṃ dadyācca gurudakṣiṇām| tasmin muhūrte tāṃ vidyāṃ sañjapedakṣamālayā|| 31.52 || ādau yamakṣamālāyāṃ mantraṃ sthāpitavān guruḥ| tameva mantraṃ gaṇayenna yaṃ kañcana mālayā|| 31.53 || apratiṣṭhāpitā yā ca tayā naivā'kṣamālayā| japaṃ kurvannaro mohātkurvannaivā'śnu te phalam|| 31.54 || iti śrī pāñcarātre mahopaniṣadi pādmasaṃhitāyāṃ kriyāpāde prabhā ghaṃṭākṣamālā pratiṣṭhāvidhirnāma ekatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ |
<2.32>
śrībhagavān gṛhārcāsthāpanaṃ vakṣye yathāvatkamalāsana| sauvarṇī rājatī vā'pi pratimā syāddvijanmanām|| 32.1 || ārakūṭamayī yadvā yadvā tāmramayī bhavet| lohajāḥ pratimāssarvāssarva kāmaphalapradāḥ|| 32.2 || śilābimbaṃ dārubimbaṃ svagṛhe nārcayedbudhaḥ| piśācādi vaśīkāre pratimā cāyasī matā|| 32.3 || uccāṭanakarī kāṃsyapratimā kamalāsana| trilohajā śatrujayā sīsakosthā'mayapradā|| 32.4 || ratna japratimāssarvāssarvakāma phalapradāḥ| candrakāntasphaṭikajā saumyā pratikṛtirmatā|| 32.5 || āgneyī mitramaṇijā anyā sphaṭikajā dvidhā| pālagrāmaśilā śvetā saumyā saumyaphalapradā|| 32.6 || śrīkarī pītavarṇā ca raktā kāmapradā matā| kṛṣṇā puṣṭipradā nityaṃ piṅgalā rogadā sadā|| 32.7 || śilāśca krasarijjātāssarvā mokṣaphalapradāḥ| mūrtabhirgarbhitāssarvā śśilāścakra saridbhavāḥ|| 32.8 || prādurbhāvaiśca mīnādyaistathā divyāyudhairapi| lāñcitāḥ kaustubhādyaiśca bhūṣaṇaiḥ kamalāsana|| 32.9 || aṅkitāḥ pūjanīyāśca bhuktimuktiphalārthibhiḥ| sarvāssvāyambhuvā jñeyāśśilāśca krasaridbhavāḥ|| 32.10 || nityaṃ sannidhi retāsu parasya paramātmanaḥ| na pratiṣṭhā vidhātavyā na caivā''vāhanādikam|| 32.11 || sālagrāmaśilā yatra pūjyate bhagavanmayaiḥ| taddeśe yojanādarvāṅmṛto nirvāṇamaśnu te|| 32.12 || dvāravatyāścilāścāpi sālagrāmaśilāsamāḥ| drumajātipratikṛtissabhājyā kāmanavaśāt|| 32.13 || pratimā candanamayī pūjitā śriyamāvahet| pratimā cā'garumayī bhuktimukti phalapradā|| 32.14 || devadārumayaṃ bimbaṃ sarvadaṃ bhavane'rcitam| bilvajā pratimā lakṣmīmatulāmānahetsadā|| 32.15 || brahmavarcasakāmena brahmavṛkṣasamudbhavā| śamīpratikṛtissvargyā namerussukhadābhavet|| 32.16 || annādikāmaiḥ pratimā pūjyodumbaradārujā| aśvatthanirmitā pūjyā rājyakāmena dhāmani|| 32.17 || nyagrodhanirmitaṃ bimbaṃ sarvatra bhavane'rcitam| plakṣajaṃ jīvadhanadaṃ sarvopakaraṇāvaham|| 32.18 || piyaṅgu nirmitaṃ bimbaṃ śrīvaśyaṃ bhavanercitam| putradīpamayaṃ pratrakārakaṃ muktidaṃ tathā|| 32.19 || mantrādi sādhane yuktāṃ saralārcāṃ samarcayet| tamālajātipratimā sarvaloka sukhāvahā|| 32.20 || cūtajā'rogyadā putra vittajā badarīkṛtā| vasapratimā brahman bahuputrā samarcitā|| 32.21 || kṣīraṇī dhanadā jñeyā saptalā dukhanāśinī| dhanajaṃ jātijaṃ bimbaṃ sphandajaṃ sukhakāraṇam|| 32.22 || timidaṃ dhanajaṃ brahman kadambaṃ jñānakāraṇam| kuravaḥ puṣṭhiphaladastilakassarvakāmadaḥ|| 32.23 || madhūkassiddhidaścāhurasanaśśrīkarassadā| puṣṭido jambuvṛkṣastu punnāgaḥ puṣṭivardhanaḥ|| 32.24 || rogado rājavṛkṣaśca kādiraścākṣināśanaḥ| nimbhavṛkṣapratikṛtirvidyeṣaṇa karī matā|| 32.25 || vibhītikā śalmalī ca kalpyate kamalāsana| gajotpāṭikāgaurārka mūlakalpitakautukam|| 32.26 || vaināyakamabhipretasakalārtha prasādakam| mātrāṅgulivaśenaiva gṛhārcāmānakalpanam|| 32.27 || nādhikaṃ hastamānācca na nyūnaṃ dvādaśāṅgulāt| kautukaṃ bhavane'bhyarcaṃ śilādārvādijaṃ dhruvam|| 32.28 || aṅgulaiḥ pratimāmānaṃ varṇānāmucyate kramāt| hastamānamitārcā syādbhavane pūrvajanmanaḥ|| 32.29 || aṅgulai rekaviṃśatyā pratimā vasudhāpate| viśāmekonaviṃśatyā dvābhyāṃ sūdrasya hīnayā|| 32.30 || ardhacitraṃ tadabhāsaṃ bhavane bhuktivardhanam| dvādaśāṅgulamānārcā lohajā pūrvajanmanaḥ|| 32.31 || navāṅgulā kṣatriyasya viśassaptāṅgulā matā| pañcāṅgulā caturthasya pratimā bhavane bhavet|| 32.32 || pratimā yanmayī klṛptā prabhāpīṭhādi tanmayam| yadvā sovarṇabimbasya rājataṃ tāmrameva vā|| 32.33 || lo hena ceduttamena pratimā nirmitā bhavet| tadanantaralohena prabhāpīṭhādī kalpayet|| 32.34 || trilohajāyāmarcāyāṃ suvarṇaṃ vā prabhādikam| ratnasphaṭikajānāṃ tu pratimānāṃ prabhādikam| lojahaṃ smaryate brahman rahasyamidamīritam|| 32.35 || gṛhe saṃhāraśayanamarcayennakadācana| bhagavanmūrtayastvanyā ssarvāḥ pūjyā tathātatham|| 32.36 || śrī bhūmi sahitaṃ devaṃ śriyā kevalayā'pi vā| sahitāṃ pūjaye nnityaṃ bhaktyā padmani ketana|| 32.37 || pūjāsthānaṃ gṛhasyoktaṃ mārutyāṃ diśi nā'nyathā| arcayedbhavaneṣvarcāṃ yajamāno yathoditām|| 32.38 || tatpratiṣṭhārthamācāryamabhyarthyā''gamayodgṛham| aṅkaṇe vā nadītī re kṣetre yadvā supūjite|| 32.39 || vedikāṃ paritaḥ klṛpte homakuṇḍacatuṣṭaye| ekarsmi vā guruḥ kuryātphratiṣṭhā karmāpūrvavat|| 32.40 || aṅkurānarpayitvāgre jale caivādhivāsanam| nayanonmīlanaṃ cā'pi kuryā'tpūrvoktavartmavā|| 32.41 || pādyamarghyaṃ tathācāmaṃ pañcagavyaṃ tathā dathi| payomadhukaṣāyaṃ ca uṣṇāmbhaḥ phalavāri ca|| 32.42 || mārjanāmbhokṣatāmbhaśca ratnāmbho lohavāri ca| gandhāmbhaśca yapāmbhaśca krameṇā'nena padmaja|| 32.43 || snāpayecca nṛsūktena tathedaṃ viṣṇurityṛcā| snapanaṃ kārayedvārvān mantraiḥ prāguktavartmanā|| 32.44 || śayanādikamanyacca kriyājātaṃ yathāpuram| mahāpratiṣṭhā vidhivatkarma kuryādgurussvayam|| 32.45 || pratimāstāpanasthāne ratnanyāsādi pūrvakam| prāptai muhūrte pratimā sthāvarāṃ cedabhīptitām|| 32.46 || sthāne tāṃ sthāpayitvaivaṃ kuryā dhāvāhanādikam| jaṅgamā cedabhimatā vedyā māvahanādikam|| 32.47 || kuryāttadanu tāṃ sthāne sthāpayedvidhipūrvakam| caṇḍapracaṇḍau valaje kṣetrapālaṃ khageśvaram|| 32.48 || vighneśaṃ vāstunāthaṃ ca durgāṃ vā tatra kalpayet| guhaṃ ca viṣvaksenaṃ ca śaṅkhapadmanidhī tathā|| 32.49 || ācāryacodito bhūmau patitvā daṇḍavatsvayam| yājamānaḥ prārthayettamabhīpsitam śeṣataḥ|| 32.50 || dāso'smi tava deveśa saputragaṇabhāndavaḥ| sannidhassvagṛho yāvadanvavāyo mamā'cyuta|| 32.51 || phūjāṃ mayā yathāśakti vihitāṃ vikalāmapi| gṛhṇīṣva bhagavan bhaktajanānugraha kāmyayā|| 32.52 || yācitvā devadeveśa mitthamācārya sannidau| gurave dakṣiṇāṃ dadyādyathāvibhavistaram|| 32.53 || yathā ca tṛptirasya syāt ṛtvijāmapi pūrvavat| bhrāhmaṇān bhojayecchaktyā tobhyo dadvācca dakṣiṇām|| 32.54 || sthāpayitvā'rcayeddevaṃ bhaktimān bhaktavatsalam| bhuktvā bhogān suvistīrṇān pretya nehā'bhijāyite|| 32.55 || bhavane sthāpito viṣṇuḥ puṣṇāti kulamātmanaḥ| mandire tu gajatsarvaṃ puṣṇāti sthāpito hariḥ|| 32.56 || śrī vatsakaustubhoṣṇīṣavanamālā catuṣṭayam| pradhāna bhuṣaṇaṃ viṣṇoḥ pratiṣṭhāpya yathāvidhi|| 32.57 || śrīvatsaṃ sthāpayitvāgre śālibharāre saśāṭake| niveśya pralayaṃ sargaṃ mahākumbhaṃ yajedguruḥ|| 32.58 || kuṇḍe śrīvatsamantreṇa nalinākārakalpite| juhuyātsamidhā ghāracatubhiśśatamaṣṭa ca|| 32.59 || vārānnyaseśca tattvāni śāntiṃ hutvāspṛśeccatam| saṃprokṣya kumbhatoyena muhūrtme harivakṣasi|| 32.60 || niveśayeddakṣiṇā ca deyā niṣkatrayā'varā| gurave yajamāne manaḥ prītivivardhanī|| 32.61 || yo bhūṣayati deveśaṃ śrīvatsapratikarmaṇā| sa lakṣmīṃ labhate nityāmuttamāṃ nā'tra saṃśayaḥ|| 32.62 || kaustubhaṃ svena mantreṇa sthāpayitvā yathāpuram| harimā kalpayettena muhūrte deśikottamaḥ|| 32.63 || yajamānaśca gurave prayaccheddakṣiṇāṃ śubhām| yaḥ kaustubhena deveśaṃ maṇḍaye daśnute śriyam|| 32.64 || vanamālāṃ ca sauvarṇīṃ nānāratna pariṣkṛtām| sthāpayitvoktamārgeṇa muhūrte śabhane guruḥ|| 32.65 || karṇe pralambayodviṣṇossarvasambatkarīṃ nṛṇām| dakṣiṇāṃ kurave dadvādyajamāno'pi puṣkalām|| 32.66 || yaśca cabhuṣayati śriśaṃ manujo vanamālāyā| po'śnu te durlabhān kāmān sarvānevana śaṃśayaḥ|| 32.67 || pretya lokān suvipulān svargādīn so'śnute'kṣayān| śuddhajāmbūnadamayaṃ kirīṭaṃ maṇibhiścitam|| 32.68 || cetasā bhaktiyuktena yathārhaṃ madhuvidviṣaḥ| kalaśaissaptadaśabhissnāpayitvā svavidyayā|| 32.69 || śālibhāreṣu vinyasya veṣṭayitvā ca vāsasā| ahatena punaḥ pumbho yajedāvāhya vidyayā|| 32.70 || juhuyācca caturthakṣu vidyayā ca svayā guruḥ| spṛṣṭā ca śāntihomānte prabhāte kumbhavāriṇā|| 32.71 || saṃprokṣya svena mantreṇa datvā ca gurudakṣiṇām| prāpte muhūrte deveśamāsīnaṃ bhūpaviṣṭare|| 32.72 || snāpayedrājanaddevamārādyā kalpabhūṣaṇaiḥ| brāhmaṇeṣu caturvedā nadhīyāneṣu sarvataḥ|| 32.73 || nānāvidheṣu vādyeṣu caturdikṣu nadatsu ca| vandāruṣu ca deveśaṃ stotrairuccāvacairbhṛśam|| 32.74 || stuvastu bhaktinamreṣu śrībhūmisahitaṃ harim| prastūyamāneṣvanyeṣu maṅgaleṣu samantataḥ|| 32.75 || kuṇḍheṣu purato hutvā pūrvavatsamidādībhiḥ| caturdikṣu ca turdvāri e kāgneḥ koṇataḥ sthite|| 32.76 || pañcopaniṣadairmantraiḥ kirīṭaṃ devamūrdhani| āropayeyurācāryyāḥ mūrtipāśca vicakṣaṇāḥ|| 32.77 || muñceyuḥ puṣpavṛṣṭiṃ ca tūryaghoṣapurassaram| mahadbhirucāraiśca guruṇā'bhyarcitaṃ harim|| 32.78 || brāhmaṇebhyo dhanaṃ datvā sukhāsīnāṃ mahāsane| yānamāropya hastyādi śvetacchatra virājitam|| 32.79 || vījyamānaṃ ca gaureṇa cāmareṇa samantataḥ| grāmaṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ nītvā mandire viniveśayet|| 32.80 || yaḥ kirīṭena deveśamākalphena prasādhayet| trayāṇāmapi lokānāmādhipatyaṃ sa vindati|| 32.81 || hārādibhirnūpurāntrairbhūṣaṇaistapanīyajaiḥ| kṣālitairgandhato yena dvādaśākṣaravidyayā|| 32.82 || dhānyarāśiṣu saṃsthāpya homaṃ ca samidādibhiḥ| spṛṣṭvā kalpaṃ japenmantraṃ deśiko dvādaśākṣaram|| 32.83 || mūhūrte bhūṣayettena deveśaṃ vidyāyā tayā| ye bhūṣayati deveśaṃ so'pi kāryān samaśnute|| 32.84 || pañcāyudhānāṃ divyānāṃ pratiṣṭhā vakṣyate'dhunā| cakrasya tāvatsarveṣu mukhyasya kamalāsana|| 32.85 || vakṣyate sthāpanaṃ tasya yānaṃ rūpaṃ ca yādṛśam| vistṛtaṃ hastamānena yadvā saptadaśāṅgulam|| 32.86 || aṣṭādaśāṅgulaṃ yadvā viṃśatyaṅgulameva vā| caturdhaśāṅgulaṃ yadvā ṣoḍaśadvādaśāṅgulam|| 32.87 || mūlabimbānanasamaṃ sahasrāraṃ samujvalam| yadvā śatāramathavā caturviṃśatyarānvitam|| 32.88 || dvādaśāramathāṣṭhāramathavā ṣaḍaraṃ param| sahasrajvālamathavā ṣaḍjvālaṃ nābhimaṇṭitam|| 32.89 || triloha nirmitaṃ cakraṃ nālapīṭhasamanvitam| kṛtvā karaṇḍhamukuṭaṃ bibhrāṇaṃ vā sudarśanam|| 32.90 || caturbhujadharaṃ kruddhaṃ bhrukuṭīkuṭilānanam| puruṣaṃ dvibhujaṃ yadvā dakṣiṇenāpi tarjanam|| 32.91 || spṛśantaṃ kaṭimanyena itarābhyāṃ kṛtāñjalim| mukhyābhyāṃ tu karābhyāṃ vā susthitaṃ padmaviṣṭare|| 32.92 || athivāsya jale pūrvaṃ sthāpayitvā ca maṇṭape| śayayitvā ca śayane iṣṭvā kumbhe svavidyayā|| 32.93 || dvāyanpuruṣamatyugraṃ dvibhujaṃ raktavāsasam| raktadaṃṣṭrānanaṃ nābho saṃsthitaṃ gururīdṛśam|| 32.94 || caturdikṣu ca kuṇḍeṣu cakramantreṇa mūrtipāḥ| juhuyussamidhāghāraṃ carubiḥ kamalāsana|| 32.95 || kuṇḍheṣvekatra puratastoraṇādīni pūrvavat| arcayitvā tataścakraṃ śoṣayecchoṣaṇādibhiḥ|| 32.96 || sphṛṣṭvātu śāntihomānte nābhyādyavayavān kramāt| mūhūrte kumbhatoyena śiñcedātmīyā vidyayā|| 32.97 || caturṇāmita reṣāṃ ca śaṅkhādīnāṃ yathāpuram| pratiṣṭhāpanamācāryaḥ svairmantrairanupūrvaśaḥ|| 32.98 || gurave dakṣiṇā deyā daśaniṣkāvarā tataḥ| paṃcāyudhāni nirmāya yaḥ sthāpayati mānavaḥ|| 32.99 || sa viṣṭapatraye dīmān na bhibheti kutaścana|
