bhuṅkai ca bhogān vistīrṇān yodate ca triviṣṭape|| 32.100 || caṇḍhādi dvārapālānāṃ pratiṣṭhāvidhirucyate| jalādivāsanaṃ pūrvaṃ maṇṭape snapanaṃ tathā|| 32.101 || śayyāyāṃ cāpi śayanaṃ kumbhe caikatra pūjanam| homaścaturṣu kuṇḍheṣu kuṇḍhe vaikatra padmaja|| 32.102 || tattvanyāsaṃ tathāśāntihomāṅgasparśanaṃ tathā| prokṣaṇaṃ kumbhatoyena vidyayā ca svabhījayā|| 32.103 || gurave dakṣiṇā cā'pi deyā vittānusārataḥ| caṇḍādīn sthāpayenmatmartya ścaitatsārūpyamaśnute|| 32.104 || vainateyapratiṣṭhāyāṃ viśeṣo vakṣyate'dhunā| prācyāṃ juhvan bṛhatsāmnā tasyaṃ dhyāyedgurustataḥ|| 32.105 || dakṣiṇasyāṃ suparṇaṃ tu sauparṇyā vidyayā huvet| pratīcyāṃ garuḍaṃ kuṇḍhe dhyāyeddhomo rathantaraiḥ|| 32.106 || tārkṣyadhyānamudīcīne gāyatryā ca svayā hutiḥ| purastādupariṣṭā cca śubhaṃ karmayathāpuram|| 32.107 || sthāpako vainateyasya labhate tatsamīpatām| ādityasya pratiṣṭhā ca vidhātavyā yathāpuram|| 32.108 || viśeṣastūcyate kaścidyathāvadavadhāraya| āvahanaṃ svagāyatryātayā kuṇḍheṣu cāhutiḥ|| 32.109 || bibhrāḍityanuvā kena sāvitryā sthāpanaṃ tathā| māryasya mūlamantreṇa kuṇbhatoyena secanam|| 32.110 || sthāpakastasya talloke rājate muktakilbiṣaḥ| brahmādīnāṃ ca sarvāsāṃ devatānāṃ yathāpuram|| 32.111 || svātantrye pāratantrye ca svairmantraiḥ sthāpanaṃ bhavet| durgā ca mātarassapta yāḥ kāściddevatāstriyaḥ|| 32.112 || pratiṣṭhā tāsulakṣmīvanmantraissvaisvairviṃṣyate| brahmā viṣvaksevasya bhagavan utphattiḥ kāraṇātkṛtaḥ| sthāpanaṃ ca kathaṃ tasya kathyatāṃ yadyanugrahaḥ|| 32.113 || śrī bhāgavān dauvārikeṣu sarveṣu yaścaṇḍhaḥ prathamo bhavet| sa devāsurayoryuddhe balī daṇḍhadharassvayam|| 32.114 || jaghāna daityān devārthamātmanā'bhi pracoditaḥ| tasya tuṣṭoha madadāṃ matsvarūpasarūpatām|| 32.115 || aiśvaryaṃ kumudādīnāṃ balaṃ cā'prativāritam| viṣvassenasamākhyāṃ ca sarvasenādhipocitām|| 32.116 || naivedyasya caturthāṃśaṃ sarvasyopahṛtasya me| caṇḍhasya ca padetyugramanyaṃ sthāpita vānaham|| 32.117 || itthaṃ brahman tadutphattiḥ stāpyaśca mama sannidhau| sthāpanaṃ ca svamantreṇa tasyeṣṭaṃ yadvadātmanaḥ|| 32.118 || dakṣiṇā gurave deyā sthāpakasya phalaṃ tathā| pratikāyaṃ ca bhaktānāṃ kṛtvā sthāpanamācaret|| 32.119 || svatantraṃ vā'nyatantraṃ vā yathālābhaṃ śilādibhiḥ| kṛtāñjalipuṭaṃ saumyaṃ sthitamāsīnameva vā|| 32.120 || yathāvarṇaṃ yathārūpaṃ yathācāśramadharmiṇām| yathāpayorūpadharaṃ padmapiṭhe pratiṣṭhitam|| 32.121 || kṛtalakṣaṇasampannaṃ śilpibhissuparīkṣitam| yadvā karmānurūpeṇa pratikāyaṃ prakalphayet|| 32.122 || sthāpayedaṅgu rānādāvarpayitvā śubhe dine| ayugmāḥ pālikāḥ kāryāśśarāvaghaṭavarjitāḥ|| 32.123 || adhivāsanamārabhya pūrvavatkarmapaddatiḥ| upacārastathā homaḥ kumbhayāgaśca secanam|| 32.124 || pareṇa brahmaṇā kāryaṃ mantraiścānyainsupūjitaiḥ| toraṇādīnyajotpūrvaṃ na vedikalasānapi|| 32.125 || muhūrte prokṣayetkumbhavāriṇā deśikottamaḥ| svatantre mandiraṃ kalpyaṃ siṃhadiṅgūrtivarjitam|| 32.126 || dakṣigurośca pratimāṃ sthāpayenmantra siddhaye| dīkṣiṇā gurave deyā tarpaṇīyāśca bhūsurāḥ|| 32.127 || āvarjanīyaṃ sarvatra dhanairbrāhmaṇatoṣaṇam| ghaṇyāhavācanaṃ vipraissvādhyāyādhyāyanaṃ tathā|| 32.128 || dakṣiṇā ca guro rgurvī yajamānadhanocitā| etairyathoditairyuktaṃ hīnamanyena dūṣyati|| 32.129 || sthāpanaṃ pratikāyānāṃ brahmannai vā'tra saṃśayaḥ| satyahaṃ cārcanaṃ teṣāṃ upacāraiḥ pṛthagvidhaiḥ|| 32.130 || kartavyamutsavaṃ cā'pi dhvajārohaṇavarjitam| naparomo na bali stīrdhaṃ svātantryai vidhirīdṛśaḥ|| 32.131 || pāratantryetu bhaktāvā mutsavaḥ kamalāsana| devasyotsavamadhye ca prakrānā vā'tha nirmite|| 32.132 || tasmin kāryokṛte tasmin prīyate hi janārdhanaḥ| rājño rāṣṭrasya sarvasya brāhmaṇānāṃ gavāmapi|| 32.133 || jāyite bhuyasi sampadutsave vihite sati| iti brahman kriyāssarvāḥ kathitāḥ pṛcchatastava|| 32.134 || dayayā parayā bhūyaḥ kimanyacchrotumicchasi| saṃvartaḥ mahopaniṣadaṃ śāstraṃ caturveda samanvitam| saṃkṣipya ca śatādhyāyātpadmena kapilācchrutaṃ|| 32.135 || tadeva kaṇvassaṃkṣipya śriddadhānasya te mayā| dvātriṃśadadhyāyayutaṃ śubhaṃ vai sāravattaram|| 32.136 || padmāt śrutamidaṃ śāstraṃ tathā padmāhvayaṃ matam| idaṃ ca deyaṃ paramaṃ rahasyamanasūyave|| 32.137 || śraddadhānāya bhaktāya śucaye dīkṣitāya ca| brahmaṇāya prapannāya śrotriyāya ca dhīmate|| 32.138 || yadvā jyeṣṭhāya putrāya na vidyamaraye vadet| namo brahmaṇya devāya śridharāyāvyayātmane|| ṛgyajussāmarupāya śatarūpāya viṣṇave|| 32.139 || iti śrīpāñcarātre mahopaniṣadi pādmasaṃhitāyāṃ kriyāpāde saṃvartaproktāyāṃ saṃhitāyām gṛhārcāsthāpanavidhirnāma dvātriṃśo'dyāyaḥ |
kriyāpādassamāptaḥ|
<3.1>
āsīnamāśrame kaṇvaṃ kaṇvāśramanivāsinaḥ| niśreyasakaraṃ karma praṣṭumārobhiro munim|| 1.1 || ṛṣayaḥ adhītāḥ kaṇva bhagavan sāṅgo paṅgāssaviturāḥ| vedāstvatta stadarthāni śāstrāṇica yathātatham || 1.2 || eteṣu yadadhīteṣu kaivalyāyanakalpate| kāraṇaṃ tadapi tvattaśśrotavyaṃ nānyathāgatiḥ|| 1.3 || kaṇvaḥ śrūyatāṃ munayassarvai yathāpūrvaṃ mayā śrutaṃ| upasaṅgamya saṃvartamṛṣimarkamivāparam| pradīptametamevārthaṃ pṛṣṭavānabhivādyatam|| 1.4 || śṛraṇvatāṃ sa maharṣīṇāṃ saṃvarta ssarvavitsvayaṃ| mahyaṃ śuśrūṣamāṇāya pratyuvāca yathātatham|| 1.5 || saṃvartaḥ adhītāssakalāvedā ssāṅgopaṅgāssavistarāḥ| itihāsapurāṇāni vākovākya yutānica|| 1.6 || śrutāni teṣu sarveṣu dṛśyante sarvadevatāḥ| svatantrāḥ phalamapyeṣu svargādanyanna dṛśyate|| 1.7 || vividhāni ca śāstrāṇi na tarkāśca pratiṣṭhitāḥ| apavargaphalopāyaṃ na ca paśyāmi kuttacit|| 1.8 || śrutireva ca tasyāpi pramāṇamiti śaśruma| niścayaṃ nādhigacchāmi manasā vimṛśannapi|| 1.9 || tato'haṃ bhṛśanirviṇṇassantaptahṛdayastathā| siddhāśramaṃ samāsādya druhiṇaṃ samapūjayam|| 10 || atyugraṃ tapa ātiṣṭhaṃ tataḥ prītaḥ prajāpatiḥ| ṛṣibhirdaivataissārdhaṃ svayamāgānmadantikam|| 1.11 || brahmāḥ varaṃ vṛṇīṣva bhadraṃ teyatte manasi vartate| varārthināṃ dvijaśreṣṭha darśanaṃ varadaṃ mama|| 1.12 || saṃvartaḥ ityukto'haṃ bhagavatā pratyavocaṃ kutāñjaliḥ| jñānaṃ bhavatu me śuddhaṃ nissaṃśayamanākulam|| 13 || yena sāṃsārikaṃ duḥkhaṃ tarāmi jñānavartmanā| ityukto devadevastu prahasannidamabravīt|| 1.14 || brahmāḥ śṛṇu vipra pravakṣyāmi siddhyupāya manāmayam| śrutireva dvijātīnāṃ niśśreyasakarī parā|| 1.15 || yato vai śrutimantreṇa nityamārādhayan harim| kaivalyaṃ paramaṃ prāpto na bhūyassaṃsarediha|| 1.16 || saṃvartaḥ bhagavan kena śāstreṇa dena ārādhyate paraḥ| kīdṛśastu paro devo vidhiḥ ko vā tadarcane|| 1.17 || brahmāḥ vaiṣṇavaṃ śāsanaṃ śruddhamacchidraṃ pāpanāśanam| hitārdhaṃ sarvadevānāmādidevena coditam|| 1.18 || catuṣpādasamāyuktaṃ caturvargaphanapradam| tena śāstravidhānena samārādhaya keśavam|| 1.19 || tacchāstraṃ śrutavān mattaḥ kapilo munipuṅgavaḥ| macchāsanāttu pātālaṃ tatsamīpamito praja|| 1.20 || saṃvartaḥ ityuktvā bhagavān brahmā tatraivā ntaradhīyata| pātālagamanārthāya puna staptaṃ tapomayā|| 1.21|| tapobalena pātālaṃ praniśannāgapālitam| tatrāpaśyaṃ sukhāsīnaṃ nāgeśaiḥ parivāritam|| 1.22 || avocaṃ kapilaṃ viṣṇuṃ daṇḍavat praṇataḥ kṣitau| jambūdvīpāduvṛttassaṃvartohaṃ prasīdame|| 1.23 || viddhi māṃ bhagavan viṣṇo prāptaṃ druhiṇaśāsanāt| jñānayogakriyācaryā mṛgyate yanmaharṣibhiḥ|| 1.24 || tadaśeṣeṇa viditaṃ bhavavidhvaṃsanaṃ tava| saṃsārāpārapāthodhimagnaṃ māṃ bhṛśaduḥkhitam|| 1.25 || trāyasva bhagavannārtaṃ kṛpayā parayāvibhau| tvadṛte'nyona vettāsya mokṣopāyasya vartmanaḥ|| 1.26 || ityuktaḥ kapilo devaḥ prasādātpadmajanmanaḥ| pārśvasthaṃ padmamālokya prasīdannidamabravīt|| 1.27 || kapilaḥ he padma nāgarājendra janmavidhvaṃsahetukam| mahopaniṣacaṃ sarvaṃ śrutavānasi manmukhāt|| 1.28 || śrāvyatāṃ sakalaṃ cāyaṃ saṃvarto vedapāragaḥ| jñānānāṃ paramaṃ jñānaṃ sākṣā ddevasamāśritam|| 1.29 || sātvikaṃ deva devasya samārādhanakarmajam| mokṣyamāṇaiśca satataṃ mṛgyamāṇaṃ durāsadam|| 1.30 || saṃvartaḥ uktena kapilenaivaṃ padmākhyena mahātmanā| uditaṃ yanmahacchāstraṃ tatsarvaṃ prabravīmite|| 1.31 || sārdhakoṭipramāṇena brahmaṇākeśavāccrutam| kapilāya dadaubrahmalakṣāṇāṃ pañcakaṃpunaḥ|| 1.32 || kapilo'picamadmāya prīdadau lakṣamātrayā| padmo'pi dattavānmahya mayutagrandhasaṅkhyayā|| 1.33 || yasmāt padmo padiṣṭeyaṃ tasmātsā pādmasaṃhitā| mokṣaikaphaladaṃ dharmamādyamasmin prajā{14} pate|| 1.34 || tenai vādyena dharmeṇa brahmāloka pitāmahaḥ| ārādhayan mahādevaṃ hariṃ nārāyaṇaṃ param|| 1.35 || yajñena yajñaṃ yaṣṭavyaṃ yajanta iticaśrutiḥ| ādyaṃ dharmaṃ samāsthāya ye yajante vicakṣaṇāḥ|| 1.36 || te yānti vaiṣṇavaṃsthānaṃ punarāvṛttivarjitam| evaṃ sarveṣukurvatsu mānaveṣu mumukṣuṣu|| 1.37 || sṛṣṭikṣayo mahānāsī nnārakī bhūstṛṇāvṛtā| pañcakālaparāssarve sarvecabhagavanmayāḥ|| 1.38 || nānyaṃ yajantedhyāyanti ṛte nārāyaṇānnarāḥ| evaṃ kārtayugedharme vartamāne mahāmune|| 1.39 || lokakartāsvayaṃ brahmā nārāyaṇamupāgamat| tuṣṭāvaca hṛṣīkeśaṃ puṇḍarīkākṣavidyayā|| 1.40 || bhūmau daṇḍapraṇāmaṃca kṛtvātūṣṇīṃ vyatiṣṭhata| śrībhagavān lokāḥ kinnānuvartante śāsanaṃ tavaśāśvataṃ| brahman tavādhikārovā prāpyate kinnurākṣataiḥ|| 1. 41|| tadīyaṃvāpadaṃprāptuṃ natapasyanti kiṃsurāḥ| ityukto deva devena pratyabhāṣatapadmabhūḥ|| 1.42 || brahmāḥ bhagavan bhūtabhavyeśa mamaśreya si jāgrati| tvayi sarvatrakuśalaṃ vatarte sārvakālikam|| 1.43 || kintu vakṣyāmi deveśa śraddadhānā jitendriyāḥ| mahārahasyamāsthāya yajantesarvamānavāḥ|| 1.44 || te yānti vaiṣṇavaṃsthānaṃ punarāvṛttivarjitam| sasvargonāpi narakona janmamaraṇe ubhe|| 1.45 || saṃvatan ityukto brahmaṇādevaḥ śaṅkhacakragadādharaḥ| pārśvasthaṃ rudramālokya vyājahāra svayaṃhariḥ|| 1.46 || śrībhagavan ṣaṭ prakārāṇi tantrāṇi tvaddaivatyāśaṅkara| parasvaraviruddhāni kuruṣva tvaṃ yathātatham|| 1.47 || avatāraiśca bahubhirmatsyādibhirahaṃ punaḥ| tvatpraṇītāniśāstraṇi sthāpayāmi mahītale|| 1.48 || alpāyā senasulabhaṃ bhūyiṣṭhaṃ phalamadbhutam| ṣaṭ prakārecaśāstre'smin darśaya sthema kāraṇam|| 1.49 || yogaśāstrasya kartṛtveviriñco'dhikariṣyati| sāṅkhyasyacāpinirmāṇe kapilo'dhikariṣyati|| 1.50 || buddhamūrtiṃ samāsthāya buddhaśāstraṃ sṛjāmyaham| jñānāpahnavaniṣṇātāṃ jñātṛjñeyāpalāpica|| 1.51 || ārhatīṃ mūrtimāsthāya śāstraṃ śāsmi tathārhataḥ| pañcarātrābhidhaṃ śāstraṃ mayāpūrvaṃ kṛtaṃkila|| 1.52 || kāpālaṃ śuddhaśaivaṃ ca tathā pāśupataṃtrayam| kuruṣvatrīṇiśāstrāṇi lokānāṃ mohanāyavai|| 1.53 || śāstrāṇi matpraṇītāni bhavadbhirvyākṛtānica| ābhūtasaṃplavaṃ lokesthāsyanti mama śāsanāt|| 1.54 || bhāḍhamityevatesarve praṇipatyābruvan harim| kṛtakṛtyastadābrahmā sārdhaṃ devaissvamālayam|| 1.55 || jagāma siddhagandharva cāraṇādibhirarcitaḥ|| saṃvartaḥ pañcarātreṇatulyāni tadā prabhṛtivaimune| śaivādīnacaśāstrāṇi prathante śāsanāddhareḥ|| 1.56 || vaiṣṇavyāmāyayāloke pracapantiniraṅkuśāḥ| śaivādayopi samayāstatra tatra pratiṣṭhitāḥ || 1.57 || pañcetare pañcarātramadūṣitamapi svayaṃ| dūṣayantyeva sṛṣṭatvāt taddhūṣayitumīśvaraiḥ|| 1.58 || pāṣaṇḍeṣu nirasteṣu hetuvādānukūlatā| jāyate viṣṇumāyābhiḥ patitānāṃ durātmanāṃ|| 1.59 || nāstikānindakājātāḥ vyādhibhiḥ paripīḍitāḥ| jāyante camriyante ca pacyante nirayoṣvapi|| 1.60 || svargeṣu ca vatantyanye māyāmalinacetasaḥ| taranticabhavāmbhodhiṃ māyayāye bahiṣkṛtāḥ|| 1.61 || āloḍyasarvaśāstrāṇi vicārya ca punaḥ punaḥ| nārāyaṇāmṛtadhyānamuśanti brahmavādinaḥ|| 1.62 || brāhmaṇassarvavarṇeṣu yatiścāśramiṣūttamaḥ| yadyadgaṅgā catīrtheṣu daivateṣvapicācyutaḥ|| 1.63 || tadvatsarveṣu śāstreṣu pañcarātraṃ praśasyate| pañcarātro ktavadhinā yassamārādhayeddhariṃ|| 1.64 || kaivaryaṃ paramaṃprāpto na bhūyassaṃsarediha| akṣayyaṃ phalamāpnoti sa pumānnātra saṃśayaḥ|| 1.65 || kalyāṇakāriṇa stasya pitarassvargavāsinaḥ| brahmaloke pi pūjyante kā kathā narakārṇave || 1.66 || mantraiśca vaiṣṇavairdattaṃ havyaṃ vā kavyamena vā | tadakṣayaṃ bhavettena tṛpyanti pitrṛ devatāḥ|| 1.67 || āsphoṭayanti pitaraḥ pranṛtyanti pitāmahāḥ| vaiṣṇavojāyate yeṣāmanvayeṣu mahāmatiḥ|| 1. 68 || pāñcarātroktavadhinā vāsudevaṃ samāśritaḥ| nārāyaṇāmṛtadhyāna nirastāśeṣaviplavaḥ|| 1.69 || etaccāstraṃ ca dātavyaṃ śiṣyāyānabhyasūyave| mokṣamāṇāya nānyastme kastmeca yadṛcchayā|| 1.70 || trayīniṣṭhāya dātavyamadhyetavyaṃ ca vedavat| mahopaniṣadākhyasya śāstrasyāsya mahāmate| pañcarātrasamākhyāsau kathaṃloke pravartate|| 1.71 || saṃvartaḥ pañcetarāṇi śāstrāṇi rātrīyante mahāntyapi| tatsannidhausamākhyāsau tena loke pravartate|| 1.72 || candratārāgaṇaṃ yadvacchobhate naiva vāsare| tathetarāṇi śobha ntepañcanaivāsya sannidhau|| 1.73 || pañcatvamathavā yadvaddhīpyamāne divākare| ṛcchantirātraya stadvaditarāṇi tadantike|| 1.74 || idaṃ pavitraṃ pāpaghnaṃ śāstraṃ bhavavināśanaṃ| saṃsārārṇavamagnānāṃ karmapāśānupeyuṣāṃ|| 1.75 || mahāpotena sadṛśaṃ tārakaṃ bhavasāgarāt| ṛgādibhedavat tantracāturvidhyaṃ ṛgādisaṃjñayā vedaścaturdā bhidyateyathā|| 1.76 || tadvatsiddhāntabhedena pañcarātraṃ caturvidhaṃ| ṛgādayo yathā caikaṃ bhidyate bhahuśākhayā|| 1.77 || tathā siddhā ntamekekaṃ vaktṛbhedena bhidyate| siddhāntaṃ nāmacānvarthaṃ nirāhuriti vaṇḍitāḥ|| 1.78 || mīmāṃsādiṣu śāstreṣu ye siddhārthāmanīṣiṇaḥ| teṣāmante'dhikārosminniti siddhaṃta saṃjñitaṃ|| 1.79 || siddhāntabheda nirūpaṇaṃ ekamūrtipradhānaṃtu mantrasiddhāntamucyate| caturmūrtipradhānaṃtu yattadāgamasaṃjñitaṃ|| 1.80 || siddhāntamucyatesadbhardvatīyaṃ lokaviśrutaṃ| navamūrtipradhānaṃca tantrasiddhantamucyate|| 1.81 || caturvaktre trivaktre vā deve yatrārcanāvidhiḥ| tattantrāntavamiṣṭaṃ syāttantrametaccaturvidhaṃ|| 1.82 || catasraḥ kathitāḥ pūrvaṃ vāsudevādaya stathā| nārāyaṇo hayagrīvo viṣṇu rnṛharisūkarau|| 1.83 || tantrasaṅka ryedoṣaḥ sāṅkaryaṃ natu kurvīta siddhānteṣu parasparaṃ| yadi saṅkarato mohāt rājārāṣṭaṃca naśyati|| 1.84 || yena siddhāntamārgeṇa karṣaṇādikriyā kṛtā| tenaiva sakalaṃ karma kuryāttantravibhāgavit|| 1.85 || tattantrāntaramiṣṭaṃ syāt sarve sarvaphalapradāḥ| teṣvayaṃ mantrasiddhāntaḥ pādmasaṃjño bhidhīyate|| 1.86 || ekaikavaktṛ bhedena siddhāntā bhahudhāsmṛtāḥ| paṅgraho vistaraścaiva tantrāṇāṃ prakaṭīkṛtaḥ|| 1.87 || siddhānte mantrasaṃsiddhai śśiṣyāṇāṃ hitakāmyayā| tantrāṇāṃcaivasarveṣāṃ vaktā nārāyaṇassvayam|| 1.88 || anugrahārthaṃ bhaktānāṃ śrāvayāmāsa casvayam| śrotāromūrtibhedāśca munayaśca pitāmahaḥ|| 1.89 || prayojanaṃ ca śāstrasya mokṣaḥ prakṛtidurlabhaḥ| abhidheyaṃ bhagavatassamārādhanamuttamam|| 1.90 || sambandho pīṣyate sadbhi ssādhya sādhana lakṣaṇaḥ| śrutimūlamidaṃtantraṃ pramāṇaṃ kalpasūtravat|| 1.91 || sarge sarge pyavicchinnaṃ devadevasyaśāsanāt| cintāmaṇiryathā loke śabalā kalpakadrumaḥ|| 1.92 || arthibhyo vāñchitaṃ sarvaṃ prayacchati gatiṃ vinā| pañcarātrākhya śāstraṃtu caturvargaphalapradam|| 1.93 || śāstrāntaravyasanināmabhyāsaḥ kālayāpanam| phalaṃ vā kiṅci devassāt yattatsādhubahiṣkṛtam|| 1.94 || vāsudevaṃ parityajya ye'nyaṃ devamupāsate| narakāya bhavanyete nātrakāryā vicāraṇā|| 1.95 || satyaṃ satyaṃ punassatyamuddhṛtya bhujamucyate| vedaśāstrātparaṃnā sti nadaivaṃ keśavātparaṃ| tasmādbhajasva deveśaṃ vidhinānenavai mūne|| 1.96 || kaṇvaḥ kati bhedāni tantrāṇām nāmadheyāni kāni vā| śrotumicchāmi viprendra paraṃ kautūhalaṃhime|| 1.97 || saṃvartaḥ śatamekamathāṣṭau ca purāṇe kaṇva śuśruma| nāmadheyānicai teṣām śrūyatām kathyate mayā|| 1.98 || pādmam padmodbhavam māyāvaibhavam nalakūbaram| trailokyamonam viṣṇutilakam paramāhvayam|| 1.99 || nāradīyam dhanadīyam vāsiṣṭham pauṣka rāhvayam| sanatkumāraṃ sasakaṃ satyākhyaṃ viśvasaṃhitā|| 1.100 || anantākhyaṃ mahīpraśnaṃ śrīpraśnaṃ puruṣottamam| māhendhra saṃhitāpañca praśnākhyaṃ tatvasāgaram|| 1.101 || vāgīśam sātvataṃcaiva draviṇaṃ śrīkarāhvayam| sāṃvartaṃ viṣṇusadbhāvaṃ siddhāntaṃ viṣṇupūrvakam|| 1.102 || viṣṇutantraṃ ca kaumāraṃ tathāhirbudhnyasaṃhitā| viṣṇuvaibhavikaṃ sauraṃ saumya mīśyarasaṃhitā|| 1.103 || anantākhyaṃ bhāgavataṃ jayākhyaṃ mūlasaṃhitā| puṣṭitantraṃ śaunakīyaṃ mārīcaṃ dakṣasaṃhitā|| 1.104 || aupendraṃ yogahṛdayaṃ hārītaṃ pārameśvaram| ātreyaṃ māndaraṃ viṣvaktevamauśanasāhvayam|| 1.105 || vaikhānasaṃ vihajgendraṃ bhārgavaṃ parapūruṣam| yājñavalkyaṃ gautamīyaṃ paulastyaṃ śākalāhvayam|| 1.106 || jñānārṇavaṃ jāmadagnyaṃ yāmyaṃ nārāyaṇākhyakam| pārāśaryaṃ ca jābālaṃ kāpilaṃ vāmanāhvayam|| 1.107 || jayottaraṃ bhārhaspatyaṃ jaiminaṃ sātvatāhvayam| kātyāyanīyaṃ vālmīka maupagāyanasaṃhitāḥ|| 1.108 || hairaṇyagarbhamāgastyaṃ kāṇvaṃ bodhāyanāhvayam| bhāradvājaṃ nārasiṃhaṃ gārgyamuttarapūrvakam|| 1.109 || śātātapaṃ cāṅgirasaṃ kāśyapaṃ paiṅgalāhvayam| trailokyaṃ vihayaṃyogaṃ vāyavīyaṃ ca vāruṇam|| 1.100 || kṛṣṇaṃ cāmbharamāgneyaṃ markaṇḍeyasya saṃgrahaḥ| mahāsavatkumārākhyaṃ vyāsākhyaṃ viṣṇusaṃhitā|| 1.111 || mārkaṃḍeyaṃ pāriṣadaṃ brahmanāradasaṃhitā| saṃvādaṃśukarudrābhyāmumāmāheśvarāhvayam|| 1.112 || dattātreyaṃ ca śarvākhyaṃ vārāhamihirāhvayam| saṅkarṣaṇākhyaṃ pradyumnaṃ vāmanaṃ kalki rāghavam|| 1.113 || prācetasākhyamityete śatamaṣṭottaraṃ smṛtam| etāni tantra nāmāni mayoktāni mahāmate|| 1.114 || tantrāstvaneke bhodhyante muktyupāyāḥ pṛthakpṛthak| iti tantraṃ samākhyātaṃ śāstrameva manīṣibhiḥ|| 1.115 || tantrāṇāṃ nāmadheyāni yo nityaṃ paṭhate naraḥ| sarvapāpa vinirmuktau yāti brahma sanātanam|| 1.116 || iti śrī pāñcarātre mahopaniṣadi pādmasaṃhitāyām jñānapāde śāstrāvatārakam nāma prathamo'dhyāmaḥ |
<3.2>
saṃvartaḥ he padma nāgarājendra śrutavānasi yatpurā| tantraṃ tadahamadhyāpyo mayi cedastyanugrahaḥ || 2.1 || śrīpadma uvācaḥ tatpa vakṣyāmi viprarṣatantraṃ vai lokaviśrutam| jñāna yoga kriyā caryā catuṣpāda samanvitam || 2.2 || rahasyamadbhutaṃ dinyaṃ yanmayā kapilācchrutam| saṃkṣiptaṃ ca mahārthaṃ ca sarvasiddhi prasādhanam || 2.3 || sārdhakoṭi pramāṇena brahmaṇā keśapācchrutam| tasmātsamuddhrataṃ tantraṃ vāridheramṛtaṃ yathā || 2.4 || vijñānamādau sakalaṃ sṛṣṭyupodghātamucyate| tato yogaḥ kriyā paścāccaryā ca tadanantaram || 2.5 || vijñāna śabhdārthaḥ vijñānaṃ bhagavajñānaṃ tajñānānmuktirucyate| bhagavataḥ ādyaṃrūpam ādimadhyānta rahitamavṛddhi kṣayamacyutam || 2.6 || nityaṃ nirupamaṃ jyoti rnityatṛptaṃ nirañjanam| sarvākāraṃ nirākāraṃ tamasaḥ paramavyayam || 2.7 || tatkāraṇavaśā ttasmādāvirāsītsanātanāt| dvihastamekavaktraṃ ca śuddhasphaṭikasannibham || 2.8 || sahasrasavivahnīndu lajñakoṭi samaprabham| marīci cakramadhyasthaṃ cakrādyayudhalāñcitam || 2.9 || śrīvatsakaustubhoraskaṃ vanamālāvirājitam| kirīṭahārakeyūra valayādi vibhūṣitam || 2.10 || pītāmbaradharaṃsaumyaṃ rūpamādyaṃ sanātanam| sa vāsudevo vijñeyassṛjyaṃ sarvaṃ ca tanmukhāt || 2.11 || dhyeyaśca yogibhirnatyaṃ hṛtvadmāhvayaviṣṭare| paśyanti sūrayaśśaśva ttadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam || 2.12 || vāsudevāttato jāto vāsudevāhyayo'paraḥ| ekavaktraścaturbāhuścakrā dyāyudhalakṣaṇaḥ || 2.13 || sthityai cakraṃ sarasijaṃ dadhānaṃ sṛṣṭaye punaḥ| muktaye pāñcajanyaṃ ca gadāṃ saṃhṛtaye tathā || 2.14 || śrīvatsa kaustubhorasko vanamālā vibhūṣitaḥ| mayūrakaṇṭhavacchyāmaḥ pītanaisargikāmbaraḥ || 2.15 || sa vāsudevo bhagavān sṛṣṭisthityantamuktidaḥ| ātmānaṃ sa dvidhācakre punaḥ kenāpi hetunā || 2.16 || tayoreko vāsudevaśśuddhasspaṭikasannibhaḥ| nārāyaṇo dvitīyastu nīlāmbudasamaprabhaḥ || 2.17 || saṅkarṣaṇo vāsudevāt tasmātpradyusnasaṃjñitaḥ| pradyumnādaniruddhau'bhūt sarva ete caturbhujāḥ || 2.18 || jñānādi guṇasāmānye vāsudevaḥ prakīrtitaḥ| ṣaṇṇāṃguṇānāṃ vaiṣamyevakṣyaṃte mūrtayaḥ kramāt || 2.19 || jñāne'dhiko bhavedbhrahman saṅkarṣaṇa samāhvayaḥ| bale'dhikastupradyamna ssyādaiśvarye'niruddhakaḥ || 2.20 || mūrtibhyaśca caturbhyaśca caturviṃśatimūrtayaḥ| jāyantekramaśo brahman dīpāddhīpāntaraṃ yathā || 2.21 || sarve caturbhujāḥ padma śaṅkhacakra gadādharāḥ| vāsudevādādidevātprathamā tkeśavastathāḥ || 2.22 || nārāyaṇo mādhavaśca jajñire bhūsurottama| saṅkarṣaṇācca goviṃdo viṣṇuśca madhusūdanaḥ || 2.23 || tramaste samajāyaṃta pradyumnācca trivikramaḥ| vāmanaśśrī dharaścai te jajñiremunisattama || 2.25|| aniruddhāddhṛṣīkeśaḥ padmanābhaśca suvrata| dāmodaraśca tenetthaṃ dvādaśāṃśāḥ prajajñire || 2.26 || vāsudevācca tannāmnā tathā saṅkarṣaṇādapi| praddhyamnādapi tannāmnā tannāmnaivāniruddhakāt || 2.27 || abhūvan kramaśastebhya ścaturbhyaḥ puruṣottamāḥ| adhokṣajo nṛsiṃhaśca caturthaścācyuto mataḥ || 2.28 || caturbhya eva tebhyomī jajñire ca yathākramam| janārdanattathopeṃdro hariḥ kṛṣṇassamākhyayā || 2.29 || vāsudevādādidevānmūrtyaṣṭakama jāyata| brāhmīca mūrtiḥ prathamā prājāpatyāca vaiṣṇavī || 2.30 || divyā cārṣī māsuṣī ca saptamī cāsurī matā| paiśācī caramā tāsāṃ mūrtīnāmaparādaśa || 2.31 || mīnādyā jajñire vipra caturpyūhādyathākramam| matsyaḥ kūrmo parāhaśca vāsudevādajāyata || 2.32 || nṛsiṃho vāsuno rāmo jāmadagnyo'pyajāyata| saṅkarṣaṇāttathā jajñe pradyumnā drāghavo balī || 2.33 || aniruddhādabhūtkṛṣṇaḥ kalkīti daśa mūrtayaḥ| saṅkarṣaṇācca puruṣassatyaḥ pradyumna sambhavaḥ || 2.34 || jāto'cyuto' niruddhācca buddhastelokya mohanaḥ| daśārhaśśaurirannośo vāsudevādajāyata || 2.35 || saṅkarṣaṇāddhayagrīvaśśajkho daranṛ kosarī| vaikuṇṭhamūrtirādyātu mukundaśca vṛṣākapiḥ || 2.36 || tatraivādi parāhaśca tatassaṅṇarṣaṇādapi| anaṃtaḥ pannago jātassahapraphaṇavān balī || 2.37 || sudarśanādyāyudhāni kirīṭādi vibhūṣaṇam| murtyā virbhāvasamaye sahai vaitāni jajñire || 2.38 || devyaśśriyādayastadvat mūrtabhedaṃ samāśritāḥ| śrivatsādeva sakalā jjajñire divyalāñcanāt || 2.39 || garuḍaḥ pakṣiṇāmindro vāhanaṃ bhalināṃ varaḥ| vāsudevādi mūrti bhyaśchando mūrtirajāyata || 2.40 || kumudādyaśca bhūteśāssarve pāriṣadaissaha| pādataścā niruddhasya samabhūvan sahasraśaḥ || 2.41 || sahasraśīrṣa caraṇahasta netrādbhutākṛteḥ| aniruddhājjagajjajñe svāṅṇādeva yathākramam || 2.42 || mukhādindraśca vahniśca chandhāṃsyaṅṇāni ṣaṭtathā| dyaurmūdhno nayanātsūryo manasaścandramā api || 2.43 || śrotrāddhiśo nabhonābheḥ padbhyāṃ bhūmi rajāyata| prāṇādyāyustathā pānānmṛtyuḥ keśāttathambudaḥ || 2.44 || truṭyādi kālabhedaśca kālaścābhūttathā dhiyaḥ| vanaspataya oṣadyo romakūpādvinissṛtāḥ || 2.45 || yajñāśca jajñire tasmādbahavo bahṛdakṣiṇāḥ| cāturvarṇyaṃ kramādvaktra bhāhūru caraṇodbhavam || 2.46 || evaṃ sṛṣṭvā hagatsarvaṃ viśvarūpadharo hariḥ| āsai'nantāsanedevaśśrī bhūmibhyāṃ sahaprabhuḥ || 2.47 || madhye kṣīrārṇave śvetadvīpākhye hemanirmite| prāsāde sevyamānaśca yogibhirvividhairapi || 2.48 || caṇḍādyai rdvārapālaiśca kumudādyanujīvibhiḥ| pakṣīndra viṣvaksenābhyāṃ sevyamāno mudānvataḥ || 2.49 || śrīvatsavakṣā nitya śrīrajeyaśśāśvato dhruvaḥ| aniruddho jagatsvāṃ śairindrādyaiḥ paripālayan || 2.50 || iti śrī pāñcarātre mahopaniṣadi pādmasaṃhiyām jñānapāde mūrtyutpattibhedo nāma dvitīyo’dhyāyaḥ|
<3.3>
padmaḥ brahmaṇa ssṛṣṭiradhunā vakṣyate dvijasattama| nārāyaṇo'sṛhajattoyaṃ tatraivāsīnmahārṇavaḥ|| 3.1 || aniruddhāṃśajā durgā māyārūpā sumohinī| nyagrodhamasṛjattasmin māyārūpe mahādrume|| 3.2 || aniruddhāṃśajaśśrīmān padmanābhaḥ purātanaḥ| saṃhṛtya lokān puruṣaḥ parṇaparyaṅkameyivān|| 3.3 || vaṭapatraśāyino nābhīpadme caturmukhasṛṣṭiḥ| tatra puṃsaśśayānasya nāgaparyaṅkabhūṣite| hiraṇmayaṃ padmagarbham nābheraṇḍamajāyata|| 3.4 || tadaṇḍaṃ pañcabhūtātmabhūtaṃ śuddhamatarkitam| aṇḍasya pardhamānasya madhye padmaṃ sitaprabham|| 3.5 || sahasradalaparyantamantaḥ kesaramaṇḍitam| madhye karṇikayā yuktamadbhutam sṛṣṭikāraṇam|| 3.6 || sraṣṭāramasṛjattasmin padmanābhaścaturmukham| āsanaṃ brahmaṇo yasmātpadma mādāvabhūttataḥ|| 3.7 || anyeṣāmapi devānā māsanaṃ padmamiṣyate| sanandanādīnasṛjatsaṣṭyarthaṃ padmabhūssvayam|| 3.8 || sraṣṭuṃ mano na dadhire te ca svāyambhavāstadā| sarve te yogino jātā vītarāgā vimatsarāḥ|| 3.9 || teṣvevaṃ nirapekṣeṣu lokasṛṣṭau mahātmasu| brahmaṇo bhūnmahān krodhastrailokyadahanakṣamaḥ|| 3.10 || bhrukuṭīkuṭilā ttasya lalāṭātkrodhadīpitāt| samutpannastadā rudro yugāntāgni samaprabhaḥ|| 3.11 || ardhanārīnaravapu rmahākāyaḥ pratāpavān| saṃvibhajyātmano devaṃ naraṃ nārīṃ ca nirmame|| 3.12 || mithunājjajñire tasmādrudrāṇāṃ koṭayastathā| sarve caturbhujāḥ krūrāḥ triṇetrāśśūlapāṇayaḥ|| 3.13 || teṣu pradhānā viprendra rudrā ekādaśa smṛtāḥ| rudrasṛṣṭhimapi brahmā vyarthamālokya lokakṛt|| 3.14 || marīcyādīn ṣaḍaparān manasā virmame punaḥ| tairetadakhilaṃ sṛṣṭhaṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaram|| 3.15 || evaṃ sṛṣṭvā jagadidaṃ padmayoniścaturmukhaḥ| dhyānaṃ paramamātasthau kāraṇaṃ svasya cintayan|| 3.16 || dhyāyatastasya purataḥ tejaḥ puñjamivābhavate| divākarasahasrābhaṃ vidyutsaṅghātasannibham|| 3.17 || tanmadhye puruṣaśreṣṭhaṃ pītanirmalavāsasam| śaṅkhacakragadhāpadmaṃ dhārayantaṃ caturbhujam|| 3.18 || śrīvatsāṅṇaṃ prasasnāsyaṃ kaustubhena virājitam| sphutkirīṭahārādyai rbhūṣaṇai rupaśobhitam|| 3.19 || taṃ dṛṣṭvā puruṣaśreṣṭhaṃ padmayoniracintayat| eṣa eva paro devassarvasya jagataḥ prabhuḥ|| 3.20 || nāsmātparataraḥ kaścīddhṛśyate puruṣaḥ sthitaḥ| tameva saṃśaryān praṣṭuṃ vividhānupacakrame|| 3.21 || brahmāḥ kastvamatyadbhutākāraḥ puruṣaḥ puruṣottama| mahyaṃ jijñātamānāya ātsānaṃ darśayasvame|| 3.22 || śrībhagavān sraṣṭāraṃ sarvalokānāṃ purāṇaṃ puruṣaṃ param|| anādimadhyanidhanaṃ viddhi māmacalaṃ dhruvam|| 3.23 || kāraṇaṃ sarvalokasya mā ca bhūtsaṃśayastava| saṃśayasya tvadīyasya cchettāraṃ māmupasthitam|| 3.24 || brahmāḥ dhanyosmyanugṛhīto'smi pūrṇākāmo'smi śāśvata| ajñātaṃ nāsti te jñeyaṃ kartavyaṃ nāsti cākṛtam|| 3.25 || nānavāptamavāptavyaṃ triṣu lokeṣu vidyate| kasya hetorjagatsraṣṭuṃ bhavān prerayase vada|| 3.26 || śrībhagavan krīḍāmi kevalaṃ brahman sṛṣṭisaṃhārapālanaiḥ| lokānāmapi sarveṣāmahaṃ kenāpi hetunā|| 3.27 || iti śrī pāñcarātre mahopaniṣadi pādmasaṃhitāyāṃ jñānapāde brahmādisṛṣṭiprakāro nāma tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ |
<3.4>
brahmāḥ vidhatse kena rūpeṇa kena rūpeṇa pāsi vā| saṃhartuṃ yatase kena śuśrūṣā me vijṛmbhate|| 4.1 || śrī bhagavān anantāśśaktayassṛṣṭāḥ manasaiva caturmukha| catasrastāsu nardiṣṭāḥ mukhyā viṣṇvādimūrtayaḥ|| 4.2 || rajassatvasamomayya stisrassaṃsāragocarāḥ| ānandākhyā caturthī tu bhukti muktipradāyinī|| 4.3 || rajo guṇena bhuvanaṃ sṛjāmi sacarācaram| pālayāmi ca satvena tamasā saṃharāmi ca|| 4.4 || ānandhātmānamāsthāya vāsudevāhvaya ssvayam| vipāśayāmi saṃsārāt ye māmeva bhajanti tān|| 4.5 || sṛjāmi pāmi hanmyeta drūpairbahmādibhistribhiḥ| vāsudevatmarūpeṇa pareṇa bhavasāgarāt|| 4.6 || vipāśayāmi niṣkāmānye māmārādhayanti tān| mukhyaścaturṇāme teṣāmucyate paramaḥ pumān|| 4.7 || apavargakaratvena vāsudevassa īritaḥ| brahmādayastato'nyetu saṃsārāhitadṛṣṭayaḥ|| 4.8 || brahmāḥ saṃsārī puruṣaḥ ko'sya mātre ke vā parāvare| muktaḥ ko yasya mātre dyena vidyete varāvare|| 4.9 || śrībhagavān puṇyapāpanimitte yassukhaduḥkhe niṣevate| sāṃsārī sā parā mātrā bhrahmabhūya mitīnyate|| 4.10 || mātrā parā bhave ttasya sthāvaratvamasatsamam| saṃsāravāsanātītaṃ vimuktaṃ karmabandhanaiḥ|| 4.11 || ātmatṛptamudāsīnaṃ muktamāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ| sadaika rūparūpasya mātrā kāpi na vidyate|| 4.12 || brahmāḥ ke saṃsāraṃ prapadyante ke ca gacchanti nirvṛtim| kautūhalaṃ hi bhagavan brūhi tattvaṃ yathātatham|| 4.13 || śrībhagavān phala kāmanayā karma vihitaṃ vaidikaṃ bhajan| badhyate nispṛhaḥ karma bhajamāno na badhyate|| 4.14 || jñānaṃ vaiṣayikaṃ yasya cakṣurādinibandhanam| bhaddhyate sa pare deve yasya jñānaṃ sa mucyate|| 4.15 || brahmāḥ muktātmanaśca bhavato bhedaḥ kaḥ puruṣottama| etadācakṣva bhagavannā tiguhyaṃ yadi prabho|| 4.16 || śrībhagavān ahamena bhavanyaite na bheda statra kaścana| yathāhaṃ vivārāmyevaṃ tathā muktāśca dehinaḥ|| 4.17 || brahmāḥ badhnanti puruṣaṃ ke te hetavaḥ karmahetavaḥ| karmapāśairnagalitānpuruṣān bhrāmayantiye|| 4.18 || śrībhagavān tribhireva guṇairvyastaissamastaiḥ pūrvamīritaiḥ| satvādibhiḥ kriyā cāpi trividhā sampravartate|| 4.19 || tayā saṃsāra mṛcchanti puruṣāḥ pūrvavṛttayaḥ| evameva suraśreṣṭha yanmāṃ tvaṃ paripṛcchasi|| 4.20 || brahmāḥ kathamebhirguṇai ryogaḥ puruṣasyopajāyate| karmapāśairvamucyeta mokṣyamāṇaśca pūruṣaḥ|| 4.21 || puruṣasya guṇā ye te devādarmānuvartinaḥ| viṣayasya vaśādete bhavantina bhavantica|| 4.22 || viṣaya svarūpapraśnaḥ | brahmāḥ kosau viṣaya ityuktaḥ puruṣāṇāṃ maheśvara| yasya yogādbhava nyaite na bhavanti ca te guṇāḥ|| 2.23 || śrībhagavān triguṇā prakṛtirbrahman viṣayo dehinaḥ smṛtaḥ| tadyogādbhadhyate jantustadayogādvimucyate|| 4.24 || jānāti puruṣo nityaṃ prakṛtiṃ trigṛṇātmikām| sā ca prasūte satataṃ nidrālasyaṃ pṛthagvidham|| 4.25 || svarūpaṃ vismaratyeṣa nidrayā vivaśassvayam| sa bhandha iṣyate puṃsāṃ kiṃ bhūyaśśotumicchasi|| 4.26 || iti śrī pāñcarātre mahopaniṣadi pādmasaṃhitāyāṃ jñānapāde mumukṣusaṃsāramocanaṃ nāma caturtho'dhyāyaḥ |
<3.5>
brahmāḥ prakṛtyā tasya saṃyogo jāyate kena hetunā| etadācakṣva bhagavan rahasyaṃ durlabhaṃ mama|| 5.1 || śrībhagavān prakṛtyā puruṣasya saṃyoge hetuḥ| manmāyā kāraṇaṃ brahmanna nādiravināśinī| yunakti puruṣaṃ saiṣā prakṛtyā guṇarūpayā|| 5.2 || matprasādaṃ vinā tasya na virāmo sti kasya cit| yāvannāhaṃ prasīdāmi tāvanmāyā duratyayā|| 5.3 || brahmāḥ pūrṇa kāmasya devasya prasāde kiṃ nibandhanam| na jāne kāraṇaṃ tasya tanme brūhi nibandhanam|| 5.4 || śrībhagavāḥ varṇānāmāśramāṇāṃ ca maryādāyāmayākṛtā | tāṃ ye samanuvarta nte prasāda steṣu me mahān|| 5.5 || tasmātsaṃsāriṇāṃ puṃsāṃ matprasādaṃ vinā kvacit| niśśreyasakaraṃ nāsyadbhadhyasva kamalāsana|| 5.6 || brahmāḥ bhagavan devadeveśa jānāmi puruṣottama| tvāmeva jagatāṃ manye sraṣṭāpaṃ kamalekṣaṇa|| 5.7 || prabhavanti yato lokāḥ pralayaṃ yānti yatra ca| bhagavan tadaśeṣeṇa jñātumicchāmi śaṃsa me|| 5.8 || sṛṣṭyādinirūpaṇam| śrībhagavān prakṛtiḥ puruṣaścobhe mama rūpe duratyaye| anupraviśya dvitayāṃ kṣobhayāmyahamicchayā|| 5.9 || prakṛti stri guṇā brahmannanādiravināśinī| puruṣādhiṣṭhitā sūte sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca|| 5.10 || guṇasāmyātmana stasmātpuruṣādhiṣṭhi tātpunaḥ| ajāyata mahattatvaṃ trividhaṃ trividhairgaṇaiḥ|| 5.11 || ahaṅkārastato jāta stasya tisro vidhāḥ smṛtāḥ| vai kārikastaijasaśca bhūtādiśceti tattridhā|| 5.12 || vaikārikādahaṅkārātsātvikāḥ pañcahajñi re| jñānendriyāṇi paṃcaiva rājasāttaijasātpunaḥ|| 5.13 || karmendriyāṇi jātāni bhūtādestāmasādatha| śabdatanmātramabhavattaccā kāśamajījanat|| 5.14 || sparśatanmātramākāśā ttasmādvāyurajāyata| rūpamātraṃ tato vāyo stasmādagnirajāyata|| 5.15 || rasamātramajanyagne stasmādāpaḥ prajajñire| gandhatasmātramadbhyopi gandhamātrāttathā mahī|| 5.16 || śabdaikaguṇamākāśaṃ śabdasparśaguṇo'nilaḥ| śabdasparśau tathā rūpaṃ tadvadagnerudāhṛtam|| 5.17 || śabdassparśau raso rūpaṃ cāturguṇyapāṃ smṛtam| śabdasparśau rūparasau gandhaḥ pañcaguṇā mahī|| 5.18 || nānāvīryāḥ pṛthagbhūtāste sṛṣṭāssaṃhatiṃ vinā| nāśaknuvanprajāssraṣṭuṃ tatasai saṃhatāssvayam|| 5.19 || mahadādi viśeṣāntāḥ pradhānapuruṣeritāḥ| aṇḍaṃ mamāṃśabhūtasya padma nābhasya madmaja|| 5.20 || nābherajāyata tato jagadyonirabhūdbhavān| sargādau prakṛterevamudbhūtamakhilaṃ jagat|| 5.21 || līyate prakṛtāveva kalpānte kamalāsana|| brahmāḥ manye tvayā jagatsṛṣṭaṃ vidhṛtaṃ ca tvayā vibho| kālarūpa stvamevaikaḥ kalvānte sañcahartha ca|| 5.22 || idānīṃ vada mejñānaṃ brahmasiddhidamacyuta| yajjñātvā na punarjanma maraṇaṃ bhavabaddhanam| brahmajñānadvai vidhyam| śrībhagavān jñānaṃ dvividhamākhyātaṃ satvākhyaṃ cakriyātmakam| satvākhyasya kriyākhyena siddhiravyabhicāriṇī|| 5.23 || brahmāḥ jñānaṃ kriyātmakaṃ tāvat vada krīyagvidhaṃ prabho| yonābhyastena satvākhyaṃ yāsyāmi brahma siddhidam|| 5.24 || satvakriyātmakajñāna lakṣaṇam| śrī bhagavān yamaśca niyama ścaivakriyākhyaṃ dvividhaṃ smṛtam| tābhyāṃ jñānaṃca satvākhyaṃ prāpnotyeva na saṃśayaḥ|| 5.25 || brahmaṇyabhinnaṃ satvākhyaṃ jñānāj jñeyamavāpyate| jñānānmuktaḥ parānande paramātmani padmaja|| 5.26 || brahmāḥ brahmaprāptau tvayā samyagupāyaḥ kathitaḥ purā| idānīṃ deva deveśa brūhi me brahmalakṣaṇam|| 5.27 || brahmalakṣaṇam| śrībhagavān ānandalakṣaṇaṃ brahma nādarūpamavikriyam| kleśādibhirasaṃspṛṣṭaṃ niṣkriyaṃ nirvikalpakam|| 5.28 || advandvamanavacchinnaṃ svasaṃvedyaṃ nirañcanam| susūkṣmaṃ svavaśaṃ svairaṃ svayaṃ jyoti ranādimat|| 5.29 || anantamakṣayaṃ śāntamadṛṣṭā ntamavṛddhimat| dhruvamekaṃ sadā nandaṃ cidrūpaṃ sarvagaṃ param|| 5.30 || gatāgatavinirmuktaṃ vāsudevāhvayaṃ vibhu| prabhavaṃ sarvabhūtānāmīśvaraṃ puruṣottamam|| 5.31 || svabhāvanirmalaṃ nityaṃ nistaraṅgaṃ nirākulam| nirmaryādaṃ guṇātītaṃ saguṇaṃ sarvakāmadam|| 5.32 || hīnavarṇairasaṃsevyaṃ mokṣamāṇairatarkitam| adhyeyaṃ dhyeyamāścaryamavājmanasagocaram|| 5.33 || ṣāḍguṇyavigrahaṃ sarvaśakti svāśrayamāśrītam| bhūteśaṃ bhūtakṛdbhūtaṃ tamasaḥ parataḥ sthitam|| 5.34 || pradhānaṃ prakṛteranyadbhogyaṃ bhoktṛ niraṅkuśam| pramāṇapratyayātītaṃ sarvatokṣiśiromukham|| 5.35 || sarvataḥ pāṇicaraṇaṃ sarvamāvṛtya viṣṭhitam| bahirantasthsitaṃ vyāpi sarva tantrātiśāsanam|| 5.36 || ajamoṅkāramavyaktaṃ mūlamantrātmakaṃ śivam| māyārūpaṃcamāyābhinnityatṛptamaṇoraṇu|| 5.37 || mahato'pi mahā sthūla matulaṃ mṛdu dīptimat| amūrtaṃ mūrtamojasvi cidghanaṃ nirupadravam|| 5.38 || paśyannitthaṃ paraṃ brahma pareṇa jñānacakṣuṣā| yogayuktassadā martyaḥ prāpnoti ca paraṃ padam|| 5.39 || iti śrī pañcarātre mahopaniṣadi pādmasaṃhitāyāṃ jñānapāde brahmālakṣaṇaṃ nāma pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ |
<3.6>
brahmāḥ sarvataḥ pāṇipādādi brahmaṇo rūpamiritam| arūpasyāpi tatsarvaṃ kathayasva yathātatham|| 6.1 || bhagavatassarvataḥ pāṇu pādāditya nirvacanam| śrībhagavān carācaramidaṃ kṛtsnamākṣiptaṃ paramātmanā| yatastatsarvapāṇitvaṃ tasya lakṣaṇamucyate|| 6.2 || deśakālā viśeṣeṇa saṃyuktaṃ parameṣṭhinā| yaugapadyena satataṃ sarvataḥ pātprabhustṛtaḥ|| 6.3 || tiryagūrdvamadhaścoccairgatvā bhāsayate jagat| raviryathā tathā kṛtvā viśvataścakṣurucyate|| 6.4 || sarvaṃ purasthsitaṃ tasya vastujātaṃ yata stataḥ| viśvato mukhatā tasya brahmaṇaḥ kamalāsana|| 6.5 || jñānendhiyāṇi sarvāṇi śrūyante śira uttamam| tathā jñānāśrayatvena jñeyassarvaśirāḥ prabhuḥ|| 6.6 || vidūramavidūrasthaṃ tathā vyavahitetare| śṛṇoti śabdasaṅghātaṃ tenāsau sarvataśśravāḥ|| 6.7 || bhinno vahnirayaḥ piṇḍādabhinna ina dṛśyate| tadvadvyaktādbhahirbhūto vyaktamāvṛtya tiṣṭhati|| 6.8 || ādarśe nirmale yadvadantasthā pratiyātanā| dṛśyate tatra tadvatsyādvibhoravyaktarūpatā|| 6.9 || nendriyādhīnavijñāno rūpādiṣu caturmukha| bhagavānamuto hetossarvajñaḥ kathato budhai|| 6.10 || parameṇa mahatvena saṃyogātparamātmanaḥ| vyāpitvamucyate viṣṇorīśvarasya manīṣibhiḥ|| 6.11 || anāditva majatvena tathai vānantatā vibhoḥ| parokṣatvena sarveṣāmapadityucyate nṛbhiḥ|| 6.12 || asaṃvidvaṣayo brahman gandhaḥ puṣpādike yathā| tribhirguṇairabaddhopi baddhavatteṣu tiṣṭhati|| 6.13 || yathā puṣkāraparṇeṣu svacchamambhaḥ pratiṣṭhitam| antarbahirabhivyāpya tiṣṭhityeko mahārṇave|| 6.14 || nimagnasyeva kumbhasya bahirantarapāṃ sthitiḥ| parakṣetrakṣayoraikyamātmano śśruticoditam|| 6.15 || kṣetrakṣasyāsyabāhulyaṃ dehabhedātpratīyate| ekasyaivahi bimbhasya darpaṇeṣu yathā tathā|| 6.16 || bhūtādi pañcapaṅghātaṃ kṣetraṃ tatra vyavasthitaḥ| jīvoyastaṃ viduḥ prājñāḥ kṣetrajñaṃ parasaṃjñitam|| 6.17 || abuddhibodhyamaspaṣṭaṃ vyaktasyopari viṣṭhitam| parātparataraṃ viṣuṃ sūrayo jñānacakṣuṣā|| 6.18 || vidantina tamajñānāt jñānagocaramakṣaram| parasya vyāpino dehacalanādyā na vibhramaḥ|| 6.19 || yathā ghaṭasthamākāśaṃ nīyamāne ghaṭe matiḥ| yātīti vastuto naiva bhedausti parajīvayoḥ|| 6.20 || padmapatrasahasreṣu sūcībhinneṣvanu kramāt| sūkṣmatvātkālabhedastu yathā naivopalabhyate|| 6.21 || tathaiva paramātmāyāṃ nāmnāṇuḥ parikīrtitaḥ| dūrasthamajñāḥ paśyanti hṛtvadme viṣṭhitaṃ sadā|| 6.22 || vitatya vāyurākāśaṃ yathaika stiṣṭhati prabhuḥ| tathā carācaraṃ viśvaṃ vyāpya tiṣṭhatyajassvayam|| 6.23 || sraṣṭuṃ saṃhartumīśāno raśmīnabhyudito raviḥ| yathā tathā jagatsarvaṃ sraṣṭu hartuṃ prabhurhariḥ|| 6.24 || svaṃ paraṃ cāpi viṣayaṃ prakāśayati cidghanaḥ| yathā pradīpassvasyāpi ghaṭādeśca prakāśakṛt|| 6.25 || varṇaissitādibhirhīnasta dvadbhāsayate hariḥ| ṣaḍbhirguṇai ranvita tvāt jñānādibhiranavyagaiḥ|| 6.26 || bhagavān kathitassadbhiḥ paramātmā jaganmayaḥ| dadhni sarpi stile tailaṃ mādhuryaṃ ca guḍādiṣu|| 6.27 || abhinnaṃ tasvato dvavyādamūrtaṃ tatra ca sthitam| upalambhana sāmarthyāddṛśyate na tadīkṣyate|| 6.28 || ajopyamūrtassa rveṣāmantarātmā paraḥ pumān| jñānināṃbhāvanāyogādupalabhdhipathaṃ gataḥ|| 7.29 || brahmāḥ carāca reṣu sarveṣu yadvastu vyāvya viṣṭhitam| amūrtamapṛthagbhūtaṃ svasaṃ vedyaṃ vidanti ke|| 6.30 || vidyayābhagavanmahyaṃ tānācakṣva yathātatham| pañcarātravidhidīkṣitānāṃ viṣṇumāyo ttaraṇam| śrībhagavān pañcarātroktamārgeṇa yo dīkṣāṃ cakramaṇḍale| kṛtvā samarcanaṃ viṣṇoḥ dviṣaṭkākṣaravidyayā|| 6.31 || ārādhayanti śāstroktavidhinā deśikottamāḥ| teṣāṃ hṛdambuje sākṣādāvi rāsaiparaḥ pumān|| 6.32 || taranti viṣṇumāyāṃ te na tarantītare janāḥ|| brahmāḥ vastu sākṣātkṛtaṃ kīdṛglakṣaṇaṃ tasya kīdṛśam| bhagavan kathyatāṃ sarvaṃ mayi cedastyanugrahaḥ|| 6.33 || śrībhagavān vālāgraśatabhāgasthaṃ pradhāna puruṣātmakam| gamanāgamanairhīnamaṇiṣṭhaṃ tadaṇopari|| 6.34 || mahiṣṭhaṃ mahato vastu paramānandavigraham| vṛddhikṣayavinirmaktaṃ sarvagaṃ saṃvidātmakam|| 6.35 || sadrūpaṃ praṇavā vedyamapratarkyaṃ pramāṇavat| evaṃ vastu ca kāṃkṣante hṛdaye yoginassadā|| 6.36 || sthūlaṃ sūkṣmaṃ paraṃ tasya trividhaṃ rūpamīritam|| sthūlaṃ tatsakalaṃ jñeyaṃ sūkṣmaṃ sakalaniṣkalam|| 6.37 || paraṃ niṣkalamevasyādrūpaṃ kamalasambhava| rūpaṃ sahasraśīrṣādi sakalaṃ paramātmanaḥ|| 6.38 || tejaḥ puñjamivābhāti rūpaṃ sakalaniṣkalam| saccidānandarūpādi rūpāṃ niṣkalasaṃjñitam|| 6.39 || prakṛtirvikṛtiśca sve sva rūpe paramātmanaḥ| satvādiguṇasaṃghātaḥ prakṛtirvikṛtiḥ punaḥ|| 6.40 || puruṣaḥ paramātmākhyasteneyaṃtriguṇātmikā| maramātmā dhiṣṭhitāyāḥ prakṛterjagatsargādiḥ| adhiṣṭhitā jagastarvaṃ prasūte cetanātmakam|| 6.41 || saṃharatyapi tatsarvaṃ niyogā deva tasya sā| eka eva paro devo nānāśakti samanvitaḥ|| 6.42 || karoti sargasaṃhārau sa ca nārāyaṇassmṛtaḥ| nānāthikkaiḥ puradvārairyathā puranivāsinaḥ|| 6.43 || antarviṃśanti yadvacca puruṣāḥ puruṣaṃ param| upāsakā viśantyantarvidyayā parayā sadā|| 6.44 || jyotirmaṇḍalamadhyasthaṃ rukmābhaṃ puruṣaṃ paraṃ| hṛtpadmakarṇikārūḍhaṃ śaṅkhacakragadādharam|| 6.45 || caturbhujaṃ bhāvayanti sthāneṣveteṣu yoginaḥ| brahmarandhre bhruvormadhye nabhicakregalāvaṭe|| 6.46 || jīhvāgre dālumadhye ca bhāvayanto yatendriyāḥ| pūrvajanmakṛtaṃ karma dagdhvā yānti sanātanam|| 6.47 || viṣṇorārādhanaparāḥ pañcakālaparāyaṇāḥ| aṣṭāṅgayoga siddhāśca dvādaśākṣaracintakāḥ|| 6.48 || vāśudevaśrayā martyā vāsudeva parāyaṇāḥ| sarvapāpaviśuddhāśca yānti brahma sanātanam|| 6.49 || varṣadhārāḥ pṛthagbhūtāḥ patantyo divi meghataḥ | bhūmāvaikyaṃ yathā yānti tadvadbrahmaṇi yoginaḥ|| 6.50 || arṇo nadīnāṃ bahṛdhā tatsvarūpādi bhedavat| praviṣṭaṃ vāridhervāri nodakādvyatiricyate|| 6.51 || tathaiva brahmaṇi pare muktātmāvaścaturmukha| ekībhāvena tiṣṭhanti tatsālokyaṃ yathā bhavet|| 6.52 || etadrahasyamuditaṃ niṣatsūpaniṣatsu ca| yogaḥ prakāśitastubhyaṃ mayā kamalasambhava|| 6.53 || iti śrīpāñcarātre mahopaniṣadi pādmasaṃhitāyāṃ jñānapāte brahmaprāptyupāyakathanaṃ nāma ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ |
<3.7>
brahmāḥ brahmaṇaḥ prāptyupāyasya jñānasyo tpattikāraṇam| ucyatāṃ tadaśeṣeṇa prasādo mayi cettava|| 7.1 || śrībhagavān bāhyo parāgarahitaṃ nirmalaṃ tasya jāyate| vijñānaṃ yasya bhagavatsamārādhana karmabhiḥ|| 7.2 || anādyavidyāvirayo yogaṅgaiśca yamādibhiḥ| śaucamijyā tapaścaryā svādhyāyā bhyasanaṃ tathā|| 7.3 || brahmācaryā mitāhāro maunamindriyanigrahaḥ| ahiṃsā copavāsaśca snānaṃ tīrthaniṣevaṇam|| 7.4 || vairāgyaṃ putradā reṣu duṣṭāhāravivarjanam| akrūratā vṛddhasevā kṣamā maityranṛśaṃsatā|| 7.5 || paradāraparasveṣu vai mukhyaṃ śāstrasevanam| asaktatā bhogyavastuṣvtetai ścittaprasādhanaiḥ|| 7.6 || jñānaṃ pratyaṅmukhaṃ jātaṃ tena jānanti tatpadam| yatprāpya na nivartanai janmamṛtyu vivarjitāḥ|| 7.7 || puruṣāḥ karmaniratā jñāna vijñānajanmani| saṃsārahetu madhunā kathayāmi caturmukha|| 7.8 || śubhāśubhātmakaṃ karma kṛtvā māyāvaśaṃ gatāḥ| bhogāyatanamāsthāya tattatkarma pravāhajam|| 7.9 || duḥkhaṃ sukhaṃ vā puruṣā bhuñjate niyatendriyāḥ| saṃsṛtissā caturvaktra tasyāḥ karmaiva kāraṇam|| 7.10 || muktīrjñānādike tasyāssaṃsṛterātmano bhavet| karmādhike puvassaiva jāyate niravagrahā|| 7.11 || saṃsārahetubhūtaṃ tatkarmajñānena naśyati| kṣīṇe karmaṇi saṃsārahetau mukti ranantarā|| 7.12 || kalpate saṃsṛtiḥ karmahetu ruktā viniścitā| karoti karma cāvidyāvivaśaḥ puruṣassvayam|| 7.13 || guṇā eva trayo vidyā samāsavyāsavṛttayaḥ| taireva kurute karma śubhaṃ vā yadi vā śubham|| 7.14 || taistribhirvividhā nidrā jāyate karmakāraṇam| saiṣā'vidyā ca māyā ca kathyatekovidottamaiḥ|| 7.15 || satvātsukhamayī nidrā rajasaḥ karmasaṅkulā| tamaso mohinī nāma tābhirnigalitaḥ pumān|| 7.16 || saṃsā rato'vaśaḥ karma karoti janikāraṇam| satvādiguṇasaṃyuktaṃ mano bhūteṣu pañcasu|| 7.17 || prayuktaṃ pañcadhā bhinnaṃ prasūte bahudhā kriyāḥ| manassatvaguṇopetaṃ pṛthivīsthaṃ yadā bhavet|| 7.18 || tadā karoti pṛthivīkhananādikriyāṃ naraḥ| ārādhayetpraticchāyāṃ pālanāya nṛṇāṃ tathā || 7.19 || rajasisthe prāṇahiṃsāṃ mṛgayābuddhimeva ca| tamasisthe tu hṛdaye cchedanaṃ bhedanaṃ tathā|| 7.20 || abhicāra vaśīkāra parasvaharaṇādikam | satvasthe'psu jalakrīḍā jalapānaṃ caturmukha|| 7.21 || nadītanaraṇamityādi karoti vivaśaḥ pumān| rajasā ca jaladroṇyāmavagāhū nivajjanam|| 7.22 || setubandhaṃ samudrādau bāhūbhyāṃ taraṇaṃ tathā| tamasisthe tu manasi jalatīre vimocanam|| 7.23 || kūpe vā patanaṃ śvabhre karoti puruṣassadā| manastejasi satvasthe sūryacaṃdrādi darśanam|| 7.24 || paṭutvamuṣṇabhāvaśca ratna hemādi darśanam| karoti rajasi prāpai khaḍgahastassamu tthitaḥ|| 7.25 || mṛgānhanti tathā muṣṭidaṇḍaiśca bhṛśatāḍanam| tamasisthe manasyagnau raktapuppādiṣu spṛhā|| 7.26 || śvasanasthe guṇe satve śīghrayānaṃ ca nartanam| gānaṃ pralāpanaṃ karma karoti rajasi sthite|| 7.27 || citte gajāśvarohādi tathordhvagamanādikam| tamoguṇasthe manasi prāsādārohaṇādikam|| 7.28 || citte vyomani satvasthe nirābhāsaṃ nirāśrayam| gamanaṃ rājase citte dhṛṣṭhaṃ jāgarti yatpunaḥ|| 7.29 || svāpe tadīkṣitaṃ sarvaṃ mānase tamasi sthite| sarvadaṣṭha vadā tmāyaṃ sukhaduḥkhaṃ na budhyate|| 7.30 || evaṃ bahuvidhāṃ karma pumān māyā vaśaṅgataḥ| karoti triguṇairyaktaḥ karmabhistaiḥ pumānayam|| 7.31 || saṃsāre pi gato janma nāśaṃ ca pratipadyate| yadā prasādasumukhaḥ paramātmā sanātanaḥ|| 7.32 || tadā māyāvi muktaśca yogayukto jitendriyaḥ| vijñānena paraṃ brahma prāpnoti sukhalakṣaṇam|| 7.33 || brahmāḥ ebhirguṇai stathā yogo viyogo vā kathaṃ bhavet|| śrībhagavān puruṣasya guṇā ete trayopi kamalāsana|| 7.34 || māyāyoga viyogābhyāṃ bhavanti na bhavanti ca| māyānapāyinī nityā mayi tiṣṭhati śāśvatī|| 7.35 || māyāvaśaṃgatāssarve bhramantya jñānamohitāḥ| brahmāmayo pi kimuta devādyāḥ kamalāsana|| 7.36 || matprasādāvasānā yā madadhīnā vinaśyati| māyāyogena badhyante mucyantetāṃ jayantiyo|| 7.37 || brahmā paripūrṇasya bhagavan prasādastava kiṃkṛtaḥ| na vedvi kāraṇaṃ tatra tanme brūhi yathātatham|| 7.38 || śrībhagavān śraddhā bhaktissamādhiśca mayi samyaksamarpitā| kāraṇaṃ śāstradṛṣṭena vidhinā nānyathā bhavet|| 7.39 || sarveṣāṃ mokṣyamāṇānāṃ kāraṇa trayamīritam| tairvinā saṃsarantyanye māyāpara vaśā janāḥ|| 7.40 || mamāvatārarūpāṇi budhvā sṛṣṭāni manmukhāt| adharmasyopaśāntyarthaṃ dharma kāma praṣṛddhaye|| 7.41 || bahūni boddhaṃ yogyāni trayaṃ tatra samācaret| sarvākāravinirmuktaṃ rūpaṃ yatparamātmanaḥ|| 7.42 || durvijñānaṃ tadeteṣāṃ śraddhādīnāmagocaram| muktikāraṇamuddhaṣṭaṃ brahman bhūyaḥ kimiṣyate|| 7.43 || brahmāḥ acetanaṃ cetanaṃ ca rūpaṃ sraṣṭuṃ samīkṣyate| kimekayoni ssā sṛṣṭi ryoni bhedaḥ kimetayoḥ|| 7.44 || śrībhagavān abhinnamekamavyaktaṃ rūpaṃ tatpara mātmanaḥ| avibhaktaṃ vibhaktaṃ ca dadhni sarpiriva sthitam|| 7.45 || avyaktaṃ vyaktimāpannaṃ kadācitpuruṣecchayā| mahān jāta statovyaktādahaṅkārattato'jani|| 7.46 || āhaṅkārānmano jātaṃ tanmātrā pañcakaṃ tataḥ| indriyāṇi daśaikaṃ ca samajāyata padmaja|| 7.47 || mahābhūtaṃ pṛthivyādi pañcakaṃ tadana ntaram| acetanāccetanācca sṛṣṭhirevamudāhṛtā|| 7.48 || tribhirevaṃ guṇai retai ruttamādhamamadyamāḥ| jāyanai kāraṇavaśāttānbhravīmi kramādaham|| 7.49 || bhāveṣu teṣu bhūyuṣṭhaṃ satvaṃ śreyāṃ ścaturmakha| bhūyuṣṭharājaso madhyo jaghanyasta samādhikaḥ|| 7.50 || tatra satvādhikai rbhavai rarcanā mama toṣiṇī| bhogo vāpyapavargo vā phalaṃ teṣāṃ yathepsitam|| 7.51 || rajasādhikabhāvena yajante ye dvijātayaḥ| teṣāṃ triviṣṭape vāsaḥ punarāvṛttilakṣaṇaḥ|| 7.52 || saṃsṛtiśca kṣaṇe tasya yahante ye tamo'dhikāḥ| teṣāṃ bhuvasthsale vāsaḥ kṣaye bhūlokasaṃsṛtiḥ|| 7.53 || yakṣabhūta piśācādi yajante tamasādhikāḥ| uṣitvā narake ghore janma syājjaṅgamādiṣu|| 7.54 || gatvā gatvā nivarta nte yajña dharma parāyaṇāḥ| advāpi na nivarta nte ye mamārādhane sthitāḥ|| 7.55 || ābrahmasadanāllokāḥ jāyane'gavasthitāḥ| malloka vāsino bhūyassaṃsaranti na kutracit|| 7.56 || tasmādbhajasvamāṃ brahman satvabhāvasthitassadā| satvādi guṇayuktānā māhāra strividhaḥ smṛtaḥ| snigthāśca madhurā hṛdyā stiṣṭhataḥ prathame guṇe|| 7.57 || kaṭvamlalavaṇaprāyā madyame tiṣṭataḥ priyāḥ| rasahīnaṃ yātayāmaṃ pūtiganthaṃ ciroṣitam| ucchiṣṭaṃ prītijananaṃ jaghanya guṇa vartinaḥ|| 7.58 || satvātsukhamayī nidrā rajasaḥ karmasaṅkulā| nidrā divāniśaṃ tasya tamo yasyādhiko guṇaḥ|| 7.59 || sattvasthasyordhvagamanaṃ sthitarma dhye rajo'dhike| adho gatistāmasānāṃ trividhānāṃ tridhā gatiḥ|| 7.60 || tatra satvaṃ narmalatvātpra kāśakamanāvṛtam| satvaṃ jñānaṃ tapo maunaṃ dhṛtiśśaucaṃ śamaḥ kṣamā|| 7.61 || ityādayassatvaniṣṭhe guṇāḥ kalyāṇa kāriṇaḥ| ahaṅkāra stridhā darmaḥ krodho dambha itīritaḥ|| 7.62 || guṇā rajoguṇasyaite tāmasasya tu kathyate| pai śunyaṃ paranindā ca nidrā lasyaṃ'vṛśaṃsatā|| 7.63 || ityādayastamo'dhīnā guṇāḥ proktāścaturmākha| pralīnayoritarayorguṇayośca jaghanyayoḥ|| 7.64 || satve pravṛddhe vijñānamutkṛṣṭaṃ jāyate'dhikam| tena prāpnoti paramaṃ sthānaṃ prakṛti durlabhaṃ|| 7.65 || yatprāvya na nivarta nte saṃsāre duḥkha sambhave| dehaṃ tyajantassatvasthā lokān yānti sanātanān|| 7.66 || rajasthsasya pralīnasya jasma mātraṃ mahākule| pralaye tamasisthasya puruṣasya caturmukha|| 7.67 || mūḍhayoniṣu janma syānnikṛṣṭāsu punaḥ punaḥ| tyajato'nte smṛtiryeṣu devasambhandhamātmanaḥ|| 7.68 || bhāveṣu taṃ tamāpnoti puruṣo bhāvanāvaśāt| puṃsāmevaṃ bahuvidhāḥ gatayassamudāhṛtāḥ|| 7.69 || iti śrīpāñcarātre mahopaniṣadi pādmasaṃhitāyāṃ jñānapāde gativi śeṣakathanaṃ nāma saptamo'dhyāyaḥ |
<3.8>
brahmāḥ vijñānopāyārūpeṇa tapaścaryā ca kīrtitā| bhagavan tattapaḥ krīdṛk kiṃ vā tatkathyatāṃ mama|| 8.1 || śrībhagavān vāṅmanaḥ kāyajatvena tapastattri vidhaṃ matam| devadvijaguruprājña pūjanaṃ śaucamārjavam|| 8.2 || ahiṃsanaṃ brahmacarmaṃ tapaśśārīramīritam| anugrahaparaṃ vākyaṃ satyaṃ bhūto pakārakam|| 8.3 || svādhyā yābhyasanaṃ ceti vācikaṃ kathitaṃ tapaḥ| santoṣassatataṃ brahmacivtayā''tmavinigrahaḥ|| 8.4 || bhāvaśuddhi ssaumyatā ca tapo mānasa mīritam| śraddhadhānaiḥ kṛtaṃ samyagaphalākāṅkṣibhirnaraiḥ|| 8.5 || sātvikaṃ tattapo jñeyaṃ taddhi vijñānakārakam| satkāramānapūjādi sidhyarthaṃ rājasaṃ tapaḥ|| 8.6 || tāmasaṃ tu tapattatsyāt yatparotsādanādikam| karma kadvividhaṃ naiva vijñānotpattikāraṇam|| 8.7 || brahmāḥ kutaḥ prasūtirjagatāṃ teṣāṃ nāśaḥ kvasaṃmataḥ| kiyantaṃ kālameteṣāṃ sthitirma bhagavan vada|| 8.8 || śrībhagavān āpannā prakṛtirvyaktiṃ sūte sarvaṃ carācaram| tatraiva līyate sarvaṃ brāhme āyuṣi ca sthitiḥ|| 8.9 || kālo yugasahastrākhyaḥ divārātriśca tāvatī|| brahmaṇasaina mānena śatamāyuśca vatsarāḥ|| 8.10 || bhavanti manavastasya dine tatra caturdaśa| ekonasaptatiḥ kālo manorekasya kīrtitaḥ|| 8.11 || parasmin brahmaṇi brahman arvācine layaṃ gate| pralayo mahadākhyoyaṃ caturānana kīrtitaḥ|| 8.12 || avāntarāśca pralayā dinānāmavasānajāḥ| bhavantidhātṛbhistaistairma hāṃśca pralayaḥ punaḥ|| 8.13 || cakravadvartate kālo na virāmosti karhicit| brahmāḥ kiṃrūpā prakṛtirdeva sūte kathamidaṃ jagate| brūhi sarvamaśeṣeṇabha vagavan bhūtabhāvana|| 8.14 || śrībhagavān asyūnādhikarūpāṇāṃ satvādhīnāṃ caturmukha| guṇānāṃ saṃhatiryā sā prakṛtissadbhirucyate|| 8.15 || acetanā sā viśvasya yoni ravyākṛtā svayam| nityā sūte jagatsarvaṃ niyogātparamātmanaḥ|| 8.16 || avibhaktā vibhaktā ca dadhni sarpiriva sthitā| saṅkarṣaṇākhyo bhagavān prakṛtāveva tāḥ prajāḥ|| 8.17 || rudrassaṃharati svairaṃ brahmaṇo divasakṣaye| divasādau jagatsarvaṃ punarevā sṛjatprajāḥ|| 8.18 || lokakartāsvayaṃ brahmā yathā pūrvaṃ yathākramam| ityevaṃ sargasaṃhārau mayā samyagudīratau|| 8.19 || brahmā aiśvaryamaṣṭaguṇavatkiṃ tadhyadbhaktimān pumān| āproti kīdṛksāyujyaṃ yuñjānasya sumedhasaḥ|| labdhvā caiśvaryamakhilaṃ kena pratinivartate|| 8.20 || śrībhagavān aṇimā mahimā cāpi yāvānevāsya kāmyate|| tāva ntamiṣṭamāpnoti garimā laghimāpi vā|| 8.21 || iṣyamāṇamavāpnoti laghimnātena pūraṣaḥ| deśaṃ vidūramapyeṣa kṣaṇamātreṇa gacchati|| 8.22 || yathā śālmanitūlasya tathā dehasya lāghasam| garimṇā tena dehasya parvatasyena noddhṛtiḥ|| 8.23 || āhāreṣu vihāreṣu yathākāmaṃ pravartate| saṅkalpenaina bhūtāni vaśyāni kamalāsana || 8.24 || parakāyapraveśaṃ ca yatheṣṭaṃ pratipadyate| ebhiraṣṭabhirevaite viharanti yathepsitam|| 8.25 || yadi māṃ visma reyusai sukhanidrāvimohitāḥ| madbhakri kṣaraṇādeva pratisroto vahā janāḥ|| 8.26 || jāyante punarutkṛṣṭavaṃ śeṣu mahatāṃ satām| punarbha jeyurmā meva yajante siddhikāmyayā|| 8.27 || mucyante matprasādena janmano'smādvigarhitāt|| bhedena cāpyabhedena miśreṇa ca caturmukha|| 8.28 || tridhaina muktiruditā bhede kaiṅkaryalakṣaṇā| muktiryatheha lokeṣu paricaryāparā narāḥ|| 8.29 || devasya tadvadenai te vai kuṇṭhe paramātmanaḥ| loke tasya samīpasthā muktātmāna ssamāhitāḥ|| 8.30 || vasanti kiṅkarāssanta statprasādaparāssadā| abheda muktiratyanta maikyaṃ syātparajīvayoḥ|| 8.31 || ātmano bhāvanā caikye sohamityevamātmikā| yasya tasyaikatāpatti rmuktirjīvavarātmanoḥ|| 8.32 || siddhāntemiśrarūpe tu bhedesthitvārcanādibhiḥ| toṣayitvā paraṃ devaṃ tato yuktassamāhitaḥ|| 8.33 || vijñānentekatānena paramātmani cidghane| aikyaṃ prāpnoti sā muktiruktā sāyujyalakṣaṇā|| 8.34 || aiśvaryamaṇimādyaṣṭa guṇāvāptissudurlabhā| muktirvā varamānandaprāptirūpā yadīptitam| puṃsāṃ tadubhayaṃ muktiḥ prasūte paramātmani|| 8.35 || brahmāḥ bahūni tatvānyuktāni śāstrairbahubhiracyuta| teṣu tatyeṣu narveṣu bhāvanā vihitā kramāt|| 8.36 || samādhirekatānaiva śāstravijñānamuttamam| prasūte yena tadbrahma tatvebhyaḥ paramaṃ matam|| 8.37 || prāpnuvanti sarāssarve tatvāni kathayasva me|| 8.38 || śrībhagavān catvāriṃśaddaśaikaṃ ca tatvāni paramātmanaḥ| rūpāṇyeva caturvaktra saṅkṣeṣapātkathayāmyaham|| 8.39 || bhāvanā teṣvavikṛtā siddhaye kalpate parā| vaktavyāni tatastāni heto stānyavadhāraya|| 8.40 || avyaktaṃ buddhiranvakca tataḥ paramahajkṛtiḥ| tanmātrapañcakānyekādaśa coktānyanukramāt|| 8.41 || pṛthivyādīni bhūtāni pañcaivakamalāsana| māyākālakalārāgavidyādīni yataḥ kramāt|| 8.42 || nandaścaiva mahānando mahāvidyā samīritā| kṣetrajñaśca śivo brahmā puruṣastadanantaram|| 8.43 || satyācyutau tathā'nanto viṣṇussarvaśca nirvṛtiḥ| viśvaśca puruṣaśca dvau parameṣṭhī samīritaḥ|| 8.44 || nāmnā'niruddaḥ pradyumnassaṅkarṣaṇa samāhvayaḥ| vāsudevaśca catvāriṃśaddaśacaikaṃ caturmukha|| 8.45 || tataḥ proktamidaṃ sarvaṃ yatrotpannaṃ carācaram| tasya prapañco rupāṇi teṣāṃ nāmāni kaḥ kṣamaḥ|| 8.46 || iha sarvāṇya śeṣāṇi vaktuṃ vācāmapīśvaraḥ| ityeṣā kathitā tubhyaṃ tatvānāṃ nāmapaddhatiḥ|| 8.47 || saṃjñāvikalpaistatvāni bhāvayanta ssamādhibhiḥ| yuñjānā yoginaśśaśvatprāpnu panti paraṃ padaṃ|| 8.48 || iti śrī pāñcarātre mahopaniṣadi pādmasaṃhitāyāṃ jñānapāde tapoviśeṣakathanaṃ nāma aṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ|
<3.9>
brahmāḥ ajñānasāgaraṃ tīrtvā vidyāpāramupeyivān| ucyatāṃ sāṃprataṃ mahyaṃ bhuvanāni caturdaśa|| 9.1 || rūpato nāmataścāpi jijñāsā parameśvara| śrībhagavān yatra pratiṣṭhitaṃ yacca mānaṃ rūpaṃ ca yādṛśam| bhuvanānāṃ tadakhilaṃ caturmukhamukhai śśataiḥ|| 9.2 || vaktuṃ niravaśeṣeṇa kaḥ kṣameta prapañcataḥ| boddhuṃ vā nikhilaṃ śaktaḥ ko vā dhārayituṃ kṣamaḥ|| 9.3 || tadbhravīmi samāsena sarvaṃ tvaṃ budhyase yathā| caturaśrā bhavati bhūḥ pañcauśatkoṭi yojanaiḥ|| 9.4 || vistīrṇā sarvato dikṣu ghanaṃ vaikoṭiyojanam| dvīpāni sapta santyatra tāvastastoyarāśayaḥ|| 9.5 || āṅgulīyakavatsarve bhūmerupari viṣṭhitāḥ| dvīpāni nāmabhistāvatkathyante kramaśaśṛṇu|| 9.6 || jambhūplakṣa kuśa krauñcāśśākadvīpastathā paraḥ| śālmalī puṣkaro nāma saptamaścaturānana|| 9.7 || ānupūrvyātsamudrāṃśca kathayāmi yathātatham|| lavaṇekṣurasau paścāt maireya stadanantaram|| 9.8 || sarpirdadhi payastvavyattataśśuddhodakaṃ param| bhūbhāge madhyame jumbhūdvīpamānaṃ ca kathyate|| 9.9 || lakṣayojanavistārassarvatastadanantaram| vistāraṃ vāridhiḥ kṣārastādṛgdvīpamanantaram|| 9.10 || uttarottaramekaikaṃ dvīguṇāyāma vistaraḥ| dvīpāni ṣaṭsamudrāśca pariśiṣṭhāścaturmukha|| 9.11 || dvīpaṃ jambhūsamākhyātaṃ vibhajennavadā punaḥ| bhāgetu madhyame merorucchāyo lakṣasaṃmitaḥ|| 9.12 || yojanānāṃ kṣiterasta rmagnaṣṣoḍaśakaṅkhyayā| sahastrāṇāṃ yojanānāṃ śiṣṭobhāgaḥ prakāśate|| 9.13 || kṣīte rūrdhvaṃ raimayaśca sarvato mūrdhnivistṛtaḥ| dvātriṃśacca sahaprāṇāṃ yojanā nāmayāṃ punaḥ|| 9.14 || karṇikāvacca bhūpadmamadhye samyagavasthitaḥ| śṛṅgaiśśatasahasreṇa śatayojana vistṛtaiḥ|| 9.15 || tatsaṅkhyāpariṇāhaiśca tasya pārśvamahīdharān| vakṣyāmi cānupūrvyeṇa yathā tadavadhāraya|| 9.16 || himavān hemakūṭasca niṣadhaśchāsya dakṣiṇe| ete varṣācalāḥ proktā strayaḥ kamalasambhava|| 9.17 || varṣaṃ bhāratamākhyāṃ prathamaṃ tadana ntaram| nāmnā kiṃpuruṣaṃ tasmāddharivarṣamanantaram|| 9.18 || uttare meruśailasya kramā dvarṣamahīdharāḥ| nīlaśśvetāhvayaśśṛṅgī nāmnā varṣatrayaṃ punaḥ|| 9.19 || ramyaṃ hiraṇmayaṃ varṣamuttarāḥ kurava stathā| uktāni ṣaṭca varṣaṇi pratyekaṃ parimāṇataḥ|| 9.20 || yojanānāṃ sahasrāṇi nava varṣaṃtu madhyamam| ilāvṛtaṃ samākhyātaṃ tanmadhye merurīritaḥ|| 9.21 || meroścaturdaśaṃ tatra vistīrṇaṃ yojanāni ṣaṭ| triṇī caiva sahasrāṇi catvārastatraparvatāḥ|| 9.22 || viṣkambharūpai racitā yojanāyutamucbhritāḥ| mandharo diśi purvasyāṃ yāmyāyāṃ gandhamādanaḥ|| 9.23 || pratīcyāṃ vipulo nāmnā............... .................... kaubherīmadhitiṣṭhati|| diśānu tānu catvāro pṛkṣāḥ ketuvadunnatāḥ|| 9.24 || kadambhabhūruho jambhūḥ pippalo viṭapī vaṭaḥ| śatāni daśa caikaṃ ca teṣāṃ pratyekamāyatiḥ|| 9.25 || jambhvūtayā samākhyā syāt dvīpasya kamalāsana| phalāni gajamānāni patitāni śilātale|| 9.26 || śrīryante śatadhā teṣāṃ rasavāha ssaridvarā| jāmbhūnadīti kathitā tattaṭorvīnivāsinaḥ|| 9.27 || pītvā rasaṃ jarāmṛtyuvalīpalitavarjitāḥ| na svedo na ca daurgandhyaṃ nendriyāṇāmapi kṣayaḥ|| 9.28 || bhavanti teṣāṃ tīrorvī mṛdastadrasarañjitāḥ| jāmbhānadākhyāṃ kalpante sauvarṇā kalpasampadaḥ|| 9.29 || bhadrāśvavarṣamākhyātaṃ meroḥ prācyāṃ caturmukha| paścimaṃ ketumālākhyametayorvarṣayoḥ punaḥ|| 9.30 || ilāpṛtaṃ samākhyātaṃ madhyamaṃ tatpuroditam|| vanaṃ caitrarathaṃ pūrvaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ gandhamādanam|| 9.31 || vai bhrājāṃ paścīmaṃ merorvanaṃ nandana muttaram| aruṇodaṃ saraḥ pūrvaṃ mahābhadraṃ tataḥ param|| 9.32 || śītodakaṃ pratīcīnamudīcīnaṃ tu mānasam| devopabhogayogyāni sarāṃsi kathitāni te|| 9.33 || śatātaśca mukundaśca kurarī mālyavānatha| vaikaṅko nāmapañaite paurastyāḥ kesarācalāḥ|| 9.34 || trikūṭoṅgirasaśco bhau pannagaḥ kūṭalāhyayaḥ| niṣado dakṣiṇe tasya tāvantaḥ kesarācalāḥ|| 8.35 || śikhivāso tha vai dūryaḥ kapilo gandhamādanaḥ| jārudhiḥ pañcamo brahman kesarāḥ pañcabhūdharā|| 8.36 || śaṅkhakūṭassamākhyāta ssamākhyāta statharṣabhaḥ| haṃsassamākhyayā nāgastathā kālāñjanaprabhaḥ|| 9.37 || udīcyāṃ kesarāḥ pañca viṃśatiḥ kesarācalāḥ| yojanānāṃ sahasrāṇāṃ dvātriṃśanmānasammite|| 9.38 || vistāre mūrdhnā śailasya merorbhāge'tha madhyame| caturbhīrdaśabhiścaiva sahasrairnirmitā purī|| 9.39 || yojanaissaṃmito dhātuḥ karṇi kevācalāmbhuje| vidikṣu dikṣu cāṣṭāsu parito brahmaṇaḥ purī|| 9.40 || indrādilokapālānāṃ puraḥ pūrvādiṣu sthitāḥ| vistārāyāmamānena śatayojanasaṃmitāḥ|| 9.41 || purī bhavati māghaunī nāmnā cai vāmarāvatī| sahasragopuradvāra prākāra parighākulā|| 9.42 || tejovatī puryāgneyī yāmyā saṃyamanī purī| rakṣovatī rākṣasī pūśsuddha vatyatha vāruṇī|| 9.43 || vāyorgandhavatī khyātā nāmnā saumyā mahodayā| yaśaspinī bhavasyoktā kesarācalabhūmiṣu|| 9.44 || bhagavasmūrtī bhedānāṃ purassanti pariṣkṛtāḥ| bhitvendumaṇḍalaṃ gaṅgā bhagavatpāda janmabhūḥ|| 9.45 || divaḥ patantī pratyāśamabhyāśaṃ bhrahmaṇaḥ puraḥ| caturtikṣu vahantī sā caturdhābhavatisvayam|| 9.46 || sitā cālakanandā ca sucakṣurbhadrayā saha| catasro nāma bhedāśca digbhedāśca caturmukha|| 9.47 || stītā ntarikṣagā pūrva śailānniṣkramya nimnagā| yāti pūrveṇa varṣeṇa bhadrāśvena ca saṃjñayā|| 9.48 || praviṣṭā sāgaramukhaṃ dakṣiṇena tathā dhvanā| bhārataṃ varṣamabhyeti śailātsaptamukhā tataḥ|| 9.49 || praviṣṭālakanandhā sā nadī trailokyapāvanī| sucakṣuḥ paścimācchailā tketumālāt svayaṃ punaḥ|| 9.50 || atītya varṣamambhodhimeti yoṣidyathā patim| bhadrā girerudhīcinā deśā nuttarataḥ kurūn|| 9.51 || atītya vāridhiṃ yāti nimnagā saritāṃ patim| ānīna viṣadāyāmau mālyavān gandamādanaḥ|| 9.52 || madhye tayormeruśailaḥ karṇakā paṅkaje yathā| bhārataṃ ketumālaṃ ca bhadrāśvaṃ kurusaṃjñakam|| 9.53 || patrāṇi lokapadmasya maryādā śailato bahi| hemakūṭaśca niṣadho dakṣīṇottaramāya tau|| 9.54 || maryādāparvatau jñeyau kailāso gandhamādanaḥ| aśītiyojanāmāmau pūrvāparamahodadhī|| 9.55 || saṃspṛśantau pāriyātra niṣadhāvadhibhūbhṛtau| meroḥ paścimabhūbhāge pūrrottara mathāśritau|| 9.56 || triśṛṅgo jārudhirvarṣa parvatau merubhūbhṛtaḥ| uttareṇa sthitau prāpya pūrvāparamahodadhī|| 9.57 || parvatānāmavasthāna mānantyānna prapañcyate| śailānāmantaradroṇyassevyante siddhacāraṇaiḥ|| 9.58 || anyaiśca puṇyakṛdbhistā daityadānavakinnaraiḥ| bhaumā hyete kṛtāssvargāḥ durlabhāḥ pāpakarmabhiḥ|| 9.59 || jñānamūrtirhayagrivo bhadrāśve vasati svayam| varṣeṣu mūrtayoviṣṇo rmaryādāparvateṣuca|| 9.60 || vasanti lokarakṣāyai nānārūpaviśeṣitāḥ| yāni kiṃpuruṣādīni varṣā ṇyeteṣu padmaja|| 9.61 || nirātaṅkāḥ prajāśśaśvan śoko na bhayaṃ tathā| nodanyā ca bubhukṣā ca na dveṣo nā yuṣuḥ kṣayaḥ|| 9.62 || santi teṣāṃ sahasrāṇi varṣāṇi dvau ca viṃśatiḥ| āyurva teṣu deśeṣu bhaumamambho na varṣati|| 9.63 || devo na cartubhedosti na kālo yugabhedavān| sadā kṛtayugaḥ kālo vartate caturānana|| 9.64 || dharmaścatuṣpātsakalo dhyānamevārcanaṃ hareḥ| parvatāssaritaścāpi yatra yatra purāṇi ca|| 9.65 || grāmāśca santi bahavassya dharmaniratāssadā| brāhmaṇā bhūmipāścāpi prajāpālanatatparāḥ|| 9.66 || sve sve karmaṇyabhiratāścāturvarṇyamavasthitāḥ| cārurāśramyamapyevaṃ yathoktamavatiṣṭhate|| 9.67 || iti śrī pāñcarātre mahopaniṣadi pādmasaṃhitāyāṃ jñānapāde jambūdvīpramāṇavarṇanaṃ nāma navamo'dhyāyaḥ |
<3.10>
śrībhagavān ādākṣiṇātyādambhodherāśai lācca himālayāt| deśo'yaṃ bhārataṃ varṣaṃ bhūreṣā karmaṇāṃ nṛṇām|| 10.1 || yojanāni sahasrāṇi vistāraścaiva kathyate| svargāpavarga phaladaṃ karma kāryaṃ nṛṇāmiha|| 10.2 || sahyo mahendro malayaśśuktimānṛkṣanāmavān| vindhyaśca pāriyātraśca saptaite kulaparvatāḥ|| 10.3 || ihaiva kriyamāṇasya karmaṇo narakaṃ phalam| varśeṣvanyeṣu sarveṣu kevalaṃ bhujyate phalam|| 10.4 || ihaiva cāturāśramyaṃ cāturvarṇya mavasthitam| kṛtādiyugabhedānāṃ caturṇāmiha sambhavaḥ| dānāṃ yajñaṃ tapo martyāḥ paraloka phalārthinaḥ| iha kurvanti yajñeśaṃ yajante puruṣottamam|| 10.5 || śreṣṭhaṃ tadbhārataṃ varṣaṃ sarvavarṣe'ṣu saṃmatam| phalārthinaḥ kāmayante karmabhūṣu janiṃ bhudhāḥ|| 10.6 || sahastāṇi tathai vāsmin divyāni puruṣaḥ paraḥ| āste dhāmāni sadyaśca puṇyāssanti sahasraśaḥ|| 10.7 || grāmāḥ puraḥ pattanāni bhavanti ca paraśśatam| dvīpeṣu ṣaṭsu cānyeṣu santi varṣāṇi sapta vai|| 10.8 || pratyekaṃ sapta ca brahman bhavanti kulaparvatāḥ| varṇānāmāśramāṇāṃ ca bhedāstatra vyavasthitāḥ|| 10.9 || antime puṣkaradvīpe mānasottaraparvataḥ| madhye valayavadbhāti tasyocchrāyo bhidhīyate|| 10.10 || yojanānāṃ sahastrāṇi pañcāśattatsamunnatiḥ| tāvānevasya vistāro dvīpaṃ tadvibhajanniva|| 10.11 || sthitaśśailavaro brahman dve varṣe parimaṇḍale| śailasya cāntarmānasya bahiśca sadṛśe ubhe|| 10.12 || tanmūrdhni lokapālānā mindrādīnāṃ yadhā punaḥ| purassanti puvastāsāṃ nāmānyapi yathāpuram|| 10.13 || devānāmapi cānyeṣāṃ tatra santi puraḥ pṛthak| asaṅkhyātā brahmaṇaśca purī bhavati puṣkare|| 10.14 || svādussvacchodakaiḥ pūrṇo vāridhiḥ puṣkarādbahiḥ| tena tadveṣṭitaṃ dvīpaṃ yathā nyānyarṇavottaraiḥ|| 10.15 || svādūdakādbahirbhūmissarvā caiva hiraṇmayī| tapanīyamayo brahman lokālokācalo bahiḥ|| 10.16 || bhūlokasya samastasya sālava ccaturaśrakam| āvṛtya tiṣṭhatastasya yojanāyatamunnatiḥ|| 10.17 || vistāraśca na evāsya mūrdhni sarvatra ca svayam| mūrtibhedairaparyanteḥ paramaḥ puruṣaḥ sthitaḥ|| 10.18 || kumudādigaṇāścātra cakrādhīnyāyudhāni ca| devyau mahī ca lakṣmīśca viṣvaksenaḥ patatrirāṭ|| 10.19 || sthānāni mūrtibhedānāṃ viṣṇoḥ parijanasya ca| santi bhūyāṃsi ramyāṇi tatra tatra caturmukha|| 10.20 || paraṃ pārśvaṃ ravistasya na dyotavati bhānubhiḥ| āvṛtya taṃ tamaśśailabhāgaṃ bāhyamavasthitam|| 10.21 || lokālokassa ca punassamantādveṣṭito giriḥ| bahiraṇḍakaṭāhena mahatā samanantaram|| 10.22 || yojanānāmiyaṃ pṛthvī pañcāśatkoṭibhirmatā| sahaivāṇḍakaṭāhena sadvīpābhdhimahīdharā|| anayā dhriyate sarvaṃ jagaddhātrī tataḥ smṛtā|| 10.23 || iti śrī pañcarātre mahopaniṣadi pādmasaṃhitāyāṃ jñānapāde bhūlokavistārakathanaṃ nāma daśamo'dhyāyaḥ|
<3.11>
śrībhagavān eṣa bhūlokavistāraḥ kathitaḥ kavalāsana| lokānadhastādadhunā sapta vacmi yathātatham|| 11.1 || atalaṃ prathamaṃ lokaṃ dvitīyaṃ vitalāhyayam| tṛtīyaṃ nitalaṃ viddhi jñeyaṃ turyaṃ gabhastimat|| 11.2 || pañcamaṃ mahadāhvānaṃ sutalaṃ ṣaṣṭhamīritam| pātālaṃ saptamaṃ vidhyā tte caikaikaṃ samucchritāḥ|| 11.3 || yojanānāṃ sahastrāṇi daśai teṣvatalādiṣu| vasanti dānavā daityāḥ kāleyāḥ phaṇinastathā|| 11.4 || svargepi na bhavantyeva ye bhoga stvatalādiṣu| bhakṣyaṃ bhohyaṃ tathā peyaṃ svādiṣṭaṃ guṇavattaram|| 11.5 || prāsādabhūmayo ramyāḥ kānanāni ca nimnagāḥ| nāgakanyāśca śataśassanti sarvāṅgaśobhanāḥ|| 11.6 || ratnānāṃ dīptījālena dhvāntedhvaste divāniśam| nārkona candramāstatra janai rākāṅkṣyate kvacit|| 11.7 || yāprīti rvasatāṃ tatra na sā muktātmanāmapi| yadbhoktumiṣyate vastu dṛśyate tadupasthitam|| 11.8 || na mṛgyatekvaci dvāpi vastu tadbhogatatparaiḥ| svargādaṣṭaguṇaṃ bhogamatalādiṣu saptasu|| 10.9 || bhuñjate bhoganiratāḥ rakṣodai teyadānavāḥ| na daridrā na rogārtā na kṛśā na ca duḥkhitāḥ|| 11.10 || bilāni śataśassanti vipulāni samantataḥ| sahasraphaṇavānviṣṇuḥ kapilo sāma saptame|| 11.11 || pātālākhye talādīnāmāste rakṣaṃśca kevalam| sarvaiḥ pāriṣadaissārdhāṃ pure mahati śobhite|| 11.12 || tāmasīṃ tanumāsthāya viṣṇureṣā mavasthitaḥ| saptānāmatalādīnāṃ śeṣākhyo balavattaraḥ|| 11.13 || phaṇāsahasrasubhago maṇibhirdīpayan diśaḥ| ananta iti ca prājñeḥ khyāto loke maharṣibhiḥ|| 11.14 || tasya mūrdhāni māleva dhriyate sakalā mahī| kurvan surādidaiteyā nabalānātmatejasā|| 11.15 || kirīṭī srapagdharassubhrūrmadaghūṇitalocanaḥ| nīlavāsāstitatanuḥ kailāsa iva bhūdharaḥ|| 11.16 || lāṅgalaṃ musalaṃ bibhradāyudhaṃ daityadāraṇam| upāsyamāno vāruṇyā śaśvatsannidadhānayā|| 11.17 || kalpāvasāne vaktrebhyo yasya saṅkarṣaṇaśśivaḥ| niṣkrāmati jagatsarvaṃ saṃhartuṃ viṣapāvakaḥ|| 11.18 || āste sampūjitassarvaiḥ pātālatalavāsibhiḥ| nāsya varṇayutuṃ śaktā guṇā vaktṛśatairapi|| 11.19 || yadā madena murdānaṃ kampayannavatiṣṭhate| tadā mahītalaṃ sarvaṃ sādrivāridhikānanam|| 11.20 || kampate kaḥ kṣametāsya balaṃ vaktumaśeṣataḥ| adhassāccheṣaphaṇinaḥ kūrmaḥ kālā nalasthitiḥ|| 11.21 || śikhāsahasrajaṭilo dussahaḥ kamalāsana| ādhāraśaktire tasmāda dhastādvaiṣṇavī tanuḥ|| 11.22 || anantaramathai tasyāḥ bhavatyaṇḍakaṭāhakaḥ| karmaṇaḥ puṇyarūpasya kathitāḥ phalabhūmayaḥ|| 11.23 || adhunā pāparūpasya kathyante phalabhūmayaḥ| bhuvo jalasya cādhasnānnarakākhyā bhuvassmṛtāḥ|| 11.24 || rauravaṃ prathamaṃ taśca mahatpūrvamanantaram| taptaputthalikā kumbhī śūlāropaṇamīritam|| 11.25 || sūcyagraṃca kṣuraṃ caiva khaḍgakṛntanamanvataḥ| sūkaraṃ tailakumbhaṃca mahājvālā ca tāpanam|| 11.26 || asipatraṃ pūyavahaṃ vyāghrasiṃhavṛkādikam| taptastambhaṃ śunā bhakṣyaṃ śālmalī hemapuṣpitā|| 11.27 || lālodakaṃ raktasindhu śśaktibhiśchedanaṃ tathā| evamūdīni cānyāni phalānyāhurvikarmaṇām|| 11.28 || narakāṇāmasaṅkhyānā meṣā dikkathitā mayā| patitāsteṣu pāpiṣṭhā jantavo bhuñjate phalam|| 11.29 || na karmaṇāṃ kṣayo brahman vinā bhogaiḥ pṛthagvidaiḥ| jñānāgnissarvakarmāṇi bhasmasātkurute dṛḍham|| 11.30 || na svargo nāpi narako yegavidyā mupeyuṣām| iti śrī pāñcarātre mahopaniṣadi pādmasaṃhitāyāṃ jñānapāte ātalādilokaparimāṇaṃ nāma ekādaśo'dhyāyaḥ|
<3.12>
brahmā vistāraḥ kathito bhūmeḥ lokāssaphtātalādikāḥ| narakāṇi tathoktāni sāṃprataṃ bhagavanmama|| 12.1 || bhuvaḥ prabhṛtilokānāṃ rūraṃ mānaṃ ca kathyatām| śrībhagavān yāvatpramāṇā vṛthivī vistīrṇā parimaṇḍalā|| 12.2 || tāvadbhuvasthsalaṃ brahman vistīrṇaṃ parimaṇḍalam| upariṣṭātkṣitervyomni lakṣayojanasaṅkhyayā|| 12.3 || ravistiṣṭhati tigmaissvairaṃśubhirbhāsayan jagat| rathamāsthāya bhagavān bahuyojana vistṛtam|| 12.4 || vāmapārśve rathasyaikaṃ cakraṃ disyaṃ pratiṣṭhitam| vahanti saptayassapta chandhāṃsi syandanaṃ mahat|| 12.5 || sārathiścāruṇasśarvānaśvānvāhayati svayam| mānasottara śailasya mūrdhni syandanapaddhatiḥ|| 12.6 || vibhāga heturuṣasāmahnā mapi gatikramāt| yogināṃ paramaḥ panthāḥ smṛtaḥ kleśaparikṣaye|| 12.7 || mokṣamāṇāḥ pathānena yāntiviṣṇoḥ paraṃ padam| udayāntamayau naiva bhānussarvatra sammukhaḥ|| 12.8 || darśanādarśane bhāno rudayā stamayau matau|| yairmatra dṛśyate bhānussa teśāmudayassmṛtaḥ|| yāti yatra tirobhāvaṃ tatrāstamayadhīrnṛṇām|| 12.9 || sphītā bhavanti pūrvāhṇe rasmayo'rkasya santatāḥ| hrasvībhavanti paścāttu yāvatteṣāmadarśanam|| 12.10 || varjayitvā purīṃ dhātussarvato merubhūdhare| patanti bhānavo bhānostirya gūrdhvamadhastathā|| 12.11 || sabhāṃ tu brahmaṇo gatvā prasthitaṃ pānti yo punaḥ| brahmaṇastejasā tena nānyatra skhalanaṃ kvacit|| 12.12 || bhūsūryayorantarālaṃ bhuvasthsalamudāhṛtam| vidyādharāśca gandharvā ssiddhāśca saha dānavaiḥ|| 12.13 || vasanti muditā sveṣu pureṣveva pṛthakpṛthak| lakṣe divākarasthānāśchaśinaḥ sthānamīritam|| 12.14 || tasyopariṣṭāttaṣṭhanti nakṣatrāṇi yathāyatham| lakṣatrayamatītyordhvaṃ budhasya sthitirucyate|| 12.15 || uśanā tu sthito lakṣadvayamu ttīrya tiṣṭhati| tadyojanānyatikramya bhaumanti ṣṭhati sarvadā|| 12.16 || tāvatpramāṇe'vasthānaṃ guro stasyopari sthitiḥ| śanaiścarastatpramāṇamatītyordhvaṃ ravessutaḥ|| 12.17 || lakṣalakṣa kramādūrdhvaṃ nakṣatraṃ munayaḥ pare| parassahasraṃ ṛṣayassantyuparyūrdhva gāminaḥ|| 12.18 || tato dhruvasthsitasthsāne durārohe maharṣibhiḥ| dvādaśāraṃ mahācakraṃ nemī dve tasya nābhayaḥ|| 12.19 || tisrassanti na santyasya māsapāsteṣvareṣu te| meṣādayopyareṣvavaṃ mīnāntādvādaśa sthitāḥ|| 12.20 || mānā dvādaśa caitrādyā vasantapramukhā stathā| ṛtavaṣṣaṭsaṅkramāśca viṣuvadvāyanadvayam|| 12.21 || sitāsitau ca pakṣau dvau yugabhedāśca vatsarāḥ| truṭyādayaḥ kālabhedāścakradhārāsu viṣṭhitāḥ|| 12.22 || dhruvaḥ sthito nā bhimadhye prādakṣiṇyena rāśayaḥ| prasavyena grahāssarve caranti gatirīdṛśī|| 12.23 || kulālacakramadhyasthamṛtpiṇḍa sadṛśo dhruvaḥ| bhramanti paritassarve dhruvaṃ jyotirgaṇāssadā|| 12.24 || ādityadhruvayormadhye deśasyvargasamāhyayaḥ| vasanti tasmin gīrvāṇā vimāneṣu pṛthakpṛthak|| 12.25 || asaṅkhyātā nityatṛptāḥ jyotirmayavapurdharāḥ| teṣāṃ gaṅgājalaṃ sevyaṃ puṣpāṇi surabhūruhām|| 12.26 || dhanaṃ ca cintāmaṇayaḥ striyaścāpsarasaḥ smṛtāḥ| siddhādayo vapantismapureṣu nirupadravāḥ| utendra mūrtirbhagavā nāsīvantatra sarvadā|| 12.27 || rakṣati svarganilayan devādīn svena tejasā| bhūrbhavassvastrayolokāḥ lakṣāḥ pañcadaśa smṛtāḥ|| 12.28 || tataḥ paraṃ maharlokaḥ kotiyojanamāyataḥ| sanandanādyā munayo vasanti daśakoṭayaḥ|| 12.29 || tataḥ paraṃ janolokaḥ koṭidvayasamāyataḥ| anantaraṃ tapolokaḥ sthitaḥ koṭibhiraṣṭabhiḥ|| 12.30 || yojanānāṃ satyalokaḥ punastriguṇamāyataḥ| koṭitrayayutaṃ tasmādūrdhvaṃ dhātuḥ puraṃ sthitam|| 12.31 || tabbrahmalokaṃ munayaḥ gṛṇanti kamalāsana| lakṣayojanavistāraṃ sālaprāsādagopuram|| 12.32 || uttareṇa brahmalo kāddviṣṇulokaṃ vidurbudhāḥ| antaraṃ lokayoruktaṃ lakṣayojanasaṃmitam|| 12.33 || tāvatye vā ntarāle'sya dakṣiṇasyāṃ diśi sthitaḥ| śivalokaścaturvaktra tasminnā ste śivassvayam|| 12.34 || yojanānāṃ koṭi mūdhvan mullaṅghya purataḥ sthitaḥ| sarvātvā bhagavāsūrdhvaṃ tasmātkoṭitrayāya te|| 12.35 || nivṛtyātmā nivasati bhagavānavyayassvayam| tāvatyeva sthito māne viśvātmā viśvakṛddhariḥ|| 12.36 || puruṣātmā purastāttu catuṣkoṭi pramāṇake| sthitaḥ koṭīratītyordhvaṃ pañca paścādavasthitaḥ|| 12.37 || parameṣṭhi sa bhagavān paścakaṃ viṣṇu viṣṭaram| adhyāste bhagavānnityaṃ śaṅkhacakra gadādaraḥ|| 12.38 || paścaśaktimayo viṣṇuḥ koṭiyojanasaṃmite| āste śrībhūmisahito vaina teyena sevitaḥ|| 12.39 || aṇḍabhittiruparyasya sthito rdhve koṭiyojane| ghanaṃ ca tasyāḥ koṭyā tu saṃmitaṃ kamalāsana|| 12.40 || śuddhaṃ hiraṇyayaṃ jñeyamaṇḍaṃ tadvisma yāvaham| etenaṇḍakaṭāhena lokāssarve samāvṛtāḥ|| 12.41 || uparyuparyamī lokāḥ kapitthaphalavat sthitāḥ| taddaśo ttarasaṅkhye vāriṇā pariveṣṭitam|| 12.42 || āvṛtyāṇḍaṃ yathāvāri sthitaṃ tadyattadagninā| sa vāyunā tadvadeva sa vyomnā ca samāvṛtaḥ|| 12.43 || sarvaṃ daśottaraṃ vidyāttadvyoma mahatāvṛtam| mahāṃśca sa pradhānena pradhānaṃ tamasāvṛtam|| 12.44 || tadanantamaparyantaṃ na saṅkhyā tatra vidyate| hetubhūtama śeṣasya tamasaḥ prakṛtiḥ parā|| 12.45 || aṇḍānāmīdṛśāṃ brahman sahasrāṇyayutāni ca| bahunāpi kimu ktena saṅkhyā vaktuṃ na śakyate|| 12.46 || aṇḍāni tāni sarvaṇi vyāpya nārāyaṇaḥ sthitaḥ| antaśca teṣāṃ bhagavān sarvavyāpī paraḥ pumān|| 12.47 || bahiśca sākṣivatsarva mīkṣamāṇo'vatiṣṭhate| mahatastamaso bhāhye lokā ssubahuyojanāḥ|| 12.48 || catvāraḥ kramaśassanti caturbhissamadhiṣṭhitāḥ| vyūhaiḥ krameṇa vakṣye tānaniruddhaḥ paraḥ smṛtaḥ|| 12.49 || pradyumno'na ntaraṃ teṣāṃ saṅkarṣaṇa samāhvayaḥ| vāsudevastataḥ paścādvyūhākhyaḥ kamalāsana|| 12.50 || vibhavākhyo vāsudevastadanantaramīritaḥ| anādirvāsudevaśca tayorlokā vanukramāt|| 12.51 || tato nārāyaṇasyāpi lokastannikaṭe sthitaḥ| ekaikasyāntaraṃ koṭiryohanānāmudīritā|| 12.52 || tāvāneva ca vistārasaiṣāmati manoharaḥ| tebhyo bahisthsito loko yatrāste bhagavānajaḥ|| 12.53 || anādirvāsudeśākhyaśśobhite maṇimaṇṭape| śeṣabhogāsane divye śrībhūbhyāṃ samamāsthitaḥ|| 12.54 || vyāptyādibhistathāṣṭābhiśśaktibhiḥ parivāritaḥ| vālavyajanahastābhi styevyamānābhirantike|| 12.55 || seneśādyaiḥ pāriṣadaiśca krādyairāyudhairapi| praṇamadbhissevyamānassāmīpyādipadasthitaiḥ|| 12.56 || muktaiśca pañcakālajñaistiddhaiḥ kiṅkaratāṃ gataiḥ| upāsyamānassatataṃ dvādaśākṣaracintakaiḥ|| 12.57 || aṣṭāṅgayogasaṃsiddhairbahubhirbhagavanmayaiḥ| pañcarātrārdhatatvajñairnityatṛptaistamīpagaiḥ|| 12.58 || yathārhaṃ bhagavaccheṣakarmaniṣṭhermahātmabhiḥ| digeṣā kathitā brahman dhanyānāṃ tatra tiṣṭhatām|| 12.59 || antargatānāṃ lokānā maṇḍeṣu bahirapyatha| vistāraḥ kathyate naiva durgrahatvādbhavādṛśaiḥ|| 12.60 || sāramātraṃ samuddhṛtya sarpatassamudāhṛtam| brahmāḥ jñānaṃ bhagavataḥ kiñcidajñānaṃ ye na havyate|| 12.61 || naṣṭamajñāna timiraṃ jñānaṃ taddharśitaṃ mahat| sarve ca saṃśayā naṣṭhāḥ prasādā dbhagavanmama|| 12.62 || padmaḥ iti guhyatamaṃ jñānaṃ bhagavān brahmaṇe dadau| brahmāpi tadyathātatvaṃ kapilāyāvatārayat|| 12.63 || kapilopi maharṣistat jñānaṃ mama yadhātatham| dadau tubhyaṃ tadatyenaṃ pāraṃparyakramāgatam|| 12.64 || siddhāntajñānamutkṛṣṭaṃ tvayyanugrahakāmyayā| bhagavanmayamākhyātaṃ rahasyataramadbhutam|| 12.65 || bhagavanmayamākhyātaṃ rahasyataramadbhutam| naitadguhyataraṃ jñānamākhyeyamatimānine| nābhaktāya na hīnāya na cāśuśrūṣave punaḥ|| 12.66 || nādīkṣitāya dātavyaṃ na kṛtaghnāya pāpine| sa nāstikāya cākhyeyaṃ na ca pāṣaṇḍine tathā|| 12.67 || na hīnavarṇine naiva piśunāya durātmane| naiva cānupa nītāya na bāhyā gamasaṅgine|| 12.68 || na cāpyasūyave cāpi tyaktācārāya parhicit| vaktavyaṃ ca vinītāya śuddhāya brahmacāriṇe|| 12.69 || śuśrūṣave prasannāya vratine vaśine tathā| āśramasthāya saṃsāravimukhāya mumukṣave|| 12.70 || jijñāsamānāya tathā pāñcarātro ditāṃ kriyām| suśīlāya kṛtajñāya ṛjave ṛjubuddhaye|| 12.71 || chandāṃsyadhītine sāṅgaṃ kulīnāya tapasvine| traivarṇikāya saṃvarta maharṣe saṃhitāmimām|| 12.72 || nādhyāpayennopatiśennavidyāmaraye vadet| uktānuvāda pūr…
<4.1>
brahmā karṣaṇādi pratiṣṭhāntaṃ karma yasya prasiddhaye | taṃ samārādhanavidhiṃ śrotumicchāmi sāmpratam || 1.1 || ārādhanavidhiḥ kīdṛgadhikārī ca kīdṛśaḥ | bhagavaṃstadaśeṣeṇa brūhi me bhaktavatsala || 1.2 || śrībhagavān śrūyatāmabhidhāsvāmi pṛṣṭaṃ niravaśeṣataḥ | caturṇāṃ brāhmaṇādīnāṃ varṇānāṃ kamalāsana || 1.3 || adhikāro'nulomānāmapi nānyasya kasya cit | pūjāvidhau bhagavataḥ parasya paramātmanaḥ || 1.4 || pratilomabhuvāṃ sūtaḥ prathamastatra śasyate | ādyamekāyanaṃ vedaṃ sadbrahma pratipādakam || 1.5 || tenaiva saṃskṛtā viprā mukhya kalpādhikāriṇaḥ | anyeṣāṃ brahmāṇādīnāṃ varṇānāṃ dīkṣayā kramāt || 1.6 || trayāṇāṃ kṣatriyādīnā manulomabhuvāmapi | sūtasya ca viśeṣeṇa dīkṣā cātmaparā'niśam || 1.7 || parārthayajanaṃ kuryurvaprā mukhyānukalpayoḥ | naivādhikāriṇasteca dīkṣā saṃskāravarjitāḥ || 1.8 || yathaiva dīkṣaṇīyeṣṭyā jāyante brāhmaṇādayaḥ | tathaiva dīkṣāvidhinā jāyāmānā yathoditāḥ || 1.9 || pūjāvidau bhagavataḥ prakalpante'dhikāriṇaḥ | brahmo bhagavan brāhmaṇādīnāṃ janma karma ca bhāvukam || 1.10 || vihitaṃ ca vivāhaṃ ca yacca yāvacca yādṛśyam | mahyaṃ jijñāsamānāya bhaktāya parameśvara || 1.11 || tadaśeṣaṃ yathātatvamupadeṣṭuṃ tvamarhasi | śrībhagavān satvaṃ kajastamaśceti streguṇyaṃ kamalāsana || 1.12 || tanmayīṃ tanumāsthāya sasarjāhaṃ purā prajāḥ | satve'dhike mukhe viprānasṛjaṃ vithunātmakān || 1.13 || rajoguṇe'tiśayite bāhubhyāṃ kṣatriyāṃ stathā | ūrubhyāṃ guṇasāmyetu asṛjaṃ mithunaṃ viśām || 1.14 || ādhikye tamasaḥ pardbhyāṃ śūtrān mithunarūpiṇaḥ | eteca varṇāśśreyāṃsaḥ pūrvepūrve yathoditāḥ || 1.15 || hetubhyāṃ janmakarmabhyāṃ śtreṣṭhyameṣu prakalpate | trayasteṣu dvijāḥ pūrve mauñjabandhanakarmaṇā || 1.16 || catvāraścāśramā brahhan sarvaeva dvijanmanām | upanīya guroḥ pārśve vratānuṣṭhāna pūrvakam || 1.17 || vedādhyayanamādauyatsa śreyān prathamāśramaḥ | bhāryāsaṅgrahaṇaṃ snātvā prajāyai tadana ntaram || 1.18 || tayā ca dharmacaraṇaṃ dvītīyaścāśramasmṛtaḥ | gatvā sabhāryovipinaṃ yathoktenaiva vartmanā || 1.19 || vane vanya phalahāro vihitendriya nigrahaḥ | vasettṛtīyo vijñeyaścāśramaḥ kamalāsana || 1.20 || putre dārānvinikṣipya śikhī muṇḍī trivaṇḍavān | yadvaikadaṇḍaniyato brahmadhyānaparāyaṇaḥ || 1.21 || nivṛttasarvakāmastu vasetturyāśrame dvijaḥ | kṣatriyasyāśramāḥ pūrve sannyāsāśramavarjitāḥ || 1.22 || vihitā viśa ekasya dvāvanyainatu paścimau | eka eva caturthasya dārasaṅgrahaṇātmakaḥ || 1.23 || ṣaṣkarmā brāhmaṇo jñeyaḥ karmaṇādhyāpanādinā | adhyāpanaṃ cādhyayanaṃ yajanaṃ yājanaṃ tathā || 1.24 || dānaṃ pratigrahaśceti ṣaṭkarmāṇyagrajanmanaḥ | dānamadhyayanaṃ yajñovṛttistrayyeva bhūbhujām || 1.25 || viśāṃ ca saiva śūdrasya śuśrūṣaikaiva vartanā | āstikyamārjavaṃ śaucaṃ tapaśśāntirdamaḥ kṣamā || 1.26 || jñānaṃ vijñānamityete viprasya sahajā guṇāḥ | śauryaṃ tejo dhṛtirdākṣyaṃ yuddhe cāpyapalāyanam || 1.27 || dānamiśvarabhāvaśca kṣātraṃ karma svabhāvajam | karṣaṇaṃ caiva vāṇijyaṃ gavāṃ rakṣaṇameva ca || 1.28 || svābhāvikaṃ viśāṃ karma śuśrūṣā pādajanmanaḥ | śudrā śūdrasya bhāryaikāsā ca svāca viśasmsṛtā || 1.29 || teca svā ca kṣitīśasya tāśca svā cāgrajanmanaḥ | svāsu prajāssajātīyā ścāturṣarṇyamitīritam || 1.30 || apare jārajātī ca kuṇḍagolakasaṃjñite | jārai rutpāditā varṇāssavarṇāsveva bhīruṣu || 1.31 || sabhartṛkāsu kuṇḍosau golako vidhavāsutaḥ | tayorviprajayorneṣṭaṃ trayamadhyāpanādikam || 1.32 || savarṇaḥ kṣatriyāyāṃ tu vipreṇoḍhaścikitsakaḥ | āyurvedamadhīyūta mantravacchopanīya saḥ || 1.33 || tatra cauryeṇa sambhūto jyotirvedābhijīvikaḥ | jyotirvidyāṃ samabhyasye dupanīya samantrakam || 1.34 || brāhmaṇādhyūḍha vaiśyāyāmambaṣṭhaśśalyakṛntakaḥ | cauryātkulālaḥ kumbhūdi nirmāṇaṃ tasya jīvikā || 1.35 || mṛṇmayū pratimā cāpi kāryā śostrektavartmanā | nābherūrdhvaṃ tu vapavanaṃ pṛttirasya vidhīyate || 1.36 || brāhmaṇādhyūḍhaśūdrāyāṃ jātaḥpāraśavasmsṛtaḥ | arcanaṃ saptamātrūṇaāṃ pādyapādanameva ca || 1.37 || tasya vṛttirniṣādastu cauryātsyānmṛgaghautukaḥ | paṭṭabandhocitau cobhau nṛpajau guṇḍagolakau || 1.38 || kṣatriyādvinnavaiśyāyāṃ goṣṭhī paṇyopa jīvanaḥ | cauryeṇa jāto māhiṣyasturaṅgramavaṇigbhavet || 1.39 || śūdrāyāṃ kṣatriyādugro vinnāyāṃ karibandhakaḥ | cauryeṇa śūliko jñeyaśśūlāropaṇavṛttikaḥ || 1.40 || maṇikāraśśaṅkhakāro vaṇijau guṇḍagolakau | karaṇo vinnaśūdrāyāṃ vaiśyāddyūtādijīvanaḥ || 1.41 || yauryā tkaṭaṅkarastasya vṛttireva kaṭakriyā | mālavaścāśvapālaśca śūdrajāvaśvapau sadā || 1.42 || gavādipālako'mbaṣṭhyāmābhīro brāhmaṇādbhavet | viloko vadhakṛt kṣattā viprātpāra śavastriyām || 1.43 || māhiṣyeṇa karaṇyāṃ tu rathakāro rathādikṛt | śilpavitsarva śilpānāmācāryassa ca ucyate || 1.44 || prātyānāṃ brāhmaṇādīnāṃ trayāṇāṃ vṛttirucyate | māraṇaṃ maṇḍanaṃ kṣemaṃ samudrataraṇaṃ tathā || 1.45 || brāhmaṇyāṃ kṣatriyātsūto vivāhātsratilomajaḥ | sārathyaṃ vṛttiretasya dharmāṇāṃ caiva bodhanam || 1.46 || upavītopanayane prāpnotyeva samantrakam | cauryā ttatraiva sūto'nyassonyasaṃskāra kārakaḥ || 1.47 || tasyāṃ vaidehako vaiśyā dvivāhādvrastraśuddhikṛt | māgadhastadra cauryeṇa jaṅghākarika vṛttikaḥ || 1.48 || śūdrādbrāhmaṇa yeṣāyāṃ vivāhāccauryato'pivā | caṇḍālo jhullarīkākṣo malanirha raṇādikṛt || 1.49 || āyogavastantuvāyo vaiśyādūḍha nṛpastriyām | tatraiva cauryā dāraṇyapulindo mṛgaghātukaḥ || 1.50 || śūdrānnṛpāyāṃ vinnāyāṃ pulkano lākṣamadyakṛt | vaiśyena tatra cauryeṇa jṛmbhanṛttādivartanaḥ || 1.51 || vaiśyāyāṃ śūdravinnāyāṃ takṣā syāttakṣaṇādikṛt | so'yaṃ kāṃsya svarṇakṛtsyāt tvaṣṭā ca bhramijīvanaḥ || 1.52 || nailyakṛcca sa vijñeyo nīlavastrādi catrakṛt | evaṃ ca jātipālassyā ccauryāccakrītu tailikaḥ || 1.53 || śūdrātkaraṇyāṃ vai jātaḥ kūṭakṛcchana dāhakaḥ | brāhmaṇānnāpito'mpaṣṭhyāmadhoma panavṛttikaḥ || 1.54 || pratilomānulomābhyāṃ pratilomānulomataḥ | bahavassaṅkarā jātā yathābhīrādi jātayaḥ || 1.55 || prakṛtānupayogātte varṇyantena svarūpataḥ | iti śrīpāñcakātre mahopaniṣadi pādmasaṃhitāyāṃ caryāpāde jātinirṇayo nāma prathamo'dhyāyaḥ |
<4.2>
brahmā ye dīkṣāyāmadhikṛtā ye ca tatra bahiṣkṛtāḥ | te yathāvadaśeṣeṇa kathitāḥ puruṣottama || 2.1 || dīkṣā svarūpaviṣaye bubhutsā mama samprati | vijṛmbhate tatsvarūpamupadeṣṭuṃ tvamarhasi || 2.2 || śrībhagavān pratiṣṭhāvidhivatsarvaṃ dīkṣāmaṇḍapamāditaḥ | kārayitvā śucau deśe tadvadeva caturmukha || 2.3 || deśe ca paścime vedyāḥ guṇḍaṃ tālatrayādbahiḥ| kārayitvādvijendrādi varṇānāmanupūrvaśaḥ || 2.4 || anukūlaṃ catuṣkoṇaṃ tāladvayamitāntaram | vṛttaṃ gokarṇayugmena vistīrṇaṃ tadanantaram || 2.5 || cāpākāraṃ vitastibhyāṃ vistārāyāma sammitam || trikoṇamitaratkuṇḍaṃ prādeśadvayavistṛtam || 2.6 || āyāmassruksruvādīnāmīdṛśo brāhmaṇādiṣu | daśamyāṃ yāgasambhārāssambhūryānsamidhādayaḥ || 2.7 || ekādaśyāṃ tu sāyāhne tithau syādadhivāsanam | maṇḍape yajane sthāpyaṃ dvārakumbhādi pūrvavat || 2.8 || dhāraṇāśodhitatanuścakrābjaṃ vartayedguruḥ | kumbhaṃ ca hemādimayaṃ karakaṃ cāpi tādṛśam || 2.9 || gālitodakasampārṇaṃ nyastaratnasuvarṇakam | sūtraveṣṭitanarvāṅgraṃ prakcandana pariṣkṛtam || 2.10 || ahatābhyāṃ ca pāsobhyāṃ cchāditaṃ doṣavarjitam | astreṇa śatavāraṃ tu karakaṃ cābhimantrayet || 2.11 || acchinnadhārayā siñce dvedikāṃ parito guruḥ | prādakṣiṇyena karakaṃ nītvā kumbhaṃ ca pṛṣṭhataḥ || 2.12 || aiśāne cakrapadmasya bhāge dhānye niveśayet | dakṣiṇe kalaśaṃ vāme karakaṃ mūlavidyayā || 2.13 || kumbhe ca harimāvāhya pūjayecchāstravartmanā | yajeta devaṃ cakrābjamaṇḍale kamalāsana || 2.14 || sāṅgraṃ saparivāraṃ ca yathāvidhi yathākramam | mathitvā'ṣṭākṣareṇāgniṃ guṇḍe taṃ viniveśayet || 2.15 || tatra siddhaṃ caruṃ kṛtvā caturdhaikaṃ nivedayet | maṇḍalasthāya haraye kumbhe bhāgamathetaram || 2.16 || agnau caikaṃ svayaṃ caikamupa yuñjīta deśikaḥ || samidhaśśatamaṣṭā ca juhuyāddeśikottamaḥ || 2.17 || ājyahomo'pi tadvatsyānmūlamantreṇa mantravit | caruṃ nṛsūktena tathā pūrṇāhutyanta manyataḥ || 2.18 || śiṣyaṃ snātaṃ jitakrodhaṃ madādyervarjitaṃ śucim | ahatakṣaumavasanaṃ sottarīyamalajkṛtam || 2.19 || āhūya pāsasā badhvā gururnetre sva vidyayā | ātmano dakṣiṇepārśve niveśya prāṅmukhaṃ yathā || 2.20 || tena darbhaiścha saṃspṛṣṭaḥ puṇḍarīkākṣa vidyayā | dvādaśāhutimājyena juhuyāccaruṇā tathā || 2.21 || samitpuṣpatilaiścāpi tataḥ prasṛti mudrayā | trirmūrdhni śiṣyamālabhya prādakṣiṇyena deśikaḥ || 2.22 || aṣṭākṣareṇa mantreṇa tato bhasma samidbhavam | pāṇḍaraṃ mūrdhni śiṣyasya viniveśyordhva puṇḍrakam || 2.23 || astramantreṇa bhadhnīyā tsūtraṃ pratisaraṃ kare | pītvā śiṣyaḥ pañca gavyaṃ praṇavena caruṃ tataḥ || 2.24 || bhuñjīta kāyaśuddhyarthaṃ darnā kāṣṭhena dhāvayet | dantakāṣṭhaṃ ca bhūbhāge nipātyāgraṃ vilokayet || 2.25 || nairṛte mārute yāmye yadyagramaśubhaṃ bhavet | śubhamanyatra digbhāge kāṣṭhāgre pratite bhavet || 2.26 || aśubhaṃ śāntihomena śāmyecchu bhakaraścasaḥ | nārasiṃhena mantreṇa tilaikaṣṭottaraṃ śatam || 2.27 || homaḥ kāryastataśśiṣyamācāntaṃ depavannidau | kare gṛhītvā de veśaṃ praṇamya gururātmavān || 2.28 || vijñāpayedimāṃ gādhāmuccārya kamalāsana | saṃsārapāśabaddhānāṃ paśūnāṃ pāśamokṣaṇe || 2.29 || tvameva śaraṇaṃ deva gatikanyāna vidyate | vāśamokṣaṇaheturyastvatsamārādhanātmakaḥ || 2.30 || tenemān janmapāśena pāśitān paśujanmanaḥ | vipāśayādideveśa tadanujñātumarhasi || 2.31 || iti vijñāpya śiṣyaṃ taṃ māyāsū treṇaveṣṭayet | śuklaṃ kaktaṃ ca kṛṣṇaṃ ca trivarṇaṃ triguṇīkṛtam || 2.32 || sūtraṃ punaścatriguṇaṃ kṛtvā sūtreṇa tādṛśā | śikhāṃ prakramya pādāntaṃ pañcaviṃśati saṅkhyayā || 2.33 || veṣṭayenmūlamantreṇa kāyaṃ śiṣyasya sarvataḥ | juhuyāttena mantreṇa śiṣyaṃ saṃspṛśya deśikaḥ || 2.34 || sarpiṣāṣṭottaraśataṃ pārān pūrṇāhutiṃ tataḥ | svapnādhipatimantreṇa sarpiṣāṣṭottaraṃ śatam || 2.35 || svapnadarśanasiddhyarthaṃ juhuyāddeśikottamaḥ | māṣodanena bhūtebhyo baliṃ dadyātsamāhitaḥ || 2.36 || vimuktanetrabandhasya śiṣyasya tanubandhanam | māyāsūtraṃ samādāya śarāvenyasya nikṣipet || 2.37 || kumbhapārśveśarāveṇa pidhāyānyesa deśikaḥ | darbhānāstīrya tattalpe śiṣyasvāpanamācaret || 2.38 || maṇḍalasthaṃ ca kumbhasthaṃ devaṃ nūdvāsa yettadā | tataḥ prabhāte śiṣyasya śubhaṃ cetsvapna darśanam || 2.39 || dīkṣeta nūcedaśubhaṃ śāntihomaṃ samācaret | snātvā śiṣyeṇa sahitaḥ pravisedyāga maṇḍapam || 2.40 || dhvājatoraṇa kumbhādipūjā pūrvavadiṣyate | caturvidhaṃ nivedyānnaṃ samaskṛtya pradakṣiṇam || 2.41 || śiṣyaṃ tu pūrvavannetre badhvā nūtanavāsasā | niveśya vūrvavatpārśve juhuyātsamidhādibhiḥ || 2.42 || pratyekamaṣṭottara śataṃ mūlamantreṇa deśikaḥ | māyāsūtraṃ tataśchitvā saṃhārakrama māsthitaḥ || 2.43 || tatvānyādiśya juhuyātprakṛtyantāni deśikaḥ | pratyekamaṣṭottara śata maṣṭakṛtvo'thavāguruḥ || 2.44 || hṛtpadme paramaṃ jyoti rdhyātvā paramapūruṣam |
