tasmin jīvaṃ ca śiṣyasya saṃharenmantravittamaḥ || 2.45 || śoṣaṇādīni dehasya śiṣyasambhandhina stathā | kṛtvā tatra smaredaṇḍaṃ tatassva hṛdayāmbujāt || 2.46 || sajkramayya punarjīvaṃ prakṛtyādi kramātsṛjet | sargakāle ca juhuyāttatvāni krama mūsthitaḥ || 2.47 || sṛṣṭvā sthūlaśarīrānta maṇḍabhedaṃ vicintayet | tanmadhye puruṣaṃ dhyātvā jātamātmāna mātmanā || 2.48 || prokṣayenmūlamantreṇa netrabandhaṃ ca mocayet | śiṣyastu paridhāyānyadvāsaḥpādau prasādya ca || 2.49 || acamya pāsasā'nyena baddhanetro ntike guroḥ | asīta prāṅmakhastasmin śodhayecca ṣaḍadhvānā || 2.50 || kalādhvā ca padādhvā ca bhunanādhvātathaiva ca | mantrādhvā mantravarṇādhvāṣaḍadhvānaḥ prakīrtitāḥ || 2.51 || pūrnamājyāhutiṃ hutvā mahāvyāhṛtividyayā | hutaśeṣeṇa śiṣyasya pādauspṛṣṭvā tatastilaiḥ || 2.52 || hutvā nābhiṃ samālabhyatato hutvākuśeśayaiḥ | spṛṣṭvā ca hṛdayaṃ hutvā caruṇā mūrdhanispṛśet || 2.53 || aṣṭottara śataṃ homaḥ pratyekaṃ mūlavidyayā | homanteca guruśśiṣyaṃ gṛhītvā dakṣiṇe kare || 2.54 || nītvā pradakṣiṇaṃ kumbhaṃ maṇḍalaṃ ca yathoditam | dvāre tiṣṭhaṃścaturṇāṃ tu dvārāṇāṃ kamalāsana || 2.55 || maṇimuktāpravālairvā puṣpairvākevalterguruḥ | añjaliṃ pūrayedante tatastasya vikasvaraiḥ || 2.56 || puṣpādi viki rettasmin maṇḍale gurucoditaḥ | yasmin patati bhūbhāge puṣpāṇāmutkarassvayam || 2.57 || tadbhāgādhipamūrtīnāṃ nāmānyasya vinirdiśet | śiṣyasya keśavādīni padaṃ bhāgavateti ca || 2.58 || nāmnāmante prayoktavyaṃ yadvā bhaṭṭāraketi ca | brāhmaṇaccet kṣatriyasya deha naṃ nāmanirdiśet || 2.59 || vaiśyasya pālaśabdāntaṃ dāsāntaṃ pādajanmanaḥ | tato vimucya dṛgbandhaṃ darśayeccakramaṇḍalam || 2.60 || śiṣyeṇa sahito vedyāṃ dhyāyennā rāyaṇaṃ guruḥ | dhyātvāca dakṣiṇe karṇe śiṣyasya praṇavānvitam || 2.61 || mantraṃ dadyādṛṣicchandho daivataṃ cāṅgrameva ca | dvādaśākṣaramādau tu paścādaṣṭākṣarātmakam || 2.62 || mūrtimantrāṃśca tadanu samadhyāpya yathāvidhi | kevalaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ nāma namaḥ praṇavavarjitam || 2.63 || huṃ phaḍhādivaṣaṭ svāhāvarjitaṃ keśavādikam | adhyāpyaṃ strīṣu śūdreṣu tadvadevānulomaje || 2.64 || kumbhasthaṃ maṇḍalasthaṃ ca hariṃ śiṣyassamarcayet || 2.65 || ārādhya harimutthāya tasthuṣaḥ prañjale stathā | mūrdhni śiṣyasyasa guru rhastedhyātvābjamaṇḍalam || 2.66 || hastaṃ nyase dviṣṇuhaste tataśśiṣyasya deśikaḥ | ācārānni yamān sarvān bodhayedagni sannidhau || 2.67 || mantraḥ parasya nākhyeyo nākṣasūtraṃ pradarśayet | na ca mudrāṃ nāpi siddhiṃ mantrasya kathayet svayam || 2.68 || ācāryanāma navade nni yogānnāsya laṅghayet | śayanādīṃścana gurorākramenna ca laṅghayet || 2.69 || na guruṃ dūṣayedvācā nācarettasya vipriyam | guruvadgurudāreṣu vartitavyamasannidhau || 2.70 || ācāryamacyutaṃ śāttraṃ trayaṃ sammāna yetsadā | nāstikān bhinnamaryādān deva brahmaṇadūṣakān || 2.71 || naspṛśennaiva taissārdhaṃ saṃvaseddurdaśānvapi | prasārayennaiva pādau gurudevāgni sannidhau || 2.72 || veditavyaṃ jagatsarvaṃ vāsudevamayaṃ sadā | anarcayītvā deveśaṃ nātmapoṣaṇa mācaret || 2.73 || javastotrapraṇāmādīn sandhyākāle samācaret | bhagavaddhyānatatkarma kīrtaneṣu sadā kamet || 2.74 || vaiṣṇavaṃ ca yatiṃ caiva dṛṣṭvātaṃ praṇamet kṣitau | putradāragṛhakṣetra paśvādi dhanamātmanaḥ || 2.75 || vyapadeśyamaśeṣeṇa nāmnā bhagavato bhavet | samassarveṣu bhūteṣu kāmakrodhau viparjayet || 2.76 || śanaiśśanairindriyāṇi viṣayebhyo nivārayet | saṃsāravimukhaissārdhaṃ śāstrābhyāsaṃ samācaret || 2.77 || śrautasmārtādikarmāṇi sadi seveta netarat | svanūtroktena vidhinā niṣekādikriyā bhavet || 2.78 || kuryātsarvāṇi karmāṇi bhagavaddhyānatatparaḥ | guhyaṃ nāma ca gotraṃ ca prakṛtaṃ nānyadiṣyate || 2.79 || āsīno vā śayāno vā gacchan bhuñjāna eva vā | sajkīrtayet smaredvāpi vāsudevaṃ sanātanam || 2.80 ||
<4.3>
śrībhahavān śrūyatāmabhidhāsyāmi brahmannārādhanaṃ hareḥ | yena viṣṇoḥ padaṃ martyaḥ propnotyamaradurlabham || 3.1 || snānamūlāḥ kriyāssarvāḥ snānaṃ ca bahudhā śrutam | vāruṇaṃ divyamāgneyaṃ vāyavyaṃ pārthivaṃ tathā || 3.2 || māntraṃ mānasamityevaṃ snānaṃ saptavidhaṃ smṛtam | nirīkṣya cātmanaśśaktiṃ samayaṃ deśameva ca || 3.3 || etaṣvekataraṃ kuryātsamārādhanatatparaḥ | avagāhana mapsvantarvāruṇaṃ snānamiṣyate || 3.4 || sahātapena varṣeṇa snānaṃ divyamanantaram | samidhāṃ dīpitānāṃ ca gomayasya hutasya ca || 3.5 || sitena bhasmanā'ṅgeṣu lalāṭādiṣu cakramāt | yadūrdhvapuṇḍrakaraṇaṃ mantroccāraṇapūrvakam || 3.6 || tadāgneyaṃ bhavet snānaṃ śodhanaṃ paramaṃ smṛtam | gacchatsu goṣu pādotthairajobhirbhūmisambhavaiḥ || 3.7 || sparśanaṃ vapuṣassnanaṃ vāyavyaṃ tadudāhṛtam | praśaste varvatāgrādau jātayā svetamṛtsnayā || 3.8 || uccārya keśavādīnā nāmānyaṅge yathākramam | lalāṭādau yadvidhāna murdhvapuṇḍrasya tadbhavet || 3.9 || pārthivaṃ snānamabliṅgairmantrairviprakareritaiḥ | ambhobhiḥ prokṣaṇaṃ brahmaṃ stanmāstraṃ snānamiṣyate || 3.10 || trirācamyā'hataṃ vāsaḥ paridhāya sukhānasaḥ | prāṇāna yamya māṃ dhyāye ddhṛdayāmbhoruhe sthitam || 3.11 || dhyānenānena nirddhūtakalmaṣo jāyate pumān | snānaṃ mānasametatsyāt snataśca harimarcayet || 3.12 || ājānu pādau prakṣālya hastau cāmaṇi bandhanāt | ācamya ca dvārapārśvaṃ gatvāṅganyāsapūrvakam || 3.13 || tālatrayaṃ ca hastābhyāṃ kṛtvā'bhivalajaṃ sthitaḥ | kavāṭa mudghāṭya tato vāyamantreṇa mantrevit || 3.14 || sāmnā devavratenāntaḥ praviśeddakṣiṇāṅghriṇā | praṇamecchirasā devaṃ puṇḍarīkākṣa vidyayā || 3.15 || āropiteṣu dīpeṣu mālye cāpi nirāsite | vedyāṃ pātreṣu bimbeṣu śodhiteṣu yathātatham || 3.16 || dvārapūjāmukhe sarvaparivārasamarcane | kṛte śiṣyeṇa vā'nyena paricārapareṇa vā || 3.17 || pūjako'laṅkṛtassragvīśuklāmbaradhaṃ śśuciḥ | śuklopavītottarīyaśca ndanādya nulepanaḥ || 3.18 || candanaśvetamṛtsnāmbu talpitā grordhvapuṇḍrakaḥ | ārabhya nāsikāmūlaṃ lalāṭāntaṃ likhetkramāt || 3.19 || devapārśvāṃ samāsādya pārśve savyetare svayam | āsīno viṣṭage śuddhe ṝsyādau svasti kāsane || 3.20 || badhvā padmāsanaṃ vāpi dūryāghoṣe pravartite | tiraskariṇyāca dvāre niśchidraṃ cchādite tataḥ || 3.21 || astramantreṇa kakubho badhvā dhūmadhvajaṃ bahiḥ | prākāravat sthitaṃ dhyāyettejo mantreṇa mantravit || 3.22 || cakramudrāṃ ca khe nyasya cakramantreṇa sādhakaḥ | gopayannitthamātmānaṃ prāṇāyāmaistribhiḥ kramāt || 3.23 || yuktaḥ kṛtvā yogamudrāṃ nābhikanṭe sthitaṃ punaḥ | vedyākāraṃ vāyubījaṃ dhyātvā tajjena vāyunā || 3.24 || dhūmreṇa dehapāpmānaṃ śoṣayitvā niranvayam | trikoṇamagnibhījaṃ ca raktavarṇaṃ hṛdambuje || 3.25 || dhyātvā tadutthasaptārciśśikhābhiḥ kalmaṣaṃ dahet | māhendra bījaṃ vinyasya pītābhaṃ caturaśrakam || 3.26 || kaṇṭhe sahasparśanena stambhayedagnimutthitam | vāyunā kumbhakenaiva vṛttaṃ sphaṭikasannibham || 3.27 || vinyasya vāruṇaṃ bījaṃ mūrdhni tajjāmṛtāmbhasā | kṣālayetsarvato dehamāpādatalamastakam || 3.28 || pṛthivyādīni tatvāni samādhiparayā dhiyā | paramātmani saṃhṛtya pralayakramamāsthitaḥ || 3.29 || pṛthivīṃ pañcaguṇakāṃ pītābhāṃ caturaśrakām | ghrāṇopasthendriyayutāṃ tanmātrālakṣaṇe tataḥ || 3.30 || gandhe saṃhṛtya yogena gaganena vicakṣaṇaḥ | kasanā pāyvīndriyābhyāṃ sahāpaśca caturguṇāḥ || 3.31 || ardhacandrākṛti ścaitā stanmātrālakṣaṇe kase | gandhaṃ ca tanmātrātmānaṃ tatogniṃtryaśrapāṭalam || 3.32 || triguṇaṃ dṛṣṭicaraṇastrotobhyāṃ susamāhitaḥ | tanmātrālakṣaṇe rūpe rasaṃ tanmātrayā saha || 3.33 || saṃhareddviguṇaṃ vāyuṃ sparśetanmātralakṣaṇe | dhūmraṃ vṛttaṃ tatkarābhyāṃ rūpaṃ tanmātrayā saha || 3.34 || vāyunā saṃharedyogī khaṃ ca śabdaguṇaṃ punaḥ | tanmātrālakṣaṇe śabhde nīlotpala dalaprabham || 3.35 || sparśaṃ ca tanmātrātmānaṃ śrutipāksahitaṃ tataḥ | saṃhṛtya śabdatanmātrāṃ svānte svāntamahaṅkṛtau || 3.36 || ahaṅkṛtiṃ buddhitatve buddhiṃ ca prakṛtau punaḥ | jīve ca prakṛtiṃ jīvaṃ vāsanāvivaśaṃ tataḥ || 3.37 || susūkṣmaṃ nābhicakre sve bhāskarābhamavasthitam | nuṣumnayā nāḍikayā padmasūtrasusūkṣmayā || 3.38 || uparyārohayeddehe kumbhakena sabhasvatā | bhitvā ca brahmaṇo randhraṃ bahirdehādvinirgatam || 3.39 || praviśya bhāskarasyāpi maṇḍalānnirgataṃ bahiḥ | aśarīraṃ tathā jīvaṃ parasmin brahmaṇi druve || 3.40 || sthitaṃ dhyāyet sthitaṃ tatra svadehaṃ yonijaṃ dahet | nyastena śikhibhījena pādāgrejvalanaṃ dviṣā || 3.41 || pādādimūrdhaparyantaṃ dagdhe dehe nije tataḥ | nivṛttibījaṃ khe dhyāye tpūrṇa candrāyuto pamam || 3.42 || tadutthapīyūṣanidhau jā te pāṇḍara paṅkaje | smarejjīvaṃ samutpannaṃ sakāśādbhrahmaṇa stadā || 3.43 || jīvātpradhānaṃ tasmācca buddhiṃ buddherahaṅkṛtim | tato manastataśśabdaṃ tanmātrāṃ khaṃ tatassaha || 3.44 || pākchrutibhyāṃ śabdhaguṇaṃ tanmātrāṃ sparśalakṣaṇām | vāyuṃ sparśaguṇaṃ sārdhaṃ tvacā hastena casmaret || 3.45 || tanmātrāṃ sparśarūpāṃ tāṃ tatogniṃ saha cakṣuṣā | padbhyāṃ rūpaguṇaṃ rūpatanmātrāṃ ca rasaṃ tataḥ || 3.46 || apo rasaguṇāḥ pāyurasanābhyāṃ sahābjaja | gandhaṃ ca tanmātrātmānaṃ sahagandhaguṇāṃ bhuvam || 3.47 || samutpannaṃ smaredvidvān phrāṇopasthayutaṃ tathā | itthaṃ śarīramātmīyaṃ sṛṣṭaṃ mahyādibhūtajam || 3.48 || vicintya paṅkajaṃ budhyā prabuddhaṃ tadvinissṛtaiḥ | śātakumbhamayaiḥkumbhaiḥ pūrṇairamṛtavāribhiḥ || 3.49 || snāpitaṃ śuddhamanaghaṃ cintayitvā nijaṃ vapuḥ | ārādhane hare ryogyaṃ parasya paramātmanaḥ || 3.50 || dhyāyannaṣṭākṣaraṃ mantraṃ dvādaśākṣarameva vā | sṛṣṭisthitilayavyāsai rhastanyāsa purassaram || 3.51 || nyasyedaṅgraṣu mūrdhādi pādānteṣu yathā tatham | talaṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ cakarayo śśodhayutvāstra vidyayā || 3.52 || aṅgralīnāṃ ca sarvāsāṃ parvasvādyantavartiṣu | iṣyate praṇavanyāso madhyameṣu ca parvasu || 3.53 || mantrākṣarāṇi vinyasye nnyāsa eṣa sanātanaḥ | parvadakṣiṇa tarjanyāḥ prakramyāṅguliparvasu || 3.54 || dakṣiṇetaratarjanyāḥ parvāntaṃ sādhakottamaḥ | sṛṣṭinyāsamimaṃ kuryā dvyatyāsena tu saṃhṛtau || 3.55 || prakramya tarjanīparva kaniṣṭhāparva viśramaḥ | sthitāvaṣṭākṣarasyeṣa mantrasya nyāsa īritaḥ || 3.56 || dvādaśākṣara mantrasya nyāsassamprati kathyate | nyāsastavale madhyamayā tarjanyā'ṅguparvaṇi || 3.57 || kṛtvā pradakṣiṇaṃ parnasvaṅguṣṭhenetareṣu tu | savye tale tu viśrānti ssṛṣṭānaparadhā laye || 3.58 || talayoḥprakramasthāne dakṣiṇetarayordvamayoḥ | kaniṣṭhayośca viśrāntiḥ parvaṇo rubhayorapi || 3.59 || dvādaśākṣara mantrasya nyāso'yaṃ kamalāsana | hṛdayādīni cāṅgāni dhyātvā'ṅguṣṭhādi pañcasu || 3.60 || nyasyennakhamukhe netre tale savye gadā dharau | savyetare padmacakrenyasyesnyāsaḥ karadvaye || 3.61 || īritastalayormantraṃ dhyātvā tejobhiru jvalam | tābhyāṃ mūrddhādipādāntaṃ dehe nyasye tsamūhitaḥ || 3.62 || vyāpakaṃ kañcukaṃ yadvā mantramakṣaraśastataḥ | mūrdninetre mukhe citte nābhyāṃ guhye ca jānuni || 3.63 || caraṇau kramaśassṛṣṭau nyāso mantrasya iṣyate | viparītakramojñeya ssaṃhṛtau pālane punaḥ || 3.64 || nābhyādi pṛdayānteṣu nyāsoṅgeṣu prakīrtitaḥ | aṣṭākṣarasya mantrasya sthānānyetāni tāni ca || 3.65 || śirasaḥ paścimaṃ pūrvaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ cottaraṃ tataḥ | catvāri ca caturvaktrasthānāni dvādaśākṣare || 3.66 || mūrdhni madhyamayā'ṅgulyā tarjanyā saha cakṣuṣoḥ | nyasyenmukhe'nāmikayā sāṅguṣṭhena ca mantravit || 3.67 || aṅguṣṭha tarjanībhyāṃ tu hṛdaye nyasanaṃ bhavet | tathāṅguṣṭha kaniṣṭhābhyāṃ nābhau nyāsaḥ praśasyate || 3.68 || vināṅguṣṭhena śeṣābhirguhye jānuni cobhayoḥ | samastābhiścaraṇayo rityaṣṭākṣarabhūmayaḥ || 3.69 || prāgbhāge śirasoṅgulyā nyāso'ṅguṣṭhena dakṣiṇe | tarjanyā paścime bhāge nyāso'nāmika yottare || 3.70 || kaniṣṭhayātadhaitāssyurdvādaśākṣarabhūmayaḥ | rūpaṃ kramṇākṣarāṇāṃ nyāsakāle vicintayet || 3.71 || śuklaṃ hiraṇyayaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ raktaṃ kuṅkuma sannibham | padmakiñjalka sadṛśaṃ sarvavarṇa kamaṣṭakam || 3.72 || sitaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ ca dhūmrābhaṃ śyāmaṃ tārānibhaṃ tataḥ | sphaṭikābhaṃ ca śajkhābhaṃ kaktaṃ śuklaṃ ca lohitam || 3.73 || tamorūpaṃ pītavarṇaṃ dhvātvāmantradvayākṣaram | sthāne yathokte vinyasya ṣaḍaṅganyāsamācaret || 3.74 || hṛdayaṃ ca śiraśceva śikhā kavaca meva ca | netramastraṃ ṣaḍetāni hṛdaye mastake tathā || 3.75 || śikhāyāmānupūrvyeṇa skanthasyobhaya pārśvayoḥ | netrayordikṣu sarvāsu nyasanīyāni bhūmiṣu || 3.76 || rūpāṇi ṣaṇṇāṃ kumudaṃ bandhūka masitotpalam | abjakesara mambhoja matasī sūna sannibham || 3.77 || divyāyudhadharaṃ divyavastramālyānu tepanam | kaustubhaṃ vanamālāṃ ca śrīvatsaṃ divyalakṣaṇam || 3.78 || bibhrāṇaṃ bhāvayetsākṣādātmānaṃ parameśvaram | arcayennyāsabījāni gandapuṣpādibhiḥ kramāt || 3.79 || mānasairūpa cāraiśca hṛdayāmbhoruhe sdhitam | homāntamarca yetpūrvaṃ pāsudevaṃ sanātanam || 3.80 || ātma śuddhiriyaṃ proktā mantraśuddhistu kathyate | ṣadviṃśe nārṇabījena mantrabījāni śoṣayet || 3.81 || saptaviṃśena bījena dahedetāni varṇaśaḥ | aṣṭāviṃśena bījena khe ca stambha namācaret || 3.82 || ekonatriṃśabījena tānyeva kṣā layetpunaḥ | huṅkāreṇa prabuddhāni phaṭkāreṇa vicakṣaṇaḥ || 3.83 || kuryādabhimukhānya nvakpraṇavena viśodhayet | tamakṣamālayā śuddhaṃ japenmantraṃ samāhitaḥ || 3.84 || aṣṭottara śataṃ vārā naṣṭāviṃśati meva vā | aṣṭhau vāmantravinmantraṃ bījādyanta puṭhīkṛtam || 3.85 || pūjādravyāṇi sarvāṇi kṣālayeccāmbu pūritām | dakṣiṇe vāmapārśvevā viniveśya gala ntikām || 3.86 || arghyādi pātrāṇyādāya gāyatryā viṣṭhupūrvayā | prakṣālya pādeṣpādadhyāddevasyāgre'tha padmaja || 3.87 || pādyaṃ madhye dakṣiṇe'rghyaṃ pāme cācamanīyakam | tasya pārśvasya pārśvetu vāme snānīyapātrakam || 3.88 || pūrṇāni gālitāmbobhiḥ pātrāṇi nigamādinā | saṃspṛśyārghyādi pātreṣu dravyāṇi viniveśayet || 3.89 || kuśāgramakṣataṃ puṣpaṃ phalaṃ malayajaṃ tathā | tirlā siddhārthasahitān yavā na rghyasya bhājane || 3.90 || tilān dūrvāṃ viṣṇuparṇīṃ śyāmākaṃ padmamakṣatam | prādyapātre ṣaḍetāni dravyāṇi viniveśayet || 3.91 || elālavaṅgakarpūraṃ jātītakkola candanam | puṣpāṇyācamanīye tu pātre dravyāṇi kalpayet || 3.92 || sandhaṃ sarvaiṣadhī ratnaphalabīja kuśāni ca | tilāni cākṣataṃ caiva dadhikṣīraghṛtāni ca || 3.93 || rajanī dvādaśāṅgāni snānīye ca vinikṣipet | koṣṭhaṃ māṃsīhiridre dve murāśaileyacampakāḥ || 3.94 || vacākacoramustāśca sarvauṣadhyaḥ prakīrtitāḥ | tilāni tulasī caiva nikṣipecchānti vāriṇi || 3.95 || dvādaśāraṃ bhāsamānaṃ cakraṃ madhyetu bhāskaram | haste pāmetare dhyātvādīptaustadraśmibhiḥ punaḥ || 3.96 || dravyāṇi dagdhvāniśśeṣaṃ bhasmībhūtāni tāni ca | dakṣiṇetarahastasthesite padme vikasvare | 3.97 || dalaiṣṣoḍaśabhiryukte candraṃ pīyūṣakaśmibhiḥ | hlaudayantaṃ sthitaṃ dhyātvā tadutthairamṛtāmbubhiḥ || 3.98 || siktāni jātāni puna ryāgayogyāni bhāvayet | hastayorubhayordevaṃ dhyāyennā rāyaṇaṃ prabhum || 3.99 || tābhyāmarghyādipā treṣu spṛṣṭvā dravyāṇi viśvataḥ | sakṛtsakṛtsambhṛtāni gāyatryā viṣṇupūrvayā || 3.100 || abhimantrya tato mudrāṃ saurabheyīṃ pradarśayet | taddugdhena ca pātrāṇi pūritāni vicintayet || 3.101 || omarghyamityādi pūrvaṃ kalpayāmīti coccaran | spṛśetpātrāṇi hastena pātre'nyasminnana ntaram || 3.102 || arghyapātrājjalaṃ kiñcadgṛhītvā viniveśayet | dakṣiṇaetarahaste tat pātraṃ saṃsthāpya mantrayet || 3.103 || manraiṇa mūlabhūtena vārān saptatadambanā | paṭhaṃsaināstra mantreṇa dravyāṇyātmānameva ca || 3.104 || prokṣya kūrcena devasya yogapīṭhaṃ prakalpayet | abhinne sahaje pīṭhe pratimāyāścaturmukha || 3.105 || ādhāraṃ prathamaṃ rūrmaṃ kālāgniṃ tadanantaram | upariṣṭācca bhogīndraṃ paṇābhirbhūmimaṇḍalam || 3.106 || caturaśraṃ sahasreṇa bibhrāṇaṃ balavattaram | bhuvaścopari dharmādyāḥ kalpyā yogāsanāṅghrayaḥ || 3.107 || āgneyādiṣu catvāraścatasṛṣveva padmaja | adharmādyāśca tāvantaḥ prāgādyāsu yathākram || 3.108 || āśāsu tāvatīṣveva puruṣākṛtayasthsatāḥ | caturbhujāssiṃhavaktrāssitāḥ pūrva'ruṇāḥ pare || 3.109 || hastābhyāmapi mukhyābhyāṃ racitāñjali sampuṭāḥ | avarābhyāṃ ca bibhrāṇā hastābhyāṃ yogapīṭhikām || 3.110 || madhye sadā śivo deva stadvadeva pratiṣṭhitaḥ | athavā puruhūtādyā dikṣu prāgādiṣu kramāt || 3.111 || aṣṭāvaṣṭanu pīṭhasya pādarūpeṇa dhārakāḥ | īṣāścatasraḥ pūrvādyāḥ tasya veda catuṣṭayam || 3.112 || ahaṅkārāstrayaḥ pāśā guṇāssatvādayo guṇāḥ | tūlikā pañcabhūtātmā jīvātmāstaraṇaṃ tathā || 3.113 || agne ssomasya sūryasya maṇḍalānyu parikramāt | ambhojamupariṣṭācca valarkṣaṃdvādaśacchadam || 3.114 || smerakesarasampūrṇaṃ madhye vipulakarṇikam | bhadrāsanaṃ kalpayītvā yatho ktenaiva vartmānā || 3.115 || arcayedgandhapuṣpādyaiḥ pīṭhapārśvaitu dakṣiṇe | brahmāṇaṃ viṣṇu mīśānaṃ samārādhya tathottare || 3.116 || sanatkumāraṃ sanakaṃ sanandaṃ ca sabhājayet | pārśveca paścime durgāṃ vighneśaṃ nāradaṃ tathā || 3.117 || ātmanaśca gurūn dhyātvā prārabhetācyutārcanam | āvāhanapadaṃ pātraṃ prakṣālitamathāmbabhiḥ || 3.118 || pūramesmūlamantreṇa hastābhyāṃ ca samuddharet | lalāṭasamametasminnantarāvāhya keśavam || 3.119 || mūlabimbhā dyathādīpaṃ dīpādavikṛtaṃ tathā | yaturucchārayenmantramāgaccha padasaṃ yutam || 3.120 || tenatoyena karmārcāṃsiñketkūrcena mūrdhani | tatra sannihitaṃ devaṃ karmārcāyāṃ vicintayet || 3.121 || praṇamyakiñcadutthāya svāgato kairanantaram | darśayetpratimāmudrāṃ kalpayītvā ca sannidhim || 3.122 || yāgāvasānikīṃ tatra prārthayeta hareḥ sthitam | sammukhīkaraṇaṃ kuryātpuṇḍarīkākṣavidyayā || 3.123 || dadyācca mūlamantreṇa saparyāsanamāditaḥ | yathā dehe tathārcāyāṃ mantranyāsaṃ samācaret || 3.124 || hastanyāsaṃ vinā śaṅkhacakramudrāṃ pradarśayet | nāvāhayedekabere surasiddhāvatārite || 3.125 || ṛṣibhirmanujairvāpi sthāpite niścale harai | susthate'bhimukhībhāvasta devāvāhanaṃ hareḥ || 3.126 || yathāgnimāhitaṃ kuṇḍe yathā vā puruṣaṃ sthitam | kāle prabodhayedevamarcane bodhayeddharim || 3.127 || kalpanaṃ yogapīṭhasya mantranyasanameva ca | bimbe sthire sadā kāryaṃ pūjārambhe caturmukha || 3.128 || arghyavastrāmbarākalpa puṣpagandhānulepanaiḥ | pratyarcitaṃ sthitaṃ dhyāyetpādyacamanayoḥpunaḥ || 3.129 || āsīnaṃ snānakāle ca padmāsanasukhāsane | naivedyadhūpadīpādāpāsīnaṃ svastikāsane || 3.130 || upacāreṣu cānyatra tattatkarmānusārataḥ | sthitamāsīnamathavā devaṃ dhyāyeta pūjakaḥ || 3.131 || arcayāmīti sāmnātu kṣipetpuṣpāñjaliṃ hareḥ | vibho sakalalokeśa viṣṇo jiṣṇo prabho hare || 3.132 || tvāṃ bhaktyā pūjayāmyadya bhogai rarghyūdibhiḥ kramāt | divyenārghyopacāreṇa yathāśakti yathāvidhi || 3.133 || arcayiṣyāmi samaye bhagavantaṃ janārdanam | iti vijñāvya deveśaṃ yajedarghyādibhiḥkramāt || 3.134 || bhaktinamreṇa śirasā dadyādarghyaṃca mūrdhani | pādāravindayordadyātpādyaṃ pādyapratigrahe || 3.135 || dhyāyedācamanīyasya dānakāle jagardurum | ācāmantamivāmbhobhi ssākṣādambhaḥ pratigrahe || 3.136 || upacaryopacāreṇa madhuparkādinā harim | hastābhyāṃ śirasā padbhyāṃ manasā cadhiyā tathā || 3.137 || ahaṅkāreṇa cātmānaṃ nipātya dharaṇī tale | anena praṇipātena praṇipatya janārdanam || 3.138 || daso'haṃ te jagannāthasavutrādiparigrahaḥ | preṣyaṃ praśādhi kartavye māṃ niyuṅkṣvahite sadā || 3.139 || iti vijñāpya deveśaṃ parivārām prakalpayet | yogāsanābjapatreṣu pūrvādiṣu yathākramam || 3.140 || dvādaśa dvādaśasveva śaktīśśrīvatsapūrvikāḥ | śrīvatsaṃ vanamālāṃ camāyāṃ yogātmikāṃ tathā || 3.141 || vaiṣṇavīṃ vimalāṃ sṛṣṭiṃ śaktimutkarṣiṇīmapi | prajñāṃ satyāṃ tatheśānāmanukampāṃpitāmahīṃ || 3.142 || prathamāvaraṇe cāpi dakṣu prāgādiṣu kramāt | vyāptiṃ kāntiṃcatṛptiṃcaśraddhāṃ vidyāṃ jayāṃ kṣamām || 3.143 || śāntiṃca śaktīraṣṭaitāḥ kṛtvā cāmaradhāriṇīḥ | tato dvitīyāvaraṇe saṅkhadyāyudhadhāriṇaḥ || 3.144 || puruṣānaṣṭa pūrvādiṣvānu pūrvyeṇa kalpayet | tṛtīyāvaraṇe svāsu dikṣvindrādīn prakalpayet || 3.145 || bahirāvaraṇe tārkṣyaṃ bhagavatpramukhaṃ tathā | viṣvaksesaṃ tadhai śānyāṃ dvitīyāvaraṇādbahiḥ || 3.146 || parivārā nirīkṣeran sarve prāñjalayo harim | dadyācca pāduke snātumutthānasamaye hareḥ || 3.147 || idaṃviṣṇuriti dvābhyāṃ pādukārohaṇaṃ hareḥ | uddharecca hariṃ snātumuttiṣṭha brahmaṇasspate || 3.148 || itimantreṇa deveśaṃ prāpayet snānapīṭhikām | mantrastu bhadraṃkarṇebhiriti snānāsanāsane || 3.149 || sāvitryā vitaredarghyaṃ pādyaṃ trīṇipadeti ca | āpaḥ punantvityetena mantreṇācamanakriyā || 3.150 || dantadhāvana kāṣṭhaṃ ca tadviṣṇoriti nirvapet | abhyaṅgaṃ pāmadaivyena kuryādudvartanaṃ punaḥ || 3.151 || kāryaṃ viṣṇornukamiti mantreṇāmalakādikaṃ | pratadviṣṇuriti kṣālyamabhiṣeka vidhistataḥ || 3.152 || apāhiṣṭheti tisṛbhiratodevā avantviti | kaṅkatena mṛjetkeśān kalaśaissnapanaṃ tataḥ || 3.153 || hiraṇyavarṇāṃ hariṇīmiti lepo haridrayā | hiraṇyavarṇāṃ śśucayaḥpāvaketi catasṛbhiḥ || 3.154 || kṣālyo sandhāmbunā dehaḥ punastaṃ kuñkumenatu | ālipya viṣṇugāyatryā kṣālametpāvamānībhiḥ || 3.155 || brahmajijñānamiti ca kayānaścitra abhuvat | ityeva marghyapādyādyai ryajedādyaṃ maheśvaram || 3.156 || pariṣicya tu sāvitryā sūktena puruṣātmanā | sahasradhārayā snānaṃ yadvākumbhena tadbhavet || 3.157 || agnirmūrddhetimantreṇa plotenāṅgāmbu nirhṛtiḥ | viṣṇugāyatriyā dadyā dvastre dve dhautanirmale || 3.158 || praṇavena brahmasūtramuttarīyaṃ ca kalpayet | acāntamanvadhiṣṭhāya pāduke maṇḍanāsane || 3.159 || sukhāsīnāya devāya prāgvadarghyādi narvapet | dhūpenāguruje nārdrāmūrdhrānaṃ divaityṛcā || 3.160 || keśān saṃśoṣya śucinā candanena sugandhinā | idaṃ viṣṇuriti śrutyā lepanaṃ vapuṣismṛtam || 3.161 || jitaṃ ta itimantreṇa maṇḍanairapi maṇḍayet | puṣpāṇi dadyātta dviṣṇo ritimantreṇa mantravit || 3.162 || irāvatīti mantreṇa pādayorakṣatān kṣipet | añjanaṃ viṣṇugāyatryāvyāhṛtyādarvaṇekṣaṇam || 3.163 || jitaṃ ta iti dhūpaiśca dhūpayedagurūtthitaiḥ | uddhīpyasveti mantreṇa dīpāropaṇa miṣyate || 3.164 || tilān vastraṃ tathā hema tāmbulaṃ taṇḍulānapi | phalāni gavyamāghāraṃ gāścadhyānaṃ yathāvasu || 3.165 || gogrāsaṃ deśikāyaiva dadyāddevasya sannidhau | adhipasya tathā rājño rāṣṭrasya sakalasya ca || 3.166 || prajānāṃ brāhmaṇādīnāṃ dānamabhyudayāvaham | apanīte yavanikāpaṭe bhaktānukampayā || 3.167 || ghoṣayettūryaghoṣeṇa nṛttaṃ gītaṃ tathācaret | stotrāṇi ca kathāścitrā vedanāṅgāni ṣaṭe tathā || 3.168 || paṭheyuragre devasya sarvamanyacca maṅgalam | ācare tpāduke datvā gamayedbhojanāsanam || 3.169 || datvārghyaṃ pādyamācāmaṃ madhuparkaṃ nivedayet | praṇavena tato dadyā ttāmbūlīmāsya śodhanīm || 3.170 || ha virnavedayetsiddhaṃ bhojyabhakṣyādikaṃ tathā | madhurāti kasopetaṃ vidhyuktaṃ susamāhiteḥ || 3.171 || susaṃskṛtaiśca niṣpannairyaktamanyaiḥphalādibhiḥ | apaktairapatipakvaiśca yathā yogaṃ prakalpayet || 3.172 || rājopacāra vatsarvamupa cāre prakalpayet | prokṣitaṃ cāstramantreṇa pariṣicya ca marmaṇā || 3.173 || praṇavenārhaṇe datte dahanāplāvanādike | kṛte ca surabhīmudrāṃ darśayitvāca deśikaḥ || 3.174 || nyaste'rghyapuṣṭe saṃspṛṣṭe viṣṇuhaste samādhinā | anvārabdhena savyena pāṇinā dakṣiṇena tu || 3.175 || pragṛhī tārghyapuṣpeṇa darśitagrāsamudrayā | devasya tveti mantreṇa nai vedyaṃ tadyathodiśam || 3.176 || devasya dakṣiṇe haste nirvapetsādharassvayam | datte'nnapānake haste pānīye ca susaṃskṛte || 3.177 || kṛte cācamane dadyāttāmbhūlī māsyaśodhinīm | kriyākalāpaṃ pūjādai karmārcāyāṃ yadīritam || 3.178 || tatsarvaṃ dhruvaberādau yathāsambhavamācaret | arghyādiṣūpacāreṣu kartavyeṣu yathātatham || 3.179 || mantrapūrveṣu sarvaṣu vācamenāmudīrayet | divyenārghyopacāreṇa yathāśakti yathāvidhi || 3.180 || arcayicyāmi samaye bhagavantaṃ janārdanam | ityādikāmavitathāṃ pūjakassusamāhitaḥ || 3.181 || caturbhirevagandhādyaiḥ paripārārcanaṃ matam | sarvasminnupacāre ca stutyante'puṣṭhite punaḥ || 3.182 || japecca pūjako mantraṃ yathodīritasañkhyayā | dvādaśākṣaramanyaṃ vā tadante huhuyādbahiḥ || 3.183 || bhūtebhyo balidānaṃ ca kuryānnityaṃ mahotsavam | vijñāpya devadeveśaṃ pūjakaḥ praṇametsvayam || 3.184 || ādadītāvaśiṣṭāni pūjāvastūni kṛtsnaśaḥ | tairātmapūjanaṃ kuryāttuṣyettenāpi keśavaḥ || 3.185 || mantrairyathoktairārādhya sūktena puruṣeṇa vā | athavādvādaśārṇādyairmantrairbimbhamukhe harim || 3.186 || prapadyate paraṃ śreyā niṣkāmo yadi pūjakaḥ | kāmanāyāstu kāmyāni phalāni prati padyate || 3.187 || iti śrīpāñcarātre mahopaniṣadi pādmetantrecaryāpāde nityayāgavidhirnamā tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<4.4>
brahmā bhagavannutsavo nityo homaścāgnau puroditaḥ | sa kathaṃ pūjakaiḥkāryaḥ kathayasva yathātatham || 4.1 || śrībhagavān dvārasthānagnyagārasya caṇḍādīna rcayetkramāt | antaḥ praviśya śakṛdālipte kuṇḍe'kṣatārcite || 4.2 || upaviśyātmanaḥ pārśve dakṣiṇe puṣpabhājanam | anyāni homadravyāṇi vāmapārśvetu nikṣipet || 4.3 || kuṇḍasyottarapārśvetu prāgagreṣu kuśeṣu ca | ājyapātraṃ carusthālīṃ prokṣaṇiṃ samidhaḥkukān || 4.4 || praṇītāṃ taṇḍulān toyaṃ paridhīn sruksruvai tathā | darvīmagnerviharaṇaṃ vyajanāni ca mekṣaṇam || 4.5 || śuṣkaṃ ca kāṣṭhaṃ ghaṇṭāṃ ca gandhadravyaṃ ca sākṣatam | dvandvāni ca prayojyāni nyañci satyeva sambhave || 4.6 || kuṇḍamadhye tatastisrorekhāḥprāgāyatāḥ pṛthak | tathodagāyatāstisrolikhitvā mūlavidyayā || 4.7 || darbhastambadvayenādbhi rubhyukṣyādāya pāvakam | mathitaṃ laukikaṃ yadvā nidhāya ca vihṛtya ca || 4.8 || adbhiḥ parisamūhyāgniṃ paristīrya tribhistribhiḥ | prāgagrairudagagraiśca darbhaiḥ pañcabhireva vā || 4.9 || saptabhirnava bhirvāpi yadvaikādaśasammitaiḥ | granthīkṛtāgrairadvandvaiḥpañcaviṃśatiniṣṭhitaiḥ || 4.10 || tatrāgnimadhye'pāṃ pūrṇāṃ praṇītāmakṣatārcitām | nidhāya darbhayugmena kūrcaṃ prādeśasammitam || 4.11 || nirmāyācchādanaṃ tasya tribhirdarbaiḥ pavitritaiḥ | kū rcena tena prokṣaṇyāṃ praṇītājalamāvapet || 4.12 || prokṣaṇī mātmanaścāgre sarūrcāṃ nyasya mantravit | aṅguṣṭhānāmikābhyāṃtukūrcaṃtatkarayordvayoḥ || 4.13 || punarāghāramutpūya triḥprokṣya prokṣaṇīṃ punaḥ | homadravyāṇi sarvāṇi prokṣayettena vāriṇā || 4.14 || spṛśecca tāni dravyāṇi nāmādeśaṃ yathā tatham | sravāpayetprokṣaṇīvāri prādakṣiṇyena tāṃ punaḥ || 4.15 || kṛtvāmbhaḥ pūritāṃ devaṃ praṇītāyāṃ sabhājayet | agnerdakṣiṇato darbhakūrca tanmayaviṣṭare || 4.16 || āvāhya buddhyā brahmāṇamiṣṭhvā prakṣālya vāriṇā | viṣṇugāyatriyā sthālīmāḍhakaṃ tatra taṇḍulān || 4.17 || prakṣipya hṛdayādyaṅgaiḥ prakṣālyāgnāvadhiśrapet | ājyasthālyāṃ nirūpyājyaṃ drāvitaṃ gālitaṃ tathā || 4.18 || tatra pratyasya darbhāgradvayaṃ mantreṇa mantravit | aṅgāreṣu nidhāyāgnau tāṃ dīptenātha barhiṣā || 4.19 || paryagnikuryāduttārya yathāsthānaṃ niveśayet | utpūyotlpavanaṃ kūrcamadbhispṛṣṭvā hyuṣarbudhe || 4.20 || prahṛtya cāmṛtīkṛtya ghṛtaṃ surabhimudrayā | avakuṇṭhya ca dikpālā nindrādīn pūjayetkramāt || 4.21 || uṣṇodakena prakṣālya sruksruvai kuśapañcakam | kūrcamādāya tau tena mūle madhye ca mūrdhani || 4.22 || sammṛjya kūrcamūlena madhyenāgreṇa cakramāt | niṣṭapyāgnau nidhātavyai tāvudīcyā mathātmanaḥ || 4.23 || suvreṇājyaṃ samādāya homavastūni secayet | caruṃ cājyena saṃsicya pārśvetamavaropayet || 4.24 || kevalānnaṃ tathā maudgaṃ pāyasānnaṃ gulodanam | caturvidhaścarurjñeyaḥ pākaśculyāmapīṣyate || 4.25 || yādṛṅni vedyate bimbehotavyaścāpi tādṛśaḥ | udak saṃsthāḥ paridhayaḥ pratyagārambhaṇā stathā || 4.26 || nidhātavyāśśikhīśānakoṇayo ssamidhau tathā | ūrdhve nidhāya manasā dhyāyannidhmān prajāpatim || 4.27 || ekatogrān sakṛtsañcadaśoktān muṣṭimudrayā | ādadhyādājyapātraṃ ca kuśamārcena veṣṭite || 4.28 || vāme kare nidhāyāgnāvāghārāhutimācaret | prājāpatyaṃ tathācaindramājya bhāgamathācaret || 4.29 || āgneyaṃ dakṣiṇe bhāge saumyaṃ bhāgamathottare | madhyevyāhṛtibhirhutvāsmaredagni manantaram || 4.30 || dviśīrṣakaṃ saptahastaṃ tripādaṃ saptajihvakam | varadaṃ śaktipāṇiṃ ca bibhrāṇaṃ sruksruvai tathā || 4.31 || abhītidaṃ carmadharaṃ vāme cājyadharaṃ kare | jihvāyāṃ dakṣiṇe vaktredhūmrāyāṃ māraṇādikam || 4.32 || lohinyāṃ tu vaśīkāraḥ kālyāṃ karma ca śāntikam | sarvasiddhi ssphuliṅginyā mānane dakṣiṇetare || 4.33 || viśvarūparasajñāyā maṇimādi mahāphalam | karālikā vijayadā puṣṭidā ca manūjavā || 4.34 || kārṣṇyaṃ lauhityametāsāṃ varṇaśyāmatvameva ca | sphuliṅgarūpaṃ catato varṇassphaṭika sannibhaḥ || 4.35 || tapanīyanibhaḥ phrokto jihvānāmānu pūrvaśaḥ | tilānāghāra samidho juhuyā jjātaśāntaye || 4.36 || aṣṭottaraśataṃ vārān dvādaśākṣaravidyayā | pūrṇāhutyavasāne tu dhyātvā jvalasamarcayet || 4.37 || gandhādyairātmanū dadyādakṣatāni ca varmaṇā | pariṣiñcejjalenāgniṃ tanmadhye yogapīṭhikām || 4.38 || kalpayītvā ca tanmantrairjuhuyātsarpiṣā sakṛt | atrāvatārya hṛdayācci drūpaṃ parameśvaram || 4.39 || sakalīkṛtya mantrasya nyāsaṃ kuryādyathāvidhi | arghyapūrvaṃ nivedyānnaṃ narpiṣā juhuyātsakṛt || 4.40 || japārthaṃ ca sakṛnmantrairjuhuyātsarpiṣā tataḥ | samidbhirvā dalaiḥ puṣpairbījairvāpyatha vāphalaiḥ || 4.41 || parivārārthamapyevaṃ sarpiṣā juhuyātsakṛt | ārādhanaṃ hareretatsaptārciṣi caturmukha || 4.42 || ārādhanaṃ cedanyatra pratimādāvanantaram | juhuyātsamidādyaistrervakṣyamāṇena vartmanā || 4.43 || āyāmassamidhāṃ tālaṃ kaniṣṭhā nahanaṃ kramāt | carmahīne vināśassyādbhede kṣīṇaṃ kulaṃ bhavet || 4.44 || ārdrāsu bandhunāśassyātputranāśaḥ purātane | kṣatāsu bhāryāmaraṇaṃ kalahāya ca śākhinī || 4.45 || udvegāya bhavet sthūlā hrāsvā'vagrahakāriṇī | dīrghāti vṛṣṭi jananī tyājyā doṣayutā samit || 4.46 || śataṃ tadardhaṃ pādaṃ pā samidho'ṣṭau yathoditāḥ | tadardhaṃ vā ghṛtāktāstā juhuyānmūlavidyayā || 4.47 || ājyāvasiktāścatvāraḥ pratpṛcaṃ grāsamudrayā | nṛsūktena ca hotavyā mūlamantreṇa sarpiṣā || 4.48 || śatādisaṅkhyayā homo dhyātvā paramapuruṣam | sruveṇa juhuyādājyaṃ hasteva samidhaṃ punaḥ || 4.49 || caruṃ palāśapātreṇa yadvā hastādinā bhavet | hutvā purṇāhutiṃ pūrvaṃ tataśśāntiṃ prakalpayet || 4.50 || yajñavṛkṣodbhavaiśśānnissaubhāgyaṃ kusumaiśśubhaiḥ | dhūpadravyessadārogyaṃ puṣṭiṃ dadhnā payaśśuci || 4.51 || annena vividhān kāmānājyenāyuṣmatīḥ prajāḥ | śvetapadmaistu juhuyādicchan brahmaśriyaṃ naraḥ || 4.52 || lakṣmīpuṣpaistu juhuyā llakṣmīkāmo'tha vāruṇaiḥ | padmairbilva samidbhirvā jñānakāmastu sarpiṣā || 4.53 || kanyākāmaḥ kālapuṣṭai rgokāmo gomayaiḥ punaḥ | āyuṣkāmastu dūrvābhirbhūtikāmastu mṛtsnayā || 4.54 || yavāgvendriyakāmastu tilaissarvajanapriyaḥ | brahmavarcakāmastu brahmavṛkṣasamudbhavaiḥ || 4.55 || veṇubhiśca yavaiścaiva nīvāraiśśālibhi stathā | sarve kāmāḥprasiddhyanti hoturbhījairyathoditaiḥ || 4.56 || lājahomena sidhyanti sarve kāmā na saṃśayaḥ | antekannādikāmastu putrakāmastu pāyasaiḥ || 4.57 || nimbapuṣpai rhiraṇyārthī sarvaṃ sidhyati sarpiṣā | home sarparmadhukṣīradhārā syāccaturaṅgulā || 4.58 || śuktirdadhyāhutirgrāsaṃ pāyasājyāhutirbhavet | bhakṣyāhuti stadardhaṃ syātphalaiḥ puṣpairakhaṇḍitaiḥ || 4.59 || niṣpāvabījamānā tu dhūpadravyāhutirbhavet | tilavrīhi yavādyestu muṣṭyardhārdhāhutiḥ kramāt || 4.60 || aṣṭāṅgulā tadardhāvā samiddhūrvā ṣaḍaṅgulā | mṛdvīkā'kṣapramāṇā tu gomayāhutiriṣyate || 4.61 || pūrṇāhutirghṛtasya syātkuḍubena caturmukha | nyūnādhikapramāṇāṃ tu havyakavyāhutiṃ kṛtām || 4.62 || bhuñjanti dānavā daityā na phalāya ca kalpate | kukkuṭāṇḍa pramāṇaṃ tu caroḥ piṇḍaṃ ghṛtāplutam || 4.63 || nikṣipya casrucorgate abhighārya sruveṇa ca | sasamiddarbhakusumaṃ juhuyānmūla vidyayā || 4.64 || prāyaścittārthamājyenapaḍhañcopaniṣadā punaḥ | srucamājyena sampūrya sadarbhaṃ samidhānvitam || 4.65 || uddhṛtya nāsikāgrāntamabhighārya sruveṇa ca | jāhuyānmūlamantreṇa pūrṇāhutyātu sādhakaḥ || 4.66 || srucaṃ jalena sampūrya bahiḥ kuṇḍātpradakṣiṇam | secayedvā viśeṣaṃ tu ninayecchirasi svayam || 4.67 || bhasmanā tilakaṃ kṛtvā harimagne ssamutsṛjet | gṛhitvārghyaṃ pradadyācca dhāmni devāya pūjakaḥ || 4.68 || bhaktyā yadagnau vihitaṃ yathāśakti yathāvidhi | ārādhanaṃ tadevati gṛhāṇi varameśvara || 4.69 || agni kāryavidhirhyeṣa saṅkṣepātkathitomayā | vidhinānena yaḥkuryā dagnikāryaṃ dine dine || 4.70 || sayāti brahmaṇa sthsānaṃ bhuktvā bhogānyathessitān | iti śrīpāñcarātre mahopaniṣadi pādme tantre caryāpāde agni kāryavidhirnāma caturtho'dhyāyaḥ |
<4.5>
śrībhagavān atha nityotsavavidhiṃ kathayāmi caturmukha | sarvaduḥkhaharaṃ puṃsāṃ sarvabhūta praharṣaṇam || 5.1 || rāṣṭrasya rājño gramasya yajamānasya sadmanaḥ | sukhāvahaṃ śāntikaraṃ puṇyamāyurvivardhanam || 5.2 || āvāhya taṇḍule śuddhe pārśvasthe parameśvaram | śaktibhirdaśabhirdvābhyāṃ saha prātardine dine || 5.3 || parikramedāyatanaṃ madhyāhne tvanna kalpite | sāyaṃ kusumasaṅghāte trisandhyaṃ triṣu kalpayet || 5.4 || bimbena vā parīyāyāttri sandhya manuvāsaram | athavānnena madhyāhne kāle'nyata dvaye rcanā || 5.5 || trisandhya mathavānnena kuryānnityotsavaṃ hareḥ | madhyandine vā sarvārthaṃ parikramya baliṃ kṣipet || 5.6 || yadvotsavapratikṛte ranvagagre'thavā bhavet | trisandhyaṃ cāmaraṃ chatraṃ vi tānadhvaja saṃyutam || 5.7 || taṇḍulādikamannaṃ vā kevalaṃ kamalāsana | pañcāvaraṇake dhāmni pañcasvāvaraṇe ṣvapi || 5.8 || baliṃ datvā paryaṭanaṃ geyavādya purassaram | utsavaṃ prāhurutkṛṣṭamekonaṃ madhyamaṃ viduḥ || 5.9 || dvyūne'dhamaṃ jaghanyaṃ trinyūne kṣudramathetare | balipradānena vinā notsavo'bhyudayāvahaḥ || 5.10 || śuklāmbaradharaṃ saumyaṃ śuklayajñopavītinam | sottarīyaṃ ca soṣṇīṣaṃ svanuliptamalaṅkṛtam || 5.11 || paricārakamāhūya bhāvitaṃ garuḍhātmanā | tanmūrdhani ca pātrasthe taṇḍule'nne prasūnake || 5.12 || devamāvāhayenmūla berādārādhaka ssvayam | iṣṭvāca gandhapuṣpādyaistatra devaṃ yathāvidhi || 5.13 || viṣṇvādimūrtīścapunaḥ pūjayitvā pradakṣiṇam | prāgādyeṣu dvādaśanu pātrastheṣu daleṣu ca || 5.14 || sūktaṃ sarvaṃ svastyayanaṃ tathānyaccāpi maṅgalam | paṭhan pātraṃ cabibhrāṇo vrajecca paricārakaḥ || 5.15 || caṇḍapracaṇḍupramukhān dvārapālān prapūjayet | ghoṣayenmallatālādyairbalidāna purassaram || 5.16 || nṛttaṃ tu vaijayantī syādṛṣabhaṃ geyamiṣyate | vitāna dhavalacchatra cāmara vyajanādi bhiḥ || 5.17 || parikrameta balyarthaṃ sarvānāvaraṇān kramāt | pīṭhaṃ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya praviśedālayaṃ punaḥ || 5.18 || taṃtu pradakṣiṇīkṛtya praviśedgarbhamandiram | datvārghyāṃ mūlamantreṇa mūlabere samutsṛjet || 5.19 || baliśeṣaṃ kṣipetkiñci dviṣvaksenasya mūrdhani | pariśiṣṭaṃ mahāpīṭhe nikṣipedakṣatādikam || 5.20 || nityotsavaśce dāropya tadbimbaṃ śibikādiṣu | āropya yadvā śirasi paribhramaṇamiṣyate || 5.21 || ātodyanṛttairbahudhā bhidyamānte ssamadhitam | tatra nṛttaṃ bahuvidhaṃ tāni vakṣye samāsataḥ || 5.22 || vilāsaṃ kartarī viṣṇukrāntamālīḍhamaṅgalam | bhadramālī tārkṣyapakṣaukaraṇaṃ svastikāhvāyam || 5.23 || cārī pracārī sūcī ca sāvartaṃ pāribhadrakam | saumyaṃ viṣamasūcī ca kheṭakaṃ cāvakuñcitam || 5.24 || kaṭibandhamalaṅkāra maśmarī pṛṣṭhakuṭṭimam | ullaṅghivāmajānvākhya māsūrī cāpaveṣṭitam || 5.25 || vāsareśvarasañcārībhāvai syātāṃ nikuṭṭimau | kuṭṭimaṃ ghaṭitaṃ sthāyībhāvo yacca vijṛmbhitam || 5.26 || maṇḍalaṃ kuñcitārdhādi patākā sarvamaṅgalam | kāntārakuṭṭimāhvānaṃ prapūrvaṃ ghaṭitaṃ tathā || 5.27 || vilāsaṃ sarvato bhadraṃ śuddhaṃ kuñcita miṣyate | mārgacārī karādhīna māvabhāsa manantaram || 5.28 || āveṣṭitaṃ parīvartaṃ nirdhūtaṃ deśimaṇḍalam | samapūrvaṃca ghaṭitaṃ padaṃ viṣamapūrvakam || 5.29 || karkarīkavilāsaśca bhavedvigalitaṃ tathā | nṛttabhedāḥ pṛthagbhāvā gātrāvayava ceṣṭitaiḥ || 5.30 || ātodya gītibhedānā mānantyānneha tanyate | puṣpaprabhāsamopetaṃ dhvajacchatrādi saṃyutam || 5.31 || sarvavāditrasubhagaṃ sarvageya samedhitam | brahmavidbrahmaghoṣeṇa sahitaṃ dīpasaṅkulam || 5.32 || viṣṇukrāntaṃ khageśasya nṛttaṃ geyaṃ ca madhyamam | vilāsaṃ sarvatobhadraṃ kheṭakaṃ cakramaṇḍalam || 5.33 || kāntāraṃ kuṭṭimaṃ pṛṣṭhakuṭṭimaṃ kaṭibandhanam | pāmajānūrdhvanṛttaṃ ca puruhotādiṣusmṛtam || 5.34 || ṣaḍjarṣabhauca gāndhāro madhyamaḥ pañcamastathā | dhyaivataśtceva niṣadhaḥ puruhūtādiṣu svaraḥ || 5.35 || saptajñeyā dhaivatastu bhavasya svara iṣyate | nṛttaṃ tu viṣvaktenasya svastikaṃ vṛṣabhassvaraḥ || 5.36 || hastinṛttaṃ gaṇeśasya svaraḥpañcama iṣyate | dhaivatassyātsvaro nṛttaṃ durgāyāssarva maṅgalam || 5.37 || anyeṣāmapi devānāṃ nṛttaṃ syātsarvamaṅgalam | gānaṃ ca dhaivataṃ proktaṃ gāndhāraṃ paṅcamaṃ tathā || 5.38 || tadavāntarabhedā vā geyā geyavicakṣaṇaiḥ | samatālāhvayaṃ pādyamaindryaṃ diśi havirbhujaḥ || 5.39 || baddhāvatālābhidhānaṃ yamasya diśi śṛṅgiṇī | nairṛtyāṃ mallatālaṃ syādvāruṇyāṃ maṅgalāhvayam || 5.40 || vāyavyāṃ jayatālākhyaṃ kauberyāṃ bhadrasaṃjñitam | aiśānyāṃ karkarītālaṃ | tārkṣyasya garuḍāhvayam || 5.41 || bhūtānāṃ balitālākhyam | seneśasyāpi tādṛśam | anyeṣāmapi devanāṃ tālaṃ bhadraṃ praśasyate || 5.42 || dikṣu sarvāsu sarveṣu mandirāvaraṇeṣu ca | nṛttaṃ geyaṃ ca vādyaṃ ca sākalyena samīritam || 5.43 || khagadhvajaṃ darśayītvā maṅgalāṣṭakameva ca | sannidhāne ca devasya sarvatra baliriṣyate || 5.44 || nivedyaṃ tatra tāmbūlaṃ bhakṣyaṃ ca pṛthukādikam | narveṣvā varaṇeṣvevaṃ sthānaṃ prati samācaret || 5.45 || kevalāmbujanādena prākāradvāranirgamaḥ | nirgamya ca mahāpīṭhe mandirābhimukhaṃ sthitaḥ || 5.46 || dīkṣu sarvāsu pīṭhasya pāditre ghoṣi te bhṛśam | kṣālite pīṭhikāmūrdni pūjayedviṣṇu pārṣadān || 5.47 || baliṃ niravaśeṣeṇa datvā pīṭhasya mūrdani | pīṭhaṃ parītya dhāmāntaḥ praviśya mukhamaṇḍape || 5.48 || pradāya pāduke pīṭhe yānāderavaropyaca | praṅmakhaṃ viṣṭare devamavasthāpya sabhājayet || 5.49 || upahāra maśeṣeṇa pradāyāvasarocitam | praveśayedgarbhagehaṃ devamārādhaka ssvayam || 5.50 || vādye geye tathā nṛtte bahiraṅgaṇa bhūmiṣu | nyūnībhāvaṃ samādhātuṃ śuddhe tāṇḍavamācaret || 5.51 || mahāvātādi saṃkṣobhena nityotsavamācāret | balipradānamātraṃ tu kuryācca sati sambhave || 5.52 || nabiṃ caṇḍe pracaṇḍe tu kevalaṃ vā vinikṣipet | tayormadhyetu purato mūlamantreṇa sādhakaḥ || 5.53 || bhūtebhyo nama ityevaṃ pakṣipetsodakaṃ balim | ārādhana vidhirhyeṣu kālabhedeṣu śasyate || 5.54 || ahni kātrau ca tān brahmannadhunā kathayāmi te | ekastrayo vā ṣaḍvāpi kāli dvādaśa evavā || 5.55 || pañca kālaścatuṣkāla statkālo bahudhā mataḥ | yathāvibhavamuddiṣṭaṃ samārādhana karmaṇi || 5.56 || eko madhyāhnasamayaḥ prātarmadhyandinaṃ niśā | trayaścet ṣaṭsupūrvektāḥ kālabhedāḥ punastrayaḥ || 5.57 || madhyarātro'pa rāhṇaśca tathā pratyūṣa īritaḥ | pratyūṣa ścārdharātraṃ ca prātarmadhyandinaṃ niśā || 5.58 || pañcakālā ime proktānsataḥkālacatuṣṭayaṃ | ekena hīnaḥ pratyūṣo vijñeyaśchaturāsana || 5.59 || kālā dvādaśa vijñeyāḥ pañca pañca ca nāḍikāḥ | itare kālabhedāstu pratyekaṃ yāma sammitāḥ || 5.60 || utsavāvasitaṃ śreṣṭhamārādhana mudāhṛtam | homāntaṃ madhyamaṃ proktaṃ prāpaṇānta mathādhamam || 5.61 || kṣudraṃ tu dhūpadīpānta madhamāradhanaṃ bhavet | ghaṭike dve bhavat snāne ghaṭikai kārcane bhavet || 5.62 || nṛttageye tathā caikā tadhardhena nivedanam | home caikā cotsave dve śuddhanṛttāvasānike || 5.63 || prabhātakāla pūjāyāṃ snānādi vidhirīdṛśaḥ | ghaṭikā snānasamayastathārdha ghaṭikārcanam || 5.64 || geyanṛttasya ghaṭikā tadardhena nivedanam | homārdhe pariśiṣṭastu bhavennityotsavekṣaṇaḥ || 5.65 || kālabhedeṣu sarveṣu śreṣṭhaṃ kālatrayaṃ viduḥ | prātarmadhyandinaṃ rātri rmukhyaṃ ca kamalāsana || 5.66 || āvaśyaṃ bhāvinau teṣu balinityotsavāpubhau | homaparyantamanyatra kārabhedeṣu śasyate || 5.67 || utsavādyaṅgalimbāni senānyaṃ vihageśvaram | caṇḍapracaṇḍai dvārasthausarvakāleṣu pūjayet || 5.68 || madhyandine pradeṣe ca purastādvādya vādanam | nīrājayetpradoṣeṣu devaṃ tadapi kathyate || 5.69 || svarṇapātrāṇi yugmāni vipulāni tathāvasu | tanmadhye sālipṛṣṭheṣu partidīpān tapradīpayet || 5.70 || tathāvidhāni pātrāṇi karairuddhṛtya yoṣitaḥ | kalyāṇavastrābharaṇā nirgatāśca mahānasāt || 5.71 || śreṇībandhāḥ purogīta nṛtta vādyasamanvitāḥ | antike devadevasya vinyaseyu rmahītale || 5.72 || ādhāreṣu tataḥ pātrāṇyarcaye dviśvavidyayā | ācāryodhruvabherādai ṣaḍaṅganyāsamācaret || 5.73 || iṣṭhvā ca devamarghyādyerdīpapātrāṇi pūjakaḥ | uddhṛtya bhrāmayeddeva māpādatalamastakam || 5.74 || guṇantraistribhiḥ pātrāṇyanuyoṣitsu nikṣipet | arcānāme…
<4.6>
brahmā sūktasyāṅgeṣu bhagavan pauruṣasya kathaṃ bhavet | nyāsaḥ kathaṃ vā tena tvāmarcayāmi yathā mama || 6.1 || pṛcchata ssaṃśayānasya gṛhārcana vidhikramaḥ | yāthātathyena vaktavyomayi cedastyanugrahaḥ || 6.2 || śrībhagavān chando'nuṣṭu bṛṣi stasya vāsudevassa devatā | mūrdhniphāle nayanayo rnāsikāyāṃ tathā mukhe || 6.3 || gale bhā hvośca hṛdaye nābhāvaṅge ca mehane | ūrvoścaraṇayornyānaḥ prathamādi ṛcāṃ kramāt || 6.4 || ādyayā'vāhayeddeva māsanaṃ ca dvitīyayā | pādyaṃ tṛtīyayā cārghyaṃ caturthyā vitaredṛcā || 6.5 || paṅcamyācamanaṃ snānaṃ ṣaṣṭhyā saptaṛcāmbaram | upavīta mṛcāṣṭamyā navamyāgandhelepanam || 6.6 || puṣpaṃ daśamyekādaśyā dvādaśyā dhūpadīpakau | nivedanaṃ trayodaśyā caturdaśyā namaskṛtiḥ || 6.7 || pradakṣiṇaṃ paṅcadaśyā ṣoḍaśyodvāsanaṃ hareḥ | samidhannājya homaśca pratyṛcaṃ jātavedasi || 6.8 || svagṛhe pūjayedviṣṇu śucau dese gṛhe kvacit | sthale ratnamayasthāne vimāne ca tathāvidhe || 6.9 || apsvagnau hṛdaye sūrye sthaṇḍile pratimāsu ca | puṣpodapātramādāya tiṣṭhannāvāhayeddharim || 6.10 || oṃbhūrādi vyāhṛtibhiḥ pratyekaṃ puruṣottamam | vyastābhiśca samastābhiḥ vedādyenāsanaṃ tataḥ || 6.11 || pātrasthamambhassāvitryā abhimantrya pavitrakam | tadaghyaṃ viṣṇugāyatryā dadyāttrīṇipadetyṛcā || 6.12 || pādyamācamanīyaṃ ca praṇavena prakalpayet | mantraissnapanamabliṅgairaṅgaṃ ca vimṛjettataḥ || 6.13 || vyāhṛtyāplotavastreṇa jitanta iti vidyayā | vāso vidyādinā dadyādupavītaṃ ca lepanam || 6.14 || idaṃ viṣṇuriti procyapraṇavena prasādhanam | tadviṣṇoriti puṣpāṇi jitanta iti dhūpakam || 6.15 || uddīpyasveti dīpaṃ ca devasya tveti vai haviḥ | vāsudedādimantraiśca matsyādyaiḥ keśavādibhiḥ || 6.16 || puṣpāṇi dadyāddhyātvācatāṃtāṃ mūrtiṃ yathāyatham | caturmukhādi devānāṃ parivāratayārcanam || 6.17 || na svātantryeṇa yaṣṭavyaḥ vaiṣṇavena gṛhārcane | japakāle nṛsūktaṃ vā dvādaśākṣarameva vā || 6.18 || aṣṭākṣaraṃ vā yadvānyaṃ mantraṃ praṇavameva vā | japetsamāhitamanā yadvā trayyanta gocarān || 6.19 || yo nityaṃ pūjayedviṣṇuṃ gṛhastho veśmani svayam | sa nayetsva kulodbhūtān puruṣānekaviṃśatim || 6.20 || viṣṇoḥ padaṃ vā sālokyaṃ yadvānya dabhivāñchitam | upacārā haredadya saparyā vidhigocarāḥ || 6.21 || aṣṭottaraśataṃ viṃśacchrutā ye manmukhodgatāḥ | avahana namaskārau pratyutthāna manantaram || 6.22 || puṣpāñjali ssvāgatokti rāsanaṃ pādapīṭhikā | arghyaṃ pādyaṃ pratigrāhaḥ pādyaplotābhi marśanam || 6.23 || ālepanaṃ caraṇayośca ndanakṣodavāriṇā | apāmācamanīyaṃ tu pratigrahaṇa darśanam || 6.24 || upasparśana mālepaścanda nādyambucarcayā | puṣpamālā dhūpadānaṃ madhuparka nivedanam || 6.25 || ghanasāro nāgavallī snānaviṣṭara gocarāḥ | pādure snānapīṭhaṃ ca snānaśāṭaka manvataḥ || 6.26 || dantakāṣṭha mathādarśo jihvānirlekhapaṭṭikā | tāmbūlaviṭikā vastramaparārdhaprasāritam || 6.27 || abhyaṅgo maulimālā ca tālavṛntamanantaram | candanodvartanaṃ tanvā gandhāmalakavāri ca || 6.28 || kaṅkataṃ kajanīsnānaṃ vastraṃ gandhānulepanam | uttarīyaṃ pavitraṃ ca nṛttaṃgeya manantaram || 6.29 || vādyaṃ daśaśataiśchidraissnānaṃ dhārābhi rarṇasām | nīrājanaṃ śiraḥplota muṣṇīṣaṃ plotapāsasā || 6.30 || aṅgābhimarśanaṃ vastra mupavīta manantaram | uttarīyaṃ triṃśadete kathitāḥ kamalāsana || 6.31 || alaṅkārāsanasthasya harestatkāla gocarāḥ | upacārā śśirastrāṇaṃ pītakauśeya vāsasā || 6.32 || karpūra rajasā ''mauli cāpādānta manantaram | kastūrikā mṛgamadaṃ candanenānulepanam || 6.33 || vyajanaṃ cāmarapyūhauḥkuṅku menānulepanam | gandhaṃ ca kṛtrimā bhūṣā brahmasūtra manantaram || 6.34 || uttarīyaṃ maulimālā bhāhumālāvilambanam | mṛtsnayā tilakaṃ kuryādañjanaṃ ca śalākayā || 6.35 || puṣpāvakiraṇaṃ brahman mahādarśapradarśanam | tāmbūlikā dhūpadīpau śālitaṇḍula mātrikā || 6.36 || svādhyāyādhyayanaṃ dānaṃ nāṭyaṃ veṇu ninādanam | vīṇādivādanaṃ pāṭho maṅgalānā manantaram || 6.37 || nīrājanaṃ ca piṇḍānāṃ paṅcānāṃ kṣepaṇaṃ diśi | yātrāsanopacārāstu haresattkāla gocarāḥ || 6.38 || upānahau cāmarāṇi muktātapa nivāraṇam | mayūrapiṅchavyajanaṃ tālavṛntaṃ ratho gajaḥ || 6.39 || aśvaśca śibikāyānaṃ vainate yadhvajonnatiḥ | krīḍāyaṣṭiśca tāmbūlī kriḍāphalasamṛddhayaḥ || 6.40 || evaṃ paṅcadaśa proktā yātrāsanagatāḥ param | bhojanāsanamārūḍhe harau tatkālagocarāḥ || 6.41 || madhuparkaṃ ca tāmbūlaṃ vīṭikā mukhaśāṭikā | arhaṇāmbhaḥ pāyasānnaṃ mudgānnaṃ ca gulodanam || 6.42 || dadhyodanaṃ pānakaṃ ca pānīyaṃ hastaśāṭakam | śuddhikca karayo relācandanakṣodavāriṇā || 6.43 || sukhāsīne ca dāśārhe candanodakacarcayā | ajgeṣvālepanaṃ mālyamapūva pṛthukāstathā || 6.44 || saktanastilapiṇḍāśca phalāni kvathitaṃ jalam | nālikerāmbudānaṃ ca tāmbūlīdalavīṭikā || 6.45 || pradakṣiṇa namaskārastu tirātma nivedanam | arghyamudvāsanaṃ caite śatamaṣṭhā ca viṃśatiḥ || 6.46 || upacārā harerbrarhma vistareṇa pradarśitāḥ | āpāhana namaskārau saparyāsana manvataḥ || 6.47 || pādapīṭhaṃ tathaipārghyaṃ pādyanīra pratigrahaḥ | pādyamācamanīyāmbhaḥ pratigrahaṇameva ca || 6.48 || acāmo mukhavāsaśca pāduke snānaviṣṭaram | snānaśāṭī dantakāṣṭhaṃ jihvānirlekhanaṃ tathā || 6.49 || tāmbūlābhyaṅjanaṃ caiva vyajanaṃ cāṅgapeṣaṇam | gandhāmalakajaṃ snānaṃ kaṅkatena viśodhanam || 6.50 || rajanīcarcayā snānamuttarīya pariṣkṛtiḥ | vāridhārā sahasreṇa snānaṃ nīrājanaṃ tathā || 6.51 || plotābhimarśanaṃ vāso brahmasūtra manantaram | uttarīya malaṅkāraviṣṭaraṃ keśaśoṣaṇam || 6.52 || paridhānaṃ dukūlena gandhadravyānu lepanam | vyajanaṃ bhūṣaṇaṃ mālā puṣpāṇāṃ sayanāñjanam || 6.53 || tāmbūlaṃ darpaṇaṃ dhūpadīpau mātrā parivyayaḥ | dānaṃ nīrājanaṃ cchatramupānaṭ cāmaradhvajāḥ || 6.54 || vāhanaṃ śibikāyānaṃ trayaṃ krīḍā phalaṃ tathā | bhojana syāsanaprāpti rmadhuparka nivedanam || 6.55 || arhaṇaṃ prāpaṇaṃ pānaṃ pānīyaṃ sukhaviṣṭaram | nivedana mapūpāde stāmbūlī stotra śaṃsanam || 6.56 || visarjanamiti brahman ṣaṣṭiśca caturuttarā | upacārānatho pakṣye dvātriṃ śattuyathātatham || 6.57 || āvahanāsane paścādarghyaṃ pādya mana ntaram | ācāmo mukhavāsaśca pāduke dantadhāvanam || 6.58 || jihvānirlekhanaṃ telaṃ dhātryāssnānaṃ haridrayā | pāsaścaipūpavītaṃ ca gandhālepaśca bhūṣaṇam || 6.59 || mālā'ñcanaṃ tathādarśadānāṃ dhūpaścadīpikā | mātrādānaṃ tataśchatraṃ cāmaraṃ tūryaghoṣaṇam || 6.60 || madhuparkārhaṇaṃ caiva nivedana manantaram | bhakṣyaṃ tathā nāgavallī visarjana mathāntimam || 6.61 || upacārāṣṣoḍaśa nyurātmanaśśaktyapekṣayā | āvahanāsane pūrvamarghyaṃ pādya manantaram || 6.62 || upasparśastathā snānaṃ pastraṃ yajñopa vītakam | gandhālepastathā bhūṣā mālā dhūpaḥ pradīpikā || 6.63 || madhuparkaṃ prāpaṇaṃ ca visarjana mathāntimam | āsaneṣu ca sarveṣu pādyaṃ pādya pratigrahaḥ || 6.64 || pādaplota ścaraṇayorgandhā lepaścaturmukha | ācāmaśca tadambūnāṃ pratigrahaṇa miṣyate || 6.65 || bhojyayātrāsane tyaktvā kartavyaṃ pādaviṣṭaram | upakramopa ramayo rmadhuparka nivedanam || 6.66 || bhojanānteca vastrasya paridhāne tathā plave | jihvānirlekhanānte ca sarvatrā camanakriyā || 6.67 || nivedani ca vastrāṇāṃ keśānāmapi śoṣaṇe | ghanṭānādaṃ vinā dhūpo na vinānyatra ghaṇṭayā || 6.68 || dīpopacāre nai veṣṭaṃ ghaṇṭāsvanana manyathā | vibhavānāṃ kṣaye sthāne syācca pūjā'surīkṛtā || 6.69 || nirlekhanaṃ rasajñāyā dantakāṣṭhaṃ ca nikṣipet | upasparśana vārīṇāṃ pratigrahaṇa bhājane || 6.70 || bhakṣaṇādyanna pānānte pāsasā hastamārjanam | tathāñjane nayanayo rmārjanaṃ pāsasā bhavet || 6.71 || arhaṇaṃ bhojane dadyānna pānādau kadā cana | parasya sūkṣmasya tathā sthūlasya tadanantaram || 6.72 || cintā saṅkramaṇaṃ tasya bimbe pratyudgama stathā | svāgatoktirnamaskārassānnidhya prārthanā tathā || 6.73 || ityāvāhana maṣṭāṅgaṃ parasya paramātmanaḥ | ratneṣu sphaṭike svarṇe rajate tāmrake'pivā || 6.74 || kṣaṇike vārcayeddeva māvāhya vidhipūrvakam | cakrābjamaṇḍalaṃ kumbha ssodaka ssūtraveṣṭanam || 6.75 || bījaṃ piṣṭaṃ tathaipānnaṃ phalaṃ puṣpaṃ jalaṃ tathā | gandhaṃ vediśśakṛtkūrcamityādi kṣaṇikaṃ matam || 6.76 || ālaye sthāpitaṃ devaṃ sadā nīrājayeddharim | sampūrṇa mambhasā kumbhaṃ hemādidravya nirmitam || 6.77 || sragviṇaṃ sāpidhānaṃ ca mukhe'śvattha dalai ryutam | akṣatairarcitaṃ gandhavāriṇābhyukṣitaṃ tathā || 6.78 || catuṣṭayā ṅgulotsedhaṃ dīpavarti virājitam | uccairādāya hastābhyāmāpāda talamastakam || 6.79 || triḥ paribhramya deveśaṃ balipīṭhe vinikṣipet | evaṃ nīrājanaṃ ghoraśāntyarthaṃ puṣṭivardhanam || 6.80 || iti śrīpāñcarātre mahopaniṣadi pādme tantre caryāpāde nṛsūktopacāra nīrājana vidhirnāma ṣaṣṭhyo'dhyāyaḥ |
<4.7>
brahmā bhagavan kathyatāṃ kīdṛk cakrābjaṃ nāma maṇḍalam | yadārādhyaṃ samārādhya taranti bhavavāridhim || 7.1 || śrībhagavān caturbhiryājñikaiḥ kāṣṭhaiṣṣaḍaṅgula ghanaiśśubhaiḥ | dvādaśāṅgula vistārai rākāraṃ caturaśrakam || 7.2 || maṇḍalānuguṇāyāmavistāraṃ parikalpayet | aṣṭatālāyatān stambhān suvṛttāṃ ścaturastathā || 7.3 || sannikṛṣṭasya koṇeṣu caturṣvetasya maṅgalān | sthāpayedupariṣṭācca stambhānāṃ sanni veśayet || 7.4 || catvāri caiva dārūṇi yathāpūrvekta lakṣaṇam | taccatuṣkaṃ ca dārūṇāṃ vitānadhvajamālayā || 7.5 || bhūṣaye tparito muktādāmāni ca vilambayet | śuddhayā ca mṛdādhastāccatuṣkoṣṭhasya cāntaram || 7.6 || pūraye dantaraṃ tasya gomayenopalepayet | cakrābjādīni bimbāni kuryāttatra mahītale || 7.7 || teṣāmā yāmavistārā viṣyete hastasammitau | dviguṇau triguṇau vāpi syātā matha caturguṇau || 7.8 || yadvāpañcha guṇau brahmannavakāśānu sārataḥ | candanārdrāṇi sūtrāṇi prañci saptadaśakṣitau || 7.9 || nipāta yettadhodañcitāvanti kamalāsana | ṣaṭpañcāśatsamadhike santyeva dveśate punaḥ || 7.10 || koṣṭhāni santi tatrāntaṣṣaṭtriṃśatkoṣṭha madhyataḥ | sthāpayitvātataśśaṅkuṃ bhrāmaye tsūtravartmanā || 7.11 || pañcavṛttāni bimbāni samānyekaṃ tu madhyamam | karṇikākṣetrametasmādbahirbimbaṃ tridhā punaḥ || 7.12 || vibhajya sūtramārgeṇa prathamā kesarāvaniḥ | dalabhūmirdvitīyā tu tṛtīyā nābhimaṇḍalam || 7.13 || tadekaṃ dvividhaṃ vāpi trividhaṃ sūtravartmanā | vibhajennābhi bhūbhāgādbahirdve maṇḍale bhat || 7.14 || arakṣetraṃ bahirnemibhūrekaṃ maṇḍalaṃ bhavet | koṣṭhairathāṣṭaviṃśatyāparito bahirāsanam || 7.15 || caturaśraṃ bhavetkoṣṭhairaśītyāvīdhikā bahiḥ | paṅtkidvayena viśvātman caturaśrādbahiḥpunaḥ || 7.16 || koṣṭhāni dvādaśādhikyaṃ śataṃ paṅktidvaye bhavet | pratyāśaṃ teṣu koṣṭheṣu caturdvāraṃ prakalpayet || 7.17 || koṣṭheścaturbhiḥpratyekaṃ dvayoḥ paṅtkyoścaturmukha | caturṣu koṇeṣu tathā pratyekaṃ śaṅkhasiddhaye || 7.18 || koṣṭhadhvayaṃ tu sammārjyaṃ dvayoḥpaṅtkyoścaturmukha | pratidvāraṃ tadabhyarṇe pārśvayo rubhayorapi || 7.19 || artha śobhā prasidyarthaṃ bāhyānantara rathyayoḥ | dve dve koṣṭhe bahiḥpaṅtkyā maikaikaṃ tadanantaram || 7.20 || sammārjya mevaṃ śobhārthamekaikaṃ bahiranyataḥ | trīṇi trīṇi ca koṣṭhāni mārjanīyāni padmaja || 7.21 || upaśobhārthamapyevaṃ vyatyāsena catuṣṭayam | sammārjanīyaṃ koṣṭhānāṃ viniyogaḥ pradarśitaḥ || 7.22 || yadvāpīṭhādinirmāṇaṃ vinā koṣṭhāni viṃśatiḥ | śatadvayaṃ ca paritaḥ parimṛjya caturmukha || 7.23 || ādipadma pramāṇena kuryādāvaraṇatrayam | caturdiśaṃ caturdvāra kalpanaṃ padmamānataḥ || 7.24 || yadvaika valajaṃ kuryādabhīṣṭadaśi padmaja | dvādaśābjāni kalpyāni pratyāvaraṇakalpanam || 7.25 || caturṣu koṇeṣvekaikaṃ dve dve valaja pārśvayoḥ | dalairdvādaśabhiryuktaṃ karṇikāke sarānvitam || 7.26 || ādipadmārdhamānena padmajātaṃ prakalpayet | madhyame paṅkaje bindūn karṇikāyāṃ prakalpayet || 7.27 || dvādaśā bbajarekhāśca śataṃ ca navatiṃ tathā | kesarorvyāṃ pidhāyānvagdalakṣetre prakalpayet || 7.28 || vidikṣu dikṣu ca tathā catasro viṃśatiṃ tathā | pradarśayedupadalānnyarakṣetre diśaḥprati | are dve dve vihikṣu syādekaikaṃ dvāśaśāratā || 7.30 || arāṇindīvaradalaistulyānyabjapalāśavat | yadvā yapodarābhāni mātuluṅga samāni ca || 7.31 || pipīlikodarābhāni parasparamāni ca | antarālāni cai teṣāṃ tulyamānāni padmaja || 7.32 || īdṛśaṃ maṇḍalaṃ śastaṃ pāsudeva samarcane | nārāyaṇe tu yaṣṭavye bindvādyāḥ pūrvamīritāḥ || 7.33 || aṣṭāvaṣṭau vidhātavyāḥ kesarā navatissaṣaṭ | pūrveritāni koṣṭhāni mārjayitvāṣaḍuttaram || 7.34 || triṃśaśca tatra nābhyādi vināpadmaṃ prakalpayet | śaṅkumāhṛtya sūtreṇa tatsamaṃ vibhajeddvidhā || 7.35 || prathamaṃ karṇikākṣetraṃ dvitīyaṃ vibhajettridhā | triṣvādyaṃ kesarakṣetraṃ dalakṣetra manantaram || 7.36 || tṛtīyamantarālaṃ syā ddalapīṭhikayordvayoḥ | aṣṭau dvādaśa vā kuryā dbindvādīn kamalāsana || 7.37 || maṇḍalaṃ bhadrakaṃ nāma tadidaṃ sarvakāmadam | cikīṣan svastikaṃ bimbaṃ kṣetraṃ ṣaṭtriṃśatāyum || 7.38 || saṃmṛjya tatra koṣṭhāni ekaṃ daśa ca pātayet | prāgāyatāni sūtrāṇi udicīnāyatānica || 7.39 || saṃmṛjya madhyato dve dve vīdhīṃ prāgāyatāmapi | tathodagāyatāmekāṃ kuryānnirga manaṃ punaḥ || 7.40 || prāgāyatābhyāṃ koṣṭhābhyāṃ bahiḥpaṅtkā udaṅmukham | prācīnaṃ paścimaṃ cāpi dakṣiṇāmukha miṣyate || 7.41 || tathodagā yatābhyāṃ syā dudakpratyaṅmukhaṃ śubham | dakṣiṇāgraṃ bhavetprācyā mitisvastika mīritam || 7.42 || dvidhā vibhajya pūrvoktaṃ ṣaṭtriṃśatkoṣṭhamaṇḍalam | madhyataḥ padmakaraṇa mavaśiṣṭe tridhākṛte || 7.43 || dvābhyāṃ suvṛttaṃ bhāgabhyāṃ bhrāntaṃ vṛttyasya maṇḍalam | avaśiṣṭena bhāgena tvantarālaṃ bhavedbahiḥ || 7.44 || sauramaṇḍala metatsyāde tadevendu maṇḍalam | sarveṣāmeva bimbānāṃ pīṭhādbāhyaṃ yathāpuram || 7.45 || vinā vidadhyātpīṭhādīn kevalaṃ cakrapaṅkajam | cakraṃ vinā vā padmaṃ syā tkartuśśakti samīkṣayā || 7.46 || maṇḍalaṃ śobhayedratnaiḥ pañcavarṇaissitādibhiḥ | taccūrṇai rathavā cūrṇai rlohajai rvātha dhātujaiḥ || 7.47 || candanāgurukuṣṭhādi gandhacūrṇai rathāpi vā | śālyādi taṇḍulaiḥ piṣṭaissitrervrīhi bhirapyuta || 7.48 || puṭadagdhai ravakṣuṇṇai rasitai ryājñikaiśchadaiḥ | śyāmai śśuklairavakṣuṇṇauḥ kausumbhai rapi pāṭalaiḥ || 7.49 || niśā cūrṇaiḥ prasūnairvāpaṅcavarṇaiśca kālajaiḥ | śobhayetkarṇikādīni yadvarṇāni caturmukha || 7.50 || tadvarṇaireva ratnādi dravyairākāraśobhanam | antarālāni sarvatra kṛṣṇaiśśyāmairathāpi vā || 7.51 || śobha yetkarṇi kāṃ pītai śśuklairbindūnvi śobhayet | pāṭalaiḥ karṇikārekhāṃ kṛṣṇairvā kesarāvanim || 7.52 || dvidhā kṛtvā pūrvabhāgaṃ śvaitairbhāga mathottaram | pītairaktairvirāmeṣu pratikesaramarjunaiḥ || 7.53 || bindūnvidadhyādradnaistu dalakoṭiṣu rekhayet | ādyantāni ca barhāṇāṃ sitara ktairviśobhayet || 7.54 || barhānta valayaṃ raktaissitairvā rbhūṣaye tpṛthak | śyāmaiḥ pītaiśca raktaiśca nābhirekhātrayaṃ kramāt || 7.55 || dvinābhitve śyāmapītai śśyāmairevaikanābhike | rekhayedasitai reva tvarakoṭī rarāṇi tu || 7.56 || raktairarāntavalayaṃ kṛṣṇairnemyantamedinīm | sitairnemi mahībhāgaṃ dvidhā kṛtvaika māditaḥ || 7.57 || bhāgaṃ kṛṣṇaissitairanyannemibhāgaṃ viśeṣayet | pīṭhaṃ pītaiḥ pāṭalairvā sitairvā vīdhikāṃ punaḥ || 7.58 || latāvitāna patrādiyuktāṃ cūrṇaiśca citrayet | raktaiśśobhāṃ tathā pītai rūpaśobhāṃ ca śobhayet || 7.59 || dvāraṃ śuklaiśca raktaiśca pītaiḥ kṛṣṇai ryathākramam | śobhaye duttarādīṃśca koṇān kṛṣṇairathārjunaiḥ || 7.60 || śaṅkhaṃ ca kuryāttaireva svastikaṃ pāṭalaprabham | yadvā pītanibhaṃ sauraṃ maṇḍalaṃ pāṭalaprabham || 7.61 || maṇḍalaṃ caindavaṃ śuklamantarālaṃ tu sarvaśaḥ | yatheṣṭavarṇa subhagaṃ maṇḍale hastasammite || 7.62 || rekhānu cūrṇairutsedhaḥ kaniṣṭhāṅguli sammitaḥ | dvihaste'nāmi kā mānastrihaste madhyamāsamaḥ || 7.63 || caturhaste maṇḍale tu tarjanya ṅgulisammitaḥ | pañchahaste samo'ṅguṣṭhenetyutsedhaḥ pradarśitaḥ || 7.64 || maṇḍalaṃ citrayitvaiva mārabheta samarcanam | ārādha yetkarṇikāyāṃ mantrādhvānamanantaram || 7.65 || tatvādhvānaṃ kesareṣu varṇādhvānaṃ daleṣu ca | padādhyānaṃ nābhibhāgi kalādhvāna mareṣu ca || 7.66 || ṣaṣṭhaṃ tu bhuvanādhvānaṃ nemibhāge caturmukha | karṇikāyāṃ dvādaśasu binduṣu dvādaśārcayet || 7.67 || akṣarāṇi samāvāhya karṇikāyāṃ samāhitaḥ | yajeta paramātmānaṃ sakalīkṛtya tatvavit || 7.68 || kesareṣu śriyādīṃśca yajeta dalabhūmiṣu | śaktīstadīyā daśa ca dve ca pūjyā yathāvidhi || 7.69 || śrīvatsā dyāśśaktayaśca vyāptyādyāḥ paritasthsitāḥ | dalā ntavalaye pūjyo viṣṇuḥ prathamanābhigaḥ || 7.70 || brahmā dvitīyanābhisthastṛṇetrastu tṛtīyagaḥ | dvādaśāreṣu viṣṇvādvāḥ pūjyā dvādaśamūrtayaḥ || 7.71 || arāntavalaye pūjyā mīnādyā daśa mūrtayaḥ | prathame nemivalaye śaṅkhyādyāyudha pūjanam || 7.72 || pīṭhakoṇa catuṣkeṣu varāho narakesarī | anantaśca hayagrīvastadāgneyādiṣu kramāt || 7.73 || vīdhikāyāṃ lokapālāḥ puruhūtā dayaḥ kramāt | pūjyā dvāreṣu caṇḍādyā dvau dvau prati caturṣvapi || 7.74 || īśāna koṇe rathyāyāṃ viṣvaksenaṃ samarcayet | garuḍo'bhi mukhastiṣṭhan pūrvadvārā dbahiḥ kṣitau || 7.75 || cakraṃ ca dakṣiṇadvāri gadāṃ ca dvāri paścime | valaje cottare śaṅkhaṃ prathamā varaṇe tataḥ || 7.76 || viṣṇvādi mūrtayaḥ pūjyā dvādaśā bjeṣu padmaja | anantare cāvaraṇe padmeṣu dvādaśasvapi || 7.77 || pāsudevādi kṛṣṇāntā mūrtayo dvādaśaiva te | padmeṣvāvaraṇe cānte dvādaśā ditya pūjanam || 7.78 || etasmin maṇḍale devaṃ pāsudevaṃ samarcayet | bimbe nārāyaṇākhye tu binduṣvaṣṭasu tāvatām || 7.79 || aṣṭākṣarāṇāṃ nyasanam vyāptyādyāśśaktayo'ṣṭa ca | kesareṣu samārādhyā daleṣvaṣṭau śriyādayaḥ || 7.80 || areṣvaṣṭanu śaṅkhādīnyāyudhānyaṣṭa pūjayet | caturviṃśatipadmeṣu caturviṃ śatimūrtayaḥ || 7.81 || triṣu cāvaraṇeṣveṣu pūjyāḥ tanmaṇḍale harim | nārāyaṇaṃ samāvāhya yajeta parameśvaram || 7.82 || darśeca paurṇamāsyāṃ ca saṅkrāntau śrāvaṇeṣu ca | dvādaśyāṃ viṣuve caiva grahaṇeṣva yaneṣu ca || 7.83 || janmaṛkṣe viśeṣeṇa maṇḍale harimarcayet | maṇḍalārādhanamidaṃ dharmakā mārthamokṣadam || 7.84 || cakrābjamaṇḍale śastā dīkṣā tasyāśca maṇḍalam | ekadvāraṃ bhavettacca saumyaṃ syādagrajanmanām || 7.85 || citritaṃ śvetavarṇena prāgdvāraṃ pṛthivī bhujām | raktena citritaṃ dvāraṃ pāścātyaṃ pītavarṇakam || 7.86 || viśāṃ bhaveddākṣiṇātya masitaṃ pādajanmanām | dvārāṇi cānulomānā mutpādakavadiṣyate || 7.87 || sūtasya valajaṃ prācyāṃ śūdrāṇāmiva yoṣitām | śiṣyaṃ sutaṃ vā sarvajña manasūyaṃ jitendriyam || 7.88 || ācāryavaṃśajanmānaṃ nigrahānu grahe kṣamam | śāntike pauṣṭike caiva karmaṇi kṣamamarthinām || 7.89 || veda vedānta tatvajña mācārya padakāṅkṣiṇam | deśikendro vidhānena vakṣyamāṇena tatvavit || 7.90 || karṣaṇādiṣu sarveṣu vidhāneṣvadhikāriṇam | kuryānmaṇḍala pūjādi kumbhayāgāvasānikam || 7.91 || dīkṣāyāmiva tatsarvaṃ kṛtvā śiṣyasya sannidau | ājyena caruṇā caiva samidbhaḥ kusumai stilaiḥ || 7.92 || juhuyānmūlamantrābhyā maṣṭottarasahasrakam | śiṣyasya dakṣiṇe haste badhvāprati saraṃ guruḥ || 7.93 || nṛttairgeyaistathā pādyai rvedaghoṣairnayenni śām | tataḥprabhāte śiṣyaṃ taṃ snātaṃ nūtana vāsanam || 7.94 || samāhoyā samārādhya maṇḍalaṃ kumbhameva ca | caturvidhaṃ nivedyānnaṃ homaṃ kuryādyathā niśi || 7.95 || kalaśāṃ ścaturo droṇa pūrṇān homādi nirmitān | mṛṇmayānvā yathāvittaṃ sūtra vastrādiveṣṭitān || 7.96 || saṃsthāpya dhānyarāśau tu ratnādīni vinikṣipet | agneyakumbhe ratnāni sarvāṇi viniveśayet || 7.97 || nairṛte sarvalohāni gandhadravyāṇi mārute | aiśāne tīrthavārīṇi tato devaṃ samarcayet || 7.98 || agnikoṇe vāsudevaṃ saṅgarṣaṇa manantare | pradyumnaṃ vāyukoṇe tu koṇe raudre'niruddhakam || 7.99 || tato'nu śiṣyaṃ saṃsthāpya pīṭhe bhadrādividyayā | śiṣyaṃ prāṅmukhamāsīnaṃ ṣaḍaṅga nyāsapūrvakam || 7.100 || arcayitvāghṛtāropa mācare davilambayan | tūrya ghoṣeṇa geyena brahmaghoṣeṇa ghoṣayet || 7.101 || caturdikṣu tatogandhaiḥ puṣpaistāmbālaviṭibhiḥ | dhanairbahu vidhairiṣṭaissadasyān toṣayeddvijān || 7.102 || toṣayecca viśeṣaṇa bhagavadbhaktimā śritān | muhorte śobhane prāpte brāhmaṇānāmanujñayā || 7.103 || ṛgveda mantritaṃ kumbha māgneyadiśi niṣṭhitam | tamupādāya pāṇibhyāṃ sūktena puruṣātmanā || 7.104 || dvādaśākṣa ramantreṇa sampuṭīkṛtamūrtinā | abhiṣiñcedguruśśiṣyaṃ kumbheva tadanantaram || 7.105 || nairṛtasthena yajuṣā mantritena samāhitaḥ | vaiṣṇavena ca sū ktena brahmannādyavasānayoḥ || 7.106 || saṅkarṣaṇākhya mantreṇa sammuṭīkṛtamūrtinā | kumbhena mārutasthena sāmāghoṣitavāriṇā || 7.107 || pradyumnasampuṭenātha brahman vāruṇasāmabhiḥ | kumbhenātharvavedena pavitrī kṛtavāriṇā || 7.108 || īśāna koṇasaṃsthena sampuṭīkṛtamūrtinā | aniruddhākhya mantreṇa nārāyaṇa samāhvāyā || 7.109 || vidyayā kalaśaissarvai rabhiṣiñcedyathoditam | abhiṣiktastataśśiṣyo navāmbarathaṃśśuciḥ || 7.110 || ācāntaścandanakṣodai rliptamāti ralaṅkṛtaḥ | sragvī pāsobhi ruṣṇīṣaṃ baddhvā mukuṭa sannibham || 7.111 || uttarīyaṃ ca bibhrāṇo bibhrāṇo yogapaṭṭikām | añjanāktekṣaṇadvandvo bāhumālā pariṣkṛtaḥ || 7.112 || nirīkṣitādarśatalo brāhmaṇaissvasti pācakaiḥ | dattaprasava vṛṣṭiśca śvetavyajanavījitaḥ || 7.113 || dattopānaṭ sitacchatro dattāśva gajavāhanaḥ | nīrājitaśca kalyāṇo jāyate gurvanugrahāt || 7.114 || anenaivābhiṣekeṇa labdhvācārya padaṃ svayam | ācārya kṛtyamakhilaṃ kartumicche ccaturmukha || 7.115 || guruve dakṣiṇāṃ dadvā dgobhūhemādikaṃ tathā | yathāvibhavavistāraṃ tato hastyādi vāhanam || 7.116 || āruhya dhavalacchatra śveta cāmara vījitaḥ | ācāryacihnairakhilai rlakṣito brāhmaṇai ssaha || 7.117 || rathayānenāgrahāraṃ prādakṣiṇyena rathyayā | gatvā devasya sadanaṃ praviśetsvasya dhāma vā || 7.118 || iti śrīpāñcirātre mahopaniṣadi pādme tantre cāryāpāde maṇḍalārādhanacāryābhiṣekavidhirnāma saptamo'dhyāyaḥ |
<4.8>
brahmā rājñorāṣṭrasya martyānāṃ yadabhyudayasādhanam | yaccotpāta praśamanaṃ vyādhīnaṃ cāpanodanam || 8.1 || yadabhipretamakhilaṃ sādhayatya vilambitam | kurvatāṃ bhagavan tanme tadarcana manuttamam || 8.2 || kathyatāṃ mayi cedasti dayā parama pūruṣa | rahasyamapi tanmahya mākhyeyaṃ jagato hitam || 8.3 || śrībhagavān mahābhiṣeko nāmāgryaṃ snapanaṃ kamalāsana | viṣuve saṅkrame caiva grahaṇe cāyanadvaye || 8.4 || dvādaśyāṃ śravaṇe caiva tathā kartu strijanmasu | dinatraye vyatīpāte rohiṇyāṃ ca tithitraye || 8.5 || darśeca paurṇamāsyāṃ ca punarvasvorviśeṣataḥ | pañcamyāṃ śubhanakṣatra tithivā reṣu cābjaja || 8.6 || prayujyamānaṃ sarvārtha sādhanaṃ sarvaśāntidam | kartavyaṃ tattridhā brahmannuttamādhamamadhyamam || 8.7 || jātyutkarṣaṃ dhanotkarṣa mathavāvekṣyatatvavit | prayuññītūttamaṃ snāna mitareṣvitaradbhavet || 8.8 || pūrvedyu raṅkuranyāso badhvā kautukamaṅgalam | adhivāsaśca bimbasya sadyo vā sakalaṃ bhavet || 8.9 || snapanaṃ pratimāyāssyādadhivāsaśca turmukha | tīrthapratikṛtau vāpi pūrvālābhe'dhivāsayet || 8.10 || yadvotsa vārthapratimāṃ balibimba mathāpivā | bimbaṃ karmārthamathavā asattsakuśakūrcakam || 8.11 || lepamṛṇmayabhittistha paṭastheṣu ca darpaṇam | kūrcaṃ mūrtyantarābhāvekluptireṣā sanātanī || 8.12 || prāsādasyā grataḥkuryāttatassnapana maṇḍapam | daśahasta pravistāraṃ dviguṇenāyataṃ śubham || 8.13 || caturdvāraṃ caturdikṣu catustoraṇa bhūṣitam | sarvāvaraṇa bhūṣveva dikṣu sarvāsu vā bhavet || 8.14 || klupte vā maṇḍape kuryā davakāśānu sārataḥ | vibhajya tattridhā kuryā ttṛtīye'ośe'tha paścime || 8.15 || avalambya brahmasūtraṃ caturaśraṃ samantataḥ | caturhastāṃ snānavedīṃ hastotsedhāṃ śilādibhiḥ || 8.16 || upānahādisaṃyuktāṃ darśanīyāṃ salakṣaṇām | upariṣṭācca valayaṃ vṛttaṃ vā caturaśrakam || 8.17 || prādeśena pravistīrṇaṃ tatamaṣṭāṅgulena vā | ṣaḍaṅgulena vā brahman caturaṅgula munnatam || 8.18 || vedikopari taddhāri kulyāmāśvabhra medinīm | mṛṇmayādiṣu bimbeṣu bahirvedī prakalpanam || 8.19 || ekabere tu na bahissnā navedī prakalpanam | dukūlakṣaumavasanai rmaṇḍapaṃ sarvatodiśam || 8.20 || śobhayetpūrṇa kumbhādyaisto raṇaiśca vibhūṣayet | veṣṭayeddarbha mālābhi rmuktādāmāni lambayet || 8.21 || āsthānamaṇḍape sthāne tathācaivārdha maṇḍape | toraṇādi na kartavyaṃ gṛharcāyāṃ tathaiva ca || 8.22 || nitye ca snapane nāpi kautukaṃ nāṅkurārpaṇam | niśācūrṇairnasnapanamiṣyate maṇḍapa sthalam || 8.23 || gomayāmbobhi rālipya sudhācūrṇaiśca śobhayet | dīpānā kopayettatranyasyeda ṅkurapālikāḥ || 8.24 || koṇe raudre maṇḍapasya jaladroṇyādibhājanam | kalpayedgāli tasvādu sugandhi jalapūritam || 8.25 || pavamānādi bhissūktairmantritaṃ sāpidhānakam | vedidakṣiṇato bhūmā vupasnānāmbu kalpanam || 8.26 || arghyādi dīpaparyantaṃ pūjādravyāṇi kalpayet | candanārdrāṇi sūtrāṇi caturdaśa nipātayet || 8.27 || prāgāyatāni tāvanti sūtrāṇyeva caturmukha | udagāyatāni santyevaṃ koṣṭhānye konasaptatiḥ || 8.28 || śataṃ ca teṣāmā yāma vistāraṃ ṣoḍaśāṅgulam | dhānyapīṭhā nurūpaṃ vā kalaśānāṃ caturmukha || 8.29 || dikṣvaṣṭānu tathā madhye pratyekaṃ nava bhūmiṣu | nava koṣṭhāni kumbhānāṃ padāni kamalāsana || 8.30 || ekamekādhikāśīti koṣṭhāni kalaśāspadam | anyānyaṣṭottarāśītī rathyāṃ sammṛjya kalpayet || 8.31 || vrīhibhiḥpīṭhikāṃ kuryātkoṣṭhabhūṣu pṛthakpṛthak | āḍhakena tadardhena tadardhārdhena vā bhavet || 8.32 || pīṭhikā dhānyaturyāṃśāstaṇḍulāḥ pīṭhikopari | tatturyāṃ śāstilāsteṣāṃ bhaveyurupari sthitāḥ || 8.33 || dvau dvau ku śāgrau pratyasyet pīṭhikāsucaturmukha | sauvarṇā rājatāstāmrā mṛṇmayā vā yathāvasu || 8.34 || kalaśā lakṣaṇopetāḥ pakvabimbaphalopamāḥ | acchidrā ssvanava naśca kālamaṇḍala varjitāḥ || 8.35 || abhinnā mṛṇmayāḥkumbhāḥpāṣāṇa sphoṭavarjitāḥ | dravyakumbhā droṇapūrṇāstadardhenāthavā'thavā || 8.36 || pādena kalaśāśśiṣṭāḥ pūryāvāryāḍhakena tu | prakṣālya viṣṇugāyatryā dravyakumbhāṃstathetarān || 8.37 || sthāpayitvā karatale savye'savyena pāṇinā | indramarudvamantreṇa tantunā pariveṣṭayet || 8.38 || tantūnāṃ viṣṭitānāṃ syā dantarālaṃ yavā ntaram | ardhāṅgulāntarālaṃ syā dyadvaikāṅgula mantaram || 8.39 || kalaśāspadamedanyāḥpaścime dharaṇītale | dhānyapīṭhaṃ vidhāyāsmin kalaśānadhivāsayet || 8.40 || dhānyapīṭhe tatastasmin kuśānā stīrya viśvataḥ | prāgagrānu dagagrāṃśca teṣu kumbhānadhomukhān || 8.41 || omityuccārya vinyasyennava bhūṣu yathottaram | nyastānā mapi kumbhānā mupariṣṭādyathāpuram || 8.42 || darbhāṃstṛṇī yādācāryomantreṇa parameṣṭhinā | prokṣayedarghyatoyena prāṅmukhaḥ puruṣātmanā || 8.43 || viśvamantreṇa virire dakṣatā na dhipāsite | uttāni teṣu kumbheṣu nivṛtyā hvonavidyayā || 8.44 || sarpiṣā ṣṭottaraśataṃ viṣṇugāya triyākṛte | home hutājya śeṣeṇa snapanadravyasecanam || 8.45 || ghṛtādisnapanadravyai rvastrapūtaiḥ pariṣkṛtaiḥ | pūrayetka laśāṃstattanmantreḥpūrṇān samuddharet || 8.46 || sarvamantreṇa viśvātman kumbān saptadadaśdhotān | dravyakumbhān dhānyapīṭhe sthāpaye dviṣṇupūrvayā || 8.47 || gāyatryā ca catuṣṣaṣṭi dvādaśākṣaravidyayā | udakumbhān krameṇānyān praṅmukho vāpyudaṅmukhaḥ || 8.48 || navake madhyame sthāne sthāvanī yāstu madhyame | ghṛtakumbhaṃ sthāpayitvā padepautrāmaṇe tataḥ || 8.49 || uṣṇodakumbhaṃ vinyasye dratna kumbha manantaram | phalakumbhaṃ yamapade lohakumbhaṃ tu nairṛte || 8.50 || prācetase mārjanāmbhaḥ kumbhaṃ gandhāmbumārute | akṣatāmbu ca kau bere pade śārve yapodakam || 8.51 || prācyāṃ tu kumbhanavake madhye pādya ghaṭaṃ syaset | arghya kumbhaṃ pade yāmye pade prācetase punaḥ || 8.52 || upasparśana pānīyaṃ pañcagavya mudakpade | agneya kumbhanavake madhye dadhi ghaṭaṃ nyaset || 8.53 || nairṛte madhyataḥkṣīraṃ vāyavīye ghaṭaṃ madhoḥ | kaṣāya kumbhamaiśāne sarvatra parito ghaṭān || 8.54 || śuddhodakāṃścatuṣṣaṣṭi maṣṭhāvaṣṭau niveśayet | saptabhiḥ pañchabhirvāpi yadvā darbhaustribhiḥkṛtān || 8.55 || kūrcān kumbheṣvapāgagrān nikṣipella kṣaṇānvitān | mahā kumbhe kuśaiḥkūrcaṃ caturviṃśatibhiḥ kṛtam || 8.56 || cakramantreṇa tān kumbhān śarāvairapidhāna yet | vāsobhi rdravyakalaśā nyupāsupāsa ityṛcā || 8.57 || kaṇṭheṣu veṣṭayedanyān vāsobhi schādayennavaiḥ | adhīyānaistrayīvidyāṃ vidvadbhi rbrāhmaṇaissaha || 8.58 || ṛtvigbhi ssahadevasya yāyānmantra vidantikam | ṛtvijo devamutthāpya guruścottiṣṭha vidyayā || 8.59 || sāmnārathanta rākhyena brahmayāne gurussvayam | sthāpayedṛtvijaissārdhaṃ brāhmaṇai rvedapāragaiḥ || 8.60 || śibhikāyāṃ sthāpayitvā mṛdvāstaraṇa kalpite | niveśameyuḥ pratimāṃ snāna veditale śucau || 8.61 || puṇyāhaṃ vā cayetpaścātpañcakāla parāyaṇaiḥ | ayugmaistoṣayedvittaistānvibhūtyanusārataḥ || 8.62 || dvāratoraṇa kumbhādīn samabhyarcya yathāpuram | dvāreṣva dhyayanaṃ nṛttaṃ vādyaṃ geyaṃ pravartayet || 8.63 || sarpiṣā juhuyādaganau yāvatkalaśasaṅkhyayā | mūlamantreṇa juhuyā ccaruṃ purvektasajhkhyayā || 8.64 || nṛ sūktena samabhyarcya kalaśān sthāpitān guruḥ | arghyādi bhistathā devaṃ ghṛtāropaṇa mācaret || 8.65 || dantakāṣṭhaṃ gandhatailaṃ tathāmalakavāri ca | vastraṃ datvācottarīya marghyādyai rarcayetpunaḥ || 8.66 || dīpāntamarcanaṃ kṛtvā pādyakumbha mukhai rghaṭaiḥ | ghṛtakumbhāna sānaiśca snāpaye dde śikottamaḥ || 8.67 || chinnaikatantu muddhṛtya pādyakumbhaṃ samarcitam | puṣpairdadyātkaratale deśikendrasya mūrtipaḥ || 8.68 || kūrcamādāya kumbhasthaṃ svahaste deśikottamaḥ | avāgagreṇa kūrcana tīrdhai rbrahmādi bhistataḥ || 8.69 || śubhairvaiṣṇava gāyatryāsnāpayetpādya vāribhiḥ | tadviṣṇuritimantreṇa snāpayedarghyapāribhiḥ || 8.70 || na teviṣṇu ritiśrutyākumbhenācamanāmbunā | viṣṇoḥ krameti mantreṇa pañcagavyābhiṣecanam || 8.71 || dadhikrā viṇṇayajuṣā dadhnā devabhiṣecanam | sāmnā payo pṛtenaiva payasā madhunā punaḥ || 8.72 || madhuvāteti mantreṇa snapanaṃ madhuvidvaṣaḥ | oṣadhya itimantreṇa kaṣāyāmbhobhiṣecanam || 8.73 || tadviṣṇo riti mantreṇa snānaṃmuṣṇāmbudhārayā | phalinītyanuvākena snapanaṃ phalavāribhiḥ || 8.74 || śaṃ nodevīriti snānaṃ mantridairmārjanāmbubhiḥ | sāvitryākṣatapāthobhistrātāra miti sāmabhiḥ || 8.75 || ratnodakairlohatoyairmahāvyāhṛtividyayā | gandhadvāreti mantreṇa snapanaṃ gandhavāriṇā || 8.76 || śatadhāreti mantreṇa snānaṃ syādyavavāribhiḥ | ghṛta snāteti mantreṇa ghṛtena snapanaṃ hareḥ || 8.77 || athavā pauruṣai ssūktaiḥkramātpā dyādipāribhiḥ | ṛgbhiṣṣoḍa śabhissnāna mṛcedaṃ viṣṇurityapi || 8.78 || aṣṭākṣareṇa vā yadvā dvādaśākṣaravidyayā | viṣṇugāyatriyā vāpi snānaṃ yadvā caturmukha || 8.79 || svamūrti vidyayā vāpi snapanaṃ madhuvidviṣaḥ | kṣālanaṃ ca ghṛta snāne sāmānyai kuṣṇavāribhiḥ || 8.80 || pādyādi dravya kumbhānā muddhāreṣpantarā ntarā | śuddhoda kumbhairanyaiśca snānamaṣṭabhi raṣṭabhiḥ || 8.81 || aṣṭākṣareṇa mantreṇa bhaveddevasya padmaja | upasnānaṃ tathā plotaṃ vastraṃ caipūttarīyakam || 8.82 || arghyaṃ pādyaṃ tathācāmaṃ gandhaṃ puṣpaṃ ca dhūpakam | dīpaṃ caitāni deyāni pratidravya ghaṭāplavam || 8.83 || uddhareddranva kalaśān viṣṇugāyatrividyayā | śuddhodakāṃśca kalaśān dvādaśākṣara vidyayā || 8.84 || haridrā taṇḍulai ssvarṇa cūrṇaiḥ kumbhān sasūtrakān | pūrayennava nirdoṣān saptavā pañca vāthavā || 8.85 || trīṇyekaṃ kumbhamathavā te ca sthāpyāḥ parivyaye | sāpidhāneṣu kumbheṣu sakūrceṣu samarcayet || 8.86 || śriyaṃ kumbhān samuddhṛtya śrīsū ktenābhiṣecayet | pūrṇāhutiryathā homecūrṇaissnāsaṃ tathābhavet || 8.87 || pāsudevatanubhraṣṭān cūrṇān paramapāvanān | yevahanti śirobhissvairnarā nirdhūtakalmaṣāḥ || 8.88 || teyānti vaiṣṇavaṃ sthānaṃ punarāvṛttivarjitam | abhiṣeka jalaṃ viṣṇo rye pibanti vahanti vā || 8.89 || te sarvitīrthābhiśeka phalamaśnuvate mahat | kṛtvā pradakṣiṇaṃ natvāstutvā stotreṇa deśikaḥ || 8.90 || tata ssahasra dhārābhi ssnāpayitvā janardanam | nīrājanāntamiṣṭvaivaṃ tato'laṅkāra viṣṭare || 8.91 || yajeta mātrādānāntaṃ mātrāsaṅkhyā parivyayaḥ | khāridroṇaṃ tadardhaṃ vā deyāssyurdeśikāya te || 8.92 || caturvidhāni cānnāni bhojayedbho janāsane | homānta marcayeddevaṃ deśikendro yathāvidhi || 8.93 || snapanānte tato devaṃ sukhamāsīna māsane | yāceta yājamānopi sarvamiṣṭaṃ janārdanam || 8.94 || dakṣiṇāṃ deśikendrāya suvarṇaśataniṣkakām | tadardhaṃ pādamathavā dadyādvi ttānu sārataḥ || 8.95 || kuryādā cāryasātsarvaṃ dravyaṃ pūjāṅga māhṛtam | vastrādikaṃ tathānyeṣāṃ ṛdvijāṃ tuṣṭimāvahet || 8.96 || nṛttageyaratānāṃ ca tathā svādhyāyaśālinām | brāhmaṇānāṃ yathā tuṣṭi stathā vittaṃ visarjayet || 8.97 || athamottamametattusnapanaṃ parirīrtitam | koṇeṣu kumbhairdvāttriṃśatkevalodakapūritaiḥ || 8.98 || tairvihīnaṃ haressnānaṃ jñeyantvadhamamadhyamam | śuddhoda kumbheryaddhīnaṃ sarvestadadhamādhamam || 8.99 || pādyakumbhe tathā cārghye tathopasparśanāmbhasi | kumbhe kaṣāyaphalayoḥ kumbhe cākṣatagandhayoḥ || 8.100 || ekaikasmin ghaṭeṣveṣu dravyāṇāmaṣṭakaṃ kṣipet | pādyādiṣu kramāddravyaṃ tatpramāṇaṃ ca kathyate || 8.101 || tulasī ca tathā padmaṃ dūrva ca syāttathā'kṣatam | śyāmūkaṃ viṣṇu parṇīṃ ca bhilvapatrāṇi candanam || 8.102 || dravyāṇi candanaṃ muktvā muṣṭimātrāṇi tatphalam | siddhārthaṃ cākṣataṃ caiva kuśāgraṃ ca tathā phalam || 8.103 || yavāstilāścandanaṃ ca prasavāśca sugandhayaḥ | phalaṃ supakva meteṣu candanaṃ ca triniṣkakam || 8.104 || śiṣṭāni muṣṭimātrāṇi takkolaṃ campakasya ca | mukulaṃ ghanasāraṃ ca jātirelāphalāni ca || 8.105 || lavaṅgatvakcandanaṃ ca puṣpāṇi surabhīṇi ca | palārdhaparimāṇāni pratyekaṃ kamalāsana || 8.106 || śamīpalāśakhadirabilvāśvattha vikaṅkatam | audumbaraṃ canyagrodhaśśamyādīnāṃ tvacaḥ smṛtāḥ || 8.107 || pratyekaṃ palamānāssyuḥ kadalī bhejapūrakam | amramāmalakaṃ bhilvaṃ nālikera phalāni ca || 8.108 || panasaṃ mātulaṅgaṃ ca bhinnānyetāni nikṣipet | nīvāraveṇuśālīnāṃ priyaṅguyuvayorapi || 8.109 || kaṅguṣāṣṭikayoścaiva godhūmasya ca taṇḍulāḥ | muṣṭipramāṇā vijñeyāḥ kuṅkumaṃ koṣṭhacandane || 8.110 || agarūśīramālāni hriberaṃ girisambhavam | māṃsī muraṃ ca pratyekaṃ palamātrāṇi padmaja || 8.111 || māṇikyaṃ padmarāgaṃ ca nīlaṃ vajraṃ ca puṣyakam | pravālaṃ mauktakaṃ caiva tathā maratakaṃ kṣipet || 8.112 || vaiḍūryaṃ navaratnāni tāni ratna ghaṭo dake | suvarṇaṃ rajataṃ tāmraṃ sīsakaṃ trapukaṃ tathā || 8.113 || kāṃsyamāyasasāraṃ ca saptalohaghaṭo dake | pratyekaṃ niṣṭamānāni rajanī sūryavartinī || 8.114 || sahadevī śirīṣaṃ ca sadā bhadraṃ kuśāgrakam | mārjanāni ṣaḍetāni muṣṭimātrāṇi nikṣipet || 8.115 || yavā veṇuyavāścaiva vrīhayaśceti tattrikam | yapūdake nidhātavyaṃ pratyekaṃ kuḍupaṃ bhavet || 8.116 || pañcagavyāni grahṇīyāsmṛtpātre nūtane śubhe | gomūtraṃ gomayaṃ kṣīraṃ dadhi sarpiśca pañcamam || 8.117 || kapilāyā jarāyā vā pañcigavyaṃ praśasyate | tayorabhāve tvanyāsāṃ gavāṃ gavyaṃ vidhīyate || 8.118 || nārtāyā na ca garbhiṇyā na vṛddhāyāḥ kadā cana | nāvatsāyā upādeyaṃ dhenormūtraṃ śakṛddhvayam || 8.119 || bhūmiṣṭhaṃ gomayaṃ grāhyaṃ soṣṇaṃ krimyādyadūṣitam | niṣpīḍya samyaggṛhṇī yādgomayasya rasaṃ punaḥ || 8.120 || sadyastaptaṃ ghṛtaṃ śuddha mahorātroṣitaṃ dadhi | kṣīraṃ grāhyamataptaṃ ca daśāhjjanmanaḥ param || 8.121 || go mūtraṃ viṣṇugāyatryā gandhadvāreti gomayam | āpyāya sveti ca kṣīraṃ dadhikrā vṇeti vai dadhi || 8.122 || ghṛtaṃ śukramasītyevaṃ gavyāni saha yojayet | viṣṇugāyatriyā yadvā pañcopaniṣadai stuvā || 8.123 || parameṣṭhī śakṛnmantro gomūtrasyatu pūruṣaḥ | viśvamantro bhaveddadhno nivṛttissarpiṣo bhavet || 8.124 || payasassarvamantrassyātsarveṣā maṣṭavarṇakam | dadhni dviguṇa māghārā tpīyūṣaṃ triguṇaṃ tataḥ || 8.125 || ṣaḍguṇaṃ mūtrametasmācchakṛdvāri caturguṇam | snavane kadhitaṃ mānam prokṣaṇe pañcakaṃ samam || 8.126 || gomayena samaṃ mātraṃ dadhisyāddviguṇaṃ tataḥ | tataścatugurṇaṇaṃ sarpissarpiṣo'ṣṭa guṇaṃ payaḥ || 8.127 || praśane pañcagavyānāṃ pramāṇa midamīritam | droṇamānaṃ pañcagavyaṃ ghṛtamānaṃ ca tā dṛśam || 8.128 || tādṛgeva dadhi kṣīraṃ tāvadeva ca mākṣikam | ardhaṃ pāsyādāḍhakaṃ vānyūnaṃ cedāsuraṃ bhavet || 8.129 || gṛhorcāsnapane nyūnaṃ prasthenaiva prakalpayet | pādye dravyāntarālābhe dūrvaivā rghyo ca sarṣapāḥ || 8.130 || śastamācamanīye tu takkolaṃ mārjanāmbhasi | sahadevī gandhatoye candanakṣoda iṣyate || 8.131 || kaṣāyatoye cāśvattha śśītamuṣṇodare sati | ratnodare vajramekaṃ kadalyekā phalāmbhasi || 8.132 || suvarṇaṃ lohapānīye śāli daṇḍulamakṣate | yapūdakaghaṭevrīhiśśasyate kamalāsana || 8.133 || alabdhe dadhini kṣīraṃ kṣīrā bhāve tu taddadhi | madhunyalabdhe sarpīṃṣi tadalābhe bhavenmadhu || 8.134 || alābhe pañcagavyānāṃ ghṛtamevaikamiṣyate | pañcagavyeṣu yasyasyādalābha statpade ghṛtam || 8.135 || snapanaṃ madhyamaṃ vakṣye yathā tadava dhāraya | madhye pūrvoktakalaśa sthāpane vihite sati || 8.136 || dvau dvau bahistataḥ paṅktīssammṛjya kamalāsana | parito vīdikāḥ kuryā dbahistā bhyo ghaṭāspadam || 8.137 || pañcāśata mathaikona kalaśān dikṣu nikṣipet | pūrvādiṣu pratidiśaṃ ca tasṛṣvambujāsana || 8.138 || catvāro dravyakalaśāsteṣu śuddhodakāḥ pare | gulodakaṃ cekṣurasaṃ nālikerajalaṃ tathā || 8.139 || śāntivāri ca pūrvādau kramānnyasyeccatuṣṭayam | gulābhāve cekṣurasastastyābhāve gulodakam || 8.140 || gulamānaṃ palāśīti rardhamardhārdha meva vā | nālikera jalābhāve tatthsāne kṣīramiṣyate || 8.141 || tulasīveṇunīvarayavāśca śvetasarṣapāḥ | tilāśca ṣaṭ śāntikumbhe dravyāṇi tulasī bhavet || 8.142 || muṣṭimātraṃ dravyamanyatpṛtha kkuḍubasammitam | tulasīdalamanyeṣāmalābhe grāhyamiṣyate || 8.143 || gulodakādi bhirdravyaissnapane vihite sati | pādyādi dravyakalaśai rghṛtāntai ssnāpayeddharim || 8.144 || madhuvāteti mantreṇa snapanaṃ gulavāriṇā | madhunaktamitisnāna maikṣavena rasena ca || 8.145 || madhumānna itisnānaṃ nālikerāmbhasā punaḥ | vedāhamitimantreṇa śāntidravya ghaṭāmbubhiḥ || 8.146 || jitaṃ ta iti śuddhena vāriṇā snapanaṃ hareḥ | madhyamottamamuddiṣṭaṃ madhyame madhyamaṃ punaḥ || 8.147 || caturbhirdravyakalaśai ssnānaṃ śuddhodakairvinā | bahiṣṭhairdevadevasya madhyamādhama āplavaḥ || 8.148 || sarvaireva dravyakumbhaissarvaiśśuddhodakairvinā | uttamaṃ snapanaṃ vakṣye yathāvadava dhāraya || 8.149 || vidikṣu dikṣuvatkumbhāsthsāpyāḥ pūrvoktasaṅkhyayā | teṣu ca dravyakalaśāścatvāro'nye caturmukha || 8.150 || śuddhodakā vidiśyagne rvinyasyenmaṅgalodakam | indravalyaṅku rāśvatthapallavāśca kuśeśayam || 8.151 || ekapatrāmbhujaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ kuṅkumaṃ rohiṇa drumam | puṇyāssu manasaścāṣṭau yūdhikā mallikāpi ca || 8.152 || trīṇyutpalāni jātiśca campakaṃ ketakī tathā | dravyāṇi maṅgalānīti prasyīnmaṅgalapāthasi || 8.153 || aṅkuradvayamekair mekapatraṃ ca paṅkajam | muṣṭimātraṃ sumanasaśchaikaikaṃ candanādikam || 8.154 || palaṃ pṛthakpṛthakkumbhe nairṛte sakalauṣadhīḥ | māṃsī kuṣṭhaṃ haridre dvemurā śaileyacambake || 8.155 || mustā vacā ca karpūraṃ pratyekaṃ palasammitam | piṣṭvā sarvaiṣadighaṭe nikṣipetkamalāsana || 8.156 || vāyavīye sarvagandha dravyāṇāṃ kṣepaṇaṃ ghaṭe | karpūraṃ kuṅkumaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ māṃsī malayajaṃ muram || 8.157 || priyaṅgu kesaraṃ mustā tamālaṃ nāgakesaram | māladvayaṃ cakaccoraṃ suraparṇikaresaram || 8.158 || uśīraṃ tagaraṃ lodhraṃ tathaiva haricandanam | agurudvayaṃ sitaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ kāleyaṃ granthipallavam || 8.159 || mukulaṃ campakasyeti pratyekaṃ palasammitam | cūrṇīkṛtaṃ samastaṃ ca nya syedgandhodake ghaṭe || 8.160 || mālauṣadhighaṭe śārve mālauṣadhisamarpaṇam | vyāghrīsiṃhī balā cāgniśśarapuṅkhā śatāvarī || 8.161 || bilvamūlaṃ vacā śuṇṭhī koraṇḍaṃ śatamūlikā | pratyekaṃ palamānānsyuḥ piṣṭvā kumbhe vinikṣipet || 8.162 || maṅgalodakavastūnāmalābhe candanaṃ varam | sarvauṣadhīnāmetāsāmalābhe kuṣṭhamiṣyate || 8.163 || alābhe sarvagandhānāṃ śasyate candanaṃ varam | mālauṣadhīnāṃ sarvāsāmalābhe śasyate balā || 8.164 || adhidaivaṃ samabhyarcya uddhṛtya snāpayetkramāt | pūrvādidikṣu prathamamāgneyādi tataḥparam || 8.165 || viṣṇornukamiti procyasnāpayenmaṅgalāmbhasā | oṣadhya iti mantreṇa sarvaiṣadhijalena ca || 8.166 || nārāyaṇānuvākena sarvagandhāmbubhirharim | yā oṣadhītimantreṇa mālauṣadhijalai stataḥ || 8.167 || astraśuddhodakaissnāyāddvidyayāṣṭākṣarātmanā | pādyapūrvaṃghṛtāntaṃca snānaṃ deve yathāpuram || 8.168 || uttamottamametattusnapanaṃ parikīrtitam | ardhaśuddhodakairhīnaṃ bhaveduttamamadhyamam || 8.169 || sarvaśuddhodakairhīna muttamādhama miṣyate | viṃśatiḥ pañca ca brahman saṅkṣkepe kalaśā matāḥ || 8.170 || catuśśataṃ ca vistāre saptatiśca tri ruttaram | dravyāṇā matha sarveṣāṃ kathayāmyadhidevatāḥ || 8.171 || ghṛtasya paramātmā ca vāsudevo'dhidevatā | uṣṇodakumbhe puruṣa ssatyassyāttu phalodake || 8.172 || acyuto mārjane devastvanantaścākṣatodake | ratnodake keśavassyāllohe nārāyaṇasmsṛtaḥ || 8.173 || gandhodake mādhavassyādgovindassyādyavodake | pādyodake bhavedviṣṇu rarghye ca madhusūdanaḥ || 8.174 || trivikra mastathā cāme pañcagavyeṣu vāmanaḥ | dadhini śrīdharo devo hṛṣīkeśaḥ payasyapi || 8.175 || madhunaḥ padmanābhassyāddāmodaraḥ kaṣāyake | gulodake varāhassyāt nṛsiṃhaścaikṣavodake || 8.176 || śrīdharo nālikerasya hayāsya śśāntivāriṇaḥ | vāsudevo maṅgalasya kumbhasya kamalāsana || 8.177 || sarvaiṣadhyambukalaśe devassaṅkarṣaṇasmsṛtaḥ | pradyumna ssarva gandhasya mālauṣadhye'niruddhakaḥ || 8.178 || mūrtireteṣu kumbheṣu sāṅgapīṭhaṃ samarcayet | śuddhodakeṣu sarveṣu nārāyaṇasamarcanam || 8.179 || dhānyānāṃ kalaśānāṃ ca devatā syādvasundharā | kurcānāṃ daivataṃ cāstraṃ cakrakāṇāṃ sudarśanam || 8.180 || pāsaso daivataṃ viṣṇu ssarveṣāṃ vā janārdanaḥ | ityevaṃ snapanaṃ proktaṃ navadhā tava padmaja || 8.181 || eṣāmanya tamena syātsnānaṃ vittānusārataḥ | pañcamyāṃ snapanaṃ viṣṇo ryathokta phalamaśnute || 8.182 || trijanmarkṣe daśaguṇaṃ śravaṇe dviguṇaṃ bhavet | triguṇaṃ śaśinaḥ pūrtau kṣaye śataguṇaṃ bhavet || 8.183 || caturguṇaṃ syāddvādaśyāṃ triguṇaṃ tārakātraye | saṅkrāntyāṃ ṣaḍguṇaṃ caiva viṣuve triguṇaṃ bhavet || 8.184 || ayane dakṣiṇe snāna mekaṃ śataguṇaṃ bhavet | ayane'nyatra vihite sahasraguṇa āplavaḥ || 8.185 || vidau vidhuntudagraste snānaṃ triṃśadguṇaṃ hareḥ | sūrye śatasahasraṃ tu yugānte koṭisammitam || 8.186 || anantaṃ syādvyatīpāte kāleṣveteṣu pūjanam | anantaroktaphaladaṃ kalpate caturāsana || 8.187 || aṣṭottareṇa kumbhānāṃ śatena kamalāsana | snapanaṃ kathyate viṣṇo ryathāvadavadhāryatām || 8.188 || brāhmadivya mānuṣeṣu bhāgeṣu triṣu bhāgayoḥ | ādyayoḥ sphālayetsūtrāṇyekādaśa pṛthak kṣitau || 8.189 || prāgāyatāni tiryakca tatra madhye ca dikṣu ca | catvāri catvāryaṣṭāsu kumbhasthānāni vīdhikāḥ || 8.190 || anyāni kuryādevaṃ caṣaṭtriṃśatkoṣṭhakaṃ bhavet | tatra kumbhāṃ stoyapūrṇān vinyasenmānuṣe pade || 8.191 || bhāge nava navāśāsu kumbhānaṣṭasu kalpayet | aṣṭottaraśataṃ kumbhāssaṃpadyanaitathā sati || 8.192 || brāhme tu madhyame sthāne kalaśānāṃ catuṣṭaye | ekasmin dravyamāghāraṃ śiṣṭaṃ śuddhodakaṃ trikam || 8.193 || divye tu bhāge prācīne kalaśānāṃ catuṣṭaye | ekasminnuṣṇamu dakaṃ diśyagne ratnaśambaram || 8.194 || yāmyephalodakaṃ lauhaṃ nairṛtyāmatha vāruṇe | mārjanaṃ vāyubhāgetu gandhatoya mudagdiśi || 8.195 || akṣatodakamīśāne yavambhaḥkathitā nava | dravyakumbhā bahirbhāge mānuṣe pūrvavatpade || 8.196 || pādyādi dravyakalaśāḥ pūrvādiṣu yathoditāḥ | kalpanīyā yathāpūrvamuddṛtya snāvayetkramāt || 8.197 || kumbhairekonapañcāśa tsaṅkhkyairanyadudīryate | candanārdrāṇi sūtrāṇi daśa prāgāyatāni ca || 8.198 || tathodagāyatāni nyusthsāpyāni kamalāsana | madhye navasu koṣṭheṣu vinyasetkalaśānnava || 8.199 || dikṣu pratidiśaṃ kumbhān ṣaṭsu koṣṭheṣu tāvataḥ | vinyasecca turaḥ kumbhān vidikṣvapi pṛthakpṛthak || 8.200 || vīdhayo'nyāni koṣṭhāni dravyāṇi ca yathāpuram | kumbhānāṃ pañcaviṃśatyā snānamanyadudīryate || 8.201 || pūrvavaddaśa sūtrāṇi sphālayitvā bhuvasthsale | madhye navasu koṣṭheṣu navakumbhān prakalpayet || 8.202 || prāgādidikṣu pratyekaṃ kalaśāṃ strīnpra kalpayet | āgneyādiṣu kumbhānāṃ koṇeṣvekaikalpanam || 8.203 || dvau dvau purvādiṣu ghaṭau pārśvataḥ kevalodakau | aṣṭā tānvarjayitvānye dravyakumbhā yathoditāḥ || 8.204 || madhyame kumbhanavake yathokta dravyapūraṇaṃ | gandhadravyaiḥ pūrayedvākalaśānvañcaviṃśatim || 8.205 || candanāguru kāśmīra kuṣṭha tagara vīraṇaiḥ | asitāguruṇā cāpi haricandanavāriṇā || 8.206 || hrībherakardamenāpi navamena ghaṭānnava | madhyādīśānaparyantaṃ pūrayetkamalāsana || 8.207 || tamālasitakuṣṭhābhyāṃ suraparṇīrajaḥ kaṇaiḥ | karpūranāgasumanomustācampakakuṭmalaiḥ || 8.208 || priṅgupuṣpakāleyagrandhivallavabhījakaiḥ | māṃsīkharjūraśaileya hrīberaiśca suradrumaiḥ || 8.209 || mureṇa tairyathā yogaṃ bahiṣṭhānapi ṣoḍaśa | hitvā bahirvi dikkumbhān yadvānyaissnāpayeddharim ||
