8.210 || sphālayennava sūtrāṇi yathā pūrvaṃ bhuvasthsale | brāhmasthāne catuṣkoṣṭhe vinyaseccaturo gharṭā || 8.211 || dvau dvau syātāṃ ca pūrvādi dikṣvaukaikaṃ vidikṣu ca | ratnaṃ lohaṃ tathā gandhamāghāraṃ ca yathā kramam || 8.212 || dravyāṇi kumbheṣvāgneya koṇādi stheṣvanu kramāt | bahiraindra pade koṣṭhe dvayoḥkalaśayoryathā || 8.213 || pādyamarghyaṃ tathāgneya koṇe dadhighaṭo bhavet | yāmye cācamanīyaṃ prāksañcagavyaṃ ca paścime || 8.214 || koṇe tu nairṛte kṣīraṃ paścime tu ghaṭadvaye | dakṣiṇe'kṣatamanyatra mārjanāmbhastathānile || 8.215 || koṇe madhu tathā saumye kaṣāyāṃ ca kuśodakam | yapodakaṃ śārvakoṇe dravyaiḥ padyādibhiḥ kramāt || 8.216 || yugbhiṣṭoḍaśabhissūktaiḥ pauruṣai ssnāpayeddharim | kumbhairdvādaśabhirvāpi caturbhirmadhyamasthitaiḥ || 8.217 || katnena lohena tathā sarvagasthena sarpiṣā | pūrtairbahirindrādi koṣṭhasthairaṣṭabhirghaṭaiḥ || 8.218 || prācīmārabhya pādyena dadhyarghyakṣīrapūritaiḥ | tathaipācamanīyena madhunā pañcagavyakaiḥ || 8.219 || phalodakena yadvānyairdravyairdvādaśasammitaiḥ | madhye'gni koṇe koṣṭhena nairute'guruṇā'nile || 8.220 || grandhipallavabhījena śārve malayajāmbhasā | bahiḥkrameṇa pūrvādi dikṣvāṣṭāsu caturmukha || 8.221 || kāśmīrajena māṃsyā ca tamālena mureṇa ca | mūlena parvatotthena suravarṇīrajaḥkaṇaiḥ || 8.222 || campakaprasanakṣodaiḥ śarjūreṇa prapūritaiḥ | kalaśaissnāpayeddevaṃ navabhirvā vidheḥpade || 8.223 || prāgādidikṣu cāṣṭānu krameṇājyena vastunā | pādyena dadhnā cārghyeṇa kṣīreṇācamanāmbunā || 8.224 || madhunā pañcagavyena phalenāpi ca pūritaiḥ | ratnairvā navabhipūrṇaiḥ kumbhairnavabhirlāvaḥ || 8.225 || pañcabhirvā ghaṭairmadhye dikṣu prāgādiṣu sthitaiḥ | maṇibhiśca pravālaiśca muktābhiḥpūritaiḥkramāt || 8.226 || vajravaiḍūrya śakalairlohairvā pañcabhiśśubhaiḥ | pañcāmṛtairvā madhunā gulenājyena pūrayet || 8.227 || dadhnā ca payasā yadvā pañcagavyaiḥkramādbhavet | ekena vāharessnānaṃ dravyaiḥ pūrvoditairbhavet || 8.228 || vyastaissamastairvā vittaṃ deśakālānusārataḥ | deyā ca dakṣiṇā svarṇaniṣkāḥkalaśammitāḥ || 8.229 || ardhaṃ pādaṃ tadardhaṃ vā yathāvittānusārataḥ | snapanaṃ dakṣiṇāhīnaṃ niṣphalaṃ phalakāminaḥ || 8.230 || kartustasmāddakṣiṇā ca deyā'lpāpi phalārthibhiḥ | iti śrīpāñcarātre mahopaniṣadi pādmasaṃhitāyāṃ caryāpāde mahābhiṣekonāmāṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ |
<4.9>
brahmā niyakto'haṃ prajāssraṣṭu tvayā kaiṭabhasūdana | muhyāmi ca prajāssraṣṭuṃ kathaṃ kartavya mityaham || 9.1 || śrībhagavān devarājyātparibhraṣṭo devendro brahmahatyayā | māṃ samārādhya vidhinā prāptavānātmanaḥpadam || 9.2 || evamanye ca rājāno mamārādhanamuttamam | kṛtvā nirdhūya pāpāni pātakāni mahāntyapi || 9.3 || prāpurlokān suduṣprā pāniṣṭānatyayavarjitān | ekottareṇa kalaśaissaha sreṇābhi ṣecanam || 9.4 || pavitravastusahitaiḥ pavitrajalapūritaiḥ | ārādhanaṃ mama brahman prīṇanaṃ paramaṃ matam || 9.5 || pāpāpanodanaikāntaṃ sarvābhyudayasādhanam | prajānāmapi rāṣṭrasya rājñaścāyurvivardhanam || 9.6 || anuṣṭhitaṃ putrakāmaistathā vijayakāṅkṣibhiḥ | durbhikṣadurnimittādi ghorāṇāṃ śamanaṃ param || 9.7 || sarvasaṃpatkaraṃ sarva puruṣārdhaikasādhanam | ārādhanena tena tvaṃ māmārādhya yathāvidhi || 9.8 || nirmuktamoho niṣpāpaḥ prajāssraṣṭumapīśiṣe | brahmā sahasrakalaśasnānavidhiḥkīdṛkkathaṃ bhavet || 9.9 || pavitrāṇi ca vastūni kāni ko vā vidheḥkramaḥ | sthāpanaṃ kalaśānāṃ ca ko vā sthāpaka iṣyate || 9.10 || śrībhagavān dvātriṃśaddhasta vistāraṃ dviguṇenāyataṃ śubham | kalaśāspadabhū bhāgavaipulyānuguṇaṃ mahat || 9.11 || maṇṭapaṃ kalpayitvānyaddvārāṇi ca yathāvidhi | kalaśasthāpanābhūmiṃ pañcaviṃśatidhā samam || 9.12 || vibhajya sūtramārgeṇa madhyame brahmaṇaḥpade | ekāśītighaṭā sthsāpyādivye tu tadanantare || 9.13 || bhāge pratyekamāśāsu pūrvādicatasṛṣvapi | ekāśītighaṭāḥ sthāpyāḥ koṇe'pi ca catuṣṭaye || 9.14 || sthāpyāścai konapañcāśatpratyekaṃ mānuṣe punaḥ | bhāge ṣoḍaśa dikṣu syātpratyekaṃ pañcaviṃśatiḥ || 9.15 || vidhikāśca yathāyogaṃ kalpanīyāḥ pade pade | brāhme bhāge tu navake madhyame ca mahāghaṭe || 9.16 || sarvalohāni ratnāni sarvāṇi ca phalānica | sarvaiṣadhīṃśca sarvāṃśca gandhapūrṇāṃśca nikṣipet || 9.17 || śrīvatsādyāḥ pratikṛtīḥ kṛtvā niṣkapramāṇikāḥ | svarṇaṃ tāmraṃ ca rajayaṃ kevalaṃ caiva nikṣipet || 9.18 || śrīvatsaṃ vanamālāṃ ca śaṅkhaṃ cakraṃ gadāṃ tathā | padmaṃ śārṅgaṃ tathā khaḍga maṣṭau cihnāni śārṅgiṇaḥ || 9.19 || vāsobhyāṃ veṣṭite kumbhe vāsudevaṃ samarcayet | brāhma eva ca bhūbhāge parito navakāṣṭake || 9.20 || prācīna kumbhanavake madhyame kalaśe kṣipet | nūryākāntaṃ padmarāgaṃ puruṣastasya devatā || 9.21 || navakānāṃ tathānyeṣāṃ kramāddravyaṃ ca devatāḥ | kumbhasya vakṣyate brahman madhyamasya pṛthak pṛthak || 9.22 || vaiḍūrya mindrakāntaṃ ca dvayaṃ dravyaṃ tu devatā | vāsudevaścendra nīlo'pyayaskāntaśca taddvayam || 9.23 || devatā satyamūrtissyātpravālo vastu gāruḍam | saṅkarṣaṇo devatā syātpuṣyakaṃ sphaṭikadvayam || 9.24 || dravyaṃ devo'cyutaḥ padmarāgaḥ kanakameva ca | pradyumno devatā tasya vajraṃ rajatameva ca || 9.25 || ananto devatā tasya tāmraṃ muktā ca vastuni | devatā cāniruddhassyā tsarvakumbheṣu mauktikam || 9.26 || divye bhāge diśi prācyāmekāśītighaṭāspade | navake madhyame madhyakalaśe kadalīphalam || 9.27 || panasāmraṃ mātulaṅgaṃ havyajambākakesarāḥ | badarāṇi ca tatvātmā devatā tasya kathyate || 9.28 || devatā'dravyamanyatra navakeṣvaṣṭasūcyate | kramānmadhye ghaṭe dravyaṃ mātulaṅgaṃ sadāḍimam || 9.29 || pṛthivī devatā tasya jambā nāraṅgameva ca | devatā'pāmadiṣṭhātrī takkolailā phaladvayam || 9.30 || tejasvī puruṣo devaḥ kṣīrikāmalakadvayam | dravyaṃ devo jagatprāṇo drākṣā kharjūrajaṃ phalam || 9.31 || dravyaṃ viṣṇupadaṃ devacūtaṃ pārā ca dāḍimam | devo manaḥphalaṃ kṣudrapanasaṃ vastu devatā || 9.32 || ahaṅkāraḥphalaṃ bilvakadalyorvastu devatā | buddissarveṣu kumbheṣu badarāṇi ca nikṣipet || 9.33 || aṣṭākṣareṇa mantreṇa pañcopaniṣadā punaḥ | kumbhānāmapi sarveṣā mabhimantraṇamiṣyate || 9.34 || uśīraṃ kuṅkumaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ māṃsī malayajaṃ muram | hrīberamaguruṃ piṣṭvā kumbe tatra vinikṣipet || 9.35 || trailokyamohanaṃ deva marcayenmantravittamaḥ | navakeṣu tathā nyeṣu prācyādiṣu yathākramam || 9.36 || jalato vīraṇīmūlaṃ babhrurdevassa bhājyate | karpūrakāśmīramubhau dravyaṃ śauriśca devatā || 9.37 || campakaṃ mukulaṃ māṃsī dāsārhaścādhidevatā | candanaṃ candanaṃ rakta mannādhipatiracyutaḥ || 9.38 || nuraparṇī rajo mauraṃ kardamo vastu devatā | vaikuṇṭho girijaṃ mūlaṃ priyaṅgvāśca rajaḥkaṇāḥ || 9.39 || puruṣottamadaivatyaṃ kuṣṭhe dve dravyamucyate | mukundaḥkṛṣṇadhavalo vakrarūpī vṛṣākapiḥ || 9.40 || tamālapatraṃ sarveṣu nikṣipetpuruṣātmanā | pavamānādibhirmantrermantreyettān sakṛtsakṛt || 9.41 || tratyekaṃ gandha vastūni phalanyaṣṭai yathoditam | ekāśīti ghaṭagrāme vāruṇe brahmaṇaḥ pade || 9.42 || ghaṭe vāpīsaritkūpa hradavṛṣṭi himāpagāḥ | patyuḥ pāthāṃsi cāhṛtya taṭākasya ca nikṣipet || 9.43 || navakānāmathānyeṣā maṣṭānāṃ madhyame ghaṭe | pūrvoktānyeva vāpyādi nīrāṇi kramaśaḥkṣipet || 9.44 || madhyamārna dravyakalaśān sarvāneva prapūrayet | nalinīnirjharāmbhobhiḥ matsyakūrmāvapi dvayam || 9.45 || niṣkadvayaparicchinna kāñcanena vinirmitam | kalaśeṣveva navasu madhyameṣu vinikṣipet || 9.46 || matsyādi rūpiṇaṃ devaṃ varjayitvāca bhārgavam | yathoktakumbhanavake krameṇaiva sabhājayet || 9.47 || ekāśīti pade saumye madye navakamadhyame | yamagodhūmakavrīhi śālimudgapriyaṅgukān || 9.48 || māṣaśyāmākanīvārān kṣipettatra ca pūjayet | deveśaṃ garuḍārūḍhaṃ padmanābhaṃ yathāvidhi || 9.49 || dhānyāni tāni caikaika manyeṣvaṣṭasu nikṣipet | ghaṭeṣu madhyabhūteṣu kramātsarvatra śālayaḥ || 9.50 || pūjayedvanamālāṃ ca śaṅkhaṃ cakraṃ ca kaustubham | padmaṃ śārṅgaṃ gadāṃ khaḍgaṃ kramāduktaṃ ghaṭāṣṭake || 9.51 || paṅchā śatsuṭeṣvagnerekoneṣu tathā diśi | madhyamaṃ kumbhanavakamāghāreṇa prapūrayet || 9.52 || ṣaṭsvendreṣu ca gomūtraṃ kṣīraṃ yāmyeṣu puruṇe | dadhi ṣaṭsu tathā saumye gomayaṃ ṣaṭsu nikṣipet || 9.53 || caturṣu kumbheṣvāgneye koṇe vāpyuṣṇamucyate | nairute pañcagavyāni pañcāmṛtamathānile || 9.54 || aiśāne saktubhisteṣu nārāyaṇasabhājanam | nairṛttaukonapañcāśadghaṭeṣu brahmaṇaḥpade || 9.55 || tailena navakaṃ pūrya gandhādbhiṣṣaṭpurasthsitāḥ | ghaṭasāradravairyāmye lājaiḥkumbheṣu vāruṇe || 9.56 || saumye bhimantritāmbhobhiḥ koṇeṣu gulavāribhiḥ | yajeta teṣu kumbheṣu vāsudevaṃ jagadguram || 9.57 || mārudaikonapaṃcāñcāśadghaṭeṣu navakaṃ punaḥ | pūrya sarṣapatailena prācyāṃ ṣaṭpādyapāribhiḥ || 9.58 || yāmyeṣaḍarghyaiṣṣaṭkumbhāḥ pratīcyācamanāmbubhiḥ | ṣaṭsaimye maṅgalāmbobhiḥ pūrayetkamalāsana || 9.59 || koṇeṣvikṣurastestatra samārādhyo'niruddhakaḥ | eśānaikonapaṃcāśadghaṭeṣu brahmaṇaḥ pade || 9.60 || navakaṃ madhubhiḥpūrya prācyāṃ ṣaṭsarvagandhakaiḥ | śāntivāribhiranyatra ṣaṭkaṃ koṇe ca nairute || 9.61 || āgneye ca sthitāḥ kumbhā nālikerajalairapi | śārve ca vāyavīye ca pīyūṣairnālikerajaiḥ || 9.62 || yaṣṭapyo harireteṣu kumbheṣu kamalāsana | bhāge tu mānuṣe prācyāṃ kumbhānāṃ pañcaviṃśatiḥ || 9.63 || madhyamaṃ purayenmṛdbhirvakṣyamāṇābhiraṣṭabhiḥ | kṣetratīrthābdhiśaileṣu gajasūkarayorapi || 9.64 || valmīkavṛṣamormṛtsnānyasyate madhyame ghaṭe | aṣṭāsvanyeṣu kalaśeṣvekai kāṃ tāṃ vinikṣipet || 9.65 || arcyaśca keśavasteṣu kramādanyatra cocyate | sahadevī vacā caiva śatamūlā śatāvarī || 9.66 || kumārī ca gulūcī ca siṃhī vyāghrīti cāṣṭamī | mūlāni madhye cai teṣāṃ kalaśe madhyame kṣipet || 9.67 || ekaikamaṣṭāsvanyeṣu teṣu nārāyaṇārcanam | nyagrodhomambarāśvattha jambubhilva tvacāṃ rasāḥ || 9.68 || tathāpalāśamadhuka śirīṣāṇāmapi tvacaḥ | nyasanīyā ghaṭe madhye pratyekamitarāṣṭake || 9.69 || pūjyaścamādhavasteṣu tarūṇāṃ pallavā ime | palāśabilvavakula kadambāmraśirīṣajāḥ || 9.70 || nyagrodhāśvatthajāścāpi nyasanīyā vidheḥpade | ekaikamita reṣvarcyo govindo jātimallikaiḥ || 9.71 || priyaṅgu padmavakula nandyāvartaka campakāḥ | kundaṃ caitāni puṣāṇi nyasanīyāni madhyame || 9.72 || siddhārtho rājasiddhārtho vaṃśo gorocanāpi ca || 9.73 || indraveṇuryavaṣṣaṣṭhaśśamī ca caṇaka stathā | etāni madhyame kumbhe ekaikamiti reṣu tat || 9.74 || teṣu pūjyo madhuripusarassī ruhasambhava | tilamāraṇyaṃ kaṃ grāmyaṃ jīrakadvayameva || 9.75 || atasīsambhavaṃ caiva śatapuṣpaṃ kumārakam | ṛṣibījaṃ ca kalaśe madhyame'nyatra pūrvavat || 9.76 || teṣāṃ trivikramo devo yaṣṭavya ssāṅgapīṭhakaḥ | śyāmākaṣṣāṣṭikaśśālī nīvārasya ca taṇḍulāḥ || 9.77 || durvākuśendra vallīnāmaṅku rāḥ pippalasya ca | nyasyante madhyame kumbhe kumbheṣva nyatra pūrvavat || 9.78 || devatā vāmanasteṣu kuśā divyauṣadhāstrayaḥ | kāśā mūlamuśirasya śarapuṅkhasya mūlikā || 9.79 || mūlikāsta garasyāpi tathāpāmārgamūlikā | te madhye ca ghaṭe sarve ghaṭeṣvanyatra pūrvavat || 9.80 || devatā śrīdharasteṣāṃ tulasyau ca sitāsite | veṇukesariṇoḥpatre patre ketakabilvayoḥ || 9.81 || śamīparṇaṃ tathā jātermadhyame'nyatra pūrvavat | devatā ca hṛṣīkeśo dvayaṃ mustākacorakam || 9.82 || kumudotpalayoḥ kandaṃ kahloraṃ śītalīyakam | nyasyenmadhye kuvalayaṃ kumbheṣvaṣṭasu pūrvavat || 9.83 || teṣāṃ devaḥ padmanābho mudgamāṣayavāṅkurāḥ | niṣpāvatuvarīvrīhikulutthānāmathāṅkurāḥ || 9.84 || āḍhakasya ca kumbhānāṃ madhyame'nyatra pūrvavat | dāmodarārcanaṃ tatra śaṅkha puṣpī balā tathā || 9.85 || viṣṇukrāntā sadābhadrā padmamekadalaṃ varam | sahā ca saha devā ca nyasanīyāḥvidheḥpade || 9.86 || anyatra pūrvavatpūjyo yajñanārāyaṇo bhavet | svetārkaśca tathaivāgnibhadrā brahmasuvarcalā || 9.87 || sarasā ca viraktā ca pṛśniparṇī sthirā tathā | eraṇḍakaṃ ghaṭe madhye anyatra syādyathā puram || 9.88 || arcanīyo haristatra sūrabhiḥ padmakesaraṃ | patramelā lavaṅgatva ṅnāgakesarameva ca || 9.89 || latājātiphale madhye nyasanīyā vidheḥpade | ekaikamitareṣu syātteṣu kṛṣṇaśca devatā || 9.90 || suvarṇaṃ rajataṃ tāmraṃ pratyekaṃ niṣṭapañcakam | kṛtvā padmākṛtiṃ kāṃsyaṃ darpaṇaṃ caṣakāni ca || 9.91 || ayolavitrādyākāraṃ trapuṃ sīsakapittale | trayaṃ prakṛtirūpeṇa nyasyate madhyame ghaṭe || 9.92 || pratyekamitareṣvetaddhaya grīvo'dhidaivatam | kumbheṣvanyeṣu sarveṣu pūraṇaṃ gandhapāribhiḥ || 9.93 || sahasrakalaśassnāne deśikā bahavaḥ smṛtāḥ | catvāro dviguṇaṃ vāpi teṣāṃ ṣoḍaśa ṛtvijaḥ || 9.94 || puṇyāhaṃ vācayitvānvagadhidevārcanaṃ bhavet | pañcopaniṣadairmantraissahasraṃ sarpiṣāhutīḥ || 9.95 || śāntyarthaṃ mūlamantreṇa juhuyātsamidādibhiḥ | yāvadrajobhirhāridraissnapanaṃ madhuvidviṣaḥ || 9.96 || mṛtsnābhirmānuṣe bhāge prakramya brahmaṇaḥpade | ratnodakāntaṃ kalaśaissahasreṇābhiṣecanam || 9.97 || mṛdā viṣṇornukamiti snapanaṃ mūlavāribhiḥ | tadviṣṇoriti devasya kaṣāya kalaśāmbabhiḥ || 9.98 || prathadviṣṇuritīśasya vidyayā pallavāmbabhiḥ | devasya tveti kusumaistavāmityapisarṣapaiḥ || 9.99 || druvaḥ pātviti mantreṇa snapanaṃ tilavāribhiḥ | bhadraṃ karṇetimantreṇa ṣāṣṭikāmbubhirāplavaḥ || 9.100 || na te viṣṇuriti snānaṃ kuśa mūlāmbabhirhareḥ | irāvatīti mantreṇa tulasīdalavāribhiḥ || 9.101 || mustāmbubhirato devā avantviti caturmukha | idaṃ viṣṇuriti snānaṃ uṣṇaistrīṇipadeti ca || 9.102 || śaṅkhapuṣpāmbubhiśce tairviṣṇoḥ karmāṇi paśyata | tadviṣṇoḥ paramiti surabhyādijalai stathā || 9.103 || tidviprāsa itisnānaṃ lohaurbhāge nṛṇāmapi | divye bhāge tu paurastye ekāśīti ghaṭāspade || 9.104 || prāgādi brahma bhūmyantaṃ krameṇa snānamiṣyate | ainṭre phalāmbubhiḥ snānaṃ yajñāyajñīyamantrakam || 9.105 || krameṇa mantrāḥ kathyante dravya kumbhāṣṭake yathā | indrāviṣṇupade mantro manīṣāpadalakṣitaḥ || 9.106 || paṣaṭte viṣṇurityeta ttisro vāca itīdṛśaḥ | iṣetvorjeti mantreṇa sāvitrī tvamasīti ca || 9.107 || yasminviśvāni vidya ca parjanyāyeti lakṣitaḥ | ekāśītapade yāmye snānaṃ gandhodakairghaṭaiḥ || 9.108 || nārāyaṇānuvākasya ṛgbhiraṣṭābhirāditaḥ | vyastābhiraṣṭabhissnānaṃ sarvābhi rmadhyamena tu || 9.109 || digbhāge paścime brahma nne kāśīti phaṭāspade | prāgādi brahmabhūmyantaṃ snānaṃ vāpyādibhirjalaiḥ || 9.110 || mantrāḥ krameṇa vakṣyante pratidravya ghaṭāplavam | yā āpa iti mantreṇa sindhudvīpetividyayā || 9.111 || ete śatamṛcā snānamimaṃ me varuṇeti ca | śaṃ no devīrabhītyeṣa yāsāṃ rājeti mantrataḥ || 9.112 || samudra jyeṣṭha mantreṇa yāsāṃ deveti vidyayā | sūktena vāruṇenaiva snānaṃ dravya ghaṭairi ti || 9.113 || ekāśīti ghaṭe saumye vūrvādyabjapadāvadhi | dhānyāni vastu kumbhānāṃ navānāṃ mantra ucyate || 9.114 || trātāra mindrasāmnā camantaścātvā vahantviti | mantrojitaṃ ta ityeṣa āpo vahati lakṣitaḥ || 9.115 || mantraśca tāvatī tyeṣa sa tvaṃ no agnirityṛcā | tvaṃ no agna iti ca mahāvyāhṛtaya stathā || 9.116 || aṇoraṇīyānityanto mantraḥ snāna vidau kramāt | ekona pañcāśatkumbheṣvagneḥ koṇe yathākramam || 9.117 || gomūtrādi ghaṭe snāne mantrāṇaṃ kathyate kramaḥ | gāyatrī prathamā tāsāṃ payovrata manantaram || 9.118 || dadhikrāvṇeti ca snānaṃ gandhadvārāmitīdṛśam | viṣṇorarāṭamiti ca mūrdhānaṃ diva ityṛcā || 9.119 || hiraṇyagarbhamantreṇa āpyāyasveti vidyayā | ghṛtasnā teti mantraśca ghṛtasnānavidhau kramaḥ || 9.120 || ekonapañcāśatkumbhe pade nirṛtigocare | mantrāḥkrameṇa vakṣyante vastukumbherathāplave || 9.121 || rakṣoghnamiti sāmādyaṃ pavitranta itīti ca | bhagavān vāsudeveti sāmavedavratāhvāyam || 9.122 || vai rājasāma kathitaṃ tathā caiva parājitāḥ | kathyate vāyukoṇe'pi mantrāssnāsavidau tathā || 9.123 || dvādaśākṣaramantraśca drupadā diva ityasau | aṣṭākṣarāhvayo mantraśśannodevīriti smṛtaḥ || 9.124 || hiraṇyapāṇiriti ca vedāhamiti ca kramāt | īśānakoṇe mantrokti rānoniyuriti smṛtaḥ || 9.125 || śrīsūktaṃ madhu mānnaśca madhunakta itīti ca | madhuvāteti koṇeṣu mantraklṛptirudāhṛtā || 9.126 || brāhmepade tu sūktasya pauruṣasyāditaḥkramāt | aṣṭāsu dravyakumbhānāmaṣṭānāṃ mantra iṣyate || 9.127 || madhyame navake pūrvamaṣṭābhiśśuddhavāribhiḥ | snāpayenmūlamantreṇa sahasreṇa ghaṭairiti || 9.128 || snāpite devadeveśe paścādratnaghaṭāmbubhiḥ | nūktena pauruṣeṇaina snāpayeddeśikassvayam || 9.129 || ghaṭaiśśuddhodakainyaissnapanaṃ mūlavidyayā | haridrācūrṇasaṃpūrṇaiḥpañcaviṃśatibhirghaṭaiḥ || 9.130 || snapanaṃ saptadaśabhiryadvāṣoḍaśasaṃmitaiḥ | yadvā dvādaśabhiḥ kāryaṃ navabhirvā yathāvasu || 9.131 || ārādhya devamucitaṃ nivedya ca mahāhaviḥ | homassahastrerājyena samidbhirmūlavidyayā || 9.132 || annaiśchaturvidhaiścaiva pratyṛcaṃ puruṣātmanā | sūktena tuṣṭiṃ vastrādyairde śikānāmanantaram || 9.133 || sahasrakalaśasnāne tatsaṅkhyā svarṇadakṣiṇā | tadardhamadhavā pādo yathāśraddhaṃ yathāvasu || 9.134 || yāvatī dakṣiṇā teṣāṃ syādardhamatha ṛtvijām | sahasraṃ brāhmaṇā nannairbhojayeddakṣiṇāmapi || 9.135 || tadyāttuṣṭikarīmanyānāgatānapi toṣayet | sevāṃ kurvantiye martyāśśraddhābhaktisamanvitāḥ || 9.136 || devasya snānasamaye sahasrakalaśāmbubhiḥ | gaṅgādi saritāṃ snānaphalamaśnuvate mahat || 9.137 || sahasra kalaśasnāne yatphalaṃ rājarāṣṭrayoḥ | pūjante tadaśeṣeṇa prāguktamiti nocyate || 9.138 || mahotsavaphalanaitatkiñcittulyaphalaṃ smṛtam | iti śrīpāñcarātre mahopaniṣadi pādme tantre caryāpāde sapāsrakalaśābhiṣeka vidhirnāma navamo'dhyāyaḥ |
<4.10>
brahmā kathaṃ mahotsavaḥ kaścit kīdṛktasya phalaṃ ca kim | phalakāmairanuṣṭhātumavijñāto na śakyate || 10.1 || mahyaṃ jijñāsamānāya prasīda bhagavannidam | ākhyātumarhasi yathā mahotsava manuttamam || 10.2 || śrībhagavān ārādhanamidaṃ brahman mokṣakāmai ranuṣṭitam | paśvādiphalakāmaistu duranuṣṭheyamadbhutam || 10.3 || toṣaṇaṃ mama kalyāṇa manuṣṭhitamamānuṣam | devaireva purāvṛtravadhe tatpāpanuttaye || 10.4 || indreṇāpi diviṣṭhena māmuddiśya kṛtaṃ śubham | rūpaṃ tasya pravakṣyāpi yathā tadavadhāraya || 10.5 || savassāṃsārikaṃ duḥkhamuttaranti tadambhudhim | yaṣṭāra iti vidvaṃso nirbruvantyutsavāhvayam || 10.6 || nityo naimittikaḥ kāmya strividha ssa mahotsavaḥ | tatra nityaṃ pratisamaṃ māsapakṣavyavasthayā || 10.7 || śubhe ca tathinakṣatre viṣuve cāyanadvaye | kalpitāvabhṛthasnānassevitassarvadaivataiḥ || 10.8 || naimittika ssa vijñeyo nimitte sati kalpitaḥ | avagrahe ca durbhikṣe colkāpāte tathā niśi || 10.9 || darśane suracāpanya vālamīnasya darśane | devatā pratikāyānāṃ kampane bhedane tathā || 10.10 || hasane calane caiva rodane patane tathā | gopurālayasālānāṃ maṇṭapasya ca bhedane || 10.11 || bhaṅge vā patane vāpi parvatānāṃ tathaiva ca | nipāte caityavṛkṣasya bhaṅge jvalanadarśane || 10.12 || vṛkṣe tvanyaphale dṛṣṭe divā nakṣatradarśane | bhūtādidarśane ghore bhūmikampe tathaiva ca || 10.13 || digdāhe ca mahāvāte mahāvṛṣṭai tathaiva ca | grahayuddhe ca sañjāte pratisūryasya darśane || 10.14 || nṛpe rogābhibhūte ca grāme janapade tathā | masūrikādi ghorāṇāṃ vyādhīnāṃ ca praveśane || 10.15 || paracakrapraveśe ca vyomni nemisvane tathā | divyadundibhi nirhrade nirmale gagane sati || 10.16 || varṣevā'śanipāte ca śakradhvajanipātane | jale'gnijanane caiva tathaivādbhutadarśane || 10.17 || evamādau mahotpātenaimittika mahotsavaḥ | caturṇāṃ puruṣārthānā muddiśyānyatamaṃ phalam || 10.18 || utsavonuṣṭhitaḥ kāmyassaṅkalpitaphalapradaḥ | kathyate'vabhṛthasnānasamayastrividhotsave || 10.19 || māsarkṣe viṣuve caiva grahaṇe cāyanadvaye | darśe ca pūrṇamāsyāṃ ca śravaṇe sarvamāsike || 10.20 || rohiṇyāṃ ca punarvasvoḥ pratiṣṭhādivase tathā | rājñāṃ janmadine kuryādabhiṣekadine tathā || 10.21 || ete ṣvavabhṛthasnānaṃ brahman sarvārthasādhanam | māsena vā tadardhena dvādaśāhena vā punaḥ || 10.22 || navāhenotsavaḥ kāryaḥ ssaptāhena caturmukha | ahobhiḥ pañcabhi rvāpi tribhirvaikena vā punaḥ || 10.23 || ekāhe tryahake dhīmān dhvajakarmana kārayet | saṅkalpapūrvamālocya māsaṛkṣe tathā tithau || 10.24 || tīrthāvagāhanaṃ yadvā saṃyoga tithitārayoḥ | viṣuve cāyane caiva nādarastithi tārayoḥ || 10.25 || duṣṭavārādi saṃyoge śubhameva yathoditam | pattane nagare grāme pratilomā'nadhiṣṭhite || 10.26 || aśūnye balidānādīn rathyāsu bahirācaret | nocedāvaraṇeṣveva kuryādantarmahotsavam || 10.27 || grāmādi rahite dhāmni notsavaṃ bahirācaret | antarāvaraṇeṣvena na tu tyājyaṃ kathaṃ cana || 10.28 || pāstveṅge ca svatantre ca dhāmanyutsava sampadi | yaugapadye na doṣasyāddoṣo vāstvaṅgayordvayoḥ || 10.29 || svatantraṃ paratantraṃ ca āśrayaṃ samudāhṛtam | uttamādivibhedena ālayastrividhobhavet || 10.30 || viṣṇvālayaṃ purā''kalya paścādgrāmādi kalpanam | svantramiti vijñeya mālayaṃ tūttamaṃ bhavet || 10.31 || grāmādikaṃ pūrā''kalpya paścādālayakalpanam | asvatantramiti khyātamālayaṃ madhyamaṃ bhavet || 10.32 || svatantrālaya klṛptāsu rathyāvīdhīṣu padmaja | antare sthāpitaṃ yatta dāśrayaṃ tvadhamālayam || 10.33 || svatantre paratantre vā utsavādau kṛte sati | pūrvaṃ svatantre kartavyaṃ vāstvaṅge dviguṇārcanam || 10.34 || āśrayādiṣu bimbeṣu utsavādau kṛte sati | tattadāvaraṇe kuryā dbāhyavīdhyāṃ tu nācaret || 10.35 || mohādvā yadivā lobhā dviparīte kṛte sati | arātibhiḥ paribhavo mahāvyādhyādipīḍanam || 10.36 || prāṅgaṇaeṣu ca sarveṣu prāsādādiṣu mūrtiṣu | prītyābhiṣekamātraṃ ca snapanādyutsavaṃ vinā || 10.37 || kārayedyadi sammohātprajānāṃ pīḍanaṃ tathā | tasmātsarvaprayatnena viparītaṃ tu nācaret || 10.38 || anyathā kārayenmohādrājā rāṣṭraṃ ca naśyati | grāmāśrayādibherāṇāmālayāśrayakeṣu ca || 10.39 || grāmavastu balihīnaṃ kevalotsavamācaret | devatāntarakalyāṇe vartamāne'pi vaiṣṇavam || 10.40 || kuryāddevotsavaṃ naiva vaiṣṇave'nyaṃ kadācana | vāsudevo hi devānāṃ devatāmnāyate yataḥ || 10.41 || utsave devadevasya dhvajārohaṇapūrvake | pravartite devayāge caulādi rnaiva saṃskriyā || 10.42 || grāmādyanaṅgāyatane pravṛtte'pyutsave punaḥ | kuryāddevāntaraṃ yāgaṃ caulādiṃ caiva saṃskriyāṃ || 10.43 || toraṇādīni cānyeṣāṃ devānāmutsave satām | utpāṭya rathyāsu hare rutsavo nānyathā bhavet || 10.44 || klṛptānāmutsave viṣṇo rathyādiṣvitarotsave | sthirāṇāṃ toraṇādīnāṃ kuryaṃ notpāṭanaṃ bhavet || 10.45 || adhike māsi śukrādau gurau ca stamite sati | notsavaḥ prathamaḥkalpyaḥ kalpane rājarāṣṭrayoḥ || 10.46 || prajānāṃ caiva duḥkhaṃ syā dvyādhirvā mṛtireva vā | utsave ca dvidīyādau noktadoṣaḥ kathañcana || 10.47 || māsādāvutsavadine pañcāhāvadhike kramāt | dhvajārohaṇakālastu brahmannadya pradarśyate || 10.48 || ekonaviṃśatitame dine tīrthāṅkurārpaṇāt | aṣṭādaśadine vāpi prāgeva samaye śubhe || 10.49 || vainateyadhvajārohāddvādaśāhe'thavā bhavet | yadvā kalyāṇa divasaṃ triguṇīkṛtya tāvatām || 10.50 || ādau dinānāṃ kartavyaṃ dhvajārohaṇamabjaja | aṅkurānaparyayitvāhni puṇye purve yathodite || 10.51 || dhvajamāropayetpaścānmaṅgalaṃ maṅgale dine | daivādvāmānuṣādvāpi kutaścitkāraṇādyadi || 10.52 || utsavāhargaṇā tpūrvaṃ yathoktaina kṛte dhvaje | utsavārambhaṇadine divā''ropya dhvajaṃ niśi || 10.53 || bherītāḍanamanvakca pālikāsvaṅkurān kṣipet | aghoṣya bherīṃ prathamaṃ dhvajārohaṇamanvataḥ || 10.54 || tato'ṅkurārpaṇaṃ yadvā yadvā niśyaṅkurārpaṇam | pradoṣe'nvagdhvajāroho bherītāḍanamanvataḥ || 10.55 || tatkāle'pi dhvajārohe traividhyaṃ caturāsana | tantūtthaṃ kṣaumavasanaṃ nirdeṣaṃ sūkṣmamāhṛtam || 10.56 || kārpāsaṃ vā yathāvittaṃ dhvajārthe kalpayedbudhaḥ | āyataṃ daśabhirhastai rvistīrṇaṃ pañcabhirdṛḍham || 10.57 || navabhirvāṣṭabhirvāpi saptabhirvā caturmukha | mūlabherasamāyāmaṃ dvārāyāma mathāpi vā || 10.58 || āyāmārdhena vistīrṇaṃ pādena kṛte śekharam | śekhareṇa samaṃ pucchaṃ tadardhaṃ karṇapuccakam || 10.59 || nirṇejitaṃ khalīyuktaṃ śoṣitaṃ lakṣaṇānvitam | āhṛtya madhye vastrasya garuḍaṃ kāñcanaprabham || 10.60 || navatālapramāṇena dvibhujaṃ dhṛtañcukam | dhṛtapuṣpāñjalipuṭaṃ śvetāmbara dharaṃ vibhum || 10.61 || daṃṣṭrākarālavadanaṃ brukuṭīkuṭilekṣaṇam | nīlanāsāgrasaṃyuktaṃ kuñcitāsavyapādakam || 10.62 || pṛṣṭhe niviṣṭasarvāṅghriṃ pakṣavikṣepaśobhitam | gagane gamanārambhaṃ suvṛttaṃ ghoradarśanam || 10.63 || karaṇḍikāmukuṭinaṃ lalāṭe racitālakam | hārakeyūravalayanūvurābharaṇojjvalam || 10.64 || ananto vāmakaṭako yajñasūtraṃ tu vāsukiḥ | urasi nyastakārkoṭaṃ kaṭisūtritatakṣakam || 10.65 || bibhrāṇaṃ dakṣiṇe karṇe padmāhvayasarīsṛpam | mahāpadmaṃ tathānyatra śaṅkhaṃ śirasi bhoginam || 10.66 || gulikaṃ cāṅgade sarpaṃ varṇasteṣāṃ ca kadhyate | sphaṭikābhaśpoṇitābhaḥpītābhodhūmravarṇakaḥ || 10.67 || raktāmbuja nibhaśchaiva piṅgalastu hinaprabhaḥ | bhramarābhaḥ kramācchatraṃ muktāhema pariṣkṛtam || 10.68 || upariṣṭācca kartavyaṃ pārśvayoścāmaradvayam | adhastādambajaṃ purṇa kumbhamadbhiśca pālikāḥ || 10.69 || saṅkurā likhitavyāssyurdīpau dvau pārśvayordvayoḥ | pañcavarṇairlikhedeva mantaraṃ śyāmavarṇakam || 10.70 || antarālaṃca kṛṣṇena citraye ccitrakṛttamaḥ | dhvajārdhasammitāṃ caiva patākāṃ caiva citrayet || 10.71 || adhivāse dine prāpte tamisrāyāṃ gurussvayam | kāruśālāṃ praviśyātha kārayitvātha śilpinā || 10.72 || nayanonmīlanaṃ tasmin visṛṣṭe śilpinī psitaiḥ | arthaiśca toṣite saścā nikṣipya śirasi dhvajam || 10.73 || mūrtripasya suvarṇādi lohapātre samarpitam | prādakṣiṇyena dhāmādīnnī tvā tūrya nināditam || 10.74 || tataḥpraveśayedyāga maṇḍapaṃ deśikottamaḥ | nayanonmīlanādanya tpratiṣṭhāyāmivācaret || 10.75 || chāyādhivāsanaṃ sadyo jale kuryādyathāvidhi | kumbhaiṣṭoḍaśabhi śchāyāsnapanaṃ darpaṇe bhavet || 10.76 || pauruṣeṇaiva sūktena gāyatryā svasya pūjayet | śāyayecchāli bhārādāvāstīrṇe navavāsasi || 10.77 || śāyitasya paṭasyātha apasavye sahāṣṭabhiḥ | parito nyastakalaśairvardhanyā ca ghaṭaṃ kṣipet || 10.78 || āvāhya garuḍaṃ kumbhe karake ca sudarśanam | indrādīnaṣṭapūrvādi kalaśeṣu supūjayet || 10.79 || śodhayitvā ca garuḍaṃ paṭasthaṃ śoṣaṇādibhiḥ | saṃhṛtya tatvāni tataḥ kramādutpādya pakṣiṇam || 10.80 || caturṣu pārśva kuṇḍeṣu home sthaṇḍilabhūṣu vā | kuṇḍe mahānase vāpi samidhājyai ryathāpuram || 10.81 || śāntihomassparśanaṃ ca secanaṃ ca yathāpuram | paṭaṃ vistīrṇagaruḍaṃ mandirābhimukhaṃ yathā || 10.82 || pradarśyāpāhayettatra vyāhṛtyā sannidhiṃ tataḥ | prārthayeta gurustasya gādhayā vakṣyamāṇayā || 10.83 || mahābala mahābāho vainateya vayodhipa | sannidhatsva paṭe tubhyaṃ samaḥ praṇavamūrtaye || 10.84 || karmaṇāṃ siddhimāhotaḥ kuruṣva vihageśvara | ahutavyāstrayo lokā devasyotsava saṃpadi || 10.85 || yajedātmīya gāyatryā tamarghyādyupacaryayā | nivedayettatastasmai nivedyaṃ ca caturvidham || 10.86 || kumbhāya ca nivedyānnaṃ stotrergaruḍatoṣaṇam | vāhanāya mahāviṣṇo stārkṣyāyā mitatejase || 10.87 || garuḍāya samastubhyaṃ sarvasarpendra mṛtyave | namo namaste pakṣīndra svādhyāyavapuṣe namaḥ || 10.88 || vihagandre manaste'stu samutpāṭitakalpaka | āhṛtāmṛtakuṃbhāya jananīdāsyamocine || 10.89 || surāsurendrajayine nāgendrābharaṇāya te | yadādhārmidaṃ sarvaṃ tadādhārāya te namaḥ || 10.90 || pakṣau yasya bṛhatsāma rathantaramapi dvayam | akṣiṇī cāpi gāyatri trivṛtsāmaśiraḥ smṛtam || 10.91 || stoma ātmā namastasmai vāmadevyāṅgasampade | namaḥprāṇādi vāyūnā miśāya garuḍātmane || 10.92 || doṣānapayāyākhaṇḍan guṇānāvaha sarvataḥ | vighnāni jahi sarvāṇi ātmasātkūru māmapi || 10.93 || stutvaivaṃ gāruḍaṃ mantraṃ japedekāgramānasaḥ | turyāghoṣairvedaghoṣairjāgareṇa nayenniśām || 10.94 || nivedyaṃ kabalīkṛtya mantrayitvāca mantravit | pauruṣairgāruḍairmantrai rvasthyānāmapi yoṣitām || 10.95 || kṣipedañjiliṣu dhvātvā garuḍaṃ cācyutaṃ harim | bhakṣayitvā trayaḥ piṇḍān janayeyussutān bahūn || 10.96 || taṃ prabhāte samārādhya nivedya ca harviḥkramāt | vastrābharaṇa puṣpaistu paṭasthaṃ śobhayetkhagam || 10.97 || āropya hastipṛṣṭhe pārathe vānyatra maṅgale | śibhikādau nayedgrāmaṃ prādakṣiṇyena dhāma vā || 10.98 || bherīmṛdaṅgapaṭahauśśaṅkhakāhalacihnakaiḥ | ghoṣayetpuratastasya nṛttairgeyaiśca sarvataḥ || 10.99 || khageśa vādyayormadhye pālikāssaṅkurānvitāḥ | vaheyurbrāhmaṇāssarve śirobhissaṃyatendriyāḥ || 10.100 || bimbamautsavamanyacca garuḍasyāntike'thavā | icchayā yajamānasya sarvamaṅgalasaṃyutam || 10.101 || agrato balipīṭhasya bahirvā dhāma gopurāt | dhvajastambhaṃ khanedbhūmau nirdeṣaṃ dāravaṃ sthiram || 10.102 || antassāro bahissāro nissārastrividha staruḥ | kramukādi bahissāraṃ praśastaṃ viduruttamam || 10.103 || antassāraṃ candanādi praśastaṃ stambhakalpane | nissāraṃ varjayettsambhaṃ śatatālāyataṃ śubham || 10.104 || mānāṅgulapramāṇena viṃśatyūnamathāpi vā | prāsādocchrāyamathavā yadvā gopurusammitam || 10.105 || caturdhā vibhajettsambhamekāṃśenaiva mastakam | tasyacādhārabhūtānāṃ ccheditānāṃ tu mūlataḥ || 10.106 || trayāṇāmapi pīṭhānāṃ stambhāgre viniveśanam | āyatāni ca pūṭhāni dvitālena caturmukha || 10.107 || vistīrṇāni tadardhena tadardhena ghanāni ca | mūle sthūlāni sūkṣmāṇi cāgre yuñjīta bhūruhān || 10.108 || agre pīṭhadvayecchidre dhvajayaṣṇiṃ ca sskṛtām | niveśayecchidrayitvā dhvajastambhaṃ caturmukha || 10.109 || niveśayedveṇukaṃ vāsava vā saptapañca vā | itthaṃ bhūtaṃ dhvajastambhaṃ pīṭhasyottarapārśvataḥ || 10.110 || ārādhya vedavidvipraiḥ prāgagraṃ śāyayedguruḥ | yadvodagagraṃ prakṣālya stambhamabliṅgamantrataḥ || 10.111 || kuśaiśca sāgraiḥ pracchādya stambhamūrdhvamukhaiśśubhaiḥ | saṃveṣṭya darbhamālābhi rviṣṇusūktena deśikaḥ || 10.112 || dhvajastambhāvaṭe nyasya lohabījādi śodhitam | tatrāvaṭe dhvajastambhaṃ sthāpayitvādṛḍhaṃ yathā || 10.113 || prāsādābhimukhaṃ tasya veṇvagravivare dhvajam | pāśenāṅguṣṭhanāhena triguṇīkṛtya tantunā || 10.114 || dhvajaṃ niveśayedyadvā stambhamāruhya bandhayet | baddhadhvajāgrastambhaṃ vā sthāpayecchaktyapekṣayā || 10.115 || evaṃ niyojya yaṣṭyagre muhūrte śobhane guruḥ | pūrvāhṇe vātha madhyāhne dhvajamāropayettathā || 10.116 || badhvā puruṣamantreṇa sapatākaṃ saghaṇṭakam | suvarṇo'sīti mantreṇa dhvajasyāropaṇaṃ bhavet || 10.117 || prāsādābhimukhaṃ sthāpya khagendraṃ paṭasaṃsthitam | tūryaghoṣaṃ tathāmnāyaghoṣaṃ dikṣu ca ghopayet || 10.118 || khageśamālāmantrādīṃ statkāle deśiko japet | stambhamūlasthale vediṃ hastaissaptabhirāyatām || 10.119 || tāpadbhireva vistīrṇāmekahastasamucchṛtām | pañcabhirvā tribhirvāpi caturaśrāṃ prakalpayet || 10.120 || vedikāyāstṛtīyāṃśe madhye pīṭhaṃ prakalpayet | catuṣṭayāṅgulotsedhaṃ mekhalātrayasaṃyutam || 10.121 || bhāge tṛtīye tasyāpi padmamaṣṭadalai ryutam | karṇikāstho yathā stambhastathā kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥ || 10.122 || ṣoḍaśa stambhasaṃyuktā prapā syātparita stataḥ | caturdvārasamāyuktā darbhamālādyalaṅkṛtā || 10.123 || puṇyāhaṃ pācayitvātha prokṣayetkumbhavāriṇā | gāruḍenaiva mantreṇa kalaśaiścāṣṭabhi stathā || 10.124 || indrādyaiḥprokṣayet stambhaṃsvaisvairmantrairyathākramam | prārthayeta sthitiṃ tasya garuḍasya dhvajodare || 10.125 || utsavāvabhṛthaṃ yāvadgādhayā vakṣyamāṇayā | pakṣīndra pakṣavikṣepataraṅgānilasampadā || 10.126 || nirastāsurasannāha samare śatrusūdana | sannidhatsya paṭe yāvadutsavāvabhṛthāvadhi || 10.127 || utsavapratimāṃ yānamāropya śibhikādikam | dhvajastambhasamīporvīmānīyādarśayetkhagam || 10.128 || āhvonārthamaśeṣāṇāṃ lokānāṃ patageśvaram | niyujya devastadanu prāpnuyānmaṇḍapāvanim || 10.129 || ārādhayettrikālaṃ tu garuḍaṃ ca nivedayet | anirvāṇaṃ tathā dīpaṃ rakṣennaktaṃdivā sadā || 10.130 || utsavapratimāṃ tatra maṇḍape ca yathāvidhi | pūjayitvā nivedyātha havirhomāntamarcayet || 10.131 || rātrau tu pūjayitvaivaṃ bherītāḍana siddhaye | dhvajapīṭhasaṃya purataḥ kṣitiṃ gomayapāriṇā || 10.132 || ālipya caturaśraṃ ca sudhācūrṇaiścaśobhayet | caturaśraṃ dhānyapīṭhaṃ droṇapañcakaśālinā || 10.133 || kalpayitvā kālacakraṃ tasya madhye niveśayet | balyarcāmapitatraiva sthāpayeddhvaja sammukham || 10.134 || pūjayitvā nivedyātha havīṃṣi vividhāni ca | āpipte puratastasya bhūtale dhānyapīṭhake || 10.135 || tāvadeva mahābherīṃ veṣṭitāṃ navavāsasā | dakṣiṇetarayostasyā bherikāyā yathākramam || 10.136 || bhāgayorarcayedviṣṇuṃ śriyaṃ caiva yathāvidhi | triguṇāṃ prakṛtiṃ caiva madhyabhāge sabhājayet || 10.137 || muhūrte śobhane bherīṃ śabdatanmātravidyayā | koṇena tāḍayenmūrtitrayaṃ dhyāyedgurussvayam || 10.138 || tataḥ pāraśavassnāto darbhapāṇiralaṅkṛtaḥ | sopavītottarīyaśca vahan bherīmalaṅkṛtām || 10.139 || śaṅkhādivādyasahitāṃ tālabhedavidhānavit | ghoṣayedguruṇendrādau hūyamāne marudgaṇe || 10.140 || divyāyudhānāmāhvānaṃ tathā vaikuṇṭhavāsinām | tathā pāriṣadāssarve viṣvaksenābhirakṣitāḥ || 10.141 || āhvātavyā makhe tasmin kumudādyā ssanāyakāḥ | ṛṣibhiśca marīcyādyairbrahmalokanivāsibhiḥ || 10.142 || samāhvānaṃ viriñcasya rudralokanivāsibhiḥ | sārdaṃ pramathasārdhaiśca rudraśca vṛṣavāhanaḥ || 10.143 || āhvātavyāstathānye ca tattallokanipāsinaḥ | vāhanaiḥparivāraiśca sākaṃ tasmin mahūtsave || 10.144 || vidyāśca mūrtidhāriṇyastrayū caṅgairvapuṣmatī | ahvātavyāssamāhvānaṃ sarveṣāṃ ca svanāmabhiḥ || 10.145 || nityotsavārcaṃ parito vīdhikāsu sudarśanam | annarmūrtividhānaṃ ca pradīpairbahubhirvṛtam || 10.146 || gamayitvā pratidiśaṃ bherītāḍanapūrvakam | grāmamadhyaṃ samāsādya tatrāvāhya caturmukham || 10.147 || arcayitvā makhe tasmin yācitvā sannidhiṃ guruḥ | indrādīṃśca pratidiśaṃ balyarthaṃ sannidhiṃ tadā || 10.148 || arcayitvā tūryaghoṣaṃ ghoṣayitvāsvatālavat | anyatra gāruḍaṃ tālamantarāleṣu ghoṣayet || 10.149 || praviśya mandiraṃ tatra yathāpūrvaṃ niveśayet | ādāyotsavabimbaṃ vā kevalaṃ vā sudarśanam || 10.150 || annamūrtividhānaṃ vā bherīmādāya kevalām | rathyāsu devatāhvānaṃ tatra tatra yathāvidhi || 10.151 || devatāhvānavelāyāṃ bherīṃ śṛṇvantiye narāḥ | tairnadītaraṇaṃ naiva yānaṃ vā yojanātparam || 10.152 || anādṛtyotsavaṃ mohāddūraṃ yāyājjano yadi | sa yāti nirayasthānaṃ pretya duḥkhamihāpi ca || 10.153 || tasmādavabhṛthaṃ yāvadvasettatraiva no prajet | dhvajārthamaṅkurā yena nyastāssa yadi kāraṇāt || 10.154 || kutaścidasamartho vā mṛto vā deśikottamaḥ | śeṣaṃ samāpayedanyaḥ putro vā tadanujñayā || 10.155 || śiṣyo vā yadi vā brātā ṛtvikvā guṇavattaraḥ | iti śrīpāñcarātre mahopaniṣadi pādma saṃhitāyāṃ caryāpāde dhvajārohaṇa vidhirnāma daśamo'dhyāyaḥ |
<4.11>
śrībhagavān utsavārambhadivasādarvāgahani saptame | āṅkurānāvapellagne śobhane deśikottamaḥ || 11.1 || aṣṭottara śateṣveva pālikāsu yathāvidhi | ṣaṭtriṃśatsvatha vā paścādalaṅkāraṃ samācaret || 11.2 || kramukairdārujairvāpi toraṇai rvīdhikāmukham | catvārāṇi tathā greṣu gopurāṇāmalaṅkriyā || 11.3 || phalabhārāvanamrāśca kadalīkramukādayaḥ | pārśveṣu toraṇānāṃ syuḥ sthāpyā gamanavīdhayaḥ || 11.4 || samabhūmitalāḥkāryāssikatābhiśca śobhitāḥ | dukūlakṣaumapāsobhi rdarbhamālāśatena ca || 11.5 || dhvajaiśca sarvato dikṣu śobhayecca prapādibhiḥ | śodhayetsarvabhūbhāgaṃ gomayombhobhirāplutaiḥ || 11.6 || prāsadabhittayaḥ kāryāścitritā varṇapañcakaiḥ | kambhābhiḥ pūrṇakumbhaiśca dīpikāvalibhi stathā || 11.7 || muktādāmabhiranyaiśca sāṅkuraiḥpālikāśataiḥ | deśāddeśātsametānāṃ varṇānāṃ ca tadutsave || 11.8 || sevituṃ devadeveśa mannādyaistuṣṭimāvahet | prapāpānīyaśālādhyai ryajamāno divāniśam || 11.9 || rogārtānatha bhaiṣajyairbhiṣajeddhanarāśibhiḥ | prathamāvaraṇe brahman kārayedyāgamaṇḍapam || 11.10 || yadvāvakāśānuguṇaṃ dvitīyāvaraṇe bhavet | antarāleṣu sarvatra diśāmiṣṭe kvacidbhavet || 11.11 || saptahastāyataṃ yadvā pañcahastāyataṃ tu vā | vistārāyāmasadṛśaṃ yaturdvārasa manvitam || 11.12 || maṇḍapaṃ kārayettasya paritaḥ kārayetprapām | tasya madhye triyaṃśe tu vedīṃ hastasamucchṛtām || 11.13 || vistīrṇāṃ dvitrihastena vedyāḥ prācyāṃ prakalpayet | kuṇḍamāhavanīyasya caturaśraṃ yathoditam || 11.14 || dakṣiṇasyāṃ dakṣiṇāgnerdiśi cāpa samākṛti | kuṇḍaṃ tu gārhapatyasya pratīcyāṃ vṛtta madbhutam || 11.15 || sabhyasya kuṇḍaṃ kauberyāṃ trikoṇaṃ tadanantaram | aiśānyā magnikoṇe vā kuṇḍaṃ ca caturaśrakam || 11.16 || avasakthyasya śikhinaḥ pañcāgnyutsava muttamam | yadvā''vasakthya rahitaṃ caturagniṃ caturdiśi || 11.17 || sabhyāvasakthya rahitaṃ yadvāgni trayasaṃyutam | ekāmāhavanīyaṃ vā kalvayetkatkuricchayā || 11.18 || aśvatthādidrumairdvāratoraṇāni caturdiśam | sruksruvau kārayedaṣṭa maṅgalāni yathāpuram || 11.19 || āsanaṃ tvṛtvijāṃ homapātrāṇi vividhāni ca | maṇḍapānāṃ ca purataḥ prapāsyātpārśvayorapi || 11.20 || dukūlakṣaumakāśeyairvicitraṃ maṇṭapaṃ prapām | vitānayedveṣṭayecca stambhānantarbahisthsitān || 11.21 || muktādāmāni sarvatra lambayeddīpamālikāḥ | āropayecca stambheṣu patākāvalibandhanam || 11.22 || muktāvitānaṃ badhnī yātpuṣpamālāśca sarvataḥ | evamādipariṣkārai rbhūṣayenmaṇḍapādikam || 11.23 || tiraskariṇyo vipulā badhnīyācca vicitritāḥ | agre caturṇāṃ varaṇa mācāryāṇāṃ ca ṛtvijām || 11.24 || ṣoḍaśā nāṃ tathānyeṣāṃ svīkāraḥ paricāriṇām | te ca bhūṣyā yathāvittaṃ bhūṣaṇaiḥ kaṭakādibhiḥ || 11.25 || vāsobhiśca navaiścitre radhikārānu sārataḥ | uṣṇīṣairuttarīyaiśca gandhadravyāsu lepanaiḥ || 11.26 || śobhanīyāḥ prayatnena yajamānena sarvadā | snapanaṃ cotsavā rambhe tadante ca yathoditam || 11.27 || kuryāddevasya pūrvedyuḥ kautukaṃ bandhayedguruḥ | sauvarṇe rājate vāpi pātre vimalataṇḍule || 11.28 || khāridvayena vārdhena yadvā pādena sammite | nyasyetsūtraṃ ca sauvarṇaṃ kṣaumaṃ kārpāsameva vā || 11.29 || saptabhiḥ pañcabhirvāpi sūtraṃ kṣaumāditantubhiḥ | śatena ṣaṣṭhyārūḍhena phalaiḥ kramukajairapi || 11.30 || nāgavallīdalaissārdhaṃ phalasaṅkhyā caturguṇaiḥ | tadardhairvā tadardhairvā kadalyādiphalairapi || 11.31 || sārdhaṃ tadanu tatpātraṃ sādhāraṃ nyasya mūrdhani | vastreṇaācchāditaṃ chatracāmaravyajanānvitam || 11.32 || bahudīpakasaṃyuktaṃ savitānaṃ ca mūrtipaḥ | paṭhadbhiśśākunaṃ sūktaṃ brāhmaṇairveda pāragaiḥ || 11.33 || tūrya maṅgalagītaiśca sārdhaṃ nītvā pradakṣiṇam | dhāma viṣṇostathā tasya bahirāvaraṇāni ca || 11.34 || prādakṣiṇyena vā grāmaṃ praviśeddevatā ntikam | devasya purato bhūmitale gomayapāriṇā || 11.35 || ālipte caturaśreca śālibhāreṇa pūrite | pātraṃ nidhāya puṇyāhaṃ vācayitvā yathāvidhi || 11.36 || sabhājayitvā ttsūtra mantramantreṇa deśikaḥ | aṅguṣṭhā nāmikābhyāṃ tu gṛhītvā hastayordvayoḥ || 11.37 || aparājitayā sūtraṃ candanakṣoda vāriṇā | ālipya dakṣiṇe haste badhvā cotsavakautukam || 11.38 || spṛṣṭvā dakṣiṇahastena sūtraṃ pārān śataṃ japet | antramantraṃ tathārghyārdairiṣṭvādevaṃ nivedayet || 11.39 || mahāpūvaṃ tathāpūpān pṛthukāṃśca phalānyapi | keyaṃ nṛttaṃ tathāpādya mācareddevatāntike || 11.40 || tribhirbhāgavatairdevaṃ sthāne'nyatra niveśayet | snānāntaṃ kṣaumavasanamāliptaṃ candanādinā || 11.41 || bhūṣitaṃ bhūṣaṇaissarvaissrigviṇaṃ devadaivatam | arcayitvā yathāśāstraṃ paramānnaṃ nivedayet || 11.42 || yathoditaṃ pratiṣṭhāyāṃ yathāśayana kalpanam | bhimbaṃ copari vinyasya śayane sthāpayecchubhe || 11.43 || koṇeṣu sthāpayeddīpān pālikā ssāṅkurāstathā | tūryaghoṣaistathāvedaistotraistutvā madhudviṣam || 11.44 || niśāṃ nayojjāgareṇa samāhitamanā guruḥ | śvobhūte śobhane prāpte muhūrte bhāskarodaye || 11.45 || uttiṣṭhe tyādimantreṇa tribhirbhāgavataissaha | dikṣu śākunikaṃ sūktaṃ paṭhatsu brāhmaṇeṣvapi || 11.46 || utthāvya śayanāddevaṃ taṃ idaṃviṣṇurityṛcā | āropayeyuśśibhikāṃ suvarṇa prabhayā saha || 11.47 || vaheyu rbhūsurā yānaṃ dhyāyanto vihagādhipam | vikiretsarvato dikṣu puṣpāṇisurabhīṇi ca || 11.48 || lājāṃśca sākaṃ muktābhistūryaghoṣaiśca nādayet | īdṛsairmaṅgalairanyaissarvāvaraṇa bhūmikāḥ || 11.49 || nītvā pradakṣiṇaṃ yānādavaropya prabhānvite | bhadrāsane dukulādicitrāstaraṇaśobhite || 11.50 || pārśvekalpadrumacchāyāśītale svarṇanirmite | niveśya maṇṭape sarvamupacāraṃ samācaret || 11.51 || prābhṛtaṃ cāhṛtaṃ sarvaṃ dravyamutsavakāraṇam | devāya darśayetsarvaṃ janasaṃnadi deśikaḥ || 11.52 || kṛtvopacāra makhilaṃ tatassnapanamaṇṭape | snāpayeddevadeveśaṃ yathāpūrvoditaiḥkramamaiḥ || 11.53 || ācāryo yajamānaśca samīkṣya vibhavodayam | mahāhavirnivedyānte hutvā havyairyathāvidhi || 11.54 || garbhagehaṃ vimānasya nayenmaṅgalasaṃyutam | tato'parāhṇasamaye aṅkurādhāramṛttikām || 11.55 || ānetuṃ bahirudyāna būmeryadvā nadītaṭāt | yānamāropya garuḍaṃ senānyaṃ vā pariṣkṛtam || 11.56 || devādeśaṃ puraskṛtya sarvamaṅgala saṃyutam | vahadbhiḥpālikāḥpūrvaṃ khanitraṃ cāpi bhūṣitam || 11.57 || brāhmaṇairbahubhirvedānadhīyānaissamantataḥ | nītvā pradakṣiṇaṃ grāmaṃ tato nirgatya deśikaḥ || 11.58 || diśaṃ prācīmudīcīṃ vā pratisaṅgṛhyamṛttikām | yathāpūrvoditaṃ dhāma praviśya rajanīmukhe || 11.59 || pradoṣe yāgasadasi pālikā dvādaśāvarāḥ | śarāvakumbhasahitāstadvargā api ṣoḍaśa || 11.60 || īśānabhāge saṃsthāpya somakumbhasamanvitāḥ | āvapettāsu bījāni muhūrte śobhane guruḥ || 11.61 || tataḥ praviśya sadanaṃ yajamāno guruśca tau | praṇamya daṇḍavadbhūmau devamutsava sampadam || 11.62 || yācetāṃ gururanvakca badhvā kalyāṇakautukam | utsavasnānabalyartha pratimāsu yathā kramam || 11.63 || sudarśane caśayane kalpite'nyata pūrvavat | baddhapratisaraṃ sarvamadhivāsya yathākramam || 11.64 || utthāpya sadyaścārādhya prādakṣiṇyena mandiram | nītvā praveśya yāgārthamaṇḍapaṃ tatra cāsane || 11.65 || nityotsavā rcāṃ cakraṃ ca niveśya tadanantaram | vedikāyāṃ dhānyapīṭhaṃ kṛtvā purveditakramāt || 11.66 || tatra prakṣālitān kumbhān sūtreṇa pariveṣṭitān | gandhodakena sampūrṇā nnavaratnayutānnava || 11.67 || sarvagandharajomiśrān karakeṇa samanvitān | pratyekaṃ syastasauvarṇaniṣkānaśvatthapallavaiḥ || 11.68 || kuśakūrcena sahitān mukheṣvapi samallakān | madhyamaṃ vastra yugnena śiṣṭānekena vāsasā || 11.69 || veṣṭitānvedikābhūmau sthāpayeddhānyarāśiṣu | ayataṃ saptabhirhastaiṣṣadbhirvā cātha pañcabhiḥ || 11.70 || vistīrṇaṃ vastramāyāmamānārdhena niyojayet | bhagavanmayavipraiśca puṇyāhamapi vācayet || 11.71 || dvāratoraṇakumbhādīn pratiṣṭhāyāmi vārcayet | madhyakumbhe mūlaberaṃ karake ca sudarśanam || 11.72 || pūrvādyāśāgate kumbhe vāsudevādi kānyajet | āgneyādiṣu koṇeṣu yaṣṭavyāḥ puruṣādayaḥ || 11.73 || tadhaiva puruṣassatyaḥ krameṇācyutadevatā | anantaśceti haviṣā caturṇāṃ ca nivedanam || 11.74 || kumbhe tathāstre ca balibimbe cai vāṣṭa maṅgalam | veṣṭitaṃ vāsasā vede radhastāddhānya rāśiṣu || 11.75 || nyasyābhyarcya caturdikṣu vedatūryādighoṣaṇe | pravṛtte juhuyādagnau dhyāyannāhava nīyake || 11.76 || vāsudevaṃ dakṣiṇāgnau saṅkarṣaṇa manantare | pradyumnaṃ paścime cāgnāvudī cīne'niruddhakam || 11.77 || āvasakthye mūlamūrtimiṣṭvā tīrthāva sānikam | sannidhiṃ prārtha kuṇḍeṣu juhuyā tsarpirādibhiḥ || 11.78 || sarpiṣā ca prasūnaiśca dhūpadravyaiśca padmaja | samidhā payasā dadhnā tilavrīhi yavai stathā || 11.79 || tattaddaivatamantreṇa aṣṭottara śataṃ pṛthak | aṣṭāviṃśativārānvā kuṇḍeṣu prāgupakramaḥ || 11.80 || pāyasaiḥkṛsarairgaulyairharidrānnaiśca maurdikaiḥ | hotavyaṃ pauruṣai ssūktaiḥ pṛthagagniṣu pañcasu || 11.81 || pañcame paramānnena brahmādyuddiśya devatāḥ | tattannāma caturthyantaṃ parivārapadānvitam || 11.82 || svāhāntaṃ mantramuccārya dhyātvā brahmādidevatāḥ | brahmā prajāpatī rudrassarve devā yathākramam || 11.83 || chandhāṃsi vedā ṛṣayo gandharvāśca sarīsṛpāḥ | yakṣāścapsarasaścaiva māsādyaissaha vatsarāḥ || 11.84 || saritaśca samudrāśca parvatāśca tathāpagāḥ | bhūtāni paśavo vṛkṣā stathaivauṣadhayaḥsmṛtāḥ || 11.85 || vanaspatiścodbhidaśca svedajāścāṇḍajā stathā | jarāyujāśca bhūrādisaptalokāstathaiva ca || 11.86 || atalādyāstathālokāssapta caṇḍādidevatāḥ | ityetebhyo balidravyaṃ juhuyānmūlavidyayā || 11.87 || idaṃ viṣṇuritiprocya pūrṇāhuti mathācaret | na dahetparidhīn darbhān devānnodvāsayet sthitān || 11.88 || pratyahaṃ dhārayedagnīn yāvattīrthadināvadhi | ahorātraṃ pratidinaṃ juhuyāduktavartanā || 11.89 || ekāgnauvāpi hotavyaṃ homadravyamaśeṣataḥ | traye catuṣṭaye caivamagnīnāṃ kamalāsana || 11.90 || balipradānaṃ prathamaṃ kuryādyāgasya maṇṭape | cakraṃ ca balibhimbaṃ ca samādāyānnamūrtinā || 11.91 || sākaṃ niṣkramya sadanāttaddvāre kumudādikam | abhyarcyapurato dadyādbaliṃ bhūmitale śucau || 11.92 || pātrasthaṃ tadbalidravyaṃ ghaṇṭāṃ prasavabhājanam | toyapūrṇaṃ ca karakaṃ dīpapātraṃ ca dīpikāḥ || 11.93 || dhūpapātraṃ gṛhītvāgre gacchantu paricārakāḥ | agre gacchedanna mūrtistataścakramanantaram || 11.94 || nityotsavārcāṃ tadanu vitānādi samanvitām | tataścaṇḍa pracaṇḍādīn dvāreṣvā varaṇeṣu ca || 11.95 || nityotsavaprakriyāyā balimabhyarcya nikṣipet | madhyamārabhya ca grāme brahmādīnāṃ yathāvidhi || 11.96 || deśeṣvīśānaparyantaṃ datvā'bhyarcya baliṃ tataḥ | mahāpīṭhe balidravyaṃ pariśiṣṭama śeṣataḥ || 11.97 || dadyātpāriṣadān sarvānuddiśya kamalāsana | muhūrte śobhane prāpte gururutsava kautukam || 11.98 || śayanasthaṃ samutthāpya mantramuttiṣṭha pūrvakam | uccārayan svastisūktaṃ paṭhadbhirbrāhmaṇai ssaha || 11.99 || niṣkramya mandirāttasmā duccārya ca rathantaram | samāropya rathaṃ yuktaṃ caturbhirhastipuṅgavaiḥ || 11.100 || vājibhirvā balīvardaiśśīghragāmibhiruttamaiḥ | kalpakadrumasaṃyuktaṃ hemakuṭai ralaṅkṛtam || 11.101 || rathasyo parikṛtvā ca nayedāsthitasārathim | yantreṇa vā vipravaryau radhīyānai rbalānvitaiḥ || 11.102 || gaje vā syandanālābhe yāne vā tadasambhave | bhadraṅkarṇeti mantreṇa yānamāropayettadā || 11.103 || sapuṣpahemaprabhayāyuktaṃ puṣpairalaṅkṛtam | haimena ca vimānena yuktaṃ puṣpādiśobhinā || 11.104 || kuṭākāreṇa vā yuktaṃ mayūracchadaśobhinā | sarvālaṅkāra yuktena samanaḥpariveṣinā || 11.105 || yāne tatra samāsīsamabhyarcyanyāsapūrvakam | devaṃ nivedayettasmai bhakṣyaṃ ca pṛthukādikam || 11.106 || nānyaṃ caraṇayornyasyenniśācūrṇāni sarvaśaḥ | dīpairudagrairbahubhiḥ pariṣiktai rghṛtādinā || 11.107 || parassahasrai ssarvatra dīpayecca śatāvaraiḥ | dvijendramukhyairbahubhi rbhūṣitairdhavalāmbaraiḥ || 11.108 || kañcukoṣṇīṣasahitai rvālavyajanapāṇibhiḥ | tālavyajanahastaiśca barhibarhakaraistathā || 11.109 || muktātapatrahastai śca meghuḍambaradhāribhiḥ | bhibhrāṇairdhūpapātrāṇi gandhodgārīṇī viśvataḥ || 11.110 || yānāruḍhena purato racitāñjalikarmāṇā | ucchairdhvajādhirūḍhena tathā tārkṣyeṇa padmaja || 11.111 || pṛṣṭhataśca praṇamatā śibhikāṃ kalakojjvalām | ārūḍhena viriñcādīn samutsārayatā bahiḥ || 11.112 || viṣvaksenena devena vedrahastena sevitaḥ | upānahau pāduke ca pātre kanakanirmite || 11.113 || samāropya puro viprairdhārayadbhiralaṅkṛtaiḥ | rājacihnāni cānyāni yātavyamavilambitam || 11.114 || vipraistrayī madhīyānai rjavastuti parāyaṇaiḥ | nṛtyatā gāyatā cāpi gāṇikyenānu sevitam || 11.115 || vīṇādivādanaparairvandibhiśca tathā paraiḥ | ṣaḍjadigītanipuṇai rvādyavādanakonidaiḥ || 11.116 || gadyaṃ padyaṃ tathā miśraṃ paṭhadbhistotra mujjvalam | bhāṣāśca bahudhā bhinnā bhāṣamāṇai rita stataḥ || 11.117 || vaitaṇḍi kai stathā jalpanipuṇairvāda śikṣitaiḥ | tathā tatvakathāniṣṭhaiḥ padārthajñaiśca tārkikaiḥ || 11.118 || vimāṃsakairyājñikaiśca cchāndasaissāṅkhyakovidaiḥ | yogajñaiśca pūrṇajñai śśābdikaustatva vedibhiḥ || 11.119 || mauhurtikaiśca gaṇaśaḥparasparajigīṣubhiḥ | tattacchāstroktamārgeṇa prameyaṃ bahudhā sthitam || 11.120 || uccairbruvāṇairva dvadbhiḥ pañca rātra parāyaṇaiḥ | pāsudevasya mahātmyaṃ kathayadbhiśca sātvikaiḥ || 11.121 || saṃskṛtaṃ prākṛtaṃ miśramīra yadbhirita stataḥ | śāstreṣu naipuṇaṃ sarvaṃ pradarśayitu mudyataiḥ || 11.122 || devasya purataḥpṛṣṭhe pārśvataśca sthitairjanaiḥ | senayā sarvatodikṣu caturaṅga nalāḍhyayā || 11.123 || devasya pārśvayoḥpūrve lākṣā rañcitamaskaraiḥ | yantrerdāru mayaiścitraiṛḥ pakṣyākārairiti stataḥ || 11.124 || devatākṛti yantraiśca tathā yantrairgajādibhiḥ | niṣādibhissamārūḍhaistrībhiśca bharatoditaiḥ || 11.125 || mārgairbahuvidhairnṛttaṃ darśayantībhiradbhutam | lekhāyantre striyārūḍhai ryantre ranyestathāvidhaiḥ || 11.126 || gatāgatāni kurvāṇairanuyātassamākulaiḥ | itthamāvaraṇaṃ sarvaṃ parikramya bahi stathā || 11.127 || grāmādivīdhi kāśchāpi parikramya pradakṣiṇam | praveśasamaye cāpi prākāravalayaṃ tathā || 11.128 || prādakṣiṇyena gatvāntaḥ praviśenmaṇṭa pāvanim | tatrāvaropayeddevaṃ baliberaṃ tu mandire || 11.129 || cakraṃ ca yāgasadane balipīṭhe bahisthtate | annamūrtiṃkṣipennityaṃ samārādhanakalpitaiḥ || 11.130 || vastubhirdvaguṇairnityaṃ druvabheraṃ samarcayet | rātriśeṣe vyatikrānai maṇṭape siṃhaviṣṭare || 11.131 || avasthāpyautsavaṃ bimbamarcayecchāntravartmanā | snapanaṃ tatra vā bimbe yadvānnaparakautuke || 11.132 || ekabheravidhāne tu mūlabimbe'bhiṣecanam | pratyahaṃ snapanaṃ kuryādyathāśakti yathāvidhi || 11.133 || mehīhavirni vedyātha bimbe kalyāṇakalpite | maṇḍanālayamāsādya śobhayodbhūṣaṇādibhiḥ || 11.134 || bimbe tatra sthite yāgamaṇṭapaṃ prāpya deśikaḥ | kumbhādikaṃ samabhyarcya nivedya ca yathoditam || 11.135 || hutvā ca pūrvavatpīṭhe baliṃ datvā yathāvidhi | sarvamanyacca balyarcāṃ nītvā grāmādivīdhikāḥ || 11.136 || yathāniśaṃ vidhāyānvagutsavārcaṃ nayedbhahiḥ | yathāpuramalaṅkāraṃ kṛtvā parikarāṃ stathā || 11.137 || divasānuguṇānanyān dhvajādīnviṣvagucchṛtān | tāmbūlavīṭikāṃ datvā sthāne sthāne samāhṛtām || 11.138 || puthu kādīṃ stathā bhakṣyā nnālikeraphalāni ca | pānīyācamānādīna coditāni yathāvidhi || 11.139 || datvānaivedyamakhilamadbhiḥ prokṣyāstravidyayā | nivedayedapūpādīn pakvaṃ tūṣṇīṃ pradarśayet || 11.140 || pānīyaṃ ca tathā svādu payaḥprabhṛti cāhṛtam | piṣpamūlādi yaccāsyaccandanakṣodabhājanam || 11.141 || bhūṣaṇaṃ cāṅgulīyādi bhaktyā yatpratidīyate | prokṣya sarvaṃ tathāstreṇa devaṅge yojayodguruḥ || 11.142 || grāmaṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ nītvātadhaivāvaraṇāni ca | praveśya dhāma śibhikāmanyāmāropya maṅgalām || 11.143 || pnānamaṇṭapabhūbhāge kāñcane paramānane | sukhāstaraṇa saṃyukte yūnāderavaropyatam || 11.144 || niveśyābhīṣṭadigbhāge sammukhaṃ makhakautukam | ārādhayedbhāgavata ssarvālaṅkāra saṃyutaḥ || 11.145 || ahatena susūkṣmeṇa vāsanā ślakṣṇatastunā | baddoṣṇīṣottarāsaṅgaḥ karṇakārdauralaṅkṛtaḥ || 11.146 || sauvarṇavāravāṇena dhavalena virājitaḥ | baddhasvadehasannāhaḥ pavitratakaraśśuciḥ || 11.147 || samārādhanavastūni nayadbhiḥ paricārakaiḥ | kañcukoṣṇīṣavāsobhirbhavitavyaṃ samantataḥ || 11.148 || devasya dakṣiṇe pārśve pūjarendropaveśanam | āsthitavyaṃ bhagavataḥ pārśvayoḥ pṛṣṭhata stataḥ || 11.149 || ekāgremānasaissarvai rekāntibhiruvāsakaiḥ | āsthitavyaṃ yativaraistridaṇḍairekadaṇḍibhiḥ || 11.150 || brahmadhyāna parairanva gārādhana vidhikramam | anusandhāyi bhiśśaśva dupaveṣṭavya mantike || 11.151 || bahisteṣāṃ ca kalyāṇai rvaiṣṇavai ssaṃyatendriyaiḥ | ānasdajāśru salilai rāplutāṅgairmahīsuraiḥ || 11.152 || upāsitavyamantyestu sadasyairmaṇṭapādbahiḥ | adhastātsarvatodikṣu prapāyā mupaveśanam || 11.153 || adhastādagrato nṛttagītavādyaviśāradaiḥ | nāṭyaṃ bahuvidhaṃ vādyaṃ prakṛṣṭaṃ bahudhāsthitam || 11.154 || gītaṃ ca divyaṃ ṣaḍjadyaissvaraiḥkālānusāribhiḥ | pradarśayadbhirlāsyāni bandhanānītarāṇica || 11.155 || āviṣkurvadbhirānyāṃśca śravyaṃ dṛśyaṃ ca taddvayam | darśayadbhiradhīyānaistrayūṃ svādhyāyakalpitām || 11.156 || itihāsapurāṇāni kathayadbiryathāyatham | sannidhātavyamanyābhi rvāṇinībissamantataḥ || 11.157 || itthaṃ saṃsevite tatra maṇḍape madhuvidviṣam | arcayitvā tatassnānapīṭhe nītvā yathāpuram || 11.158 || sahasradhārāparyantaṃ snāpayetpuruṣottamam | alaṅkārāsane nītvā tatra kṛtyama śeṣataḥ || 11.159 || kṛtvā yātrāsane devamāropya saparicchadam | praveśya maṇḍapaṃ tatra nyasettaṃ bhojavāsane || 11.160 || mahāhavirnivedyātha pānakāntaṃ yathoditam | sukhāsane sthāpayitvā rājavatsarvamācaret || 11.161 || alaṅkārāsanaṃ nītvā yānamāropya maṅgalam | avaropyāsane tatra maṇḍayitvā yathāpuram || 11.162 || homādi balidānāntaṃ kṛtvā sarvama śeṣataḥ | autsavaṃ bimbamādāya kuryādevaṃ mahotsavam || 11.163 || pratyahaṃ mahamuktena vidhinā vihitaṃ kramāt | apūrvābharaṇairmālyairapūrvaiścāmbaraistathā || 11.164 || apūrvodyānayānādyairyathā kautūhalaṃ bhavet | tathā viśiṣya kartavyaṃ yāvattīrthadināvadhi || 11.165 || yasminnāsthānabhūbhāge ye bhogāḥ kalpitāḥ purā | tatreva te vidhātavyā devasya sati sambhave || 11.166 || śriyā vasudhayā sārdhaṃ grāmādau nityamutsave | paribhramaṇamīśasya kevalasyāpi vā bhavet || 11.167 || ahani prathamādausyā dbalidānamanukramāt | palalaṃ rajanīcūrṇaṃ karambhān lājasaṃyutān || 11.168 || caruṇā saha saṃyojya baliṃ tadyādyathāvidhi | dvitīye'hani saṃyojya caruṇā tilataṇḍulam || 11.169 || miśritāṃścaruṇā lājā dhānānyāpūpakāṃ stathā | tṛtīye ca caturthe ca nālikerajalaissaha || 11.170 || saktūṃśca śālipiṣṭaṃ ca saṃyojya caruṇā saha | paṃcame padmabhījāni pāyasaṃ śālitaṇḍulam || 11.171 || ṣaṣṭhe tvapūpān saṃyojya caruṇā nikṣipedbalim | saptamādiṣu sarvatra sārdhamannaiścaturvidhaiḥ || 11.172 || apūpāṃśca tathā saktūn pratyahaṃ nikṣipedbalim | brahmādīśānaparyantaṃ sthāneṣvaṣṭasu pūrvavat || 11.173 || vidhāya balipīṭhāni gomayāliptabhūmiṣu | teṣu vādyaṃ tathā nṛttaṃ geyaṃ nityetsave yathā || 11.174 || kṛtvā dadyāttoyapūrvaṃ baliṃ teyottaraṃ tathā | balimudrāṃ darśayitvā darśayenmaṅgalāṣṭakam || 11.175 || baliṃ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya gaccheyurbalidāyinaḥ | ārambhadivase rātrau samāptidivase'hani || 11.176 || balimekāṃ kṣipenmadhyadivaseṣu balidvayam | ahni rātrau ca sarvatra balidānaṃ yathāvidhi || 11.177 || avasānadine rātrau grahaṇe viṣuve'yane | prāpte kuryādavabhṛthaṃ yadi tasmin balidvayam || 11.178 || grāmādirahite sthāne madhye tu purato balim | mahāpīṭhasya vitaredbrahmaṇe deśikottamaḥ || 11.179 || purvedyustīrthadivasāddevasya mṛgayā bhavet | mṛgayādivasātpūrvaṃ jaladroṇyavagāhanam || 11.180 || avagāhadinātpūrvadivase devamarcayet | śrībhūmibhyāṃ sahaikasmin viṣṭare vipule sthitam || 11.181 || udyānādau ca devībhyāṃ sārdhaṃ devasya nirgamaḥ | kīḍrāśca tatra bahudhā darśaye ccopadāḥ punaḥ || 11.182 || deśāddeśādāhṛtāni prābhṛtāni gurussvayam | pradarśya devadevāya janasaṃsadi maṇḍape || 11.183 || ito yātamidaṃ sarva mito yātamitīryaca | devādīnapi cāhartṝnkāle vijñāpaye ttataḥ || 11.184 || tanmayatvāddeśikendro devo'hamiti bhāvayan | kuryādanugrahaṃ sarvaṃ devasyālokya cānanam || 11.185 || abhiprāyaṃ yathā rājño jñātvā tena pradarśitam | bruvanti tatsamīpasthā rājñāṃ tattadanugraham || 11.186 || sudarśanānnamūrtibhyāṃ saha tābhyāṃ vināpi vā | saha balyarcayā kuryādvinā vā taṃ mahotsavam || 11.187 || kevalotsavabimbena dineṣvavabhṛthāvadhi | jaladroṇīṃ jalasnānadine kṛtvā yathāpuram || 11.188 || utsavaṃ devadevasya prātarārabhya maṅgalam | aparāhṇe jaladroṇyāmavagāhanamiṣyate || 11.189 || sopānadeśe sarasi jaladroṇīṃ niveśayet | kaṭāhaṃ vāpi sauvarṇaṃ pūrayedgandhavāribhiḥ || 11.190 || muktā bhānyakṣatānyatra parito vikiret sthale | jaleṣvāvāhya gaṅgādyāssaritastāssabhājayet || 11.191 || jale'bhimantrite mantrairabliṅgairdevamarcitam | upacārairyathāpūrvaṃ snānāntrairavagāhayet || 11.192 || kāle tasminnadhīyūran sūktaṃ vāruṇamuccakaiḥ | tanmayā dikṣu sarvāsu ghoṣayettūryamuccakaiḥ || 11.193 || avagāḍhaṃ tato devaṃ yānamāropya maṇḍapam | anyamānīya tatrāpi yathāpūrvaṃ sabhājayet || 11.194 || anuṣṭhitamidaṃ tīrthaṃ brahmadyairapi daivataiḥ | etaiśca tīrthasalilaiḥpītaiśśirapi dhāritaiḥ || 11.195 || snānairnirdhūtapāpmāno yānti brahma sanātanam | mṛgayādivase vāpi prātarārabhya pūrvavat || 11.196 || kṛtvotsavamaśeṣeṇa tasyānte mṛgayā bhavet | mṛgayānuguṇaissarvairbhūṣaṇairbhūṣitaṃ tataḥ || 11.197 || tadyogyāyudhasannāhaṃ hastyādau parikalpite | āropya kṛtrime cāśve nayedgrāmādi pūrvavat || 11.198 || devībhyāṃ saha sīmādau sainyairhastyādibhiryutam | udyanamaṇṭape cāpi madhye sauvarṇaviṣṭare || 11.199 || āsane tatra cāsīnaṃ snānapūrvaṃ samarcayet | maṇṭape'nyatra vidhinā nivedya ca mahāhaviḥ || 11.200 || yānamāropya tadrātrau mandrirāntarbhuvaṃ nayet | nityotsavaṃ yathāpūrvaṃ kuryāttadanu maṅgalam || 11.201 || paścime rātribhāge tu tīrthabhimābādhivāsanam | badvā pratisaraṃ tīrthabimbābhāve caturmukha || 11.202 || nityotsavapratikṛterabhāve tvadhivāsanam | snānarcāyāṃ bhavedyadvā bimbasyotsavakāriṇaḥ || 11.203 || utsavaṃ prātarārabhya kuryātpūrvoditakramāt | utthāpya śāyitaṃ bimbaṃ niveśya mukhamaṇṭape || 11.204 || ādāya sthāpitān kumbhān yāgamaṇḍapabhūmiṣu | nītvā pradakṣiṇaṃ dhāma tīrthabhimbasya sannidau || 11.205 || sthāpayitvā dhānyarāśau tīrthabimbaṃ yathāvidhi | vastrāntamarcayitvānte muhūrte śobhane guruḥ || 11.206 || ekabhere mūlabheramanyathā tīrthakautukam | kumbaurabhyuddhṛtairdevaṃ mūlamantreṇa mantravit || 11.207 || vūrvādimadhyakumbhāntamabhiṣiñcedyathāvidhi | snānādidīpaparyuntaṃ pratikumbhaṃ samarcayet || 11.208 || paṭhatsu vipravaryeṣu dikṣu svādhyāyamuccakaiḥ | ghoṣayatsu ca vādyeṣu mantrairabdaivadairguruḥ || 11.209 || navavastrottarīyādyairdīpāntairarcite harau | dhvajapīṭhasya purataḥ kṣitau gomayapāriṇā || 11.210 || ālipte caturaśre ca śālibhārairvikīryaca | vastrapūrvādyalaṅkārairulūkhalamaṅkṛtam || 11.211 || kṣālitaṃ sthaṇḍile pīṭhe sthāpayitvā caturmukha | śrīnūktavidyayā lakṣmīṃ dhyātvā mantritamarcitam || 11.212 || musalaṃ kṣālitaṃ cāpi mantritaṃ mūlavidyayā | ādāya mārtipaissārdhaṃ deśikendrassamāhitaḥ || 11.213 || avahanyānni śācūrṇaṃ nikṣiptaṃ tadulūkhale | gāyantyo gaṇikā gītaṃ mandire devadāsikāḥ || 11.214 || avahanyurniśācūrṇaṃ yathāsūkṣmataraṃ bhavet | nikṣiptacūrṇaṃ tadanu kumbhaṃ veṣṭitavāsanam || 11.215 || sakūrcamallakaṃ pīṭhe taṇḍulaiḥ parikalpite | sthāpitaṃ mūlamantreṇa gandhādibhirathārcitam || 11.216 || ādāyakumbhacūrṇaistaiśśrīsūktenābhiṣecayet | ṛtvijo deśikendraśca devaṃ gatvā pradakṣiṇam || 11.217 || aṣṭāṅgapraṇipātena praṇipatya vikīrya ca | puṣpāṇyañjalibhirdevaṃ stutvā stotre ranekaśaḥ || 11.218 || alaṅkṛtairbhāgavataiśchatracāmaradhāribhiḥ | taireva sarvairbahubhirbhāvyaṃ devasamīpagaiḥ || 11.219 || aropya devaṃ hāstyādau tīrthabhimbamalaṅkṛtam | paścādutsavabimbena nīyamānena pūrvavat || 11.220 || sahitaṃ sarita stīrthaṃ nītvā yadvā sarittaṭam | darśe ca paurṇamāsyāṃ ca arvākcedyojanāvadau || 11.221 || samudratīramathavā maṇḍape tatra kalpite | avaropyāsane yānā nniviṣṭe tīrthakautuke || 11.222 || kalaśānagrataḥpañca viṃśatiṃ daśa sapta ca | yadvā yadvā nava nyasya yathāvidhi yathākramam || 11.223 || kalaśairabhiñceta cakraṃ śiṣṭaiśca vāribhiḥ | saritādau ca tīrtheṣu tīrthānyāvāhya nāmabhiḥ || 11.224 || nimajjayettatra bimbaṃ cakraṃ ca triryathāvidhi | tīrthārthamautsave bimbe samānīte tu vāribhiḥ || 11.225 || prokṣya kūrcāgrapatitairbhimbaṃ cakraṃ nimajjayet | cakrābhāve tu tatkūrcaṃ kevalaṃ devasannidau || 11.226 || devena saha tatkāle nimajjanti ca ye narāḥ | te nirdhūyākhubhaṃ sarvaṃ mahāpātakamapyatha || 11.227 || yānti druvaṃ suduṣprāpaṃ sthānamācandratārakam | maṇḍape devamānīya pūjayitvā yathāpuram || 11.228 || mahāhavirnivedyātha brāhmaṇān bhojayettataḥ | pratyahaṃ bhojayedviprān sahasraṃ śatameva vā || 11.229 || ālayābhyantaraṃ yānamāropya prāpayettataḥ | tadrātrau maṇḍape devaṃ nītvābhyarca yathāvidhi || 11.230 || nivedya ca yathānyāyaṃ prabhāte maṇḍapāntare | bhaktairbhāgavataiścaiva sevite bhūtela kvacit || 11.231 || cakrābjaṃ vartayitvoktavartanā varaṇānvitam | prasavaiḥ kālajaiśśyāmaiḥ kṛṣṇaiśca tulasīdalaiḥ || 11.232 || nyūvātirekarahitairvarṇaireva sitādibhiḥ | vicitrayetpañcavarṇaiścitrite tasya madhyataḥ || 11.233 || bhadrapīṭhe prabhāyuktenyaste kalyāṇakautukam | niveśyārādhayedarghyapādyādibhiranukramāt || 11.234 || dvādaśākṣaramantrasthānyakṣarāṇi yathāyatham | uddiśya bhūṣāparyantairarghyārdyairnavabhiḥkramāt || 11.235 || pratyakṣaraṃ samastāni puṣpau rabhyarcayeddharim | hṛdayādīni cāṅgāni samuddiśyāñjalisthitaiḥ || 11.236 || phalaṃ bhavatu me puṣpairnama ityavasānakam | tantra mantraṃ samuccārya mantraviddeśikottamaḥ || 11.237 || bhūṣaṇāni tathoddiśya śrīvatpādīnyanukramāt | āyudhāni ca divyāni cakrādīni yathākramam || 11.238 || tathaivāvaraṇasthānāṃ devatānāṃ samarcanam | matsyādimūrtidaśakaṃ keśavādīṃ stathā parān || 11.239 || caturviṃśatisaṅkhyātā nuddiśya kusumārcanam | pauruṣeṇa tu sūktena pratyṛcaṃ kamalāsana || 11.240 || nārāyaṇānuvākena viṣṇusūktena deśikaḥ | puṣpāṇi tadyāddevasya caraṇāmbojayordvayoḥ || 11.241 || tathaupaniṣadairmantreḥ ñcabhissarvapāpanaiḥ | dikṣu vedāṃśca caturaḥ paṭheyurmantravittamāḥ || 11.242 || vidikṣvekāyanāṃ śākhāṃ tanmayūssumukhā stathā | adhīyīran tathā stotrenṛttaiśca satatodyataiḥ || 11.243 || toṣayeddevadeveśaṃ geyaiśca bahudhā sthitaiḥ | puṣpābhiṣekaṃ prahitaiḥ puṣpaireva sitādibhiḥ || 11.244 || devasya kṛtvā devāya pāyasādi caturvidham | annaṃ nivedya juhuyāddiśyagnermaṇḍapasca ca || 11.245 || samidbhirājyaiścaru bhiścatubhirnaśca pṛthakpṛthak | aṣṭottaraśataṃ vārān mūlamantreṇa mantravit || 11.246 || tataḥpradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā devaṃ stutvā ca bhūtale | praṇayeddaṇḍadyānamāropya śibhikādikam || 11.247 || praviśayedāvaraṇaṃ prathamaṃ tatra ca sthitaḥ | sevānubhūtivivaśārna bhaktān bhāgavatāṃśca saḥ || 11.248 || brahmādīnapi kalyāṇamanusandhātumāgatān | praṇatānālayaṃ svaṃ svaṃ gantuṃ sarveśvaro hariḥ || 11.249 || niyujyāvaraṇaṃ tacca parikramya pradakṣiṇam | sārdhamabhyantarai rnirtaissevakai ranuyāyibhi || 11.250 || abhyantaraṃ mandirasya praviśenjaṅgalānvitam | tadaharniśi pūrvasmin nyasyetsnasapanamaṇḍape || 11.251 || utsavāntocitaṃ snānaṃ kalaśairā caretkramāt | mahāhavirnivedyatha nītvātanmaṇḍapāntare || 11.252 || yāgamaṇḍapamāsādya homaṃ kuryādyathāvidhi | śāntihomaṃ tataḥkuryādyathā pūrvoditatramāt || 11.253 || prāyaścittaṃ tu juhuyātpañsopaniṣadā ghṛtam | sahasraṃ vāśataṃ vāpi hutvā pūrṇāhutiṃ caret || 11.254 || agnīn visarjayeddevān tatrasthāṃ storaṇādiṣu | dhvaja stambhaṃ samāsādya pūjayitvā khagādhipam || 11.255 || havirni vedya garuḍaṃ parikramya pradakṣiṇam | tamudvasetpaṭāttārkṣyaṃ saṃhārakramamāśritaḥ || 11.256 || avaropya dhvajastambha mutpāṭya ca mahāniśi | stambhaṃ dhvajaṃ cagṛhṇīyāddeśikendrassvayaṃ tataḥ || 11.257 || grahaṇaṃ deśikendreṇa tārkṣyatṛptikaraṃ bhavet | sthāne cāvāhitān devān tatra tatra sthitānapi || 11.258 || baliṃ datvā tūryaghoṣaiḥ sthāne sthāne sakṛtsakṛt | ghoṣayitvā caturvaktra samudvāsya svanāmabhiḥ || 11.259 || mūkaiḥ parikaraissārdhaṃ gururaṣṭākṣaraṃ japet | praviśya dhāma devasya vijñāpya śakaṭādikam || 11.260 || yānamāropya dhāmāntaḥ prāpayenmakhakautukam | prabhātāyāṃ niśāyāṃ vā'nuṣṭhite yāgakarmaṇi || 11.261 || yajamāno guruṃ vastre rbhūṣamaiḥkaṭakādibhiḥ | sauvarṇairgandhapuṣpādpaidyairalaṅkṛtyābhipūjya ca || 11.262 || dakṣitāmuttamāṃ svarṇaśataniṣkāṃ tato'dhikām | yathāvibhūti datvānyā dakṣiṇāḥ pratipāsaram || 11.263 || daśaniṣkaṃ tadardhaṃ vā tadardhaṃ vā yathāvasu | niṣkarūpāṃ yathāśraddhamācāryaya tadardhakām || 11.264 || tadardhamṛtvijāṃ dadyāttadardhaṃ paricāriṇām | hemavastrānnayānādyestoṣaye dupacaryayā || 11.265 || gāyakādyān janān sarvānadhikārānusārataḥ | karmāṅgabhūtānanyāṃśca kalyāṇaṃ draṣṭumāgatān || 11.266 || bharktā bhāgavatāṃśaiva sāmānyāṃścepsitairdhanaiḥ | apyalpikāpi dātavyā dakṣiṇā yāgakarmaṇi || 11.267 || karmirbhyo dakṣiṇāhīno niṣphalaḥkarturabjaja | yajñaḥpratyuta kartṝṇāṃ pratyavāyāma kalpate || 11.268 || tasmādarthānuguṇyena dātavyā dakṣiṇā bhavet | śraddhayā vāsudevasya sāṅgo pāṅgaṃ sadakṣiṇam || 11.269 || utsavaṃ devadevasya yaḥkuryātsakulaṃ svakam | uttarayarna svayaṃ viṣṇossāyujyaṃ gacchati druvam || 11.270 || hayamedhasahasreṇa yajate yassamāhitaḥ | yaścotsavena yajate tayostulyaphalānvayaḥ || 11.271 || yāgānāmapi sarveṣāṃ phalamutsava karmaṇā | devasyāśnuvate sarvaṃ yaṣṭāro nāstisaṃśayaḥ || 11.272 || upakurvanti ye martyādevasyotsava karmaṇi | karmaṇā manasā vācā te'pi yānti yathepsitam || 11.273 || grāme vā nagare vāpi pattene vā mahotsavaḥ | viṣṇoḥ pravartate yatra deśe rāṣṭre'pi vā bhavet || 11.274 || bhayaṃ na mṛtyorsavyādherna durbhikṣādisambhavaḥ | nasyanti taskarāstatra nādharmassaṃpravartate || 11.275 || dharmayukto bhavedrājā janā dharmaparāyaṇāḥ | bhavanti sukhinassarve sarvaduḥkhavivarjitāḥ || 11.276 || mahotsave vartamāne yatarthibhyaḥpradīyate | pānīyamannaṃ vastraṃ vā tatsavāsraguṇaṃ bhavet || 11.277 || puṣpamūlaphalai rijyā devasyābharaṇādikaiḥ | kriyamāṇā yathāśakti phalānantyāya kalpate || 11.278 || sevaste tatra ye devamaharniśamatantritāḥ | teṣāmidamiyacceti phalaṃ vaktuṃ na śaktate || 11.279 || alepanaṃ mārjanaṃ ca rajaḥpraśamanaṃ tathā | vāribhirdīpikāropaṃ kṣvelanāsphoṭanādikam || 11.280 || kurvantiye brahmalokaṃ te yāntyamaradurlabham | yānaṃ vahantiye viprāste yānti brahmaṇaḥpadam || 11.281 || rathaṃ vahantiye cāśvāste'pi yānti surālayam | chatrādidhāriṇaścāpi modantedivi mānavāḥ || 11.282 || deśiko mūrtipāścaita tathaiva paricārakāḥ | utsave'dhikṛtā viṣṇoḥprāpnuvanti yathepsitam || 11.283 || ṛco yajūṃṣi sāmāni ye tatrādhīyate janāḥ | te pare pyomni devasya pārśve vartantinispṛhāḥ || 11.284 || sarvaśāntikaraṃ sarvaduḥkhotsādanamuttamam | rājño rāṣṭrasya sukhadayāyurārogyavardhanam || 11.285 || prajānāṃ vāsudevasya kalyāṇā rādhanaṃ mahat | imaṃ devadayassarve viṣṇorutsavamuttamam || 11.286 || kṛtvā śāśvatikaṃ sthānaṃ prāpuratyantadurlabham | utsave tridinai kāhasādhye śraddhā pravartite || 11.287 || balipradānaṃ samanoyajanaṃ cādhipāsanam | navāvāmapi kumbhānāṃ tathā tīrdhāvagāhanam || 11.288 || mṛgayā ca jaladroṇī varjanīyāni padmaja | tāvatyevotsavadine tīrthānte grāmavīdhiṣu || 11.289 || brahmādidevatāssadyassamāvāhya baliḥ kṣipet | kenalodanamagnau ca homo niśyadhivāsanam || 11.290 || snapanaṃ viṣuvādyeṣu nadyādāvavagāhanam | puṣpayāgo jaladreṇī mṛgayā ca na yujyate || 11.291 || anyatsarvaṃ yathāpūrvaṃ kartavyaṃ phalakājñkṣibhiḥ | iti guhyatamaṃ brhamannuttamārādhanaṃ param || 11.292 || iti śrīpāñcarātre mahopaniṣadi pādmasaṃhitāyām caryāpāde mahotsava vidhirnāma ekodaśo'dhyāyaḥ |
<4.12>
brahmā samārādhyo hariḥ puṣpaiḥ kālapakvairhavīṃṣi ca | phalamūlāni cānyāni kāni yogyāni kathyatām || 12.1 || śrībhagavān puṣpāṇi nandanavanādārāmādātmanopi vā | araṇyādvā gṛhītvā ca vikrītānyāpaṇasthalāt || 12.2 || ayācitāni labdhāni yadvā kamalasambhava | pūrvapūrvoditālābhe grāhyamuttaramuttaram || 12.3 || anyāyopārjitāvyanyadevatārthāni vā punaḥ | agrāhyāṇi tathā bhinnaṃ mukulaṃ patitaṃ tathā || 12.4 || jīrṇaṃ paryuṣitaṃ kīṭadūṣitaṃ pādalaṅghitam | mlānaṃ spṛṣṭaṃ tathā'spṛśyairnītaṃ ca pratilomajaiḥ || 12.5 || snātaśśuddhāmbaro maunī pāṇiṃ prakṣālya vāriṇā | pātre puṣpāṇi gṛhṇīyādvetraje tṛṇaje'thavā || 12.6 || kalpakadrumasañjātaṃ pārijātasamudbhavam | haricandana santānamandāradrumasambhavam || 12.7 || saugandhikodbhavaṃ puṣpaṃ ṣaḍete suradārujāḥ | pālāśaṃ saptamaṃ puṣpamupayuktāni cārcane || 12.8 || anirmālyāni deyāni punaḥprakṣālya vāribhiḥ | uttarottaramekaikaṃ sahasraguṇamiṣyate || 12.9 || prātaḥpadmadvayaṃ śastamutpalatrayamarcane | phalaṃ ca pūrvavat jñeyaṃ tathaiva śatapatrikā || 12.10 || campakaṃ ketakīyugmaṃ mālatī mādhavī tathā | sandyāvartaṃ ca punnāgaṃ suraparṇyekaparṇikā || 12.11 || priyaṅgu pāṭaladvandvaṃ mandāradvayameva ca | lakṣmīśca karṇikāraśca yūdhikā kuravastathā || 12.12 || paṭṭikai tāni śastāni phalaṃ pūrvavadiṣyate | śastaṃ madhyandine śvetakaravīrajamarcane || 12.13 || kaiṅkirātaṃ ca sauvarṇaṃ puṣpaṃ sahacarī tathā | pūrvavacca phalaṃ vidyātpradoṣe ca praśasyate || 12.14 || jātiyugmaṃ vicakilaṃ malli kādvayameva ca | vakulaṃ vanajātiśca tathā ca vanamallikā || 12.15 || kumudaṃ vanamallī ca pūrvavacca phalaṃ smṛtam | prātaḥkāloditaṃ puṣpaṃ yuktaṃ madhyandinepica || 12.16 || pradoṣe kathitaṃ puṣpaṃ madhyarātre ca śasyate | divāpuṣpairdivā pūjā niśāpurṣaustathā niśi || 12.17 || deśe kāle yathāyogamarcayetpuruṣottamam | mālatyā pūjayetprātarmadhyāhne karavīrajaiḥ || 12.18 || sāyāhne jātipuṣpaistu pradoṣe vakulairapi | madhyarātre mallikābhiryajeta jalajaissadā || 12.19 || pratyūṣe nandikāvartaiḥ kāla eṣa udāhṛtaḥ | padmādi jalapuṣpāṇāmarvāgdhartustryahādbhavet || 12.20 || na ca paryuṣito doṣo nīrajānāṃ bhavettathā | abaddhebhyaḥ prasūnebhyo baddhamālā praśasyate || 12.21 || mālābhyassragvarā mālā sajātīya prasūnakā | sraktu nānāvidhaiḥpuṣpairnirmitā kadalītvacā || 12.22 || hrīberaṃ ca tamālaṃ ca tathā damanakatrayam | na paryuṣitametaiśca sadaivārādhayeddharim || 12.23 || tulasyau sitakṛṣṇe ca kevalākṣapakāstathā | catvārastulasībhedā dūrvā bhilvadalāni ca || 12.24 || sarvadārarādhanārhāṇi pūjā tu karavīrajai | gṛhe kulakṣayakarī puṣpapatrādyasannidau || 12.25 || akṣatairarcanaṃ kuryāddhareḥ kalamajaissitaiḥ | nīvārā veṇavaśśālyaḥ kalamādyā yavā api || 12.26 || haviryogyā vrīhayaśca tadabhāve prayaṅgavaḥ | anye ca yājñikā dhānyabhedāḥkodravavarjitāḥ || 12.27 || nīcairdattāstathā spṛṣṭāḥpatitaiḥ pratilomajaiḥ | aśaucavadbhiraparairapakvāḥkalamādayaḥ || 12.28 || śasyante carusākeṣu pakvāśca tadasannidau | cāturvarṇairupahṛtāstaṇḍulā doṣavarjitāḥ || 12.29 || akhaṇḍitāḥkhaṇḍitāścā bhāve trīniṣphalīkṛtāḥ | carupātraṃ tāmramayaṃ praśastaṃ mṛṇmayaṃ tu vā || 12.30 || viṣṇugāyatriyā bhāṇḍe kṣālite gālitairjalaiḥ | purṇepraṇavasaṃspṛṣṭe taṇḍulānmūlavidyayā || 12.31 || yadvā pañcopaniṣadā kṣālayedvāribhiḥpunaḥ | pūrayetpraṇavenaiva pidadhyāccakravidyayā || 12.32 || adhiśritya ca mūlena mantreṇāgniṃ samedhayet | pañchopaniṣadairmantreḥkāṣṭhaiḥ kīṭādyatūṣitaiḥ || 12.33 || yajñavṛkṣodbhavaiḥkāṣṭhaiḥ pācayetpāvakaḥkramaḥ | pakve jalamapi srāvyasiktvājyena caruṃ punaḥ || 12.34 || udagudvāsayeddarbhaiḥphalake yajñadāruje | sādhayeddīkṣitaḥpākaṃ vidhino ktena tat striyaḥ || 12.35 || yadvā tūṣṇīṃ sādhayeyurupadaṃśāṃśca coditān | phalamūlāni tatrādau phalāni kadalīphalam || 12.36 || āmraṃ panasamurvāruṃ bṛhatīṃ karkarīmapi | kāravallīmalābuṃ ca kūśmāṇḍaṃ tantriṇīmapi || 12.37 || karavartaṃ ca niṣpāvaṃ gavākṣaṃ trapusaṃ tathā | mudgabhedāṃśca nirdeṣān sadoṣān parivarjayet || 12.38 || ucciṣṭaṃ krimiṇā daṣṭaṃ śivadyairlaṅghitaṃ tathā | ghrātaṃ lālājalaspṛṣṭamamedhyaprabhavaṃ tathā || 12.39 || pādaspṛṣṭaṃ ca patitamakāle cāśucisthale | bhuktaśeṣaṃ tathā spṛśyaisspṛṣṭaṃ dattāvaśiṣṭakam || 12.40 || varjyaṃ vallī trayaṃ kandaṃ sūraṇadvayamutpalam | piṇḍāradvitayaṃ cāpi haviryogyaṃ caturmukha || 12.41 || jīvantīṃ vastukaṃ śākaṃ kāravallīdalaṃ tathā | tumbūdalaṃ ca bhāñjīṃ ca śimbamudgadalāni ca || 12.42 || śākinīṃ śataparvāṇaṃ tathaivāśvāsamardinīm | āgastyaṃ pācayecchākaṃ vihitaṃ brāhmaṇasya ca || 12.43 || ekamūlāni cānyāni gṛhṇīyādaniṣedhane | aṅkurāṇyapi veṇvādivastūnāṃ kamalāsana || 12.44 || cedayitvālavitreṇa lavaṇairmaricai stathā | sarṣapairjīrakairhiṅkuśrīparṇīdalamiśritaiḥ || 12.45 || nālikeraphalairājyairyathāyogaṃ niveśitaiḥ | saṃskāryaṃ vyañjanaṃ yūṣayuktaṃ kahitameva vā || 12.46 || sarpiṣā vā''yase pātre ghṛṣṭaṃ mṛṇmaya eva vā | kalāyamudganiṣpāva śimbamāṣakulukatthākāḥ || 12.47 || sayūṣā vā viyūṣā vā pacanīyā guṇānvitāḥ | tvaco vyapohya kulmāṣāḥkāryā yadvā yathoditāḥ || 12.48 || āmrādīni ca śuṣkāṇi phalāni gulatintriṇī | miśrāṇi pacanīyāni tathā lavaṇapāsitam || 12.49 || āmraṃ ca śrṛṅgiberaṃ ca tathā kevalamiṣyate | pasanaṃ kadalī cāmraṃ kapitthaṃ badarīphalam || 12.50 || drākṣā rājādanaṃ jambhūphalaṃ toṭakamapyatha | kharjūraṃ vetrajaṃ caiva mātuluṅgaṃ ca dāḍimam || 12.51 || phalānyetāni pakvāni kālapakvāni yojayet | kṣīraṃ cairo guṇastasya toyamardhaṃ tadardhakam || 12.52 || taṇḍulāstāvadeva syādbhinno mudgastadardhakaḥ | ghṛtaṃ samuditaṃ sarvaṃ paramānnaṃ nivedayet || 12.53 || samabhāgaṃ tu pūrvoktaistaṇḍulaissammitaṃ samam | gulaṃ phalena nikṣipya gulānnaṃ tadvidurbudhāḥ || 12.54 || taṇḍulaissammitaṃ nistvaṅmudgabhinnaṃ susādhitam | mudgānnaṃ kālapakvaistu phalai rājyapariplutam || 12.55 || nivedayetkevalānnaṃ daṇḍulai reva sādhayet | phalāni kandaśākāni mudgabhedāstathāṅkurāḥ || 12.56 || payo dadhi ghṛtaṃ cāpi kālapakvaṃ tathā phalam | āmrādilavaṇaiścāpi śṛṅgiberādisādhitam || 12.57 || matsyaṇḍī gulabhedāśca yaccānyadupadaṃśakam | parimāṇamamiṣāṃ syāt yathāśraddhaṃ yathāvasu || 12.58 || marīcyādi yathāyogyaṃ dravyasaṃskārakaṃ bhavet | nāgamallīdalāni syuraśītiravarāstathā || 12.59 || viṃśatiḥkramukasyāpi phalānyavarasaṅkhyayā | aṅgāni tailaṃ takkolaṃ lavaṅgaṃ jāti reva ca || 12.60 || mātulaṅgatvaganyacca cūrṇakaṃ karpūramiśritam | pāṣāṇajaṃ nālikeraphalaṃ pakvaṃ ca nirjalam || 12.61 || karpūraṃ kevalaṃ vāpi āmaṃ vā śuṣkameva vā | etairvastubhiranyaiśca nyūnabhāvivarjitaiḥ || 12.62 || tāmbūlavīṭikāstailamṛdupūgaphalānvitāḥ | nivedya yājamānasya śraddhāvittānusārataḥ || 12.63 || godhūmaśālipiṣṭātthā apūpāścāpi saṃskṛtāḥ | gulabhedājyamarica jīvakādyairyathāyatham || 12.64 || vastubhirvividhākārā gulapākapariplutāḥ | puṭadagdhāṃ stilānikṣurasapākapariplutān || 12.65 || maricairjīrakai ryuktān palalāṃśca nivedayet | pṛthukān puṭadagdhānvā kevalānvā gulaplutān || 12.66 || maricairjīrakai ryuktān nālikeraphalaissaha | saktūn guladravairmiśrān maricairapi jīrakaiḥ || 12.67 || karambhānapi pūrvoktaissaṃskārairapi sskṛtān | pākasthānācca bhāṇḍānvā vāribhiḥkṣālitān bahiḥ || 12.68 || bhasmanā ca caturdikṣu kṛtordhvākārapuṇḍrakān | astramantreṇa vāsobhiścannānvā vetrapañjare || 12.69 || yadvā pratiṣṭhitān bhūmau jaladhārāpurassaram | vaheyurvidhṛtoṣṇīṣāssitakañcukasaṃvṛtāḥ || 12.70 || paricaryā parā viprā maṇṭape mandire'pi vā | devasya dakṣiṇepārśve nītvā phalakabhūmiṣu || 12.71 || sauvarṇādī nipātrāṇi viṣṇugāyatriyā tataḥ | kṣālitāni parāmṛśya praṇavenājyadhārayā || 12.72 || pātrāṇisiktvāmantreṇa tathā darvyā havīṃṣi ca | ādāyādāya nikṣepya mamatreṣvannamarcitam || 12.73 || khārī tadardhaṃ pādaṃ vā tadardhaṃ vā'varaṃ matam | pratisthālīṃ pāyasādibhaktamānaṃ caturmukha || 12.74 || yathāyathaṃ vyañjanāni nikṣepyāṇi ghṛtaissaha | dadhnā ca sarvāṇya nnāni prakalpya vyañjanaissaha || 12.75 || nivedayeyurdepāya pānakāni ca pūjakāḥ | coṣyāṇi lehyakhādyāni yathāvibhavavistaram || 12.76 || niveditānāṃ turyāṃśaṃ viṣvaksenāya kalpayet | taccāgādhajale kṣepyaṃ tadbhaktānyāpi bhojayet || 12.77 || tenaivapārṣadāstṛptābhaveyurbhūta tṛptaye | dāsyo vā gaṇikā bhojyā devasya paricārikāḥ || 12.78 || brahmeśānādi devānāṃ naiva bhojyaṃ niveditam | na spṛśyaṃ laṅganīyaṃ ca caṇḍādīnāṃ ni veditam || 12.79 || devīnāṃ ca śriyādīnāṃ vinatā nandanasya ca | cakrādīnā māyudhānāṃ vastu yadyanniveditam || 12.80 || bhoktavyameva sarveṣāṃ viprādīnāma śaṅkitam | viṣṇorniveditaṃ śuddhaṃ pāvanānāṃ ca pāvanam || 12.81 || prāpaṇaṃ durlabhaṃ bhojyaṃ na tyājyaṃ syātkadācana | bhuñjānānāmedhate śrīstyajatāṃ parihīyate || 12.82 || vratopavāsatulitamaśanaṃ tasya pāvanam | śunāmiva puroḍāśo na nīceṣu tadiṣyate || 12.83 || viṣṇorniveditānnena yaṣṭavyaṃ devatāntaram | pitṛbhyaścāpi taddeyaṃ tadānantyā kalpate || 12.84 || dhāritaṃ viṣṇunirmālyaṃ candanādyanulepanam | aharniśaṃ dhārayatāṃ na punarjananaṃ bhavet || 12.85 || tathā hi caraṇasparśi viṣṇostsripathagājalam | punāti siddhadevarṣisaṅkhānaṃ ho vighātakam || 12.86 || pādodakaṃ ca devasya pavitraṃ paramaṃ madam | pādyaṃ datvā jalaṃ viṣṇo rmūlamantreṇa deśikaḥ || 12.87 || gṛhītvā śatadhāreṇa mūrdnidhāryaṃ viśuddhaye | śodhanaṃ sarvapāpānāṃ sarvaduṣkṛtanāśanam || 12.88 || lakṣmīvivardhanaṃ nityamāyurvṛddhikaraṃ param | mriyamāṇassvayaṃ viṣṇoścaraṇasparśitaṃ jalam || 12.89 || pītvā sadgatimāpnoti na cehājāyate punaḥ | pitṛṇāṃ tarpaṇaṃ śastaṃ pāriṇā tena tarpitāḥ || 12.90 || ṛṇebhyaḥpitaro muktāvasantidivi devavat | bhaktāya deyaṃ pādotthaṃ śāntāya śubhakarmiṇe || 12.91 || pañcakālavidhijñāya tadanuṣṭhānaśīline | na nāstikāya dātavyaṃ dātavyaṃ nābhyasūyave || 12.92 || pāṣaṇḍine na dātavyaṃ tebhyo rakṣetprayatnataḥ || iti śrīpāñcarātre mahopaniṣadi pādmasaṃhitāyāṃ caryāpāde puṣpahavirvidhānaṃ nāma dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ |
<4.13>
brahmā pañca kālavidhijñānaṃ praśastaṃ bhagavanniha | vihitaṃ pañcake kāle vidhayaścāpi pañcake || 13.1 || mahyaṃ jijñāsamānāya kathayasva yathātatham | na cedrahasyamatyantaṃ yadahaṃ pṛṣṭavānidam || 13.2 || śrībhagavān ādyaṃ karmābhigamanamupādānamataḥparam | ijyā ca paścātsvādhyāyastato yāgastataḥparam || 13.3 || paṃcaite vidhayasteṣāṃ kālāḥpaṃcaiva te kramāt | kalyāṇācaraṇāntaṃ yatkarmajātaṃ caturmukha || 13.4 || utthānādikramādetadabhiyānamudīritam | brāhme muhūrte budhyeta dhyāyannā rāyaṇaṃ param || 13.5 || utthāyīsīta śayane kīrtayannāma vaiṣṇavam | krameṇa sṛṣṭvā tatvāni dehamutpādya tatvavit || 13.6 || nyasya dehe ṣaḍaṅgāni mantramuccārya mānasam | daśāvatārān vyohāṃśca caturṇāṃ mānasānapi || 13.7 || dhyātvā svanāmabhistāni kīrtayitvā pṛthakpṛthak | avakuṇṭhya ca vastreṇa śarīraṃ dakṣiṇāṅghiṇā || 13.8 || ākramya bhūmiṃ prathamaṃ pravikramamanusmaran | namaḥ kṣitidharāyeti mantramuccārya mānasam || 13.9 || grāmādbahirdiśaṃ gatvānairṛtīṃ nyasya dakṣiṇe | upavītaṃ karṇadeśe vyavadhāya tṛṇādinā || 13.10 || bhūmiṃ samutsṛjenmūtraṃ kiṭṭaṃ ca tadanantaram | udaṅmukho divā kuryātsanthyayorubhayorapi || 13.11 || dakṣiṇābhimukho rātrau vāti vāte nusāriṇi | dakṣiṇetarahastena gṛhṇīyānmehanaṃ tataḥ || 13.12 || dakṣiṇe mṛttikāṃ haste samutthāya jalāśayam | prāgudīcyāṃ pratīcyāṃ vā gatvā śaucaṃ samācaret || 13.13 || mṛttikābhirdvādaśabhirgudaṃ ṣaḍbhiśca mehanam | antarācāntarā vāmakaraṃ prakṣālyavāribhiḥ || 13.14 || mṛṇmātrābhistadante dvaukarau dvādaśasaṅkhyayā | saṃśodhya caraṇai ṅaṅghe kaṭiṃ corū ca vāribhiḥ || 13.15 || pratyekaṃ mṛttikāmātrā catuṣkoṇe viśodhayet | ā camya praṅmukhobhūtvā dantadhāvanasamācaret || 13.16 || nyagrodhodumbharāśva tthaplakṣāmrārjunadhātakī | pālāśaveṇu khadiraśamīdārūṇi dhāvane || 13.17 || dantānāmuditānyekādaśa cāmbhoruhāsana | dantadhāvanakāṣṭhaṃ taddhvādaśāṅgulamāyatam || 13.18 || daśāṃgulaṃ tathā mānamaṣṭāṅgulamathā pi vā | brāhmaṇakṣatriyaviśāṃ krameṇa samudāhṛtam || 13.19 || jihvānirlekhanaṃ kuryā dgaṇḍūṣācamanaṃ punaḥ | kṣālayitvā mukhaṃ toyairācāntassnānamācaret || 13.20 || avagāhobhavedvāpyāṃ snāyādvā sarasīghu ca | vāpyādyasaṃbhave naiva kupaiṣvāplavanaṃ bhavet || 13.21 || snānaṃ vātaptatoyena doṣavaiṣamyasambhave | nābheradhastādvā dehaṃ kṣālayitvātmanastanum || 13.22 || ācamya prokṣayeddehaṃ vāribhirmantra vittanum | oṃ pūrvayā ca gāyatryā vāribhiścabhimantritaiḥ || 13.23 || ātmānaṃ pariṣicyordhvamutkṣi petsalilāñjalim | yoddhukāmāni rakṣāṃsi sandhyayorubhayorapi || 13.24 || śāmyanti tairvajraghātairhastābhiprerirjalaiḥ | prāyaścittaṃ tu hiṃsāyāḥ paribhramaṇamātmanaḥ || 13.25 || tarpayedupaviśyātha tattanmantramudīrayan | devādīn salile tiṣṭhan sāvitrīṃ prāṅmukho japet || 13.26 || yāvatsūryodayaṃ dṛṣṭvā prañjali stimirāpaham | upasthāya svaśākhoktairmantraidhyāyan hṛdi sthitam || 13.27 || abhivādya gurūn vṛddhārna tathā bhāgavatān kramāt | praṇamya svāśramaṃ devamabigamya yathāvidhi || 13.28 || arcayejjapahomāntaṃ dadyādgrāsaṃ gavāmapi | añjanālepanaissrigbhirvāsobhirbhūṣamaistathā || 13.29 || alaktakarasādyaiśca tāmbūlīmukhaśodanaiḥ | upetomaṅgalairanyairnayedabhigamakriyām || 13.30 || upādadyāttataḥpūjāsādhanāni yathāyatham | puṣpāṇi phalamūlāni vividhānyoṣadhīrapi || 13.31 || dadhyādi ca haviryogyaṃ taṇḍulāni gulāni ca | snānīyāni ca vastrāṇi svādūni salilāni ca || 13.32 || darbhān parṇāni samidho yathāśakti yathāvasu | āhṛtya yājñikārdhairvā pūjāsthāne niveśayet || 13.33 || nītvopādānasamayamitthaṃ tadanu pūjayet | prāpte madhyāhnasamaye snānaṃ kuryādyathāvidhi || 13.34 || nyāsamagre ṣaḍaṅgānāṃ kṛtvādāya mṛdaṃ kare | savye nidhāya kṛtvā tu tridhā mūlāgramadhyataḥ || 13.35 || mūle sthitāṃ mṛdaṃ pūrva mabhimantryāstravidyayā | vidikṣu dikṣu cordhvāyāmadharāyūmapi kṣipet || 13.36 || tato madhyasthitāṃ mṛtsnāmudake mūlavidyayā | nikṣipya bhāgamagrasthaṃ karābhyāṃ karayordvayoḥ || 13.37 || vidhāya paṅkamaṃbhobhirdarśayitvā ca pūṣaṇam | astrahīnāṅgavidyābhirāpādatalamastakam || 13.38 || ālipya dehamakhila mavagāhya ca vāriṣu | devamāvāhya lakṣmīśaṃ datvā cārghyādikaṃ tataḥ || 13.39 || tatpādakṣālanāmbobhiḥ pāṇibhyāṃ kumbhamudrayā | pāvanaiśśirasi nyastairātmānamabhiṣicya ca || 13.40 || vāsudevamabhidhyāyannaghamarṣaṇamācaret | uttīrya karmanikhilaṃ madhyāhna samayocitam || 13.41 || kṛtvā yajeta deveśaṃ homāntaṃ kamalāsana | stretreṇābhiṣṭuyāddevaṃ daṇḍavatpatitaḥkṣitau || 13.42 || jitante puṇḍarīkākṣa namaste viśvabhāvana | namaste'stu hṛṣīkeśa mahāpuruṣa pūrvaja || 13.43 || namaste vāsudevāya śāntānantacidātmane | ajitāya samastubhyaṃ ṣāḍguṇyanidhaye namaḥ || 13.44 || mahāvibhūtisaṃsthāya manaste puruṣottama | sahasraśirase tubhyaṃ sahasracaraṇāya te || 13.45 || sahasrabāhave tubhyaṃ sahasranayanāyate | amṛtāya namastubhyamekamūrtāya te namaḥ || 13.46 || aneka mūrtaye tubhya makṣarāya ca te namaḥ | vyāpine vedavedyāya namaste paramātmane || 13.47 || cinmātrarūpiṇe tubhyaṃ namastraiyanta bhūmaye | aṇiṣṭhāya sthaviṣṭhāya mahiṣṭhāya ca te namaḥ || 13.48 || nediṣṭhāya daviṣṭhāya kṣepiṣṭhāya ca te namaḥ | varṣiṣṭhāya yaviṣṭhāya kaniṣṭhāya namo namaḥ || 13.49 || pañcātmane namastubhyaṃ sarvāntaryāmiṇe namaḥ | kalpanā poḍharūpāya sṛṣṭhisthitya ntahetave || 13.50 || namaste guṇarūpāya guṇarūpātivartine | vyastāya ca samastāya samastavyastarūpiṇe || 13.51 || ādimadhyāntaśūnyāya tadvadeva namo namaḥ | praṇavapratipādyāya namaḥpraṇavarūpiṇe || 13.52 || lokayātrāprasidhyarthaṃ nṛṣṭa brahmādirūpiṇe | namastubhyaṃ nṛsiṃhādimūrtibhedāya viṣṇave || 13.53 || vipākaiḥkarmabhiḥklaiśairaspṛṣṭavapuṣe namaḥ | namo brahmaṇyadevāya tejasāṃ nidhaye namaḥ || 13.54 || nityasādhāraṇānekalokarakṣāparicchada | saccidānandarūpāya vareṇyāya namo namaḥ || 13.55 || yajamānāya yajñāya yaṣṭavyāya namo namaḥ | ijyāphalātmane tubhyaṃ namassvādhyāyaśūtine || 13.56 || namaḥparama hiṃsāya samassatvaguṇāyate | sthitāya parame pyūmni bhūyo bhūyo namo namaḥ || 13.57 || saṃsārasāgare ghore viṣayāvartasaṅkule | apāre dustare'gādhe patitaṃ karmabhissvakaiḥ || 13.58 || anādhamagatiṃ bhīruṃ dayāyā parayā hare | māmuddhara dayāsindho sindhorasmātsu dussahāt || 13.59 || mantrahāniṃ kriyāhāniṃ hāniṃ vānyāṃ tvadarcane | kṣamasva mama deva tvamaparādhasaho vyāsi || 13.60 || aparādhasahasrabhājanaṃ patitaṃ bhīmabhavārṇapodare | agatiṃ kharaṇāgataṃ hare kṛpayā kevalamātmasātkuru || 13.61 || janmaprabhṛtidāso'smi śiṣyo'smi tanayo'smite | tvaṃ ca svāmī gururmātā pitā ca mama mādhava || 13.62 || nāhaṃ hitaṃ vijānāmi tvāṃ bhajāmveva kevalam | budvaivaṃ naya govinda muktyupāyena vartmanā || 13.63 || tvameva vettā śreyo me naita detaditīti ca | buddhiyogaṃ ca me dehi yena tvāmupayāmyaham || 13.64 || iti vijñāpya deveśaṃ vaiśvadevaṃ svadhāmani | kuryātpañca mahāyajñānapi gṛhyoktavartmanā || 13.65 || atithīnapi tatkāle yathāśakti samarcayet | poṣyavargān bhojayitvā bhuñjīta niyatassvayam || 13.66 || ijyāyāssamayastasyāḥkathitaḥkamalāsana | mandire vā harerna dyāstīre vā maṭhabhūmiṣu || 13.67 || vivikte vipine vāpi parvate pā gṛhe'pi vā | ṛco yajāṃṣi sāmāni bhidyamānānyanekadhā || 13.68 || śākhābhedairmūlaśākhāyekāyanasamāhvayām | trayūmayīmadhīyīta sukhāsīnassamāhitaḥ || 13.69 || anyaissārdha madhīyānaiṣṣajaṅgeṣu ca rovidhaiḥ | adhyāpayīta vā śiṣyān śāstrāṇi vividhāni ca || 13.70 || itihāsapurāṇāni dharmaśāstrāṇi vā punaḥ | tadārādhananiṣṭhāni samabhyasyedyathāyatham || 13.71 || saṃsārabhīrubhirvipraistatva niṣkarṣakonidaiḥ | sahāsītopadeśādiprakāracaturairapi || 13.72 || svādhyāyakālaḥ kathitassvādhyāyopi ca kīrtitaḥ | tataḥpaścimasanthyāyāṃ prāptāyāṃ tatra coditam || 13.73 || japahomādikaṃ sarvaṃ kṛtvā paramapuruṣam | arcayitvā yathānyāyaṃ yathāpūrvamaśeṣataḥ || 13.74 || bhuktvā saṃviśya śayane samutthāya mahāniśi | ācam prayato bhūtvā dhyātvā paramapuruṣam || 13.75 || yogā nane sukhāsīno yuñjītātmānamātmani |
