yathoktena prakāreṇa yathāśakti caturmukha || 13.76 || saṃhārakramāśritya tatvānyātmani saṃharet | ātmānaṃ vāpi hṛtpadme paramātmani niṣṭhite || 13.77 || saṃha redutthito yogātsvāpaṃ kleśāvahaṃ tyajet | ityeṣa kathito brahman yogaḥkālaśca pañcamaḥ || 13.78 || pañcai te samayāḥpañca vidhaya steṣu darśitāḥ | itthameteṣu kāleṣu darśitaiḥkarmabhirnaraḥ || 13.79 || ārādhanaṃ bhagavataḥkurvannai vāvasīdati |
<4.14>
brahmā māsi māsi praśastāni nakṣatrāṇi janārdana | bhagavan kāni yeṣu syādarcanaṃ paramaṃ smṛtam || 14.1 || kāni cāṃśāvatārāṇāṃ janmarkṣāṇi yuge yuge | ucyatāṃ tāni deveśa śrotumicchāmi tatvataḥ || 14.2 || śrībhagavān caitre māsi punarvasvorjanma rāmasya maṅgalam | tithau navamyāṃ lagne ca kulīre kamalāsana || 14.3 || rāghavasyāprameyasya nakṣatre tatra rāghavam | devyāca sītayā sardhamarcayitvā yathāvidhi || 14.4 || utsavaśca bhavettasmin sarvamaṅgalasaṃyutaḥ | puṣye ca mīnalagne ca bharatassamajāyata || 14.5 || tatra syādarcanaṃ devyā māṇḍavyā saha pūrvavat | utsavaśca tathā sarpe nakṣatre lakṣmaṇo'pi ca || 14.6 || śatrughnaśca kulīre ca lagne jātastadarcanam | ubhayostatra divase devyā cormilayā saha || 14.7 || lakṣmaṇasyetarasyāpi śrutakīrtyā mahotsavaḥ | rāmasya janmanakṣatre sarve vā bharatādayaḥ || 14.8 || arcanīyā hanumatā sardhaṃ sarvairmahotsavaḥ | tatraiva śravaṇe caiva sāyāhne narakesarī || 14.9 || arcanīyassa hi tadā hiraṇyamavadhīdripum | tasminneva site pakṣe trayodaśyāṃ samarcayet || 14.10 || viṣṇuṃ yadvā punarvasvoḥ paurṇamāsyāmathāpi vā | vasantakālatṛptyarthaṃ tatsamṛddhibhirāhṛtaiḥ || 14.11 || puṣpairnānāvidhairdevamarcayeddakṣiṇāmukham | āsīnaṃ maṇḍape klṛpte vedīmadhye manorame || 14.12 || udyāne mandire vāpi kṛtrimodyānaśobhite | nadyādau vā yathāyogaṃ phalapuṣpodakānvite || 14.13 || paurṇamāsyāṃ tathau tasmin māse damanikādalaiḥ | puṣpānvitaiḥprapāṃ kṛtvā maṇḍape pūjayeddharim || 14.14 || puṣpordamanikābhiśca sarvālaṅkāramācaret | utsavaśca bhavettasmin homo damanikādalaiḥ || 14.15 || vaiśākhe māsi vā kuryādvasantotsavamabjaja | damanīdalakalyāṇamapi vā pūrvamīritam || 14.16 || vaiśākhe māsi vā caitre sitapakṣe śubhe dine | damanīdalavatkuryātkalhārakusumotsavam || 14.17 || sthāneṣu pūjayeddevaṃ kumbhādiṣu caturṣvapi | mahāhavirnivedyātha homaṃ kṛtvā samāpayet || 14.18 || phalānyapi samāhṛtya vanyajānapadānyapi | jyeṣṭhe vā śrāvaṇe vāpi devāya vinivedayet || 14.19 || sarvālaṅkārasaṃyuktaṃ vidadhyācca mahotsavam | evaṃ yaḥ kārayetpūjāṃ śraddhāpūtena cetasā || 14.20 || sarvān kāmānihāvāsya viṣṇolokaṃ sa gacchati | śrāvaṇe janma pūrvahṇe vāmanasya trivikramam || 14.21 || madhyaṃ dine ca tatkāladvaye pūjā madhudviṣaḥ | paurṇamāsyāṃ ca vaiśākhyāṃ hare rarcanamiṣyate || 14.22 || anurādhe hanumato janma tasmin sabhājayet | taṃ rāghaveṇa sahitaṃ sītayā lakṣmaṇena ca || 14.23 || āñjaneyaṃ tadatyantaprīṇanaṃ rāghavātmanaḥ | anūrādhe paurṇamāsyāṃ kalaśaissnapanaṃ hareḥ || 14.24 || āṣāḍhe śuklapakṣe ca dvādaśyāṃ kamalāsana | cakrābjamaṇḍale devamarcayitvā yathāvidhi || 14.25 || kalpite śayanāgāre mandhire vā yathāvasu | paryaṅke kalpite tatra śāyayitvātha kautukam || 14.26 || devībhyāṃ saha kūrcaṃ vā tritayaṃ tadabhāvataḥ | tatra nityārcanaṃ māsāṃścaturo maṅgalānvitam || 14.27 || nayeccaśayane naiva śāyayodanyakautukam | pratopavāsaniyamān kalpayitvā tadādikān || 14.28 || tadanuṣṭhāyinastatra cāturāśramya māśritāḥ | āsīraṃstatra niyatā stareyurnataraṅgiṇīm || 14.29 || devasya yāvadutthānāṃ bhogiparyaṅkaśāyinaḥ | śrāvaṇe māsi kṛṣṇe ca pakṣe'ṣṭamyāṃ tathau hareḥ || 14.30 || rohiṇyāṃ janma kṛṣṇasya lokānāṃ maṅgalāvaham | jayantī nāma sā proktā jayatyaśubhamityasau || 14.31 || madhyarātre tatastasmin kalyāṇaṃ sarvamācaret | tithyayoge'pi nakṣatre kevale'rcanamiṣyate || 14.32 || devasya devakīsūnoraparedyurmahotsavaḥ | nityaṃ naimittikaṃ kāmyaṃ karmayacchruticoditam || 14.33 || tatkurvatāmāśrameṣu sthitānāmānupūrvaśaḥ | varṇānāṃ mantralopādiśāntyarthaṃ pratyahaṃ hareḥ || 14.34 || ārādhaṃ bhagavataḥ pūrṇahutyā svayaṃ matam | tasya nyūnātirekābhyāṃ duṣkṛtaṃ sakalaṃ bhavet || 14.35 || karmajātaṃ tataḥpūrṇamārādhanamabhīpsitam | pratisaṃvatsaraṃ māsi śrāvaṇe tantunirmitam || 14.36 || pavitrabhūṣaṇaṃ viṣṇorāropyaṃ bahumālyavat | ārādhya vidhivadbhādrapade vāśvayuje'pi vā || 14.37 || mantralopādinā karma patitaṃ vihitaṃ punaḥ | prāyaśchitaina yatsarma kartāraṃ trāyate punaḥ || 14.38 || tatpavitraṃ phalairbhūyo rohatyeva samāhitaḥ | iti nirvacanāttat jñeḥpavitrārohaṇaṃ matam || 14.39 || pūrvoditeṣu māseṣu dvādaśyāṃ pratipadyapi | daśamyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ vā paṅca myāmadhavā tithau || 14.40 || ekādaśyāṃ trayodaśyāṃ dvitīyāyāmathāpi vā | sitapakṣe śubhe vāre lagne śubha tare'tha vā || 14.41 || śravaṇe puṣyarohiṇyāṃ revatyāṃ bharaṇīṣu ca | svātau hastapunarvasvoraśvinyāṃ mitradaivate || 14.42 || ṛkṣeṣvanyatam kāryaṃ pavitrāropaṇaṃ hare | tantūn brāhmaṇakanyābhirnirmitān doṣavarjitān || 14.43 || kārpāsānvātha kau śeyān krītānvā śauddhavāribhiḥ | kṣālitānmi śritāṃścūrṇai rmaudgikaiśśoṣayedbhahiḥ || 14.44 || ātapeṣu tataśśuthdhān śoṣitāṃ striguṇīkṛtān | punastāṃ striguṇīkṛtya tāvantopi caturguṇān || 14.45 || yadvā triguṇatāṃ nītvā caturguṇyaṃ caturmukha | triguṇāṃstriguṇīkṛtya yadvā tānekatāṃ nayet || 14.46 || gomiyālepite bhūmitale mānānusārataḥ | śaṅkvosthsāpitayoryajñadrumasambhūtayo stataḥ || 14.47 || āropya bhagavadbhaktāḥ prāṅmukhā vāpyu daṅmukhāḥ | āsīnā gururanyo vā tatprayuktāssamāhitāḥ || 14.48 || snātā nirmāṇanipuṇā manuṣyā bhagavanmayāḥ | kuryāḥpavitra kalyāṇaṃ yathā syādbhūṣaṇottamam || 14.49 || pavitramadhivāsārthamādyaṃ nābhyavadhismṛtam | aṣṭottaraśataissūtrairdvātriṃśadgranthibhiryutam || 14.50 || mūlaberādiberāṇāṃ pavitramidamiṣyate | pavitraṃ maṇṭale padmatulyamānaṃ ghaṭe'pi ca || 14.51 || kuṇḍe ca mekhalāmānaṃ purvedyurmānamīritam | aparedyuḥpavitreṣu mānaṃ saṃprati kathyate || 14.52 || padmanābhyaranemīnāṃ cakrābje maṇḍale satām | tanmānāni pavitrāṇi bāhyamānaṃ bahissamam || 14.53 || granthayastantavaścaiṣāṃ kathyanaica yathākramam | catuśsatāni sūtrāṇi granthayassaptaviṃśatiḥ || 14.54 || śatatrayaṃ tantusaṅkhyā grandhayo dviguṇā matāḥ | dveśa te dviguṇā granthiśatameka manantaram || 14.55 || caturguṇā granthisaṅkhyā bāhyasūtraṃ catuśśatam | granthayaḥpañca guṇitāḥ kumbhe cāṣṭottaraṃ śatam || 14.56 || tantavo granthisaṅkhyā ca saptaviṃśatiriṣyate | ekādhikāśītisaṅkhyāsta ntavaḥ karake matāḥ || 14.57 || saptaviṃśati saṅkhyāścha granthayaḥparikīrtitāḥ | pavitrasaṅkhyā bherāṇāṃ daśa tāni padāmite || 14.58 || prāmāṇyaṃ gandhasaṃjñaṃ cāpyalaṅkārāhvayaṃ tathā | uttamādhamamadhyākhyaṃ kirīṭāhvamanantaram || 14.59 || śrīvatsakaustubhāhvānaṃ vanamālāhvayaṃ tathā | mānāni teṣāṃ sūtrāṇi granthayaśca yathākramam || 14.60 || karthyanainābhimaryādā sūtrāṇyaṣṭottaraṃ śatam | dvātriṃśadgranthayastasya hṛdayāntamana ntaram || 14.61 || sūtrāṇyaśīti tasyoktā kranthayaḥ paṅca viṃśatiḥ | jaṅghāmadhyāntamāyāmaṃ nirmitaṃ śatatantubhiḥ || 14.62 || aṣṭottarairgranthibhiśca dvātriṃśadguṇatairyutam | uttamākhyasya sūtrāṇāṃ bhavetsaṅkhyā catuśśatam || 14.63 || śatamaṣṭauttaraṃ saṅkhyā granthīnāṃ jānusīma tat | śatāni trīṇi tantūnāṃ granthayo'śītiriṣyate || 14.64 || āyataṃ corumadhyāntaṃ dveśate tantavaḥ punaḥ | nābhyantaṃ granthayaṣṣaṣṭi tantavo'tha catuśśatam || 14.65 || kirīṭamānaṃ dvātriṃśadgranthaya stadana ntaram | śatāni trīṇi tantūnāṃ hārākāraprakalpitam || 14.66 || granthibhissaptaviṃśatyā dve śate ta ntavaḥ punaḥ | dvātriṃśat ntasamaryādaṃ sahasraṃ cāṣṭabhiryutam || 14.67 || tantavaścaraṇā yāmamanekagranthibhiryutam | viṣṭarasya sahotthasya pavitraṃ tatsamaṃ madam || 14.68 || tantavo'ṣṭottaraśataṃ granthayaḥpañcaviṃśatiḥ | prabhāvitraṃ tattulyaṃ granthayo bahanaḥsmṛtāḥ || 14.69 || sarveṣāṃ ca svatantrāṇāṃ bimbānāmidamīritam | paratantreṣu bimbeṣu tritayaṃ tū ttamādikam || 14.70 || devīnāṃ ca śriyādīnāṃ pavitraṃ tadvadiṣyate | aṣṭottaraśataissūtrairgranthibhirbahubhiryutam || 14.71 || agnikuṇḍe mekhalāsu pavitraṃ pratimekhalam | tantubhissaptaviṃśatyā tāvadbhirgranthibhiryutam || 14.72 || agneḥpavitraṃ hastena samāyāmaṃ prakīrtitam | madhyamaṃ pañcaviṃśatyā dvāviṃśatyādhame matam || 14.73 || sūtrāṇāṃ pañcaviṃśatyā pavitraṃ sruksruvādiṣu | tadāyāmasamāyāmaṃ granthibhirbahubhiryutam || 14.74 || arghyapātre tathā dhūpadīpapātre caturmukha | ghaṇṭāyāmakṣamālāyāṃ sarvatrāṣṭottaraiśśataiḥ || 14.75 || sūtrairyathepsitāgranthirdvādaśāṅgulamāyatam | viṣvaksenasya tārkṣyasya tathā duścyavanādiṣu || 14.76 || digdevatāsu druhiṇe durgāyāṃ vighnunāyake | rudre ca parivāreṣu pavitraṃ tastubhiḥkṛtam || 14.77 || śatenāṣṭottareṇa syāddvātriṃśadgranthibhiryutam | hastamānāyataṃ kāryaṃ caṇḍādiṣu ca sarvataḥ || 14.78 || saptaviṃśatisūtreṇa granthibhinnena nirmitam | hastamānaṃ bhavetkumbhatoraṇādiṣu tādṛśam || 14.79 || balipīṭhapavitraṃ tu karṇikāyā masaṃmitam | ācāryāṇāṃ yatīnāṃ ca pavitraṃ tantubhiḥkṛtam || 14.80 || aṣṭottaraśatai ssūtrairgranthibhiḥparvabhiryutam | ṛtvijāṃ pūjakānāṃ ca brāhmaṇānāṃ tathaiva ca || 14.81 || ekāśītyā kṛtaṃ sūtrairnābhyantaparilambitam | rājñaḥpavitraṃ sūtreṇa śatenāṣṭottareṇa tu || 14.82 || yatheṣṭagranthinicayaistūlagarbhaiścanirmitam | nābhyantamānametatsyāttathā tadanujīvinām || 14.83 || etāśītyā kṛtaṃ sūtrairvaiśyādīnāṃ ca tantubhiḥ | caturviṃśatibhisteṣāṃ pavitramupavītavat || 14.84 || pavitreṣu samasteṣu vistāro vibhave sati | pādonamardhaṃ pādo vā saṅkhyā syādvibhavakṣaye || 14.85 || granthīṃstataḥpavitrāṇāṃ dravyaiḥ kastūri kādibhiḥ | maṇimuktāpravālādyai ratnaiścāpi yathāvasu || 14.86 || lohaiśca kaladhautādyaistūlairvā tadasannidhau | pūrayitvā dṛḍhaṃ badhvā granthīṃstāṃ stanturajjubhiḥ || 14.87 || granthayaśśaṅkhasaṃsthānasamānākṛtayo'tha vā | dhātrīphala samākārā yadvā muktādi sannibhāḥ || 14.88 || kuṅkumairocanābhiśca tathā malayajairapi | lohitairapyavaśyāyaissaṃpiṣṭaiḥkardamīkṛtaiḥ || 14.89 || granthīnāmantarālāni limpecchobhā yathā bhavet | granthīnāṃ pūraṇaṃ yadvā mallikādyaissugandhibhiḥ || 14.90 || puṣpaustadantarālāni niśācarcābhireva vā | rañjayettantavaścāpi granthayaśca yathecchayā || 14.91 || yathāvibhavavistāraṃ kalpaniyāścaturmukha | vibhave sati saṅkoco naiva kāryastathā'sati || 14.92 || vistāro naiva kāryasyāttadeva prīṇanaṃ hareḥ | sadyo'dhi vāsya vā tasminnupoṣyārādhayeddharim || 14.93 || gṛhārcane kautuke vā maṇḍale vā ghaṭe'pi vā | arcanaṃ śraddhayā kāryaṃ śraddhāpūtamidaṃ jagat || 14.94 || vihiteṣu pavitreṣu yathoktenaiva vartmanā | ārabhetārcanaṃ viṣṇordaśamyāṃ ca nivedanam || 14.95 || niśāmukhe gurussārdhaṃ mūrtipaissu samāhitaḥ | yajamānena sahitaḥpraviśedviṣṇumandiram || 14.96 || praviśya pūjayitvātaṃ gurustaissahitassvayam | vijñāpayedimāṃ gadhā mīrayan prāñjalisthitaḥ || 14.97 || nyūvātirekaśāntyarthaṃ pavitrārohaṇaṃ param | arcanaṃ bhagavan sarvadurutotsāraṇakṣamam || 14.98 || saṃpadāṃ cāpi sarvāsāmutpādanamanu tamam | kriyate tadavighnena yathā syātkarma coditam || 14.99 || tathānujñāpayāmi tvā manujānīhi karmatat | iti vijñāpya nirgatya mandirāt maṇḍape punaḥ || 14.100 || saṃstīrya darbhān prāgagrān teṣu prāgānano guruḥ | upaviśyopavāsaṃ ca kalpayitvā samāhitaḥ || 14.101 || nayettatreva tāṃ rātriṃ japadhyānaparassadā | aparedyu rniśīdhinyāmadhipāsanakarmatat || 14.102 || ārabhettekabhereṣu badhvā tatreva kautukam | bahuberuṣu kalyāṇamimbe kautukamaṅgalam || 14.103 || tato nirgatya vipule maṇṭape toraṇādikam | arcayitvā yathāpūrvaṃ dikṣu caiva vidikṣu ca || 14.104 || caturvedavito viprānekāyanavidastathā | adhīyānān sthāpayitvā turyāghoṣeṣu satsu ca || 14.105 || maṅguleṣvapi cānyeṣu kalpiteṣu yathātatham | pavitrapātrāṇyādāya prāgudagbhuvi maṇḍape || 14.106 || dhānyarāśiṣu saṃsthāpya puṇyāhaṃ vācayettataḥ | dahanāpyāyanadhyānaiḥ pātrasthāni viśodhayet || 14.107 || dhūpayedgandhavaddravyairlimpetkastūri kādibhiḥ | puṣpāṇi vikiretteṣu gandhavanti bahuni ca || 14.108 || tāni bhūṣaṇapātrāṇi veṣṭayennavavāsasā | darśayeccakramudrāṃ ca pūjayedastravidyayā || 14.109 || aiśānīṃ diśamārabhya sūtressaṃveṣṭya maṇṭapam | maṇṭapasyopari dhyātvā cakraṃ bhūmitale punaḥ || 14.110 || padmaṃ gadāṃ ca dvāreṣu śaṅkhamaṣṭanu dikṣu ca | pratyūhakāriṇāṃ tasya chidramanviṣya dhāvatām || 14.111 || bhūtānāṃ rākṣasādīnāṃ māṣānnena baliṃ kṣipet | bahubereṣu kalyāṇabimbaṃ snānāsane bahiḥ || 14.112 || sthāpayitvopavītā ntamupacarya yathātatham | cakrābjamaṇḍale bhūyassamānīya caturmukha || 14.113 || havirnivedanāntetu samārādhana karmaṇi | niṣṭhite karake kumbhe devamāvāhya pūjayet || 14.114 || havirnivedayitvānte hutvācāgniṃ yathāpuram | ekabere cu kalyāṇa kautukārādhanaṃ vinā || 14.115 || anyatsarvamanuṣṭheyaṃ yathā pūrvodita kramāt | sambhave kautuke tasmin pavitraṃ bhūṣaṇaṃ punaḥ || 14.116 || nikṣipetkumbhakarake dahane tadanantaram | cakrābjamaṇḍale mantramidaṃ viṣṇuriti bruvan || 14.117 || praviśya mandiraṃ sarvairmaṅgulaissaha deśikaḥ | mūlaberaṃ samāsādya pavitranyasanaṃ tataḥ || 14.118 || pūrvoditena mantreṇa sarvārcāsu yathākramam | pavitrabhūṣaṇanyāsaḥ pañca rāgaiśca tantubhiḥ || 14.119 || prāsādaṃ veṣṭayedrātrau sarvamāmnāyaghoṣaṇaiḥ | pādyairgeyaiśca nṛttaiśca stotrairjāgaritā janāḥ || 14.120 || nayeyuraparedyuśca kautukaṃ maṇḍalesthitam | snānavedyāṃ samānīya snāpayitvā yathāvidhi || 14.121 || alaṅkṛtya ca deveśaṃ maṇḍale mārjanādibhiḥ | śodhite vartayitvā ca cakrābjaṃ pañcavarṇakaiḥ || 14.122 || dvārādiyajanaṃ prāgvatkṛtvāvasthāpya maṇḍale | devamārādhya dīpāntaṃ kumbhādīnapi pūjayet || 14.123 || annaṃ caturvidhaṃ cāpi kumbhe deve nivedya ca | agnau ca juhuyādannaṃ pāyasādi caturvidham || 14.124 || pauruṣeṇai va sūktena yavaiśca vrīhi veṇubhiḥ | tilairlājaistathā puṣpaistathā cāgarubirghṛtaiḥ || 14.125 || samidbhirmūlamantreṇa pṛthagaṣṭottaraṃ śatam | muhūrte śobhane prāpte daivajñapariśodhite || 14.126 || pavitrāṇi samādāya cakrābjaṃ bhūṣayetpunaḥ | padmādīni tadaṅgāni yathā svamidamityṛcā || 14.127 || tataḥkumbhe cakarake deve ca tadanantaram | sa eva mantraḥkuṇḍe'pi havyavāhe'pi toraṇe || 14.128 || dvārakumbheṣu tat stheṣu pavitrāṇi yathā tathā | tataḥ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya maṇḍalasthaṃ jagadgurum || 14.129 || praviśya mandiraṃ sarvairmaṅgulaissaha deśikaḥ | snapanādi vidhāyādau samārādhana macyute || 14.130 || havirnivedanāntaṃ tatkṛtvā tatratyadevatāḥ | mūlaberaṃ samārabhya pavitrai rbhūṣayetsvakaiḥ || 14.131 || parapantrāssvatantrāśca sarvāḥpūrvokta vidyayā | abhyarcyagandhapuṣpādyaiḥpavitrāṇi pṛthakpṛthak || 14.132 || deyāni dānavelāyāṃ vādyavādanakovidāḥ | nartakā gāyakāścaiva tathā svādhyāyakovidāḥ || 14.133 || sarve yathāsvanṛttādi darśayeyustadantike | caṇḍādiparānārāṇāmanyeṣāṃ prāṅkaṇāsinām || 14.134 || pavitrāṇi pradeyāni balipīṭhāvasānakam | brahmādi devatānāṃ ca tārkṣyaseneśayorapi || 14.135 || sarveṣāmapyanuktānāṃ pavitrāṇi yathāyatham | mantraśca viṣṇugāyatrī yadvedaṃ viṣṇurityayam || 14.136 || yadvācāṣṭākṣareṇaiva mantreṇa dvādaśātmanā | deśiko mūrtipaissārdhaṃ yajamānena saṃyutaḥ || 14.137 || praviśya mandiraṃ viṣṇo ratnapūrṇāñjalissvayam | hemapuṣpāñjalirvāpi yadvā puṣpabhṛtāñjaliḥ || 14.138 || stotrestuvāno bahubhirvikirettāni pādayoḥ | katnāni hemapuṣpāṇi puṣpāṇi surabhīṇyapi || 14.139 || kalpitāni manuṣyāṇāṃ pavitrāṇi yathāyatham | nyasya deveśapadayoḥ puṣpavatsusamāhitaḥ || 14.140 || kṣaumā dīni pavitrāṇi devaṃ vijñāpya deśikaḥ | svayaṃ gṛhītvā kṣaumādipavitraṃ cātmanaḥ kṛtam || 14.141 || dadyātpūjakamukhyānāmṛtvijāṃ sahakāriṇām | ekāyanīyaniṣṭhānāmanyeṣāṃ viduṣāmapi || 14.142 || yathādhikāraṃ kramaśo devasyālokya cānanam | spṛṣṭvā devapadānbhoja mācāryotha janāntike || 14.143 || nyūnātirekaśāntyarthaṃ gādhāmenāmudīrayet | bhagavan devadeveśa śaṅkhacakragadādhara || 14.144 || saṃvatsaropacārāṇāṃ pūraṇārthaṃ kṛtaṃ mayā | ārādhanaṃ gṛhāṇatvaṃ bhaktānāṃ hitakāmyayā || 14.145 || nāhaṃ svatantraḥkiñcicca karomi vihitaṃ hitam | kintu tvattpreritassarvaṃ karomi tava yatsvayam || 14.146 || tatkṣantavyamaśeṣeṇa kriyālopādyanuṣṭhitam | samaye yajamānastu gāṃ bhuvaṃ kāñcanaṃ tathā || 14.147 || vastrādikaṃ tathā dhānyaṃ bhojayitvā mahīsurān | datvā yathepti tānarthānācāryāya ca dakṣiṇām || 14.148 || śataniṣkāvarāṃ gobhūvastradhānyādi kāvyapi | mūrtipebhyastathānyebhyastattatka rmānusārataḥ || 14.149 || yathātuṣṭikaraṃ deyaṃ yāge tatropakurvatām | aparāhṇe bahirgrāme kuryādevaṃ mahotsavam || 14.150 || prokṣya pratyahametāni pūjākāleṣu pūjakaiḥ | syasanīyāni divasāṃ ścaturdaśa caturmukha || 14.151 || yadvaikaviṃśatiṃ sapta yadi vā divasānapi | trirātramekarātraṃ vā paścāttānyaparohayet || 14.152 || uccaran pauruṣaṃ sūktaṃ sāma yadvā rathantaram | trisuvarṇaṃ tathā mantraṃ mūlamastramathāpi vā || 14.153 || avaropya pavitrāṇi deyāni gurave tataḥ | kurave tāni dattāni prīṇanāya madhudvipaḥ || 14.154 || anyathā karmanaiṣphalyaṃ kṣayassyāddhrājarāṣṭrayoḥ | maṇḍalasdhaṃ ca kumbhasthamagnisthaṃ ca visarjayet || 14.155 || pavitrārohaṇadine kālotkarṣona yujyate | kṛtvā varohaṇaṃ teṣāṃ snapanaṃ tadana ntaram || 14.156 || kāryaṃ yathoktavidhinā praviśenmandiraṃ tataḥ | ityeṣa kathito brahman pavitrārohaṇevidhiḥ || 14.157 || anena vidhinā viṣṇoḥpavitrārohaṇaṃ hareḥ | kurvan phalānyanantāni prāpnu yānnaiva saṃśayaḥ || 14.158 || sukhaṃ jīvati nirvyādhi ryāvadāyussamṛddhimān | āyuśca vindati prāptaṃ dharmāthān dharmamāpnuyāt || 14.159 || kāmānavāpnuyātkāmī arthārthīcārthamāpnuyāt | mokṣārthī mokṣamāpnoti prajārthī labhate prajāḥ || 14.160 || bāndhavairlabhatecāpi pravāsibhissamāgamam | kīrtiṃcāpnoti paramāṃ kīrtikāmo na saṃśayaḥ || 14.161 || jñānārthī jñānamāpnoti śāntyarthī śāntimāpnuyāt | śatravastu praṇaśyanti grahabhūtādyupadravāḥ || 14.162 || ārogyakāmī cārogyaṃ śrīkāmaśsriyāmāpnuyāt | bahunātra kimuktena phalaṃ yadyadabhīpsitam || 14.163 || tatsarvaṃ tasyahastathaṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā | bhuktvā bhoṃgāṃśca vipulān dhyātvā cānte madhudviṣam || 14.164 || tallokaṃ samavāpnoti na cehojāyate punaḥ | dhārayanti pavitrāṇi yebhaktāśśraddhayānvitāḥ || 14.165 || tepi nirdhūya pāpāni modantediva devavat | ācāryo mūrtipāssarve ye cānye paricārakāḥ || 14.166 || ye śyaṇvanti ca paśyanti kīrtayanti ca karma tat || te sarvepi samṛddhārthālabhante sarvasaṃpadaḥ || 14.167 || āgrayaṇaṃ śrāvaṇe māsi māsi proṣṭhapade'pi vā | māse cāśvayuje brahman kārtike māsivā bhavet || 14.168 || varṣāsvevaṃ tatonyatra taiṣe māghe'pi vā bhavet | phālgune māsi caitre vā vaiśākhe vā tadācaret || 14.169 || haste ca śravaṇe pauṣṇe nairṛte ca prajāpateḥ | nakṣatre vāruṇe puṣye vāyavyeditidaivate || 14.170 || makhāsu maitre citrāyāṃ śraviṣṭhāyāmathāpi vā | saumye triṣūttarākhyeṣu sambhavānuguṇaṃ bhavet || 14.171 || ayugmāstithayassarvā navamīparirjitāḥ | yugmāstu tithayo neṣṭā dvitīyāṃ daśamīṃ vinā || 14.172 || somo bṛhaspatissaumyo bṛguśceti grahāśśubhāḥ | meṣavṛścikamine tu kanyājhaṣakulīrake || 14.173 || pūrvapakṣe ca kartavyastatrāyaṃ karmaṇaḥkramaḥ | ādau dadhyādanaṃ kṣetre kṣetrapālāya kalpayet || 14.174 || muhūrte lavanasyokte vidhāya lavanaṃ tataḥ | dhānyaṃ kaṇiśabhāreṇa gṛhṇīyādbhūmikarṣakaiḥ || 14.175 || kadalīpanasādīni tathādadhighṛtādikam | dhānyabhārāsapi tathā kandalyādidalāni ca || 14.176 || nayeyurnṛttavāditragītālaṅkārasaṃyutam | purataḥ pṛṣṭhataścaiva seneśavihagadhipau || 14.177 || alaṅkṛtau kuñjarādiyānārūḍhau yathāvasu | chatra cāmarasauśeyadhvajātiparibarhakau || 14.178 || nītvā pradakṣiṇaṃ grāmamālayaṃ ca madhudviṣaḥ | goṣṭhāgāraṃ praviśyāntardhānyaṃ kaṇiśagocaram || 14.179 || śrīsūktena samabhyarcya bhāṇḍeṣvabhinaveṣu tat | nikṣipya saṅgrahaṃ tasya kuryāttatrāla yeṣu ca || 14.180 || karmiṇāṃ devadevasya tathā devaṃ samarcatām | yathādhikāraṃ dhānyāni dadyācca samaye śubhe || 14.181 || taṇḍulānnūtanā nāmān kṣālitāṃstriphalīkṛtān | maricairjīrakai ryuktān gulapākenubhāvitān || 14.182 || nālikeraphalopetānikṣukhaṇḍasamanvitān | mūlaberādiberāṇāṃ muhūrte śobhane guruḥ || 14.183 || nivedayettato mūlavidyayāṣṭottaraṃ śatam | taṇḍulai rjuhuyādagnau brāhmaṇānāṃ yathāpuram || 14.184 || tasmin dine paredyurvā navānnāni nivedayet | prabhūtasskṛtā nekaniṣṭhāni kadalīdale || 14.185 || iti śrīpāñcarātre mahopaniṣadi pādme tantre caryāpāde pavitrādyutsavavidhirnāma caturdaśo'dhyāyaḥ |
<4.15>
śrībhagavān māsi bhādrapade devaṃ śravaṇe cādipūruṣam | varāharūpaṃ subhagaṃ hiraṇyākṣāsuradviṣam || 15.1 || yajeta dharayā devyā sārdhaṃ sarvārthasiddhaye | anyeṣāṃ mūrtibhedānāmapi tasmin samarcanam || 15.2 || svātāvāśvayuje māsi yajanaṃ snapanādibhiḥ | kārtike māsi saṃprāpte dvādaśyāṃ cāsitetare || 15.3 || pakṣe prabodhayeddevamarcayitvā yathāvasu | mantraścodityamityeṣa uttiṣṭheti ca bodhane || 15.4 || prabodhya vārcayeddevamutthitaṃ vidhivartmanā | autsavaṃ bimpamabhyarcya maṇḍape maṇḍale sthitam || 15.5 || dvāratoraṇakumbhādiyajanaṃ ca yathāpuram | grāme mahotsavaḥ kāryassarvamaṅgalasaṃyutaḥ || 15.6 || sarvecāśramiṇaḥ kuryārvratānāṃ ca visarjanam | daśaniṣkaṃ tadardhaṃ vā dakṣiṇāṃ gurave tadā || 15.7 || kṛttikāsu kārtikyāṃ porṇamāsyāṃ madhudviṣaḥ | kṛttikābhirayoge vā kevalāyāṃ tithau bhavet || 15.8 || dīvotsavaṃ tathā sarvaṃ śobhayenmama mandiram | aropya sarvato dīpān stambheghāccairmadhudviṣaḥ || 15.9 || dikṣu sarvāsu sarvatra tathā cāvaraṇeṣu ca | kūṭā kārāḥkalpinīyāsteṣāṃ syurdīpamālikāḥ || 15.10 || prākārabhittiṣu tathā maṇḍape gopu reṣu ca | bahvībhirdīpamālābhirbhāvyaṃ sarvāsu dikṣu ca || 15.11 || dīvotsavāya pūrvedyurniśi kalyāṇakautukam | badhnīyādautsave bimbe sarvamaṅgalasaṃyutam || 15.12 || aparedyuśca mūlādiberāṇāmarcanaṃ bhavet | naimittikaṃ pradoṣe tu kuryāddīpādhipāsanam || 15.13 || purastānmūlaberasya pātramāropya nūtanam | dhānyarāśau tatastasmiṃścajyamāḍhakasaṃmitam || 15.14 || kāpilaṃ tailamadhavā nikṣipya pariśodhitam | ṛjuvartiṃ tantubhirvā pāsasā nūtanena vā || 15.15 || kalpayitvā samuddhṛtya kuṇḍāgniṃ tena dīpayet | vartimāgneyamantreṇa agnimudrāṃ pradarśayet || 15.16 || abhyarcya cāgni mantraistu muhūrte śobhane guruḥ | ādāya pātraṃ tat sthena vahninā valajādiṣu || 15.17 || dīpayeddīpikāssarvāstūryeṣu vidiśo diśaḥ | ghoṣayatsu tathā nṛttagītādīnāṃ samudyame || 15.18 || adhīyāneṣu vipreṣu mantrānanavadaivatān | autsavaṃ bimbamādāya sarvalaṅkāraśobhitam || 15.19 || yānamāropya rathyāsu nayedāvaraṇeṣu ca | dṛśyāni nāṭakādīni kṛtrimāṇītarāṇica || 15.20 || darśayeddeva devāya bhāṣābhedānyathoditān | āsādya maṇṭape tasminni vedya ca mahā haviḥ || 15.21 || pṛthukān saṃskṛtān saktūn palalānagnitṛptaye | apūpān samaye tasminni vedya madhuvidviṣe || 15.22 || abhyastaraṃ mandirasya gamayenmaṅgalānvitam | kṛttikādīpavidhinā samārādhasamīritam || 15.23 || viśāṃ ca rājño rāṣṭrasya sampatkaramanuttamam | vipatpraśramanaṃ brahman prīṇanaṃ jātavedasaḥ || 15.24 || mārgaśīrṣesite pakṣe māsi vratamanuttamam | dvādaśyāṃ vratapūrvatvādvratamārādhanaṃ hareḥ || 15.25 || ārādhanaṃ bhagavataḥkurvaṃstādṛśamuttamam | daśamyāṃ harimārādhya bhojayitvāca bhūsurān || 15.26 || dakṣiṇāṃ ca yathāśakti datvā tebhyassamāhitaḥ | bhagavatsannidau teṣāṃ vijñāpya dvādaśīvratam || 15.27 || anujñāpūrvakaṃ pūjāṃ vratapūrvāṃ mahāphalām | saṅkalpya darbheṣvāsīnaḥ prāṅmukhaḥ praṇidānavān || 15.28 || haviṣyāśī sakṛtkṛtvā sarvaṃ karmāhnikaṃ tathā | rātrau ca bhagavadyogamāsthāya ca yathāvidhi || 15.29 || aparedyuḥkriyājātame kādaśyāṃ yathāvidhi | pūrvaṃ triṣavaṇannāyī niyamaṃ paramāsthitaḥ || 15.30 || anaśnan devamārādhya homāntaṃ maunamāsthitaḥ | bhagavaddhyānanirato vyavahāraṃ ca laukikam || 15.31 || asaṃspṛśan manaḥkāyakarmabhiśceṅgitādibhiḥ | sthito maunī tadā tadvadrātrau kautukamabandhanam || 15.32 || badhvā deveśamārādhya darbhaśāyūnayenni śām | brāhme muhūrtecotthāya kṛtvā sandhyāṃ yathāvidhi || 15.33 || karmadevāntikaṃ gatvā kuryātpūjāṃ yathāpuram | caturvedavido viprān dikṣu prācyādiṣu kramāt || 15.34 || darbhāsaneṣvāsayitvā devasyābhimukhaṃ yathā | koṇeṣu ca diśāṃ viprānekāyanavida stathā || 15.35 || adhyāpayedadhyayanaṃ yathā svacchandasāṃ guruḥ | sāmagāni tarālābhe kevalāṃ stapasi sthitān || 15.36 || ekāyanavido vāpi harestatprīṇanaṃ param | prāśayedprāhmaṇaissārdhaṃ vratasdhaḥkāyaśuddhaye || 15.37 || kuśodakaṃ pañca gavyaṃ prāpaṇaṃ ca yathā kramam | divā svāpaṃ parānnaṃ ca punarbhojanakarma ca || 15.38 || strīsevāṃ tailasevāṃ ca kāṃsyabhojanameva ca | māṃsāśanaṃ tyajettasmin divase karma garhitam || 15.39 || bhojayecca yathāśakti tadyādante ca dakṣiṇām | upavāsākṣamo naktame kādaśyāṃ samācaret || 15.40 || ajñānāccettrayodaśyāṃ pāraṇaṃ rākṣasaṃ bhavet | varjyāśca vārā mandasya bhṛgoraṅgārakasya ca || 15.41 || nakṣatraṃ yamadaivatyaṃ vratārambhe caturmukha | pāraṇaṃ copavāsaśca na doṣāya tithitraye || 15.42 || na sambhāṣeta pāṣaṇḍavṛttibhirgarhitairnaraiḥ | pramādādapinaivānyairnāstikaiḥpratilomajaiḥ || 15.43 || nāśaucavadbhirdvādaśyāṃ vratastho nāvalokayet | ārdrāyāmapi māse'smin janmarkṣeca garutmataḥ || 15.44 || tatprītaye samārādhyo hariśśāstroktavartmanā | pāyasānnaṃ gulānnaṃ ca prabhāte vinivedayet || 15.45 || bimbaṃ cautsavamākalpya vīdhikāvaraṇeṣu ca | garuḍenaiva sahitaṃ gamayenmaṅgalānvitam || 15.46 || uttarecāyane devaṃ snapanādyaissamarcayet | ghṛtenābhyañṅayeddevaṃ majjayedvā ghṛtādiṣu || 15.47 || ghṛte vā dadhni pīyūṣe yadvā madhuni sambhṛte | phaleṣu vā phalarane pañca gavyaraseṣu vā || 15.48 || pāyasādiṣu cānneṣu kālapuṣpoccayeṣu vā | daleṣu vā tulasyāternavaratnaca yeṣu vā || 15.49 || suvarṇakaladhauteṣu puṣpākāreṣu śobhane | suvarṇa golakāḥkṛtvā kalpitāvayapojvalāḥ || 15.50 || kalpitākalpakalyāṇapratimākārasaṃmitāḥ | pīṭhikākāratulitāstābhirācchādya bhūṣayet || 15.51 || pañcāyudhasamākārā hastādisatṛśākṛtīḥ | kṛtvā vṛthagyathāśobhaṃ galakāḥ kañcukākṛtīḥ || 15.52 || bhūṣayettābhiraṅgāni cāyudhāni ca sarvaśaḥ | āpādamastakaṃ vānyairvrīhyādibhiradhokṣajam || 15.53 || chādayenmūlamantreṇa pūraṇaṃ sarvavastubhiḥ | tisrastripādasahitā napi vā dviguṇāṃ stathā || 15.54 || pūrayetkālamātodyanṛttagītādumaṅgalam | ācaretsarvametasminyathāvibhava vistaram || 15.55 || juhuyātsarpiṣā yāvatpūraṇaṃ mūlavidyayā | deyā ca dakṣiṇā svarṇamācāryaya yathāvasu || 15.56 || ghṛtādipūraṇaṃ caitatsarvakāmasamṛddhidam | puṣye ca māsi nakṣatre paurṇamāsyāmathāpi vā || 15.57 || ārādhanaṃ bhagavatassarvapāpavināśanam | māghamāse site pakṣe vañcamyāṃ madhuvidviṣam || 15.58 || samārādhya yathāśāstraṃ devasyāgre mahītale | gomayālepite dvābhyāṃ hastābhyāmapi saṃmite || 15.59 || caturbhirvā samāyāmavistāre cchādi tepunaḥ | vāsasā nūtanenaiva sadaśena tathopari || 15.60 || kṛṣṇājinena śuddhena bhedanaccedanādinā | varjitena samācchādya vastraṃ tadupari kṣipet || 15.61 || tilānāṃ bhāramekaṃ vā dvau vā kṛtvā ca vedikām | trimekhalāṃ tile tasmin padmākārasamākṛtim || 15.62 || niṣkatrayātmakaṃ svarṇaṃ lekhāpadmaṃ tileṣu vā | nikṣipya navaratnāni dikṣu cāṣṭāsu nikṣipet || 15.63 || dhānyapūrṇānipātrāṇi dve dve pratidiśaṃ kramāt | prasthatailaṃ tathā sarpirdhadhi cāpi caturguṇam || 15.64 || pārśvayoḥpurataścāpi pātrasthaṃ nyasya bhūtale | tilājyāhāraḥpuratastrīṇyahāni jitendriyāḥ || 15.65 || upoṣya vā guruḥpūrvamekarātraṃ caturmukha | abhyarcya gandhapuṣnādyaistilānyastānyanantaram || 15.66 || adhīyāneṣu vistreṣu tūryavāditraghoṣaṇe | maṅgaleṣu tathānyeṣu pravṛtteṣu yathāyatham || 15.67 || tilaissahasrakṛtvognau juhuyānmūlavidyayā | acaryaṃ pañca kālajñaṃ bhagavacchāstrakovidam || 15.68 || kalyāṇācāranirataṃ sarvessamuditaṃ guṇaiḥ | tasme bhāgavatāyedamarcayitvā kṣatādibhiḥ || 15.69 || tilapadmaṃ pradātavyaṃ sannidau vāripūrvakam | priyatāṃ bhagavān viṣṇurityācāryeṇa mantravit || 15.70 || tadante devamabhyarcya bhojayitvā mahāsurān | dadyācca dakṣiṇāṃ tebyo gurave ca yathoditām || 15.71 || itthaṃ tilasarojaṃ yo dadyāddhānyādisaṃyutam | pūnāti sa pitṝn sarvānātmānaṃ ca parāvarān || 15.72 || māsarkṣe paurṇamāsyāṃ ca yajanaṃ snapanādibhiḥ | phālgune māsi phalgunyāṃ śrīkāmo harimarcayet || 15.73 || uṣoṣya pūrvaṃ niyato dhyāyannitthaṃ samāhitaḥ | vipule bilvavipine madhye puṣkaraśobhite || 15.74 || mahātaṭāke śijñānapakṣisaṅghasamākule | maṇḍape tatra māhendre ratna prākāraveṣṭite || 15.75 || caturdikṣu caturdvāre kalpakadrumamaṇḍite | sauvarṇe bahukalyāṇaratnastambhasamanvite || 15.76 || siṃhāsane vare ratna padme'ṣṭadalasaṃyute | karṇikākesaropete sukhāsīnaṃ śriyā saha || 15.77 || pūrvādidikṣu dhyātavyā vāsudevādayo dale | āgneyādiṣu koṇeṣu catvāro hastinaḥkramāt || 15.78 || gugguluśca kuraṇḍaścadamakaśśalala stathā | śaṅkhapadmanidhī cāpi saṃhaviṣṭarapārśvayoḥ || 15.79 || anyonyābhimukhau bhūri vamantau vasu sarvadā | bhūmyādayo'ṣṭau pūrvādidikṣu cāmarapāṇayaḥ || 15.80 || indrādayaśca pūrvādi dikṣvaṣṭāvaṣṭasu kramāt | sthitāścaturṣudvāreṣu vetrahastāssakaṅcu kāḥ || 15.81 || kubjaveṣāstriyo dvāri pālayantyomanuharāḥ | balākinī bhīṣi kā ca tathaiva vanamālinī || 15.82 || śāṅkarī ca kramādetāḥpūrvādiṣu caturmukha | dvārāṇi pālikābhiśca pūrṇakumbhairdhvajai stathā || 15.83 || toraṇairdāmabhirmauktairdīpairanyaiśca maṅgalaiḥ | pariṣkṛtāni dhyātvaivaṃ devīṃ devaṃ ca pūjayet || 15.84 || śriyaṃ vā kevalāṃ padme karṇikāyāmavasthitām | maṇḍape tatra pūrvekte parivārasamanvite || 15.85 || lakṣmīprasūnakaiḥpadmairhomo bilvādipallavaiḥ | samidājyaiśca mantreṇa śriyaścāṣṭākṣareṇa ca || 15.86 || śrīsūktāni caturdikṣu pāṭhyāni pṛthivīsuraiḥ | ārādhyābhiṣṭuyādantestotrairbahuvidhaiśśriyam || 15.87 || samāmi devi lokānāṃ janayi tryabdhisambhave | sarvalokeśvareśeśa vallabhe durlabhe'dhamaiḥ || 15.88 || vāsudevāṅgasaṃsparśa sukhaikarasabhājane | namaste sukhade devi devānāmadhidevate || 15.89 || yadṛcchayāpi te devi kaṭākṣāḥ patitāssakṛt | kṣudreṣvapi pragalbhanaite trilokeśvarāḥkramāt || 15.90 || na spṛśanti trilokeśānapi yānvīkṣaṇānite | saṃpādyante kṣaṇātkṣudrā nākapṛṣṭhādapicyutāḥ || 15.91 || lāvaṇyādiguṇā yatra kāṣṭhāmaśnu vate parām | tāni tvadīyānyaṅgāni devi kastotumarhati || 15.92 || tvaṃ māyā tvamavidyāsi tvaṃ śaktiḥ karmaṇāmapi | caitanyaśaktistvamasi prakṛtistriguṇātmikā || 15.93 || tvameva vidyātraiyyantā trayī ca tvaṃ parāvarā | yasyāstavāyutāṃśāṃśe devyo vāgādayasthsitāḥ || 15.94 || saccidānandarūpasya parasya paramātmanaḥ | ānandādimayī mūrti kavibhaktā bhavatyasi || 15.95 || prabhāsi tasya nityā tvaṃ bhāsvataḥ paramātmanaḥ | sandhyā tvamasi viprāṇāṃ vandanīyā dine dine || 15.96 || bhūrbhuvassvastvayī ca tvaṃ bhūrasi tvaṃ bhuvosi ca | svarasi vyāhṛtiścāpi ṛgyagussāmakāraṇam || 15.97 || tvamāhutistvamiṣṭaśca dakṣiṇāsi tvameva ca | siddhiśca karmaṇāṃ tvatto nānyāsti kamalālaye || 15.98 || nītirānvīkṣakī vārtā vidyā cādyāsi laukikī | dṛṣṭvā devi tvayā hīnaṃ mṛta prāyaṃ jagattrayam || 15.99 || yatnairambhodhimathanaprāyairāvirbhabhūvitha | anuṣaṅgikamutpannaṃ prāptamapsarasāmapi || 15.100 || tādṛgevāmṛtādanyadindire harimandire | hālāhalaṃ viṣaṃ cāpi janmanaśśreyase tava || 15.101 || pratyūharūpeṇotpannaṃ kṣīrapāridhisambhave | abhyarhitā tapotpatti revaṃ nāma madhudviṣaḥ || 15.102 || kurmāditiryagyonitvaṃ yatprāptaṃ paramātmanaḥ | tvaṃ sarvalokajananī janako jagatāṃ hariḥ || 15.103 || tvayā ca viṣṇunācaidvyāptaṃ sthāvarajaṅgumam | mānaḥkośaṃ tathā goṣṭhaṃ māgṛhaṃ mā paricchadam || 15.104 || mā śarīraṃ kalatraṃ ca tyajethā mā ca santatim | śrutavān śīlavān dakṣo buddhimān vittavānṛjuḥ || 15.105 || vṛttivān bandhumān śrīmān paśumān dhānyavānapi | guṇavān kīrtimān loke tathābhijanavān prabhuḥ || 15.106 || āyuṣmān vijayī bhūmāṃstathaipārogyavānapi | ślāghyavān deva puruṣaḥkaṭākṣaviṣayāttava || 15.107 || guṇairyathoktairahitastvaddarśanavivarjitaḥ | krīḍābhūmirhareryasya vakṣobhūmissanātanī || 15.108 || ānantyāttanakalyāṇi guṇānāṃ varṇane kṣamaḥ | na vācaspatirapyeṣa dūre syānmādṛśāṃ sthitiḥ || 15.109 || prasīda devi padme tvaṃ padmahaste śucistite | padmāsane padmayonerjanayitri haripriye || 15.110 || padmapriye namastubhyaṃ viṣṇorvakṣasthsalālaye | stutyantamitthamārādhyā devyassarvā śśriyādayaḥ || 15.111 || arhaṇaṃ copavītaṃ ca varṅayitvopacaryayā | dhyātvā yathoktamārgeṇa yadvā dhūmadhvajārcanam || 15.112 || utsavaṃ ca śriyā devyā sārdhaṃ tasminmadhudviṣaḥ | yāvajjīvaṃ śriyaṃ devīmarcayan saṃpadaṃ parām || 15.113 || ihānubhūya bhūyo'pi paratra śriyamaśnute | yadvā kāmayamānena puruṣeṇārcanaṃ śriyaḥ || 15.114 || labhate tattadeveha phalabhedaiḥ kimīritaiḥ | ārogya kāmassāvitre maṇḍale ratnapaṅkaje || 15.115 || asīnaṃ viṣṭare pītakauśeyavasanaṃ harim | niṣṭaptatapanīyābhaṃ caturbhujamadhokṣajam || 15.116 || prasādasumukhaṃ sarvadivyābharaṇabhūṣitam | devīsahāyaṃ kalyāṇaṃ kevalaṃ vā caturmukha || 15.117 || pūrvādyaṣṭadalāsīnaśaktyaṣṭasamupāsitam | evaṃ dhyātvārcayennityamārogyaṃ paramaśnute || 15.118 || ananyalabhyamārogyaṃ sarvaṃ labhyettataḥparam | dināni pañca śastāni vaiṣṇavāni caturmukha || 15.119 || teṣu vratanuṣṭheyaṃ sarvābhipretasādhanam | pakṣadvaye ca dvādaśyau sinīvālī kuhustathā || 15.120 || śravaṇarkṣaṃ dināni syurmāseṣu dvādaśasvapi | caitrādiṣu dvādaśasu māseṣu dvādaśādhipāḥ || 15.121 || arcanīyāḥkramādviṣṇustathaiva madhusūdanaḥ | trivikramo vāmanaśca śrīdhara stadanantaram || 15.122 || hṛṣīkeśaḥpadmanābho dāmodarasamāhvayaḥ | keśavo nāmadheyena tathā nārāyaṇaḥsmṛtaḥ || 15.123 || mādhavo'nyaśca govindo dvādaśaite prakīrtitāḥ | māsecaitre samārambhomārgaśīrṣethavā bhavet || 15.124 || aśnan haviṣyaṃ pūrvedyuranaśnannapare'hani | śravaṇe madhyame bhāge śucirdakṣassamāhitaḥ || 15.125 || cakrābjamaṇḍale yadvā bimbe kumbhe'tha vā harim | ārādhya mūrtiṃ māseśamupacārairyathoditaiḥ || 15.126 || ārādhanānte vittāni datvā śaktyanusārataḥ | brāhmaṇebhyastathā datvā gurave dakṣiṇādikam || 15.127 || aparedyustathā devamarcayitvā yathāvidhi | pāraṇaṃ brāhmaṇaissārdhaṃ kuryānni yatamānasaḥ || 15.128 || evaṃ caturṣu cānyeṣu dineṣvārādhanakramaḥ | māsi māsi ca yaṣṭavyā māseśā mūrtirabjaja || 15.129 || dineṣu pañcasūkteṣu sarvābhipretasiddhaye | triṣu saṃvatsareṣvevaṃ kṛtvā māseṣu ca triṣu || 15.130 || vrate samāpte snapanaṃ kuryātpūrvokta vartmanā | yācayeta vrataphalaṃ dhānyarāśau sthito dvijaḥ || 15.131 || bhojayitvā dvijavarān datvā tebhyaśca dakṣiṇām | dakṣiṇābhistathācāryaṃ toṣayetkāñcanādibhiḥ || 15.132 || paurṇamāsyāmapi hyeṣa kramo māsādhipārcane | viśeṣata striyāmāyāṃ candramasyu dite'rhaṇā || 15.133 || kuhvāmapi tithau prāgvadarcayedvratamāsthitaḥ | ārādhanaṃ dineṣveṣu caturvarga phalapradam || 15.134 || sarvasmin māsanakṣatre prādurbhāva dineṣu ca | arcayitvāṅkurān pūjā kāryāsnapanapūrvikā || 15.135 || homāvasānikānviprāṃstarpayecca yathāvasu | iti śrīpāñcarātre mahopaniṣadi pādmasaṃhitāyāṃ caryāpāde "vratānuṣṭhāna kramo" nāma pañcadaśo'dhyāyaḥ |
<4.16>
brahmā bhagavan bhāvināṃ karma phalānāmaśubhātmanām | sūcaneṣu nimitteṣu sañjāteṣvaśubhātmasu || 16.1 || gṛhadoṣādiṣu nṛṇāmadhipasya ca bhūpateḥ | teṣā makasmājjātānāṃ karma yacchamanaṃ param || 16.2 || tanmamākhyāyatāṃ kīdṛkkiṃ kathaṃ ceti cācyuta | rahasyamapi tadvācyaṃ dayāyā parayā mayi || 16.3 || śrībhagavān janmarkṣādyaśubhasthānaga teṣvaṅgārakādiṣu | krūreṣu durnimitteṣu dusvapneṣvāmayeṣu ca || 16.4 || gṛhakṣetrādikeṣvevaṃ valmīkajanane tathā | raktastrīṣu ca jātāsu agnidāhe ca veśmanām || 16.5 || vastrādimūṣikādaṃ śe dagdheṣu śayanādiṣu | saṅkaṭeṣvapi cānyeṣu putrādikalahātmasu || 16.6 || nṛpakope tathā cittaduḥkhe nigalabandhane | pīḍāyāmaripakṣeṇa piśācādyairbhayānakaiḥ || 16.7 || vratadhvaṃse prāgabhāve putrāṇāmarthahāniṣu | ariṣṭasūcane putrajanmanyutpātasambhave || 16.8 || evamādiṣu jānyeṣu doṣeṣvārādhanaṃ mama | śāntaye kalpate brahman prakārastasya kathyate || 16.9 || snānapūrvāṇi karmāṇi kṛtvā vidhivadādṛtaḥ | ācāryaṃ varayetpaścānmadāradhanatatparam || 16.10 || śamādiguṇasaṃyuktaṃ pañcakālaparāyaṇam | śucau bhūmitale kumbhaṃ sauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ tu vā || 16.11 || tāmraṃ vāpi yathāvittaṃ vāripūrṇaṃ sakūrcakam | tantubhirveṣṭitaṃ nyasta vāribhījaṃ sapallavam || 16.12 || dhānyarāśiṣu saṃsthāpya nyastaratna guvarṇakam | śāntidravyasanāthaṃ ca aśvatthadalamaṅgalam || 16.13 || veṣṭitaṃ navavastreṇa raktenākṣatasaṃyutam | prācyāṃ diśi ca deveśaṃ yāmye saṅkarṣaṇaṃ tathā || 16.14 || pradyumnaṃ paścime bhāge aniruddhaṃ tathottare | evaṃ krameṇa va...ttamāvāhyaghaṭikāsane || 16.15 || kuśakūrcaiḥ paścimāśāsammukhe'ṣṭākṣareṇa tu | yajetārghyādinā yadvā rukmaṃ nyasya tadarcanam || 16.16 || kumbhe cāvāhya yajanaṃ japesmantramanuttamam | mūlamantreṇa lakṣaṃ vā tadarddhaṃ vā tadarddhakam || 16.17 || tataḥ puṃsūktamanvākaṃ nārāyaṇānuvākakau | tataśśrīsūkta bhūsūkte japedācārya ṛtvijām || 16.18 || mūlenāgniṃ pratiṣṭhāpya juhuyādgavyasarpiṣā | agni pratiṣṭhāṃ kvatvā'tha vaiṣṇavīkaraṇaṃ tathā || 16.19 || mantreṇāṣṭākṣareṇaiva lakṣavārā nathāyutam | sahasramapi vā kuṇḍe śataṃ vāṣṭottaraṃ guruḥ || 16.20 || dhyātvā hariṃ sarvaśāntikaraṃ sarvasamṛddhidam | gauravaṃ lāghavaṃ cāpi samavekṣya yathocitam || 16.21 || doṣāṇāṃ yatnamātiṣṭhedarcanādiṣu sarvataḥ | antepraṇavamabliṅgairyajamānaṃ gurussvayam || 16.22 || mantraiḥ kumbhasthato yena prokṣayenmūlavidyayā | sahasrakṛtvaḥ kūrcena snāpayeccheṣavāribhiḥ || 16.23 || ācāryāya yathāvittaṃ dadyātsvārṇādi dakṣiṇām | brāhmaṇān bhejayettebhyo dakṣiṇāmalpikāmapi || 16.24 || prabhūṇāmapi sarveṣāṃ sarvopadravaśāntaye | sarvābhipretalābhāya viśeṣayajanaṃ hareḥ || 16.25 || kuryāt snapanapūrvaṃ tadahni nityārcane kṛte | tadanaiśāntikaṃ karma aparāhṇe tu pauṣṭikam || 16.26 || pūrvāhṇe nityakarmoktaṃ vastubhirdviguṇairiha | pūjādravyairekabhere mūlabhere samarcanam || 16.27 || bahuberetu bimbasyādautsave kamalāsana | ācārya eva pūjāyāṃ vaiśeṣikyāṃ samarcayet || 16.28 || homakuṇḍaṃ bhavetpadmatulyākāraṃ suśobhanam | pauṣṭike śāntike vṛttaṃ pratyahaṃ samidhādibhiḥ || 16.29 || pratyekaṃ tilahomassyādayutaṃ vā śatāvaram | pratyahaṃ bhojayedviprān yathāśakti ca dakṣiṇā || 16.30 || nṛttaṃ geyaṃ ca vādyaṃ ca tathādhyayanamanvaham | karmāvasānadivasaṃ yāvadagneśca dhāraṇam || 16.31 || saptāhaṃ dviguṇaṃ vā syāttriguṇaṃ vā caturguṇam | snapanaṃ pratyahaṃ kāryaṃ dānahomādaya stathā || 16.32 || śāntike karmaṇi dhyeyo harissphaṭika sannibhaḥ | pauṣṭike tu suvarṇābhaśśriyā'sīnassahāsane || 16.33 || cakrābjamaṇḍale kumbhe yatra yatra samarcanam | tatraivānyedyurārādhyo na tu nirmālyatā tayoḥ || 16.34 || ācāryadakṣiṇā vāpi yathāvibhavavistaram | karmaṇyadhikṛtānāṃ ca karmagauravalāghavam || 16.35 || avekṣya toṣaṇaṃ vittairṛtvijāṃ copakurvatām | dinādiṣvanukūleṣu prārabhyā pauṣṭikī kriyā || 16.36 || śāntikī pratikūleṣu yajamānasya padmaja | brahmā bhagavanmārjanādīni mandire kurvatāṃ nṛṇām || 16.37 || viṣṇoḥ kṣetrādidātṝṇāṃ pūjopakaraṇāni ca | bhūṣaṇāni ca vastrāṇi phalamabhyudayātmakam || 16.38 || kīdṛkkīdṛśca tānyeva dattānyāharatāmapi | anarthakarametanme saṃśayānasya kathyatām || 16.39 || śrībhagavān mārjanaṃ mandire viṣṇoḥ kurvan sammārṣṭi dehajam | malaṃ pāpātmakaṃ sarvaṃ paratreha ca sambhṛtam || 16.40 || pratyahaṃ mārjanaṃ kurvan pratyahaṃ hanti kilbiṣam | gocarmamātramālipya gomayena ca bhūtalam || 16.41 || ālaye labhate sadyogopradānaphalaṃ naraḥ | mārjanālepane kurvan viṣṇorāyatane naraḥ || 16.42 || uṣitvā suciraṃ svarge karmaśeṣeṇa bhūtale | bhūyopi jāyate bhūpaḥ kule mahati pūjite || 16.43 || srajaṃ badvā sumanasāṃ yaḥ prayacchati viṣṇave | sa bhuktvā vipulān bhogānnākapṛṣṭhe virājate || 16.44 || dīpānāropayedviṣṇormandire'bhyantare bahiḥ | divi devavadāsitvā jāyate paramārthavit || 16.45 || nityānnaimittikānvāpi dīpānāropayennaraḥ | bahuduḥkhasamākirṇaṃ narakaṃ naiva paśyati || 16.46 || ahorātramanirvāṇaṃ dīpamāropayennaraḥ | sarvapāpaviśuddhātmā viṣṇuloke mahīyate || 16.47 || udakābhyukṣaṇaṃ viṣṇorālaye vidadhāti yaḥ | lokaṃ sa vāruṇaṃ prāpya ramate vatsarān bahūn || 16.48 || sammāryālipya ca harerdhāma puṣpāṇi bhūtale | vikirenmanujassarvakāmānāpnoti puṣkalān || 16.49 || viṣṇusātkurute bhūmiṃ sarvasasya phalapradām | yassalokānavāpnoti sarvāneva na saṃśayaḥ || 16.50 || puṣpodyānapradānena tapoloke mahīyate | phalavṛkṣasamopetāṃ pūgabhūmiṃ jalānvitām || 16.51 || yo dadāti maharloke saciraṃ vasati dhruvam | utpādayati yaḥ kṣetre vaiṣṇave phalinastarūn || 16.52 || nālikerādikānyāti sa svargaṃ pretya durlabham | ārādhanāya tulasīmutpādayati yatnavān || 16.53 || surabhīṇi ca puṣpāṇi divi devaissapūjyate | vāpīkupataṭākāni viṣṇormandhirabhūmiṣu || 16.54 || utpādayati hastasthāstasya sarvasamṛddhayaḥ | na taṃ badhnanti pāpāni bahujanmārjitānyapi || 16.55 || yaḥ kuryādvaiṣṇavaṃ dhāma bhaktiśraddhobha yocitam | khaṇḍite sphuṭite dhāmni dūṣite ca sudhādibhiḥ || 16.56 || samādadhyātpunardhāma sa lokaṃ yāti vaiṣṇavam | snānapānāmbhasāṃ viṣṇoḥ pradānāttatsalokabhāk || 16.57 || snānīyadravyadānena nīrogaḥ pretya modate | kṣaumādidānādāpnoti paraloke mahatsukham || 16.58 || ālepanadravyadānatkāmānāpnoti śāśvatān | elākarpūratāmbālītailādisvarśanātsukhī || 16.59 || paratreha ca loke nyāddhīrghakālamasaṃśayaḥ | cāmaravyajanacchatradānāt svārājyamaśnute || 16.60 || ādarśanapradānena dṛśyassarvairbhaviṣyati | dhūpadravyapradānena svasthānaṃ svargiṇāṃ bhavet || 16.61 || upānahau pāduke ca vāhanaṃ yānameva ca | dadāti yo maṇḍayitvā maṇikāñcana citrim || 16.62 || sa vimānaṃ suduṣprāvaṃ prāpnotyeva na saṃśayaḥ | alaṅkṛtaṃ bhadrapīṭhaṃ prayacchan sarvakāmabhāk || 16.63 || vinatānandanasthānaṃ dhvajamutpādya darśayan | sāmīpyaṃ sahasā viṣṇoryāti sadyaścaturmukha || 16.64 || dhvajaṃ ca vādyamutpādya viṣṇusātkurute tu yaḥ | sa divyadundubhiprāyaṃ sthānaṃ prāpya virājate || 16.65 || dāsīdānaṃ tathātmīyamātmānaṃ ca prayaccati | vāsudevāya dāsyena muktiḥkaratale sthitā || 16.66 || nṛttabhedairgītabhedai stathā vādyairanekadhā | śrotavyairapi dṛśyaiśca evaṃ deveśasannidhau || 16.67 || āsīna mupacāraustairye samārādhayantite | pretya divyeṣu lokeṣu pūjyaṃte tairna saṃśayaḥ || 16.68 || pradakṣiṇanamaskārastutiprāyopacaryayā | ārādhayantiye devaṃ devānāmadhidaivatam || 16.69 || te devairupacaryante paratra bhagavān yathā | sthitaṃ śayānamāsīnaṃ devaṃ sarveśvareśvaram || 16.70 || yadṛcchayāpi paśyastaḥ prāpnuvanti paraṃ padam | kiṃ punarbhaktipūrvaṃ ye paśyanti kṣaṇama cyutam || 16.71 || nirdhūya duṣkṛtaṃ sarvaṃ yānti lokānyathepsitān | aṣṭāṅgapraṇipātena ye namasyanti mānavāḥ || 16.72 || tapassvādhyāyaśīlānāṃ phalamaśnuvate'cirāt | iyadetaditi smartuṃ phalaṃ vaktuṃ ca kaḥ kṣamaḥ || 16.73 || sakṛtpraṇamatāṃ devaṃ phalaṃ yanmadhuvidviṣam | śirasā śravaṇābhyāṃ vā manasā vā kareṇa vā || 16.74 || bahubhyāṃ vātha padbhyāṃ vā dṛgbhyāṃ vā pakṣasāpi vā | ekaikenāṅgajātena praṇamanmadhuvidviṣam || 16.75 || kāmānāpnoti vipulānanantānanyadurlabhān | kiṃ punarye'ṣṭabhissarvairaṅgaiḥ praṇipatanti ca || 16.76 || vāsudevā śrayakathā vyācakṣāṇā dine dine | pāsudevālaye yānti vācaspatyamasaṃśayam || 16.77 || gavāṃ ca kapilādīnāṃ pradānādaśnu te janaḥ | brahmalokādilokeṣu vāsaṃ vindanti śāśvatam || 16.78 || haviṣāṃ pāyasādīnāṃ haraye ca nivedanāt | sukhaikarasapūrṇātmā rājate viṣṇusannidau || 16.79 || bhakṣyapānīyabhojyānāmanyeṣāmapi dānataḥ | śvetadvīpe tatsamīpe vasanti sukhanassadā || 16.80 || bahunātra kimuktena vāsudevārthamādarāt | dadāti vastujātaṃ yaḥ sthānaṃ prāpnoti cepsitam || 16.81 || karmaṇāṃ mārjanādīnāṃ phalabhogādanantaram | karmaśeṣaiḥ punarjanma karmānuguṇayoniṣu || 16.82 || utkṛṣṭāsveva bhoktāro labhante sukhinassadā | prāsādamaṇḍapādīnāṃ bhoktāraḥkaiṭabhadviṣaḥ || 16.83 || ye mūḍhamatayaḥ pretya nirayeṣu niratyayāḥ | vasanti bhūyo nīcāsu jāyante yoniṣu druvam || 16.84 || bhūṣaṇacchatravastrādi yo partā durmati rnaraḥ | gale nigalitaḥ pāśaiḥ kṛṣyate nirayeṣu saḥ || 16.85 || vāhanāni ca yānāni vaiṣṇavāni harantiye | mohadvāsanti te dīrghamaṅgāra narakodare || 16.86 || pretya bhūyo'pi jāyante gardabhoṣṭrādiyoniṣu | candanādīni vastūni puṣpāṇi surabhīṇyapi || 16.87 || harantisvāni viṣṇoste vrajante yāmyayātanām | anubhūya punarbrahman jāyante gandhamūṣikāḥ || 16.88 || upānatpādukāpīṭhavyajanāni harantiye | uṣitvā nirayeṣvete jāyante phaṇināṃ kule || 17.89 || gobhūhiraṇyapastrādidhanaṃ viṣṇoḥ parigraham | āhṛtya ye tu bhuñjante narakeṣu niratyayāḥ || 17.90 || uṣitvā pretya bhūyopi jāyante śvādiyoniṣu | sarveṣu narakeṣvevaṃ devabrahmasvahāriṇaḥ || 17.91 || vasanti mūḍhamatayo yāmyaduḥkhāni bhūyasā | vyāyāmodvartanābhyaṅgasnānapānāśanādikam || 17.92 || kurvanti mantire viṣṇorye te nirayagāmisaḥ | pacyante tatra bhūyopi jāyante nīcayoniṣu || 17.93 || vāsudevapratikṛterbhedanacchedanādiṣu | vikrītādīni cānyeṣu yatante pāpacetasaḥ || 17.94 || ye te yānti kramātsarvānnarakān bhṛśadāruṇān | anyeṣvapyapacāreṣu sthūlasūkṣmeṣu mānavāḥ || 17.95 || kṛtinaḥ pretya narake pacyavte duḥkhabāginaḥ | itiśrīpāñcarātre mahopaniṣadi pādmasaṃhitāyāṃ caryāpāde saṃmārjanādiphaladevasvāpaharadoṣakīrtanaṃ nāma ṣoḍaśo'dhyāyaḥ |
<4.17>
brahmā pratimānāṃ tathā dhāmnāṃ jīrṇānāṃ bhagavannaham | uddhāraṃ śrotuvicchāmi tanme brūhi yathātatham || 17.1 || śrībhagavān svāyambhavārṣadivyeṣu mānuṣeṣu caturṣvapi | aṅgahānau ratnajeṣu tattajjāmbānadaiḥ punaḥ || 17.2 || samādhātavyamevāṅgaṃ na tyājyaṃ śailajeṣvapi | tadvadeva samādhānaṃ dārujādiṣu pañcasu || 17.3 || hīnāṅgeṣu tu bimbāni hitvā tāni punassṛjet | aṅgamātrasamādhāne sṛṣṭau sarvātmanāpi ca || 17.4 || kumbhe śaktiṃ samudvāsya nirmāya ca yathāpuram | adhivāsādikaṃ sarvaṃ pratiṣṭhāyāmivācaret || 17.5 || sthitavatsveṣu bimbeṣu samādhiryadi śakyate | na tyāgo yujyate teṣāṃ sarveṣāmeva padmaja || 17.6 || tyaktaṃ ca lohajaṃ bimbaṃ drāvayitvā punassṛjet | deve jīrṇe punassṛṣṭau devyaḥpracyo yathāsthitāḥ || 17.7 || tābhireva punardevo yojyo nānyāssṛjetpunaḥ | nodvāhaśca punaḥ kāryassantate tānu pūjane || 17.8 || prabhāpadmāsanādīnāṃ vaikalye calane'pi vā | āyudhe'pi ca cakrādau yaṣṭavyo nāsamāhite || 17.9 || udvāsya pratimāśaktiṃ mūlabhere ghaṭe'pi vā | cakrādeśca samādhānaṃ kāryaṃ tasmin samāhite || 17.10 || saṃprokṣya pūjayeccaktimāvāhya pratimāsu tām | bālālayaṃ kalpayitvātatra śailādivastuṣu || 17.11 || bimbe tu śaktimāvāhya jīrṇebhyaḥ pūjanaṃ hareḥ | tyaktaṃ ca bimbaṃ nikhanet kṣitau vāmbhasi nikṣipet || 17.12 || prāsāde cāpi śithile pūjayedbālaveśmani | upetaṃ parivāraissvairdevaṃ mūle yathā tathā || 17.13 || ajīrṇe dhruvabimbe tu jīrṇṭe dhāmani tat sthitān | devāndevaparīvārānmūlabere niveśayet || 17.14 || ajīrṇadhāmaniṣṭhānāṃ jīrṇetu dhruvakautuke | nodvāso nyatra kartavyo devādīnāṃ caturmukha || 17.15 || ajīrṇenāṅga hānau ca dhāmādau naiva kalpayet | bhūyastaro pi martyena vyāmohādyadi kalpayet || 17.16 || ātmahānirddhravā tasya yajamānasya sānvayā | yadi pramāṇarahitaṃ pramādātkalpitaṃ pūrā || 17.17 || prāsādādi punassṛṣṭau kalpaye llakṣaṇānvitam | bahuberairabereṣu kalpanaṃ syādyathāpuram || 17.18 || bahuberenaikaberaṃ naikabere tathā param | devīvirahitaṃ pūrvaṃ bahuberaṃ kṛtaṃ yadi || 17.19 || bhūyaḥ prakalpane tasya devībhyāṃ saha vā vinā | amānuṣaṃ ca bimbādi pūrvaṃ lakṣaṇavarjitam || 17.20 || jīrṇoddhāre'pi kartavyaṃ tathaiva na tadanyathā | śayanaṃ vā''sanaṃ sthānaṃ yānaṃ vā tadyathāpuram || 17.21 || bimbasya punaruddhārastathaiva syādamānuṣe | mānuṣe tu sthitādīnāṃ bimbānāmicchayā bhavet || 17.22 || punassṛṣṭirna doṣāya tathā sati caturmukha | divyaṃ vimānaṃ yadvastu yanmānaṃ yādṛśaṃ purā || 17.23 || tādṛgeva punassṛṣṭau nānyathā tatprakalpayet | anyathā kalpane doṣo kājño rāṣṭrasya ca dhruvam || 17.24 || mānuṣaṃ sadanaṃ cārṣaṃ caiṣṭakaṃ vātha mṛṇmayam | jīrṇaṃ punassamuddhāre śaileneṣṭakayāpi vā || 17.25 || upapīṭhādikaṃ klṛptaṃ rakṣārthaṃ vardhayedbahiḥ | parivārāṃśca tatrasthānupapīṭhe ca vardhite || 17.26 || sthāpayenmūlaberasya rakṣārthatvānna dūṣaṇam | sālagopurapīṭhādau calite jīrṇa eva vā || 17.27 || dṛḍhaṃ śilādibhiḥkuryā dvistīrṇa matha vā'nyathā | nadyādijalavegena calite naṣṭa eva vā || 17.28 || prāsādādau punasthsāne nirbādhe'nyatra kalpayet | yā mūrtiryena mantreṇa yādṛśenādhikāriṇā || 17.29 || prathame kalpane saiva dvitīye kalpane bhavet | mūrtissaiva ca mantraṃ ca sa eva sthāpakaḥ punaḥ || 17.30 || apūrvakalpane jīrṇasamuddhāre dvayorapi | tulyaṃ phalaṃ kalpanāyāṃ dhāmādernāstisaṃśayaḥ || 17.31 || tantrādhikārimūrtīnāṃ vyatyaye kalpane punaḥ | nṛṇāṃ narapateścāpi rāṣṭrasya ca bhavet kṣayaḥ || 17.32 || bahubere pratiṣṭhāyāṃ jīrṇoddhāre'yathāpuram | karmārcāṃ sthāpayedvedyāṃ śāyayeccāpi maṇṭape || 17.33 || nādhivāsaṃ jalekuryānnayanonmīlanaṃ tathā | na tatvasaṃhārotpādau sarvaṃ pūrvavadācaret || 17.34 || mūlabimbaṃ samāsādya prāgvatsarvaṃ samācaret | bālakautukamabhyarcya yātrā manyatra tadgatām || 17.35 || śaktiṃ kumbhe samāvāhya kumbhaṃ dhānyasthitaṃ punaḥ | abhyarcya samaye prāpte mūlabere gurussvayam || 17.36 || śaktiṃ niveśayecchāstradṛṣṭena vidhinā harau | kumbhatoyāvaśeṣeṇa parivāraprakalpanam || 17.37 || utsavaṃ kārayedante sarvaśāntikaro hisaḥ | brahmā saṃprokṣaṇanimittaṃ kiṃ prakāro vāsya kīdṛśaḥ || 17.38 || kathyatāṃ bhagavanmahyaṃ jijñāsā ye'nuvartate | śrībhagavān prāsāde cāṅgabhaṅgādisasthāne nūtane kṛte || 17.39 || pratimāyāṃ ca pīṭhe ca prabhāyāṃ cāyudhepi ca | ārādhane ca vicchinne māsādau kamalāsana || 17.40 || sparśane pratilomādyairnityāśaucavigarhitaiḥ | pratilāmānulomaiśca sūtaiśca rathakārakaiḥ || 17.41 || vaikhānasaiśca saṃspṛṣṭe bhārgavāgamapūjakaiḥ | śaivādibhiśca pāṣaṃḍairbrahmahatyādidūṣitaiḥ || 17.42 || kṣayyapasmārikuṣṭhyādyaiḥ kṛcchribhirmūlarogibhiḥ | udakyādibhiranyaiśca śilpibhissparśadūṣite || 17.43 || viṇmutrarudhirāpeyasparśadoṣe ca mandire | janane maraṇe caiva śvasṛgāla kharādhibhiḥ || 17.44 || spṛṣṭe ca bimbe tantrāṇāṃ saṅkare samupasthite | evamādiṣu cānyeṣu saṃprokṣaṇavidhirbhavet || 17.45 || dhāmādikamasaṃprokṣya pratimādikamapyatha | arcane rāṣṭramadhipaḥ prajāśca sadanaṃ hareḥ || 17.46 || śūnyaṃ syādiriṇa prāyamupadravasamākulam | durbhikṣavyādhikalahamṛti prāyāssyurītayaḥ || 17.47 || tasmātsaṃprokṣaṇaṃ kāryaṃ dhāmādīnāṃ yathāvidhi | viṣṇornukamiti svacchairjalaiḥ prokṣaṇa miṣyate || 17.48 || abliṅgairitarairmantrairācāryo brāhmaṇaissaha | dhruvaberādibimbānāṃ śodhane kṣālane kṛte || 17.49 || idaṃ viṣṇuritiprāyairmantraiḥ paramapāvanaiḥ | snapanaṃ ca yathāśakti kuryāt snapanapūrvakam || 17.50 || dvāratoraṇakumbhādiyajanaṃ tadanantaram | dhānyapīṭhe maṇḍapasya madhyabhāge suśobhite || 17.51 || sthāpayitvā mahākumbaṃ sūtrāvastrādiveṣṭitam | pūrvoktavartmanā tasmin paramātmānamarcayet || 17.52 || kuṇḍe vā sthaṇḍile vāpi juhuyītsamidādibhiḥ | pratyekamaṣṭottaraśataṃ śāntihomo yathāpuram || 17.53 || badhnī yātkautukaṃ bimbe prokṣayedapare'hani | prabhātasamaye prāpte śobhane deśikottamaḥ || 17.54 || sthāpitaṃ kumbhamāsthāya prādakṣīṇyena mandiram | nītvā devasya purato dhānyapīṭhe niveśya ca || 17.55 || kūrcena toyamādāya kumbhasthaṃ mūlavidyayā | pañcopaniṣadairmantrairabliṅgairitiraistathā || 16.56 || śāntimantrāṇi samaye paṭheyurvi prasattamāḥ | brāhmaṇān bhojayeccāpi yathāśakti ca dakṣiṇā || 16.57 || ācāryadakṣiṇā cāpi daśaniṣkāvarā tadā | sadyo vā sakalaṃ kuryānniśi vā divase'pi vā || 16.58 || na tithi rna ca nakṣatraṃ kālavelā na vidyate | sadya eva tu kartavya miti śāstrasya niścayaḥ || 16.59 || iti śrīpāñcarātre mahopaniṣadi pādmasaṃhitāyāṃ caryāpāde jīrṇoddhāra saṃprokṣaṇa vidhirnāma saptadaśo'dhyāyaḥ |
<4.18>
brahmā naimittikānāṃ nityānāṃ karmaṇāṃ bhagavan hare | ārādhanānāṃ vaikalyaṃ lopo vā prāyasaṃjñitam || 18.1 || tasya cittaṃ samādhānamiti nirvacanakriyā | kasya kiṃ vā samādhānaṃ kaḥ prakāro'sya kathyatām || 18.2 || śrībhagavān asnātonu pavīto vā adhṛtvātilakaṃ tathā | arcayeddevadeveśaṃ prayaścittīyate naraḥ || 18.3 || samādhānaṃ mūlamantraśataṃ japtvā tadarcanam | akṛtvā pādayośśaucamanācamyāpi vārcane || 18.4 || pañcopaniṣadāṃ jāpaḥ prayaścittaṃ tadarcanam | nagno vā muktakeśo vāsvinnāṅgo vā hasan śvasan || 18.5 || kupyanvā pralapanvāpi pūjāyāṃ tu śataṃ japet | śatakṛto'stramantasya samārādhanamanvataḥ || 18.6 || keśāsthilomaloṣṭādisparśane naiva niṣkriyā | vasāno nīlamalinakliṣṭavāso'pavitrakaḥ || 18.7 || arcayenmūlamantrasya japastasya pratikriyā | gatvāstriyamānāplutya pūjane snāpayeddharim || 18.8 || pañcagavyaistataḥpañcamahopaniṣadāṃ japaḥ | viṇmūtraretorudhirabālādisparśane sati || 18.9 || asnānapūjane devaṃ snāpayetkuśavāribhiḥ | mūlamantrajapaścoktoniṣkriyā tasya karmaṇaḥ || 18.10 || vastraṃ rajasvalāyāśca spṛṣṭvā devārcane kṛte | pañcagarvaissnāpayitvā pañcopaniṣadāṃ japaḥ || 18.11 || śvānaṃ rajasvalāṃ yūpaṃ caṇḍālaṃ vedavikrayam | citiṃ ca caityabhūmiṣṭhaṃ vṛkṣaṃ spṛṣṭvā tadarcane || 18.12 || pañcavāruṇamantraiśca snāpayetkuśavāriṇā | kākapāṣaṇḍapatitapratilomakharādikān || 18.13 || aspṛśyamanyadapyevaṃ spṛṣṭvā prāgvatpratikriyā | keśādidoṣaduṣṭena puṣpeṇārādhane kṛte || 18.14 || kṣīreṇa snapanaṃ kṛtvā śāntihomaḥ pratikriyā | purīṣādikamākramya yadyanāplotya pūjayet || 18.15 || snapanaṃ kuśapāthobhirjavaḥ prāgvatpratikriyā | striyo vā nupanīto vā spṛśedbimbaṃ pratikriyā || 18.16 || ukṣaṇaṃ kuśatoyena mantreṇa parimeṣṭhinā | ārādhane saṃpravṛtte niṣṭhīvādikamantarā || 18.17 || yadyāpatedācamanaṃ spṛśedvā dakṣiṇaṃ śravaḥ | pralayādikramāddehamasaṃśodhya samādhinā || 18.18 || mantranyāsamakṛtvā ca pūjane pūrvavajjapaḥ | arcanaṃ ca punassarvaṃ kṛtvādevasya niṣkṛtiḥ || 18.19 || caṇḍālādyairasaṃspṛśyairhavisspṛṣṭaṃ nivedayet | yadi pramādātsnapanaṃ koghṛtena pratikriyā || 18.20 || śānti homaśca kartavya stadante kamalāsana | dṛṣṭaṃ ca spṛṣṭavattadvatsṛgālādyaiśca dūṣitam || 18.21 || ācārarahitairanyaistathai vāśucivastubhiḥ | ayājñiyaiḥkodravādyairhavirbhiśca nivedane || 18.22 || pūrvavacca samādhānaṃ mūlamantrāyutaṃ japet | śākamūlaphalairlehyapeyādyaiśca vivarjitaiḥ || 18.23 || snapanaṃ śāntihomaśca mūlavidyajapa stathā | atyuṣṇasyātiśītasya haviṣaśca nivedane || 18.24 || nivṛttimantrajāpaśca viśvamantrajapaḥ kramāt | śavādidūṣite gehe pakvasya haviṣastathā || 18.25 || nivedanaṃ cetsnapanaṃ śānti homastathaiva ca | krimikeśādiduṣṭasya haviṣaśca nivedane || 18.26 || pauruṣeṇaiva sūktena kuryācchuddhābhiṣecanam | mukhavāyuhatāghrātaṃ rajastuṣakaṇānvitam || 18.27 || mṛtpāṣāṇaśakṛtprāya dūṣitasya nidedane | mūlamantrāyutajapastadvatparyuṣitaṃ yadi || 18.28 || niveditasya haviṣo bhūyo yadi nivedanam | snānapūrvarcasaṃ mūlamantrasya japa iṣyate || 18.29 || nivedayecca nirmālyamucchiṣṭaṃ vā pratikriyā | kumbhairdvādaśabhissnānaṃ śāntihoyojana stathā || 18.30 || gurvādīnmanasā vācā karmaṇā samataḥkare | sthitāni havirādīni puṣpādīni caturmukha || 18.31 || pūjāvastūnyayogyāni samārādhanakarmaṇi | tairarcane pañcakumbhaissnapanaṃ pūrvavajjapaḥ || 18.32 || vāsudevaṃ praṇamataḥ pūjāvastūni hastayoḥ | sthitāni nārcanārhaṇi senānye tāni nikṣipet || 18.33 || tairarcanaṃ cetsnapanaṃ kalaśaissaptabhirbhavet | śāntihomaśca kartavyo mūlamantrajapastathā || 18.34 || maṇḍūkamūṣikāsarpabiḍālādyaiśca jantubhiḥ | krimikīṭapataṃgādyaiḥpakṣibhirvāyasādibhiḥ || 18.35 || spṛṣṭaṃ daṣṭaṃ havirnaipa devārhaṃ tanni vedane | snapanaṃ kalaśaireva tribhirhomāntamarcayet || 18.36 || makṣikādyaiśca saṃspṛṣṭaṃ prokṣya devāya kalpayet | bhuktaśeṣaiḥpramādādvālobhādvā devamarcayet || 18.37 || mūlamantrāyutajapaśśāntaye tasya kalpate | dattaśeṣapradānena tadvadeva ca niṣkṛtiḥ || 18.38 || snāne paryuṣitāmbobhiḥ punarepamathāmbubhiḥ | abliṅgaiḥ pāvanai rmantraiḥ prāyaścittaṃ taducyate || 18.39 || puṇyatīrthasarittoye na paryuṣitadūṣaṇam | samudratoyaṃ daśamātparaṃ paryuṣitaṃ dināt || 18.40 || tiryagyonibhiraspṛśyairmanuṣyairapi laṅghitam | spṛṣṭaṃ ca vāri na snānayogyaṃ snāne ca vāruṇaiḥ || 18.41 || snānaṃ punarvidhātavyaṃ śāntyarthaṃ tasya karmaṇaḥ | ajāśva mukhasaṃscarśona doṣāya kadācana || 18.42 || gomukhenaiva saṃspṛṣṭaṃ varjanīyaṃ samarcane | prāyaścittaṃ punassnānaṃ mūlamantrajapastathā || 18.43 || viṇmūtrarudhirāpeyayuktaistoyādivastubhiḥ | nārcayedarcane snānaṃ kalaśai radhamādhamauḥ || 18.44 || śivanirmālyaduṣṭena toyaprabhṛtivastunā | pūjane kalaśaissnānamadhamairmadhyamairbhavet || 18.45 || śivādidūṣite kūpe jalamuddhṛtya pūrvakam | sarvaṃ tadante puṇyāhaṃ vācayejjñalaśuddhaye || 18.46 || paśvādimaraṇe kūpe caṇḍālasnānapānayoḥ | tathā rajasvalādyaiśca pratilomairvigarhite || 18.47 || kūpasthaṃ tajjalaṃ sarvamuddharetkamalāsana | cucundaryādimaraṇe jalasyārdhaṃ samuddharet || 18.48 || divā samuddharettoyaṃ rātrau cedagni sannidau | uddharedanyathā toyairupayoge'tha vāruṇaiḥ || 18.49 || pañcabhirjuhuyādagnau brāhmaṇānapi bhojayet | pūjākāle tu dīpasya nirvāṇedviguṇārcanam || 18.50 || dīpamuddīpya japtapyo viśvamantraśśatāvaraḥ | akasmādeva nirvāṇe śāntirnaiva tvahetuke || 18.51 || anirvāṇasya nirvāṇe dīpasya snapanaṃ hareḥ | kṣīreṇa mūlamantrasya japaścāṣṭottaraṃ śatam || 18.52 || sarpiṣā tilatailena dīpāropaṇamācaret | nānyaireraṇḍatailādyairnājāvimahiṣādijaiḥ || 18.53 || snehairāropaṇaṃ kāryaṃ na ca prāṇyaṅgamambhavaiḥ | pramādātphalajaistailaissna pane dīpane haviḥ || 18.54 || nivedane ca home ca snehauranyaiśca ninditaiḥ | anuṣṭhāne kṛte kumbhai ssnāpayenmadhyamottamaiḥ || 18.55 || śāntihomastathā dānaṃ dvijebhyo bhojanaṃ tathā | ajaprabhṛtidadhyādyaissnānādau vihite sati || 18.56 || prāyaścittaṃ yathāpūrvamācaretkasulāsana | pūrvopacāraklṛptau tu nyūnāyāṃ klṛptavastubhiḥ || 18.57 || vastubhirdviguṇairbhūyaspamārādhya madhudviṣam | sarpiṣāṣṭottaraśataṃ juhuyānmūlavidyayā || 18.58 || mantrahānau kriyāhānau mudrāhānau tathaiva ca | japahānau dhyānahānau hīneṣvanyeṣu keṣu cit || 18.59 || mūlamastrajapastasya yathāśakti pratikriyā | geyavāditranṛtteṣu pūrvaklṛpteṣu pūjane || 18.60 || hīnekasmiṃścidārādhyo harissnapanavartmanā | vādyahānau tu payasā nṛttahānau ghṛtena tu || 18.61 || geyahānau tu madhunā juhuyātpūrvasaṅkhyayā | pūrvaklṛptopadaṃ śādihānau dviguṇavastubhiḥ || 18.62 || nivedayetsnānapūrvaṃ kālāti kramaṇepi ca | bhogadravyairdviguṇitai rārādhya kṣamyatāmiti || 18.63 || uccārayettathā santhyātikrāntau dvāda śeṣvapi | kāleṣu klṛptaṅkhyeṣu hānau kālasya kasya cit || 18.64 || dviguṇairvastubhiḥ pūjyaḥ kāleṣu ca yathottaram | kālaṃ prathamamārabhya dviguṇaistriguṇai stathā || 18.65 || caturguṇaiḥ pañcaguṇairevamādyaistu vastubhiḥ | pūjayejjapa homādyaistadvadeva yathāyatham || 18.66 || atikrānte dinavidau vidhireṣaprakīrtitaḥ | dvidinādau tu pakṣānte pūjāhine ghaṭaistathā || 18.67 || adhamottamamārgeṇa snāpayettasya śāntaye | māse ca pūjāvikale madhyamottamavartmanā || 18.68 || tilājyacarubhiścaiva juhuyānmūlavidyayā | saṃvatsaratrayādarvāṅmāsādūrdhvamanarcite || 18.69 || saṃprokṣaṇaṃ bhavedūrdhvaṃ pratiṣṭhāvidhirucyate | bhūguptāmapi caikāhamuddhṛtya pratimāṃ punaḥ || 18.70 || saṃprokṣayedgṛhārcāyāmārādhanaviropane | snapanaṃ paṃcagavyena sūktena puruṣātmanā || 18.71 || śāntaye juhuyādagnau brāhmaṇānapi tarpayet | māsādūrdhvaṃ tu ṣaṇmāsaṃ pūjāhīne caturmukha || 18.72 || kumbhaiṣṣoḍaśabhissnānaṃ sūktena puruṣātmanā | bhojayedbrāhmaṇānagnau juhuyācchāntaye punaḥ || 18.73 || ūrdhvaṃ saṃprakṣaṇaṃ kāryaṃ yāvatsaṃvatsarāvadhi | pratiṣṭhāvidhirūrdhvaṃ tu vatsarāduktavartmanā || 18.74 || tridaśādipratiṣṭhāyāṃ pūjālope na dūṣaṇam | prayaścittaṃ tu martyānāṃ pratiṣṭhāyāmudīritam || 18.75 || sāligrāvaśilādīnāṃ pūjālopo na dūṣaṇam | tathaipāśuchisaṃsparśe kṣālayitvārcayetpunaḥ || 18.76 || sarvadhā lopane śāntirnoktakālāśrayo bhavet | ajñānādadhavā jñānādvahnitarpaṇa varjite || 18.77 || paṃcopaniṣadairmantressarpiṣā juhuyācchatam | ekādikālātikrāntau dviguṇādi yathāpuram || 18.78 || bahubhiḥkalaśairdevaṃ snāpayeddivasātparam | māsāvadhi tadūrdhvaṃ tu kalaśairvatsarāvadhi || 18.79 || aṣṭottaraśataiḥkuryātsnapanaṃ juhuyātpunaḥ | aṣṭottarasahasreṇa tilājyacarubhiḥ kramāt || 18.80 || dvādaśākṣaramantreṇa śāntihomastadā bhavet | vatsarādupariṣṭāttu snapanaṃ madhyamottamam || 18.81 || kuṇḍe cāgniṃ sthāpayitvātilavrīhiyavairapi | lājaiśca kālapuṣpaiśca samiccarughṛtairapi || 18.82 || aṣṭottarasahasreṇa juhuyānmūlavidyayā | śāntihomastathā dānaṃ viprāṇāṃ cāpi bhojanam || 18.83 || satyagnāvapyahome tu prāyaścittamitīritam | agnauśāntemathitvāgniṃ śāntihomaṃ samācaret || 18.84 || paṃcopaniṣadairmantrervyāhṛtipramukhai rapi | guparistīrya ca kuśairhomaḥpraṇavavidyayā || 18.85 || aṣṭottaraśatenājyairmūlamantrajapastathā | ayathoktakrame tadvatprāyaścittaṃ vidhīyate || 18.86 || kāmye paridhamo neṣā nitye karmaṇi vāna vā | alābhe samidhāmajyaiścarubhirvāhutirbhavet || 18.87 || tayoralābhe bījairvā samidbhirvā yathoditaiḥ | agnau keśādibhi sspṛṣṭe aspṛśyasparśane tathā || 18.88 || homo vyāhṛtibhiḥ kāryo vārānaṣṭottaraṃ śatam | āyutaṃ puṣpavatyādisparśe mathanaje'nale || 18.89 || pākasthāne cullisparśe naraiḥ purvoditaistathā | śvādibhissthānamālipya gomayena mahānasam || 18.90 || ānīyāgnyantaraṃ culyāṃ puṇyāhaṃ vācayeddhvijaiḥ | viṇmūtrādyaistathāsparśe pūrvavacchuddhiriṣyate || 18.91 || pakvena culyāṃ duṣṭāyāṃ haviṣāṃ ca nivedane | snāpayennavabhiḥkumbhairdevaṃ vātha ghaṭaistribhiḥ || 18.92 || parivārārcane cchinne tattannāmānyudīrayan | sarpiṣā juhuyādagnau pratyekaṃ tvaṣṭasaṅkhyayā || 18.93 || dviguṇādyairdvikālādau balyarthaṃ ca haviryadi | dūṣitaṃ keśakīṭādyairaspṛśyairmanujaistathā || 18.94 || kākādibhiśca tattyaktvāhaviṣānyena karmatat | yadi duṣṭena haviṣā baliṃ dadyātpramādataḥ || 18.95 || śāntihomastadā kāryaśśāstradṛṣṭena vartanā | taṇḍule codane puṣpe balyarthe pātrasaṃbhṛte || 18.96 || deve cāvāhite tasmin pūrvavaddūṣaṇaṃ yadi | patite vā balidravye mūlabhere'thavātmani || 18.97 || udvāsya devamānīya dravyāntaramadūṣitam | tasminnāvāhya deveśaṃ yathāpūrvaṃ punarnayet || 18.98 || taddoṣaśāntaye paścāddadhnā kṣīreṇa vā harim | snāpayejjuhuyācchāntiṃ mūlamantrajapastathā || 18.99 || bali bere nipatite yanādāvutsave bahiḥ | sthāpayitvā yathāpūrvaṃ baliśeṣaṃ nayetpunaḥ || 18.100 || śāstaye navabhiḥ kumbhaissnāpayetpatite bhuvi | adhamādhamamārgeṇa śāntihomo japastathā || 18.101 || nṛttageyaratā nāryo gaṇikāścāthavetarāḥ | devadāsyo dūṣayeyū rajobhiḥ pṛthivītalam || 18.102 || rajasvalārajoduṣṭaṃ bhūtalaṃ jānumātrakam | khātvā ca mṛdbhiranyābhiḥ pūrayitvā mahītalam || 18.103 || ālipya gomayāṃbobhiḥ puṇyāhaṃ vācayettataḥ | prokṣaṇaṃ paṃcabhirgavyaissannikṛṣṭaṃ ca kautukam || 18.104 || adhamottamamārgeṇa kalaśaissnāpayedguruḥ | tilājyacarubhirhomaḥ pratyekaṃ mūlavidyayā || 18.105 || sahanrakṛtvastadanu śāntihomo japastathā | kavāṭādikamapyanyatspṛṣṭaṃ prakṣālyamambhasā || 18.106 || tāsāṃ ca mārgāssaṃśodhyā gomayāmbhobirukṣaṇaiḥ | corabhūtairbrāhmaṇādyaiḥ spaṣṭe bere'pyacoditaiḥ || 18.107 || corasparśanimittaṃ tu snapanaṃ kalaśairhareḥ | varṇānāmānupūrvyeṇa tvathamādhamapaddhatim || 18.108 || ārabhya gaṇitaiḥ kuryātsaṅkarairapi tadbhavet | bījaprayuktakalaśaissnapanaṃ śāntaye bhavet || 18.109 || śāntihomo brāhmaṇānāṃ bhojanaṃ dānameva ca | ajñātajātisaṃsparśe snāpayeduttamottamaiḥ || 18.110 || śāntihomo dvijendrāṇāṃ bhojanaṃ dānameva ca | trivastukaṃ mṛṇmayaṃ ca lepabimbaṃ ca bhittijam || 18.111 || citraṃ nīcairyadi spṛṣṭaṃ caṇḍālādyai rvigarhitaiḥ | navīkaraṇamāstheyaṃ saṃprokṣaṇavidhi stathā || 18.112 || pratiṣṭhā vā yathāvittaṃ doṣabhūyastayātha vā | paṭasparśe kṣālayitvā yathāpūrvaṃ pusassṛjet || 18.113 || dīkṣitairanyaśāstreṣu spṛṣṭe snapanamācaret | dīkṣitairitaraiścāpi śūdraistadvatsamācaret || 18.114 || mahāpātakisaṃsparśe snapanaṃ cottamottamam | upapādaki saṃspṛṣṭe snapanaṃ cādhamottamam || 18.115 || parastrīgamanāsaktaistathā'niyatavṛttibhiḥ | sparśe ca navabhiḥkumbhaissnapanaṃ kautuke bhavet || 18.116 || aspṛśyairitarairvāpi kuṇḍādissarśane sati | snapanaṃ pūrvavatkāryaṃ strībhirduṣṭābhireva ca || 18.117 || anulomāstriyaśśūdrā vrajeyurgarbhamandiram | bhūtalaṃ pañcagavyena siñcedvā gomayāmbabhiḥ || 18.118 || caṇḍālaiḥpulkasairvāpi tapitairmadyapai stathā | śvapacairmandirābhyantaḥ praveśe mṛṇmayāṃstyajet || 18.119 || tatrasthān kṣālayitvāntaḥ kavāṭādimahītalam | ālipya gomayombhobhiḥ puṇyāhamapi vācayet || 18.120 || pratimāścāpi tatrasthā ssnāpayetkalaśairguruḥ | śāntihomo japaścaiva dvijānāṃ dānabhojane || 18.121 || aśaucavatpraveśe ca pūrvavadvidhiriṣyate | caṇḍālaśśvapaco vāpi tādṛśāḥpulkasādayaḥ || 18.122 || ajñānādgarbhagehetu karmasvadhikṛtā yadi | vaseyuścaiva taissārdhaṃ bhojyaṃ vā vastu tādṛśam || 18.123 || spṛṣṭamārādhanāṅgaṃ cetspṛṣṭaṃ vā kautukaṃ yadi | kriyāsamabhihāreṇa prāyaścittamihocyate || 18.124 || śodhayenmandiraṃ pūrvaṃ gomayālepanādibhiḥ | puṇyāhaṃ vācayitvātha brāhmaṇāṃstatra bhojayet || 18.125 || svādhyāyaṃ parikurvīran brāhmaṇā vedapāragāḥ | itihāsapurāṇāni paṭheyuśca divāniśam || 18.126 || kapilāśca pradeśeṣu tatra tatrādhipāsayet | evaṃ māsādikāleṣu doṣagauravarāghavam || 18.127 || avekṣya śodhite dhāmni brāhmaṇāṃstoṣayeddhanaiḥ | pratimānāṃ yathāyogamuddhāro vā navīkṛte || 18.128 || kuryāttato yathāpūrvaṃ nimitte vā navīkṛte | pratiṣṭhāpya yathāśāstraṃ snāpayetkalaśairadhi || 18.129 || sahasreṇa pūrāvṛttadoṣāṇāmapanuttaye | antemahotsavaḥkāryona cedrāṣṭrānṛpakṣayaḥ || 18.130 || bimbaṃ na cālayecchailaṃ na navīkaraṇaṃ tathā | tathaiva divyamārṣaṃ ca svayaṃ vyaktaṃ ca kautukam || 18.131 || tathānyairmāgadhādyaiśca pratilomaiśca garhitaiḥ | sahasrakalaśairdevaṃ snāpayettasya śāntaye || 18.132 || śvāpadaiśca sṛgālādyaiśchaṇḍālādyaiśca garhitaiḥ | prathamādi praviṣṭaṃ ceddhāmāvaraṇabhūtalam || 18.133 || prokṣayetpañca gavyena puṇyāhamapi vā cayet | dhāmasparśe tathānyasya balipīṭhādi kasya ca || 18.134 || sparśekṛtvā yathāpūrvaṃ śāntihomaṃ samācaret | āgantukaiḥ kukkuṭādyaisspṛṣṭaṃ ceddhāma sarvataḥ || 18.135 || prokṣayenmrapūtena vāriṇā śāntimācaret | devān saṃsnāpaye ccaiva prathamāvaraṇādigān || 18.136 || sarpiścarutilairhomo mūlenāṣṭottaraṃ śatam | khadyotasparśane devaṃ snāpayennavabhirghaṭaiḥ || 18.137 || pūjākāle kavāṭasya bandhanaṃ cedasaṅkule | aṣṭottaraśataṃ mūlamantrasya japa iṣyate || 18.138 || saṅkule bandhanaṃ naiva doṣāya bhavati kvacit | prabhāpīṭhāstrasaṃsparśe bimbasparśavadiṣyate || 18.139 || ācāryāḥpūjakāścānye tathaiva paricārakāḥ | āsaneṣvāsikāṃ bhuktiṃ śayanaṃ ca yathātatham || 18.140 || kuryuḥ karmaṇyadhikṛtā doṣā naiva tadā bhavet | anye cetkuryuravaniṃ prokṣayedgomayāmbubhiḥ || 18.141 || prākāre maṇṭape dhāmni gopure pākaveśmani | dagdhe'gninā samādhāya pūrvavanmaṇṭapādikam || 18.142 || pratiṣṭhāpya yathāpūrvaṃ tataḥ śāntiṃ samācaret | adhamottamamārgeṇa snapanaṃ śāntidaṃ bhavet || 18.143 || śāntihomastu kartavyodvijānāṃ dānabhojane | pratimādahane cāpi samādhāya yathāpuram || 18.144 || snāsaṃ sahasrakalaśaiḥ pratiṣṭhāpya yathāvidhi | vastrādidahane tasyāḥ prabhādidahane tathā || 18.145 || navabhiḥkalaśaissnānaṃ homādi tadanantaram | sudarśane'gninā dagdhe snānaṃ navaghaṭairbhavet || 18.146 || dhvaje vitāne chatre ca dagdhecāstaraṇādike | punarutpādya tatsarvaṃ śāntihomādikaṃ bhavet || 18.147 || prāsādādyavakāśānāṃ vṛddhiścetsarvato bhavet | yadvā prācyāmudīcyāṃ vā vṛddhirnānyatra śobhanā || 18.148 || dakṣiṇāparavṛddhiścetsnapanaṃ cottamottamam | śāntihomo dvijendrāṇāṃ tarpaṇaṃ bhojanādibhiḥ || 18.149 || śobhanā sarvato vṛddhi rupapīṭhasya ceṣyate | prathamāvaraṇaṃ yāvat doṣassyāddevanirmite || 18.150 || vardhitaṃ yadi pūrvoktaṃsnapanaṃ śāntidaṃ bhavet | nahrāsayetpurāklṛptaṃ dhāmādi na ca cālayet || 18.151 || paurāṇikaṃ śiraḥ pīṭhaṃ dhāmacihnaṃ ca vaiṣṇavam | noddhṛtya pūrayitvāvā na vṛddhirgopurādiṣu || 18.152 || alpīyaḥ prāgvimānādi divyavargaṃ dhanaiḥ punaḥ | vardhayecchraddhayā mukhyairdravyairarcāṃnayedguruḥ || 18.153 || iti śrīpāñcarātre mahopaniṣadi pādmasaṃhitāyāṃ caryāpāde nityārādhanaprāyaścittavidhirnāma aṣṭādaśo'dhyāyaḥ |
<4.19>
nityaṃ naimittikaṃ kāmyaṃ nipatedyugapadyadi | śrībhagavān kṛtvānaimittikaṃ nityamācārya stadanantaram || 19.1 || gṛhārcāsnapane prāpte vistāre sati veśmani | tatraiva snapanaṃ kāryaṃ saṅkaṭe tu bahirbhavet || 19.2 || parvatādau śucau deśe prapānirmāṇapūrvakam | snapanaṃ devadevasya kāryaṃ bhāgavatena tat || 19.3 || ālaye sthāpitaṃ bimbaṃ na kadāciccaturmukha | nirgamayya bahissnāpya mantareṇa tu sarvadā || 19.4 || tīrthāvadhṛthavelāyāṃ sadyādīnāṃ taṭe bhavet | anyathā cecchāntihomaṃ kuryātsarvasamṛddhidam || 19.5 || aṅkurārpaṇahīne ca snapane kautuke'nvite | adhivāsavihīne ca kalaśaissnapane sati || 19.6 || śāntihomo vidhātavya ssarvadoṣāpanuttaye | saṅkalpitasnānahānau dviguṇaṃ snapanaṃ bhavet || 19.7 || akṛte rājarāṣṭrasya bhavedvibhavasaṅkṣayaḥ | yajamānasya dhāmnaśca prajānāṃ ca dhanakṣayaḥ || 19.8 || akāle tu kṛte snāne viṣuvādau yathodite | śāntiḥ kāryayane caiva dakṣiṇe prāgupakramaḥ || 19.9 || uttare caiva pāścātye uttamaṃ naiva dūṣaṇam | caitre ca viṣuve tadvatkramādāśvayuje'pi ca || 19.10 || sthāpitānāṃ ca kumbhānāṃ bhedane patane tathā | kālādidoṣaduṣṭe ca krimikeśādidūṣite || 19.11 || laṅghite'śucisaṃspṛṣṭe vāyasādyaiścha dūṣite | garhite śvāpadādyaiśca spṛṣṭe cāśucibhistathā || 19.12 || pāṣaṇḍaiḥ pratilomaiśca tathodakyādidūṣite | kalaśaṃ taṃ tamuddhṛtya sthāpayitvā parān punaḥ || 19.13 || taddaivatyān japenmantrā naṣṭottaraśatāvaram | snapanaṃ yadi taiḥkuryācchāntihomaṃ samācaret || 19.14 || akrameṇa samuddhṛtya snapane vihite sati | japaḥpañcopaniṣadāṃ kartavyastatsamācaret || 19.15 || devatāmantrabhūbhāgadravyāṇāṃ vyatyaye sati | pūrvavanmantrajāpassyātpratidravyamanarcite || 19.16 || arghyādibhirjapastadvanmahiṣājoṣṭrasambhavaiḥ | kṣīrādibhistathā dravyai ssnapane snāpayetpunaḥ || 19.17 || samadbhirmūlamantreṇa juhuyātkamalāsana | adbhiḥparyuṣitābhiścetsnapanaṃ snāpayetpunaḥ || 19.18 || śāntihomo mūlavidyā japaścāṣṭottaraṃ śatam | ārādhanāṅgavaikalye nṛttavādyādibhi ssaha || 19.19 || śāntihomo bhavedvedyāṃ snapane calane sati | pratimāpatane tadvatprāyaścittaṃ caturmukha || 19.20 || snapane vartamāne tu carane patane'pi vā | yathāpūrvamavasthāpya snāpayitvā yathīvidhi || 19.21 || śāntihomaśca kartavyaḥ pīṭhādīnāṃ ca bhañṅane | sahajānāṃ tathā hastapādādīnāṃ caturmukha || 19.22 || bhaṅgetu teṣāmāvāhya kūrcādau tadgataṃ harim | kriyāṃ samāpayedbha gnāṃ prabhāpīṭhādikaṃ punaḥ || 19.23 || samādhāya yathāpūrvaṃ saṃprokṣaṇavidhirbhavet | vastuṣu snapanāṅgeṣu ādhikyaṃ hānireva vā || 19.24 || yadi syānmūlamantrāsya japaścāṣṭottarāvaraḥ | mokṣamāṇassadā kuryātsnapanaṃ niśi vā'hani || 19.25 || ripukṣayārthīdivase dharmārthī dinamadhyame | dinānte sarvabhogārthī prāya ścittāya sarvadā || 19.26 || baddhapratisare bimbe snapanārthaṃ tu mantriṇā | snapanāntarasaṃ prāptau na ca pratisarāntaram || 19.27 || maṇḍūkamūṣikāsarpacucundaryādijantubhiḥ | spṛṣṭe vilaṅghite naṣṭe sthāpite kalaśe tathā || 19.28 || tyaktvānyaṃ tu tathā kṛtvā mūlamantraṃ japedguruḥ | sthāpitaṃ kalaśaṃ tadvatpāṣaṇḍaiḥ pratilomajaiḥ || 19.29 || āśaucavadbhiraparaiḥkalaśa sparśane sati | sadravyaṃ kalaśaṃ tyaktvā tathānyaṃ tatra nikṣipet || 19.30 || vācayitvātha puṇyāhaṃ śāntihomaṃ samācaret | karmaṇisnapanādau tu pravṛtte deśikottamaḥ || 19.31 || sūtakaṃ maraṇāśaucaṃ śṛṇuyānnāśucirbhavet | utsave tu yathāśātracodite skhalane sati || 19.32 || śāntistathocyate brahmannidānīmavadhāryatām | vimānasthāpanāhīne na kuryadutsavaṃ hareḥ || 19.33 || kuryādvā dhvajamuddhṛtya utsavaṃ ca krameṇa vā | vāyavīye dhāmakoṇe vidhinā śāntimācaret || 19.34 || saṃvatsarāntaṃ tatraiva dhvajayaṣṭeḥ sthitirbhavet | hīnanityotsave dhāmni dhvajārohaṇapūrvakam || 19.35 || notsavaṃ kāraye tkāmyaṃ kārite śāntimācaret | pramāṇahīne pakṣīndre dhvaje stambhādike'pi vā || 19.36 || śāntiḥkārya tathā hīne mūṣikādyaiśca dūṣite | aśucidravyasaṃsparśe tyaktvā kopyadhvajāntaram || 19.37 || śāntihomaśca kartavyo brāhmaṇānāṃ ca bhojanam | dhvajārohaṇa karmāṅgaṃ dhvajaṃ vā stambhameva vā || 19.38 || sakṛnniyuktaṃ tyaktavyaṃ dhvajayuṣṭiṃ tu na tyajet | sakṛnniyuktestambhādau bhūyo'pi viniyojite || 19.39 || prāyaścittaṃ tu tatra syātsnapanaṃ cottamottamam | śāntihomaśca kartavyo brāhmaṇānāṃ ca bhojanam || 19.40 || sthāpite vihageśānadhvaje vātātapādibhiḥ | varṇahānau na doṣasyā tsamārādhanamiṣyate || 19.41 || patite vātavegena hetunā yena kena cit | uddhṛtya badhvā bhūyopi snapanaṃ madhyamottamam || 19.42 || varṇahānau tathā bhinne dhvaje cchinne'pi vā kvacit | dhvajāntaraṃ samutpādyatyaktvā nipatitaṃ dhvajam || 19.43 || yaṣṭiṃ vākalpyamevāsyaṃ na tu kālapratīkṣaṇam | viparītaṃ dhvajapaṭaṃ pramādādyadibandhayet || 19.44 || tanmocayitvā yadvānyaṃ badhvāsnapanamācaret | dhvajastambhe tathā bhinne bhagne vā suṣire'pi vā || 19.45 || stambhānta ramapasthāpya śāntissnapanapūrvikā | patane bhramaṇe vāpi patite vā yadṛcchayā || 19.46 || śāntihomo bhavetprāgvanmūlamantrajapastathā | pakṣīśādhiṣṭhite kumbhe bhinne naṣṭe'tha vā tathā || 19.47 || aspṛśyaiḥ prāṇibhiḥ spṛṣṭe sthāpya kumbhāntaraṃ punaḥ | āvāhya tatra vihagaṃ karmaśeṣaṃ samāpayet || 19.48 || dhvajastambhe ca saṃspṛṣṭe caṇḍālādyairvigarhitaiḥ | stambhāntaramavasthāpya śāntihomaṃ samācaret || 19.49 || sūtakaiḥ pretakaiścaiva pratilomai sathāvidhaiḥ | spṛṣṭe prokṣya dhvajastambhaṃ puṇyāhoktipurassaram || 19.50 || sakṛnniyojitaṃ tyaktvāmṛṇmayaṃ pālikādikam | aṅkurānarpayennūcet śāntihomādikaṃ caret || 19.51 || aṅkureṣvapi rakteṣu śyāmavarṇayuteṣu vā | aprarūḍheṣu sarveṣu tathā tiryaggateṣu ca || 19.52 || aspṛśyasparśane teṣāṃ bhinnacchinneṣu vā punaḥ | pālikādiṣu naṣṭeṣu patiteṣu yathātathā || 19.53 || valmīkādiprarohe ca mūṣikādyaiśca bhakṣite | śāntihomaśca kartavyo brāhmaṇānāṃ ca bhojanam || 19.54 || prārabdhakarmamadhye cetkarmanaimittikaṃ punaḥ | āpatedarpayedbhūya statarthāṃ ścaṅkurrā guruḥ || 19.55 || arpiteṣvaṅkureṣu syāddaivādvā yadi mānuṣāt | karmalopastadā tyaktvā kalpitānaṅkurānapi || 19.56 || śāntyarthaṃ juhuyādagnau mūlamantrajapastathā | baddhapratisare bimbe karmārthamaparaṃ yati || 19.57 || antarā karma nipatedbadhnīyātkautukaṃ punaḥ | antarā patite snāne samāpte snapanaṃ punaḥ || 19.58 || pūrvārabdhamanuṣṭheyaṃ yathāśāntraṃ caturmukha | grāmādiṣu syācchūnyeṣu na balirvīdhikotsavaḥ || 19.59 || dhāmanyeva bhavetkāmaṃ yadi syādvīdhikotsavaḥ | sahasrakalaśaissnānaṃ prayaścittaṃ tadiṣyate || 19.60 || utsave varta māne syānmahāvātādinā yati | grāmādau śithile kṛtvā prayaścittaṃ punarmahaḥ || 19.61 || kāryona lopyo lope tu kumbhairaṣṭottarai rhareḥ | snapanaṃ kārayeddhomo japaścārthairdvijārcanam || 19.62 || muhūrtātikrame śāntissarveṣāṃ karmaṇāmapi | kāryāhomādibhiḥ paścātkarmārambho yathoditaḥ || 19.63 || karmaṇyadhikṛte pūrvaṃ deśiko mūrtipeṣu vā | daivādvā mānuṣādvāpi vighniteṣvadhikāriṣu || 19.64 || prārabdhaṃ karma kartavyaṃ tādṛgbhiraparairdvijaiḥ | utsave vighnite daivānmānuṣādvā yathodite || 19.65 || balimeva kṣipeddhāmni grāmādau vidhikāsvapi | balipradāne pyakṛte kasmiṃściddivase punaḥ || 19.66 || kurvan balimatikrāntaṃ kṛtvaivaṃ balimācaret | utsavāṅgeṣu hīneṣu kaliteṣu yathāpuram || 19.67 || udyānayānamṛgayā jaladroṇyādi karmasu | śāntiḥkāryā bhojanaṃ ca brāhmaṇānāṃ japastathā || 19.68 || hīnāyāṃ tīrthayātrāyāṃ punarutsavamācaret | uttamottamamārgeṇa kṛtvā snapanamāditaḥ || 19.69 || māse yathokte'tikrānte nakṣatrādau yathodite | utsavo'nantare māsi yadyarvāgvatsarādbhavet || 19.70 || ūrdhvaṃ saṃvatsarā tkurvan śāntiṃ kṛtvāsamācaret | sahasrakalaśaissnānaṃ śāntihomaṃ japādikam || 19.71 || lupte parpotsave śānti ssnapanaṃ śaktyapekṣayā | anyeṣu viṣṇorlupteṣu śravaṇādyutsaveṣu ca || 19.72 || uttamottamamārgeṇa snapanaṃ tasya niṣkṛtiḥ | vyatyāse balivastūnāṃ juhuyātsarviṣā śatam || 19.73 || vātādyutpāta saṃspṛṣṭe bimbhe snapanamuttamam | ācaredyāgaśālāyāṃ prapādiṣu mahotsave || 19.74 || agnidagdheṣu tatsarvaṃ samādhāya yathāpuram | śāntihomo dvijendrāṇāṃ bhojanaṃ dānameva ca || 19.75 || kuryātsudarśanaploṣe kumbhairnavabhiruplavaḥ | kāryo bimbādidāhe'pi tathā snapanamācaret || 19.76 || śvasṛgālādibhiryāgamaṇṭapādi praveśane | saṃsparśe purvaklaptāni tyaktvānyāni nidhāya ca || 19.77 || śāntihomodvijendhrāṇāṃ bhojanādi yathāpuram | caṇḍālādipraveśādau tyaktvā tadvastu dūṣitam || 19.78 || utsavārthāni vastūni śānti homaṃ samācaret | utsavāgnau svayaṃ śānte śāntiṃ kuryādyathākramam || 19.79 || viṣuve cāyane caiva tīrthayātrā na doṣakṛt | rātrāvapi tato'nyatra kartavyā hnyeva sā bhavet || 19.80 || pramādādyadi yātrāsyātsnapanaṃ cottamottamam | utsave homavicchede dviguṇaṃ homamācaret || 19.81 || bimbe corādibhirnaṣṭe vartamāne mahotsave | karmārcādiṣu bimbeṣu bimbaṃ cotpādya pūrvavat || 19.82 || ārādhayennipatite bimbe yānānmahotsave | āropya pūrvavadyānaṃ rathyāsu patitaṃ nayet || 19.83 || ekādhikāśītikumbhaissnāpayecchāntaye punaḥ | aṅgahānau kautukasya bimba manyaṃ nayettadā || 19.84 || hīnāṅgaṃ cetsamādhāya sadyassaṃ prokṣaṇaṃ caret | snapanaṃ śāntaye kuryādbrāhmaṇānāṃ ca toṣaṇam || 19.85 || yānabhaṅge nayeddevaṃ yānenā'nyena vīdhikām | śāntiśca kāryā patanabhramaṇādau ca sāratheḥ || 19.86 || puṇyāhavācanādīni kāryāṇi kamalāsana | aspṛśyā yadi yānāni vaheyurbhimbameva vā || 19.87 || kṣālayitvā tu yānāni bimbaṃ ca snāpayedghaṭaiḥ | puṣpayāgo niśi bhavecchāntaye bhuktaye pi vā || 19.88 || abhāve puṣpayāgasya snapanaṃ cottamottamam | ārabhya tīrthadivasādūrdhvaṃ pañcadināvadhi || 19.89 || dhvajāvarohaṇaṃ kāryaṃ paścāccedavarohaṇam | doṣassyāddoṣaśamanaṃ snapanaṃ madhyamottamam || 19.90 || aparopya dhvajapaṭaṃ snapanāna ntaraṃ punaḥ | udvāsya devatāssarvāśśakaṭādbalikarmaṇā || 19.91 || mahotsavāntaḥ patitaṃ karma vaiśeṣi kāhvayam | kāryameva na lopyaṃ tallope snapanamācaret || 19.92 || pavitrāropaṇe prāyaścittamanyatpra darśyate | hīnamāne pavitre vā kuṇḍe vā maṇḍale'pi vā || 19.93 || astramantraṃ śataṃ japtvā pūjaye dastravardhinīm | tyaktvā pavitraṃ keśādidūṣitaṃ punareva tat || 19.94 || kṛtvā pūrvavadāropya tataśśāntiṃ samācaret | aspṛśyasparśane kumbhe bhinne naṣṭe'pi vā punaḥ || 19.95 || kuṃbhāntare samāvāhya mūlamantraṃ japetpunaḥ | asthāne sthāpitaṃ śūla manyatra pratimādikam || 19.96 || sthāpayitvā yathāsthānaṃ snapanādi samācaret | māne nyūnādhike vāpi vedyādīnāṃ prakalpite || 19.97 || śāntirājyāhutiḥ kāryā paṃcopaniṣadā śatam | teṣāmabhāve ca tathā śāntirnayanamokṣaṇam || 19.98 || akṛtvāsthāpane śāntiṃ kṛtvā nayanamokṣaṇam | toyādhivāsākaraṇe pratiṣṭhāyāṃ madhudviṣaḥ || 19.99 || snapanaṃ śāntihomaśca tadvadevāṅgahāniṣu | anācāryapratiṣṭhāyāṃ punasthsāpanamācaret || 19.100 || ācāryapadamārūḍho vaidhuryādyalpadoṣavān | adhikāryeva vijñānapāraṃ yāto yadi svayam || 19.101 || jñānādhikena deveśe sthāpite jñāna rūpiṇi | na doṣo jñānadahanassarvadoṣān dahetkhalu || 19.102 || yāvatkālaṃ sthitirbhālamandire prārthitā purā | tāvatyatīte samaye snapanaṃ madhuvidviṣaḥ || 19.103 || kāryaṃ punaścatatraiva sthitikālaṃ parīkṣayet | anyatra vā bālagehe yadvā mūlālaye bhavet || 19.104 || karmārthapīṭhikāyāṃ tat sthāpayitvā samarcayet | gopure vālaye yadvā prākāre maṇṭape'thavā || 19.105 || śithilī saraghātumbāvalmīkādisamudbhave | uddhṛtyatattatsaṃśodhya deśaṃ kṛtvā yathāpuram || 19.106 || snapanaṃ devadevasya kuryāduttamamadhyamam | śāntihomo dvijendrāṇāṃ bhojanaṃ dānameva ca || 19.107 || siddhāntasaṅkare jāte pramādāttatra saṅkare | kṛtvā saṃprokṣaṇaṃ pūrvaṃ sahasrakala śāplavaḥ || 19.108 || brahmā sidthāntaṃ nāma kiṃ ko vā bhedastasya janārdana | śrotumicchāmi tatsarvaṃ na rahasyamidaṃ yadi || 19.109 || śrībhagavān mahopaniṣadaṃ nāma siddhāntapadaśabditam | mīmāṃsādiṣu śātreṣu ye siddhārthā manīṣiṇaḥ || 19.110 || teṣāmante'dhikārosminnitisiddhānta śabditam | taccaturdhāsthitaṃ śāstramṛgādivadanekadhā || 19.111 || ekaikaṃ bhidyate tantraṃ śākhābhedena bhūyasā | prathamaṃmantrasiddhāstaṃ dvitīyaṃ cāgamāhvayam || 19.112 || tṛtīyaṃ tantrasiddhāntaṃ turyaṃ tantrāntaraṃ bhavet | ekaiva mūrtirārādhyā prādhānyenetarāḥ punaḥ || 19.113 || devyaśśriyrādayaścāpi saṃpūjyāḥ parivāravat | āyudhaiśśaṅkhacakrādyaiśśrīvatsādyaiścabhūṣaṇaiḥ || 19.114 || mūrtimadbhiḥ parivṛtā kevalā vāmbujāsana | kathyate yatra tatproktaṃ mantrasiddhāntamagrimam || 19.115 || vāsudevādayo vyūhāścatvārassādhakairapi | kramāgataistulyakakṣyāḥ pūjyāstatprabhavāpyaye || 19.116 || karmaṇāmapi sanyāsaḥ kathyate yatra cāgame | tantramāgamasiddhāntaṃ taduktaṃ kamalāsana || 19.117 || navānāmapi mūrtīnāṃ prādhānyaṃ yatra kathyate | mūrtayo dvādaśāṅgāni teṣāmeva tathāpare || 19.118 || prādurbhāva guṇāścānye mūrtyantaraguṇā api | prādurbhāvāntarayutāssa digdevaissahāyudhaiḥ || 19.119 || mūrtimadbhiścha devībhirlakṣmyādibhirapi sphuṭam | tattantrasiddhāntāhvānaṃ caturthaṃ paramaṃ punaḥ || 19.120 || saumyasiṃhādibhūyiṣṭhaṃ vaktrebhaidaiścaturmukha | dvitrādimukhabhedā vā mūrtirekaiva pūjyate || 19.121 || parivārainsaṃvṛtā vā vinā vā sarvakāmadā | yatra tantrāntaraṃ tatsyāccaturthaṃ kamalāsana || 19.122 || yena siddhāntamārgeṇa karṣaṇādikriyā kṛtā | ādau tenaiva sakalaṃ nānyasiddhāntavartmanā || 19.123 || tantreṇāpi tathā yena karṣaṇādikriyā kṛtā | tenaiva sakalaṃ kāryaṃ na tantrāntaravartmanā || 19.124 || tantrāntare'pi kathitamanuktaṃ grāhyameva hi | siddhānta saṅkarastasmāttantrasaṅkara eva ca || 19.125 || doṣāya kalpate rājarāṣṭra dhāmakṣayātmane | siddhāntasaṅkare jāte pramādāttasya śāntaye || 19.126 || kṛtvā saṃprokṣaṇaṃ pūrvaṃ sahasrakalaśāplavaḥ | kartavyassnapanaṃ kuryā ttantrasaṅkarasambhave || 19.127 || antemahotsavaṃ kuryāt dhvajārohaṇapūrvakam | sthāpite pañcarātreṇa deve ṣaḍbhirathādhvabhiḥ || 19.128 || patriṣṭhāne kṛte mohāddoṣassarvakṣayātmakaḥ | śāntiśca tasya bhūyo'pi pañca rātroktavartmanā || 19.129 || pratiṣṭhāpya sahasreṇa kalaśaissnapanaṃ hareḥ | mahotsavaśca kartavyo dhvajārohaṇapūrvakaḥ || 19.130 || ekatra dīkṣitastante vā dvijottamaḥ | kriyāṃ na kuryādanyatra karṣaṇādi caturmukha || 19.131 || ācāryatvamathārtvijyaṃ pūjāyāṃ madhuvidviṣaḥ | tantrabhedhe ca siddhāntabhede cāpi na yujyate || 19.132 || brahmahatyādipāpānāṃ niṣkṛtismsṛticoditā | mṛtānāṃ viṣaśastrāgni prāyairugraiśca karmabhiḥ || 19.133 || nārāyaṇabalirnāma samārādhanamuttamam | gatiheturvinā tena gatiranyāna vidyate || 19.134 || punardahanamārabhya karma smārtamaśeṣataḥ | kṛtvā sapiṇḍīkaraṇaparyantaṃ tadanantaram || 19.135 || devadevaṃ samārādhya vakṣyamāṇena vartmanā | viṣṇvālaye nadītīre parvate vā vane'pi vā || 19.136 || ānyatra vā puṇyadeśe karturvā bhavane śubhe | yaṣṭavyaṃ kṛṣṇapakṣasya dvādaśyāmayanadvaye || 19.137 || upoṣitassan pūrvedyuḥkartāniyatamānasaḥ | brāhmaṇānbhagavadbhaktānvratasvādhyāyaśālinaḥ || 19.138 || āmantryamantravidbadhvā keśavādi yathāsvayam | śodhite gomayāmbhobhirbhūtale kuśaviṣṭare || 19.139 || upaveśya vṛtāneva prāṅmukhān kamalāsana | arghyādibhissamabhyarcya sāmabhiḥ keśavadibhiḥ || 19.140 || namontrairnāgavallyādi datvā cābhyañjayeddvijān | snātānāṃ sannidau teṣāṃ homaṃ caupāsane'nale || 19.141 || kṛtvāgni mukhamagneśca prāgbhāge cakrapaṅkaje | sthaṇḍale kuśakūrce vā devamāvāhayediti || 19.142 || puṣpāñjalissamutthāya nṛsūktādyā ṛco japan | oṃ pūrvābhirvyāhṛtibhirāvāhya puruṣottamam || 19.143 || mūrtibhedān
