keśavādīnnāmabhistairanantaram | āvāhyārghyādibhiṣṭadbhirupacarya pṛthakpṛthak || 19.144 || tarpayitvā tilāmbhobhiḥ keśavādīn svanāmabhiḥ | upacarya ca dīpāntaṃ puruṣaṃ puruṣātmanā || 19.145 || sūktena keśavādīṃstu nāmabhistairyathākramam | agnau padmāsanāsīnaṃ dhyātvā paramapūruṣam || 19.146 || anūcya pāyasaṃ viṣṇornukamityṛcamabjaja | paścātparomātrayeti yājyayā juhuyāddhaviḥ || 19.147 || keśavādyairnāmadheyaissarpiṣā juhuyāttataḥ | caturthyantairdvādaśabhi rnāmabhirdhyānamāsthitaḥ || 19.148 || kṣīrājyaguḍamiśrānnaṃ tebhya eva nivedayet | devasya tvā savituriti mahāviṣṇornavedanam || 19.149 || saptavyāhṛtibhirbhūyo juhuyātsarpiṣānale | darbhāsaneṣu bhūdevānāhutānupaveśitān || 19.150 || vastrāṅgulīyakacchatrakuṇḍalopānahādibhiḥ | yathāśakti samabhyarcya mantreṇāṣṭākṣareṇa tān || 19.151 || tilājyamiśrahastena tadanujñānapūrvakam | juhuyādanale havyaṃ vidyayā vakṣyamāṇayā || 19.152 || pitṛbhyastatpitṛbhyaśca tatpitṛbhyaḥ punastathā | mātṛbhyaḥ pitṛmātṛbhya statpitṛbhyaḥpunastathā || 19.153 || mātāmahebhya steṣāṃ ye pitarastebhya eva ca | matāmahībhyo mātuśca pitṛmātṛbhya eva ca || 19.154 || pituḥ pitāmahībhyaśca tathācāryebhya eva ca | tatpatnībhyo gurubhyaśca gurupatnībhya eva ca || 19.155 || sakhibhyastatpurandhrībhyojñātibhyā yāścatat striyaḥ | tābhyaśchāmātyatat strībhyassarvābhyastat striyaścayāḥ || 19.156 || tābhyaśceti samuccārya svadhā nama iti bruvan | nārāyaṇāya svāheti pratyekaṃ pṛthagāhutiḥ || 19.157 || agnibaddaṃ caturthyantaṃ kavyavāhanamityatha | tadantesviṣṭakṛcchabdhamanuṣaṅgaśca pūrvavat || 19.158 || hutvaivaṃ sarpiṣā paścāddvādaśākṣaravidyayā | pratyekaṃ śatamaṣṭā ca dvādaśākṣara vidyayā || 19.159 || viṣṇugāyatriyā tadvadbrāhmaṇān ṣaḍrasānvitam | bhojayeddakṣaṇāṃ tadyāttān praṇamya pradakṣiṇam || 19.160 || tānanujñāpya śiṣṭānnaṃ yatheṣṭaṃ kriyātāmiti | dakṣiṇenānalaṃ darbhān prāgagrān śodhite sthale || 19.161 || saṃstīrya teṣu darbheṣu baliṃ dadyātsamāhitaḥ | viśvebhyaścaiva devebhyassādhyebhyastadanantaram || 19.162 || sarvebhyaścaiva devebhyo viṣṇurnārāyaṇa stathā | sahasraśirase caiva yajñātmapadameva ca || 19.163 || puruṣaṃ yajñapūrvaṃ ca sarveśvarapadaṃ tathā | caturthyantaṃ samucchārya namassvā hetyanastaram || 19.164 || sarvatraivānuṣaṅgaṃ ca sviṣṭakṛdyajanādikam | ādhenuvaradānāntaṃ kṛtvā pretaṃ nivedayet || 19.165 || mūrtiṣu dvādaśasvenaṃ yajñaśarmāṇamākhyayā | nivedayāmi devāya keśavāyetyanukramāt || 19.166 || dvādaśabhyonivedyaivaṃ paramānnaṃ nivedayet | nārāyaṇabalirhyeṣa dvijānāṃ samudīritaḥ || 19.167 || evaṃ yasya kṛte datto balirde vārcanā tmakaḥ | sa yāti nikhilaṃ pāpaṃ nirdhūya brahma śāśvatam || 19.168 || pāpānāmitareṣāṃ ca baliḥ puṇyakṛtāmapi | paramātmapadaprāptyaikalpate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 19.169 || iti śrīpāñcarātre mahopaniṣadi pādmasaṃhitāyāṃ caryāpāde utsavaprāyaścittanārāyaṇabalirnāma ekonaviṃśo’dhyāyaḥ |
<4.20>
brahmā rājānastadamātyā vā ye rājyadhuri niṣṭhitāḥ | bhagavan rakṣaṇavyagrāḥ prajānāṃ satatodyatāḥ || 20.1 || brahmahatyādibhiḥ pāpairabhibhūtā vigarhitaiḥ | kāyakleśātmake śāstracodite ghorakarmaṇi || 20.2 || pāpanirharaṇopāye pravartitumanīśvarāḥ | te kathaṃ tāni pāpāni nirdhūya sakalanyapi || 20.3 || karmādhikāriṇo bhūyassatāṃ saṃsadi saṃmatāḥ | kalpanai bhagavaddhyāne tadarcanavidhāvapi || 20.4 || yogyāḥ prakāraṃ taṃ deva brūhi mahyaṃ yathātatham | śrībhagavān brahmahatyādipāpānāmapanodanamuttamam || 20.5 || kāyakleśātmake karmaṇyakṣamāṇāṃ mahībṛtām | vihitaṃ sukaraṃ teṣāṃ prāyaścittaṃ caturmukha || 20.6 || hiraṇyagarbhanāmaikaṃ karma proktaṃ yathāparam | tulābhārasamā khyaṃ taddvābhyāṃ nirdhūta kalmaṣam || 20.7 || bhagavaddhyānapūjādividau bhūyo'dhikāriṇiḥ | bhavantikarmadvitayaṃ tadaśeṣeṇa kathyate || 20.8 || kartuṃ vyavasitaṃ karma varayedgurumāditaḥ | sarvaśāstrārthatatvajñaṃ mantrāṇāṃ pāragaṃ param || 20.9 || dayāluṃ sarvabhūtānāmakrodhanamalolupam | karmadvayavidhānajñamṛjuṃ bhāgavataṃ dvijam || 20.10 || parīkṣyaivaṃ vidhaṃ yatnādupasaṅgamya pārthivaḥ | arthayitvā yathānyāyamupacarya dvijottamam || 20.11 || karmārabheta puṇyeṣu deśakāleṣu yantritaḥ | ṣaṭsutaiṣyādi māseṣu śravaṇe tvāṣṭrā eva vā || 20.12 || maitre cāśvayuji brahman rohiṇyāṃ pāsave'pi vā | puṣye vā saumyanakṣatre cottaratritaye'pi vā || 20.13 || deśetīre ca saritāṃ samudrataṭabhūṣu vā | yadvā sarvaguṇopete deśe bhagavadālaye || 20.14 || naimittikaṃ cetkarmaitanna kālādiparīkṣaṇam | maṇḍapaṃ prathamaṃ kuryātpratiṣṭhāyāmivālaye || 20.15 || anyatra vā yathoddiṣṭe deśe śāstroktavartanā | sarvālaṅkāranaṃyuktamantaḥ kalpitavedikam || 20.16 || aṅkurānarpayetpūrvamukteṣvanyatame dine | sambhārāstatra sambhāryā yathāvidhi yathāvasu || 20.17 || ekāṅgulaghane tulye kapāle dve hiraṇmaye | adharaṃ cottaraṃ cāpi karye dvābhyāṃ caturmukha || 20.18 || saṅgatābhyāṃ praviśyāntarāste garbhāśaye yathā | kartāsukhaṃ taṃ niryāya dvayamaṇḍasamākṛti || 20.19 || hiraṇyagarbha saṃjñaṃ tat yatrāyaṃ jāyate punaḥ | homapātrāṇi sarvāṇi raimayānyeva kārayet || 20.20 || sambhāreṣu samasteṣu sambhṛteṣu mahīpatiḥ | pūrvedyu rniyataścopta romaśmaśrunakhaśśuciḥ || 20.21 || śuddhadaśśuddhavasanaśśvetamālyānulepanaḥ | upoṣito ghṛtaṃ prāśya rātriṃ niyamatatparaḥ || 20.22 || nītvā paredyuḥ pratyūṣesnāto niyatamānasaḥ | ṛtvigbhiḥ kārayetkarma garuṇā coditassvayam || 20.23 || vedimadhye śālibhārairnavabhiḥ kṛtaviṣṭare | prāgagreṣu ca darbheṣu stīrṇeṣvāropya raimayam || 20.24 || kapālamadharaṃ dvāratoraṇādisamarcane | yathāpuraṃ kṛte nṛttageyavāditramaṅgale || 20.25 || hiraṇyagarbhamabhitaścaturdikṣu bhṛtodakān | saṃsthāpya caturaḥ kumbhān dhānyapīṭheṣu teṣvatha || 20.26 || kumbheṣu nyastaratneṣu veṣṭiteṣu navāmbaraiḥ | catasro devatāssvīyairnāmadheyairanukramāt || 20.27 || āvahyaḥ puruṣassatyaḥ prācīdakṣiṇayestathā | vāruṇyāmathakauberyāmacyuto'nanta eva ca || 20.28 || samudīryārghyapādyādyai rdhūpadīpāvasānakaiḥ | annaṃ caturvidhaṃ cāpi kumbhe kumbhe nivedayet || 20.29 || pūrvādi dikṣu kuṇḍeṣu pratiṣṭhāyāmivakramāt | klṛpteṣu hāvayedagnau samidhājyena cakramāt || 20.30 || pratyekaṃ mūlamantreṇa śatamaṣṭottaraṃ guruḥ | caturvidhena cānnena pratyekaṃ ṣoḍaśāhutīḥ || 20.31 || kuryātpuruṣanoktena dhyātvā yaṣṭavyadevatāḥ | prāpte muhurte bhūdevānanujñāpya gurussvayam || 20.32 || pāṇinā bhūmipaṃ haste gṛhītvā pralayakramāt | dehaṃ saṃhṛtya bhūpālaṃ dehamātrāvaśeṣitam || 20.33 || dhyātvā praveśayedgarbhaṃ raimayaṃ kamalāsana | adhare raimaye bhāge sukhāsīnaṃ ca bhūmipam || 20.34 || chādayedupariṣṭena bhāgenaitatpraveśanam | ghṛtamiśraistilaistatvasaṃhārāhutimācaret || 20.35 || tattvotpādanamārgeṇa cintayitvā guruḥ punaḥ | spaṣṭaṃ śarīraṃ bhūpasya sṛṣṭi homaṃ yathāpuram || 20.36 || kuryātkuṇḍeṣu sarvatra caturghu caturāsana | ānīya mantravajjātaṃ aṇḍāttasmādbahirnṛpam || 20.37 || vaiyāghracarmaṇyāropya kalaśairabhiṣecayet | uttamādhamamārgeṇa vedavittantravittamaḥ || 20.38 || tathaiva mantrātsnapanaṃ dravyajātaṃ ca tādṛśam | karmaṇā tena nirdhūtakalmaṣaḥ puṇyakṛttamaḥ || 20.39 || jāto guruprasādena gurumagre sabhājayet | sahasraniṣṭamānena tapanīyena bhūmipaḥ || 20.40 || ṛtvijāṃ cāpi sarveṣāṃ tāvatī dakṣiṇā matā | karmopakaraṇaṃ sarvaṃ kuryādācāryasānnṛpaḥ || 20.41 || hairaṇyamaṇḍaṃ vidvadbhyo brāhmaṇebhyaḥ pradāpayet | evaṃ kṛtavatastasya viṣṇorārādhanādiṣu || 20.42 || saṃpadyate'dhikāritvaṃ dvirevaṃ karma kurvataḥ | phalaṃ ca viṣṇossārūpyaṃ sāyujyaṃ triguṇe bhavet || 20.43 || tulābhārāhvayaṃ karma dvitīyaṃ kathyate'dhunā | nirmāya maṇṭapaṃ prāgvattasmadhye yajñadārujau || 20.44 || stambhā dṛḍhau saravantau hastaiṣṣaḍbhissamchṛtau | dvihastapariṇāhau dvau savṛttau śilpikalpitau || 20.45 || dvihastamānāntarālau sthāpitau bhūtale dṛḍham | kṛtvātayoruparyekaṃ dāru sārava duttaram || 20.46 || vistīrṇaṃ hastamānena tāvanmānaghasaṃ dhṛḍham | trihastamāyataṃ caiva tulādaṇḍamayomayam || 20.47 || āyasenaiva pāśena yojayeduttareṇa tu | vidhāyetthaṃ tulāmanyatsambhārādi yathāpuram || 20.48 || kalpayitvā yathāpūrvaṃ karmacopari śāstrikam | homāntaṃ sakalaṃ kuryādyathā yogamalopayan || 20.49 || snāto narapatiḥ kṣāmavasanābharaṇānvitaḥ | śucirdhyāyan vāsudevaṃ carmakhaḍgadharastataḥ || 20.50 || parikramya samaskṛtya devāṃstān puruṣādikān | tulāmapi tathā kṛtvā bhāge tasyāśca paścime || 20.51 || sthitvā prāgānano bhūtvā ārohetpaścimaṃ dhaṭam | svastina ityṛcaṃ sūktamadhīyānaśca maṅgalam || 20.52 || prācye dhaṭe nṛpasamaṃ nikṣipeddhāṭakottamam | caturdikṣu pravṛtteṣu nṛttavāditragītiṣu || 20.53 || adhīyāneṣu vipreṣu vedāṃśca caturastadā | śāntihome ca kuṇḍeṣu pravṛtte pārthivassvayam || 20.54 || kañcitkālaṃ dhaṭabhuvi dhyāyan rukmamayaṃ harim | āsitvā gurvanujñātaḥ pūrvaṃ dhaṭabhuva stataḥ || 20.55 || avarohetsuvarṇaṃ ca bhūṣaṇāni ca bhūpatiḥ | bhūsurebhyo yathāyogaṃ vibhajya vitarettataḥ || 20.56 || ācāryaya śataṃ niṣkaṃ mūrtipebhyaśca tatsamam | sarvebhyo ye ca tatkarmasahakāre niyojitāḥ || 20.57 || tebhyo'pi dadyāddīkṣitvā teṣāṃ karma yathāyatham | tulābhārāhvayaṃ karma kurvannitthaṃ mahīpatiḥ || 20.58 || anyo vā dhanavān kaścitsarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate | pretya cābhimatān bhogānaśnute divi devavat || 20.59 || asakṛtkarma kurvāṇo brahmaloke mahīyate | pāpāpanodanaṃ karma paraloke sukhāvaham || 20.60 || āyurvṛddhikaraṃ sarvarogaśāntikaraṃ param | saṃpatkaraṃ yaśovṛddhikāraṇaṃ sarvakāmadam || 20.61 || caturānana karmānyatsvarṇagarbhādi saṃyutam | puṣyābhiṣecanaṃ nāma śṛṇu guhyaṃ sanātanam || 20.62 || vihitaṃ pṛthivīśānāmintrādyairapyanuṣṭhitam | māsitaiṣye proṣṭapade māse cāśva yuje śubhe || 20.63 || śravaṇe caiva nakṣatre janmarkṣe kartureva vā | mahābhiṣecanaṃ karma prārabheta guru stataḥ || 20.64 || pūrvokaiṣveva deṣeṣu kasmiṃścidabhipūjite | pañcadaṇḍāyatāṃ bhūmiṃ kṛtvā vai vartulākṛtim || 20.65 || tasyāmantasthsalaṃ samyakkṛtvā niṣkasamucchṛtam | toraṇādi caturdikṣu sthāpayitvā caturmukha || 20.66 || alaṅkṛtya yathāpūrvaṃ vitānadhvajamālayā | tanmadhye kalpayenmeruṃ mṛdaṅgasadṛśākṛtim || 20.67 || ślakṣṇādi ca mṛdā kāryaṃ tasyocchrāyaṃ trihastakam | mūle cāgre ca viṣkambho hastamānastathā bhavet || 20.68 || caturdikṣu ca cadvāro bhāgāstasya yathākramam | śveto'ruṇastathāpītaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ kalpyaśca sarvataḥ || 20.69 || katnaiḥ svarṇaiḥ pūraṇīyā ṣṣaṭtathā kulaparvatāḥ | pūrvāparāyatāḥ kalpyā himavāṃ stadanantaram || 20.70 || hemakūṭaśca viṣadho nīlaśśvetaśca parvataḥ | śataśṛṅgaśca viṣkambhasteṣāṃ gyātṣoḍaśāṅgulaḥ || 20.71 || śvetaśca piṅgalo rakto nīlaścandrasamaprabhaḥ | hemavarṇaḥ kramādvarṇaiścitrayeddhātupāṃsubhiḥ || 20.72 || jambādvīpaṃ libhaitvaivaṃ lavaṇodadhivedhṭitam | plakṣadvīpaṃ likheddikṣu samudrapari veṣṭitam || 20.73 || śālmalyā lakṣitaṃ dvīpaṃ parītaṃ madirāmbubhiḥ | kuśaṃ parītamāghāraiḥ krauñcaṃ dadhisamudritam || 20.74 || śākaṃ dugdhodadhikṣiptaṃ puṣkaraṃ svacchatoyadhim | kramāllikhitvā sarveṣāṃ lokālokamahācaram || 20.75 || vapravatkalpayetprācyāṃ tasyāntaramarāvatīm | purīmindrasya yāmyāyāṃ nāmnā saṃyamanīmapi || 20.76 || yamasya varuṇasyāpi pratīcyāṃ nagarīṃ tathā | vibhāvarīmudīcyāṃ tu purīṃ somasya kalpayet || 20.77 || indrādilokapālānāṃ sthāne sthāne prakalpayet | saikate sthaṇḍile tatra tānāvāhya samarcayet || 20.78 || mahāmoruṃ ca tanmūrdhni vārāhiṃ mūrtimarcayet | meroruttarapārśve tu śvabhraṃ kṛtvā pramāṇataḥ || 20.79 || adhaḥ kapālaṃ sauvarṇaṃ nyasya tatra samarcayet | pūnarurdhvakapālaṃ ca nyasya tasyopari kramāt || 20.80 || pūrvoktena vidhānena purodhā niyatassvayam | kuṃbhān ṣoḍaśa saṃpūrṇān ṣoḍaśa prasthapūraṇān || 20.81 || parito'ṇḍakapālasya sūtravastrādiveṣṭitān | sthāpayitvā dhānyarāśau sāpidhānānalaṅkṛtān || 20.82 || diśamaindrīṃ samārabhya prādakṣiṇyena pūrayet | pañcagavyādibhirdravyaiḥ praṇavena prapūrayet || 20.83 || pañcagavyaṃ ca pīyūṣaṃ dadhi sarpi stathā madhu | haricandanatoyaṃ ca vāri cākṣatasaṃyutam || 20.84 || kuṅkumaṃ ca tathā toyaṃ karpūrāguruvāri ca | kuśodakaṃ ca ratnāmbhassarva puṣpodakaṃ tathā || 20.85 || phalodakaṃ ca dhānyāmbhassarvatīrthodakaṃ tathā | sarvagandhodakaṃ cāpi dravyāṇāṃ krama īritaḥ || 20.86 || morośca dakṣiṇe bhāge kuṇḍamagneḥ prakalpayet | ājyena juhuyādagnau śatamaṣṭottaraṃ pṛthak || 20.87 || varāhamūrti prabhṛtīrupakṣiptvā ca devatāḥ | anyāśca devatāśśailān samudrānviṣṭasāni ca || 20.88 || bhūrādīni tathā dvīpabhedāṃścoddiśya nāmabhiḥ | teṣā māhūya tatkāryaṃ guruṇā sapurodhasā || 20.89 || bhūrbhuvassvariti brahmannanai ca juhuyādghṛtaiḥ | agniṃ visṛjya vitareddakṣiṇāśca yathāvasu || 20.90 || tadanai yajamānastu sarvālaṅkārasaṃyutaḥ | śucissamāhito bhūtvākṛtakautukabandhanaḥ || 20.91 || praviśya tatra taddhaimamaṇḍaṃ ca prāṅmukha ssvayam | praviśyāsīta deveśaṃ dhyāyanneva sudhākaram || 20.92 || yajñamūrtiṃ dharāṃ devīṃ bibhrāṇaṃ nijadaṃṣṭrayā | evaṃ dhyāyantamāsīnaṃ nṛpaṃ sopaskriyaṃ svayam || 20.93 || ācāryānumataḥ kumbhaiḥ sthāpi tairabhiṣecayet | pañcagavyādibhirdravyairmantrānuccāryamantravit || 20.94 || vasoḥ pavitramantreṇa pañcagavyābhiṣecanam | śaṃ nodevīriti payassnānaṃ dadhnā'bhiṣecanam || 20.95 || iṣetveti ghṛtenāgna āyāhīti tathā punaḥ | madhunā cāgnimīḍeti mānastoka iti bruvan || 20.96 || haricandhanatoyena tathaivākṣatavāriṇā | idaṃ viṣṇuriti procya kuṅkumakṣoda vāriṇā || 20.97 || āhārṣaṃ ceti mantreṇa tathā karpūravāriṇā |
<4.21>
brahmā siddhāntānāṃ śruto bhedaścaturṇāṃ bhagavanmukhāt | idānīṃ śotumicchāmi vyavasthāmadhikāriṇām || 21.1 || śrībhagavān ahaṃ te niyamaṃ teṣāṃ kathayiṣyāmi śāstrataḥ | jāteṣu sarvavipreṣu manmukhātkamalāsana || 21.2 || nānācaraṇagotreṣu nānākarmapareṣu ca | teṣāṃ madhye mahābhāgā ṛṣayo'ṣṭasahasriṇaḥ || 21.3 || aupagāyanapūrvāste nānāgotrā mumukṣavaḥ | adhīyānāḥkaṇvaśākhāṃ tathā mādhyandināhvayām || 21.4 || teṣāṃ buddhissamutpānnā mokṣaikaphaladāyinī | te sarve saha saṅgamya brahmāṇaṃ procuravyayam || 21.5 || mokṣyamāṇā vayaṃ brahman mokṣo pāyavivitsayā | śaraṇaṃ tvāmihaprāptā janmamṛtyujigīṣavaḥ || 21.6 || aupagāyana mukhyāṃstānupāsannāṃ ścaturmukha | iti bruvāṇānāhūya tadanugrahakāmyayā || 21.7 || pañcarātrokta mārgeṇa mantrasiddhāntavartmanā | dīkṣayitvā yathānyāyaṃ cakravārija maṇḍale || 21.8 || āhutān dīkṣitān brahmākartavyamidamādiśat | kāṇvīṃ mādhyandinīṃ śākhāṃ śākhāsvantarhite ubhe || 21.9 || adhīdhvaṃ mūlaśākhe te niṣekādīṃśca saṃskṛtīḥ | tābhyāmeva tvanuṣṭhadhvaṃ somayāgādikarmaca || 21.10 || bhagavaddhyānasahitaṃ tatsamārādhanātmakam | kartavyatvena vedoktamityevaṃ phalavarjitam || 21.11 || kṛṣīdhva miti kurvāṇaiḥ karmaniśreyasaṃ param | prāpyate'nena yuṣmābhirmantrasiddhāntavartmanā || 21.12 || pañcakālaṃ yathāśāstraṃ gṛhe vā mandire'pi vā | bhagavatpūjanaṃ kāryamadyaprabhṛti nānyathā || 21.13 || yūyaṃ bhāgavatāstena jātā bhagavadarcanāt | bhagavadbhaktikaraṇāt vaṃśajātāścaturmukha || 21.14 || nāmnā bhāgavatāssanto dīkṣayitvā yathāvidhi | yathoktaṃ karma kurvāṇāḥ prāpnuvanti paraṃ padam || 21.15 || śākhāntareṣu ye mantrāḥ pāpanāḥ paramarṣayaḥ | tānapyadhīdhvaṃ tairmantrai rarcayadhvamadhokṣajam || 21.16 || ātmarthayajanaṃ viṣṇoḥ kalpa te'bhyuda yāvaham | tathā parārthayajanaṃ grāme vā pattane pure || 21.17 || svagṛhe vā svatantre vā kāryaṃ bhāgavatairnaraiḥ | ātmanaśca pareṣāṃ ca tanni śreyasakṛdbhavet || 21.18 || abhāgavatavaṃśyaistu dīkṣitairapi mānavaiḥ | ātmārthameva yajanaṃ na parārthaṃ kadācana || 21.19 || parārthayajanaṃ teṣāṃ garhitaṃ viprasattamāḥ | abhāgavatavaṃśyopi dīkṣitaśśāstrāvartmanā || 21.20 || parārthayajanaṃ kuryādapi bhāgavatājñayā | bhagavāneva govindassākṣādbhāgavatasmsṛtaḥ || 21.21 || taṃ dṛṣṭvā vidyayā hīnamapi duṣkṛtakāriṇam | nirguṇaṃ guṇinaṃ vāpi pratyuttiṣṭhetkṛtāñjaliḥ || 21.22 || tānayācata viśvātmā maharṣiramitaujasaḥ | yaṣmābhiḥ kṣitilokeṣu kāryaṃ bhagavadarcanam || 21.23 || svārthaṃ parārthamatha vā kartavyaṃ mama śāsanāt | iti bruvāṇistān brahmā tatraivāntaradhīyata || 21.24 || dhyeyaṃ vastupravakṣyāmi mantrasiddhāntināṃ nṛṇām | dvibhujaṃ cedvāsudevaṃ rekhābhistalayoḥ kare || 21.25 || lāñcitaṃ śaṅkhacakrādyairdhyāyettaddviguṇaiḥ punaḥ | dvābhyāṃ karābhyāṃ bibhrāṇaṃ śaṅkhacakre gadāmbuje || 21.26 || mukhyābhyā mathavābhīti dānaṃ kaṭyavalambanam | ito'dhike bhujagame bahvāyudhadharaṃ harim || 21.27 || varṇena śyāmasubhagamathavā dhavaladyutim | śailādivastubhiḥ klṛptaṃ beraṃ cādipadesthitam || 21.28 || āsīnaṃ vā śayānāṃ vā garuḍārūḍhameva vā | dhyāyeyurarcayeyuśca trayūmantraistrayīvidaḥ || 21.29 || dhyāyetvāgamasiddhāntasthite lambabhujadvayam | vāsudevādayassarve nirākalpā nirāyudhāḥ || 21.30 || si tāssitāmbaradharāśca tvārassamadiṅmukhāḥ | ekaviṣṭaraniṣṭhāste śayanāsana varjitāḥ || 21.31 || devībhyāṃ parivāraiśca hīnā yogāsanena ca | samapradhānaṣāḍguṇya bhājo mantrairbalādibhiḥ || 21.32 || prabhavākhyakramātyūjyā nityaṃ kamalasambhava | balipradānarahitā nityotsavavivarjitāḥ || 21.33 || pavitrāropaṇasvāpa śayanotthāna varjitāḥ | kartavyatvena bhavane prāsāde vā caturmukha || 21.34 || kālye madhyandine'cchidrapañca kālaparāyaṇaiḥ | nirāśaiḥ karmasanyāsakāribhirdevapūjanam || 21.35 || balādimantrairacchidra paṃcakālaparāyaṇaiḥ | ekādhvanā niṣekādi saṃskāraiśca balādibhiḥ || 21.36 || caturṇāṃ brāhmaṇādīnāṃ vihitaṃ nayakarmaca | dvādaśākṣaravidyaiva teṣāṃ vidyā na ca trayī || 21.37 || na sāvitrī na mantronyassvādhyāyajapa karmaṇoḥ | bījaśaktyaṅgarahitamṛṣicchandovivarjitam || 21.38 || svarūpameva mantrasya japasvādhyāyakarmaṇoḥ | caturṇāmapi varṇānāṃ saṃjñāsteṣāṃ kramoditāḥ || 21.39 || bhāgo hi dvijamukhyasya saṃjñā vā vipravannṛpe | vaiśyasya vardhinī saṃjñā maudgalī vṛṣalasya ca || 21.40 || sarve samānāścatvāro gotrapravaravarjitāḥ | utkarṣo nāpakarṣaśca jātitasteṣu saṃmataḥ || 21.41 || phaleṣu nispṛhāssarve dvādaśākṣaracintakāḥ | mokṣaikaniścayā śśāvasūtakāśau cavarjitāḥ || 21.42 || nādhikāro sti sarvatra karṣaṇādiṣu karmasu | mohāttāni prayuñjānāḥ patantyakṛta buddhayaḥ || 21.43 || rājarāṣṭramanuṣyāṇāṃ yajamānasya sadmanaḥ | kṣayo bhavati tenai te na kuryuḥ karṣaṇādikam || 21.44 || yāceta mantrasiddhānte dīkṣitaṃ viprasattamam | pūjarthamātmano bimba pratiṣṭhākaraṇādiṣu || 21.45 || sopi bījādirahitaṃ dvādaśā kṣaravidyayā | kuryātpratiṣṭhāmācāryaḥ pūjārthaṃ mantravittamaḥ || 21.46 || ekāyana stutāṃ mūrtiṃ pratigṛhya samarcayet | arcanaṃ ca catusthsāne vārisragbimbavahniṣu || 21.47 || nādhikāro stimantreṣu bījaṣiṇḍapadādiṣu | caturṇāṃ maudgalādīnāṃ viduṣāṃ dvādaśākṣaram || 21.48 || prāṇānāmapi niryāṇe naspṛśennadahecchavam | putrapautrādirahitaṃ santyajetkāṣṭhavadbahiḥ || 21.49 || mūrtyantarārcanaṃ teṣāṃ pratyavāyāya kalpate | siddhāntāntaramārgeṇa sthāpitaṃ bimbamālaye || 21.50 || ajñānādatha vā mohādekāyanavidhānataḥ | arcayannāpadaṃ sarvāmāpnotīha paratra ca || 21.51 || pradakṣiṇapraṇāmādi rāddhāntenyatra kevalam | vihitaṃ nārcanaṃ kāryaṃ rājarāṣṭrakṣayāvaham || 21.52 || na dīkṣā naiva dehasya dahanādiviśodhanam | nāṅganyāsādi sakalaṃ neṣṭamekāyanādhvani || 21.53 || ekāyane praviṣṭānāṃ traividyānāmayaṃ kramaḥ | tantrasiddhāntamārgetu saṃpratyācāra ucyate || 21.54 || caturṇāmapi varṇānāmitareṣāṃ ca tadbhuvām | dīkṣāsamaiva sarveṣā mācārastantravartmanā || 21.55 || niṣekādiśca saṃskārasteṣāṃ tantroktavartmanā | tyaktvā trayīṃ tantrameva prapadya śaraṇaṃ sthitāḥ || 21.56 || sāntarālamanuṣṭhānaṃ paṃcakāloditaṃ tathā | yatastantrāntarabhuvāṃ nṛṇāṃ kamalasambhava || 21.57 || tatvasaṃhārajanane nyāsaśca karadehayoḥ | yogaviṣṭaraklṛptiśca navapadmaprakalpanam || 21.58 || mūrtayo navapadmeṣu tāsvadhiṣṭhānamadhyame | tāmīkṣantediśo vāpi mūrtayo'ṣṭau yathāyatham || 21.59 || yāṃ diśaṃ madhyamā mūrtirīkṣate saiśvarīmatā | yāṃ ca vā '' lokya puruṣassamārādhanakarmaṇi || 21.60 || āste'sau pauruṣī jñeyā prājāpatyāca vāsavī | yogaviṣṭarapādānāṃ dharmādīnāṃ prakalpane || 21.61 || athāntaḥ parivārāṇāṃ suparṇītanayasya ca | balipradānapīṭhasya gopurasya caturmukha || 21.62 || bāhyanāmapi cai teṣāṃ prācī syādaiśvarī harit | bāhyānāṃ parivārāṇāmanyeṣāṃ parikalpane || 21.63 || prājāpatyaiva dikprācī diksamūhe tu pauruṣī | prācyādikāṃ samāśritya parivāraprakalpanaṃ || 21.64 || dviṣaṭkākṣarapūrvāṇāṃ bījaśaktyaṅgasaṃyutam | ṛṣicchando vihīnaśca mantrāṇāṃ japa iṣyate || 21.65 || varṇānāmitareṣāṃ ca samamārādhanakramaḥ | savānāmapi mūrtīnāṃ mūrtyantaragaṇasya ca || 21.66 || prādurbhāvagaṇasyāpi varṇāstrīvyaktayo matāḥ | na dhvajārohaṇaṃ nāpi māsādyutsavasambhanaḥ || 21.67 || kevalaṃ śayanotthāne balihomādivarjitaḥ | prādakṣiṇyena gamanaṃ grāmādeḥ kautukotsavaḥ || 21.68 || naimittikaṃ catusthsāne svātantryeṇārcanaṃ hareḥ | cakrābjamaṇḍale kumbhe pratimāyāṃ ca pāvake || 21.69 || tantrāntare ca siddhānte saṃpratyācāra ucyate | trivaktaṃ vā caturvaktramadhikānanameva vā || 21.70 || yogapīṭhesthitaṃ devaṃ parivāraiśca sevitam | piṇḍamantraiḥ kalāmantrerbhījaśaktyaṅgasaṃyutaiḥ || 21.71 || ṛṣicchandovihīnaśca catvāro brāhmaṇādayaḥ | samarcayeyussarveṣāṃ niṣekādyakhilakriyāḥ || 21.72 || tantrāntaroktamārgeṇa kāryā traiyyātmanāpi ca | siddhāntanāṃ caturṇāṃ tu sāṅkaryaṃ vyavasāvaham || 21.73 || siddhānteṣu caturṣvekaṃ pūvain rnṛbhiranuṣṭhitam | tyaktvā samāśrayedanyaṃ naro bhavati kilbiṣī || 21.74 || tasmājjanmaprabhṛtyekarāddhāntaniyato bhavet | anyathā kulamātmānaṃ sarvaṃ nāśayati svayam || 21.75 || mantramaṇḍalakuṇḍādi kriyāmudropacārakaiḥ | yogaṃ nayati yo mohatsvasiddhāntoktavartmanā || 21.76 || sopi svakulajān sarvān paramātmanamañjasā | nayennirayamatyugraṃ puruṣān puruṣādhamaḥ…
<4.22>
brahmā kīdṛśī bhagavanmūdrā tadbhedāścāpi kīdṛśāḥ | prayojanaṃ vā kiṃ tasyāḥ kathyatāṃ tadaśeṣataḥ || 22.1 || aṅgulīracanā bhedo mudrāyasmātpradarśitāt | hiṃsakānāmaśeṣāṇāṃ mudaṃ drāvayati kṣaṇāt || 22.2 || tato mudrā nirasanaṃ teṣāṃ tasyāḥ prayojanam | prīṇanaṃ cāpi devānāṃ karmaṇā sopidarśitaḥ || 22.3 || prayoktavyaśca rahisi na bahirjanasaṃsadi | mantramaṇḍalamudrāṇāṃ guptireṣā sanātanī || 22.4 || gandhaliptau karau kṛtvā mudrādarśanamācaret | anāmi kāmadhyamayoḥ praveśyāṅguṣṭhamāyatam || 22.5 || vidhāya muṣṭiṃ hṛdaye nyaseddhṛdayamudrikā | saiṣā muṣṭimadho badhvā stāpayitvā ca mūrdhani || 22.6 || aṅguṣṭhāgreṇa hananaṃ tarjanyā śīrṣamudrikā | urdhvāṅguṣṭhaṃ dhṛḍhaṃ muṣṭiṃ badhvānyasyecchikhāpade || 22.7 || śikhāmudreyamuditā varmamudrātu kathyate | praveśyābhyantarāṃguṣṭaṃ badhvā muṣṭipraveśanam || 22.8 || unnamyakiñcidagre ca vitatāntena muṣṭinā | bhāvayedvarmaṇo bandhaṃ saiṣā kavacamudrikā || 22.9 || tarjanyaṃguṣṭhasirasi sphoṭayeccakravat smaran | dikṣu sarvāsu śeṣābhirmuṣṭiṃ badhvā caturmukha || 22.10 || saiṣāstramudrā vijñāyā śikhāmudrāmadhomukhīm | vinyanettāṃ bhruvormadhye netramudreyamīritā || 22.11 || ṣaḍaṅgamudrāsvetānu hastassarvatra dakṣiṇaḥ | kaniṣṭhāditribhirbadhvā muṣṭiṃ sāṅguṣṭhamunna tām || 22.12 || vidhāya tarjanīṃ tena bhrāmayedāśu cakravat | agni prākāramudreyaṃ tayaivātmābhirakṣaṇam || 22.13 || nābheradhastādvinyasya savyaṃ karatalaṃ punaḥ | uttānamitaraṃ tasya vinyaseduparī dṛśī || 22.14 || yogamudrā karatalaṃ savyaṃ nābheradhastataḥ | avāṅmukhaṃ tadupari savyekaratalaṃ punaḥ || 22.15 || samāṅguṣṭhaṃ viracayedyogasampuṭamudrikā | yogābhyāse ca tatvānāṃ saṃhārotpādanepi ca || 22.16 || mudrādvayamidaṃ brahmankathitaṃ yogināṃ hitam | yogasaṃpuṭa mudreyamuccitā ghaṭavatkṛtā || 22.17 || ūrdhvaṃ syātkumbhamudraiṣātayā snānaṃ samācaret | tarjanyā nāmikāgraṃ tu viṣṭayitvā krameṇa tat || 22.18 || tathāṅguṣṭhakaniṣṭhau tu jñeyā saṃhāramudrikā | tatvānāṃ sahṛtau caiva devatodvāsane tathā || 22.19 || eṣā mudrā prayoktavyā sarvakarmasu sarvadā | saṃhatābhi śca tisṛbhiraṅgulībhiścasaṃgatiḥ || 22.20 || vimuktatarjanī bhūyassṛṣṭi mudreti kīrtitā | āvāhane tatvasṛṣṭau mudraiṣā parikīrtitā || 22.21 || aṅguṣṭhatarjanībhyāṃ tu saṃyogastatvamudrikā | tatvanyasanakāle ca mudraiṣā parikīrtitā || 22.22 || jñānamudrā pi saivaiṣā syādajñānatamopahā | ūrdhvayoḥ karayormadhyaṃ madhyamābhyāṃ tu sspṛśet || 22.23 || uttānitau karau kṛdvā nyāsa mudrā nigadyate | devātmadehayormantraṃ nyāsamudreyamīritā || 22.24 || aṅguṣṭhābhyāṃ tu karayostarjanyorubhayorapi | madhyamābhyāṃ spṛśedanyāṃ vistṛtāni yathā tathā || 22.25 || japamudreti vijñeyā japakāle pradarśayet | aṅgulībhissamastābhirdakṣiṇetarahastayoḥ || 22.26 || saṃpuṭīkaraṇaṃ brahmamudrā saṃśabditā budhaiḥ | aṅguṣṭhe dve kaniṣṭhe dve tathāsyāttarjanī dvayo || 22.27 || sahayuktāgrataśśiṣṭā viṣṇumudreti kīrtitā | sā caiva śeṣitāṅguṣṭhāsamastena parasparam || 22.28 || ubhayāṅguṣṭhamudrā sā rudrasya kathitā tava | śrotre pidhāya pāṇibhyāṃ daṇḍapaddakṣiṇaṃ karam || 22.29 || prasārayedgurūṇāṃ tu abhivādanakarmaṇi | sarvahastāṅgulīssavyakarṇenyasya tathetaram || 22.30 || prasaredvighnarājasya mudrā vighnavināśinī | antastu tarjanīyugmaṃ saṃhatāṅguṣṭhakadvayam || 22.31 || mudrā bhāgavatī sāsyāt karayugmaṃ tu sampuṭe | kṛte varāhamudrā sāsarvasiddhikarī śubhā || 22.32 || gurupaṅktikrame brahman saiṣāmudrā pradarśitā | apasavye karatale saṃsmaredraktapaṅkajam || 22.33 || tanmadhye cintayedagniṃ trikoṇaṃ tesasāṃ nidhim | avāṅmukhaṃ karatalaṃ kṛtvā dravyopari nyaset || 22.34 || jñeyā dahanamudraiṣā dravyaśuddhi pradā sadā | savye karatale śvetapaṅkajaṃ ṣoḍaśacchadam || 22.35 || kalāṣoḍaśa saṃyuktaṃ śaśinaṃ paṅkajāsana | tanmadhyecintayitvātu srāvitaṃ cāmṛtaṃ smaret || 22.36 || tenāmṛtena tadbhasma kṣālitaṃ tūtthitaṃ smaret | āpyāyananya mudraiṣā kathitā kamalāsana || 22.37 || aṃguṣṭhe dve kaniṣṭhe dve tathāsyāttarjanī dvayoḥ | śiṣṭaṃ prasārayedbrahmannaṃgulāni karadvaye || 22.38 || madhyamāṃ dakṣiṇakare'nāmikāṃ ca tathetare | saṃhṛtya prasareccheṣaṃ karayorubhayorapi || 22.39 || jñeyā surabhimudrā sā yāga dravyaviśodhinī | hastābhyāmañjaliṃ kṛtvā īṣadvikasitaṃ sphuṭam || 22.40 || avāhanasya mudraiṣā darśanātsa nnidhiṃ bhajet | hṛdaye śirasi dvepi sampuṭāñjalirūrdhvāgā || 22.41 || praṇāmamudrāsājñeyā kṣipraṃ devaprasādinī | sā jñeyā vāsudevādimūrtināṃ kamalāsana || 22.42 || caturviṃśatimūrtīnāṃ mīnādīnāṃ tathaiva ca | mudraiṣā cā nyamūrtināṃ kathitā kamalāsana || 22.43 || prasāryakarajān sarvān maṇibandhau sametya tau | antaḥ praviśya cāṃguṣṭhau tayoḥ pṛṣṭhamanuspṛśet || 22.44 || prasārayetpadmamudrā māsane tu pradarśayet | śriyādīnāṃ ca sarvāsāṃ devīnāṃ caturāsana || 22.45 || proktā kamalamudrā sā sarvakāmaphalapradā | nibadhya dakṣiṇāṃguṣṭhaṃ vāmahastasya muṣṭigam || 22.46 || kṛtvā cāṃguṣṭhatarjinyau saṃyukte prasṛte same | triprastu dakṣiṇanyāsā badhnī yurmuṣṭimūrdhvagāḥ || 22.47 || śaṅkhamudreyamuditā jñānadā mokṣadā'cirāt | maṇibandhasamau hastau tiryaksaṃ bhrāmya ca kramāt || 22.48 || paryāyeṇa prayoktakyā cakramudrā mahodayā | muṣṭhiṃ kṛtvā tu hastābhyāmaṃguṣṭhau vinatāvubhau || 22.49 || madhyamāṃguliyugmaṃ tu ṛjumūrdhvaṃ prasārayet | śeṣābhiraṃgulībhistu bandhayeyuḥ parasparam || 22.50 || saṃśliṣṭau kūrparau dvau tu gadāmudreyamīritā | tarjanyagraṃ madhyamayā saṃspṛśe ccāpamudrikā || 22.51 || muṣṭiṃ kṛtvā vāmahasta maṃguṣṭhamṛjumūrdhvataḥ | apasavyakareṇai tadaṃguṣṭhaṃ tu bandhayet || 22.52 || prasārya dakṣiṇāṃguṣṭhaṃ jñeyā musalamudrikā | kaniṣṭhāṃgulipūrvaṃ tu saṃhṛtyāṃguṣṭhakena tu || 22.53 || nibadhya tarjanīṃ bhūyastadagraṃ natameva ca | khaḍgamudrā tusā jñeyā sarvaduṣṭabhayaṅkarī || 22.54 || hastābhyāṃ lambayedbrahmannaṃgulyagraiḥ parasparam | bandhayedvana mālā syādaṃguṣṭhau dvau tu saṃharet || 22.55 || ākhaṇḍalādidevānāṃ mudrā cāñjalisaṃjñitā | ubhau karatale pṛṣṭhau saṃśliṣṭau tu kaniṣṭhakau || 22.56 || bandhayettarjanīyugmaṃ prasarettuṇḍavatkramāt | aṃguṣṭhau dvau pādayugma madhastāllambayetkramat || 22.57 || madhyamānāmikābhyāṃ tu karayorubhayorapi | pakṣavaccalanaṃ kuryājjñayā garuḍamudrikā || 22.58 || kaniṣṭhāditrayaṃ brahman saṃhṛtyāguṣṭhakena ca | nibadhya tarjanīṃ bhūyo niṣvaksenasya mudrikā || 22.59 || prasārya karajān sarvān viralānūrdhvagāminaḥ | kṛtvāhastasya cāyāmaṃ tadagrān kuñcayetkramāt || 22.60 || phaṇiphaṇāgrasadṛśājñeyā'nantasya mudrikā | caṇḍādīnāṃ bha venmuṣṭimudraiṣā balimudrikā || 22.61 || aṅguṣṭhānāmikābhyāṃtu tathā syādastramudrikā | muṣṭimudrā tu muṣṭissyādaṃguṣṭhena tu veṣṭitā || 22.62 || jñānamudreti vijñeyā saiva muktakaniṣṭhikā | gandhamudreti vijñeyā vimuktānāmikā ca sā || 22.63 || puṣpamudreti vijñeyā vimuktā madhyamā tathā | madhyamāṅguṣṭhaśirasi saṅgatirhyagraparvaṇā || 22.64 || yajñopavītamudrā syādaṃguṣṭhena kaniṣṭhikā | ākalpamudrikā jñeyā viṣṇoḥ prītikarī śubhā || 22.65 || saṃhṛtāgrāṅgulīnāṃ tu kṛtvā vyatikarāṅgulīḥ | sahaivordhvīkṛtāṃguṣṭhau karābhyāṃ dhūpamudrikā || 22.66 || ūrdhvaṃtu madhyamāṃ kṛtvā saṃhṛtyāṃguṣṭhameva ca | tarjanyā nāmikābhyāṃ tu saṃhṛtya tu kaniṣṭhikām || 22.67 || tenaiva vāmahastena dakṣiṇena kṛtā tu yā | dīpamudreti sā proktā devadeva prayādhikā || 22.68 || anyeṣāmupacārāṇāṃ mudrā sa…
<4.23>
brahmā saṃjñābhedastu varṇānāṃ mantroddhārastu kīdṛśaḥ | prayojanaṃ vā kiṃ tasya kathyatāṃ tadaśeṣataḥ || 23.1 || śrībhagavān ahaṃ te kathayiṣyāmi śṛṇu sarvaṃ yathātatham | hrasvadīrghavibhāgena bhinnāḥ padmaja manmukhāt || 23.2 || akārādyāssvarā jātāḥ kramādanye'rdhamātṛkāḥ | kakārādyāśca cakrete nyasya pūjyāḥ pariṣkṛte || 23.3 || praśaste nirjane gupte bhūbhāge śobhane same | hastadvayena vistīrṇaṃ sthaṇḍilaṃ caturaśrakam || 23.4 || darpaṇodarasaṅkāśamunnataṃ caturaṅgulaiḥ | mṛdbhiḥ pidhāya suṣiraṃ gomayenopalipya ca || 23.5 || prokṣya cakraṃ vidhātavyaṃ ṣoḍaśārapariṣkṛtam | nābhinamisamāyuktaṃ candanakṣodarekhayā || 23.6 || tanmadhye chandasāmādirarabhūṣu svarā stathā | sparśākṣaraṃ nābhimadhye nemimadhye ca yādayaḥ || 23.7 || evaṃ nyasteṣu varṇeṣu dvādaśākṣaravidyayā | arghyādyaissakalairbhogairvarṇātmāsaṃ samarcayet || 23.8 || cakrasaṃsthitavarṇānāṃ nāmabhedaḥ pradarśyate | udgīthaśchandasāmādiḥ praṇavastāraka stathā || 23.9 || brahma ca brahmakośaśca vyāpī coṅkāra ityapi | nāmāni prathitānyaṣṭāvakāro viṣṇurucyate || 23.10 || oṅkārādiścāprameya ākāro madhusūdanaḥ | ādidevo gopanaśca syādikārastsrivikramaḥ || 23.11 || māyā bandhuśca rāmaśca kathyate tadanantaram | pañcabindurmahāmāyā vāmanassmaryate tathā || 23.12 || ukāro bhuvanāhvānaśśrīdharaścodaya stathā | ūkārāścordhvalokeśo hṛṣīkeśo guhālayaḥ || 23.13 || ṛkāra ṛtadhāmā ca padmanābhastathocyate | ṛkāraḥ pīṭhanāmā syādyogī dāmodara stathā || 23.14 || lṛkāraḥ keśavo goptā prajñādhāro maheśvaraḥ | lṛkāro dīrgha ghoṇaśca nārāyaṇasamāhvayaḥ || 23.15 || saṃprasāraṇanāmāsyādekāro mādhavāhvayaḥ | devadatto mṛgeśassyādaikāro godhanaḥ smṛtaḥ || 23.16 || govindho vīrasenaśca syādokāraścaturmukha | otadeho vāsudevo brahmasādhana ityapi || 23.17 || aukāra auṣadhāhvāna aurvassaṅkarṣaṇo manuḥ | aṃkāraḥ kapilākṣaśca pradyumno devatā smṛtaḥ || 23.18 || aḥkāraścāniruddhāhvaḥ kalānta ssargisaṃjñikaḥ | kakāraḥ kamalo brahmā karālaśśaṅkhinaḥsmṛtaḥ || 23.19 || khakāraḥ kharvadehaśca cakrī garuḍavāhanaḥ | gadadhvaṃsī gakāraśca gadī paṅcātmakassṛtaḥ || 23.20 || padmapāṇirśakārastu pañcātmā gajavāhanaḥ | ṅakāraśśārṅgapāṇiśca ekadaṃṣṭraḥ kapidhvajaḥ || 23.21 || vakratuṇḍaḥ khaḍgadharaścakāraḥ pretanāyakaḥ | chakāraśchalavidhvaṃsī svacchandaḥ kuṇḍalī smṛtaḥ || 23.22 || musalī janmahantā ca jakāraḥ kakubhaḥ smṛtaḥ | jhakārassāmavedātmā jhaṣāśī ca guvarṇabhāḥ || 23.23 || ñakāraścandradhavalaḥ pāśapāṇirbhṛguḥsmṛtaḥ | ṭakāro hṛdayā hlādī kheṭakī parvataḥ smṛtaḥ || 23.24 || ṭhakāraḥ kaustubho meghī tomaro dussahaḥ smṛtaḥ | ḍakāraḥ puṇḍarīkākṣo jhaṣo bhūmirvanālayaḥ || 23.25 || ḍhakāraḥ puṣpabhadrā ca dṛḍhakarmā pratardanaḥ | ṇakāro vanamālī syātpracaṇḍassumukhaḥ smṛtaḥ || 23.26 || ekanetra stakārasyādvairājo vijayaḥ smṛtaḥ | thakārassarva rodhaśca rasātmā supratiṣṭhitaḥ || 23.27 || dakāro vaidharo dṛṣṭiratri ssa tripurāntakaḥ | dhakāro dhanadaḥ puṇyassubhago mohanāśanaḥ || 23.28 || nakāro bhadrapāṇissyādvighneśo mānuṣeśvaraḥ | pakāraḥ pāpahananaḥ pavitraḥ paścimānavaḥ || 23.29 || pakāraḥ pullanayanaśśikhaṇḍī syādvikarmaṇaḥ | bakāro jṛmbhalo hrasvo matimān kālanemijit || 23.30 || bhallāyudho bhakāraśca subhadrassūkṣmalocanaḥ | makāro mandaro dakṣo mādhavī pāṭalakriyaḥ || 23.31 || yakāraḥ puruṣātmā syādvāyu śśaṅkhaścaturgatiḥ | reṣo'nalo mahājvālo viśvātmāsarvadāhakaḥ || 23.32 || lakāraḥpītavarṇābho mahendraḥ pulahaḥ smṛtaḥ | vakāro varuṇaḥ kumbhaḥ pīyūṣātmā sudhārasaḥ || 23.33 || śakāraśśubhado lakṣmīḥ śrīvatso vittavardhanaḥ | ṣakāraḥ krodharūpī syādugrātmā śatrusūdanaḥ || 23.34 || pūrṇacandraḥ kalātmā syāt sakāraśśuklasaṃjñitaḥ | dvādaśātmā hakārāssyāddīptimān bhāskaraḥ smṛtaḥ || 23.35 || lakāroḍuṇḍabho bhargo viṣkambho viṣamadhvaniḥ | kṣakāro garuḍo' nantaḥ kūṭo narahariḥsmṛtaḥ || 23.36 || anusvāro druvo binduryaṣṭiścandrārdha ucyate | svāhākāro hutāntaśca ṭaṭheti parikīrtitaḥ || 23.37 || namaskāro natirvarṇasaṃjñā ityādayaḥ smṛtāḥ | cakrasaṃsthitavarṇānāṃ devatā kathyate kramāt || 23.38 || sarveṣāmapi varṇānāmakāraḥ kāraṇaṃ yataḥ | sarvakāraṇarūpatvā dviṣṇustasyādhidevatā || 23.39 || ākārasya madhudveṣī syādikārastri vikramaḥ | īkāro vāmano devastathokāraśśriyaḥ patiḥ || 23.40 || ūkārasya pṛṣīkeśo varṇasya syādanantaram | padmanābhastvṛkārasya devo dāmodaro bhavet || 23.41 || ṝkārasya sthitaśśambhuḥ lṛkārasya ca devatā | nārāyaṇo'dhidevassyāt lṛkārasya caturmukha || 23.42 || mādhavo'nantarārṇasya govindo devatā bhavet | aikārasya tathārṇasya syādokārasya devatā || 23.43 || vāsudevastathārṇasya syādaukārasya devatā | saṅkarṣaṇa stathāṅkāro bhavetpradyumna devatā || 23.44 || aḥkārasyāniruddhassyāddevā itthaṃ kramādacām | devatāḥ kathitā brahmanhalāṃ saṃprati kathyate || 23.45 || kakārasya vidhirdevaḥ khakārasya sudarśanaḥ | gakārasya ghakārasya vāṇī śārṅgaśca devatā || 23.46 || ṅakārasya cakārasya devo nandaka iṣyate | chakārasya yamo devo jakārasya ca devatā || 23.47 || musalī syāt jhakārastu bhavedaṅkuśadaivataḥ | ñakārasya bhṛgurdevaḥ ṭakārasya mahīdharaḥ || 23.48 || meruḥ kaustubhadaivatyaḥ ṭhakāro ḍastu pārthivaḥ | ḍhakāro mātṛdaivatyoṇakāro vānamālikaḥ || 23.49 || takārasya tathā dṛṣṭiḥ thakāro rasadaivataḥ | atrirdakārasya bhaveddhakārasya dhaneśvaraḥ || 23.50 || lambhodaro nakārasya pakārasya pavitrakaḥ | śikhaṇḍavān phakārasya bakārasya tu devatā || 23.51 || jṛmbalo bhākṣarasya syātsubhadro devatā tathā | dakṣo makārasya bhavedyakāro vāyudaivataḥ || 23.52 || dhūmadhvajassyādrephasya lakārasya divaspatiḥ | pakāro varuṇeśāna śśakāro mādhidaivataḥ || 23.53 || krodhākāraḥ ṣakārasya sakāraścandradaivataḥ | sahasrāṃśurhakārasya lakāro bhargadaivataḥ || 23.54 || narasiṃhaḥ kṣakārasya kathitāḥ kādidevatāḥ | varṇānāṃ cakraniṣṭhānāṃ nāmānyapi ca devatāḥ || 23.55 || yo vetti tasya phaladā mantriṇa ścaturānana | yāvato yasya varṇasya yannakṣatraṃ vidurbudhāḥ || 23.56 || sa ca tāvāṃ statra varṇaḥ kramādiha nigadyate | ādyaṃ vinā svaraṃ varṇāvādyāvāśvayujau smṛtau || 23.57 || ikārasyāpi bharaṇī kṛttikātrayamuttaram | catuṣṭayamṛkārādi rohiṇye kamatheḍakā || 23.58 || raudramapyeka mevasyātpunarvasvordvayaṃ matam | dvayameva tathā pauṣṇamādyantaṃ vā matā ntare || 23.59 || kādiṣu prathamaṃ puṣyaṃ dvayaṃ sārpaṃ dvayaṃ maghā | ekamaryamaṇaṃ yugmaṃ bhargadaivatamucyate || 23.60 || yugmameva tu sāvitraṃ dvayamindrādhidaivatam | ekaṃ niṣṭyā viśākhe dve trayaṃ maitramanantaram || 23.61 || aindramekaṃ trayaṃ mūlaṃ pūrvamāṣāḍhamekakam | āṣāḍhamuttaraṃ cairamekamevābhijinmatam || 23.62 || dvayaṃ vaiṣṇavamekaṃ tu śraviṣṭhā śatatārakam | ekameva trayaṃ śādi varṇassyādaja ekapāt || 23.63 || ahi rbudhnyastrayo varṇā iti varṇeṣu tārakāḥ | ādau catuṣṭayaṃ meṣo varṇānāmṛṣabhastrikam || 23.64 || tathaiva mithunaṃ yugmaṃ kulīraṃ mṛgarāṭ tathā | śiṣṭadvayaṃ śādayastu kanyā kuḥ prathamaṃ tulā || 23.65 || cavargo vṛścikaścāpaḥ ṭavargassadbhirucyate | tavargo makaraḥ kumbhaḥ pavargo' ntyasya yādayaḥ || 23.66 || nakṣatraṃ yatsādhakasya mantrasyādyakṣarasya yat | naranāryorivatayoryogāyogau parīkṣayet || 23.67 || catuṣpadaṃ likhitvorvāṃ tatrākārādi nikṣipet | yarsmipade sādhakasya nāmādyarṇalipi stathā || 23.68 || tatraiva cedbhavesmantra syādhyaṃ varṇamavasthitam | tatsiddhaṃ syāddvitīye tu sādhyaṃ vidyādanantare || 23.69 || pade siddhaṃ turīye tu vaiparītyāya kalpate | siddhe siddhaṃ jāpādyaistu sādhye sādhyaṃ susiddhake || 23.70 || adhitamātre mahate phalāya bhavati dhruvam | pade tu vairiṇassyācchellipiradhyetṛnāśanam || 23.71 || ānuguṇyaṃ parīkṣyeta nimittāni parīkṣya ca | sādhakassādhayenmantraṃ devasya kuṭilā gatiḥ || 23.72 || caturṣumūlamantreṣu nānuguṇyaṃ parīkṣayet | tāramaṣṭākṣaraṃ caiva dvādaśākṣarameva ca || 23.73 || viṣṇugāyatryapi tathā catvāraḥ prathame matāḥ | dvātriṃśadakṣarādhikye mālāmantrādaśādikhe || 23.74 || bījamantrāssamasteṣu pūrve vārdhikyaśobhanāḥ | itare yauvvane tadvatsarve bālyepi śobhanāḥ || 23.75 || strīvunna pumiti traidhaṃ bhajantemantrajātayaḥ | saṃstyānamantrāssvāhāntā manontāstu napuṃsakāḥ || 23.76 || śeṣāḥ puruṣamantrāssyuriti trividhamīritam | uccāṭane ca vaśye ca vidveṣe kṣudrakarmasu || 23.77 || striyaḥ praśastā nabliṅgāḥ karmasvanyatra pūjitāḥ | pulliṅgeṣu tu mantreṣu diṅmītraṃ kiñciducyate || 23.78 || phaḍantā maraṇādyarthe śastā bhūtādyupadrave | huṅkārāntāḥ praśasyante vauṣaḍantāstu te punaḥ || 23.79 || āpyāyane niyujyante dharmakāmārthamūrtiṣu | caturthyantāḥ praśasyante omantāssarvasiddhidāḥ || 23.80 || sarvamantrāssarvaphalā guruvaktradyadi śrutāḥ | yadṛcchayā śruto mantraścha nnenāthacchalena vā || 23.81 || patrekṣito vā vyarthassyātpratyutānarthadaḥ smṛtaḥ | ekassusādhito mantrojapahomāditarpaṇaiḥ || 23.82 || sa sādhakasya sarvārthaṃ prasūte nātra saṃśayaḥ | samyaksiddhaikamantrasya nāsādhyamihā kiñcana || 23.83 || kiṃpunarbahapo yasya kā kathā harireva saḥ | kuśeṣu kṛṣṇatvaci vā brusyāmekāntabhūmiṣu || 23.84 || prāgādidiṅmukho bhūtvā na tu yāmyamukhaḥ kvacit | upaviṣṭo japenmantraṃ sapavitrakaraśśuciḥ || 23.85 || dhṛtordhvapuṇḍraracano nānyāṃ vā camudīrayan | guruṃ praṇamya prathamaṃ praṇavapramukhaṃ japet || 23.86 || devatāyatane nadyā śaile sāgararodhasi | vane vā tīrthadeśe vānyagrodhāśvatthayoradhaḥ || 23.87 || anyatra vā śucau deśe kuṭiṃ kṛtvārabheta saḥ | anaśnan vāyubhakṣo vā yadvābbhakṣo jalāplutaḥ || 23.88 || jīrṇaparṇāśanaśśākabhojano vā phalāni vā | vakvāni mūlānyathavā bhuñjāno lavaṇaṃ vinā || 23.89 || yapoṣṭi kālājadugdha bhikṣāhoro jitendriyaḥ | pūrvaṃ pūrvaṃ praśastaṃ syādaśanīyaṃ viśodhanam || 23.90 || mantrasya devatā tāratithivāreṣu sādhakaiḥ | dvādaśyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ vā grahaṇe karma śasyate || 23.91 || viśeṣayajanaṃ kurvan cakrābje japamācaret | śikhī vā jaṭilo vāpi valkalājinakarpaṭaḥ || 23.92 || trisandhyaṃ snānaniyatastailābhyaṅgavivarjitaḥ | yāvaduktaṃ kṛtayuge mantrābhyasanamiṣyate || 23.93 || tretādiṣu triṣu proktaṃ dviguṇaṃ triguṇaṃ kramāt | caturguṇaṃ paraṃ vāpi tato mantraphalecchayā || 23.94 || sarvasiddhikaromantrassiddhassiddhyetkriyāvaśāt | kriyādhigamyate śāstrācchāstraṃ deśikapūruṣāt || 23.95 || mananaṃ sarvasatvānāṃ trāṇaṃ saṃsārasāgarāt | mananatrāṇasaṃyogānmantra ityucyate budhaiḥ || 23.96 || athavā gopanīyatvā ddhātormantrayate rayaṃ | rapratyayāntaḥ pulliṅgastathāyaṃ lokavedayoḥ || 23.97 || mantreṇa sthāpyate devo mantreṇaiva visṛjyate | jñānānāṃ tatparaṃ jñānaṃ mantrajñānaṃ vidurbudhāḥ || 23.98 || aihikāmuṣmikaṃ sarvaṃ mantreṇaiva prasidhyati | chando mantrākṣare yattaddarśanādṛṣirucyate || 23.99 || darśanaṃ ca phalasyāhurnapunarmantradarśanāt | devatā mantra phaladā mantreṇa pratipāditā || 23.100 || bruvanti nilayaṃ kṣetraṃ tatvaṃ tatvamidaṃ viduḥ | mantrākṣarāṇāṃ śuklādi mantrabhedaḥ prakīrtitaḥ || 23.101 || mūlamantrādimantrāṇāṃ sādhanaṃ śuṇu sāṃpratam | vidhāya yāgayogyāni puṣpāmūlaphalāni ca || 23.102 || śākādīni tu varjyāni varjayeditarāṇi tu | gṛhṇāyā dyāni varjyāni tāni vakṣyāmi padmaja || 23.103 || ugragandhānyagandhāni durgandhāni parityajet | vastrārkaparṇaspṛṣṭāni puṣpāṇyāradhane hareḥ || 23.104 || unmatta śālmalī bījapūra dhuttūrikājapāḥ | bandhūkīsitakoraṇḍadroṇakanyāparājitāḥ || 23.105 || hṛhatyagastyakūśmāṇḍapaṭolyāragvathaissamāḥ | mirguṇḍī damayantī ca riṃśukaṃ pāribhadrakam || 23.106 || kośātakī prāyāluśca tapasvī girimallikā | nimbavyāghrī karañjaśvī ṣaṇḍa pāṣaṇḍapaṭṭikā || 23.107 || vibhītakiṅkiṇyaṅkolalāṅgalīśaṅkhapuṣpiṇī | nāraṅganandikāvarta valli kākṣīrikādiṣu || 23.108 || puṣpāṇi varjanīyāni śākānyapi tathā śṛṇu | śṛṅgāṣṭaṃ grañjanaṃ śigrū nālikā suniṣaṇṇakam || 23.109 || saubhāñjanaṃ raktabhāṣpaṃ grāmabhāṣpaṃ trikaṇṭakam | droṇapatraṃ liliṅgā ca taṇḍulīyaṃ tapasvinī || 23.110 || kośātakī ca varjyāni mūleṣu tyājyamucyate | chatrākaṃ laśunaṃ tālaphalamūle paṭolikā || 23.111 || bimbakumbhāṇḍanāraṅgaphalāni parivarjiyet | bilvodumbara bhodhyarka vaṭapatreṣu bhojanam || 23.112 || varjayetsādhako yatnādālasyaṃ dīrghacintanam | vivādanidrā nirvedanigrahānugrahaṃstyajet || 23.113 || padmākṣamālāṃ grīvāyāṃ lambayetsādhakaśśuciḥ | dhārayedraimayaṃ cakraṃ sarvavighnopaśāntaye || 23.114 || japakāle'thavā cakraṃ śaṅkhākṛti yathātathā | śārṅgakhaḍgadākāraṃ lāñchanaṃ lāñchayetsudhīḥ || 23.115 || śarīrāvayave bāhvorvakṣobhuvi caturmukha | cakrādipañcābhijñāna lakṣitāṅgapariṣkṛtam || 23.116 || puruṣaṃ dūrato dṛṣṭvā bhūtādyā bhayavihvalāḥ | vidravanti tathā ghorāḥ pāpiṣṭhāḥ kṣaṇamātrataḥ || 23.117 || vinaśyanti tathā puṇyapuñjāni praviśantica | praṇamanti tathā devā devarṣipravarāstathā || 23.118 || akṛtyamapi kurvāṇo bhujjāno vā yata stataḥ | pāpairnalipyate dehī cakrādyāyudhalāñcitaḥ || 23.119 || havyaṃ kavyaṃ ca dātavyaṃ tasmai taddānamakṣayam | avidhāya śikhābandhamakṛtvā tilakaṃ mṛdā || 23.120 || adhārayaṃstato darbhān sūtrai ranupavītayan | kurvan karmāṇi na phalaṃ prāpnuyātpuruṣādhamaḥ || 23.121 || nagno muktaśikhābandho vāsasā vāvakuṇṭhitaḥ | gacchan śayānaḥ pralapan na japātphalamaśnute || 23.122 || japenmaunaṃ samāsthāya sahasaṃbhāṣaṇādikam | pratilomādibhirnīcairnakuryānmantravittamaḥ || 23.123 || vyāharedapi kāryārthaṃ nityaṃ tadgatamānasaḥ | dvādaśākṣara manyaṃ vā japedakṣaralakṣakam || 23.124 || tadardhaṃ juhuyā dagnau homaśālāṃ prakalpayet | dhūmanirgamanopetāṃ caturaśrāṃ manoramām || 23.125 || tanmadhye kalpayetkuṇḍamāhutyasuguṇaṃ śubham | vṛttaṃ vā caturaśraṃ vā mekhalātrayasaṃyutam || 23.126 || yo nimanmṛtsnayā brahman mānaṃ kuṇḍanya kathyate | ayutāhutiparyante home hastapramāṇakam || 23.127 || dvihastaṃ niyute kuṇḍaṃ trihastaṃ prayute tathā | śaṅkuhome caturhastaṃ mahāśaṅkā tu ṣaṭkaram || 23.128 || nṛndāhutau saptahastaṃ mahābṛnde'ṣṭahastakam | arbude navahastaṃ syānnirbude daśahastakam || 23.129 || ekādaśakaraṃ kharve parārdhe dvādaśāyatam | trayodaśakaraṃ madhye antaketu caturdaśa || 23.130 || padme karāḥ pañcadaśa mahāpadme tu ṣoḍaśa | samudre viṃśatikara moghe dvāviṃśatiḥ smṛtam || 23.131 || ito'dhikāhutividhau caturviṃśatihastakam | prasaṅgāducyate saṅkhyā tāṃ krameṇāvadhāraya || 23.132 || ekaṃ daśa śataṃ saṅkhyā sahasramayutaṃ tathā | niyutaṃ prayutaṃ śaṅkurmahāśaṅkustataḥ param || 23.133 || nṛndaṃ tathā mahābṛndamarbudaṃ nyarbudaṃ tathā | kharvaṃ parārdhaṃ madhyānte padmaṃ tanmahadādikam || 23.134 || padmottaraṃ samudraṃ syānmahaughaṃ cottamaṃ bhavet | ekamārabhya gaṇayetprayutāntaṃ yathākramam || 23.135 || sthānāt sthānaṃ daśaguṇaṃ vardhayetprayutāvadhi | lakṣasya niyutaṃ saṅkhyā koṭiḥ prayutamiṣyate || 23.136 || śaṅkumārabhyagaṇayenmahaughāntaṃ kramādyathā | śataṃ koṭisahasrāṇāṃ śaṅkusaṅkhyā nigadyate || 23.137 || tathaiva syānmahāśaṅkurevaṃ bṛndaṃ prakīrtitam | tadvadeva mahānṛnda mevamevārbudaṃ smṛtam || 23.138 || itthaṃ nirbudamākhyātamevaṃ kharvamudāhṛtam | evameva parārdhaṃ syānmadhyamitthaṃ caturmukha || 23.139 || evamantaṃ tathā padmaṃ mahāpadmaṃ tathaiva ca | sāgarapralayāvevaṃ saṅkhyā nāsti tataḥ param || 23.140 || yatra kāṣṭhaṃ tu tacchrotraṃ yatra dhūmastu nāsikā | yatrālpajvalanaṃ netraṃ yatra bhasmatu tacchiraḥ || 23.141 || yatra samyake sthitā darbhāstatra keśāḥ prakīrtitāḥ | yatra prajvilito vahnirjihvātatraiva kīrtitā || 23.142 || agnikarṇe hutī rogo nāsikāyāṃ manovyathā | cakṣuṣornidhanaṃ kuryātkeśe dāridryaṃ bhavet || 23.143 || hutaṃ śirasi pāpaṃ syāttasmājjihvāsu homayet | samidbhiryājñiyairbījairghṛtairgavyaistathā dalaiḥ || 23.144 || sumanobhissamiddhegnau juhuyādagnimāharet | āraṇyaṃ maṇijaṃ lauhaṃ kuṇḍamadhye pariṣkṛte || 23.145 || yogāsanaṃ cāgni madhye kalpayitvā hariṃ punaḥ | āvāhayettatra devaṃ homāntaṃ tatra sannidhim || 23.146 || prārthayeta samārādhya homaṃ kuryāddine dise | āhomakālamaryādaṃ rakṣedagnimatandritaḥ || 23.147 || na dahetparidhīn darbhānupastīrṇānupakrame | evamuktena mārgeṇa japato mantramuttamam || 23.148 || sādhakasya punassvāpnāssambhavantyavicāritāḥ | ācāryaṃ pratimāṃ devīṃ pūjopakaraṇāni ca | vipraṃ bhāgavataṃ bhūpaṃ chatracāmaradantinaḥ || 23.150 || siṃhāsanamapāṃ kumbhaṃ purṇaṃ kanyāṃ madhūjanam | dīpaṃ śaṅkhaṃ tathā yānāṃ śrīvatsaṃ pādukāṃ tathā || 23.151 || śvetaṃ vastraṃ ca mālyaṃ ca candanaṃ bhūṣaṇāni ca | ratnāni kāhalādīni pāyasaṃ dadhi pālikāḥ || 23.152 || tāṃbūlaṃ pustakaṃ ghaṇṭāṃ taṇḍulānavagāhanam | samudrataraṇaṃ śailārohaṇaṃ drumarohaṇam || 23.153 || bhūmilābhaṃ mṛdāṃ lābhaṃ taṭakupādidarśanam | prāṅkukhoduṅgukho vāpi yātrāṃ kurvan svayaṃ yadi || 23.154 || vimānadarśanaṃ viṣṇordīptau ca śaśibhāskarau | nakṣatrāṇi gṛhādīni jyotsāṃ ca dhruvamaṇḍalam || 23.155 || dīptamagniṃ vedaghoṣaṃ siddhavidyādharādikam | devatā samitiṃ caiva paśyan mūlaphalāni ca || 23.156 || apūpādīni bhakṣyāṇi kuśayaṣṭiṃ kamaṇḍalam | yajñopavītaṃ pātrāṇi sruksruvādīni lokayan || 23.157 || akṣamālāmeva mādyaiśśubhaissvapnairvinirdiśet | mantrasiddhiṃ bahu mukhāṃ dussvapnāścāpyaśobhanāḥ || 23.158 || kathyante muṇḍitaissārdhaṃ sambhāṣā sahavartanam | svayaṃ muṇḍaśchabhibhrāṇo jīrṇaṃ nīlaṃ tathāmbaram || 23.159 || kanthāṃ kartāṃ tathā nīlāṃ puṣpamālāṃ ca mūrdhani | gardabhārohaṇaṃ bhagnayānādhiṣṭhānamabjaja || 23.160 || chinnacchatradharo vāpi mahiṣārohaṇaṃ tathā | dakṣiṇābhimukho gacchannuṣṭravāhādirohaṇam || 23.161 || daṣṭaśca kapibhirdehe sṛgālairvā vṛkai stathā | karṇapādaśiraśchedo dantānāṃ padanaṃ tathā || 23.162 || navavastradharaḥ pīḍā bhaḍaiḥ pāśena bandhanam | vidhavāliṅganaṃ nīcaiḥ pāṣaṇḍaiḥ pratilomajaiḥ || 23.163 || vartanaṃ gopurādīnāṃ patanaṃ śākhināmapi | turagārohaṇaṃ bhuktirbauddhādyālayasevanam || 23.164 || madirāpāyibhiḥ pāparogibhiḥkitavaissaha | vartanaṃ dīpanirvāpaṃ devānāmutsavaṃ tathā || 23.165 || grāmādidāho bhakṣyāṇāṃ phalādīnāṃ ca bhakṣaṇam | madhūcchiṣṭaṃ praticchāyā yātrā yuddhodyamaṃ bhaṭaiḥ || 23.166 || abhyaṅgaṃ tailalābhaṃ ca marīcaṃ lavaṇaṃ tathā | lokayannevamādīni svapne śāntiṃ samācaret || 23.167 || japahomādibhirvidvān jāgrataḥ pratyayāṃ stathā | vakṣyāmi sādhakasyāgre jātānabyudayāvahān || 23.168 || pyūmni devagāṇānnemi ghoṣaṃ dundubhinisvanam | sddaissaṃbhāṣaṇaṃ cāpi vimānānāṃ ca darśanam || 23.169 || bhūtapretapiśācādidaśarnaṃ bhūtale tathā | homakāle ca saptārcistriśikhaḥ paridṛśyate || 23.170 || śuddhasphaṭekasaṅkāśo dakṣiṇāvarta śobhitaḥ | divyagandhopalambhaśca chatrabimbadhvajādikam || 23.171 || śaṅkhadundubhivīṇādivedaghoṣaśrutiṃ punaḥ | pūrṇāhutividhau siddhiliṅgānyetāni lokayet || 23.172 || sādhakastāni liṅgāni kathayenna guruṃ vinā | homānte bhojayedvidvān vaiṣṇavān dvādaśāvarān || 23.173 || yāvacca mantrasiddhissyāttāvadārādhayeddharim | kāmanānuguṇākāraṃ dārvādyaiḥ parikalpitam || 23.174 || dine dine japenmantraṃ juhvānnagnauyathāpuram | praṇavasya śṛṇu brahman puraścaraṇamuttamam || 23.175 || bījaṃ sāṅgaṃ samuddhāraṃ yathāvadavadhāraya | aprameyādimudayaṃ madhye mandarapaścimam || 23.176 || samāhṛtya tryavayavaṃ trīn varṇān vācakaṃ hareḥ | plutodāttasvaraṃ brahman cakramadhye pratiṣṭhitam || 23.177 || uddharedbījamasyādyaṃ pratīkaṃ daṇḍa śekharam | vaiṣṇavaṃ daṇḍayedvaiṣā śaktissarvatra kīrtitā || 23.178 || bījaśaktyaṅgahīnā ye mantryāsusai nirarthakāḥ | tasmātsāṅgaṃ bījayuktaṃ śaktiyuktaṃ phalapradam || 23.179 || bījaṃ śaktiśca kathitā śrūyatāmaṅgajātayaḥ | ṛṣirbrahmasya chandastu devī gāyatra mucyate || 23.180 || pratipādyaḥ parodevaḥ paramātmā sa devatā | buddhistatvaṃ paraṃ pyūma kṣetraṃ varṇassitacchaviḥ || 23.181 || jñānaṃ balaṃ tathāvīryamaiśvaryaṃ tejasā saha | śaktirete caturthyantā namassvāhā vaṣaṭ tathā || 23.182 || huṃ phaṭ vauṣaṭ kramādeta davasānāśśubhāvahāḥ | aṅgāni hṛdayādyeṣu ṣaṭsu sthāneṣu mantriṇā || 23.183 || prayojyāni prayukteṣu mantrassāṅgaḥ kṛto bhavet | dehe karatale caiva sthāneṣu dvādaśasvapi || 23.184 || dvādaśākṣaravannyāsaḥ praṇavassphaṭika prabhaḥ | nyāne namontassvāhntū japapūjāhutiṣvapi || 23.185 || vaśye cākarṣaṇavidau ucchāṭe huṅkṛtirbhavet | māraṇe phaṭkṛtirjñeyā stambha vidveṣamohane || 23.186 || satiṃ vināṅgamanyassyāddharmādau natireva sā | śākayāvakabhaikṣāśī japellakṣatrayaṃ śuciḥ || 23.187 || tadardhaṃ tarpaṇe saṅkhyā tadardhaṃ homakarmaṇi | homānte siddhayastasya jāyante yāvadīpsitāḥ || 23.188 || aihikāmuṣmikaṃ sarvaṃ praṇavāllabhyate' khilam | praṇavānna paromantraḥ kaścidasti caturmukha || 23.189 || śāntipuṣṭyabhicāreṣu kimanyaissiddhivarṇanaiḥ | antyakāle ca māṃ dhyātvā vyāharan praṇavākṣaram || 23.190 || yogābhyā sokta vidhinā jīvamārohayeddhṛdi | bhruvo rmadhye tatojīvaṃ tato brahma bilaṃ tataḥ || 23.191 || uccaran praṇavaṃ bhitvā bhilaṃ brahmaṇi līyate | yāvatprāṇavinirmokamabhyasyetpraṇavākṣaram || 23.192 || sarvapāpavinirimukto yāti brahma sanātanam | proktaḥ praṇavakalpaste samāsena caturmukha || 23.193 || iti śrīpāñcarātre mahopaniṣadi pādmasaṃhitāyāṃ caryāpāde mātṛkādyartha trayavarṇanaṃ nāma trayoviṃśo’dhyāyaḥ |
<4.24>
śrībhagavān dvādaśākṣaramantrasya śṛṇu kalpaṃ caturmukha | mātṛkācakramabhyarcya dvādaśārṇaṃ samuddharet || 24.1 || praṇavaṃ paramātmānaṃ bhadrapāṇimanantaram | viṣṇuṃ dakṣaṃ cotadehaṃ subhadraṃ gadinaṃ sudhām || 24.2 || viṣṇuśīrṣaṃ trayaṃ paścāddvijayaṃ saṃprasāraṇam | varuṇaṃ cādidevāntaṃ śuklaṃ bhuvanaśīrṣakam || 24.3 || atriṃ mādhava nāmānaṃ pīyūṣaṃ madhusūdanam | vāyuṃ tathā'prameyāntameva muddhāraṇakramaḥ || 24.4 || bījamasya dvādaśātmā daṇḍaśīrṣa udāhṛtaḥ | kruddho mahāṃśca vīraścha dyussahasraṃ ca tejasā || 24.5 || ulkāntāṣṣaḍime śabdāścaturthyantāḥ svadhāntakāḥ | aṅgāni hṛdayādau syuḥ sthāne bījākṣarāṇi vā || 24.6 || parasya vāsudevasya bījāṅgaṃ samudāhṛtam | dīptimānūrdhvalokānto bījaṃ daṇḍaśśiraḥ smṛtam || 24.7 || dīptimān kumbhasaṃyogo madhusūdanamastakaḥ | sa eva vāmanaśirā hṛṣīkeśaśirāstathā || 24.8 || vīrasenaśirāścāpi kalkyantoyamanantaraḥ | ṣaṣṭhamaurvaśiraḥ proktamaṅgāni kramaśaḥ punaḥ || 24.9 || satyantadaṇḍaśirasassarve vibhavapūrvake | vāsudeve prayoktavyā hṛdayā diṣu ṣaṭsvapi || 24.10 || vyūhapūrve tu bimbasyādviṣṇuḥ kuṇḍādi pūrvavat | aṅgaṃ yadvā dvādaśārṇaḥ pūrve ṣaṭ hṛdayādayaḥ || 24.11 || ṣaṇṇāmarṇāṣṣaḍapare tunda guhyabhujoravaḥ | jaṅghāpādamiti sthāneṣvete yojyāḥ kramādbudhaiḥ || 24.12 || ṛṣiśca devatā cobhe vāsudevaḥ smṛtastriṣu | chandhaśca devī gāyatrī varṇaśśvetaścaturmukha || 24.13 || tatvaṃ buddhiḥ paraṃ vyoma kṣetraṃ mantrasya śabditam | pratyakṣaramṛṣiśchando devatā varṇavistaraḥ || 24.14 || tatvaṃ kṣetraṃ kramātsarvamucyate dvādaśasvapi | parameṣṭhī sanandaśca sanakaśca prajāpatiḥ || 24.15 || bhṛgussanatkumāraśca pulastyaḥ pulahaḥ kratuḥ | marīciratryaṅgirasau kathitā ṛṣayaḥ kramāt || 24.16 || chandāṃsi devī gāyatrī bastaḥ kṣetraṃ prajāpatiḥ | triṣṭuppaṅtkiśca bṛhatī virāṭ bastastrivṛtsakaḥ || 24.17 || uṣṇikca śrīriti brahman varṇeṣu dvādaśasvapi | viṣṇvādyā māsapā devāstatvāni kathayāmite || 24.18 || cijjīvaḥ prakṛtirbuddhirmana ssatvādayo guṇāḥ | vyomāgnirmarutaścāpi varṇānāṃ tatvamīritam || 24.19 || kṣetrāṇi paramavyoma vāyuragnirjalaṃ tathā | satyaṃ tapo janaścaiva maha ssvargaṃ bhuva stathā || 24.20 || bhūmiḥ pātālametāni krameṇa kathitāni te | āmnādidhāmāśreyāṃśaṃ gopanāntaṃ sadaṇḍakam || 24.21 || satyantaṃ pāpahananaṃ viṣṇvantaṃ bhānumān param | śaṅkhamādyakṣara paraṃ kamalaṃ madhusūdanam || 24.22 || pulahaṃ cāparaṃ vighnunāyakaṃ pītasūdanau | ekanetraṃ mandaraṃ ca viṣṇvantaṃ bhatrahastakam || 24.23 || saṃprasāraṇamūrdhānamuddharenmantravittamaḥ | agniprakāramantroyaṃ kathitaḥ kamalāsana || 24.24 || durgā gaṇapatistārkṣya kṣetrapālapadāni tu | caturthyantāni natyanta praṇavādīni mintriṇā || 24.25 || koṇadikṣu prayujyerannārabhyāgnerdiśaṃ kramāt | bhāṣyaṃ ca dvādaśārṇasya pravakṣyāmi yathātatham || 24.26 || omityuktaṃ paraṃ brahma sukharūpaṃ dhruvaṃ sthiram | vyāpitvāttasya vācyasya vācakaṃ sarvagaṃ smṛtam || 24.27 || puruṣārthaṃ paraissarvaissurāsuramahirṣibhiḥ | namyante deva devaikassa evaikaḥ parāyaṇam || 24.28 || ādau sṛjati bhūtāni bhūtānugrahakāmyayā | paripālanamapyeṣa karoti bahumūrtibhiḥ || 24.29 || viśramārthaṃ ca bhūtānāṃ saṃharatyakhilaṃ jagat | gatirgatimatāmanyā vāsudevānna vidyate || 24.30 || saṃharatyātmabhūtāni punassṛjati māyāyā | deve jāgrati jāgarti supte svapiti cākhilam || 24.31 || carācaramidaṃ kṛtsnaṃ bhūtagrāmaṃ caturvidham | dvādaśākṣaravācyo sau tasya māhātmyamāśritaḥ || 24.32 || brahmabhūyaṃ gato brahmā devabhūyaṃ ca devatāḥ | ṛṣayaśca marīcyādyā munayassanakādayaḥ || 24.33 || mantramāhatmyamāśritya jagmuḥ padamanuttamam | gatvā gatvā nivartante candrasūryādayo grahāḥ || 24.34 || na kadāpi nivartante dvādaśākṣaracintakāḥ | kiṃ tasya yajñaiḥ kiṃtīrthaiḥ kiṃ viśrāṇanakarmabhiḥ || 24.35 || kiṃ vratairyasya mantro'sau dvādaśākṣaralakṣaṇaḥ | sarva yatnena puruṣastanmantra nirato bhavet || 24.36 || saṃsāra bhayabhīrūṇāṃ mokṣaikaphalakāminām | muktaye paramopāyo mantro'yaṃ dvādaśākṣaraḥ || 24.37 || devadānavagandharva yakṣavidyādharādayaḥ | praṇamanti mahātmānaṃ dvādaśākṣaracintakam || 24.38 || yasya rāṣṭre mahīpasyamantrī vasatinirbhayaḥ | tadrāṣṭre dhanadhānyādi samṛddhaṃ vardhate'dhikam || 24.39 || bhūtāni ca palāyante grahaścaiva bhayaṅkārāḥ | rāṣṭrādrājapurādrājñassakāśācca nipīḍitāḥ || 24.40 || na phalaṃ śakyate vaktuṃ kārtsnye kamalāsana | caturmukhamukhaissarverdirvairvarṣaśatairapi || 24.41 || śarīraśuddhaye pūrvaṃ puraścaraṇamācaret | śarīraṃ mantrasaṃskārapuraścaraṇamiṣyate || 24.42 || brāhmaṇāṃ stanmayān pūrvamāhuya dvādaśāvarān | bhojayitvā tataścakramaṇḍale devamarcayet || 24.43 || vijñāpya deśikaḥ pūrvamanujñātassahāyavān | āśrame yatra munibhiḥ pūrvamācaritaṃ tapaḥ || 24.44 || siddhamantraphale tatra vāsudevaniketane | paścimadvāri vānyatra pūrvoktasthānabhūmiṣu || 24.45 || sthāne'bhirucite puṣpasamitkuśaphalodakaiḥ | samupete yathoktānāṃ sampannābhimatāśanaḥ || 24.46 || bhikṣānnabhoktā bhaktānāṃ tanmayānāṃ gṛheṣu vā | brahmacārī gṛhastho vā sādhayeddvādaśākṣaram || 24.47 || vaikhānaso vā niyatastapasyabhirataśsuciḥ | bhikṣānnabhugbhrahmacārī śākakandaphalāśanaḥ || 24.48 || gṛhasthaścetsvayaṃ pākaṃ putrairvā bhāryayā'pi vā | śiṣyeṇa vā pācitānnaṃ nivedya haraye'grataḥ || 24.49 || vaiśvadevādikarmānte bhojayitvā'tithīnapi | śiṣyaṃ bhāryāṃ tathā putraṃ toṣayitvā yathātatham || 24.50 || svayaṃ bhuñjīta vidhivatpaścādannamakutsayan | putradārasamāyuktojapedvaikhānasaśśuciḥ || 24.51 || viyuktaḥ putradārādyairathavā niyatasthsitaḥ | añjasaiva svayaṃ pakvamannamadyānmi tāśanaḥ || 24.52 || sarveṣāṃ kāyaśudhyarthamādau cāndrāyaṇaṃ caret | pādodakaṃ pañcagavyaṃ brahmakūrcajalaṃ tathā || 24.53 || pītvā kāyaviśudhyarthaṃ puraścaraṇa mācaret | ārambhaḥ karmaṇāṃ māsi mārga śīrṣe'tha śobhane || 24.54 || caitre māsi site pakṣe brahmanne kādaśītithau | upoṣya pūrvaṃ cakrābje pratimāyāmathāpi vā || 24.55 || kūrce vā sthaṇḍile vāpi yathābhirucite pade | dvādaśyāṃ homaparyantamarcayitvā janārdanam || 24.56 || puṣpaiḥ patrairbrahmacaryanirato deśakālavit | saṅkalpya kālaniyamaṃ vratādinimayaṃ tathā || 24.57 || nityaṃ triṣavaṇasnānamadhaśśayanameva ca | śayanaṃ vā kuśe parṇe mṛgacarmaṇi vābjaja || 24.58 || saṅkalpya māṣaṃ tailaṃ ca kṣāraṃ lavaṇameva ca | kālālaṃ bhojanaṃ kāṃsye divā svāpādi varjayet || 24.59 || dehaśuddhiṃ purā kṛtvā mantrajāpo'kṣamālayā | ādyantayorbījayutaṃ tathaiva praṇavānvitam || 24.60 || japakāle japenmantraṃ na drutaṃ na vilambitam | lakṣīkṛtyācyutaṃ dhyāye ttadadhīnamanogatiḥ || 24.61 || dhyānaṃ vakṣyāmi sarvāghanāśanaṃ kamālāsana | caturbhujamudārāṅgaṃ sarvalakṣaṇalakṣitam || 24.62 || śuddhasphaṭika varṇābhayayutendusamaprabham | cāruhāsaṃ sutāmroṣṭhaṃ karṇāntāyatalocanam || 24.63 || nirdhūta padmarāgābhaṃ dantacchavisuśobhitam | mahoraskaṃ mahābāhuṃ prasannendunibhānanam || 24.64 || subhrūlalāṭaṃ sumukhaṃ ghanakuñcitamūrdhajam | taṭicchatasahasrābhaṃ pītanirmalavāsasam || 24.65 || pāṇipādatalāmbhojaṃ puṇḍarīkāyatekṣaṇam | śrīvatsāṅkaṃ kirīṭādisarvābharaṇabhūṣitam || 24.66 || padma cakra gadāśaṅkhadhāriṇaṃ kaustubhorasam | divyagandhaviliptāṅgaṃ divyamālāvibhūṣitam || 24.67 || śeṣāhibhoge vipule sukhāsīnaṃ caturmukha | śrībhūmisahitaṃ devaṃ lalāṭe śvetamṛtsnayā || 24.68 || dhṛtordhvapuṇḍratilakaṃ maṇḍitaṃ caṇḍabhānubhiḥ | niyutairayutaiścandrairvidyutkālāgnikoṭibhiḥ || 24.69 || samavetairivaikatra tejaḥ puñjairvisarpibhiḥ | bhrājamānaṃ durālokaṃ dehamaṇḍalanirgataiḥ || 24.70 || bhāsayastaṃ jagatsarvaṃ dhyāyetprakṣīṇakalmaṣaḥ | ārādhya devaṃ santhyāyāmaparasyāṃ yathāvidhi || 24.71 || visṛjya punarutthāyadhautapādakaraśśuciḥ | ācamya vāgyato mantraṃ japetsamyaksamāhitaḥ || 24.72 || yāvadbrāhmamuhūrtasya prādurbhāvastataḥ param | snātvā yathoktaṃ sandhyāyāmanuṣṭhāya yathāvidhi || 24.73 || ārādhya devamārghyādyairupacārai ryathoditaiḥ | japenmantraṃ śarīrasya sthitimuktaiḥ phalārthibhiḥ || 24.74 || dvādaśārṇaṃ japedevaṃ viśuddhenāntarātmanā | lakṣaṃ dvādaśa tanyārdhaṃ tarpaṇaṃ vāribhiḥ smṛtam || 24.75 || tadarthaṃ juhuyādagnau sādhakassamidādibhiḥ | caturviṃśatilakṣeṇa mantrajāpena kiṅkarāḥ || 24.76 || siddhavidyādharāssarve pātāle divi vā bhuvi | yathābhirucite deśe duṣprāpe sādhakaṃ dvijam || 24.77 || nayantastatra niyataṃ devante paricāriṇaḥ | ṣaṭtriṃśallakṣajāpena devabhūyaṃ samaśnute || 24.78 || atilakṣajāpena homaistāvanmitairvaset | maharloke sukhaṃ śaśvattatratyairabhipūjitaḥ || 24.79 || koṭilakṣeṇa jāpena prāpnu yādaṇimādikān | guṇān janāhvaye loke vasettat sthaissupūjitaḥ || 24.80 || mahābṛndaśatenaiva japahomaistathā vaset | tapoloke mahāpadmajapahomena tāvatā || 24.81 || satye vasati deveśaṃ śrībhūmisahitaṃ harim | dṛṣṭvā nirāmayastatra vasettalloravāsibhiḥ || 24.82 || mahoghaiśśatajāpena tāvadāhutisaṅkhyāyā | sākṣātkurvan vusudevaṃ tanmayo bhavati dhruvam || 24.83 || kimebhirbahubhiḥ proktaiḥ padaṃ yadyadabhīpsitam | tattadāpnoti puruṣassamārādhanakarmabhiḥ || 24.84 || vaśyākarṣaṇamukhyāni japahomādikarmabhiḥ | phalāni citrarūpāṇi darśayetsādhakassvayam || 24.85 || pātāle divi vā bhūmau ye bhogā bhuvi durlabhāḥ | tānavāpnoti puruṣaḥ puruṣottamapūjayā || 24.86 || kāmopabhogavaimukhyaṃ mantriṇaḥ kāryamucyate | mokṣaikaphaladaṃ dhāma dakṣiṇadvāramuttamam || 24.87 || siddhāyatanamāsādya tatra devaṃ caturvidham | manuṣyanirmitaṃ cārṣaṃ daivaṃ rūpaṃ madhudviṣaḥ || 24.88 || svayaṃ vyaktaṃ samārādhya mokṣakāmassamāhitaḥ | sālokyādicaturbhedāṃ muktimāpnotyasaṃśayam || 24.89 || sālokyaṃ mānuṣādārṣātsāmīpyaṃ devanirmitāt | sārūpyaṃ tulyamāpnoti svayaṃ vyaktādanukramāt || 24.90 || prāsāda dvāri cādhmāte śaṅkhe tasya mahādhvaniḥ | śūyate yatra taṃ deśaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ mānuṣālaye || 24.91 || tato dviguṇamārṣetu triguṇaṃ devanirmite | caturguṇaṃ svayaṃ vyakte deśe vṛddhimanukramāt || 24.92 || brahmacaryaparo bhūtvā kuśaśāyī jitendriyaḥ | mumukṣamāṇastanmantraṃ lakṣajāpena sidhyati || 24.93 || yuñjīta yogavidhinā hṛdayāmbhoruhāsane | karṇikāyāṃ sukhāsīnaṃ śuddhasphaṭikavarcasam || 24.94 || caturbhujamudārāṅgaṃ jyotirmaṇḍalamadhyagam | aṅguṣṭhamātraṃ puruṣaṃ dhyātvā bhogairyathākramam || 24.95 || abhyarcayennirmalena manasā susamāhitaḥ | yogābhyāsabalenaiva guṇotkarṣaḥ prajāyate || 24.96 || candrārkāgnimayaṃ bījaṃ kavimaṇṭalasannibham | tatassūkṣmataraṃ bimbaṃ rājamudgakamaprabham || 24.97 || taṃ sarvamantrānākramya sthitaṃ vidyādvicakṣaṇaḥ | tatastu rājakābhījapramāṇaṃ cintayetkramāt || 24.98 || atpādakamathānyābhiryasyānte nāda āśritaḥ | taṃ vilīya samutpannamaśvavālapramāṇakam || 24.99 || yasya gacchati te pyomni pyoma cāgacchate hṛdi | tato vicintayetsūkṣmā māśvavālapramāṇakām || 24.100 || brahmanāḍīmanenāśu paśyati dhyānanevanāt | tato'ṅgaromamātraṃ tu bījavālaṃ samantataḥ || 24.101 || dhyāyenni yamamāsthāya brahmanāḍīprakāśakam | evaṃ dhyāyannimaṃ piṇḍaṃ paripakvaṃ parityajet || 24.102 || parijñāya purā piṇḍaṃ pākalakṣaṇamuttamam | niruddhasandhimātraṃ ca kṛtvā deha samīraṇam || 24.103 || muktvā tadbrahmarandhreṇa utkrāntikaraṇena ca | dhyātvā parityaje ddhehaṃ nityābhyāsarato yadi || 24.104 || sa brahma paramāpnoti vāsudevākhyamavyayam | taile tailaṃ ghṛte sarpiḥ kṣīre kṣīraṃ jale jalam || 24.105 || tadvanna bhedo gṛhyeta jīvātma paramātmanoḥ | taptaloho yathā toyaṃ līnaṃ naiva prajāyate || 24.106 || agnidagdhāni bījāni nārohanti yathā punaḥ | tadvannajāyate bhūyojīvātmā kamalāsana || 24.107 || sārūpyaṃ bhagavadrūpaprāptissadbhi rudāhṛtā | sāmīpyaṃ sannidau sevā devasya paricaryayā || 24.108 || sālokyaṃ ca tadākhyātaṃ loke vaikuṇṭhasaṃjñite | tadīye nitya vāso'yaṃ punarāvṛttivarjite || 24.109 || brahmā śrotumicchāmi bhagavan dehapātasya lakṣaṇam | saṅkṣepatastu bhagavan vayorgatinirodhanam || 24.110 || śrībhagavān yuktāhāravihārasya kriyāsaktasya padmaja | yuktassvāpnāvabhodhasya yogayuktasya sarvadā || 24.111 || vivartate sadā śabdo hṛdgato dundhubhisvanaḥ | sparśaṃ na śītaṃ nāpyuṣṇaṃ vijānāti tvagindriyam || 24.112 || bhruvormadhye yadā jyotirdvādaśānte vyavasthitam | pratyastameti vai śīghraṃ na codayati vaipunaḥ || 24.113 || na jānāti samādhistho hārdamabjaṃ yadāntare | pariśuṣyati gātrasthaṃ śoṇitaṃ śleṣmalakṣaṇam || 24.114 || na vetti pārthivaṃ gandhaṃ na bāhyābhyantare yadā | piṇḍastadā praboddhavyaḥ kāle naiva cireṇa tu || 24.115 || pṛthivyāṃ saṃsthitaṃ caiva dhāraṇāyāṃ samāhitaḥ | na vetti śabdaṃ prāguktaṃ pañcamātpañcame kṣaṇe || 24.116 || sthitassamedhā bhāhyetu śītoṣṇe na ca vindati | pa teddinacatuṣkeṇa piṇḍastatkalite kṣaṇe || 24.117 || rūpadhyānaṃ samāsādya pūrvoktavidhinā yadi | na bhāti hṛdayākāśe bahirvā jyotiṣāṃ patiḥ || 24.118 || piṇḍapāto hyavaśyaṃ syāt jñātvāriṣṭaiḥ puroditaiḥ | tṛtīye'hni caturvaktasarvametattadā kṣaṇe || 24.119 || samādau yadi vāyavye yogī samyakpravartate | na vetti paramahlādaṃ tṛṣitaḥ parikampate || 24.120 || dinadvayena piṇḍasya pātosya dvitayakṣaṇe | sthito gaganabhāge tu prāguktavidhinā yadi || 24.121 || na vetti vidhinā gandhaṃ tadbāhye tu śubhāśubham | tatraivaikadine vātha lakṣaṇe prathame kṣaṇe || 24.122 || dhyātvaiva vidhinā samyagyogī dhyānaikamānasaḥ | mayi sannārpitamanā vyāharan dvādaśākṣaram || 24.123 || svayamutkramate piṇḍādyāyādyāganiketanam | śeṣāsane sukhāsīnaṃ vai kuṇṭhe maṇimaṇḍape || 24.124 || aṣṭabāhuṃ viśālākṣamaṣṭāyudhadharaṃ harim | śrībhūmisahitaṃ devaṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitam || 24.125 || caturbhujaṃ vā vumena hantenāliṅgya paṅkajām | aṣṭau vārastriyastasya vālavyajanapāṇayaḥ || 24.126 || tiṣṭhanti paritaḥ paścācchaṅkhādyāyudhadhāriṇaḥ | sevante puruṣāstasmādbahi stiṣṭhanti mūrtayaḥ || 24.127 || caturviṃśati saṅkhyākāstato mitrādimūrtayaḥ | pakṣīndraviṣvaksenābhyāṃ kumudādigaṇaistathā || 24.128 || mahābhāgavatāstatra dvādaśākṣaracintakāḥ | sevante maṇḍape nityaṃ punarāvṛtti varjitāḥ || 24.129 || iha yatkarma kurvāṇā viṣṇorārādhanātmakam | mucyante yogamāsthāya puruṣāḥ paramaṃ padam || 24.130 || prāpyapi tattatkurvāṇā sevante puruṣottamam | athavāpiṇḍapatanaṃ vijñāya prāgudīritaiḥ || 24.131 || nimittairaihikairbhogaissṛjantaḥ pṛthivīkṣitaḥ | piṇḍāntaramupāyena viśanti kamalāsana || 24.132 || yena taṃ kathayāmyadya śrūyatāṃ sādaraṃ vacaḥ | varapiṇḍaṃ navaṃ śuddhaṃ madhyame vayasi sthitam || 24.133 || sarvalakṣaṇasaṃpannaṃ pāparogabahiṣkṛtam | brāhmaṇasya śarīraṃ vā bāhujasyāthavā tanum || 24.134 || ūrdhvavaktraṃ dīrghapādamekānte śāyayecchavam | tatpādapārśve śāyīta badhvā yogāsanaṃ tataḥ || 24.135 || abhyasyedyogamekāgro yathāpūrvaṃ caturmukha | sa jīvaṃ nābhicakrasthaṃ bhramantaṃ bhāskaraprabham || 24.136 || haṃsākāraṃ valarkṣābhamiḍayā piṅgalena vā | haṃsarūpaṃ samāsthāya nirgataṃ nāsikāpuṭāt || 24.137 || khagavadyāti gaganaṃ sārdhaṃ prāṇasamīraṇaiḥ | tālaṃ hastāvadhiṃ daṇḍaṃ kośaṃ yojanameva ca || 24.138 || gatvā gatvā nivartante yojanāni caturmukha | nāsikāpuṭarandhreṇa nābhicakraṃ praveśayet || 24.139 || abhyasya nityamaniśaṃ yogī yogamatandritaḥ | nirgamayya svakāddehānnāsikārandhravartmanā || 24.140 || ātmānaṃ parakīyena nāsikābilavartmanā | parapiṇḍaṃ svadehasya vinipāte praveśayet || 24.141 || nābhicakraṃ praviśyātha nāḍīṣu vicaretsukham | sarvatra yogī tatrastho yuññānaḥ pūrvavatsadā || 24.142 || draḍhimne tatra vapuṣastatra sthitvā ciraṃ sukham | tasyāpi pātamālocya piṇḍe'nyatra niveśayet || 24.143 || ityetatkadhikaṃ brahman parapiṇḍapraveśanam | siddhayo mūlamantrasya samāsātkathitāstava || 24.144 || mūlamantra iti proktassākṣāddevasya vācakaḥ | prasūyate mantralatāṃ prasūtimaṇimādikām || 24.145 || kiṃ punardharma kāmārthī siddhiṃ kamalasambhava | nāsādhyamasti mantreṇa dvādaśākṣararūpiṇā || 24.146 || sarvalokeṣu sarvatra satyametadbravīmite | nāsmātparataro mantro vidyate sarvakāmadaḥ || 24.147 || rahasya metatkathitaṃ mantramāhātmyamakṣayam | ayamevāṣṭamūrtināmadhikaścaturakṣaraiḥ || 24.148 || amunā ṣoḍaśārṇena caturviṃśatimūrtayaḥ | ārādhanīyā bhogaścellabhyate durlabho mahān || 24.149 || mantratantraṃ yathāpūrvamuddṛtya dvādaśākṣaram | akṣarāṇi ca catvāri varṇacakrātsamuddharet || 24.150 || guhālaye parikrāntaṃ bhāskaraṃ daṇḍaśekham | dvipaṭkākṣaravaccāṅgamasyāpi caturāsana || 24.151 || mūrtiṣvaṣṭāsu yo dhyātā ṛṣirmantrasya niścitaḥ | chandaśca devī gāyatraṃ vāsudevo'dhidaivatam || 24.152 || adhikārṇasamaṣṭessyā dvarṇassphaṭikasannibhaḥ | kṣetraṃ ca paramapyūma tatvaṃ dhīḥ pūrva mīritā || 24.153 || śiṣṭārṇakānāṃ dyumaṇirvāsudevo nṛkesarī | manobhavaścaturṇāṃ syādadhidaivatakalpanā || 24.154 || japennamo'ntaṃ pūjāyāmubhayorhomakarmaṇi | svāhāyāṃ viramedvauṣaḍantamāpyāyane tathā || 24.155 || māraṇe tu phaḍantassyādevamanyatra yojayet | nyāso mūrdhnilalāṭe ca dṛśośśravasi ca kramāt || 24.156 || nāsikāpuṭayo rvaktre galakūpe tathā hṛdi | nābhideśe rahasye ca tathorpūrjaṅgha yorapi || 24.157 || kāryānurūpaṃ sapṛṣṭyādivyasanaṃ sarvakarmanu | ārādhanaṃ sarvasiddhikāraṇaṃ tacca kathyate || 24.158 || tejasāṃ nidhimaṣṭāraṃ sudarśanamanuttamam | cintayitvā caturvavaktrapūrvasyāṃ diśi vedhasam || 24.159 || saṅkarṣaṇaṃ dakṣiṇasyāṃ pradyumnaṃ diśi cāppateḥ | aniruddhamudīcīne koṇadikṣu śriyādayaḥ || 24.160 || devyaścatasro madhye ca vāsudevaṃ jagadgurum | arghyādibhissamārādhya mantraṃ ṣoḍaśalakṣakam || 24.161 || japan hutvāgnimudakaistarpayitvā yathāvidhi | evaṃ prasādhito mantraḥ puruṣārthāṃścaturvidhān || 24.162 || sādhayetpuruṣārtheṣu yo yenāvāptumiṣyate | sa sarpū'vāpyate brahman kimanyairativi staraiḥ || 24.163 || yadi brahmapade brahmannabhilāṣā pravartate | brāhmīṃ mūrtiṃ yajettāsu dhyātvā'nanyamanūgatiḥ || 24.164 || grīṣme māsi sthito bhūmyāṃ pādaṅguṣṭhena padmaja | pādamasyaṃ samuddhṛtya bāhū cotkṣipya niścalaḥ || 24.165 || varṣāsu parṇaśālāyāṃ bahiśśaradi śaiśire | hemantre triṣu caiteṣu vasante'gniṣu pañcasu || 24.166 || madhyastho mantrajāpassyāditthaṃ syātpratihāyanam | upāṃśu pravaro vyaktānmanasaḥ pravarastataḥ || 24.167 || vighnanti devatāstasya tapaḥ karma sudaścaram | padahāniṃ samāśaṅkya gandharvapramukhai stadā || 24.168 || apsarobhirvilobhyainaṃ nṛttavāditragītibhiḥ | tasmāt sthiramatirbhūtvā japan siddhimapāpnuyāt || 24.169 || pratyakṣaṃ yāti bhagavān triviṣṭapapatissvayam | brahmatvaṃ vā tadanyadvā prayacchati phalaṃ mahat || 24.170 || mūrtīnāmitarāsāṃ ca padaṃ yadyabhilaṣyate | mūrtiṃ tāṃ tāmabhidhyāyan japenmantraṃ ca pūrvavat || 24.171 || labhate tatprasādeva svaṃ svaṃ padamanuttamam | mantreṇānena mukhyena sādhakassādhayetphalam || 24.172 || aihikāmuṣmikaṃ tattānnātra kāryā vicāraṇā | brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyo vāpi vaiśyo vā japamācaret || 24.173 || jape'dhikāro nānyasya mantrarāṭ svayamuttamaḥ | iti śrīpāñcarātre mahopaniṣadi pādmasaṃhitāyāṃ caryāpāde dvādaśākṣarakalpo nāma caturviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ |
<4.25>
brahmā aṣṭākṣarasya mantrasya mahimānamanuttamam | śusrūṣitamatamathacchando viśeṣaṃ sarṣidaivatam || 25.1 || phalaṃ tanmantra jāpasya rūpaṃ vā kīdṛśaṃ matam | devatā sādhanaṃ cāpi madana grahakāmyayā || 25.2 || brūhi sarvamaśeṣeṇa mahyaṃ śuśrūṣave'cyuta | śrībhagavān aṣṭākṣarasya mantrasya phalāni na hi śakyate || 25.3 || vaktuṃ varṣaśatenāpi teṣāṃ diṅmātramucyate | dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāmekāntaphaladaṃ śubham || 25.4 || siddhayo bahudhā japturmantraṃ coditasajñyayā | acintanīyo mahimā devasyeva madhudviṣaḥ || 25.5 || śucau vivikte vijane sarvadoṣavivarjite | varṇacakraṃ samālikhya bhūmāvarghyādisādhanaiḥ || 25.6 || abhyarcyaca yathānyāyaṃ tato varṇān samuddharet | udgīthamādau vighṇeśaḥ prayojyastadanantaram || 25.7 || brahmāsādhanasaṃyukto mandarassyādanantaram | ādidevo vrato bhadrabāhuḥpaśpādudīritaḥ || 25.8 || vahnirgopanasaṃvītaśśvapano viṣṇuśīrṣakaḥ | vanamālī tato yojyo madhusūdanasaṃyutaḥ || 25.9 || praṇavādiśiro vāyuriti varṇakramoditaḥ | bījaṃ viṣṇuramasvārassāmarthyaṃ kathitaṃ punaḥ || 25.10 || aṅgāni ṣaḍdviṣaṭkasya mantrasyeva vidurbudhāḥ | chandaśca devī gāyatramantaryāmī munassmṛtaḥ || 25.11 || devo nārāyaṇassākṣāddaivataṃ kṣetramīritam | paramavyoma buddhissyāttatvaṃ varṇassita stathā || 25.12 || pratyakṣaramṛṣirbrahman gautamaḥ prathamassmṛtaḥ | bharadvājo viśvāmitro jamadagniranantaram || 25.13 || vasiṣṭhaḥ kāśyapaḥ paśpā datrisyātkumbhasambhavaḥ | chāndāṃsi gāyatryādīni virāḍavasitāni ca || 25.14 || dharodhruvaśca somaśca āpaścāgnirjalādhipaḥ | pratyūṣaśca prabhātaśca devāḥ pratyakṣaraṃ tathā || 25.15 || ākāśaṃ paramaṃ kṣetramakṣarasyāvasānataḥ | satyādi lokāssaptasyuḥ prātilomyena bhūmayaḥ || 25.16 || akṣarāṇāṃ pṛthivyantāssaptānāṃ sapta padmaja | agnirbhūrvāyurākāśaṃ sūryo dyauratha candramāḥ || 25.17 || nakṣatrāṇi tathā rāśirete tatvānyanukramāt | niruktamasya mantrasya kathayāmi yathātatham || 25.18 || aviḥ kvibanto vyāptyarthaḥsmaryate kartṛsādhanaḥ | oṃkāravarṇavyatyāsassyādakārasya padmaja || 25.19 || makāravarṇāvyatyāso vakārasyāpyayantvidam | antarbahiśca yatsarvaṃ vyāpnoti tadudīryate || 25.20 || athavā tantusantānaṃ vṛttervātha bhaviṣyati | ṭeśca lopo vakārasya prasāraṇamataḥparam || 25.21 || pūrvatvaṃ copasargeṇa syādantaścādguṇaḥ kṛtaḥ | yasminnotamidaṃ sarvaṃ tadevamabhidhīyate || 25.22 || avate rakṣaṇārthatvā daṭi lepe ca vartate | vakārasyopadhāyāśca dvayo rūḍhāgamaḥsmṛtaḥ || 25.23 || guṇe ca rūpaṃ yatsarvaṃ trāyate tatparaṃ param | abhidheyamitiproktā niruktiḥ praṇavasya sā || 25.24 || samyate deva evaika steṣāmekaṃ parāyaṇam | naro devaḥ parassraṣṭā sargādau pāthasāmatha || 25.25 || tasmānnā rāṇi pāthāṃsi tānyevāyanamucyate | devasya hetoścāmuṣmānnārāyaṇa samāhvayaḥ || 25.26 || nārāvā'yanamāvāsaḥ puruṣasya madhudviṣaḥ | aṇpratyayaḥ prakṛtyarthe tato vāsasamāhvayaḥ || 25.27 || evaṃ mantramimaṃ labdhvā samyaggurumukhāttataḥ | guruśuśrūṣaṇaparassarva mandrāṇi sādhayet || 25.28 || brahmacarye sthito maunī medhyāhārāśano pratī | aśanīyāni medhyāni pakṣāmi khṛṇu tānyapi || 25.29 || payoyāvakaśākāmbaphalamūlāni saktavaḥ | ādyaṃ kuśodakaṃ medhyaṃ dadhi bhikṣānnameva ca || 25.30 || sādhane mandrajāpasya śṛṇu kālaṃ yathoditam | mūrgaśīrṣe śubhe māsi dvādaśyāṃ candravardhane || 25.31 || arādhya parayā bhaktyā nārāyaṇamananyadhīḥ | cākrābjamaṇḍale devaṃ dyāye devaṃ samāhitaḥ || 25.32 || caturbhāhumudāraṅgaṃ cakrādyāyudha sevitam | kālameghapratīkāśaṃ padma patrāyatekṣaṇam || 25.33 || pītāmbaradharaṃ saumyaṃ prasannendunibhāvanam | cāruhāsaṃ sutāmroṣṭhaṃ ratnojvalitakuṇḍalam || 25.34 || subhrā lalāṭaṃ sumukhaṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitam | lalāṭatilakaṃ saumyaṃ dīpavacchvetamṛtsnayā || 25.35 || dhṛtordhvapuṇḍratilakaṃ maṇḍitaṃ caṇḍabhānunā | sphuratkaṭakakeyūrahārakaustubhabhūṣitam || 25.36 || sphuradbhāskaravarṇābhaṃ śobhitaṃ vanamālayā | pradyotanasahasrābhabhūṣaṇai rapi bhūṣitam || 25.37 || divya candanaliptāṅgaṃ divyamālyavibhūṣitam | śrībhūmibhyāṃ sukhāsīnaṃ svarṇasiṃhāsane śubhe || 25.38 || dhyātvaivaṃ devadeveśaṃ mantrājāpa paro bhavet | sukhāsīno yathākālaṃ śucirbhūtvā samāhitaḥ || 25.39 || mantraṃ japejjagannāthaṃ samārādhya dine dine | japellakṣāṣṭakaṃ proktaṃ tadardhaṃ tilatarpaṇam || 25.40 || tadardhaṃ juhuyādagnau tatassidhyati mantrarāṭ | atha saṃsādhite mantreṇa svapne jāharaṇe tathā || 25.41 || siddhiliṅgāni mantrasya mantrī paśyati santatam | tatassiddhena mantreṇa sādhayeddharmamuttamam || 25.42 || athamantravarāddharmasādhanaṃ yo'bhivāñcati | yaḥ pitṛṇāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ tarpaṇaṃ mantravittamaḥ || 25.43 || ṛṇatrayādvinirmuktiṃ sarvasmādabhivāñcati | upoṣya sa śucirbhūtvā kumbhecakrābjamaṇḍale || 25.44 || āvāhya devamārādhya samyagarghyādisādhanaiḥ | gohiraṇyādibhirdravyaistitaiścaiva kuśodakaiḥ || 25.45 || dattairmantrajapairyuktaḥ prāpayellokamakṣayam | patṛn mantraprāsāna narakasthānapi kṣaṇāt || 25.46 || ato'nyallupta piṇḍānāṃ patṛṇāṃ tṛptikāraṇam | vidhiṃ vakṣyāmi kalyāṇaṃ caturvaktra yathātatham || 25.47 || upoṣya mantravitpūrvaṃ pūrvedyussu samāhitaḥ | pañcamyāṃ māghamāsasya maṇḍalaṃ cakrapaṅkajam || 25.48 || arcayitvā tatastasya madhye devaṃ jagadgurum | yajeta kṛsarānnena homaṃ tenaiva kalpayet || 25.49 || samidājyatitānāpi mantreṇāṣṭottaraṃ śatam | pitrādi nāma saṃkīrtya tārayeti padānvitam || 25.50 || prācīnāvitiko bhūtvā homānte dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ | dakṣiṇāgrān kuśān bhūmāpāstīrya dhyānamāsthitaḥ || 25.51 || dhvātvā nārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ tarpayecca tilodakaiḥ | tadakṣayaṃ jalaṃ dattaṃ pitṛṇāṃ tṛptimāvahet || 25.52 || tarpayitvā sadācārān brāhmaṇān bhagavanmayān | bhojayetṣaḍrasopetaṃ bhojanaṃ dvādaśāvarān || 25.53 || dadyāttebhyastilānvastrān gohiraṇyādikaṃ tataḥ | tatassavye bhuje nyasya brahmasūtraṃ samāhitaḥ || 25.54 || agre bhagavato darbhān dakṣiṇāgrān dharātale | āstīrya sāgrān suṣamānāsīnū dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ || 25.55 || pātrasthamannaṃ dadhi ca tilāṃścabadarīphalam | kabalīkṛtya tān piṇḍān samānmantramudīrayet || 25.56 || madhuvāteti tisṛbhirṛgbhirbarhiṣi nikṣipet | gotranāma samucchārya pitṛṇāṃ secanaṃ jalaiḥ || 25.57 || puṇḍān pitṛbyo mātṛbhyo bhrātṛbhyogurave tathā | ācāryaya tathānyebhyo bandhubhyo dhyānamāsthitaḥ || 25.58 || avasecanapūrvaṃ tu mantreṇānena mantravit | piṇḍān dadyādabhidhyāyan devaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ harim || 25.59 || āsecanaṃ prakurvīta punareva vicakṣaṇaḥ | evaṃ vidhāya vidhivadṛṇānmuktaśca tatkṣaṇāt || 25.60 || vimānaṃ divyamāruhya yāti brahma sanātanam | upavānān bahuvidhānakṣamaḥ kartumaññasā || 25.61 || devaṃ cakrābjamadhyasthaṃ yajedarghyādhisādhanaiḥ | siddenānena mantreṇa naivedyaiśca caturvidhaiḥ || 25.62 || hutvāghṛtena jvalane samidhāṣṭottaraṃ śatam | tanmayānbhojayedviprān dadyācca vibhapocitam || 25.63 || iṣṭvevaṃ devadeveśaṃ vrastho niyatendriyaḥ | cāndrāyaṇaṃ parākaṃ ca kṛcchraṃ sāntapanaṃ tathā || 25.64 || saṃvatsaropavāsaṃ ca tathaikāduśyu poṣitam | kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ śrāvaṇe ca jayantyādi prateṣvapi || 25.65 || ekādaśyupavāsasya yaduktaṃ phalamuttamam | tattacchataguṇaṃ vidyātphalaṃ pūjāvidherapi || 25.66 || yajñadharmaphalākājkṣītattatphalamavāpnuyāt | tarthābhigamanasyāpi phalaṃ saptāhapūjanāt || 25.67 || pavitrārohaṇe vāpi pratādiparipūraṇe | snavane cotsave pañcakālābhigamane tathā || 25.68 || gopurālaya sālādinirmāṇe pratimāsu ca | kṣetrārāmataṭākādi pradāne ca madhudviṣaḥ || 25.69 || ghṛtadīpapradāne ca yatphalaṃ tatsahasradhā | phalatyārādhanādviṣṇornātra kārya vicāraṇā || 25.70 || saṅkrāntau maṇḍale kumbhejvalane ca madhudviṣam | āvāhya pūjayeddevaṃ paramānnaiśchaturvidhaiḥ || 25.71 || juhuyānmanunānena jvalane'ṣṭottaraṃ śatam | tanmayānbhūjayecchaktyādadyāccaiva yathāvasu || 25.72 || yasya yasya ca dharmasya phalaṃ yadyadudīritam | tasya tasya phalaṃ tattanmantrācchataguṇaṃ bhavet || 25.73 || ayane cottare kumbhe vahnau cakrābjamaṇḍale | sopavāsaśśucirbhūtvā samāvāhya jagadgurum || 25.74 || yajeta pūrvavatpaścāddhomaṃ pūrvavadācaret | athārthāsādhanaṃ mantramabhivāñchati cennaraḥ || 25.75 || bhadrakaṃ maṇḍalaṃ kṛtvā tasminnā rādhya mantravit | tilairbhilvaistathāpadmairnimbapuṣpaiśca taṇḍulaiḥ || 25.76 || campakai rmallikābhiśca mālatyā karavīrajaiḥ | nandyāvartairyūdhikābhiḥ pratyekaṃ śatasaṅkhyāyā || 25.77 || juhuyādvidyayā vidvān saptāhaṃ caturāsana | dhanamakṣayamāpnoti mantrasyāsya prabhāvataḥ || 25.78 || candanaṃ kuṅkumaṃ koṣṭhaṃ rocanā laktakaṃ tathā | ghanasāraṃ mṛgamadaṃ piṣṭvā tatkṣodavāriṇā || 25.79 || dhanadaṃ vilikhedbhūmau sapta rātramananyadhīḥ | yajeta gandhapramukhairnivedya ca gulodanam || 25.80 || pādenākramya hṛdayaṃ dhanadasya japettataḥ | ayutaṃ niyutaṃ vāpi mantrarājaṃ jitendriyaḥ || 25.81 || dhyātvā nārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ tadanaimantravittamaḥ | sākṣātkaroti dhanadaṃ tathaiva dhanamakṣayam || 25.82 || prayacchati dhanādhyakṣairānītaṃ svāśrayātkṣaṇāt | māṇibhadrādibhirmantraprabhāvena caturmukha || 25.83 || saptāhamathavā yāgaṃ kṛtvā bhadrakamaṇḍale | hutvā hutīstadante ca kuryādbrahmaṇatarpaṇam || 25.84 || dhyātvā nārāyaṇaṃ devamātmānaṃ sādhakottamaḥ | paśyan mahītalaṃ śuddhamagrahārādbahisthsitaḥ || 25.85 || bhavanti cāsya nidhayaḥ pratyakṣā bahavastathā | añjanāñcitacakṣurvā mantreṇānena mantravit || 25.86 || nidhīn paśyati duṣprāpānabhīṣṭāṃ stat kṣaṇādasau | bhadrake maṇḍale pūrvamiṣṭvā devaṃ janārdanam || 25.87 || yajñadāruṃ vṛṣaskandhe badhvā tasmin halaṃ punaḥ | karṣayedbhūtalaṃ śuddhaṃ sitāsu maṇikāñcanam || 25.88 || mahadāpnotyabhipretamathavā kamalāsana | valmīkasya tathābhyarṇe kṛtvā bhadrakamaṇḍalam || 25.89 || yajeta pūrvavaddevamantre valmīkabhūmiṣu | nālikerajalaissārdhaṃ piṣṭaṃ nāgabaliṃ kṣipet || 25.90 || khātvā valmīkadhiṣṇyantaṃ tatra paśyenmahaddhanam | khanitraṃ kṣālayitvā tu niśāyāmadhivāsayet || 25.91 || maṇḍale svastike devamiṣṭvā hutvā tathāhutīḥ | aṣṭottaraśataṃ bhūyaḥ prātarnikṣipya bhūtale || 25.92 || śucau khanetkhanitreṇa labhate sumahaddhanam | sādhitaṃ pāradaṃ kṛtvā haste japtvā manuṃ punaḥ || 25.93 || niyutaṃ prayutaṃ vāpi yathāśakti samāhitaḥ | tadrasasparśamātreṇa sarvaṃ kāñcanatāmiyāt || 25.94 || pāṣāṇamathavā loṣṭamagnitaptaṃ na saṃśayaḥ | auṣadhāni ca sarvāṇi rasayuktāni padmaja || 25.95 || lohasaṃsparśayuktāni suvate kanakaṃ mahat | itthaṃ dhanavatāṃ kāmassamutrāntaḥ pravartate || 25.96 || tatprāptaye vidhāyābjamaṇḍalaṃ tatra saṃsmaret | mantreśamarcayitvāgre yathāpūrvamananyadhīḥ || 25.97 || juhuyācca yathoktena mārgeṇa dinasaptakam | padmarāgarucaṃ devaṃ smṛtvā mantraṃ japetsudhīḥ || 25.98 || pūrvoktasaṅkhyayā strīṇāṃ bhogaṃ cecchati durlabham | cintayitvāphalaṃ homakarmaṇyavasite tataḥ || 25.99 || abhīṣṭasādhakaṃ sarvāḥ prārthayantevarāstsriyaḥ | yāvajjīvaṃ na tyajanti kāmārtā mantravittamam || 25.100 || kanyākāmaḥ phalaiḥ pakvaiḥ puṣpairlājairdine dine | sahasraṃ juhuyāddevamārādhya garuḍadhvajam || 25.101 || labhate kanya kāmiṣṭāṃ tadantena vicāraṇā | yantraṃ vaśyakaraṃ pakṣye śrūyatāṃ tadyathātatham || 25.102 || bhūrjapatre likhe ccakramaṣṭāraṃ rocanādikaiḥ | candanadvayakāśmīraśaśikastūrikānvitaiḥ || 25.103 || hemasūcyālikhedetairgandhadravyaistathāparaiḥ | nābhinemiyutaṃ cakramaṣṭāraṃ jvālayānvitam || 25.104 || aṣṭasvareṣu vilikhedakṣarāṇyaṣṭa padmaja | prādakṣiṇyena vispaṣṭaṃ hrīṅkāraṃ madhyame pade || 25.105 || sādhyanāmāpi tatraiva soṅkāraṃ tadanantaram | hrīṅkāraṃ nābhivalaye dikṣvaṣṭāsu samarpayet || 25.106 || hrīṅkāraṃ nemivalaye vaśīkaraṇamakṣaram | tathaivāśānu sarvāsu vaśaṃ kuru padānvitam || 25.107 || tasminnāvāhya deveśamiṣṭvā mantraṃ japedbudhaḥ | aṣṭottarasahasraṃ tu huhuyā dāhutī stataḥ || 25.108 || gulikāṃ bibhratastasya vaśyaṃ sarvamanantaram | athavā pādayoḥ pāṃsūn raktacandanamiśritān || 25.109 || ādāya puruṣākārāṃ strīrūpāṃ vā yathepsitām | kṛtvā pratikṛtiṃ tasminnasyātmānaṃ smareddharim || 25.110 || tāḍayenmūlamanunā raktaistu hayamārajaiḥ | pratyahaṃ mantrajāpassyādaṣṭottarasahasrakam || 25.111 || paśyā nārī pumān vāpi saptāhānte japādbhavet | yāvajjīvaṃ dhanairdattairātmanā vā yathepsitam || 25.112 || tilataṇḍuladūrvāṇāmayutāhutibhiḥ kramāt | brāhmaṇakṣatriyaviśo vaśyamantra prabhāvataḥ || 25.113 || apāmārgasamidbhirvā homādvārṇān vaśaṃ nayet | audumbarasamidbhirvā palāśasamidhāpi vā || 25.114 || homena brāhmaṇā vaiśyāḥ pūrvoktāhutisaṅkhyāyā | tribhirmadhurasaissiktairapāmārgasamicchataiḥ || 25.115 || daśabhirjuhuyādagnaurājā vaśyaḥ kṣaṇādbhavet | aśvatthaiḥ khādirai rvāpi vaśīkaraṇamīritam || 25.116 || vaṭavṛkṣasamitsaṅghairvaiśyāssarve vaśīkṛtāḥ | śūdrastu plakṣasamidhāmāhutyā svavaśaḥ kṣaṇāt || 25.117 || gandhadravyasamāyuktamṛtsnayā tilakaṃ dadhat | dṛṣṭamātreṇa janatāṃ vaśaṃ nayati mantravit || 25.118 || dhyātvā karatale candraṃ tanmadhye viṣṭhitaṃ harim | sukhāsīnaṃ puṇḍarīkakarṇikāyāṃ sitaprabham || 25.119 || dhyāyan karatalaspa rśaissarvaṃ vaśyaṃ kṣaṇādbhavet | bhakṣyaṃ bhojyaṃ tathā peyaṃ phalaṃ vā puṣpameva vā || 25.120 || spṛṣṭvā sahasrajāpena dattaṃ sarvān vaśaṃ nayet | akarṣaṇavidhiṃ vakṣyetaṃ brahmannavadhāraya || 25.121 || bhūrjapatre likheccakramaṣṭāraṃ pūrvavartmanā | gandhadravyairlikhenmantraṃ hemasūcyā vicakṣaṇaḥ || 25.122 || veṣṭayeduktasūtreṇa tadyantramabhimantritam | śikhicaṅcupuṭe nyastaṃ bhāvayitvā japettataḥ || 25.123 || tannāmasaṃyutaṃ mantraṃ kruddhyannākarṣayeti ca | yuktaṃ sahasraṃ saptāhaṃ japetpratidinaṃ sīdhīḥ || 25.124 || ātmānaṃ garuḍārūḍhaṃ sāyudhāṣṭabhujaṃ harim | bandhūkapuṣpasadṛśaṃ bhāvayitvā jitendriyaḥ || 25.125 || vāmotsaṅge harerdevīṃ niṣaṇṇāṃ kāmavihvalām | pāśāṅkuśadharāṃ lakṣmīṃ dhyātvā ca tadanantaram || 25.126 || nṛpaṃ badhvā gale pāśaistāḍayitvā'ṅkuśādibhiḥ | āyudhaiḥ vṛṣṭhato mantramākarṣaya padānvitam || 25.127 || japtvā'yutaṃ saptadinaṃ yojanānāṃ śate sthitam | api bhūpaṃ nayatyāśu sādhako mantratesajasā || 25.128 || dhanena mahatā yuktassvayamevāgatonṛpaḥ | vaśyo bhavati kṛtvaivaṃ viprādīnapi vā ''nayet || 25.129 || yoṣidākarṣaṇe cāpi kṛtvaivaṃ karma mantravit | pañcabhāṇeṣubhirviddhāṃ sarvāṅgeṣu striyaṃ smaret || 25.130 || pāśabaddhaṃ tathaivānyairāyudhaiptāḍitāṃ bhṛśam | kṣipramevānayennārīṃ saptāhāccharavegavat || 25.131 || dūrasthitāmapi tathā rājño vā mahiṣīmapi | sā sannidhatte kāmārtā madavihvālalocanā || 25.132 || samṛddhārthātmanā vāpi dhanairvāpi yathepsitaiḥ | sādhakaṃ toṣayatyeṣā mantrajāpādyathoditāt || 25.133 || mṛtanārīkapāle vā rocanādyena vastunā | pūrvavacca kramalikhya tanmadhye'bhīṣṭayoṣitaḥ || 25.134 || likhitvā nāmadheyaṃ ta tkapāle jvalane punaḥ | tāpayitvā japenmantraṃ saptāhaṃ jūpvasaṅkhyayā || 25.135 || tatassidhyati sā nārī dūrasthāpi
