yathepsitā | yakṣāṇāmapi yakṣīṇāṃ sādhanaṃ śṛṇu kathyate || 25.136 || vaṭavṛkṣe kuṭiṃ kṛtvā tatra cakrabjamaṇḍale | ārādhya tevaṃ juhuyādvaṭavṛkṣasamicchataiḥ || 25.137 || daśabhiḥ pratyahaṃ mantrī saptāhe pariniṣṭhite | pūrvameva vaṭe yakṣaṃ yakṣīṃ vā kuṅkumādibhiḥ || 25.138 || likhitvā karma tatsarvaṃ kuryādabhimukhe svayam | saptame'hni vaṭe rātrau kampite'bhītavat sthitaḥ || 25.139 || gugguluṃ ghṛtamiśraṃ ca dhūpayenmantravittamaḥ | vaṭābhimukhamutthāya yakṣīṃ vā yakṣameva vā || 25.140 || sākṣātkaroti tāṃ taṃ vā yā cetābhīṣṭamuttamam | mātṛtvaṃ vā svasṛtvaṃ vā bhrātṛtvaṃ vā yathātatham || 25.141 || pitṛtvaṃ vātha bhāryātvamipsitaṃ sarvamāpnuyāt | prayacchati yathāyogaṃ yakṣī yakṣaśca mantriṇe || 25.142 || mātā cenmātṛvadrakṣetpitācetpitṛtattathā | evaṃ bhrātrādayo pyanye yathāsvatrāṇatatparāḥ || 25.143 || vidyādharavaśīkāre vidhānamaparaṃ śṛṇu | asokavṛkṣa mūlorvyāṃ kuryātpūjādi pūrvavat || 25.144 || vidyādharaṇe yacchakyaṃ kartumasyāpi tadbhavet | anyeṣāṃ devayonīnāmevaṃ kuryādyathāvidhi || 25.145 || te te sarvaṃ prayacchantimantratuṣṭā yathātatham | pātālasādhanaṃ cāpi śṛṇu guhyaṃ yathātatham || 25.146 || homāvasānaṃ pūjādi karma kṛtvā yathoditam | biladvārasamīpe tu lakṣamaṣṭākṣaraṃ japet || 25.147 || kṣīravṛkṣaśamīdurvātilādyānāmananyadhīḥ | pratyekamayutaṃ homaṃ kuryādvai sādhakottamaḥ || 25.148 || nirgacchati bilāttasmātkāmārtā kanyakā svayam | sahasraparivāreṇa sārdhamāyatalocanā || 25.149 || gṛhītvā mantriṇaṃ sveṣu mandireṣu yathāsukham | ramate divyabhogaissā vicitrairatimānuṣaiḥ || 25.150 || pātāladvārapārśve tu kārayedyāgamaṇṭapam | dhvajatoraṇasaṃyuktaṃ dvārakumbhopaśobhitam || 25.151 || cakrābjaṃ vartayettatra dhyātvā nārāyaṇaṃ prabhum | yajeta pūrvavaddhomaṃ kṛtvā pūrvoktasaṅkhyāyā || 25.152 || aṣṭalakṣaṃ mitāhāro jitendriya ananyadhīḥ | tatkṣaṇādeva nāgendrakanyakā mantriṇaḥ puraḥ || 25.153 || sthitā manobhavavaśā sahasraiḥ parivāritāḥ | ātmatulyābhiranyābhiḥ kanyakābhirvaśīkṛtāḥ || 25.154 || gṛhītvā mantriṇaṃ tāśca nāgālayapurottame | praviśya vividhairbhogairvaśīkurvantimantriṇam || 25.155 || pītvā rasāyanaṃ cāpi yāvadābhūtasaṃplavam | ramate bhīrubhissārdhaṃ divi devapatiryathā || 25.156 || khaḍgasādhanamāścaryaṃ śṛṇu vakṣyāmi tadyathā | dehajaṃ lohitaṃ mantrīśmaśānāṅgāramiśritam || 25.157 || peṣayitvālikhedkhaḍgaṃ catustālāyataṃ śubham | śmaśānadeśe tanmūlaṃ spṛṣṭvāmantraṃ japetsudhīḥ || 25.158 || niśīthe nirjane tāvadyā vajjvālāṃ vimuṃcati | jvālābhirasya śobhante diśo daśa caturmukha || 25.159 || nānāvidhāni bhūtāni bhavanti bhayahetavaḥ | abhīto niścato mantraṃ jape devaṃ samāhitaḥ || 25.160 || sphurantaṃ pāṇinā khaḍgaṃ gṛhītvā dṛḍhamuṣṭinā | mantraṃ japennabho yāti yatra vidyādharādayaḥ || 25.161 || vidyāmahimnā teṣāṃ sa rājā bhavati mantravit | yakṣarākṣasadaityānāṃ jetā martyeṣu kiṃpunaḥ || 25.162 || khaḍgahastasyadā mantraṃ japanyāti triviṣṭapam | tatrāpi bhogamatulaṃ labhate cāpsarogaṇaiḥ || 25.163 || khaḍgaṃ vā''yasamādāya parṇaiḥ pipphalasaṃbhavaiḥ | antarhitaṃ vidhāyāśu niyutaṃ japamācaret || 25.164 || samidājyaistathā bījairjuhuyādayutāvaram | nararaktaṃ gajamadaṃ pittamākṣaṃ vimiśritam || 25.165 || rājavartena taiḥ khaḍgaṃ vilipyārādhayeddharim | tasmin pūrvoktamārgeṇa khaḍgaṃ spṛṣṭvā japaḥsmṛtaḥ || 25.166 || aṣṭottarasahasreṇa paścāttāpādisambhavaḥ | tāpe syādadhamāsiddhirmadhyamā dhūmajanmani || 25.167 || uttamā jvalane dṛṣṭe paścādkhaḍgadharassvayam | caredabhīpsitān lokān bhogāṃścāpnoti puṣkalān || 25.168 || śaṅkhakuktyadare mandraṃ likhedgorocanāmbubhiḥ | japenmantravaraṃ spṛṣṭvā yāvajjvālāvalokanam || 25.169 || samutthitā ca tanmadhye kanyā sarvavarapradā | tilakaṃ cākṣamālāṃ ca gulu kāñjanapādukāḥ || 25.170 || divyaiṣadhaṃ rasendraṃ ca kapālasthaṃ rasāñjanam | dadādi sarvaṃ sā kanyā mantriṇe mantravaibhavāt || 25.171 || tilakaṃ bhibhrata stasya naranārī mṛgādikam | smṛtimātreṇa pūrato dṛṣṭaṃ bhavati taddhruvam || 25.172 || tayā kṣamālayā japtaḥ puraścaraṇavarjitaḥ | mantro yathepsitān kāmān tasmai śīghraṃ prayacchati || 25.173 || nidhāya gulikāmāsye nirbhayassarvaviṣṭave | caratyeṣa yathākāmaṃ dīrghamāyuścha vindati || 25.174 || añjanenāktanayanassyādadṛśyassurāsuraiḥ | pādukāsparśamātreṇa cārayatyanale jale || 25.175 || dūraṃ vā gamayecchīghraṃ yaṃ yaṃ deśamabhīpsati | divyauṣadhena bhuktena durvādhirnaśyati kṣaṇāt || 25.176 || acikitsyopi kuṣṭhādirnātra kāryā vicāraṇā | pāṣāṇādi rasendriṇa spṛṣṭamāgnau pratāpitam || 25.177 || hiraṇyaṃ bhavati brahman pītvā cāpi rasāyanam | balavānapi tejasvī valīpalitavarjitaḥ || 25.178 || kapāle cāśma nikṣipya śatrumūrdhani nikṣipet | udvāsito vā mriyate sānvavāyassuhṛṅjanaḥ || 25.179 || darśayannindrajālaṃ cenmāyādevīṃ likhedbhuvi | kṛṣṇāṃ ca turbhujāṃ saumyāṃ sarvābharaṇa bhūṣitām || 25.180 || sarvāṅgasundarīṃ mantrī pūjayitvā japettataḥ | ayutaṃ niyutaṃ vāpi mantramaṣṭākṣa rānvitam || 25.181 || siddhā tadante sā devī caturaṅgabalaṃ mahat | bhūmau pyomni balaṃ sravamudyatāyudhamadbhutam || 25.182 || darśayatyāśu mantreṇa ma ntreṇe mantrasiddhadā | trailokyamapi sarvaṃ sā pradarśayati toṣitā || 25.183 || gulikā kadhyate brahman nirmāṇa madhunocyate | manaśśilā tathā kuṣṭhaṃ halitālaṃ ca kuṃkumam || 25.184 || gorocanāṃ ca cakrāṅgaṃ sarvaṃ piṣṭvā madhutrikaiḥ | kṛtvā ca gulikāṃ cakrapadmamadhye niveśayet || 25.185 || ekādaśīniśāyāṃ vā yajeta harimavyayam | dvādaśyāmarcayitvā tu japenmantraṃ yathāpuram || 25.186 || homamagnau prakurvīta sahasraṃ sarpiṣā tataḥ | siddheyaṃ gulikā sarvaṃ sādhayetsādhakasya hi || 25.187 || vetālasādhanaṃ brahman kathayāmi yathātatham | brāhmaṇaṃ kṣatriyaṃ vāpi yuvānaṃ nirvraṇaṃ mṛtam || 25.188 || tatkṣaṇādeva saṅgṛhya śūnyāgāre niveśayet | kṣālayitvā malaṃ sarvaṃ cakrapadme niveśyatam || 25.189 || hṛdayaṃ tasya cākramya pādena dhyānamāsthitaḥ | japenmantraṃ divārātraṃ niśīdhe kampate śavaḥ || 25.190 || nirbhayastāḍayeddehaṃ siddhārdhairabhimantritaiḥ | kampamānaṃ śarīraṃ tadutthāyāgre'vatiṣṭhate || 25.191 || kiṃ karomiti ca tatomantriṇaṃ saṃpuṭāñjaliḥ | bruvāṇo mantriṇe tasmai prayacchati yathepsitam || 25.192 || khaṇḍamuṣṭiṃ tathā divyamauṣadhaṃ ca rasāyanam | gulikāṃ pāduke siddhaṃ rasaṃ veṇupuṭe sthitam || 25.193 || pādalepaṃ cākṣasūtramanyadvā durlabhaṃ nṛbhiḥ | pādalepena gamanamākāśādiṣu mantriṇaḥ || 25.194 || khaḍgena śatrusainyānāṃ vadhaḥ kesariṇāmapi | divyauṣadhānāṃ sarveṣāṃ phalaṃ pūrvamudīritam || 25.195 || āmayānāmapasmāramukhānāṃ śāntaye vidhiḥ | bhūbhāge śalyarahīte kṛtvā maṇṭapamāditaḥ || 25.196 || nirvraṇān lakṣaṇopetānkalaśān pañcaviṃśatim | pūritān droṇamātreṇa sarpirādyena vastunā || 25.197 || sasūtrān sakuśāṃścaiva sāpidhānān savastrakān | dvārakumbhān caturdikṣu toraṇāni ca kalpayet || 25.198 || pratyekaṃ kalaśān sarvān mantreṇaivābhimantrayet | aṣṭākṣareṇa pratyekamaṣṭottaraśatāvaram || 25.199 || niśāmbanā candanena śvetadūrvāṅkureṇa ca | bhūrjapatrodare padmamaṣṭapatraṃ sakarṇikam || 25.200 || nābhinemiyutaṃ cakramaṣṭāraṃ kamalādbahiḥ | praṇavaṃ karṇikādeśe sādhyanāma ca madhyataḥ || 25.201 || aṣṭākṣarāṇyaṣṭadale nābhau sparśākṣaraṃ likhet | nābhikṣetre yakārādīnaṣṭāreṣu svarān punaḥ || 25.202 || mahāmāyāgni saṃyuktaṃ bhāskaraṃ daṇḍaśekharam | nemibhāge kramāddikṣu vidikṣu caturāsana || 25.203 || kṛtvaivaṃ sitasūtreṇa pariveṣṭyanirantaram | gulikāṃ taṇḍuladroṇamadhyasthe kalaśe kṣipet || 25.204 || āvāhya hṛdayāttasmi nmantreśaṃ cakrapaṅkaje | candanādyaissitairvastraiḥ puṣpairanyeśca tādṛśaiḥ || 25.205 || śālyodanena ca hariṃ yajeta susamāhitaḥ | pūrṇendumaṇdalāntasthamudgirantaṃ sudhārasam || 25.206 || śaśāṅkaśatasaṅkāśaṃ dhyātvā nārāyaṇaṃ harim | śāntiṃ prayaccha mahatīmityante samudīrayet || 25.207 || śaśino daśi vṛtte'tha kuṇḍe kṣīrājyataṇḍulaiḥ | gugguluṃ kṣaudrabījāṃ ścasaptāhaṃ homamācaret || 25.208 || pūrvoktasaṅkhyayā kumbhaiḥ sthāpitaṃ cāmayāvinam | svāpayenmūlamantreṇa dhyāyeccaiva janārdanam || 25.209 || mūrṇenduśatasaṅkāśaṃ syandhamānaṃ sudhārasam | tadīyapādakamalātsarvato vyādhipīḍitam || 25.210 || praviśya brahmarandhreṇa plāpayantamananyadhīḥ | dhyātvā japenmūlavidyāṃ mantravidvyādhipīḍitam || 25.211 || utthāpayati tanmūrdhninyasya tāṃ gulikāmatha | apasmārādayassarve śāmyanti manutejasā || 25.212 || athādāya ca mṛtpātraṃ paittalaṃ vātha kāṣṭhajam | tasminnikṣipya pīyūṣaṃ dadhisarpissamanvitam || 25.213 || odanaṃ caityavṛkṣādimūle bhūtabaliṃ haret | bhojayedbrāhmaṇānai dadyātaibhyo yathāvasu || 25.214 || pauṣṭiṃ vakṣyāmi te karma maṇṭapādi yathāpuram | bhūrjapatre likhedyantraṃ prāgvatpadmādisaṃyutam || 25.215 || śrībhūmimantraṃ ca likhetkesareṣu daleṣu ca | gulikāṃ veṣṭitāṃ raktāsūtrairmadhughaṭe kṣipet || 25.216 || vidrumābhaṃ ca mandreśaṃ samāvāhya ca sarvagam | saumyāśāyāṃ padmakuṇḍaṃ kalaśān raktavāsasaḥ || 25.217 || vastu sarvaṃ yathoktaṃ tadyuktaṃ syātsati sambhave | balikarmaca kartavyaṃ karmānte kamalāsana || 25.218 || mahatī puṣṭireva syātkṛte karmaṇi śāntike | āyuṣkāmastu dūrvābhirghṛtāktābhi ryathoditam || 25.219 || juhuyānmaṇṭapādīnāṃ vidhānaṃ pūrvavartmanā | karmānte kalaśaissnānaṃ sādhyasya kamalāsana || 25.220 || evaṃ kṛte yathāśāstramāyurvindati puṣkalam | ārogyakāmassāvitre maṇḍale harimarcayet || 25.221 || rukmābhaṃ vidyayārghyādi sādhanairuktavartmanā | pūrvavajjapahomādi homo gugguluvastubhiḥ || 25.222 || japānte praṇamennityamaṅgairaṣṭābhirātmavān | yāvadāyuṣamārogyaṃ labhate mantravaibhavāt || 25.223 || jvaritasya bhavecchāntiramṛtācūtapallavaiḥ | pūrvoktena vidhānena sarvamanyadyathoditam || 25.224 || jvaraśāntirbhavedante vidyāvīryaprabhāvataḥ | candanādidrumairlohairyadvā pratikṛtiḥ kṛtā || 25.225 || pūjitā pūrvavatsarvān kāmānāśu prayacchati | homaśca karmānuguṇairdravyaissyātkamalāsana || 25.226 || aśvatthaṃ mandavāreṣu spṛṣṭvā dakṣiṇapāṇinā | japato nāpamṛtyussyātpūrvamiritasaṅkhyāyā || 25.227 || ghṛtamiśraṃ vacā cūrṇaṃ yadvā brāhmīṃ ghṛtāplutām | jyotiṣmatīrasaṃ vāpi spṛṣṭvā lakṣaṃ japan pibet || 25.228 || muhurte bhobhane prāpte vāksiddhistasya niścitā | audumbare'thavā pātre kapilājyaṃ catuṣpalam || 25.229 || miśraṃ śvetavacācūrṇaṃ yadvā candhre maghāyute | puṇye sārasvate yoge śvetavarṇaṃ caturbhujam || 25.230 || śvetapadme sukhāsīnaṃ candramaṇḍalamadhyagam | iṣṭvā devaṃ goghṛtena juhuyācca yathāvidhi || 25.231 || piban sa susravaṃ paścāllabhate vācamuttamām | aṣṭabāhuṃ candranibhamātmānaṃ śeṣaviṣṭare || 25.232 || sukhāsīnaṃ bhāvayitvā kopinaṃ prativādinam | pidhāya jihvā hṛdayaṃ musalena śiro'ṅkuśaiḥ || 25.233 || tāḍayedgadayā pṛṣṭhaṃ pāśairbadhvā kalebharam | tasyaiva jihvāmadhye ca māhendraṃ daṇḍa śekharam || 25.234 || vinyasya stambhayedvācamevaṃ dhyāyan vicakṣaṇaḥ | ātmano vādinaścaiva madhye yavanikā bhavet || 25.235 || mantraṃ śataguṇaṃ japtvā vādī vācaṃ samutsṛjet | sadyaḥ parasyāpajayo vijayaścātmano bhavet || 25.236 || stambhane nai padoṣassyā dbāhyāśchetprativādinaḥ | brahmavarcasakāmaśchetsamitho brahmavṛkṣajāḥ || 25.237 || śvetapaṅkajahomo vā rājyakāmasya mantriṇaḥ | samitho rakta varṇāssyurbilvapuṣpāṇi padmaja || 25.238 || lakṣmīsumanaso vāpi yadvā bodhisamudbhavāḥ | candramaṇḍalamadhyasthaṃ śvetapaṅkajaviṣṭare || 25.239 || sthitaṃ dvihastaṃ subhagaṃ bālabhūṣaṇabhūṣitam | bālāvasthaṃ prasannenduvarcasaṃ nīlakuntalam || 25.240 || rājataṃ pātramannena pāyasena prapūritam | bibhrāṇaṃ vāmahastena dadhyanna kabalaṃ punaḥ || 25.241 || dadhānamitareṇāpi dhyātvā devaṃ samāhitaḥ | annena juhuyādagnau bahvānnatvamavāpnuyāt || 25.242 || gokāmo gomayaiḥ kṣīraistadīyairhomamācaret | labhate dhenukaṃ sadyo mantravinmantravaibhavāt || 25.243 || bhūmikāmo mṛdā homaṃ durlabhāṃ labhate bhuvam | phalairbilvasamudbhūtairhomādrāṣṭrasamudbhavaḥ || 25.244 || vastrakāmassumanasāṃ kālajānāṃ caturmukha | sitāsitādivarṇānāṃ homānniyutasaṅkhyayā || 25.245 || nānāvidhāni vastrāṇi labhate nātrasaṃśayaḥ | yadyatkāmayate mantrī dhānyajātimanekadhā || 25.246 || tattaddhomeva tatsarvaṃ labhatemandravaibhavāt | mantrābhimantritaṃ bījamuptaṃ bahuphalaṃ bhavet || 25.247 || putrakāmo haviṣṭāśī samārādhya jagadgurum | cakrābjamaṇḍale kumbhasthāpanādi vidhāya ca || 25.248 || yathāpūrvaṃ pāyasānnaṃ homānte sthāpitairghaṭaiḥ | abhiṣicya tadambhāṃsi pāyayet striyamāgatām || 25.249 || sā putrān labhate tviṣṭān bahun vidyāvicakṣaṇān | iṣṭvā nārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ cakrābjeproktavartmanā || 25.250 || anugrahe nigrahe ca sarveṣāṃ śaktimān bhavet | kampane vasudhādīnāṃ parvatānāṃ ca bhedane || 25.251 || śoṣaṇe vā samudrāṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ stambhane pi ca | sargasthitivināśānāmapi kartā yathā hariḥ || 25.252 || dhyānācca devadevasya japānmantrasya ca kṣaṇāt | naśyanti bhūtavetālapramukhāni caturmukha || 25.253 || duṣṭasatvāni mantrasya prabhāvānnātra saṃśayaḥ | viṣadaṣṭamavasthāpya dhyātvāca garuḍadhvajam || 25.254 || devaṃ vidyāṃ samuccārya tīkṣṇatuṇḍena tāḍayet | garuḍasya tu pakṣābhyāṃ viṣadaṣṭasya mūrdhani || 25.255 || evaṃ dhyātvā viṣaṃ sarvaṃ vyapohyotthāpayenmṛtam | bhuktaṃ viṣeṇa saṃspṛṣṭamannaṃ bījaṃ phalaṃ tathā || 25.256 || jarayedvidyayā sadyassarvadoṣaṃ ca nāśayet | akṣayaścābhivṛddhiśca dhanasya yadi kāṅkṣitaḥ || 25.257 || saṃspṛśya vidyayā sarvaṃ nikṣipedbahujaptayā | bandhūka kusumaprakhyamātmānaṃ bhagavanmayam || 25.258 || dhyāyanyāyātsabhāṃ tatra kruddhaśśāmyati bhūmipaḥ | anuktāssiddhayaḥ sarvāssidhyantyatyantavistṛtāḥ || 25.259 || śāstre mantraprabhāvena devabhūyaṃ prapadyate | vṛṣṭikāmo bahiśśālāṃ pūrvoktavidhinā kṛtām || 25.260 || cakrābjamaṇḍlādīni kṛtvā karmāṇi pūrvavat | saptāhamājyasiktābhissamidbhirjuhuyātsudhīḥ || 25.261 || vaitasībhiḥ pratidinaṃ niyutāyutasaṅkhyāyā | vṛṣṭirbhavati tadrāṣṭre taddheśe vā dinatraye || 25.262 || marīcikṣuṇṇasaṃmiśraissarṣapai rājasarṣapaiḥ | pūrvoktasaṅkhyayā homādativṛṣṭiśca śāmyati || 25.263 || devatādipadaṃ prepsurvidyayā lokamīpsitam | svargādyabhīṣṭarokasya mahimānuguṇairjapaiḥ || 25.264 || labhate tattadāścaryaṃ phalaṃ naivātra saṃśayaḥ | cintāratnaṃ tathaivān maṇimādi guṇaṃ param || 25.265 || lipsurmantrajapaiḥ koṭisaṅkhyaiḥ prāpnoti mantravit | mantrādhidaivataṃ devaṃ draṣṭukāmojitendriyaḥ || 25.266 || ṣaṣmāsānmantramaniśaṃ japettadhyānamāsthitaḥ | āgatya devadeveśaḥ papratyakṣo bhavati kṣaṇāt || 25.267 || varāṃśca durlabhāṃstasme pradadāti yathepsitān | mantriṇe mantramahātmyādacireṇa caturmukha || 25.268 || mantrāntarāṇāṃ yāsiddhiḥ kalpe kalpe samīritā | sāpi prasidhyedasyaiva sakalā vīryapattayā || 25.269 || ṣaḍaṅgāni ca vedāśca mantrāścānye paraśśatāḥ | anyacca vāṅmayaṃ sarvaṃ mantre'smin susamāhitam || 25.270 || apunarbhavalipsūnāṃ gatiraṣṭāraṃ matam | janmanyasminnatīte vā yatenassañchitaṃ mahat || 25.271 || tanmantrajāpamātreṇa pralayaṃ yāti niścayam | mriyamāṇaśśucirbhūtvāmantrametamudīrayan || 25.272 || prāpnoti vaiṣṇavaṃ sthānaṃ duṣprāpama vināśanam | kiṃ tasya bahubhirmantraiḥ kiṃ tasya bahubhiśśrutaiḥ || 25.273 || yasyaiṣā vaśamāpannā vidyā sarvārthasādhanī | ye mantramāhātmyamidaṃ śṛṇvanti ca paṭhanti ca || 25.274 || teṣāmapi phalānyāhuḥ pūrvoktāni manīṣiṇaḥ | caturmukhaiśca turvaktraphalānyasya pradarśayan || 25.275 || nāntaṃ jagāma vistīrṇaṃ saṅkṣepo'yamudīritaḥ | iti śrīpāñcarātre mahopaniṣadi pādmasaṃhitāyāṃ caryāpāde śrīmadaṣṭākṣaramantravaibhavo nāma paṃcaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ |
<4.26>
śrībhagavān gāyatrīṃ vaiṣṇavīṃ brahman caturviṃśākṣarātmikām | śṛṇu vakṣyāmi paramaṃ rahasyaṃ kathyate'dhunā || 26.1 || mātṛkācakramabhyarcyachandasāmādimuddharet | ādidevaśirāścātra vighneśaṃ tadanantaram || 26.2 || vahnyantaṃ gopanaṃ paścācchaṅkhaṃ viṣṇuśiraḥ smṛtam | sumukhaṃ gopanayuta manyacca marudādimat || 26.3 || māyāśritaṃ sudhādhāma vaidharo'nvakaccha mandaram | viṣṇuśīrṣo bhāskaro'tha māthavādhiṣṭhitaḥ kramāt || 26.4 || ādidevasamākrāntaḥ kumbhaśuklodayāvahau | vaidharo devatāntaśca pīyūṣarucirāśirāḥ || 26.5 || anilaḥ praṇavādyanto mahāmāyāśirāḥ kramāt | dhanadonu tato dakṣo viṣṇumūrdhātha bhāskaraḥ || 26.6 || māyāśirāśca vairājo viṣṇvanto bhadrapāṇiyuk | otadehaḥ paraḥ kumbhastrivikramaparassmṛtaḥ || 26.7 || krodhanaṃ vanamālyantaṃ tadvayaṃ bhuvanāvadhi | vasargaḥ pāpahantā ca vahniścādyarṇasaṃyutaḥ || 26.8 || cakāraścotadehaścha dvau dṛṣṭirviṣṇumūrdhakaḥ | daraśca gopanaścobhau vijayorṇassamuddhṛtaḥ || 26.9 || candaścha devī gāyatramṛṣirbrahmādhidaivatam | viṣṇuṣṣaḍaṅgāni tathā kruddholkādīni padmaja || 26.10 || mūrdhādipādaparyantamakṣaranyasanaṃ matam | mūrdhniphāle nayanayornāsikāpuṭayostathā || 26.11 || śrotrayorāsyagalayorhṛdaye buhumūlayoḥ | nyāsaḥ kūrparayoścaiva tathaiva maṇibandhayoḥ || 26.12 || hastayoḥ kukṣimadhye ca guhyecorvośca jaṅghayoḥ | pādayośca kramādevaṃ nyāsaḥproktaścaturmukha || 26.13 || pītaṃ kaktaṃ ca dhūmrābhaṃ śvetaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ ca lohitam | valarkṣaṃ pītakaṃ raktaṃ śyāmaṃ śaṅkhanibhaṃ tathā || 26.14 || pāṭalaṃ sphaṭikābhaṃ ca pītaṃ rajatasannibham | candradīdhitisaṅkāśaṃ padmakiñjalkasannibham || 26.15 || tārābhaṃ bandhujīvābhaṃ nakṣatrābhaṃ ca pāṭalam | japākusamasaṅkāśaṃ taptajāmbānadaprabham || 26.16 || raviprabhaṃ cākṣarāṇāṃ varṇabhedaḥ pradarśitaḥ | kālameghanibhaṃ saumyaṃ caturbāhuṃ kirīṭinam || 26.17 || śaṅkhacakragadāpāṇiṃ garuḍārūḍhamacyutam | evaṃ dhyātvā'rcayeddevaṃ prātaḥ kāle samāhitaḥ || 26.18 || sphaṭikopalasaṅkāśaṃ garuḍārūḍhavigraham | madhyandine'rcayitvā tamācarejjapamātmavān || 26.19 || pradoṣeṣu caturhastaṃ vainateyoparisthitam | śyāmalaṃ puṇḍarīkākṣaṃ dhyāyanmantra mudīrayet || 26.20 || kuryāttriṣavaṇasnānaṃ vratasthassaṃyatendriyaḥ | caturviṃśati lakṣeṇa mantrajāpena sidhyati || 26.21 || mantravitsādhakovāritarpaṇaṃ homakarmaca | kurvannāpnoti sakalāṃ siddhimiṣṭāṃ sudarlabhām || 26.22 || gomūtrayāvakāhāro japellakṣamatandritaḥ | pātakebhyo mahadbhyopi mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 26.23 || brahmakūrcaṃ piban lakṣatrayaṃ mantraṃ japansudhīḥ | tatsamebhyaḥ pātakebhyo vimuktomantravittamaḥ || 26.24 || brahmādi devatāssarvā ninīṣurvaśamātmanaḥ | aṇimādiphalaṃ prevsustathaivākarṣaṇodyataḥ || 26.25 || vaśīkāre ca sarveṣāṃ pātālagamane tathā | gandharvayakṣapramukhān pramukhānātmanassadā || 26.26 || cikīrṣuraṣṭākṣaravadanutiṣṭhecchaturmukha | sakṛduccārayanmantraṃ viṣṇugāyatrisaṃjñitam || 26.27 || vedānāmasakṛtsarva śākhādhyayanapuṇyabhāk | keśakīṭādiduṣṭāni havīṃṣi dhyānamāsthitaḥ || 26.28 || spṛṣṭvā japenmantramidaṃ sadyaḥ śuddhāni padmaja | caturṇāṃ mūlamantrāṇāṃ phalametena sidhyati || 26.29 || śrīkaraṃ mantramaparaṃ vakṣye sarvārthasādhanam | aṣṭākṣaraṃ caturvaktra rahasyaṃ paramaṃ śṛṇu || 26.30 || varṇacakraṃ likhitvādau samabhyarcya tataḥ punaḥ | uddharecchrīkarāṣṭārṇaṃ mantraṃ mantraprabhāvavit || 26.31 || ādau samuddharaittāramudayaṃ tadanantaram | dvirekanetramāyāntaṃ krodhanaṃ kaustubhākṣaram || 26.32 || viṣṇuśīrṣaṃ tato lakṣmīmanalaṃ tadanantaram | mahāmāyāyutaṃ padmamaprameyamanantaram || 26.33 || agnimādiṃ caturvaktraṭhaṭheti śrīkarāhvayam | bhījamasya pravakṣyāmi yathātatvamudīryate || 26.34 || dīptimānanalaḥ pañca bindurardhenduniṣṭhitā | bījamaṅgāni ṣaṭcāpi kruddolkādīni pūrvavat || 26.35 || chandhaśca devī gāyatramṛṣirasya prajāpatiḥ | devatā devadeveśaḥ pratyarṇaṃ pūrvavat smṛtam || 26.36 || ṛṣiśchandodaivataṃ ca dhyānaṃ saṃprati kathyate | kalpakānokahacchāyāmāśritya sukhaśītalām || 26.37 || garuḍasya caturbāhossarvālaṅkāradhāriṇaḥ | skandhadeśe sukhāsīnamaṣṭabāhuṃ kirīṭinam || 26.38 || kundendudhavalaṃ saumyaṃ sarvākalpapariṣkṛtam | divyagandhaviliptāṅgaṃ divyamālāvibhūṣitam || 26.39 || pītāmbaradharaṃ nīlakuntalairupaśobhitam | cakraṃ ca musalaṃ bhāṇamaṅkuśaṃ dadhataṃ bhujaiḥ || 26.40 || caturbhirdakṣiṇairanyeśśaṅkhaṃ kaumodakīṃ tathā | śārṅgaṃ pāśaṃca kalyāṇaiḥ prasannendunibhānanam || 26.41 || garuḍopi ca hastābhyāmubhābhyāṃ pādapaṅkaje | devasya dhārayan kumbhaṃ pūrṇaṃ pīyūṣavāriṇā || 26.42 || itarābhyāṃ ca hastābhyāṃ spṛśannāsye sthitaṃ tathā | śriyaṃ ca vāmorutale rukmābhāṃ kṣaumavāsinīm || 26.43 || divyagandhaviliptāṅgāṃ sarvākalpapariṣkṛtām | subhrālalāṭamukuṭāṃ karṇaviśrāntalocanām || 26.44 || lāvaṇyāmṛtatoyena varṣantīmiva sarvataḥ | pāśāṅkuśadharāṃ lakṣmīṃ kandarpaśarapīḍitām || 26.45 || dhyātvaivaṃ pūjayitvātu vratasthassaṃyatendriyaḥ | dvādaśāhaṃ japenmantraṃ dhyātvā pārśve nidhidvayam || 26.46 || ūrdhvabāhurjaletiṣṭhannurodaghne samāhitaḥ | ādityābhimukho mantrī juhuyācca samicchatam || 26.47 || bilvodbhavaistathālakṣmīṃ kusumaiḥ pāyasodanaiḥ | śuddhodanairghṛtāktaiśca aṣṭottarasahasrakam || 26.48 || evaṃ kṛte vidhānena puṣṭirutpadyate'calā | pauṣṭikādi ca pūrvoktaphalaṃ pūrvoktasaṅkhyayā || 26.49 || śāntikaṃ pauṣṭikaṃ karmamantreṇānena sādhayet | lakṣmīnārāyaṇāhvānaṃ mantraṃ paramadurlabham || 26.50 || tasyoddhāraṃ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇu varṇakrameṇa tam | udgīthaṃ manujeśānaṃ viṣṇuṃ mandara meva tat || 26.51 || sūktīndumukhyamaparaṃ gadinaṃ kumbhamarpitam | ādyantaṃ vijayaṃ dattaṃ māhendraṃ cāprameyakam || 26.52 || garuḍaṃ dakṣamaparaṃ mahāmāyāṃ vināyakam | ādidevaṃ tato vahniṃ gopanaṃ ca caturgatim || 26.53 || ādyaṃ pracaṇḍamākāraṃ śaṅkhamādiṃ ṭhaṭheti ca | uddṛtya ṣoḍaśārṇaṃ tanmantraṃ bījaśca kathyate || 26.54 || dyumaṇiṃ bindumaparaṃ vāmanaṃ bindumuddharet | aṅgāni pūrvamuktāni chandho gāyatramucyate || 26.55 || viddhi śukro munirdevo lakṣmīnārāyaṇassmṛtaḥ | japaṣṣoḍaśalakṣaṃ tu tadardhaṃ vāritarpaṇam || 26.56 || homastatardhomantrasya phalānyāhuryathā kramam | saṅkarṣaṇādimūrdīnāṃ tisṛṇāṃ manurucyate || 26.57 || āditaḥ pūrvavatsapta varṇānāmamanupūrvaśaḥ | uddhāraśśiṣṭavarṇānāṃ brahman saṃprati kathyate || 26.58 || dīptimān vahniraurvaścha druvaśśuklastathādimān | binduḥ prajāpatiścādyo vahnirugro mukhaṃ tataḥ || 26.59 || sumukhaṃ gopanayutaṃ vāyurādyaṃ ṭhaṭhāntitam | dvādaśāroṇātmako mantrobījamaṅgaṃ ca pūrvavat || 26.60 || chandaśca devī gāyatramṛṣisyānnīlalohitaḥ | devassaṅkarṣaṇo varṇo devatā tatvanirṇayaḥ || 26.61 || dvādaśākṣaravat jñeyaḥ puraścaraṇamīritam | phalāni pūrvamuktāni vāksiddhirmahatī bhavet || 26.62 || jñānaṃ ca mahadāpnoti yaccānyadadhikāṅkṣitam | tatsarvamacirādeva sidhyenmantraprabhāvataḥ || 26.63 || śaṅkhagokṣīradhavalaṃ caturbhāhuṃ kirīṭinam | vasānaṃ vasanaṃ kṣaumaṃ pūrṇacandranibhāvanam || 26.64 || muktāṃ bhūyiṣṭhamākalpaṃ sauvarṇamatiśobhanam | dadhānaṃ mukhyahastena jñānamudrāsamanvitam || 26.65 || pustakaṃ vāmahastena bibhrāṇaṃ bhujayordvayoḥ | ūrdhvayossphāṭikaṃ śaṅkhamakṣamālāṃ yathātatham || 26.66 || dhavalaiḥ kālajaiḥ puṣpaiśśobhitaṃ vanamālayā | śvetapadme sukhāsīnamevaṃ dhyāyīta mantravit || 26.67 || dhyāyato buddhiratulā bhavet jñānaṃ ca puṣkalam | śāntikaṃ pauṣṭikaṃ karma kuryādetena padmaja || 26.68 || bahunā kiṃ pralāpena dviṣaṭkākṣaravatphalam | sarvamāpnoti manunā sādhakaḥ kamalāsana || 26.69 || pradyumnamantramadhunā sarvakāmaphalapradam | bravīmi tasya coddhāraṃ kathyate'kṣaraśaḥ kramāt || 26.70 || ādita ssaptavarṇānāmuddhāraḥ pūrvamīritaḥ | asyāsādhāraṇārṇānāṃ saṃpratyuddhāra ucyate || 26.71 || pāpmānamanalaṃ viṣṇumantraṃ vāyumukāravat | mandaraṃ bhadrapāṇiṃ ca madhusūdanamārutau || 26.72 || āgneyī daśa caikaṃ cāpyarṇassaṃhananaṃ matam | anusvāraparo viṣṇurbhīja maṅgaṃ ca pūrvavat || 26.73 || ṛṣissanatkumārassyācchando gāyatramucyate | pradyumno devatā mantrassādhanaṃ phalameva ca || 26.74 || pūrvoktam mantramaparamāniruddhamataḥ param | śṛṇu brahman yathāpūrvaṃ saptārṇānāmanukramāt || 26.75 || uddhāraḥ pariśiṣṭānāmārṇānāṃ kathyate' dhunā | praṇavādyobhadrahastomāyā saptārcireva ca || 26.76 || udayau dvau ca subhago gopano vāyurādimān | bījamasyāprameyaśca visargaśchāvasānataḥ || 26.77 || ṛṣiśca sanakaśchandaḥ pūrvavaddevatā tathā | aniruddho dvādaśārṇaḥ krameṇa samudīritaḥ || 26.78 || yathāpuraṃ ṣaḍaṅgāni sādhanaṃ phalameva ca | caturviṃśatimūrtināṃ samākhyā dvādaśādibhiḥ || 26.79 || prasiddhāstāścaturthyantāssaptākṣarapuraskṛtāḥ | mantraba …
<4.27>
śrībhagavān matsyādidaśamūrtīnāmavatārakramānmasuḥ | ucyate pūrvavaccakramakṣarāṇāṃ samālikhet || 27.1 || sādhāraṇān gṛhītvārṇān yathāpūrvaṃ caturmukha | asādhāraṇarūpaṃ tatsaṃpratyudhriyate kramāt || 27.2 || sparśāntamādyaṃ vijayaṃ candramanvakcaturgatim | ādimagniṃ hṛṣīkeśaṃ pavitraṃ madhusūdanam || 27.3 || śvasanaṃ cāprameyaṃ ca dvādaśārṇāssamīritāḥ | mādhavaṃ puruṣātmānaṃ hṛṣīkeśaṃ ca bindumat || 27.4 || bījamaṅgeṣu yadrūpamasādhāraṇamucyate | sarvāntamādiṃ sarvatra ṣaṭsu cādyaśca bindumān || 27.5 || ādidevaṃ mahāmāyāṃ hṛṣīkeśaṃ ca gopanam | viṣṇumaurvīṃ ṣaḍaṅgeṣu madhyamārṇaṃ kramoditam || 27.6 || uddhṛtyaivaṃ prayoktavyamṛṣirasya manussmṛtaḥ | chandaśca devī gāyatraṃ matsyarūpaḥ paraḥ pūmān || 27.7 || devatā rūparahitaḥ pañcārṇo vā manussmṛtaḥ | bhījaṃ tadaṅgāni tathā sādhanaṃ ca yathāpuram || 27.8 || mūrteranantarāyāstu manvarṇoddhāraṇaṃ śṛṇu | asādhāraṇarūpasya sparśanādi guhālayam || 27.9 || analaṃ mandaraṃ viṣṇuṃ pūrvavaddvādaśākṣaram | bījoddhāraḥ kroḍarūpī bhūdharaśca guhālayaḥ || 27.10 || sānusvāro bījametatṣaḍaṅgāni caturmukha | ṛṣiretasya durvāsā śchandaḥ pūrvavadiṣyate || 27.11 || devatā kamaṭhākāro devassaṃpratyanantaram | varāhavapuṣo mantraṃ varṇacakrātsamuddharet || 27.12 || varuṇo viṣṇuranalaścādidevaśca bhāskaraḥ | gopanaḥ puruṣātmā ca viṣṇurete samuddhṛtāḥ || 27.13 || asyā'sādhāraṇā varṇāḥproktāssādhāraṇāḥ purā | ekādaśākṣarātmāyaṃ bījaṃ saṃprati kathyate || 27.14 || sūkṣmadṛgbinduparyantaṣṣaṭcācāmaṅgapaddhatiḥ | bījameva muniśśaṅkhaśchanto gāyatramiritam || 27.15 || nārāyaṇo devatāsya natyantaśca ṣaḍakṣaraḥ | yadvā pūrvavadevāṅgaṃ bījaṃ ca kamalāsana || 27.16 || trayodaśārṇānuddhṛtya pūrvoktān vyāhṛtitrayam | uddharetpatiśabdaṃ ca caturthyantamanantaram || 27.17 || bhūmeḥ patitvamāśāsyaṃ me dehi tadanantaram | dāhayeti ṭhaṭhāntassyāddvātriṃśadvarṇasantatiḥ || 27.18 || chando'nuṣṭubṛṣiḥ pūrvo devatā sā caturmukha | bījamuktaṃ tadaṅgāni bhaṅtkvā mantraṃ prakalpayet || 27.19 || varṇān karanasaṅkāśān nyase daṅgeṣu pūrvavat | dhyātvā ṣoḍa śalakṣāṇi japenmantramatandhritaḥ || 27.20 || urvarāyāḥ patissadyo bhavenmantraprabhāvataḥ | pātālagamanādīni phalānyasyāpi padmaja || 27.21 || catuṣṣaṣṭyarṇasaṅghāto mālāmantraḥ pradarśyate | trayodaśārṇāḥ prathamamekadaṃṣṭrapadaṃ tataḥ || 27.22 || caturthyantaṃ tathā meghapadaṃ dviḥ procya ca kramāt | ulkāvarṇa padadvandvaṃ caturthyantaṃ tataḥ param || 27.23 || chandoma yapratyayāntaṃ sambadhyantamudīrayet | dvirloḍanto dahirvācyo hantiśca mathireva ca || 27.24 || paciṃ camahadādyantaṃ bhaumeti padayoryugam | huṃ dviruccāryāriśirassvaṃ tathaiva khaniṃ punaḥ || 27.25 || loḍantamāya magneyīmiti mandrapadasthitiḥ | bījamuktaṃ tathāṅgāni bhaṅtkvāmantraṃ prayojayet || 27.26 || jāmadagnya ṛṣiḥproktaśchando'ticchda īritaḥ | devatā devadeveśaḥ sthūlaghoṇavapussmṛtaḥ || 27.27 || lakṣaṃ japedimaṃ mantraṃ bhūmipsuśca caturmukha | mṛtsnayā juhuyāttāvaddyāvadāpnoti medinīm || 27.28 || aṣṭākṣaramanostulyaphaloyaṃ manurīritaḥ | ulkāvarṇaṃ caturthyantamakṣarasyāvasānataḥ || 27.29 || catuṣṣaṣṭi prabhedasya mantrasya nṛharermayā | na vistāraḥ kathayituṃ śakyate boddhumeva vā || 27.30 || tasmāttricaturo bhedāḥ kathyante kamalāsana | varṇacakrātathoddhārassaṃ pratyekākṣarātmanaḥ || 27.31 || mandrasya kathyate brahman brahmakośapuraskṛtaḥ | nṛsiṃhaḥ karṣaṇobindurityekākṣaramiritam || 27.32 || etadeva bhave daṅgaṃ chando gāyatramucyate | devo muniśca durvāsā nṛsiṃho devatā matā || 27.33 || varṇaśca pāṭalo lakṣatrayaṃ japyaṃ vipaśchitā | jigīṣuṇā caturvargaphalamanyacca kāṅkṣitam || 27.34 || triyakṣaraṃ ca natyantameta devāṅgamapyataḥ | aṣṭākṣarātmano'syaiva mantrosyoddhāraṇaṃ kramāt || 27.35 || praṇavo natiranvakca vighneśo madhusūdanaḥ | analaścādirinduśca rāmo'nusvāra eva ca || 27.36 || gopatirgopanaśśaṅkho viṣṇuraṣṭākṣara ssmṛtaḥ | bījamuktaṃ tathāṅgāni munirvyāso'nyadīritam || 27.37 || japasaṅkhyā phalānyasya tathaiva kamalāsana | saptākṣaraṃ ca natyantamanyatpraṇavavarjitam || 27.38 || bījādi pūrvavatsarvaṃ paṅcāṅgo japa eva ca | sādhāraṇāssaptavarṇāḥ pañcā'sādhāraṇā stathā || 27.39 || pūrvoktadvādaśārṇātmā śaṅkhodarasamāhvayaḥ | yathāpūrvaṃ ṣaḍaṅgāni bījaṃ caiva yathāpuram || 27.40 || pratyakṣaraṃ lakṣajapo homastarpaṇameva ca | puruṣārthasya sarvasya sādhakassādhvanuṣṭhitaḥ || 27.41 || mantronṛsiṃhavapuṣo dvātriṃśārṇātmako'paraḥ | vakṣyate tasya varṇānāmuddhārassaṃ pradarśyate || 27.42 || chandasāmādirudayo gadī vahniracāṃ mukham | yaṣṭiḥkumbho mahāmāyā jvalano vaiṣṇava stathā || 27.43 || sparśāntaṃ dviracāmādi dvādaśātmāca gopanaḥ | parjanto bindurugrātmā pracaṇḍaścodaya stathā || 27.44 || mandaro janmahantā ca pīyūṣātmā savaiṣṇavaḥ | mahendro vāṅmukhaṃ padma pāṇirvijayasaṃjñitaḥ || 27.45 || arthacandrākṛtiśśuklaḥ praṇavādirvibhāvasuḥ | varuṇaścāprameyaśca vai rājo brahmasādhanaḥ || 27.46 || sparśāntamudaya ssparśadvitīyaṃ viṣṇudaivatam | mādhavaṃ bhadrapāṇiṃ ca padmanābhaḥ kalātmakaḥ || 27.47 || trivikramo dhruvaḥ puṣā svarādirmandarassmṛtaḥ | bhallāyudho mahāmāyā krodharūpī ca vaiṣṇavaḥ || 27.48 || vanamālī svarādiśca mādhavassūkṣmalocanaḥ | aprameyo vaidharaśca jvalanoṅkārasaṃyutaḥ || 27.49 || dvirmandaraḥ padmanābho vijayaśca caturgatiḥ | udayo mandaraśirāḥ padametadanantaram || 27.50 || varṇāni susamīkṛtya namāmyahamudīrayet | virāḍṛṣiranuṣṭupca chando naraharissmṛtaḥ || 27.51 || devatā bījamasyoktaṃ mantraṃ bhaṅtkvāṅgakalpanā | nyāsaśchāṅgeṣu pūrvoktakrameṇa kamalāsana || 27.52 || dhyāyetsphaṭikavarṇābhaṃ japasaṅkhyā ca pūrvavat | mantro'yaṃ nārasiṃhasya sakalāpannivāraṇaḥ || 27.53 || samastasampajjanano vācyonaiva ca kasya cit | ucyate narasiṃhasya mālāmantraḥ ścaturmukha || 27.54 || adhikaṃ saptadaśabhirvarṇairarṇaśata trayam | prathamaṃ chanda sāmādirnatiśca tadanantaram || 27.55 || caturthyantaṃ padaṃ vācyaṃ narasiṃheti mantriṇā | tadeva ca mahatpūrvaṃ devadānavapūrvakam || 27.56 || śoṇiteti padaṃ paścāddigdhapūrvaṃ sakhottaram | padamekaṃ caturthyantaṃ namo'ntaṃ samudīrayet || 27.57 || paca graneti ca padaṃ śuṣirṇyanta ssamuddhṛtaḥ | granthirṇijanto hantiśca santirloṇmadhyamodayaḥ || 27.58 || huṃ phaṭtadantaraṃ procya tathā kalipadaṃ tataḥ | careti ca lupetyuktvākṣareti tadanantaram || 27.59 || hāṃ hoṃkhara ciraṃ caiva dūṃ hyoṃ jvalanameva ca | jvaliśśucirdravissphoṭirṇyanto loṇmadhyamodayaḥ || 27.60 || bhidiśchidiḥ taṃ vikaro loṇmadhyamaśirāstataḥ | hisimṛṅbhyāṃṇijantābhyāṃ loṇmadhyamamudīrayet || 27.61 || āṃpūrvo nayatirloṭi huṃphaḍantamudīritam | dravadraveti ca tato vipūrvaṃ tadvayaṃ punaḥ || 27.62 || pātālāntaṃ sarvaśabdaṃ vāsināmiti paścimam | hṛdayādīni kathaye tkṛṣirṇyantaśca madhyame || 27.63 || aj pūrvovidviṣirṇvanto loṭi sambuddhiśīrṣakam | bhagavatpadamuccārya nārāyaṇapadaṃ tataḥ || 27.64 || vāsudevahṛṣīkeśapadadvitayamirayet | dānavādirlaḍantaśca jahi rākṣasapūrvakam || 27.65 || antaketi padaṃ paścāduktvā kāmodakī dhanuḥ | dhareti garuḍādiṃ ca dhvajāntaṃ padamabjaja || 27.66 || tripūrvadhāmannityetannatirastviti te padam | tvāṃ prapanno'smiti paṭhedevamuccārya te manuḥ || 27.67 || bījamuktaṃ ṣaḍaṅgāni procyate padaśo'dhunā | praṇavādiśca satyantaścaturthyantaśca vigrahaḥ || 27.68 || puruṣādimukhādiśca narasiṃhapadaṃ tathā | vajraśabdaṃ dviruccārya kramācca nakhavigrahau || 27.69 || vajreti nakhadaṃṣṭreti coktvāyudhapadaṃ tataḥ | mahānarapadaṃ siṃhaparyantaṃ ṣaṣṭhamiritam || 27.70 || aniruddho muniśchandastvatipūrvaṃ ca devatā | nṛsiṃhārūpī bhagavāniti sarvamudīrayan || 27.71 || biladvāri japenmanmrīṣoḍaśa prayatasthsitaḥ | lakṣāṇi sadyaḥ pātālavāsinaḥ kurute vaśe || 27.72 || lokāntaragatānāṃ ca vaśīkārakṣamo bhavet | etāvantiphalānyasyetyabhidhātuṃ na śakyate || 27.73 || ato'nyaṃ nārasiṃhasya mantraṃ sarvārtha sādhakam | catuśśatākṣaraṃ tasya samuddhāraḥ pradarśyate || 27.74 || ādāvuddīthamuddhṛtya natyantaṃ brahmasādhanam | bhallāyudhaṃ gadadhvaṃsaṃ vāruṇaṃ vijayaṃ tathā || 27.75 || mādhavaṃ bhadrahastaṃ ca pāvakaṃ śvetadīdhitam | vikramaṃ sadhruvaṃ brahman bhāskaraṃ madhuvidviṣam || 27.76 || śvasanaṃ vuruṇaṃ janmahantāramṛtadhārakam | dviradaṃ sarva dāhaṃ syādvaidharaṃ tadanantaram || 27.77 || acāmādiṃ sadhruvaṃ ca krodharūpamadhokṣajam | saparvataṃ hutavaha māvrataṃ madhuvidviṣam || 27.78 || mārutaṃ mādhavaṃ brahman dhanadaṃ madhusūdanam | daraṃ sacandhraṃ pullaṃ ca mādhavaṃ nagavāriṇam || 27.79 || savikramañca kamalaṃ parvataṃ pāśapāṇinam | sabandhuṃ kamalaṃ pañca bindumastaka bhūṣitam || 27.80 || sumukhaṃ cāgni śirasaṃ karālaṃ mṛgavallabham | kṣapākaraṃ tathāyāntaṃ yāmanīnāthamabjaja || 27.81 || hṛdayāhloda mākāraṃ caturgatimanantaram | nṛhariṃ bhuvanaṃ sūkṣmalocanaṃ rāmarśīkam || 27.82 || vijayaṃ pāṭalaṃ bhānuṃ sūdanaṃ sumukhaṃ tathā | yāntaṃ tacchirasaṃ paścā dvāruṇaṃ gajavāhanam || 27.83 || vāsudevaṃ tathākrodha rūpamākāramārutau | vaidharaṃ sūdanaṃ bhadra hastaṃ vāruṇamaindavam || 27.84 || vatsotadehaṃ sumukhaṃ vikramaṃ vijayābhidham | dṛṣṭivikrama pāśāntasubhāgārpitavighnarāṭ || 27.85 || taddvitīyamacāmādidvitayaṃ śvasanaṃ tathā | mādhavaṃ saddhruvaṃ bhānumāntaṃ mādhavabhāskarau || 27.86 || rāmaṃ bhallāyudhaṃ pañca antakaṃ syātsudhārasam | bhadrahastamacāmādi bhānta mādharāsūdanau || 27.87 || bhadraṃ vasuṃ śvetaruciṃ vikramaṃ saddhruvaṃ tathā | mārtāṇḍaṃ mādhavaṃ bhānuṃ gopanaṃ nāntamādharau || 27.88 || yāntaṃ saśrīdharaṃ cograṃ vasuṃ vāruṇagodhanau | kuśeśayaṃ mādhavaṃ ca sumukhaṃ kaustubhaṃ tathā || 27.89 || vighneśaṃ gopanaṃ brahman rohitāśvaṃ sagopanam | vasanaṃ sumukhaṃ paścādvāruṇaṃ madhuvidviṣam || 27.90 || dākṣāyaṇīśamudayaṃ vaidharaṃ mādhavaṃ tataḥ | amṛtaṃ vaidharamacāṃ dvitīyaṃ bhāntamajjaja || 27.91 || otadehaṃ tathā dṛṣṭiṃ yāntamākāramakṣaram | vakratuṇḍaṃ gandhavahaṃ viṣṭaraṃ vijayaṃ tathā || 27.92 || amṛtaṃ vikramaparaṃ śrīvatsaṃ varuṇārpitam | yāntaṃ guhālayaṃ nāntaṃ ṣāntaṃ ca madhusūdanam || 27.93 || saddhruvaṃ druhiṇaṃ krodhaṃ pāvakaṃ sumukhaṃ punaḥ | sapaścimaṃ padmanābhaṃ vaidharaṃ ca caturmukha || 27.94 || pavamānaṃ sabhuvanaṃ bhāntaṃ kuṅjaragopanau | bhadrahastaṃ sarāmaṃ ca yāntaṃ syācchrīdharaṃ tathā || 27.95 || bhadraṃ ca dhanadaṃ pāpahananaṃ jayamantarau | vighneśaṃ sūdanaṃ bhallaṃ bhāskaraṃ syācca turgatim || 27.96 || śubhadaṃ vāmanaparamugraṃ vasuśira stathā | pradyotanaṃ tathā yāntamṛtadhā mogravāmanau || 27.97 || kamalaṃ mādhavaparaṃ sanasīruhasambhava | vāntaṃ ca śubhadaṃ daṇḍaṃ kharvaṃ ghaḍgadharaṃ punaḥ || 27.98 || sarojamṛtadhāmānaṃ katṛtīyaṃ ca vaidharam | acāṃ dvitīyaṃ dhanadaṃ bahulaṃ sauramādharau || 27.99 || nāsikyaṃ ca samuccārya huṃphaṭ śīrṣāṇi yojayet | trayodaśāni bījāni huṃphaḍantāni yojayet || 27.100 || bījākṣareṣu pratyekaṃ huṃphaṭkāramudīrayet | dvādaśāṅgavidāṃ procyaṃ bhāskaraṃ saguhālayam || 27.101 || nāsikyaṃ nṛhariṃ caurvaṃ candrārdhaṃ yāntamauṣadham | saddhruvaṃ mārutaṃ corvīṃ sadaṇḍaṃ ca kṣapākaram || 27.102 || samaraṃ saddhruvaṃ bhānumaurvaṃ nāsikyamabjaja | pradyotanaṃ sabhuvanamardhenduṃ sāntameva ca || 27.103 || sāgniṃ savāmanaṃ sārdhaṃ candraṃ caiva saroruham | vāsavaṃ vāmanavaraṃ saddhruvaṃ katṛtīyakam || 27.104 || mahendramaurvaṃ nāsikyaṃ mādhavaṃ dviradānanam | subhadraṃ śrīdharaṃ bhadrahastaṃ gāruḍameva ca || 27.105 || citrabhānuṃ śaśadharaṃ pīyūṣaṃ vasuśīrṣakam | mārutaṃ bhadrahastaṃ ca vijayaṃ vasusūdanau || 27.106 || pracaṇḍaṃ bandhusahitaṃ vrakatuṇḍaṃ guhālayam | sumukhārṇaṃca saptārcirdaraṃ candramacāṃ mukham || 27.107 || apāmadhipatiṃ cāgniṃ jṛmbhalaṃ dviradānanam | dhanadaṃ varuṇaṃ māyāṃ bhāntaṃ syādbrahmasādhanam || 27.108 || pannagaṃ sumukhaṃ pāpahananaṃ yāntamabjaja | amṛtaṃ vikramayutaṃ vaidharaṃ dhūliketanam || 27.109 || gopanaṃ saddhruvaṃ candraṃ sārdhenduṃ bhāskaraṃ vasum | napaścimaṃ hutavahaṃ matimadvāsanaṃ tataḥ || 27.110 || pāṭalaṃ sarvarodhaṃ syātkuñjaraṃ mandaradvayam | lakṣmīṃ savijayaṃ cāgniṃ hṛṣīkeśaṃ caturmukha || 27.111 || bhadrahastaṃ mānuṣekhaṃ sūdhanaṃ harimandiram | śaṅkhaṃ kalānidhimapāṃ nāthaṃ vasumadhudviṣau || 27.112 || paścimaṃ vijayaṃ cāgniṃ subhadraṃ puruṣātmakam | kalānidhyośca yugalaṃ vāruṇaṃ vasuśīrṣakam || 27.113 || vaidharaṃ madhuvidhveṣaṃ mādhavīṃ madhuvidviṣam | ārdhacandraṃ hutavahamanantaṃ ca dviruddharet || 27.114 || sāntaṃ savikramaṃ sendraṃ bindumastakabhūṣitam | daśa pañcha ca bījāni huṃphadantāni pūrvavat || 27.115 || mandaraṃ vikrama vaśamaindraṃ traivikramaṃ tathā | khaḍgahastaṃ sarāmaṃ ca vāsavaṃ sahavikramam || 27.116 || vaidharaṃ cordhvalokeśaṃ śrībhījaṃ cānu nāsikam | otadehaṃ sayaṣṭiṃ ca acāmādiṃ sayaṣṭikam || 27.117 || acāṃ dvitīyamardhenduṃ kapilaṃ saṅgiṇaṃ tathā | māṭharaṃ gopanaṃ daṇḍaṃ māṭharaṃ pañcabindukam || 27.118 || nāsikyaṃ bhāskaraṃ vīrasenaṃ yaṣṭiṃ ca bhāskaram | otadehaṃ sayaṣṭiṃ ca patanaṃ caurvanāsikau || 27.119 || rohitāśvaṃ ca kalaśaṃ vikramaṃ kamalāsana | vāsudevaṃ sahṛdayāhlodanaṃ bandumastakam || 27.120 || śuklaṃ sahasrakiraṇamaindavaṃ cāgnimastakam | vairiṃcaṃ bandhusahitaṃ pāvakaṃ sumukhaṃ tathā || 27.121 || paścimaṃ tvṛtadhāmānaṃ kakubhā hvamanantaram | savāruṇaṃ surapatiṃ sabandhuṃ vijayaṃ tathā || 27.122 || lakṣmīṃ madhudviṣamatho ekadaṃṣṭragatiṃ punaḥ | agniśīrṣaṃ dvitīyaṃ ca jhaṣaṃ pañcāntakaṃ matam || 27.123 || druhiṇaṃ codayaṃ brahman vāsavaṃ vāmanaṃ tataḥ | śubhadaṃ paścimamacāṃ dvitīyaṃ kamalāsana || 27.124 || dvitīyaṃ saddhruvaṃ cābja yoniṃ śrīdharapaṅkaje | śrīvatsamabjaṃ vijayaṃ kāmamastaka mandaram || 27.125 || udayaṃ śukraśatruṃ ca vijayaṃ brahmasādhanam | mandaraṃ yāntadhanadaṃ yāntaṃ candraghaṭaṃ vasuṃ || 27.126 || bhallāyudhaṃ hṛṣīkeśameka netraṃ ghanaṃ punaḥ | sabandhuṃ mandaraṃ dṛṣṭiyugalaṃ cāgniśīrṣakam || 27.127 || bhadraṃ caturgatimatho phaṇīndraṃ yāntasūdanau | nṛhariṃ kalānidhimacā mādiṃ yāntaṃ madhudviṣam || 27.128 || katṛtīyaṃ gadadhvaṃsaṃ vighneśaṃ naravāhanam | amṛtaṃ vasunāmānaṃ dharitrīṃ madhusūdanam || 27.129 || kamalaṃ vikramaparaṃ yāntaṃ vāmanahastakam | nāstaṃ guṇālayaṃ caiva ṇāntaṃ ḍhāntaṃ madhudviṣam || 27.130 || paścimaṃ caindavamatho bhāntārpitasa gopanam | dhanadaṃ cotavapuṣaṃ bhadraṃ dakṣaṃ ca sūdanam || 27.131 || vaidharaṃ caindiramacāṃ dvitīyaṃ kamalāsana | trivikramaṃ bhadrakaraṃ mahāmāyāṅkitaṃ vasum || 27.132 || mṛgeśaṃ varuṇaṃ caiva vairājaṃ pañcabindukam | kṣapārakaraṃ kañjabhavaṃ tatassyādvighnanāyakam || 27.133 || sadṛṣṭiṃ vaidharaṃ devadattaṃ kumbhaṃ caturmukha | gataṃ sṛtadhāmāhvaṃ mārtāṇḍaṃ pāśahastakam || 27.134 || samādhavaṃ syāddvijayaṃ gopanaṃ viṣamadhvanim | sarasīruhaṃ sordhvalokaṃ sarasīruhasambhana || 27.135 || padmā sa mandarākārau pracaṇḍajhaṣasaṃmitau | vaidharaṃ varuṇaṃ rāmaṃ bhūdharaṃ vahnimastakam || 27.136 || jṛmbhalaṃ tvṛtadhāmā ca syātāṃ bhāskaramandarau | ādyantaṃ yāntamākāraṃ gāruḍaṃ himadīdhitim || 27.137 || oṅkārādiṃ śaśadharaṃ sa viṣṇuṃ varuṇaṃ vasum | sudhārasaṃ pracaṇḍāgniṃ bhave dṛtamanantaram || 27.138 || krodharūpaṃ sarāmaṃ ca gadaṃ ca ṛtadhāmakam | gopatiṃ vāruṇapatiṃ vikramaṃ yādasāṃ patim || 27.139 || madhudviṣaṃ hutavahaṃ pracaṇḍaṃ yāminīpatim | sudhārasaṃ vasuyutaṃ janmadhvaṃsamapāṃ patim || 27.140 || yāntaṃ sudhārasaṃ bandhuṃ dvidvirākāramindirām | dviradaṃ pāpahananaṃ madhusūdanamabjaja || 27.141 || vijayākāra garbhāśca ākāravidhumādarāḥ | pāvakaṃ pītavarṇābhaṃ brahmasādhanamabjaja || 27.142 || bhadravikramatoyeśamākārendusavikramāḥ | ibhākāraṃ tato dyumnabhāskarā bhūtavaidharāḥ || 27.143 || mārutākāra bhadrāśca māntākāramahotpalāḥ | ugrātmavasuvāyavyasūdanā vidhirabjaja || 27.144 || ugraśīrṣakamārutyau paścima dyutimaindavam | vāmanaṃ vaidharaṃ sūkṣmalocanaṃ katṛtīyakam || 27.145 || kumbhaṃ bhadrakaraṃ cāpi mādhavīṃ bhāskaraṃ madhu | sādanaṃ tridaśāhāraṃ vikramaṃ cograrūpakam || 27.146 || pracaṇḍamotadehaṃ ca śubhadaṃ vittavardhanam | pāpakaṃ sumukhaṃ bhadrahastaṃ vai ruhamakṣaram || 27.147 || kumbhaṃ sudarśanaṃ caiva kapilākṣaṃ caturmukha | dviḥ prapannosmītipadaṃ samuccārya pitāmaha || 27.148 || brahmakośaṃ puraskṛtya nṛhariṃ cānalaṃ tathā | brahmasādhananāsikyau bhījaṃ proktamataḥ param || 27.149 || nigamādiṃ subhadraṃ ca pāṭalaṃ saddhruvaṃ tathā | mantrasya śaktimuddhṛtya cchandasāmādimuddharet || 27.150 || gāruḍaṃ madhuhantāraṃ nāsikyaṃ vijayaṃ vasuṃ | sapadmanābhaṃ māyāṃ ca sūkṣmadṛṅmādhavaṃ ghaṭam || 27.151 || bhadrahastaṃ vaidharaṃ ca śrīdharaṃ cāgnivikramau | vairājaṃ bhāskaraṃ yāntaṃ madhu śatru samiraṇau || 27.152 || mandaraṃ māṭharamacāṃ dvitīyaṃ vighṇu pāvakau | kalānidhiṃ sabandhuṃ ca sārdhacandraṃ tviṣāṃ patim || 27.153 || sūdanaṃ śaṅkhamaparaṃ katṛtīyaṃ caturmukha | sāntaṃ vasuyutaṃ caiva dviruccārya caturmukha || 27.154 || huṃphaḍantaṃ ca natyantaṃ hṛnmantraṃ parikīrtitam | vedādiṃ vannagaṃ pañcabindubhūṣitamantakam || 27.155 || vāsikyaṃ bhadrahascaṃ ca madhudveṣiṃ vasuṃ tathā | aindavaṃ vikramaparaṃ nāsikyaṃ bhāskaraṃ ghaṭam || 27.156 || sabandhuṃ kamalaṃ padmanābhaṃ vāmana hastakam | puṇḍarīkaṃ sabandhuṃ ca vai rājaṃ vaidharaṃ tataḥ || 27.157 || godhanaṃ vijayaṃ māntaṃ vaidharaṃ madhusūdanam | mānuṣaṃ cāmṛtaṃ bhadrakaraṃ gopanapadmajau || 27.158 || sagopanadaraṃ caiva mādharaṃ katṛtīyakam | ṛtaṃ ca saindhavaṃ bandhuṃ sadhruvaṃ māṭharaṃ tvacām || 27.159 || dvitīyaṃ puruṣaṃ brahman mādhavīṃ mādharaṃ punaḥ | bhṛgukhaḍgaraṃ caiva dviruccāryamataḥ param || 27.160 || huṃphaḍantaṃ śiromantraṃ ṭhaṭha ityavasānakam | vedādimuragaṃ ṣaṣṭhamacāmardhendumaindavam || 27.161 || pullanetraṃ sabhuvanaṃ garhitaṃ bhūdharātmakam | kumbhaṃ savikramaṃ padmaṃ kheṭakī kalaśaṃ tvacām || 27.162 || tṛtīyaṃ kamalaṃ pañcabinduṃ sumukhamabjaja | yāntaṃ ca śirasāmabjayonimeṇeśamaindavam || 27.163 || svāhādharaṃ śaśadharaṃ mukhaṃ bhūdharasūdanau | caturgatiṃ śatānandaṃ vāsudevaṃ napaścimam || 27.164 || kalānidhiṃ sarāmaṃ ca yaṣṭiṃ bhāsragopanau | caturgatiṃ kharvadehaṃ sūdanaṃ bhānuvikramau || 27.165 || dvirabhyaseddhuṃphaḍantaṃ śiromantramudīritam | devānāṃ dāsavacanamante saṃyojya mantravit || 27.166 || oṅkāraṃ nṛhariṃ vīnasenaṃ nāsikyamaindavam | māṭharaṃ yāminīnāthamṛtadhāmasadarbhitam || 27.167 || ākhaṇḍaleśaṃ sarpeśamākāraṃ katṛtīyakam | dviradaṃ vikramaparaṃ bahulaṃ ghaṭavikramau || 27.168 || ambhoruhaṃ cotadehaṃ hṛdayāhlodavikramau | kalānidhiṃ subhadrāntaṃ sumukhāntaṃ samādhavam || 27.169 || chāntaṃ śaśadharaṃ devadattaṃ cāntaṃ sakumbhakam | aindraṃ ca kuñjaramukhaṃ pīyūṣadyutivikramau || 27.170 || sayaṣṭiṃ dyumaṇiṃ cādi devaṃ yāntaṃ himālayam | nadaṇḍaṃ garuḍaṃ bandhuṃ paścimaṃ ca dviruddharet || 27.171 || huṃpaḍhantaṃ ca kavacaṃ huṃphaṭśīrṣaṃ prakīrtitam | āgamādiṃ narahariṃ caurvaṃ nāsikya mabjaja || 27.172 || vaidharaṃ godhanaṃ ṇāntaṃ mārutyaṃ vaidharaṃ madhu | sūdanaṃ bhadrahastaṃ ca pīyūṣaṃ sarasīruham || 27.173 || gopanaṃ pulahaṃ caiva sūdanaṃ murutaṃ vasum | kūṭaṃ pullāyudhamacāṃ ṣaṣṭhaṃ vai rājameva ca || 27.174 || katṛtīyaṃ padmanābhaṃ bhāskaraṃ madhuvidviṣam | dṛṣṭiṃ savāmanaṃ bhadrahastaṃ sāgniṃ samuddharet || 27.175 || bhāskaraṃ bhadrahastaṃ ca taddviruccāryamantravit | paścimaṃ vakratuṇḍaṃ ca mandaraṃ supratiṣṭhitam || 27.176 || tānudīryāthamantrajñassubhadraṃ caindavaṃ punaḥ | sadakṣaṃ vāmanaśirā ambhoruhaniketana || 27.177 || ambhoruhaṃ sabhuvanaṃ pāvakaṃ bhuvanaṃ tathā | nṛhariṃ pāpahananaṃ vikramaṃ vijayaṃ punaḥ || 27.178 || vairiñcaṃ vāmanaṃ dakṣamaugraṃ dakṣaṃ caturmukha | guhālayaṃ savijayamagniśīrṣaṃ ca mārutam || 27.179 || aiṇeśaṃ mandaraṃ bhānuṃ sūdanaṃ vighnanāyakam | yāntaṃ tārādhipaṃ māyāṃ saddhruvaṃ māṭharaṃ tathā || 27.180 || madhudviṣaṃ mārutaṃ ca huṃpha ḍastraṃ prakīrtitam | astraśabdaṃ caturthyantaṃ phaḍantaṃ ca samuddharet || 27.181 || udgīthaṃ nṛhariṃ sargamandharaṃ māṭharaṃ tvacām | dvitīyaṃ paścimaṃ padmanābhaṃ cādisamanvitam || 27.182 || khaḍgahastaṃ ca sumukhaṃ medinyāḥ padamambujam | sagopanaṃ surapatiṃ gopanaṃ khadvitīyakam || 27.183 || bhadrahastaṃ sarāmaṃ ca vāsavaṃ brahmasādhanam | khaḍgahastaṃ gajamukhaṃ sūdanaṃ ca caturgatim || 27.184 || ācāmādiṃ gajamukhamauṣadhaṃ nā ntamabjaja | mādhavīṃ murutaṃ yāntaṃ mādharaṃ paścimaṃ tathā || 27.185 || sabandhuṃ sapracaṇḍaṃ cāpyeṇeśaṃ pāṭalapriyam | mārtāṇḍaṃ madhuvidveṣiṃ bhadraṃ syādṛtadhāmakam || 27.186 || dākṣāyaṇīśaṃ rāmaṃ syādanusvāraṃ caturmukha | divākaraṃ cādidevaṃ daraṃ vaidharagopanau || 27.187 || pāvakaṃ puruṣātmānaṃ dviruktaṃ kamalāsana | huṃphaḍantaṃ ca netrābhyāṃ vauṣaṭkāraṃ prayujya ca || 27.188 || evaṃ nyasya vidhānajño viṣkambhāntaṃ sadaṇḍakam | divākarasahasrābhaṃ hṛdayārṇaṃ ṣaḍuddharet || 27.189 || utpalaṃ kumudaṃ rakta japābandhūkariṃśukam | pāṭalaṃ hṛdayādīnāṃ varṇaṣṣaṇṇāṃ kramādbhavet || 27.190 || rakṣāmantraṃ pravakṣyāmi chandasāmādimuddharet | vighneśaṃ padmanābhaṃ syāddvijarājaṃ savikramam || 27.191 || sadaṇḍaṃ ca samārtāṇḍaṃ bahulaṃ saguhālayam | paścimaṃ vāmanaparaṃ pracaṇḍaṃ hariṇaṃ bhavet || 27.192 || bhallāyudhaṃ gadadhvaṃsaṃ lāntaṃ bhadrakaraṃ tathā | ācāmādiṃ dinamaṇiṃ mādhavaṃ sauramakṣaram || 27.193 || eṇeśaṃ dhanadaṃ dakṣaṃ vasuśīrṣaṃ ca sūdanam | dhanādhyakṣaṃ tathā dakṣaṃ pāvakaṃ mastakasthitam || 27.194 || dhāntaṃ savikramaṃ khāntaṃ hāntaṃ syātkapilaṃ punaḥ | dviradāsyaṃ banduparaṃ mādhavīṃ yāntaśīrṣakam || 27.195 || vāsudevaṃ khaḍgadharaṃ caturgatimanantaram | mukhaṃ savaidharaṃ brahmanmāṭharaṃ taddhviruddharet || 27.196 || pavitramaprameyaṃ syāttuṇḍaṃ cādisamandaram | sarvarodhaṃ dvirucchārya kamalaṃ savirocanam || 27.197 || yathāpuraṃ sadaṇḍaṃ ca sūdanaṃ yāntamārutau | dvirvaktavyaṃ subhadraṃ ca vikramaṃ vighnavaidharau || 27.198 || tadviruddhaśchaladhviṃsī banduvighnaṃ savaidharam | aindiraṃ cotadehaṃ ca ugraṃ māntaṃ caturmukha || 27.199 || atriṃ cāgniṃ madhudveṣamamṛtaṃ dhūliketanam | tārkṣyaṃ sarṅkaṇaṃ daṇḍaṃ tadviruccārya padmaja || 27.200 || mārtāṇḍamūrdhvanāsikyaṃ tadudīryamataḥ param | pāvakaṃ caurvaśirasaṃ sadaṇḍaṃ gopanaṃ tathā || 27.201 || gadadhvaṃsaṃ chaladhvaṃsaṃ tadudīrya jayaṃ tathā | vairājaṃ yāntaśirasaṃ śuklaṃ vai rājapāvakau || 27.202 || jṛmbhalaṃ samatā brahman māṭharaṃ dakṣasaṃjñitam | pracaṇḍaṃ mādhavaṃ caiva kalaśaṃ bandhuśīrṣakam || 27.203 || kamalāṃ vāruṇaṃ yāntaṃ hṛṣīkeśaṃ ca paścimam | māyā jitaṃ pracaṇḍaṃ ca mādhavaṃ ca ṭhaṭhāntimam || 27.204 || bījamaṅgāni coktāni durvāsā ṛṣirucyate | chando bastaṃ devatā ca mahānaraharirhariḥ || 27.205 || mālāmantre trivarṇāssyuśśukla pīta sitāsitāḥ | tatvaṃ ca paramāpyoma sakalīkaraṇaṃ tathā || 27.206 || vikalīkaraṇaṃ caiva mantra syāpyāyanaṃ bhavet | mocanaṃ caiva ityete kathitāḥ kamalāsana || 27.207 || catuṣṣaṣṭividhe mantre nārasiṃhe mahānayam | nṛsiṃho vyomacakrākhyaḥ pātālākhyaśca sūribhiḥ || 27.208 || dhyāyenmṛtyubhaye kṛtyāpraveśe yudhi vidviṣām | uccāṭane saṃhanane bhūtānāmapanodane || 27.209 || ākhyāyate dhyānamasya smṛtaṃ sa vitṛmaṇḍale | madhye vikasvare śubhre paṅkaje viṣṭarodare || 27.210 || āsīnaṃ ṣoḍaśamukhaṃ bhujai stadviguṇai ryutam | āyudhaiśśajñacakrādyairdurdarśairaśmimālibhiḥ || 27.211 || paracakrapratikṣepe duṣkareṣvanyakarmasu | brahmā dvādaśāṅgāni yevettimantraṃ sorhati veditum || 27.212 || ityuktaṃ bhagavan bhūyo jijñāsā teṣu vartate | śrībhagavān bījaṃ śaktistathaivāṅgaṃ hṛdayādi ca ṣaḍvidham || 27.213 || ṛṣiśchando devatā ca varṇoddīpanameva ca | apyāyanaṃ mocanaṃ ca sakalīkaraṇaṃ tathā || 27.214 || vikalīkaraṇaṃ caiva dvādaśaitāni padmaja | teṣāṃ svarūpaṃ vakṣyāmi kramāttadavadhāryatām || 27.215 || mantrasya prakṛtirbījamakṣaraṃ tatsamuddhṛtam | ātmāmantrasya sā śaktiryathā mantra phalapradaḥ || 27.216 || hṛdayādīni mantrasya ṣaḍaṅgāni pitāmaha | devasyeva mukhādīni eṣu mantraḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ || 27.217 || ṛṣiḥ phalasya draṣṭā pyācchandastadabhidhīyate | akṣarāṇāmiyattā yā devatā vācyamucyate || 27.218 || rūpabhedaśca śuklādivarṇaḥ kamalasambhava | saṃpuṭīkaraṇaṃ rephalakārābhyāṃ tu dīpanam || 27.219 || yathoditākṣaraissarvaissaṃskāraśśoṣaṇādibhiḥ | mantrasya dehavatproktaṃ yattadāpyāyanaṃ budhaiḥ || 27.220 || mantrasya mocanaṃ nāma prayogastambhanādiṣu | mantrākṣarāṇāṃ pratyekaṃ saṃpuṭīkaraṇaṃ smṛtam || 27.221 || sakalīkaraṇaṃ viddhi praṇavena caturmukha | vauṣaṭkāravaṣaṭkārahuṃ kāraiḥ pṛthagīritaiḥ || 27.222 || devatānāmabhīṣṭānāṃ sannidhiryaḥ puṭādiṣu | prārthyete sa caturvaktra vikalīkaraṇāhvayaḥ || 27.223 || etānyena prayuñjīta vidyayorādyayorapi | ekādaśākṣaro mantro vāmanasya pradarśyate || 27.224 || pūrvoditāssaptavarṇāḥ viśessamudīryate | pīyūṣamādidevaṃ ca mandharaṃ cādimuddharet || 27.225 || vighneśaṃ gopanaṃ vāyumādyaṃ ceti caturmukha | bījaṃ śirasyūrdvaloko yaṣṭiśceti caturgatim || 27.226 || aṅgāni ṣaṭphalādīni svarāntānyānupūrvaśaḥ | sānusvārāṇi yojyāni kāśyapho muniriṣyate || 27.227 || chandaśca daivaṃ gāyatraṃ vāmano devatā punaḥ | lakṣāṇyekādaśa jape home ca jalatarpaṇe || 27.228 || tatassidhyati mantroyaṃ puruṣārthacatuṣṭayam | phalamanyacca yacceṣṭa maṣṭākṣaravadīritam || 27.229 || omādinatipūrvāṇi catvāryādyāni pūrvavat | saptākṣarasyamantrasya sādhanaṃ ca yathāpuram || 27.230 || saptalakṣajāpāduktaṃ phalamāpnoti mantravit | gṛhītvārṇān sapta pūrvanvairājo gnistrivikramaḥ || 27.231 || yadādhipaśca māyā ca sparśādiranalonmukham | sparśāntaścādidevaśca śaṅkho viṣṇuritīritaḥ || 27.232 || dvādaśārṇātmako mantrastadeva kamalāsana | trivikramasya bījaṃ ca bhāskaro viṣṇureva ca || 27.233 || ardhacandrākṛti śceti tadevāṅgaṃ ca ṣaḍvidham | ṛṣiśca devatā chandaḥ pūrvoktānyeva sādhanam || 27.234 || pūrvavatphalamasyāpi rājyādiprāptiriṣyate | na tvekaṃ śakyate vaktumānantyātphalasampadām || 27.235 || rāmasya jāmadagnyasya mantroddhāraścaturmukha | gṛhītvā pūrvavatsaptavarṇān sādhāraṇāṃ stataḥ || 27.236 || asādhāraṇavarṇānāṃ kramāduddhāraṇaṃ śṛṇu | janmahantā gopanaśca mādhavī viṣṇura svataḥ || 27.237 || dṛṣṭiśchādirgadī bhadrapāṇirvāyuśca gopanaḥ | caturgatissvarādiśca vahnirākāra eva ca || 27.238 || mandharāśchādidevaścaśvasano viṣṇurabjaja | huṃpaḍanta iti proktāmantrassaptadaśākṣaraḥ || 27.239 || analaḥ praṇavādiśca sayaṣṭirbījamiritam | etadevāṅgamāvṛttaṃ ṣaṭkṛtvo gārgyadarśanaḥ || 27.240 || chandaśca daivaṃ gāyatraṃ jāmadagnyosya devatā | japeddviṃśatilakṣāṇi tatassarvārthasādhanaḥ || 27.241 || daśākṣaro'thavā mantrojāmadagnyapadaṃ vinā | bhījādi sarvaṃ purvoktaṃ mantraśśatrukṣayāvahaḥ || 27.242 || mantro rāmāvatārasya brahman dāśarathervaraḥ | kathyate bharatādīnāṃ taddevīnāṃ manuḥ kramāt || 27.243 || dvādaśākṣaramārabhya mantraṃ tadanu padmaja | caturmūrtimayāyeti padamuccāryamantravit || 27.244 || abhirāmaśarīreti caturthyantamudīrayet | rāmeti tadvibhaktyantaṃ ṭhaṭheti tadanantaram || 27.245 || dvātriṃśadakṣarātmāyaṃ manuruktaśchaturmukha | bhījamasyānalo viṣṇussānusvāraḥ kramāt smṛtaḥ || 27.246 || aṅgāni ṣaṭca tadbījamakārādi kramādbhavet | aparaṃ rāmamantraṃ te kathayāmi caturmukha || 27.247 || prathaṇaṃ praṇavaṃ procya pañcabinduṃ sayaṣṭikam | caturthyantaṃ caturmūrtipadamuktvātataḥ param || 27.248 || caturgatimayāyeti śaraśārṅgabhṛdanvataḥ | caturthyantaṃ śaratpūrvamindīvarapadaṃ tataḥ || 27.249 || tviṣeti ca padaṃ paścātprayojyaṃ bhagavatpadam | caturdhyantaṃ samuccārya mabhirāmapadaṃ tataḥ || 27.250 || śarīrāyeti ca procya rāmāyeti padaṃ tathā | satyantamiti mantrasya padoddhāraḥ pradarśitaḥ || 27.251 || bījaṃ tadaṅgaṣaṭkaṃ ca tadṛṣiśśarabhaḥ smṛtaḥ | chandaśca pūrvavaddevo rāmātmā bhagavān hariḥ || 27.252 || japedakṣaralakṣaṃ tu tatassidhyati mantrarāṭ | phalaṃ cābhīṣṭamacirāllabhate durlabhaṃ mahat || 27.253 || mātṛkā ca kravinyastānarṇaṣaṇḍān samantritān | abhyarcya kusumaistasminnuddharedbhagavanmayaḥ || 27.254 || ato nyaṃ mantrasaṅghātaṃ mālāmantraṃ yathātatham | vakṣyāmi saṃprati brahman yadhā vadavadhāryatām || 27.255 || ādau nādaṃ saptavarṇaṃ vasuṃ madhunighādanam | sparśāntaṃ gopanaṃ śaṅkhaṃ mukhaṃ viṣṇuṃ jayaṃ tathā || 27.256 || acāṃ pañcamamāhendrā nādādiṃ ghaṭavikramān | śaṅkhinaṃ śikhinaṃ dakṣaṃ karālaṃ vasuniṣṭhitam || 27.257 || hastaṃ madhudviṣaṃ brahman dhūliketanamadimam | nāntayāntau sadakṣāhvā paścimodayamakṣaram || 27.258 || atriṃ ramādharaṃ krodharūpiṇaṃ cānalāhvayam | acāṃ dvitīyaṃ pavanaṃ kalaśaṃ bandhumastakam || 27.259 || ugrātmasumukhau syātāṃ yādonāthamṛgādhipau | dineśamādiṃ nāsikyaṃ śaśāṅkaṃ madhuvidviṣam || 27.260 || vairājaṃ mādhavīṃ bhadrakaraṃ mādhavamabjaja | vakratuṇḍamacāmādiṃ vijayodayasaṃjñitam || 27.261 || pañcāntakaṃ tathā yāntakaṃ mantakasthaṃ jayaṃ punaḥ | rāmamandaraśaṅkhāssyurgopanaṃ pavanaṃ mukham || 27.262 || ādibhallāyudau rāmavasugopanapāṭalau | śrīvatsamādimanalaṃ vāmanāgni madhudviṣam || 27.263 || citurgatiṃ khaḍgadhara mekadṛdvaidharaṃ tathā | dakṣaṃ cāgniṃ hṛṣīkeśa vijayadvayamanvataḥ || 27.264 || yāntaṃ taccirasaṃ paścātpavanaṃ mṛgavallabham | ṛkṣeśamekanayanadaragopanavighnarāṭ || 27.265 || bandhuyāntau ca bhuvanaṃ vaidharau puṇyabhāskarau | śvasanaṃ dakṣabhuvanau cakravighneśasaptamam || 27.266 || acāṃ kāraṇameṇeśakalātmavasuvikramāḥ | karālagopanau pāpahananau vikramaṃ tathā || 27.267 || mahendrakumbhāvanalo madhusūdana bhāskarau | yāntagopanasaptārcirmadhusūdanamārutāḥ || 27.268 || pracaṇḍagopanau khaḍgadhara śrīdharavaijayāḥ | pīyūṣagopanau padmaśrīdharau vanamālinau || 27.269 || meghapañcātmadviradakamalāmadhuvidviṣaḥ | pito mṛgeśapavanagopanāśśukla śrīdharāḥ || 27.270 || pāvakasthāntagovindavai rājadaravaidharāḥ | madhusūdanavighneśasudhārasa samāhvāyāḥ || 27.271 || brahmasādhanasaptārcirgatibhāskarasaptamāḥ | acā mādiṃ dharo vedhāḥ brahmasādhanakheṭakī || 27.272 || agniśca kapilaṃ brahman bhallāyudhasavikramam | vighneśaṃ vaidharaṃ pretanāyakaṃ rāmaśrīrṣakam || 27.273 || bhadrapāṇiṃ tathā dṛkcha sarasīruhasambhava | dakṣādi devahutabhukcaturgatimanantaram || 27.274 || śrīvatsavāsu devau dvau krodharūpasamiraṇau | karālaṃ ca ṛtaṃ bhadrapāṇiṃ vai rājamārutau || 27.275 || paścimaṃ vasu kūrmaṃ ca vikramaṃ dṛṣṭigopanau | vighneśacchalavidhvaṃsamādhavā vaidharātmakam || 27.276 || jalajaṃ pāpahantāraṃ hutabhukkamalaṃ ghaṭam | vakratuṇḍaṃ tathā dyumnaṃ dviradānanavikramam || 27.277 || bhāntamagniṃ cotadehaṃ vakratuṇḍaṃ caturgatim | paścimānanayāntau ca otadehasamanvitau || 27.278 || vai rājadvitayaṃ dakṣaṃ gopanaṃ nāsikodbhavam | gadadhvaṃsaṃ ca kapilamatriṃ madhunighādanam || 27.279 || yāntaṃ caturgatiṃ śuklaṃ vāruṇāgni samiraṇāḥ | ekadantaṃ caikadṛṣṭiṃ bahulaṃ madhuvidviṣam || 27.280 || pracaṇḍaṃ vikramaṃ vakratuṇḍaṃ ca saguhālayam | sumukhaṃ hutabhukchaṅkhamanalaṃ madhuvidviṣam || 27.281 || yaṣṭiṃ dakṣaṃ tathākāraṃ nāsikyaṃ dhūliketanam | dhruvaṃ māhendramākāra mardhāṃśuṃ kumbhagopanau || 27.282 || saddhruvaṃ janmahantāraṃ vāruṇaṃ pulahaṃ tathā | musalī kumbhamākāraṃ pītavāyudhanapradāḥ || 27.283 || śrīdharaṃ bhadrahastaṃ ca hariṃ svāhāmayāvaham | huṃphaḍantaṃ navaitāni bījāni kamalodbhava || 27.284 || padmapāṇiṃ padmanābhaṃ vanamālāṃ trivikramam | śrīvatsaṃ śaṅkhibhuvanaṃ bhadrahastāssavikramāḥ || 27.285 || agniṃ mṛgeśaṃ varuṇaṃ vairājaṃ bandhumastakam | daraṃ tārkṣyaṃ tathācādidevaṃ śuklaṃ śriyaḥ patim || 27.286 || vasugopanaśītāṃśubhuvanānalavāruṇāḥ | mṛgeśavijayākāra viṣkambhāśśukla vikramau || 27.287 || dṛkpuṇyamādipadevaṃ ca bhāskaraṃ ṛtadhāmakam | sūkṣmadṛkchaṅkhadakṣauca vaidharo'gniśchaturgatiḥ || 27.288 || paścimaṃ tritadakṣādi agnivāyusaroruhāḥ | ṛtadhāmā jayā gopā paścimā śuklamabjaja || 27.289 || bhānugopanasaptārci rbhallāyudhaguhālayāḥ | nai rājakakubhau kumbhahavyavāṭkapilāhvayāḥ || 27.290 || vaidharaṃ bhāskaraṃ pāpahananaṃ vakratuṇḍakam | gadinaṃ ṛtadhāmānaṃ bhāskaraṃ sumukhaṃ tathā || 27.291 || kumbhavikramajanmāhvapadmanābhāssadevarāṭ | subhadrasaṅkhadakṣāhvamotadeho'tha bhāskaraḥ || 27.292 || pavanaṃ pāpahananaṃ gopanau vijayo daraḥ | udayaṃ pītakamalaṃ madhusūdanavighnarāṭ || 27.293 || māhendraśśubhado vahnigodhanau kumbhavikramau | agniratriḥ kumbhadharau lakṣmīkharvāścaturmukha || 27.294 || śuklodayaṃ tathā dṛṣṭiśśrīvatsaṃ vasuśīrṣakam | vighneśa śubhadau syātāṃ sarasīruhasambhava || 27.295 || madhusūdaśśārṅgapāṇiḥ pañchāntakavidhī punaḥ | aurvadakṣautadehaśca dṛṣṭiṃ sarasijaṃ tathā || 27.296 || vāmano dhanado yāntassubhagāgni vanasrajaḥ | rāmapuṇyāgni garuḍavikramau jayavikramau || 27.297 || subhago'gni rādidevaḥ kuñjareṇa mukhākṣaraḥ | karālaṃ kapilaṃ pāpahananaṃ pavanātmajam || 27.298 || śrīdharaṃ dṛṣṭidhanadaṃ pañcabinduṃ savighnarāṭ | śubhota dehāvugrātmā caturgatimacāṃ mukham || 27.299 || śailadvayaṃ dvādaśātmā gopanaśśukla paścimau | śrīdharassumukho bhūmiranalaḥ pañca bindukaḥ || 27.300 || karālāgniṃ mahāmāyā subhago bandhuranvataḥ | vairājaṃ vikramaṃ pupahananaṃ bandhumastakam || 27.301 || pracaṇḍaṃ puṇḍarīkākṣaṃ vāsudevaṃ jayaṃ vasum | sūkṣmadṛkkumbhavaruṇapaścimānanamādharāḥ || 27.302 || ugrātmamṛgadakṣāhva gopanā dhanadaḥ kuṭaḥ | dakṣaḥ puṇyodayaśśukla śśubhadṛṣṭirvināyakaḥ || 27.303 || vaidharo madhuhantāca mandaraṃ brahmasādhanam | atriragnipavitrāhvā vaidharasparśapaścimāḥ || 27.304 || bhadrādidevabhallāhvamugrabhūmiṃ madhudviṣam | ekadṛgdakṣavighneśamādhavā mṛgavallabhāḥ || 27.305 || bhāskaraṃ devadattaṃ ca bhānuṃ bandhuṃ subhadrakam | gadadhvaṃsaṃ tathā kumbhaṃ dviradaṃ paścimānanam || 27.306 || aurvāgni bhuvanāvugrayaṣṭirvedhāśśriyaḥ patiḥ | agniṃ ramādharaṃ dviśca agnikūṭa vigarhitam || 27.307 || tathā bhadramadhudveṣidṛṣṭigopanamastakān | vairājadakṣakamalagopanāvindupakṣirāṭ || 27.308 || manuṃ dhruvāgni mākāraṃ binduśchandramadudviṣaḥ | nāsikya mādiratriśca bandhumandaraviṣṭapāḥ || 27.309 || vai rājarephaśaṅkhāhvamādhavāvādivighnarāṭ | mṛgeśakamalau dakṣaṃ guhamambhoruhāsana || 27.310 || jayo'gnirvāyuraiṇeśamukho garuḍavāhanaḥ | bandhupītapavitrāhvamadhusūdanavaijayāḥ || 27.311 || gopano bhārgavākāraśuklodayahutāśanāḥ | pītotadehakamalavighna vikramamādhavāḥ || 27.312 || gopanaṃ somabandhuśca karigopanayaṣṭayaḥ | dineśamṛtadhāmāhva dṛṣṭiśaṅkhamadhudviṣaḥ || 27.313 || vighnavāyū tathā gopakamalau satrudāhakaḥ | dhāntasaṅkhā madhorhantā padmakrodhāgni mārutāḥ || 27.314 || ādiścakrī subandhuśca pītassarvapurāntakaḥ | udayo yāntarāmau ca vairājatapavanāgnayaḥ || 27.315 || ādiḥ kharvatanurbandhu pītapadmamadhudviṣaḥ | pāṭalaṃ paścimaṃ padmanābhaṃ vaidharamādhavau || 27.316 || bhallāyudhaṃ gadī kumbha vairājamṛgavallabhāḥ | śrīvatsamagnimikāraṃ kumbhaṃ pītadvayaṃ tathā || 27.317 || subhadragopanau śaṅkhamantarau dinakṛttathā | acāṃ caturdaśaṃ janmaśaśāṅkamṛgavallabhāḥ || 27.318 || hutāśagopadakṣāhvamādhavyaśca guhālayaḥ | vai rājayugasaptārcirdara devahutāntimāḥ || 27.319 || asalo yaṣṭisahito bījamasya samiritam | śarabhaṅgaṛṣistasya varivaṃ chanda īritaḥ || 27.320 || japo lakṣatrayastasmin catuśśatamitākṣare | puṃso rāmāvatārasya parasya paramātmanaḥ || 27.321 || catuśśatārṇarūpo'yaṃ mālāmantrassamuddhṛtaḥ | yathāpuraṃ puraścaryā siddhaścaiva yathāpuram || 27.322 || anveṣāṃ bharatādīnāmitarapyūhanāmabhiḥ | ātmaśīrṣaiśchaturthyantairnāmāni sahitāni ca || 27.323 || caturthyantāni vācyāni mantrarūpāṇi padmaja | bījānyādyakṣa rāṇyeva sānusvārāṇi yojayet || 27.324 || sītādīnāṃ ca devīnāṃ caturthyantāssamāhvayāḥ | mantraṣṭhaṭhetiparyanto bījānyādyakṣarāṇi ca || 27.325 || śrīmantravatpuraścaryā tadvacca phalasambhavaḥ | rāmasya balabhadrasya manussaṃprati kathyate || 27.326 || saptārṇaṃ padamuccārya tataḥ paścādudīriyet | rāmāyeti caturthyantaṃ balabhadrapadaṃ tathā || 27.327 || bījamasyocyate brahman jṛmbhalaṃ pulahaṃ tathā | sānusvāro hṛṣīkeśaḥ paiṅgalasyādṛṣiḥ smṛtaḥ || 27.328 || chandaḥ pūrvavadevasyāddevatā musalāyudhaḥ | rāmaḥ kamalapatrākṣo bījamevāṅgapaddhatiḥ || 27.329 || lakṣāṇyakṣarasaṅkhyāni bhavenmantrasya siddhaye | phalamiṣṭamavāpnoti pātālagamanādikam || 27.330 || caturvargaphalāvāpteḥ phalamasya karesthitam | yādavasyātha kṛṣṇasya mantrassaṃprati kathyate || 27.331 || udgīthamucchāryamukhe sparśādi tadanantaram | ṛtadhāmā tataḥ paścātkrodharūpamanantaram || 27.332 || vanamālinamākāraṃ śvasanaṃ viṣṇumastakam | satyantamiti ṣaḍvarṇā mantrasya kathitā mayā || 27.333 || bījaṃ kamalamādyaṃ syātsaptārcistadanantaram | aurvaḥ paścātsayaṣṭissyādetenaivāṅgakalpanā || 27.334 || sanako'sya bhaveddraṣṭā chando gāyatramucyate | devatā bhagavān kṛṣṇaḥ puraścharyā ca pūrvavat || 27.335 || phalāni pūrvamuktāni nānantyāducyate punaḥ | govardhanākhyamantranya varṇoddhāraḥ pradarśyate || 27.336 || vedādiṃ pūrvamuccārya prathame sparśapañcake | tṛtīyaṃ yādiṣu tathā svareṣu ca caturmukha || 27.337 || saddhruvaṃ gadinaṃ brahmasādhanaṃ ca sudhārasam | ādiṃ saptārciṣaṃ puṇyaṃ makaraṃ tadanantaram || 27.338 || bhadrabāhuṃ dvitīyaṃ ca śvasanaṃ mukhamanvataḥ | satyastamevamuddhāraḥ kathito savavarṇakaḥ || 27.339 || mantrastadeva bījādi sādhanaṃ phalamīritam | gopālamantrasyoddhāraḥ kathyate kamalāsana || 27.340 || chandasāmādimuccārya tṛtīyaṃ sparśasaṃjñitam | otadehaṃ pavitraṃ ca vāmanaṃ kakubhaṃ tataḥ || 27.341 || aniruddhaṃ vighṇu rājamakāraṃ yādasāṃpatim | ādyaṃ pulahamāvṛttaṃ sparśopāntaṃ ca gopanam || 27.342 || prabhañjanaṃ svareṣvādiṃ ṭhaṭhānto manurīritaḥ | bījaṃ tṛtīyaṃ sparśānaṃ pītaṃ turyamacāmataḥ || 27.343 || nāsikyamaṅgāni punargopanaṃ khaḍgasaṃjñitam | mukhyaṃ sparśādimanalaṃ gopanaṃ sparśanaṃ tathā || 27.344 || ādyaṃ ṭhaṭhāntaṃ prathamaṃ tadevāṅgamanantaram | vipūrvamadhikaṃ paścādaṅgaṃ trailokyapūrvakam || 27.345 || rakṣaṇeti caturthyantaṃ tadvibhaktyantamanvataḥ | asurādyantakaparaṃ padaṃ sarvādyanantaram || 27.346 || grahaṃ nivāraṇāyeti huṃphaḍantamitīritam | mantrasya nārado draṣṭā virāṭchandaśca devatā || 27.347 || kaṣṇāvatāro bhagavān japasthānaṃ puroditam | sahasraśaḥ pratisthānaṃ japaḥ proktaścaturmukha || 27.348 || japātsidhyati mantro'yaṃ sādhayatyakhilaṃ phalam | aścaryamaparaṃ mantraṃ vakṣyāmi kamalāsana || 27.349 || uccārya praṇavaṃ pūrvaṃ mādharaṃ tadanantaraṃ | caturthyantamudīryātha tadvibhaktyantamadbhutam || 27.350 || bhogeśvarapadaṃ tadvattadva cca kripadaṃ tataḥ | suparṇādidhvajāntaṃ ca padaṃ tādṛgvibhaktikam || 27.351 || pītādivāsaśśabdāntaṃ vāsudevapadaṃ tataḥ | tadvibhaktiśaro yojyaṃ natyanto manuruddhṛtaḥ || 27.352 || pūrvamaṅgāni yojyāni pūrvavannātiricyate | ṛṣiśchando devatā ca pūrvatphalameva ca || 27.353 || dharmārthakāmamokṣādi nehabhūyaḥ pratanyate | mālāmantraṃ tāvadarṇaṃ devasya madhuvidviṣaḥ || 27.354 || kṛṣṇāvatārarūpasya caturvargaphalapradam | uddharāmi yathā tatvaṃ yathā tadavadhāryatām || 27.355 || nigamādi dviṣaṭkārṇaṃ sarojamṛtadhāmakam | krodhaṃ pracaṇḍaṃ madhubhicchaṅkhakumbhṛtānvitāḥ || 27.356 || krodhaścaṇḍakramaḥ kumbhaśaṅkāgni madhusūdanāḥ | daraśrīvatsa eṇeśa krodhassūkṣma mataḥ param || 27.357 || vāsudevo gadī pāpahananaṃ ca caturgatim | agnibindhu rviriñcyādi devāśśaṅkha macāṃ mukham || 27.358 || pavitramagnimadhubhi dbhadrapāṇidvayaṃ punaḥ | vaidharaṃ paścimavasuṃ dakṣendu bhuvanātmakam || 27.359 || sūkṣmacakṣu gartissomaḥ kumbhāgni saguhālayau | pavitragopanau vāyuṃ paścimāgniṃ madhudviṣaḥ || 27.360 || vairāja mādhavīvighnassāraṅgāsidharāḥ paraḥ | bandhuvai rājahuta bhukpaṅchātmadviradā sanāḥ || 27.361 || gopanaśśaṅkhadinakṛdṛta vaidharamārutāḥ | abjotadehāvadriśca yāntabhadratrivikramāḥ || 27.362 || mahendraśaṅkha madhaubhinmārutāḥ kakubhāhvayāḥ | bhrugugovanavighneśajanma hantreṇasaṃhitāḥ || 27.363 || māruto gopano vāyurindu bhāsramaindavam | ṛtaṃ lakṣmīṃ mahāmāyāṃ krodhāgni varuṇāhvayāḥ || 27.364 || atrirvighnadvayaṃ śaṅkho dviradassūkṣmalocanaḥ | śriyaḥ patiṃ tathājanmahantāraṃ vakratuṇḍakam || 27.365 || hutāśacaṇḍamadhubhiddaraśukladineśvarāḥ | kālātmā pratimākārajayapāvakabhadrakāḥ || 27.366 || udaikaścakṣuramṛtavikramā vidhipāvakau | dakṣo vidhiścartadhāmā dakṣagopanamabjaja || 27.367 || śaṅkhamādiṃ gadadhvaṃsaṃ māhendraṃ pañcabindukam | sadhruvaṃ cendirābījaṃ puṣṭibījaṃ tataḥ param || 27.368 || kāmabījaṃ pāśabījaṃ śrīvatsaṃ bindumastakam | cakrakhaḍgadharo brahmā padmanābho'tha paścimaḥ || 27.369 || vai rāja dakṣakamala śrīdharāḥ pītavāmanāḥ | indirāpāpahananā gopanā vittavardhanāḥ || 27.370 || madhusūdana nāsikyakuśeśayaramādharāḥ | śrīvatsadvandvabahulavitteśamadhuvidviṣaḥ || 27.371 || kapidhvajo gadī yāntadakṣa śrīdhara candramāḥ | pītādidevaśśītāṃśurmāyā kamalamabjaja || 27.372 || manurdakṣautadehau ca dṛṣṭiśśaṅkhaghaṭāhvayaḥ | māyā karālāmikāra caṇḍārṇavasumastakam || 27.373 || nādādiṃ paściṃ padmanābhaṃ vai rājavikramau | pāvakaṃ chordhvalokeśaṃ paścimaṃ cā prameyakam || 27.374 || kharvavikramamāhendrabhallāyudhasudhārasāḥ | vighnamandaravighneśamādhavīsupratiṣṭhitāḥ || 27.375 || kumbhodarāmaśubhada pīyūṣāgni guhālayāḥ | paścimānavighneśa māyāmandhara yugmakāḥ || 27.376 || vasumūrdhā mahendrādi devāḥ kapilasaṃyutāḥ | jṛmbhalo yāntasubhaga hutāśadhanadāḥ paraḥ || 27.377 || govinda vighbhuvana vidhiḥ paścimasaṃkṣitāḥ | saptārciḥ pītavarṇābhaṃ devaro matimāṃ stathā || 27.378 || śaṅkhagopanavairāja śrīdharo dhanadābhidhaḥ | madhudviṭkuñjara mukhacaturgatisapannagāḥ || 27.379 || bhadrahasto madhudveṣī gadadhvaṃsī dvayānvitaḥ | bhadrapāṇistathāpuṇyaṃ sanasīruhasambhava || 27.380 || sudhāraso vasurbhūmirgopanākhyamataḥ param | karālabinduvighneśau pañca bindhu śubhāhvayāḥ || 27.381 || madhuhantā tathā brahmā māyā vighnāśca vāmanāḥ | yāntamādhavapīyūṣavai rājāḥ pañcabindukam || 27.382 || śaśāṅkakamalau bhadrapāṇi dṛgvaidharānvitāḥ | eṇeśakumbhadṛksaśrī śrīdharāścāntayādikāḥ || 27.383 || gadī ca ṛtadhāmā ca dinakṛdvaruṇomṛgaḥ | vairājaṃ madhuhantāraṃ viṣṇvābhaṃ brahmasādhanam || 27.384 || mānuṣeśaṃ tathā dakṣaṃ madhusūdanavaidharau | ṛkṣeśabhuvanau yāntaṃ madhuśatru himālayāḥ || 27.385 || udayo'gni pavitrāśca bandhuśrīmadhuvidviṣaḥ | vakratuṇḍa viriñcau dvau hṛṣīkeśa śubhābhidhau || 27.386 || bhāntādi devasumukhau puṇḍarīka vidarbitau | purṇacandraṃ sarāmaṃ ca vaidharaṃ mohanāśanam || 27.387 || pīyūṣarāmadṛk śaṅkha madhuśatru dhanādhipāḥ | svāhādharaṃ vaidharaṃ ca govindaṃ vijayābhidham || 27.388 || śvasano dṛṣṭi madubhiddherambamakarālayāḥ | kukeśayamadudveṣi pītamādhavamārutāḥ || 27.389 || acāṃ dvitīyaṃ nṛhariṃ vasumastakamabjaja | sūkṣmadṛk sordhvalokeśa vai rājamadhuvidviṣaḥ || 27.390 || pāpahantā tathā somadakṣākaravidarbhitau | acāṃ dvitīyamanalaṃ kamalāmṛtavaijayāḥ || 27.391 || dvayaṃ bandhuṃ tathā dakṣaṃ skandhanāgni trivikramam | svayambhūrjanmahantā ca piyūṣāgnimadudviṣaḥ || 27.392 || dṛṣṭivikrama yāntau ca kumbhabandhuṃ caturmukha | atrimārutamākāra bhadrahastāssavikramāḥ || 27.393 || vakratuṇḍānilau vighnadṛgdineśadvayaṃ tathā | kuñjarāsyaṃ paścimāsyaṃ vakratuṇḍaṃ tathākṣaram || 27.394 || mandarassarvaro dhaścha gadī ca ṛtadhā raviḥ | pracaṇḍapi ṇḍamākāra madhubhidvaruṇābhidham || 27.395 || acāmekādaśaṃ lakṣmī muddhṛtya kamalāsana | samira kalaśau bandhusubhagau makarālayam || 27.396 || sakaviṃ puṇḍararuciṃ mārutāmṛtavikramāḥ | ekādaśyāntamadubhicchuklaśaṅkhendavastathā || 27.397 || pullalocana mokārakheṭakī mārutābhidhaḥ | subhadravasuvighneśavaidharāḥ pretanāyakāḥ || 27.398 || sarāmavighnadṛgdakṣa madhusūdanamanvataḥ | yāntavāyudhanādhyakṣaramādharagaṇādhipāḥ || 27.399 || bhujaṅgahutabhukpuṇya dakṣadvivasugopanāḥ | subhagomandaradvandva magni bhadraka rāhvayam || 27.400 || bandhumastakapañcāntā viṣkambhadviradānanāḥ | vikramo dakṣahutabhugbhrahmasādhanamabjaja || 27.401 || vakratuṇḍadharau śukla kumbhāgnidviradāsanāḥ | madhusūdanapañcānta paśchimā ṛtamandarāḥ || 27.402 || vaidharogni śirāśśaṅkha śuklakumbhavapuśśirāḥ | sūkṣmadṛkcordhvavijaya varuṇā vittavardhanāḥ || 27.403 || yaṣṭiṃ saroruhaṃ yāntaṃ paścimāgnissamandarāḥ | dyumaṇissadhruvaṃ śuklaṃ varuṇo daramanvataḥ || 27.404 || otadehaṃ tathā dakṣaṃ vakratuṇḍaṃ karālakam | agnireṇeśa śrīvatsa kumbhāgni sahapaścimau || 27.405 || ṛtaṃ bhallāyudhaṃ gopapāśapāṇijanārdanāḥ | atriṃ śrīvatsamanalaṃ vāyuṃ śuklaṃ jalāśayam || 27.406 || vasuṃ madhudviṣaṃ candraṃ śrīdharogniścaturmukha | saṃprasāraṇavairājavasuśuklamadudviṣaḥ || 27.407 || vaidharo bhadracaṇḍāṃśu śvasanau dakṣaśrīdharau | cakrī samandaramacāṃ pañcamaṃ kamalodbhava || 27.408 || udayaṃ vighnanayanāvādikhaḍgadharā ramā | vai rājapadmāhutabhukpañca bindudhanādhipāḥ || 27.409 || agnirugrātmamadhubiddhṛdayā hlādamakṣaram | gadadhvaṃsaṃ śriyaḥ kāntaṃ vanasraksasamiraṇam || 27.410 || kumbhavikrama pañcānta ṛtabhāskaravaijayāḥ | bhuvano'mṛtavai rāja vasubhallakarālakāḥ || 27.411 || vai rāja janmahantāraṃ dviradaḥ kumbhavaijayāḥ | svaśirogniṃ tathā śuklapītakumbhāssayāminī || 27.412 || nādhaṃ ramādharaṃ vighnumāyāṃ caiva saroruham | hutā śakapilākṣau dvau paścima vratadhānilau || 27.413 || chaladhvaṃsī pavitrāhva hṛṣīkeśahutāśanam | kāntādipītaphaṇabṛddakṣavāmanamastakān || 27.414 || haurambho'gni rmadhudveṣī śubhadodaramaindavam | pāṭaladvandvamoṅkāracaṇḍāṃśukapilākṣaram || 27.415 || kamalognissabhuvana dakṣagopanayaṣṭikāḥ | hutāśatārkṣyamadhubhi nnāsikyaṃ caturāsana || 27.416 || śrībījaṃca gadadhvaṃsaṃ pītaurvaṃdhruvamādimat | pāṭalobanduvijaya vai rājamṛgavallabhāḥ || 27.417 || kakubho mādhavaparaṃ ṭhaṭhānto manurīritaḥ | nārado'sya munirdraṣṭā varivaṃ chandha īritaḥ || 27.418 || devatā devadeveśaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ kamalasambhava | aṅgāni pūrvavacchāsya puraścaryā ca pūrvavat || 27.419 || jātipuṣpaurbilva phalaissamidbhirhomamācaret | chāyāyāṃ bilvavṛkṣasya japahomādikaṃ bhavet || 27.420 || āṇimādikamaiśvaryaṃ puruṣārtha catuṣṭayam | phalaṃ dadāti mantro'yaṃ mantravidbhassusādhitaḥ || 27.421 || iti śrīpāñcarātre mahopaniṣadi pādmasaṃhitāyāṃ caryāpāde matsyādimūrtimandrakathanaṃ nāma saptaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ |
<4.28>
śrībhagavān hebrahman yajñavapuṣamantrassaṃprati kathyate | mahāphalaṃ procyamānamimaṃ tvamavadhāraya || 28.1 || ātmane iti paryantamaṣṭākṣaravaduddharet | kālādyanalamadhyaṃ ca vigrahāntaṃ padaṃ tataḥ || 28.2 || caturthyanto mūrtiśīrṣaṃ yajñādipadamanvataḥ | tadvibhaktyantamaparaṃ ṭhaṭhāntaṃ manurīritaḥ || 28.3 || bī masyā nalaṃ mukhyamanusvārāntamuddharet | aṅgāni cānalādīni ṣaḍbhārāntānyanukramāt || 28.4 || sānusvārāṇi yojyāni kraturdraṣṭā viruṭpunaḥ | chandhaśca yajñamūrtyātmā devatā bhagavān hariḥ || 28.5 || lakṣatrayaṃ japaḥkāryo mantrasyāsya prasādhane | phalaṃ prasūte dharmādipuruṣārtha catuṣṭayam || 28.6 || annādhipatimantrasya prabhāporūpameva ca | kathyate saṃprati brahman na vācyaṃ yasya kasya cit || 28.7 || praṇavādirmanussarvo viśeṣastūcyate'dhunā | mukhyamarṇaṃ bhadrapāṇiṃ dviruktaṃ tadanantaram || 28.8 || ādidevaṃ dhanapatiṃ māyāmuddhṛtya paścimam | viṣṇuṃ vijayanāmānamādyaṃ vāyumanantaram || 28.9 || devadattaṃ ca dakṣādimādyaṃ dakṣaṃ punastathā | ādidevaṃ manuṣyeśaṃ dviruktaṃ mukhyamanvataḥ || 28.10 || mandaraṃ pāpahananamṛtadhā vaiṣṇavākṣaram | śaṅkhamādimacāmanvagdviḥ proktaṃ pretanāyakam || 28.11 || praṇavādiṃ ṭhaṭhetyantamiti mantraṃ caturmukha | bījamasya pravakṣyāmi dvādaśātmānamuddharet || 28.12 || jvalanaṃ vāmanaṃ bindumetadevāṅgamucyate | ākārādikramāddīrghasvarabhaktirviśeṣa kṛt || 28.13 || astre viśeṣo viṣṇuśca visargaśca samiritaḥ | vyāso draṣṭāsya mantrasya chandastu bṛhatī tathā || 28.14 || devatānnapatiḥprokto mantrasyāsya caturmukha | anyathā śṛṇu vakṣyāmi bahvannaphaladaṃ śubham || 28.15 || natyantaṃ prapaṇavaṃ pūrvaṃ varuṇaṃ ca trivikram | krodharūpaṃ pracaṇḍaṃ ca viṣṇuṃ varuṇamanvataḥ || 28.16 || mādhavaṃ pūrṇacandraṃ ca pīyūṣātmānameva ca | ādiṃ vaiśvānaraṃ mukhyaṃ pavitraṃ praṇavādi ca || 28.17 || ekanetramakāraṃ ca śvasanaṃ mādhavaṃ tataḥ | mandaraṃ praṇavādyaṃ ca dīptimantraṃ caturmukha || 28.18 || gopanaṃ jṛmbhalaṃ viṣṇuṃ māhendraṃ gopanaṃ tataḥ | vāyuvādyaṃ ṭhaṭhāntaṃ ca varṇoddhāra itīritaḥ || 28.19 || bījamaṅgāni pūrvoktamṛṣirasya parāśaraḥ | chandaścha devī gāyatraṃ devatānnapatirbhavet || 28.20 || pūrṇendhubimbamadhyasthe sitapadme vikasvare | āsīnaṃ dhavalākāraṃ nilakuñchitamūrdhajam || 28.21 || dukūlakṣaumavasanaṃ bālayogya vibhūṣaṇam | kaladhautamayaṃ prātaṃ vāyasānnena pūritam || 28.22 || bibhrāṇaṃ dakṣiṇe haste dadhyodana mathetare | dhyāyellakṣatrayaṃ dhīmān japettadgatamānasaḥ || 28.23 || anena juhuyāccāgnau niyataṃ mantravittamaḥ | bahvannatvamavāpnoti sarvamiṣṭaṃ labheti ca || 28.24 || śaktīśamantramadhunā kathayāmi caturmukha | āditassaptavarṇānāmuddhāraḥ pūrvamiritaḥ || 28.25 || krodhanaṃ hṛdayāhlādaṃ bhuvanaṃ bhāskaraṃ tataḥ | guhālayamanussvāraṃ ravimagniṃ ca mārutam || 28.26 || sayaṣṭiṃ pītamādyarṇaṃ kamalaṃ krodharūpiṇam | mādhavīṃ pañcabinduṃ ca hananaṃ cāprameyakam || 28.27 || vai rājamapaprameyaṃ ca puruṣātmāca mādhavaḥ | nārāyaṇaṃ caturthyantaṃ ṭhaṭheti manurīritaḥ || 28.28 || aṃśumān vītihotraścha vāmano bindumastakaḥ | aṅgaṃ ca bījaṃ pūrvoktamṛṣiścāpi parāśaraḥ || 28.29 || chandaśca devī gāyatraṃ śaktīśo devatā tathā | japeddvādaśa lakṣaṃ tu prāpnu yātsarvamipsitam || 28.30 || kālanemimanurbrahman kathyate sarvasādhakaḥ | ādyarṇāḥ pūrvavatsaptapīyūṣātmā trivikramaḥ || 28.31 || ugradehaḥ pracaṇḍaśca viṣṇuḥ kalaśamādhavau | kamalaṃ gopanayutaṃ mahendraṃ viṣṇumastakam || 28.32 || vighneśaṃ devadattaṃ ca dakṣaṃ māyāpariṣkṛtam | pataṅgamṛtadhāmānaṃ vaidharaṃ ca caturgatim || 28.33 || ādyaṃ sudhārasaṃ māyāmatrirgopanahavyavāṭ | ādyaṃ sumukha mādyaṃ ca śvasanaṃ cāprameyakam || 28.34 || huṃphaḍantaṃ ṭhaṭhaparaṃ manurevaṃ samuddhṛtaḥ | bījaṃ vakṣye dinakaraṃ bhuvanaṃ yaṣṭimastakam || 28.35 || kruddhādi pūrvavaccāṅgaṃ nārado mandradarśanaḥ | chandho virāṭ devatā ca kālanemiśchaturmukha || 28.36 || japasaṅkhyāphalaṃ cāpi dviṣaṭkākṣaravadbhavet | trailokya mohanaṃ mantraṃ kathayāmi yathātatham || 28.37 || udgīthaṃ kamalaṃ pītaṃ vāmanaṃ dhruvamastakam | ekākṣaro manurayaṃ devatāṅgamanukramāt || 28.38 || ṣaḍbhiryutamacāmādvaisyānusvāraṃ prajayojayet | ṛṣirvṛddhamanuśchandho devī gāyatramiritam || 28.39 || trailokyamohano devo devatā japatarpaṇam | homaśca phalamapyasya nidhisthānopalambhanam || 28.40 || japan bhūyastathā sarvaṃ durlabhaṃ phalamaśnute | ṣoḍaśārṇo manurbrahman trilokīmohanātmakaḥ || 28.41 || ucyate pūrvavatsaptavarṇānādyān samuddharet | trailokya mohanapadaṃ caturthyantaṃ tataḥ param || 28.42 || tadvibhaktipadaṃ viṣṇupadaṃ svāhāntamuddharet | manureṣa sa evāṅgaṃ bījaṃ pūrvavadīritam || 28.43 || muniḥ punastyaśchandaśca devatā pūrvavattathā | japasaṅkhyā phalaṃ caiva mūlamantravadiṣyate || 28.44 || mantro navākṣaraścānyastrilokī mohanātmakaḥ | trailokya mohanapadaṃ caturthyantaṃ namastathā || 28.45 || bījamaṅgamayaṃ caiva sarvakāmaphalapradam | nigamādiṃ caturthyantaṃ padaṃ trailokya mohanam || 28.46 || aṃśumālinamagniṃ ca pañcabinduṃ sayaṣṭikam | śaṅkhinaṃ pulahaṃ pañca binduyaṣṭisamanvitam || 28.47 || tadbījaṃ ca dvirabhyasya natiśca tadanantaram | dvādaśārṇātmakomantrastrilokīmohanātmakaḥ || 28.48 || pratyakṣaraṃ lakṣajapo dvādaśākṣaravatphalam | kāmakāmeśvarī nāma mantrassarvaphalapradaḥ || 28.49 || udgīthaṃ pūrvamucārya bhāskaraṃ jvalanaṃ tataḥ | mahāmāyāṃ yaṣṭiyutāmityekākṣaramuddharet || 28.50 || etadevāṅgamuditaṃ śaunako munirucyate | chandaśca devī gāyatraṃ devatā puruṣottamaḥ || 28.51 || lakṣamekaṃ japenmantrī sarvān kāmānavāpnuyāt | śaṅkhakundendudhavalaṃ caturcāhuṃ kirīṭinam || 28.52 || garuḍārūḍhamāropya devīṃ vāmoruviṣṭare | dāḍimikusumaprakhyāṃ sarvākalpapariṣkṛtām || 28.53 || vāśāṅkuśadharāṃ lakṣmīṃ kāmavihvālalocanām | kāmakāmeśvarīmeva dhyāyedekāgramānasaḥ || 28.54 || trailokyamohanaṃ nāma manussaṃpratikathṛte | brahmakośamudīryādau natyantaṃ tadanantaram || 28.55 || padāni sambudhyāntāni krameṇoddhārayetsudhīḥ | puruṣādyuttamapadaṃ rupamaprati meti ca || 28.56 || lakṣmyādi ca nivāsāntaṃ sakalādiṃ jagatpadam | kṣobhaṇāntaṃ ca sarvādipadaṃ strīhṛdayāvadhi || 28.57 || vidāraṇaśiraścāpi trayādi bhuvanāvadhi | unmādakaraparyantaṃ surāsurapadaṃ tataḥ || 28.58 || manujeti samuccārya sundarījanamanvataḥ | manāṃsīti samuccārya tāpayeti caturmukha || 28.59 || dīpayeti padaṃ paścācchoṣayeti ca māraya | stambhaya drāvayākarṣaparyantaṃ ca kriyāpadam || 28.60 || dvirvaktavyaṃ tato brahman paramaṃ subhagāvadhi | sambudhyantaṃ ca saubhāgyaṃ kareti padamanvataḥ || 28.61 || sarvakāmapradaṃ procya padaṃ cāmukamityataḥ | haneti dvissamuccārya cakreṇa gadayeti ca || 28.62 || khaḍgena sarvabāṇaiśca dvirbhindheti paṭhettataḥ | pāśeneti tato bandha bandheti ca padadvayam || 28.63 || aṅkuśeneti saṃprocya tāḍayeti dvirabhyaset | kurvanti dvissamuccārya kiṃ tiṣṭhapadamanvataḥ || 28.64 || tāvadyāvatpade procya samīhitapadaṃ tataḥ | me siddhirbhavatūccārya me huṃphaḍiti śīrṣakam || 28.65 || ityeṣa mālāmantrasya samuddhāraḥ pradarśitaḥ | nigamādiranantaṃ ca aurvaṃ candrārdha śekharam || 28.66 || bījamevaṃ samuddhṛtya ṣaḍaṅgāni manuḥ punaḥ | ṣoḍhā vibhajya kartavyā ṛṣissyānnalakūbaraḥ || 28.67 || chando'ticchandanāmāsya devatā puruṣottamaḥ | dhyāyettameva puruṣaṃ sādhayenmantravittamaḥ || 28.68 || aṣṭabāhuṃ viśālākṣaṃ garuḍārūḍhamacyutam | akalaṅkaśaśiprakhyaṃ pūrṇendusadṛśāsanam || 28.69 || subhrūlalāṭamakuṭaṃ lāvaṇyāmṛtasāgaram | pītakauśeyavasanaṃ kapolāmṛṣṭakuṇḍalam || 28.70 || cakraṃ ca musalaṃ bāṇamaṅkuśaṃ dakṣiṇe bhuje | śaṅkhaṃ kaumodakīṃ śārṅgaṃ pāśaṃ vāmeṣu bibhratam || 28.71 || sarvalakṣaṇasaṃpūrṇaṃ sarvākalpapariṣkṛtam | divya candanaliptāṅgaṃ divya sragdāmabhūṣitam || 28.72 || devyo'ṣṭau paritastasya vālavyajanapāṇayaḥ | vījayanti sadā devaṃ kāmavihvalalocanāḥ || 28.73 || etābhyo bahiraṣṭau ca dikṣu cakrādidhāriṇaḥ | puruṣā devadeveśaṃ praṇipatya bahisthitāḥ || 28.74 || evaṃ saparivāraṃ taṃ dhyātvā devaṃ samāhitaḥ | saptāhaṃ mantrajāpena vaśyā manujayoṣitaḥ || 28.75 || divaseṣu ca tāvatsu punaryakṣyādiyoṣitaḥ | tiṣṭhanti saṃmukhāssarvā manmathāviṣṭacetasaḥ || 28.76 || bhajantimantriṇaṃ mantra vaibhavānmohayanti ca | japī bhūyāstathā kāmān sarvānvindatyasaṃśayaḥ || 28.77 || kiṃ punarbahunoktena devaḥ pratyakṣatāmiyāt | śāntiḥ puṣṭiśca dharmaśca kāmārthau mokṣa eva ca || 28.78 || pātālākāśagamanamantardhānamadṛśyatām | nidhānaṃ phalasiddhiṃ ca khananaṃ cauṣadhaṃ tathā || 28.79 || pādukāṃ gulikāṃ cāpi rasāyanamanuttamam | akṣasūtraṃ daraṃ khaḍgaṃ tathā vetālasādhanam || 28.80 || phalāni durlabhānyeva sidhyanti manuvaibhavāt | pratyekaṃ na pradarśante granthavistarabhīrubhiḥ || 28.81 || phalānāṃ digiyaṃ proktā durlabhānāṃ caturmukha | trailokyamohanākhyasya kāmakāmeśvarasya ca || 28.82 || ekākṣaramukhasyoktaṃ phalaṃ mantrasya padmaja | mantraṃ yajñavarāhasya vakṣyāmi kamalāsana || 28.83 || gṛhītvā pūrvavatsapta varṇānādyānanukramāt | sparsāntaṃ bhāskaraṃ cādyaṃ kalaśaṃ praṇapādi ca || 28.84 || analaṃ cādidevāntaṃ bhāskaraṃ madhusūdanam | śvasanaṃ varṇamādyaṃ ca oṣadhīśamacāṃ mukham || 28.85 || vahniṃ pracetasaṃ mukhyaṃ mārutaṃ praṇavādi ca | musaliṃ candradhavalamacāmādimanantaram || 28.86 || śrīvatsamādimanalaṃ mahāmāyāgnigopanam | daraṃ viṣṇuṃ khaḍgadharaṃ vijayaṃ śrīdharaṃ tathā || 28.87 || piyūṣarūpamanalaṃ mādhavaṃ vaidharaṃ tathā | ādiṃ pavitradhṛṣṭiṃ ca praṇavādivibhūṣitam || 28.88 || śvasanaṃ cāprameyaṃ ca kalātmā viṣṇumastakaḥ | varuṇaṃ dahanākrāntaṃ vaidharaṃ mādhavākṣaram || 28.89 || varuṇaṃ cādivarṇaṃ ca tathaipogrātma saṃmitam | analaṃ mādhavopetaṃ mandaraṃ prathamaṃ marut || 28.90 || madhusūdanavikrāntaṃ pavanaṃ śvetarociṣam | varuṇaṃ vītihotraṃ ca subhadraṃ ca guhālayam || 28.91 || vai rājamādidevāntaṃ vijayaṃ mandaraṃ tathā | bhadrapāṇiṃ mṛgeśaṃ ca vaidharaṃ yaṣṭimastakam || 28.92 || ugrātmā parvataṃ cādimṛtadhāmapariṣkṛtam | vighneśaṃ mārutaṃ caikanetraṃ śuklaśirastathā || 28.93 || subhadraṃ cordhvalokeśaṃ nābhipaṅkajasambhava | mādhavīmaprameyaṃ ca vanamālī jhaṣa stathā || 28.94 || māhendraṃ gopanayutaṃ mārutaṃ prathamasvaram | bhallāyudhaṃ hṛṣīkeśaṃ subhadraṃ bhuvanaṃ vasuṃ || 28.95 || pracetasaṃ kalātmāna mamṛtaṃ savisargakam | pavitramādiṃ vai rājaṃ mukhyaṃ pavanamādavau || 28.96 || subhadramaurvaṃ dakṣaṃ ca mukha dvipadamirayet | śaśāṅkaṃ dvipadaṃ vahnibhuvanaṃ dvipadaṃ paṭhet || 28.97 || acāṃ dvitīyaṃ dṛṣṭiṃ ca māyāṃ kamalamādiśet | havyavāḍgopanayutaṃ bhāskaraṃ madhusūdanam || 28.98 || prabhañjanamakāraṃ ca sūkṣmadṛgbhuvanaṃ tathā | mādhavīṃ rāmasahitaṃ paścimānanamādimat || 28.99 || ekanetramikāraṃ ca vijayaṃ kalaśaṃ tathā | mandaraṃ devadattaṃ ca vaidharaṃ viṣṇumastakam || 28.100 || dvirbrūyādgāpanā krāntaṃ paścimānanamādimat | prabhañjanamakāraṃ caṭhaṭhānto manurīritaḥ || 28.101 || sūkṣmadṛgbhuvanaṃ sargaṃ bījametatsamuddhṛtam | mantraṃ ṣoḍhā vibhajyāṅgakalpanaṃ kāśyapo muniḥ || 28.102 || chando virāṭ stomaghoṇī devatā kamalāsana | japo lakṣadviṣaṭkaṃ syātphalaṃ sarvaṃ yathāpuram || 28.103 || darodaranṛsiṃhasya manussaṃprati kathyate | oṃkāraṃ pūrvamuddhṛtya kamalaṃ śatrudāhakam || 28.104 || guhālayaṃ sayaṣṭiṃ ca gopatiṃ bhuvanaṃ dhruvam | pullalocanamādyaṃ ca hṛdayā hlādanaṃ tathā || 28.105 || bhadrapāṇiṃ svarādiṃ ca jvalanaṃ cādimaṃ tathā | oṣadhīśamikāraṃ ca yaṣṭiṃ bhāskaragopanau || 28.106 || śvasanaṃ ca natirmantro nārasiṃha udīritaḥ | ayameva manurbhījaṃ chando gāyatramiritam || 28.107 || devatā nṛharirdraṣṭā kapilo dhyānamucyate | darodare sukhāsīnaṃ śatapatre vikasvare || 28.108 || taptajāmbhūnadanibhaṃ caturbhāhumudāyudham | paryaṅkabandhasubhagaṃ prasāritabhujadvayam || 28.109 || jānunorupariṣṭācca sarvākalpapariṣkṛtam | vyāttānanaṃ trinayanaṃ sakhadambholibhīṣaṇam || 28.110 || siṃhasyārdhaṃ narasyārdhaṃ meghagambhūragarjitam | evaṃ dhyātvā japedaṣṭalakṣaṃ mantrī samāhitaḥ || 28.111 || sāvitre maṇḍale devamāsīnaṃ sarvakāmadam | dhyāyellabheta dharmādi puruṣārthacatuṣṭayam || 28.112 || bahunātrakimuktena sarvān kāmānavāvapnuyāt | caturṇāṃ puruṣādīnāṃ manussaṃprati kathyate || 28.113 || praṇavādīn saptavarṇān samuddhṛtya yathā puram | svaṃ svaṃ nāma caturthyantaṃ mantrāneṣāṃ prakalpayet || 28.114 || teṣāṃ bījāni vakṣyāmi varṇoddhāraiḥ kramādaham | tigmāśurgopanayutassadaṇḍaḥ puruṣātmanaḥ || 28.115 || mārtāṇḍaḥ pañcabinduśca sendussatyassa kathyate | vairājaṃ pāpakaṃ pañcabinduṃ nāsikya meva ca || 28.116 || trayūtanuṃ hṛṣīkeśaṃ yaṣṭiṃ cānantanāmani | ṛṣiśchando devatā ca phalamaṣṭākṣare tathā || 28.117 || hayagrīvasya mantrasya varṇoddhāraḥ pradarśyate | saptavarṇān samuddhṛtya vijayaṃ bahulaṃ tataḥ || 28.118 || kālātmā caika dṛgvahniṃ gopatiṃ viṣṇumastakam | śvasanaṃ praṇavādiṃ ca lakṣmīṃ bindumanantaram || 28.119 || jvalanaṃ gopanayutaṃ śaśāṅkaṃ mādhavaṃ tathā | svāhāntamaśvaśirasaḥ kathitaṣṣoḍaśākṣaraḥ || 28.120 || sa eva bījamaṅgāni kruddholkādi yathāpuram | ṛṣirbṛhaspatirhyasya cchando gāyatramucyate || 28.121 || devo hayaśirā nāma devatā kamalāsana | daśalakṣaṃ japenmantraṃ mahet jñānamavāpnuyāt || 28.122 || oṃkārapūrvaṃ natyantaṃ caturthī devatā kramāt | ṭhaṭhānto mantrarojoyaṃ daśākṣaravidarbhitaḥ || 28.123 || bījāni pūrvavatsarvaṃ kartavyaṃ kamalāsana | ato'nyaṃ vājiśiraso mālāmandraṃ bravīmite || 28.124 || arṇasaptakamuddhṛtya padaṃ hayaśirāstathā | caturthyantaṃ sarvavidyālayeti padamanvataḥ || 28.125 || sakalā maraśabdādi gurave padamuddharet | samastapratiśabdādi hantānantetyanantaram || 28.126 || vīryaṃ tejaḥ padaṃ paścāt jñānaiśvaryapadaṃ tataḥ | śaktiścaiva balaṃ caiva sarvādyāvāsamanvataḥ || 28.127 || tadvibhaktiṃ
