tataḥ paścātparamātmapadaṃ tataḥ | caturthyantaṃ vāsudevaśabdastā dṛgvibhaktikaḥ || 28.128 || jñānajñeyapadaṃ tadvadvyaktāvyaktaparāya ca | sarvaduṣṭāsuraṃ procyaduritaṃ vrajinaṃ tathā || 28.129 || pramāthi tadvibhaktyantaṃ tatsadrucirapūrvakam | padaṃ ca turagāyeti jñānamuccārya mūrtaye || 28.130 || iti coccārya tasyānu sahasraṃ koṭimanvataḥ | padaṃ vidyādinikaṃ muñca gaccha pade tataḥ || 28.131 || sphoṭirvijṛmbhirlloḍantaṃ dvirvaktavyaṃ ca tij padam | sarvāditejomadhyaṃ ca nidhyantaṃ ca padatrayam || 28.132 || caturthyantaṃ samuccārya nirdhūta padamanvataḥ | vikīrṇapadamucācārya prākpradīptapadaṃ tataḥ || 28.133 || kesaraṃ ca saṭāśabdaṃ kalāpapadamanvataḥ | pradīptasūryamaṃśuṃ ca pratīkāśapadaṃ tataḥ || 28.134 || bhāskarākāraśabdaṃ ca ūṣmamūrdhvajamanvataḥ | śaṅkhamābhamatāṅghriṃ ca prasaravrātadīptimān || 28.135 || dravatkanakamuccārya piṅgalāyatamānanam | mahāsvarasamākāraṃ viśuddhadaśanaṃ tataḥ || 28.136 || paṅtkiṃ vinirgatāṃ coktvā virājitapadaṃ tathā | lokatrayadravaddīptapadaṃ cāmikarādimat || 28.137 || piṅgalāyatamucchārya viṣphāritapadaṃ paṭhet | locanādi mahāśabdaṃ vibhīṣaṇa padānvitam || 28.138 || nāsikāpuṭamadrīndra śikharākārasaṃyutam | ruciraṃ padamuccārya vikuñchitapadaṃ tathā || 28.139 || mahāśravaṇasaṃyuktaṃ śreyaseti paṭhetpadam | tacchabdaṃ ca caturthyantaṃ duṣṭasatvānanantaram || 28.140 || bindiśchindi stathā māri rmardistrāsiśca dātavaḥ | loḍantā dvissamuccārya syauṃ vau mitipadadvayam || 28.141 || dhvaṃsi hanti tathādhmāpi hanti grahasi tāḍaya | paci rmathiśca te ete coḍantā dviḥ kṛtā stathā || 28.142 || paravidyāpadaṃ procyacchindhirṇyantaḥ prayujyatām | amityuktvā tathā nārī loṇmadhyamaśirāḥ smṛtaḥ || 28.143 || ehyehi bhagavan śabdaṃ vajraśabdamanantaram | aṅkuśeneti tadanuprocya cākarṣayeti ca || 28.144 || hṛdayā dyādiranvaksyādbhakti pūrvajaneti ca | jihvādinilayaṃ procya baḍabānalamanvataḥ || 28.145 || sambadhyantaṃ viśvamūrtiṃ saumanasyamanantaram | bhagavannitivaktavya moṃkāraṃ hṛdayaṃ tataḥ || 28.146 || sadā yadbrahma sadasadātmeti ca padaṃ punaḥ | cidghanādi ca turthyantaṃ bhagavatpadamirayet || 28.147 || ṭhaṭhāntamuddharedevaṃ hayagrīvaṃ caturmukha | pūrvoktamevāsya bījaṃ pūrvavacchāṅgapaddhatiḥ || 28.148 || vyāso munirhayagrīvo devatā cchanda utkṛtiḥ | dhyāyan hayaśirovaktrātudvāntaṃ phenamulbaṇam || 28.149 || pibanniva sudhīrmantra rājaṃ mantraviduccaret | ayutaṃ niyutaṃ vāpi japenmantrasya siddhaye || 28.150 || vidyāpāramavāpnoti vāgīśatvaṃ ca padmaja | vyākhyātṛtvaṃ ca kartṛtvaṃ śāstrāṇāṃ bahuvartmanām || 28.151 || sakṛdgrahaṇamātreṇa vidyāssarvāḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ | avismṛtiśca tāsu syātpuruṣārthacatuṣṭaye || 28.152 || nāsādhyaṃ kiñsidasyāsti dīrghamāyuśca vindati | ṣaṇṇāṃ mukundamukhyānāṃ manussaṃprati kathyate || 28.153 || saptārṇān purvamuccārya nāmadheyāni ṣaṭtathā | caturthyantāni yojyāni śiṣṭārṇānevamuddharet || 28.154 || jīmūtamādiṃ nāsikye varuṇaṃ praṇavādi ca | sabinduṃ bhāskaraṃ rephe pañcabinduṃ sayaṣṭikam || 28.155 || ṭhaṭhāntaṃ ca mukundhasya munurevaṃ samuddhṛtaḥ | bhāskaraṃ pāvakaṃ pañca binduryaṣṭisamanvitaḥ || 28.156 || akṣaraṃ ca dvirabhyasyenmārtāṇḍaṃ ca guhānvayam | sānusvāraṃ dvirabhyasyedviṣṇuśabdamanantaram || 28.157 || caturthyantaṃ ṭhaṭhāntaṃ ca babhrormanurudīritaḥ | parvataṃ bhuvanaṃ bhānumūrdhvalokeśanāsike || 28.158 || bhāskaraṃ pāvakaṃ pañca binduṃ nāsikyamuddharet | phaṭkāraṃ ca hutāntaṃ ca manuścaivaṃ vṛṣākapeḥ || 28.159 || khubhadaṃ pāvakaṃ caiva pañcabi ndusadarthakam | akṣaraṃ taddviruccārya ṭhaṭhānto mantra īritaḥ || 28.160 || śaurestathāparaṃ vakṣye daśārhaṃ manumabjaja | savitāraṃ bṛhadbhānuṃ sayaṣṭiṃ pañcabindukam || 28.161 || hutāntaśca manuḥ prokto vaikuṇṭhamanurucyate | paramātmā caturthyantaṃ varuṇaṃ prathamaṃ svaram || 28.162 || nāsikyaṃ kumbhamākāramardhenduṃ bhāskaraṃ tataḥ | hṛṣīkeśamanusvāraṃ nārāyaṇapadaṃ tataḥ || 28.163 || caturthyantaṃ ṭhaṭhāntaṃ ca vaikuṇṭhamanurīritaḥ | ṛṣiśchando devatā ca bījamaṅgāni ṣaṭtathā || 28.164 || aṣṭākṣaravadeteṣāṃ phalāni ca caturmukha | athāparājitaṃ mantraṃ vakṣyāmi kamalāsana || 28.165 || nigamādīn saptavarṇān gṛhītvādau yathāpuram | caturthya ntāna ntapūrvamantaśśabdaṃ samuddharet || 28.166 || sahasrādi ca śīrṣāntaṃ tadvibhaktipadaṃ punaḥ | tatsugandhaṃ tathākṣīramudārṇava padānvitam || 28.167 || śāyineti padaṃ procya śeṣabhojapadaṃ tathā | paryaṅketi caturthyantaṃ tadvibhaktiśca vāhanam || 28.168 || garuḍādi padaṃ paścādvāsudevapadaṃ tataḥ | tadvibhaktiśca satyantaṃ vāsaḥpītādi tādṛśam || 28.169 || saṃpūrvaṃ karṣaṇapadaṃ sambudhyantamanantaram | pradyumnādyaniruddhaṃ ca tadvibhaktipadaṃ smṛtam || 28.170 || hayādiśīrṣaṃ sambuddhau varāhaṃ tadvidiṣyate | nṛsiṃha vāmanapade trivikramamanantaram || 28.171 || rāmaśabdaṃ triruccārya kṛṣṇeti padamuddaret | varapradeti natyantamastītyanvakkriyāpadam || 28.172 || teca śabdaṃ caturthyanta masureti padaṃ tataḥ | daityayakṣapade coktvā rākṣaseti padaṃ tataḥ || 28.173 || bhūtaṃ piśācaṃ siddhaṃ ca yoginī ḍhākinīti ca | brahmādi rākṣasapadaṃ vināyaka padaṃ tataḥ || 28.174 || pūtanā revatīskandapurogamasamuddhṛtiḥ | gṛhīdīti ca nakṣatra gṛhīnityapyanukramāt || 28.175 || anyāṃśceti mahatpurvaṃ gṛhāniti paṭhetpadam | haniṃ dahiṃ paciṃ caiva mathihyanta śabanvitam || 28.176 || anibhirdviḥ patiṃ caiva patibhyantaṃ samanvitam | ākhyātaṃ dvissamuccārya gṛhāṇeti tathaiva ca || 28.177 || āviśa dhvaṃ siraparāstrasidruhyantaloṭparāḥ | catvāro dhātavo mantre dvirvaktavyāścaturmukha || 28.178 || cakraṃ gadāṃ ca vajraṃ ca tṛtīyā ntamudīrayet | bhasmīkurvityanukramya bāhuṃ sambaddiśīrṣakam || 28.179 || sahasrārapadaṃ sarvaṃ mukhya praharaṇāyudham | jayeti vijayeti dve pade dviḥ procya padmaja || 28.180 || anantamaparā pūrvajitaṃ pratihataṃ tathā | naṅpārvaṃ netṛparyantaṃ sahasrādipadaṃ tataḥ || 28.181 || prajvalirjvalirityete loḍantedvissamu ddharet | viśvarūpaṃ samuddhṛtya madhusūdanamanvataḥ || 28.182 || mahāpuruṣavaikuṇṭhanārāyaṇapadaṃ tataḥ | padmādinābhiparyantaṃ hṛṣīkeśapadaṃ tataḥ || 28.183 || sarvamuktvā tathā bhūtaṃ vaśīkaraṇamuddharet | śaṅkhacakragadāmuktvā dhareti tadanantaram || 28.184 || uddhṛtya sarvabhūtaṃ ca namaskṛtapadaṃ tathā | sarvamanvaṅnāgapadaṃ pramardanapadānvitam || 28.185 || sarvaṃ prapaṭhyānupūrvādasurotsādhanaṃ tataḥ | sarvadevamanukramya mahāśvaramudīrayet || 28.186 || sarvaṃ gṛhaṃ samuccārya nivāraṇapadaṃ tathā | yantramanyaṃ ca sarvādi prabhañjanapadaṃ tataḥ || 28.187 || sarvaduḥkhapraśamanaṃ sarvajvara vināśanam | sarvabandhamanukramya vimokṣaṇapadaṃ tathā || 28.188 || dussvapnamadhyaṃ sarvādivināśanamanuddharet | namaskṛtāntaṃ sarvādibhūtamadhyaṃ padatrayam || 28.189 || padadvayaṃ pūrvavatsyādapakarṣaṇamācaret | janārdaneti sambuddhau namaścāstviti te padam || 28.190 || aprameyamanusvārasahitaṃ bījamiritam | mantraṃ ṣoḍhā vibhajyāṅgamṛṣiḥ padyunma ucyate || 28.191 || chandho'ticchanda etasya viśvarūpaśca devatā | sādhayenmantravinmantramaṣṭākṣarasamādinā || 28.192 || aparājitamantreṇa nāsādhyaṃ vidyate phalam | vaśyamucchāṭanaṃ caiva tathāmāraṇakarmaca || 28.193 || kṛtyādi bhūtadoṣāṇāṃ nivāraṇamanuttamam | phalāni lipsussarvāṇi mantramenaṃ samāśrayet || 28.194 || iti śrīpāñcarātre mahopaniṣadi pādmasaṃhitāyāṃ caryāpāde yajñamūrtyādimantroddhāro nāma aṣṭāviṃśo’dhyāyaḥ |
<4.29>
śrībhagavān devīnāṃ ca śriyādīnāṃ mantrān viṣṭarakalpanam | mantrāṃśca parivārāṇāṃ prathamāvaraṇādiṣu || 29.1 || anukrameṇa vakṣyāmi yathā tadanadhāraya | chandasāmādirādyarṇaṃ turyamagneranantaram || 29.2 || agniśca mahatī māyāmanusvāraśca paścimaḥ | ekākṣaro manurbrahman śriyassarvaphalapradaḥ || 29.3 || ṛṣirmaṅkaṇakaḥ proktaśchando gāyatramucyate | śrīrasya devatā'ṅgāni svena rūpeṇa kalpayet || 29.4 || bilvānokahamūle tu lakṣajāpena sādhayet | samidbhiśca tadīyābhirjuhuyāllakṣasaṅkhyayā || 29.5 || śrīpuṣpaiḥ pāyasānnaiśca juhuyāduktasaṅkhyayā | śriyamāpnoti mahatīṃ śrīkāmo nātra saṃśayaḥ || 29.6 || praṇavādi caturthyantaṃ nāma natyantamiritam | caturakṣaramantroyamaparaśśrīsamāśritaḥ || 29.7 || ṛṣirasya dhanādhyakṣaśchandaśśrīrdevatā tathā | pratyakṣaraṃ japellakṣaṃ sādhako mantrasiddhaye || 29.8 || prāgvacca bījamaṅgāni phalamapyasya pūrvavat | nigamādiṃ bhadrahastaṃ hairambaṃ mandarā dipam || 29.9 || śubhadaṃ dahanaṃ māyāṃ mārutaṃ mādhavaṃ tathā | saptākṣaro'yaṃ śrīmantrassarvamanyadyathāpuram || 29.10 || gṛhītvaikākṣaraṃ pūrvaṃ bhānu magniṃ ca vāmanam | bhallāyudhaṃ ca mahendraṃ hṛṣīkeśaṃ sayaṣṭikam || 29.11 || śaśāṅkamaurvaṃ nāsikyaṃ subhadraṃ gadinaṃ param | jalādhidaivamādyarṇaṃ vai rājaṃ godhanaṃ dharam || 29.12 || pulahaṃ kamalaṃ śakraṃ dahakaṃ pāṭalapriyam | godhanaṃ kamalaṃ citrabhānuṃ māyāvibhūṣitam || 29.13 || prabhañjanaṃ mṛgeśaṃ ca svāhāyāṃ viramettataḥ | ṣoḍaśākṣaramantro'yaṃ śriyaḥ kamalasambhava || 29.14 || oṅkārapūrvaṃ natyantaṃ kamalaṃ mandaraṃ tathā | māhendraṃ varuṇaṃ cādidevaṃ candraṃ trivikramam || 29.15 || vighneśaṃ pañcabinduṃ ca hutāntaṃ tvidamiritam | bījāti pūrvavatsarvaṃ parigṛhya caturmukha || 29.16 || pūrvoktāṃścaturovarṇān gṛhītvātadanantaram | devānāṃ dānavacanaṃ humāntaṃ tadanantaram || 29.17 || ityuddhṛto manuścānyaśśriyaḥ kamalasaṃbhava | uddhṛtya pūrvamudgīthaṃ śrīvatsamanalaṃ tathā || 29.18 || vāmanaṃ yaṣṭi śirasaṃ dineśaṃ yāntamabjaja | pañcabinduṃ sayaṣṭiṃ ca śubhadaṃ vasumastakam || 29.19 || mahāmāyāṅkitaṃ daṇḍaṃ ṭha ṭha ityavasānakam | maṅkaṇo'sya ṛṣiśchando gāyatrī śrīśca devatā || 29.20 || japellakṣatrayaṃ mantraṃ bilvāraṇye'tha sādhayet | vaśyākarṣaṇabhūlābha khaniratnādisiddhayaḥ || 29.21 || dhyānamasya pravakṣyāmi śriyo mahendramaṇḍale | āsīnāyāḥ parijanānindrādīnarcayetkramāt || 29.22 || caturthyantaṃ svanāmoktvā satyantaṃ mantramabjaja | maṇḍale tatra padmasya pūrvādiṣu daleṣu ca || 29.23 || vāsudevādayo pyohāścatvāro dikṣvavasthitāḥ | teṣāṃ nāma caturthyantaṃ satyantaṃ praṇavānvitam || 29.24 || gagguluśca kuraṇḍaśca damaka śśalalastathā | koṇavarṇeṣu saṃsthyapya mantrāṃstannāmapūrvakam || 29.25 || ratissarasvatī bhūmiḥ pritiḥ kīrtiścaturmukha | śāntiḥ puṣṭiśca tuṣṭiśca śriyo'dhastācca śaktayaḥ || 29.26 || nāmāni tāsāṃ manavo yathāpūrvamudīritāḥ | pārśve ca dakṣiṇe tasyāśśriyaḥ padmanidhisthsitaḥ || 29.27 || vāme śaṅkhanidhirnāma tayormantraṃ yathāpuram | dhanado māṇibhadraśca jṛmbhalo nalakūbharaḥ || 29.28 || pūrṇabhadraścalendraśca kalisrakśibikuṇḍalaḥ | pūrvādidikṣu bhavināmetāṣāṃ manurucyate || 29.29 || nigamādiṃ subhadraṃ ca ekadantaṃ sayaṣṭikam | dhanadasya manuḥ prokto nāma natyantameva ca || 29.30 || bhallāyudhaṃ padmanābhaṃ pañcibinduṃ sadaṇḍakam | nalakūbaramantraśca kathitaḥ kamalodbhava || 29.31 || kakubhaṃ padmanābhaṃ ca nāsikyaṃ jṛmbhalo manuḥ | sparśāntaṃ pulahaṃ cordhvalokeśaṃ tadanantaram || 29.32 || māṇibhadrasya sadṛśo manussarvārthasādhakaḥ | paścimaṃ pītavarṇābhaṃ bhuvanaṃ yaṣṭimastakam || 29.33 || pūrṇabhadrasya kathito manurevaṃ caturmukha | vakratuṇḍaṃ ca bhuvanaṃ pulahaṃ bhuvanaṃ punaḥ || 29.34 || nāsikyaṃ manuretasmin śibhikuṇḍalanāmani | brahmāṇamādiṃ pulahaṃ guhālayasayaṣṭikam || 29.35 || uddhāraśca manorevaṃ kathitaḥ kalimālinaḥ | vakratuṇḍaṃ pītavarṇaṃ hṛṣīkeśaṃ ca taddhravam || 29.36 || carendramantraḥ kathitaḥ pūrvādiṣu yathākramam | mandaraṃ pulahaṃcaiva guhālayavidarbhitam || 29.37 || māhendrasya manuḥ proktassubhagaḥ pulahodayaḥ | dhanādhyakṣasya mantro'yaṃ kathitaḥ kamalāsana || 29.38 || pārśveca dakṣiṇe pūjyāśśriyaḥ parijanā sthitāḥ | khaḍgadāmodaraṃ caiva mahāmāyāṃ sabindukam || 29.39 || cintāratnasya kathito manuḥ pūrvadalāśrayaḥ | śrīvatsamagniṃ bhuvanaṃ sadaṇḍaṃ ca caturmukha || 29.40 || kathita ścha balāmantrastārkṣyasthāne samarcanam | indrādayo lokapālāssvāśāsu paritasthsitāḥ || 29.41 || tṛtīyāvaraṇe cāpi balākī vanamālinī | vibhīṣī śāṅkarī caiva dikṣu pūrvādiṣu sthitāḥ || 29.42 || sakañcukā vetrahastā mantrāstāsāṃ samāhvayāḥ | viṣvaksenapade puṣpadāriṇi marcayettataḥ || 29.43 || kalpakaṃ pārijātaṃ ca haricandanabhūruham | santānamandarau caiva dvārabhūṣuniveśayet || 29.44 || bilvaṃ ca sarasīṃ caiva śatapatrasamākulām | śriyaṃ parigatāṃ pakṣi saṅghātakalanisvanām || 29.45 || parivārān prakalpyaipaṃ tattannāmabhirarcayet | caturthyantairnatiparaiḥ praṇavapramukhaistathā || 29.46 || mālāmantraṃ pravakṣyāmi śriyaḥ kamalasambhava | udgīthamuktvā prathamaṃ natiścatadanantaram || 29.47 || uktvā bhagavatī śabde śrīcaturthyantamanvataḥ | dhīrāpadaṃ ca sambuddhau śrīpūrvaṃ nilayaṃ tathā || 29.48 || ākārapūrvaṃ bharaṇaṃ śatamaṇḍita manvataḥ | śarīreti ca sambuddhiḥ padānyevaṃ samuddharet || 29.49 || bhāskaraṃ cānalaṃ pañca binduṃ candrārdhaśekham | kalātmānaṃ visargāntaṃ bījayetatsamuddharet || 29.50 || dviruccāryaṃ bharapadaṃ pāpaśabdādanantaram | alakṣmīmitivaktavyaṃ nāśayeti dvirīrayet || 29.51 || bhāskaraṃ cānalaṃ paṃca binduṃ yaṣṭimanantaram | trirabhyasettathā saptajanmapūrvarjitaṃ tathā || 29.52 || akhalaṃ procya dāridryaṃ padaṃ dūrāttathā padam | utsārayeti dviḥ procya candramādi visargitam || 29.53 || tristriḥ procyaṃ tvadabhaktajanaśabdamanantaram | vasuṃ niyojayetyuktvā dhārayeti padaṃ punaḥ || 29.54 || pūrayeti dviruccārya padamambhoruhāsana | prapannalokaṃ hrīṅkāraṃ trirucchārya hayaṃ gajam || 29.55 || vividhaṃ paśumuccārya nicayaṃ tadanantaram | dāsīdāsaṃ parijanaṃ tadantaṃ dvirvilokaya || 29.56 || māṃ ca saumyeti cetyuktvā avalokanasaṃyutam | lakṣmīmagniṃ vikramaṃ ca śrīdharaṃ yaṣṭimastakam || 29.57 || triruccārya yajeti dvirbhavatīti ca padmaja | surāsuretyanuguṇaṃ siddhagandharvarākṣasam || 29.58 || yakṣavidyādharavadaṃ nikhilaṃ jantuśabdakam | manobhiriti cārāṅkṣya samāgamamanantaram || 29.59 || priyeti sambuddhipadaṃ bhāskaraṃ saguhālayam | sārdhacandramidaṃ bījaṃ triruccārya parādite || 29.60 || varaṃ vividhamuccārya sitamālāmbaraṃ tathā | dhāraṇīti samucchāryaṃ nikhilaṃ rociṣaṃ vasu || 29.61 || nicayā bhavatī padmā sambuddhau tattrayaṃ padam | śrīpadaṃ cāpi natyantamastvityatatkriyāpadam || 29.62 || yuṣmacchabdaṃ caturthyantaṃ ṭhaṭhānto manurīritaḥ | pūrvavadbījamasyāpi mantraṃ bhaṅtkvāṅgakalpanā || 29.63 || chando'ticchanda etasya devatā śrīrdhanādipaḥ | draṣṭā phalaṃ japaścāsya dviṣaṭkākṣaravatphalam || 29.64 || adhunā vasudhāmantraṃ pravakṣyāmi caturmukha | brahmakośaṃ mukhaṃ tasya śrīvatsaṃ jvalanaṃ tathā || 29.65 || vāmanaṃ mādhavaṃ devadattaṃ śrībījameva ca | kamalaṃ bahulaṃ pañcabinduṃ subhagamanvataḥ || 29.66 || bhadrahastaṃ vidhātāramanalaṃ vāmanaṃ tathā | subhagaṃ gopanayutaṃ vighneśaṃ ca samiraṇam || 29.67 || karālamagnimikāraṃ ṭhaṭhāntaṃ ṣoḍaśākṣaram | tārādivasumadhyaṃ ca ṭhaṭhāntaṃ hṛdayādiṣu || 29.68 || aṅgeṣu yojayenmantraṃ namaskārapadaṃ śṛṇu | sāmāyā ca tathā saumyā sambuddhau tatpadadvayam || 29.69 || samayaṃkari cetyacuktvā mahāśabdamanantaram | ṭābantassamayāśabdassambuddhau ca ṭhaṭhāvadhi || 29.70 || hyāntameti tathā pūrvaṃ gaccheti padamanvataḥ | dirvaktavyaṃ padadvandvaṃ bhagapūrvāvadhīti ca || 29.71 || vasuśabdaṃ dehī śīrṣaṃ ṭhaṭhāntaṃ tena cāhvayet | devīṃ ca vasudhāṃ dhyāyettaptahālakarociṣam || 29.72 || siṃhāsanasthāmākalpairanekairbhūṣitāṃ sadā | gṛhītadāḍiminālavāmahastāṃ tathetare || 29.73 || haste dadhānāṃ subhagaṃ cintāratnaṃ caturmukha | pūrṇaṃ nānāvidhairatnaiḥ kumbhaṃ cordhvamukhaṃ sthitam || 29.74 || dakṣiṇe caraṇāṅgaṣṭhe paścimāmarabhūruham | pārśvayorubhayoścāpi vālavyajanapāṇibhiḥ || 29.75 || anyābhiśśukla tāmbūladhāriṇībhiśca sevitām | śaṅkhapadmanidī cāpi vamantau vipulaṃ dhanam || 29.76 || parasparamukhaprekṣau parivāhau sthitau punaḥ | anuktaparivārāśca grāhyāśśrīmanuvartmanā || 29.77 || samudragāyāssaritassrotasi prāṅmukhasthsitaḥ | mastadaghne japellakṣaṃ mantrasiddhau samāhitaḥ || 29.78 || vaiśākhe māsiśukle ca pakṣe māsarkṣapaścime | vrataṃ samāpaye ccakre pūjayecca mahāniśi || 29.79 || mallikāvakulaiścānyaissugandhaiḥ kālajaiśśubhaiḥ | goghṛtaiśca tilairanyairyathābhilaṣitairalam || 29.80 || tarpaṇaṃ mantrajāpaṃ ca nityametatsamācaret | evamācaratassamyaṅmantriṇo yāvadāyuṣam || 29.81 || vasati śrīrgṛhe tasya saptajanmasu niścalā | manuṃ dharaṇyā vakṣyāmi sādhanaṃ ca yathātatham || 29.82 || chandasāmādimuddhṛtya sūkṣmādṛkpulahaṃ tathā | hṛṣīkeśaṃ visargāntaṃ manurekākṣaraḥ smṛtaḥ || 29.83 || gopanaṃ pañcabinduṃ ca ūrdhvalokeśamanvataḥ | vīrasenaṃ kalāntaṃ ca saṅkarṣaṇasamāhvayam || 29.84 || sabinduṃ gadinaṃ tānaṃ kalpayeddhṛtayādiṣu | paiṭharosya muniśchando daivaṃ gāyatramiritam || 29.85 || devatā dharaṇī devī japellakṣamatantritaḥ | manurdharaṇyāssaptārṇaḥ kathyate kamalāsana || 29.86 || dhanadaṃ pāvakaṃ cādiṃ sumukhaṃ godhanāhvayam | natyantamevaṃ saptārṇo dharaṇyāssaṃpradarśitaḥ || 29.87 || manuścatustriṃśavarṇaḥ kathyate kamalodbhava | ādāya cādau saptārṇān kumbhamādi macāmanu || 29.88 || śaśāṅkamādiṃ bhuvanaṃ subhagaṃ dattasaṃjñitam | subhadramūrdhvalokeśaṃ vijayaṃ viṣṇuśīrṣakam || 29.89 || mohanāśaṃ tathākāraṃ vai rājaṃ cāgnivikramam | bhallāyudhaṃ ca mahendraṃ hṛṣīkeśavigarhitam || 29.90 || sānusvāraṃ ca kamalaṃ pāvakaṃ saguhālayam | nāsikyaṃ tridaśāhāraṃ trivikramasamāhvayam || 29.91 || krodharūpaṃ ca sumukhaṃ sodakaṃ kalaśaṃ tataḥ | praṇavādiṃ ca mahendraṃ varṇānāṃ ca samuddharet || 29.92 || subhadraṃ devattaṃ ca bhāskaraṃ yaṣṭimastakam | pāvakaṃ pāṭalaṃ brahma māhendraṃ ca guhālayam || 29.93 || prabhañjanaṃ pūrṇacandramauṣadhaṃ yaṣṭisaṃyutam | svāhāyāṃ viratirmantraḥ kathitaḥ kamalāsana || 29.94 || pūrvoktaṃ bījamaṅgāni ṛṣiśchandhaśca devatā | sārasvataṃ manuvaraṃ pravakṣyāmi yathā tatham || 29.95 || nigamādiṃ śvetaraśmiṃ manumardhenduśekharam | ityuddharetsvayaṃ gāṃ ca draṣṭā kaśyapanandanaḥ || 29.96 || chandaśca devī gāyatraṃ devatā bhāratī svayam | lakṣamekaṃ niyamavān japenmantramatandritaḥ || 29.97 || atulā vāgnibhūtissyāllabhate jñānamuttamam | sakṛdgrahaṇamātreṇa grahaṇaṃ dṛḍhamaśnute || 29.98 || smṛtipramoṣo naivāsya sabhāyāṃ na parābhavaḥ | anyaṃ sārasvataṃ mantramadhunā kathayāmi te || 29.99 || mukhamasya brahmakośaṃ godhanaṃ cenduśekham | kamalaṃ pulahaṃ māyāmanussvārapariṣkṛtām || 29.100 || yaṣṭiṃ yaṣṭyāvisargāntaḥ pūrvoktaṃ mantramanvataḥ | triyakṣarasya coddhāraḥ kathitaḥ kamalāsana || 29.101 || draṣṭā vasiṣṭho mantrasya virāṭ chandassarasvatī | devatā japanaṅkhyā ca lakṣatrayamudāhṛtam || 29.102 || parāparajño pāgmī ca saptakṛto'bhimantritam | jalaṃ pibeddhruvaṃ tasya kalyāṇī vāgbhaviṣyati || 29.103 || ṣaḍakṣaragaṇo mantraḥ kathyate kamalāsana | tārakaṃ varuṇaṃ cādiṃ nāsikyaṃ jvalanāhvayam || 29.104 || madhusūdanamanvakcha huṃphaḍantaṃ namaskṛtiḥ | ṛṣirmaheśvaraśchando virāṭ saiva ca devatā || 29.105 || daśākṣaraṃ mantrarājaṃ varṇoddhāreṇa cocyate | vyāpī sudhārasaścāpi vaidharo viṣṇumastakaḥ || 29.106 || varṇā sta eva catvāra ssamanantaramiritāḥ | īrayitvā tathā kuṃbhaṃ madhusūdanamanvataḥ || 29.107 || pañcāntakaḥ pāśapāṇiṃ madhusūdhanapaścimam | vaidharaṃ rāmasahitaṃ vighnesaṃ bandhumastakam || 29.108 || hutāntamarṇānuddhṛtya manureṣa samiritaḥ | aṅgāni rūpaṃ mantrasya bījamevaṃ vibhājitam || 29.109 || candramaṇḍalamadhyasthāṃ tuṣāranicayaprabhām | vamantīmamṛtaṃ vaktrājjihvāmadhyagatāṃ smaret || 29.110 || dhyāyato mandriṇastasya vāksiddhiratulā bhavet | nigamādiṃ ca nattyantaṃ subhadraṃ gadinaṃ tathā || 29.111 || kumbhamādiṃ ca vijayaṃ govindaṃ madhuketanam | vijayaṃ mādhavayutaṃ ṭhaṭhāntaṃ manumuddharet || 29.112 || jvalanaṃ cādimardhendu bījamevaṃ samuddaret | draṣṭāsya devalaśchando virāṭ devī rati stathā || 29.113 || daśa lakṣaṃ japenmantraṃ tatassidhyati mantriṇaḥ | vaśyākarṣaṇa vidveṣamukhā ca phalasantatiḥ || 29.114 || dūrādāgamanaṃ cāpi proṣitasyā'cirādbhavet | saptavarṇān samuccārya pūrvoktān samanantaram || 29.115 || pavitraṃ pīṭhamanvakcha pañcabindumanantaram | vairājaṃ godhanaṃ vāyuṃ ṭhaṭhāntaṃ manumuddharet || 29.116 || ekacakṣuśca pīṭhaṃ ca hṛṣīkeśaṃ sabindukam | bījamuktaṃ manorasya muniraṅgirasaḥ smṛtaḥ || 29.117 || chandaśca devī gāyatraṃ devatā prītirucyate | sādhayitvā yathāpūrvaṃ dharmādiphalabhāgbhavet || 29.118 || saptārṇāḥ pūrva vadgrāhyāḥ karālaṃ vāmanaṃ tataḥ | ekadṛggodhanaṃ citrabhānuṃ ca madhusūdanam || 29.119 || yaṣṭiṃ karālamagniṃ ca dhruvaṃ cāgneśca yoṣitam | tadeva bījaṃ draṣṭā ca manuḥ kīrtiśca devatā || 29.120 || chandaśca devī gāyatraṃ pūrvavatsiddhisādhane | varṇānādāya saptādau pariśiṣṭān samuddharet || 29.121 || śrīvatsaṃ gopanaṃ bhadrapāṇiṃ ca vijayaṃ tathā | sparśanaṃ vīrasenaṃ ca śubhadaṃ dahanaṃ manum || 29.122 || yaṣṭiṃ ca bhāskaropetaṃ pāvakaṃ bindupañcakam | sayaṣṭiṃ bījasahitaṃ śriyassvāhāpadāvadhi || 29.123 || chando virāṭ gautama rṣirdevatā śāntirucyate | manunā sādhayedbrahman pādukādiphalaṃ mahat || 29.124 || saptavarṇā yathāpūrvaṃ nṛhariṃ pāvakaṃ tathā | mahāmāyāmanusvāraṃ vijayaṃ praṇavādikam || 29.125 || udayaṃ krodharūpaṃ ca bhūdharaṃ gopanaṃ tathā | ṭhaṭhāntamevamuddhṛtya manurjñeyo vicakṣaṇaiḥ || 29.126 || draṣṭā vyāso virāṭchando devatā tuṣṭirucyate | lakṣatrayajapenaiva tuṣṭiśca mahatī bhavet || 29.127 || saptārṇāḥ pūrvavadgrāhyāśśiṣṭārṇasyoddhṛtiḥ kramāt | bhāskaraṃ pāvakaṃ pañcabinduṃ yaṣṭisamanvitam || 29.128 || pavitraṃ bhuvanaṃ krodharūpaṃ bhūdharamanvataḥ | govindamāgneyī manvaguddhṛtya manurīritaḥ || 29.129 || draṣṭeritastatheśānā puṣṭiśchando virāḍabhūt | aṣṭalakṣaṃ japenmantraṃ puṣṭikāmassamāhitaḥ || 29.130 || bhuktvā bhogāṃśca vipulān rasāyanapurogamān | atalādiṣu lokeṣu mantrī carati devavat || 29.131 || yogāsanāṅgā nyādhāraśaktyādīni caturmukha | yāni teṣāṃ kalpaneṣu varṇoddhārapurassaram || 29.132 || mantrānvakṣyāmyānupūrvyāyathāvadavadhāraya | brahmasośamukhaṃ vidyātpavitramṛtadhāma ca || 29.133 || hṛṣīkeśaṃ binduparaṃ pratardanamataḥ param | padmanābhaṃ ca nāsikyaṃ gopanaṃ subhagaṃ punaḥ || 29.134 || ādidevaṃ hutavahaṃ śrīvatsaṃ kamalāhvayam | vairājaṃ vīnasenaṃ ca natimevaṃ samuddharet || 29.135 || ādhāraśaktimantroyaṃ kathitaḥ kamalāsana | caturmukhaṃ caturbhāhuṃ śuddhasphaṭikavarcanam || 29.136 || kirīṭahārakeyūrapramukhākalpabhūṣitam | śrīvatsāṅkaṃ śaṅkhacakragadāpadmāyudhairyutam || 29.137 || tejomaṇḍalamadhyasthaṃ dhyāyedādhārarūpiṇam | brahmakośaṃ dinakaraṃ bhuvanaṃ pāpakāhvayam || 29.138 || guhālayaṃ dhruvaṃ bhūyaḥ kamalaṃ saguhālayam | pāvakaṃ mandaraṃ padmamākāraṃ vipulaṃ tathā || 29.139 || gopanaṃ ca gadadhvaṃsaṃ vināyakamanantaram | prabhañjanaṃ mādhavaṃ ca satyantaṃ manumuddaret || 29.140 || ekavaktraṃ caturbhāhuṃ japāpuṣpasamadyutim | śaṅkacakradharaṃ kruddhaṃ padmakaumodakīdharam || 29.141 || vahnimaṇḍalamadhyasthaṃ jvalanāpītavigraham | sakalābharaṇopetaṃ dhyāyetkūrmamanantaram || 29.142 || udgīdhaṃ bhānumākāraṃ yaṣṭimādiṃ vināyakam | dviradaṃ vijayākāraṃ śvasanaṃ prathamaṃ svaram || 29.143 || natiṃ coddhṛtya mantro'yamanantasya pradarśitaḥ | sphaṭikādripratīkāśaṃ caturbhāhuṃ kirīṭinam || 29.144 || pūrṇacandrānanaṃ saumyaṃ sitapuṣpaurvirājitam | lāṅgalaṃ musalaṃ mukhyakarayordadhataṃ śivam || 29.145 || jaghanyakarayośśaṅkhacakradvandvaṃ yathāyatham | nīlāmbaradharaṃ daṃṣṭrākarālavadanairyutam || 29.146 || praśāntavapuṣā yuktaṃ sahasraphalamunnatam | phaṇāmaṇisahasrāṃśu nīrājanavirājitam || 29.147 || anantavaktrakuharairudvamantamudarciṣam | maṇḍalīkṛtanāgendra bhogaveṣṭana vigraham || 29.148 || dhyāyedanantamubhayoḥ pārśvayornāgayoṣitaḥ | devyastasya sukhāsīnāḥ phaṇāmaṇḍala maṇḍitāḥ || 29.149 || dhyātvā bhuvo manuḥ paścādvarṇoddhāreṇa vakṣyate | tāraṃ subhaganāmānamarciṣmantaṃ caturmukha || 29.150 || sumukhaṃ godhanaṃ vāyuṃ natyantamiti kalpayet | tasyopari phaṇīndrasya tapanīyanibhāṃ śubhām || 29.151 || caturaśrāṃ mahāpīṭhiṃ kalpayenmadhuvidviṣaḥ | dharmādīnāṃ caturṇāṃ tvadharmādīnāṃ ca tāvatām || 29.152 || pādānāṃ kalpanāmantarā vakṣyante kamalāsana | ādyarṇān praṇavādīṃ śca sānusvārān yathāyatham || 29.153 || caturthyantāni nāmāni procyānte natimirayet | mathye sadāśivapadaṃ pādatvena prakalpayet || 29.154 || taccaturthyantamādau ca bhāskaraṃ saguhālayam | natyantaṃ caiva pādānāṃ navānāṃ kalpayenmanūn || 29.155 || ṛgādayaścaturvedā steṣāṃ tu manavaḥ punaḥ | sānusvārāṃ stadādyarṇān procyādau kamalāsana || 29.156 || caturthyantāni nāmāni ṛgādīnāṃ satīḥ punaḥ | manūn prakalpayedevaṃ bhautikādirahaṃkṛtiḥ || 29.157 || tisraḥ prakalpayetpaścāttāsāṃ mantrān bravīmi te | praṇavādīn pullanayanānacāmādiṃ sadaṇḍakam || 29.158 || bhautikādirahaṅkāraścaturthyanto nati stathā | paścimaṃ mārutaṃ cordhvalokeśaṃ bindumastakam || 29.159 || padaṃ ca taijasaṃ śiṣṭaṃ pūrvavanmanurīritaḥ | kumbhamaurvaṃ sanāsikyaṃ vai kāripadamanvataḥ || 29.160 || śiṣṭaṃ yathāpuraṃ sarvaṃ manuranyassamiritaḥ | satvaṃ rajastamaśceti guṇān paścātprakalpayet || 29.161 || sānusvāraṃstadādyarṇān caturthyantāṃstadāhvayān | manūn prakalpayedevaṃ mahyādyaistatprakalpanam || 29.162 || ātmaśabjaṃ caturthyantaṃ mahyādi padapūrvakam | huṃphaḍhantaṃ ca satyantaṃ prayuñjīta manuṃ punaḥ || 29.163 || praṇavaṃ mandaraṃ yaṣṭiṃ musalaṃ pañcabindukam | amṛtaṃ gopanayutaṃ vijayaṃ mādhavīṃ tathā || 29.164 || bhadrahastaṃ mṛgeśaṃ ca natimuddhṛtya mantravit | mantreṇāstaraṇādhyāso vahnyādermaṇḍalatrayam || 29.165 || tasyo pari ṣṭādadhyāsān mantrān sarvānyathākramam | pāvakaṃ śaśinaṃ sūryaṃ trayamākārabindukam || 29.166 || manumevaṃ samuddhṛtya padmaṃ corikalpayet | praṇavaṃ paścimaṃ yaṣṭiṃ pavitraṃ vijayaṃ tathā || 29.167 || dakṣaṃ ca gopana paraṃ śvasanaṃ ca vināyakam | viṣṇuṃ ca mandaraṃ svargamuddhṛtyā jamanuḥ smṛtaḥ || 29.168 || śrīvatsādidvādaśānāṃ śaktīnāṃ tatsamāhvayāḥ | caturthyantāssanā sikyāstadādyarṇa puraskṛtāḥ || 29.169 || mantrobhadrāsanasyaiṣa kathitaḥ kalpānā kramaḥ | brahmādaya stataḥ paśchātsanakāditrayaṃ punaḥ || 29.170 || vināyakaśca durgā camantriṇo gururasvataḥ | praṇavādyāścaturthyantā natyantāśca tadāhvayāḥ || 29.171 || tānarcayecca brahmadīn paricaryāmukhe hareḥ | aṣṭau vyāptyādikāśśaktīḥ prathamāvaraṇe jayet || 29.172 || pūrvavattatsamākhyābhirmantraiḥ pañcāyudhānyapi | divyāni dikpatīn sarvānindrādīn vihagādhipam || 29.173 || seneśaṃ ca caturthyantairnatyantaiśca svanāmabhiḥ | pūrvavatpūjayedprahman dvitīyāvaraṇe tataḥ || 29.174 || caṇḍapracaṇḍāvantasthsau dvārsthau ca manunā jayet | nigamādiṃ khaḍgadharamṛtamotaṃ sayaṣṭikam || 29.175 || vakratuṇḍaṃ pracaṇḍaṃ ca puṇḍarīkākṣagopanau | prabhañjanaṃ cāprameyaṃ natyanto manurīritaḥ || 29.176 || prathamaṃ chanda sāmādiṃ paścimaṃ ṛtadhāmakam | sadaṇḍaṃ pāpahananaṃ dahanaṃ vakratuṇḍakam || 29.177 || pracaṇḍaṃ puṇḍarīkākṣaṃ caturthyantaṃ tathā natiḥ | caṇḍapracaṇḍayormantrassamuddhṛtyārṇamiritaḥ || 29.178 || udumburasya satyantaṃ śāntimādivibhaktikam | udīrayedadhiṣṭhātrī tasya śāntiśca devāta || 29.179 || sarasvati dakṣiṇasyāṃ ratiścottaradāruṇi | śrīḥ paścimādadhastasya śāntirbhavati devatā || 29.180 || caturthyanaṃ ca tannāmamantraścoktaścaturmukha | kavāṭe dakṣiṇe viśvanetrasyāddevatā tathā || 29.181 || uttare viśvavaktraśca devatā vetradāruṣu | vasanti vedaśāstrāṇi nārāceṣu tathā marāḥ || 29.182 || ṛṣayaḥ kīradeśeṣu bhūteśaḥ paṭṭikā bhuvi | viśvabhāvanavāsassyātkandapaṭṭadvayaṃ tathā || 29.183 || nāma teṣāṃ caturthyantaṃ manurvāstupatestathā | kṣetreśasya manurbrahman chandasāmādimuddharet || 29.184 || nṛsiṃhamudayaṃ dakṣamṛtadhāmasadaṇḍakam | caturthyantaṃ namontaṃ ca tārkṣyamagreharesthsitam || 29.185 || dvārapārśve śaṅkhacakradvayaṃ tatsaṃjñayārcayet | vacmi dhāmārcane mantraṃ chandasāmādimuddharet || 29.186 || varuṇaṃ bandhuśirasaṃ krodharūpaṃ vanasrajam | varuṇaṃ devadattaṃ ca paścimaṃ vahnigopanau || 29.187 || śaśāṅka mādidevāntaṃ vaidharaṃ dahanaṃ tataḥ | hṛṣīkeśaṃ paścimaṃ ca rāmaṃ sumukhamanvataḥ || 29.188 || mādhavaṃ huṃphaḍantaṃ ca svāhāntāvadhiko manuḥ | diṅmārtayaścānupūrvyā kathyante kamalāsana || 29.189 || indreśānau nṛsiṃhaśca viriñcaśca kramādbhavet | diṅmārtayo'thavā śaktidharaḥ paśupati stathā || 29.190 || śrīdharo dhanadaśceti yadvākroḍākṛtirhariḥ | nṛsiṃhaśśrīdharaśceti hayaśīrṣākṛti stathā || 29.191 || api vā syāccaturvaktra naranārāyaṇāvubhau | hariḥ kṛṣṇaśca kathito yadvā satyādayaḥ kramāt || 29.192 || vāsudevādayo pyohā yadvā diṅmārtayaḥ kramāt | kramācca toraṇāyānte pūrvapaścimadhāmayoḥ || 29.193 || caturaśrāyate dhāmni pūrvapaścimanāsayoḥ | pūrṇaśca puṣkaraśchadvāvadhiṣṭāne punaḥ kramāt || 29.194 || āgneye hastivadano yāmye paśupati stathā | vāruṇe dakṣiṇāmūrtiḥ kaubhere viśvarūpadhṛk || 29.195 || śāṅkare ca caturvaktra tasmin bhagavatī tathā | antarmaṇḍalasambandhigopurobhayapārśvayoḥ || 29.196 || candrādityau tathorvyāṃ tu indradikṣu vidikṣu ca | manmathaśca vidhātā ca vi śveśaṣṣaṇmukha stathā || 29.197 || durgādhanadarudrāśca kṣetreśa stadanantaram | someśānāntare caiva viṣvaksenaḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ || 29.198 || dakṣiṇorvītale saptamātaro vīrabhadrakaḥ | vighneśaḥ pārśvayosteṣāṃ jyeṣṭhāṃ nirṛtibhūtale || 29.199 || indhrādayassvāsu dikṣu dvitīyāvaraṇe punaḥ | bhagavatpramukhe tarkṣyodvitīyāvaraṇe tataḥ || 29.200 || tadīyagopuradvārapārśvayoḥ puraṣācyutau | khalurikādharitrīṣu vahnyādīnāṃ diśi kramāt || 29.201 || hayaśīrṣaḥ karṣaṇaśca kroḍākṛtiranantaram | pradyumno'nantanāmānāvaniruddhonṛkesarī || 29.202 || cakraṃ ca musalaṃ śaṅkhaṃ khaṅgaṃ kaumodakīṃ dhanuḥ | vajraṃ padmamiti proktaṃ prāgādiṣu tṛtīyake || 29.203 || gopurobhayapārśvasthā dvādaśāśśītaraśmayaḥ | yamāgnimadhye pasavaḥ pitaro yamarakṣasoḥ || 29.204 || viśve devāśca madhyasthā nirṛtervaruṇasya ca | marutaḥ pāśahastasya śvasanasya ca madhyamāḥ || 29.205 || pāśimārutayormadhye munayassapta ca sthitāḥ | kubereśānayormadhye rudrāścaikādavasmṛtāḥ || 29.206 || kṣetrapālaścatatraiva prācyādau kumudādayaḥ | maryādāhvayasālasya dvāri purṇaśca puṣkaraḥ || 29.207 || urvītale samārādhyāḥ prāṅkaṇeklṛptapīṭhake | sthāpyāścai pottamagaṇāḥ prācyādiṣvaṣṭanu kramāt || 29.208 || tathopendrādayasthsāpyā mahatyāvaraṇe tataḥ | mahītale madhyagaṇā viśve śādyā diśi kramāt || 29.209 || jayādayo gopurāṇāṃ bahirbhūmau vyavasthitāḥ | balipīṭheṣu sarvatra prathamāvaraṇādiṣu || 29.210 || ādyāścha kāmajāścaiva ye bhūtāḥ prāgdiśi sthitāḥ | prasannāḥ parituṣṭāste gṛhṇantu balikāṅkṣiṇaḥ || 29.211 || bhūmau pyomni tathā vṛkṣaparvatādiṣu viṣṭhitāḥ | vināyaka kṣetrapālāśśūrāśca kumudādayaḥ || 29.212 || sarvaiḥ pāriṣadaiścānyaipsārdhaṃ gṛhṇantu te balim | caṇḍādayotha dvārasthāścaturthyantaissvānāmabhiḥ || 29.213 || praṇapādyaiśca natyantairdevīparijanānvitāḥ | savāhanāste saṃpūjyāssve sve deśe caturmukha || 29.214 || balipīṭheṣu sarveṣāṃ baligrahaṇakāṅkṣiṇām | tattannāmasamuccārya balirdeyo vicakṣaṇaiḥ || 29.215 || dhāmeśānaṃ vinā tena balidānena yo'rcati | haranti rāṣṭraṃ rājānaṃ dhāma cātmānameva ca || 29.216 || parivārānasabhyarcyatathaivāgnessamindharam | bhogairakṛtvā devasya pūjā syānniṣprayojanā || 29.217 || tasmādyathoktamārgeṇa pūjanaṃ sthānavṛddhidam | vardhanaṃ rājarāṣṭrāṇāṃ prajānāṃ vṛddhikāṅkṣiṇām || 29.218 || dṛśyādṛśyena rūpeṇa sthitānāṃ balikāṅkṣiṇām | bhūtānāṃ bhūtikāmena deyo'vaśyaṃ balissadā || 29.219 || iti śrīpāñcarātre mahopaniṣadi pādme tantre caryāpāde śriyādiparivāra mantravarṇanaṃ nāma ekonatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ |
<4.30>
śrībhagavān tithiyāgaṃ caturvaktra bravīmi sukhapādhanam | kāmyasya karmaṇaḥ kālaśśuklapakṣastathā tithiḥ || 30.1 || japahomārcanaissamyakkāleṣvārādhayetsudhīḥ | agnirbrahmādhaneśānau vighneśaśśrīṣṣaḍānanaḥ || 30.2 || bhānurvṛṣadhvajo durgā yamo valanighādanaḥ | viṣṇuḥ kāmo'śvinau candra ityuktāstithi devatāḥ || 30.3 || praṇavaṃ navabinduṃ ca varuṇaṃ śrīdharaṃ tataḥ | gadadhvaṃsaṃ bhadrahastaṃ pāvanaṃ mādhavaṃ tataḥ || 30.4 || ṭhaṭhāntamuddhṛtya manuḥ kathito jātavedasaḥ | agnimādyamanusvāraṃ bījaṃ tenāṅgapaddhatiḥ || 30.5 || chando virāṭ devalaśca draṣṭāgnirathidevatā | caturthyantaṃ svābhidhānaṃ natyantamasaro manuḥ || 30.6 || ṛṣiśchando devatāpi manorasyāpi pūrvavat | pratyakṣaraṃ lakṣajapassādhanaṃ mantrayordvayoḥ || 30.7 || kāmyasya lābhassarvasya phalamatyantadurlabham | nigamādiṃ kālanemimṛtadhāmavidarbhitam || 30.8 || mārtāṇḍamandarayutaṃ pracaṇḍaṃ mādhavaṃ natim | ityuddharedbrahmamanumuddhāro'nyasya kathyate || 30.9 || caturthyantaṃ brahmapadamāgneyīniṣṭhitaṃ manuḥ | vai rājamakṣaprathamaṃ vijayaṃ rohiṇīpatim || 30.10 || akāramekanetraṃ ca bījaṃ praṇavasaṃyutam | etadevāṅgasantānassvaraśchandaśchalohitaḥ || 30.11 || munirbrahmāca devaśca yaṣṭavyaṃ paṅkajotare | praṇavaṃ sūkṣmadṛṣṭiṃ ca bhadrapāṇiṃ sabindukam || 30.12 || uddhṛtyaikākṣaro mantraḥ kuberasya samiritaḥ | uṣṇikchando munirvahnirdhaneśānaśca devatā || 30.13 || ārambhaṃ natimanvakca subhagaṃ vighnanāyakam | pavitraṃ vijayaṃ paścāddhvaṃsanaṃ mādhavaṃ tathā || 30.14 || kamalaṃ codayaṃ procya jṛmbhalaṃ mṛgavallabham | pāvakaṃ gopanayutaṃ sadāgatimanantaram || 30.15 || kumbhaṃ śaśāṅkaṃ bhuvanaṃ herambaṃ rāmasaṃyutam | vakratuṇḍaṃ jagatprāṇaṃ mandaraṃ paścimānanam || 30.16 || āgnimādyaṃ mārutaṃ ca prathamaṃ pretanāyakam | acāmādi mathāgneyīmuddhṛtya manurīritaḥ || 30.17 || dhanadasya nabho draṣṭā chandogāyatramiritam | daivaṃ dhanādhipo devo bījaṃ pūrvavadīritam || 30.18 || aṅgaṣṭhe māṇibhadrākhyaṃ tarjanyāṃ pūrṇabhadrakam | kalimāliṃ madhyamāyāṃ vikuṇḍalamanāmikām || 30.19 || mūle kaniṣṭhakāyāṃ ca madhye ca maṇibandhayoḥ | makhendraṃ pāṇitalayo raṅganyāse dhanādhipaṃ || 30.20 || snātvājṛmbhalamantreṇa prakṣipedudakāñjalim | ambhojakarṇikāmadhye mahākāyaṃ mahodaram || 30.21 || dvibhujaṃ pītavasanaṃ cintāratnaṃ rake sthitam | dhārayantaṃ manaḥ kāntaṃ mantribhyo pīpsitaṃ vasu || 30.22 || yakṣayakṣīparijanaṃ dhyāyannarghyādibhiryajet | ṛddhiṃ guptiṃ ca tatpārśve caturthyantaṃ svasaṃjñayā || 30.23 || arghyādyairarcayitvātu tato jṛmbhalamabjaja | kalimāliṃ māṇibhadraṃ carendhraṃ pūrṇabhadrakam || 30.24 || mukhendraṃ śikhipūrvaṃ ca kuṇḍalaṃ nalakūbaram | ambhojakarṇikāmadhye daleṣvindrādiṣu kramāt || 30.25 || arcayetpurataśśaṅkhanidhiṃ padmanidhiṃ tathā | śabalāṃ purato nyasyetpṛṣṭhataḥ kalpakadrumam || 30.26 || japahomau tarpaṇādi phalaṃ mūlamanoryathā | vakṣyāmi jṛmbhalamanumarṇoddhāreṇa saṃprati || 30.27 || omādiṃ subhagaṃ bhadrahastaṃ vaidhara makṣaram | ādidevaṃ mārutaṃ ca dhanadaṃ bhadrabāhukam || 30.28 || pavitraṃ vijayaṃ caiva mārutaṃ mādhavaṃ tathā | janmahantṛ tathāmnāyaṃ mādhavaṃ sūkṣmadarśanam || 30.29 || vikṣkambhamādidevaṃ ca sparśaṃ svāhayā yutam | bījamādyakṣaraṃ bhargo draṣṭā cchando virāṇmanoḥ || 30.30 || devatā jṛmbhalaḥ kāryaḥ phalaṃ sarvaṃ prayacchati | vighneśamantramuddhṛtya varṇān vakṣyāmyanukramāt || 30.31 || udgīthaṃ ca tṛtīyaṃ ca sparśeṣu pulahaṃ manumam | daṇḍa ityuddhṛto mantro gaṇikāṣṣaḍvirāṭtathā || 30.32 || devatā vighnu rājaśca japo lakṣatrayaṃ smṛtam | bhūtaṃ bhavyaṃ bhaviṣyaṃ ca svapne paśyati mantravit || 30.33 || ārabdhaṃ karmanirvighnaṃ phalaṃ dugdhe yathepsitam | tṛtīyādiṃ ca sumukhamādyaṃ paścimasaṃjñitam || 30.34 || acāṃ mukhaṃ ca vijayaṃ prāṇaṃ mādhavamanvataḥ | satyantamādau pūrvoktaṃ manuṃ ca manurīritaḥ || 30.35 || ajo muniśchanda uṣṭigdevatā vighnanāyakaḥ | saptalakṣaṃ japenmantraṃ siddhayaḥ pūrvamiritāḥ || 30.36 || ekākṣaraṃ natiśiro manuranyassamiritaḥ | nigamādiṃ dinakaraṃ jvalanaṃ pañchabindukam || 30.37 || sānusvāraṃ gadadhvaṃsaṃ padmanābhaṃ ca vāmanam | yaṣṭiṃ sahasrakiraṇaṃ pāvakaṃ daṇḍaśekharam || 30.38 || triyakṣaramanurbrahman kathitassarvasādhanaḥ | aṅgādi gaditaṃ varṇamakārādisvarāntakam || 30.39 || prayuñjīta manuścānyo vakṣyate kamalāsana | udgīthamādiṃ kamalaṃ pāvakaṃ pañcabindukam || 30.40 || ardhendusahitaṃ bhadramanalaṃ binduvāmanam | saroruhaṃ samāhendraṃ mahāmayā sayaṣṭikam || 30.41 || bījaṃ ca tatsvarādyarṇaṃ gadadhvaṃsaṃ pracaṇḍakam | paścimānanavairājau māyāṃ ca vasudhārasaṃ || 30.42 || ādimagni makāraṃ ca phaṭpadadvayamirayet | śaśinaṃ varuṇaṃ vahniṃ kakubhaṃ bhadrabāhukam || 30.43 || mandaradvayamekāraṃ varuṇaṃ kamalāmukham | acāṃ dakṣaṃ gopanaṃ ca vighneśaṃ śvasanaṃ tathā || 30.44 || ṭhaṭhāntamatthamuddhāro bījādi kathitaṃ purā | aihikāmuṣmikaphalaṃ sarvametena sādhayet || 30.45 || śriyaṃ pūrvoktamārgeṇa devīmarghyādibhiryajet | tatkaṭākṣanipātena labhate śriyamuttamām || 30.46 || tāraṃ natiṃ krodharūpaṃ pracaṇḍaṃ dakṣamanvataḥ | udayaṃ kharvadehaṃ ca gopanaṃ ca prabhañjanam || 30.47 || śaśāṅkaṃ śrīdharaṃ hrasvamṛtadhāmasamāhvayam | dineśaṃ mādhavīmanvakpracaṇḍaṃ madhusūdanam || 30.48 || śvasanaṃ svāhayā sārdhaṃ manureṣasamiritaḥ | jṛmbhalaṃ pulahaṃ cordhvalokeśaṃ yaṣṭimastakam || 30.49 || etadbījasamuddhārastadevāṅgamṛṣiḥ punaḥ | varṇātmā kathitaśchando gāyatraṃ devatā guhaḥ || 30.50 || dāḍimikusamaprakhyāṃ tanmantreṇa samarcayet | evaṃ kṛtavato vaṃśe subrahmaṇyādayo grahāḥ || 30.51 || na pīḍayanti tadvaṃśyān bhavanti cirajīvinaḥ | nigamādiṃ coṣadhīśamanunāsikyamuddharet || 30.52 || ekākṣaro'yaṃ kathito mantrassarvārthasādhakaḥ | hārito mantradṛcchando virāṭ sūryaśca devatā || 30.53 || brahmakośaṃ padmapāṇimṛtaṃ sumukhasaṃjñitam | rāmabinduṃ hṛṣī keśamagniṃ vāyumacāṃ mukham || 30.54 || vaidharaṃ binduvairājaṃ vāyuṃ tāraṃ samuddharet | itthamaṣṭākṣaro mantro bījamekākṣaraṃ smṛtam || 30.55 || ṛṣikatriśca devaśca pūṣā caivādhidevatā | paraṃ saptākṣaraṃ mantraṃ mantrairuddhṛtyavarṇyate || 30.56 || saptārṇāḥ pūrvavadgrāhyassubhadraṃ madhusūdanam | bhadrahastaṃ ca kalaśaṃ mādhavaṃ pūrvamiritam || 30.57 || bījamabhyantarīkṛtvā dviruktaṃ kakubhaṃ tathā | aprameyaṃ gandhavahamādyametadanantaram || 30.58 || pādadvitayamāpāhya mādidevamanantaram | pāvakaṃ vikramayutaṃ vaidharaṃ ṛtadhāma ca || 30.59 || mārutaṃ cāpi nāsikyaṃ vighneśaṃ gopanāhvayam | kamalāmādipavanamādyaṃ dviḥ padamiriyet || 30.60 || mādhavīmādisahitamakṣaraṃ dviradaṃ paṭhet | pavitraṃ gopanayutaṃ paṭhemaṃ svarasaṃyutam || 30.61 || vighneśaṃ dahatiṃ dhātuṃ loḍantaṃ dvissamuddharet | śāntarogaṃ sukhapadaṃ pūrvaloḍantamadhyamam || 30.62 || yamaṃ caṇḍaṃ dviruccārya triranvakpraṇavaṃ padam | svanāmnā praṇavāntena manurevaṃ samuddhṛtaḥ || 30.63 || bījamaṅgāni coktāni sindhudvīpaśca dṛṣṭavān | aticchandassvayaṃ chandassūryaścānena kathyate || 30.64 || padma madhye karṇikāyāmādityaṃ dalabhūmiṣu | prācyādiṣu grahānanyāṃ stadānīṃ bimbamarcayet || 30.65 || kramāt ṣaḍṛtavassarve gṛhāssānugrahāstadā | āyurārogyasaundarya samṛddhi mukhasaṃpadaḥ || 30.66 || saptajanmasuvaṃśe'sya bhavantini ravagrahāḥ | praṇavaṃ natimanvakca śubhadaṃ ca trivikramam || 30.67 || varuṇaṃ gopanaṃ vāyumādimuddṛtya mantravit | manuḥ pañcākṣaraḥ kāryo bījaṃ saṃprati kathyate || 30.68 || gopatiṃ viṣṇusahita manusvāraṃ samuddharet | bījametaccaturvaktra ṣaḍaṅgānāmudāharet || 30.69 || upamanyuṛṣiśchandho devaṃ gāyatramucyate | pratipādyo mahāśāno japassyāllakṣapañchakam || 30.70 || aṣṭākṣaravadasyāpi phalasādhanameva ca | raktāmbujāsanāsinamarcayettaddaleṣu ca || 30.71 || prāgādiṣu ṣaḍaṅgāni pārvatīnandikeśvarau | kramādvinyasya purato vāhanaṃ samyagarcayet || 30.72 || dikṣvaṣṭānu surendrādīnaṣṭāvarghyādinārcayet | sṛṣṭyādinyasanaṃ kṛtvā prathamaṃ tadanantaram || 30.73 || akṣarasyasanaṃ kuryāt sthāneṣveteṣu padmaja | mūrdhni cāsye ca hṛdaye guhye pādatale tathā || 30.74 || varṇānāṃ kramaśo varṇāḥ pañcānāṃ kathyate'dhunā | sphaṭikaṃ pāṭalaṃ pītaṃ śvetaṃ nīlamitismaret || 30.75 || śivo'hamiti cātmānaṃ bhāvayenmantravittamaḥ | dhyāyantaṃ devadeveśamārādhya vṛṣabhadhvajam || 30.76 || tyaktvā saṃsārikaṃ duḥkhameti sthānamanaśvaram | bhogānapyaihikān bhuktvā durlabhānamarairapi || 30.77 || omādisaptavarṇānāmuddhāraḥ pūrvamiritaḥ | vaidharaṃ nṛhariṃ māyāṃ pracaṇḍaṃ madhusūdanam || 30.78 || mandaraṃ cordhvalokeśaṃ vairājaṃ dviścaturmukha | pāvakaṃ pavanaṃ devadattaṃ pāṭalamanvataḥ || 30.79 || gopatiṃ mārutamatho mandaraṃ mādhavīṃ tathā | mādhavaṃ dhanadaṃ brahman madhusūdanasaṃjñitam || 30.80 || nāsikyaṃ paścimaṃ padmanābhaṃ ca pavanāhvayam | khaḍgaṃ dvirucca retsvāhā iti mandraṃ samuddhṛtam || 30.81 || manumanyaṃ pravakṣyāmi tamarṇairuddharāmyaham | tāramatriṃ garutmantaṃ rāmaṃ sumukhamanvataḥ || 30.82 || gopavaṃ mandaraṃ cordhvalokeśaṃ vijayaṃ punaḥ | tamarṇaṃ cābhiśaṅkhaṃ ca mādhavaṃ vāruṇābhidham || 30.83 || gopanaṃ ca karālaṃ ca kamalaṃ jṛmbhalaṃ tataḥ | śrīdharaṃ subhagaṃ māyāṃ janmadhvaṃsamanantaram || 30.84 || pāśapāṇiṃ cādidevaṃ bhadrahastaṃ ca paścimam | ṛtāhvayaṃ vaidharaṃ ca madhubhinmārutaṃ tataḥ || 30.85 || satimuddhṛtya kathito varṇān ṣoḍaśa saṃjñitān | mantrayoranayorbrahman jīvo draṣṭābhidhīyate || 30.86 || dharmavarttīmaheśāno devatā dakṣiṇātanuḥ | dineśa rāmasahitaṃ śvasanaṃ matibindumat || 30.87 || bījametadato dhyānamiśānasya bravimite | kundendhumuktāśaṅkhābhaṃ sarvākalpapariṣkṛtam || 30.88 || vaiyāghracarmavasanaṃ jaṭāmaṇḍalamaṇḍitam | nāsāgranyastanayanaṃ śaśikhaṇḍavirājitam || 30.89 || prasannavadanaṃ devaṃ caturbhujamabhīṣṭadam | vāmajānuni vinyastavāmetarapadāmbujam || 30.90 || pphaṭikāmakṣamālāṃ ca bibhrāṇaṃ dakṣiṇekare | vāme karāmbuje svīye dhṛtavijñānapustukam || 30.91 || darśayantaṃ jñānamudrāṃ maharṣigaṇasevitam | dhyāyato mantriṇastvaivaṃ sidhvanti sakalāḥ kalāḥ || 30.92 || gaṅgāpravāhavattasya vākprasāraḥ pravartate | caturvargaphalāvāptistasya haste sthitā dhruvam || 30.93 || japabhūyastayo kāmān durlabhān sukhamaśnute | tithau bhagavatīṃ durgāṃ navamyāṃ samyagarcayet || 30.94 || nigamādiṃ vaidharaṃ ca bhuvanaṃ ca visarjanam | manurekākṣaraḥ proktassamuddhṛtya yathātatham || 30.95 || svīkṛtyaikākṣaraṃ pūrvaṃ gadadhvaṃsaṃ hutāśanam | sparśanaṃ godhanāhvānaṃ natiṃ ca manurīritaḥ || 30.96 || bījamasyoddhariṣyāmi gopatiṃ pāvakaṃ tataḥ | vāmanaṃ yaṣṭiśirasamasya kātyāyano muniḥ || 30.97 || chandaśca devi gāyatraṃ vanadurgā ca devatā | mantramanyaṃ pravakṣyāmi durgāśrayamanuttamam || 30.98 || nigamādiṃ viṣṇusaṃjñaṃ kapilaṃ jṛmbhalāhvayam | mādhavaṃ ca surendrādiṃ pradyumnaṃ kālanemijam || 30.99 || madhusūdananamānaṃ pulahaṃ māyayāvṛtam | karālaṃ devadattākhyaṃ śaśāṅkaṃ kamalānugau || 30.100 || pavitramādi devāntaṃ nṛhariṃ sparśanaṃ tathā | brahmaṇamagniṃ coddhṛtya pañcabindumanantaram || 30.101 || ādiṃ śrīvatsamudayaṃ subhadraṃ nāsikāhvayam | bhāskaraṃ bhadrabāhudvau vaidharaṃ gopatidvayam || 30.102 || pavitrakhaḍganāmānau dvau ca dakṣamanantaram | supratiṣṭhaṃ dviruccārya dinakṛnmādhavīdhruvau || 30.103 || phaṭkāramagnyādimanvagityuddhṛtya japenmanum | arṇoddhārakramādanyaṃ mantraṃ vacmi caturmukha || 30.104 || praṇavaṃ vaidharaṃ paścācchrīdharaṃ gadinaṃ tathā | vaiśvānaraṃ mṛgapatiṃ tamevārṇamanantaram || 30.105 || yāntaṃ nṛsiṃhaṃ sumukhaṃ rāmaṃ svāhaṃ samuddharet | uddhṛto'yaṃ manuścānyo bījamaṅgāni pūrvavat || 30.106 || ṛṣirjayamatiśchando giridurgāca devatā | udgīthaṃ śrīdharaṃ caiva dṛṣṭidvandvaṃ trivikramam || 30.107 || krodharūpi ca jīmūtaṃ paścimaṃ bhuvanāhvayam | bahulaṃ śrīdharaṃ krodhaṃ vikramaṃ sarasīruham || 30.108 || vikramaṃ dharmaśītāṃśuṃ śaśāṅkaṃ ca sudhāmayam | paścimaṃ rāmaśirasaṃ krodharūpaṃ savikramam || 30.109 || bhallāyudhaṃ tathā śaṅkhamādhavīdvayamādhavam | śuklamādiṃ mṛgapatiṃ śrīdharaṃ paścimānanam || 30.110 || nīhāradīdhitiṃ sarvarodhaṃ vikramaśīrṣakam | vairājaṃ kapilaṃ śaṅkhaṃ vaidharaṃ bandhumastakam || 30.111 || śubhadaṃ kamalaṃ vāyuṃ mandaraṃ vittavarthanam | ādiṃ karālamanilaṃ nāsikyaṃ yādasāṃ patim || 30.112 || gopanaṃ vijayaṃ vighnunāyakaṃ dakṣamādhavau | subhadraṃ ca gadiṃ kumbhaṃ vairājaṃ bandhuśīrṣakam || 30.113 || śubhadaṃ mandaraṃ śaṅkhaṃ ṭhaṭhānto manurīritaḥ | ṣoḍhā vibhajya taṃ mantraṃ hṛdayādyaṅgakalpanam || 30.114 || draṣṭā vareṇyako nāma hyanuṣṭhupchanda īritaḥ | devatā vanadurgāsyāttadaṣṭākṣara vatphalam || 30.115 || sarvadāhvayadurgāyā mantramuddhārayāmi te | udgīthaṃ natimanvakca sūkṣmadṛgdṛṣṭiśīrṣakam || 30.116 || gadadhvaṃsamakāraṃ ca kumbhanādyaṃ caturmukha | vairājaṃ rājamānaṃ vai vaidharaṃ śrīdharāhvayam || 30.117 || gadinaṃ bandhusaṃjñaṃ ca svāhāśīrṣaṃ śriyaḥ patim | gadinaṃ pāvakaṃ caiva dṛṣṭimikāramanvataḥ || 30.118 || dehaṃ ca vikramaṃ caṇḍaṃ rāmaṃ mandarasaṃjñitam | madhusūdaṃ gandhavahaṃ mādhavaṃ mādharāhvayam || 30.119 || ādityaṃ gopanaṃ dakṣamādidevaṃ ca mārutam | mṛgeśaṃ mandharaṃ bhānuṃ madhusūdanasaṃjñitam || 30.120 || pulahaṃ devadattaṃ ca dakṣaṃ ca yadabhāskaram | rāma mugrātmanātmānaṃ madhusūdanamanvataḥ || 30.121 || śaśāṅkaṃ śrīdharaṃ sapta jihvaṃ kumbaṃ trivikramam | kajānanaṃ gopatiṃ ca lakṣmīṃ bhadraṃ trivikramam || 30.122 || vaidharaṃ bhuvanāhvānamugrarūpaṃ ca kheṭakam | bhallāyudhaṃ tathā brahman śvasanaṃ nāsikā bhuvam || 30.123 || vidhātāraṃ hutavahaṃ vikramaṃ ca sudhārasam | rāmaṃ ca bhadraṃ subhagamanilaṃ vighnanāyakam || 30.124 || rāmaṃ mahendrasubhagaṃ maheśaṃ gaganāhvāyam | mārtāṇḍamādidevaṃ ca śaśāṅkaṃ śrīdharaṃ tathā || 30.125 || citrabhānuṃ tathā dakṣaṃ vaidharaṃ havyavāhanam | vighneśaṃ vikramaṃ dṛṣṭiṃ devadattamapāṃ patim || 30.126 || madhusūdananāmānaṃ kalātmānamataḥ param | bhuvanaṃ pāvakaṃ dṛṣṭiṃ gopanaṃ vijayaṃ tathā || 30.127 || vāyuṃ pavitramākāraṃ musalaṃ vikramaṃ punaḥ | ekanetraṃ mādhavaṃ ca kalaśaṃ pāpakāhvayam || 30.128 || vaidharaṃ devadattaṃ ca vighneśaṃ madhusūdanam | dahanaṃ gopanaṃ caiva mārutaṃ vanamālinam || 30.129 || māyāṃ ca vaidharāhvānaṃ madhusūdanamandharau | otadehaṃ dṛṣṭimagniṃ paścimānanamanvataḥ || 30.130 || ṛtadhāmaṃ vikramaṃ ca śvasanaṃ mṛganāyakam | puṣṭibhījaṃ triruccārya sahasrakiraṇāhvayam || 30.131 || guhālayamanusvāraṃ bījametattriruddharet | bhadraṃ guhālayaṃ caiva vijayaṃ gadinaṃ tathā || 30.132 || padmanābhaṃ gopatiṃ ca kalaśaṃ mṛgarāṭ tathā | vai rājamādidevaṃ ca ḍuṇḍubhaṃ locanodayau || 30.133 || ugrātmakheṭakau vahniṃ gopatiṃ vihagādhipam | śvetāṃśu paścimaṃ lakṣmīmādidevamanantaram || 30.134 || vakratuṇḍaṃ gopanaṃ ca bhadrapāṇimanantaram | vijayākāramādiṃ ca śaśāṅkaṃ ca sadāgatim || 30.135 || dvirabhyasetkālanemiṃ bhadraṃ puṇyaṃ dviruccharet | mandaraṃ cādidevaṃ ca dahanaṃ śvasanaṃ tathā || 30.136 || dvirbrūyātsūkṣmadṛgbrahman karālaṃ vijayaṃ punaḥ | pīyūṣamādiṃ vijayaṃ vasumastakaniṣṭhitam || 30.137 || nihāradīdhitimacāmādiṃ pītaṃ samādhavam | subhadraṃ kamalaṃ caikadṛṣṭiṃ ca caturāsana || 30.138 || pavitramṛtadhāmānaṃ trivikramamataḥ param | puruṣātmānameṇeśaṃ paścimaṃ puratastathā || 30.139 || dhruvaṃ dhruvaṃ tathā hrasvaṃ māhendraṃ mandaraṃ tataḥ | sarvarodhaṃ gajāsyaṃ ca māyāṃ kamalamandarau || 30.140 || ekanetramṛtaṃ śulaṃ bahu kukṣiṃ trivikramam | karālaṃ padmanābhākhyaṃ vighneśaṃ vijayaṃ tathā || 30.141 || bhadrahastaṃ tathā rāmaṃ śaśāṅkaṃ manumanvataḥ | subhadraṃ gopanaṃ paścātpañcāntikamathānilam || 30.142 || paścimaṃ padmanābhākhya mṛtadhāmānamasvataḥ | jṛmbhalaṃ pulahaṃ pāpahananaṃ padmanābhakam || 30.143 || dṛṣṭiṃ mṛgeśamamṛtamāryāṃ ca dvirguhālayam | pavitramṛtadhāmānaṃ vaidharaṃ mādhavaṃ tataḥ || 30.144 || mārutaṃ kamalāṃ padmapavitramṛtadhāma ca | atriṃ mṛgapatiṃ lakṣmīṃ bahulaṃ pañcabindukam || 30.145 || pavitramṛtadhāmānaṃ vai rājaṃ vikramaṃ tathā | paścimaṃ padmanābhākhyaṃ vaidharaṃ mṛgavallabham || 30.146 || dakṣaṃ raviṃ gopanākhyaṃ subhadraṃ bhuvanaṃ tathā | kakubhaṃ mādhavaṃ paścānmādhavīṃ bhāskarāhvayam || 30.147 || gopanaṃ matimantaṃ ca pulahaṃ mādhavaṃ ravim | yaṣṭiṃ ca vyāharedbrahman tathaiva madhusūdanam || 30.148 || dhruvaṃ nabhomaṇiṃ gopaṃ binduṃ ca caturāsana | evaṃ tri rvyāharedarṇaṃ sugataṃ sāgarottamam || 30.149 || mandaraṃ bhāskaraṃ paścādgopanaṃ mādhavīṃ tathā | ādidevaṃ jagatprāṇaṃ mādhavaṃ natimuddharet || 30.150 || ityevamuddhṛto mantro brahman sarvārthasiddhadaḥ | śatena saṃmito varṇo raśmītyādibhireva saḥ || 30.151 || bhāskaraṃ mandharaṃ pañcabinduṃ yaṣṭimanantaram | uddhṛtya bījametena ṣaḍaṅgāni prakalpayet || 30.152 || draṣṭā kakutsthaśchandassyādaticchando tra devatā | sarvadāhvānamantrasya caturlakṣojapaḥsmṛtaḥ || 30.153 || jñānāddhyānājjapānmantrassiddhiṃ sarvāṃ prayacchati | mantriṇo nityayuktasya pratyahaṃ prayatātmanaḥ || 30.154 || āmuṣmikaṃ caihikaṃ ca phalaṃ sarvaṃ prayacchati | daśamyāmarcayedbrahman kṛtāntamabhayapradam || 30.155 || nigamādiṃ gandhavahaṃ hṛṣīkeśamantaram | daṇḍaṃ prabhañjanaṃ dakṣaṃ cādidevaṃ sadāgatim || 30.156 || nitimuddhṛtya kathito manurvaivasvatā śrayaḥ | bījamarṇān samuddhṛtya śvasanaṃ yaṣṭiśīrṣakam || 30.157 || uditaṃ tena bījena hṛdayādyaṅgakalpanam | ṛṣissatyatapāśchando gāyatraṃ daivamiritam || 30.158 || mantraśca pitṛdaivatyo japaḥ syātpañcalakṣakaḥ | tenārādhya śrāddhadevamabhīṣṭaṃ sarvamaśnute || 30.159 || prathamaṃ chandasāmādiṃ vikramaṃ mānuṣeśvaram | vaidharaṃ vahnimaparaṃ gopanaṃ pavanaṃ mukham || 30.160 || satimuddhṛtya māghonaḥ kathito manurabjaja | vaidharaṃ cordhvalokeśaṃ nāsikyaṃ bījamuddhṛtam || 30.161 || ṛṣirdevo virāṭ chando devatā valasūdanaḥ | eteneṣṭvā turāsāhaṃ sāmrājya phalamaśnute || 30.162 || dvādaśyāṃ mālamantreṇa pūjayeduktavartmanā | bhagavantaṃ śriyaḥ kāntaṃ phalamipsan sudurlabham || 30.163 || nigamādiṃ ca natyantaṃ paścimodayanaṃ tathā | krodharūpaṃ pavitraṃ ca śrīvatsaṃ pāvakaṃ tataḥ || 30.164 || ādidevaṃ ca pananaṃ gopanaṃ yaṣṭimanvataḥ | gopatiṃ bahulaṃ pañchabinduṃ narahariṃ tataḥ || 30.165 || aurvaṃ yaṣṭiṃ ca kamalaṃ gopanaṃ mandarāhvayam | vaidharaṃ devadattaṃ ca kamalaṃ gopanaṃ tathā || 30.166 || śaṅkhaṃ ṭhaṭhāntamuddhṛtya manureṣa samiritaḥ | svargādiṃ pulahaṃ bandhuṃ nāsikyaṃ bījamuddharet || 30.167 || ṛṣiśśrīnidhirasyokto virāṭ chandaśca devatā | manmathastena yaṣṭavyassa sarvaphalakāṅkṣibhiḥ || 30.168 || ekārṇamaparaṃ mantramuddhariṣyāmi padmaja | tāraṃ garuḍamaurvaṃ ca sabinduṃ manurīritaḥ || 30.169 || lakṣamekaṃ japenmantrī karmaṇyākarṣaṇādike | samarthaṃ kāmadaivatyaṃ manumanyaṃ bravīmi te || 30.170 || udgīthaṃ kamalaṃ pītaṃ māyāmardhenduśekham | karālaṃ gopanaṃ dakṣaṃ vaidharaṃ tadanantaram || 30.171 || mṛgendraṃ varuṇaṃ cādi devaṃ śvasanasaṃjñitam | śuklaṃ sudhāmayaṃ vahniṃ kakubhaṃ savināyakam || 30.172 || śaśāṅkhaṃ mādhavaṃ brahmasādhakaṃ bhāskarāhvayam | hairambaṃ gopanaṃ vāyuṃ kakubhaṃ yādasāṃ patim || 30.173 || pulahaṃ nigamādiṃ ca taddvayaṃ tadviruccharet | paścimaṃ tvṛtadhāmānaṃ pūrṇaṃ parvabhiruccharet || 30.174 || śaśāṅkamādiṃ jalajaṃ pītaṃ varuṇamabjaja | kakubhaṃ viṣṇuvighnesau prathamaṃ tagmadidhitim || 30.175 || padmanābhaṃ vaidharaṃ ca vāyumādyaṃ ca mandaram | mandarādyadvayaṃ bhūyastadeva samanantaram || 30.176 || varuṇaṃ viṣṇumabjāṃ ca yaṣṭi mabjodayau tathā | dahanaṃ śrīdharaṃ varṇaṃ pulahaṃ brahmasādhanam || 30.177 || karālamādyaṃ kalaśaṃ mukhaṃ śrīvatsamanvataḥ | prabhañjanaṃ gopanaṃ ca sparśamādyamapāṃ patim || 30.178 || ṭhaṭhāstamuddhṛtya manuḥ kathitaḥ kamalāsana | ṛṣiḥ kaliṅgo'ticchandhaśchandaḥ kāmaśca devatā || 30.179 || japeddviraṣṭau lakṣāṇi nāsādhyaṃ tena mandriṇā | ratiśca viratiścobhe tasya pārśve sthite sadā || 30.180 || mantra stayośchaturthyantaṃ nāmamātraṃ triśīrṣakam | madanaḥ prathamo bhāṇastathaivonmādano'paraḥ || 30.181 || mohanaṃ dveṣaṇaṃ ca dve dīpanaṃ pañcamaṃ smṛtam | mallikā ketakī jātiḥ paṅkajaṃ yūdhikā tathā || 30.182 || puṣpāṇi kramaśo bhāṇānyā husteṣāṃ manuḥ punaḥ | saṃvidyarṇāśca sahitāścaturthyantāssamāhvayāḥ || 30.183 || teṣāṃ satyantasahitaṃ taisteṣāmarcanaṃ vidhuḥ | dhanuraṅkaśapāśāśca tasyāstrāṇi manobhuvaḥ || 30.184 || mantrāśca pūrvavatteṣāṃ nāmānyeva caturmukha | kalpakānokaha prāya puṣpitadrumaśobhite || 30.185 || udyāne mañju śiñjānapakṣisaṅghiniṣevite | madhye mahāhrade pūrṇe sarojaiśca vikasvaraiḥ || 30.186 || viṣṭare kāñcane nyaste śubhā staraṇasaṃyute | āsīnaṃ saha devībhyāṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitam || 30.187 || raktacandanaliptāṅgaṃ raktamālyopaśobhitam | cārukuṇḍalinaṃ kāntaṃ yuvānaṃ kṣaumavāsanam || 30.188 || vasānamapsaromukhyai strīgaṇaiḥ parito vṛtam | dhyāyannanena manunā kramādarghyādibhiryajet || 30.189 || kāmagāyatriyā vāpi yajeta makaradhvajam | japādi pūrvavatsarvaṃ vaśyaṃ ca bhuvanatrayam || 30.190 || mantriṇo nityayuktasya kimanyairatisistaraiḥ | aśvinormantramadhunā bravīmi kamalāsana || 30.191 || uddhṛtya pūrvamudgīthaṃ vighneśaṃ pāṭalapriyam | brahmasādhananāmānaṃ śrīvatsaṃ ca sudhāmayam || 30.192 || māyāṃ subhadra mākāramaśvinorīrito manuḥ | ādimardhendusahitaṃ bījaṃ tenāṅgakalpanā || 30.193 || bhṛgurdraṣṭā bṛhacchandaḥ pratipādyau tathāśvinau | japanvaipañcalakṣeṇa siddhissarvārṇasādhanaḥ || 30.194 || rājayakṣmādayo rogā na tiṣṭhanti tadanvaye | auṣadhāni ca dakṣāṇi vyādhīnāmapanodane || 30.195 || tatkarasparśamātreṇa sarvaṃ vastvauṣadhaṃbhavet | paurṇamāsyāṃ tathā somaṃ yajeta manuvittamaḥ || 30.196 || nigamādiṃ pūrṇacandramotadehaṃ samandaram | madhumārutavighneśaṃ mādhavīṃ ca visarjanam || 30.197 || somasya kathito mantro bījamuddhārayāmite | sitamādimanusvāraṃ kuryāttenāṅgasantatim || 30.198 || draṣṭā kaumodako nāma paṅtkicchandassa devatā | japaḥ pūrvavadevāsya gāyatryā vā samarcayet || 30.199 || phalaṃ ca sarvaṃ pūrvoktaṃ candrasālokyamapyatha | ityuktāstithamo devāsteṣāṃ mantrāssamarcanam || 30.200 || phalāni ca samastāni krameṇāpyuditāni te | nārādhyaṃ tithiyogaistairaihikā muṣmikātmakam || 30.201 || phalaṃ mantraprasādhena taddevānāṃ mahattayā | nukṛtānyapi karmāṇi vinā vighneśapūjayā || 30.202 || na phalantyantarāyeṇa nihatāni caturmukha | tadādau karmakurvāṇairārādhyo vighnanāyajaḥ || 30.203 || iti śrīpāñcarātre mahopaniṣadi pādmetantre caryāpāde tithidevatāmantroddhāro nāma triṃśo'dhyāyaḥ |
<4.31>
brahmā bhagavan vighnarājasya janmakīdṛkkutaśca saḥ | bhūṣaṇānāṃ ca koṭīrapramukhānāṃ yathātatham || 31.1 || cakrādīnāmāyudhānāṃ tārkṣyaseneśayorapi | manavaḥ pūjitāyaistaiḥ pūjitāḥ phalahetavaḥ || 31.2 || iti sarvaṃ samācakṣvamayi te yadyanugrahaḥ | śrībhagavān asurairarditā devā balino yuddhadurjayauḥ || 31.3 || śaraṇyaṃ śaraṇaṃ jagmuḥ pradyumnamabhayapradam | devā āhaveṣu vayaṃ daityairbalavantopi bādhitāḥ || 31.4 || yathā te vighnavihatāḥ palāyante tathā kuru | pradyumnastairiti proktaḥ kruddhassaṃraktalocanaḥ || 31.5 || kopāttasya samudbhūtassamyak stambheramānavaḥ | sañjātaṃ prāñjalipuṭaṃ kurvāṇaṃ taṃ purasthsitam || 31.6 || taṃ dṛṣṭvā gajavadvaktraṃ provācedaṃ vacastadā | devānāmasurāṇāṃ ca saṅgrāme samupasthite || 31.7 || sannidhāya bhavāṃstatra daityānāṃ vighnamācara | ityuktvā miṣatastasya pradyumno bhagavān hariḥ || 31.8 || antardadhe surāścāpi pratijagmuryathā gatam | tataḥ prabhṛti vighneśa prasādāddevatāgaṇāḥ || 31.9 || asurān jaghnivāṃsastena ca jagmuḥ parābhavam | ākalpasya kirīṭasya manuṃ vakṣyāmi saṃprati || 31.10 || vyāpinaṃ natimuddhṛtya kamalaṃ tadanantaram | mahāmāyāṃ saptajihvaṃ pañcabindusamāhvayam || 31.11 || hṛdayāhlādamākāraṃ pavanaṃ śuklamandarau | dākṣāyaṇīśavijayau mandaraṃ ca saroruham || 31.12 || śrīdharaṃ hṛdayāhlodaṃ mādhavaṃ vittavardhanam | kumbhaṃ hutāśanaṃ devadattaṃ kṣīraṃ sudhāmayam || 31.13 || dahanaṃ gopanaṃ vāyuṃ karālaṃ kamalodbhava | otadehaṃ kṣitidharaṃ vikramaṃ dhūmaketanam || 31.14 || amṛtaṃ bandhusahitaṃ bhadrahastaṃ trivikramam | caturgatiṃ śrīdharaṃ ca vijayaṃ mādhavaṃ tathā || 31.15 || hastivaktraṃ vaidharaṃ ca bhuvanaṃ kāmagaṃ tataḥ | vairājaṃ vaidharāhvānamirayitvā tataḥ param || 31.16 || rāmaṃ pavitraṃ vijayaṃ gopanaṃ dviradānanam | mahendraṃ kuñjaramukhaṃ vikramaṃ sūkṣmalocanam || 31.17 || gopanaṃ sparśanāmādidevaṃ samasaroruham | māhendraṃ paścimaṃ cādidevaṃ ca dhanadāhvayam || 31.18 || vikramaṃ paścimaṃ caiva vijayaṃ ca turānana | prabhañjanamṛgeśaṃ ca madhusūdana saṃjñitam || 31.19 || mārtāṇḍaṃ pāpakamatho pañcabinduṃ sabindukam | karālamṛtadhāmānaṃ mahāmāyāṃ sayaṣṭikam || 31.20 || gopatiṃ śrīdharayutaṃ nāsikyaṃ phaṭkṛtiṃ tathā | svāhāyāṃ viramenmantraṃ bījamasyocyate'dhunā || 31.21 || kamalaṃ tvṛtadhāmānaṃ mahāmāyā pariṣkṛtam | uddhṛtaṃ ṣatṣaḍaṅgāni draṣṭā cākhaṇḍala stathā || 31.22 || chandaśca paṅtkirityuktaṃ kirīṭo devatāpi ca | kirīṭinaṃ ca dvibhujaṃ mahākāyaṃ mahodaram || 31.23 || kṛtāñjalipuṭaṃ prahvaṃ susthitaṃ bhūṣaṇairyutam | dhyātvaivaṃ mantravinmantraṃ pañcalakṣamatandritaḥ || 31.24 || natyantaṃ chandasāmādiṃ śrīśabdaṃ kalaśaṃ tathā | ekanetraṃ hutavahaṃ śaśāṅkaṃ madhusūdanam || 31.25 || sadāgatiṃ cādidevaṃ nāsikyaṃ yaṣṭisaṃjñitam | lakṣmīṃ karālaṃ pulahaṃ mahāmāyāṃ sabindukam || 31.26 || tārkṣyamaurvādikaṃ yaṣṭiṃ huṃphaṭkāraṃ hutāntimam | śrībhījaṃ tadbhavedbīja mṛṣiścaiva prajāpatiḥ || 31.27 || virāṭ chandaśca gāyatraṃ śrīvatso devatā matā | śrīvatsamantramaparaṃ kathayāmi caturmukha || 31.28 || oṃkāraṃ prathamaṃ somaṃ svarādi jayamārutau | mādhavaṃ tārakādhīśamekanetraṃ samārutam || 31.29 || kalaśaṃ vijayaṃ paścānmahāmāyāpariṣkṛtam | śuklaṃ ca tāraṃ śvasanaṃ kuṃbhaṃ vairājameva ca || 31.30 || analaṃ pūrṇacandraṃ ca pulahaṃ mādhavaṃ tathā | satyantaṃ śuklavijayau śvasanaṃ śvetarociṣam || 31.31 || dakṣaṃ daraṃ devadattāmoṣadhīśaṃ tathābjaja | vairājaṃ prathamaṃ kumbhamṛtadhāmavadarbhitau || 31.32 || jayaṃ sadāgatiṃ devadattaṃ caiva ṭhaṭhāntimam | śrībhījaṃ pūrvamevoktamṛṣirdevala ucyate || 31.33 || chandaścākṣarapaṅtkissyācchrīvatso devatā matā | tato lakṣajapenaiva sarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt || 31.34 || praṇavādiṃ ca satyantaṃ vidhātāraṃ tathā manum | sakāraṃ vijayaṃ lokaṃ subhadraṃ madhuvidviṣam || 31.35 || prabhañjanaṃ pāvakaṃ ca vairājaṃ vighnanāyakam | gopanaṃ dhanadaṃ māyāṃ paścimaṃ prathamasvaram || 31.36 || vai rājaṃ mārutaṃ paścādekāraṃ prathamasvaram | mādhavīṃ padmanābhaṃ ca vijayaṃ brahmasādhanam || 31.37 || agniṃ bhallāyudhaṃ kumbhamākāraṃ mārutaṃ tathā | acāṃ dvitīyaṃ kamalaṃ pulahaṃ ca pavitrakam || 31.38 || ādidevaṃ ca dhanadaṃ trivikramamanantaram | paścimaṃ vijayaṃ cādiṃ sparśanaṃ mādhavaṃ tathā || 31.39 || oṣadhīśamikāraṃ ca dṛṣṭiṃ ca dhanadaṃ punaḥ | rāmaṃ pradyamnasahitaṃ paścimaṃ padmanābhakam || 31.40 || prabhañjanaṃ chaladhvaṃsaṃ dvayaṃ svāhāvasānakam | kaustubhaṃ bindusahitaṃ bījametadṛṣṭiḥ punaḥ || 31.41 || jamadagnirvirāṭ chando devatā kaustubhāhvayā | kaustubhaṃ ca caturthyantamuccāryanatimu ddharet || 31.42 || pañcalakṣajapādasya manossidhyati vāñchitam | saptārṇapūrvakaṃ kumbhaṃ bhadrahastaṃ priyadviṣam || 31.43 || bhadrahastaṃ mandaraṃ ca madhusūdanamabjaja | pulahaṃ devadattaṃ ca mādhavīṃ madhusūdanam || 31.44 || māhendraṃ rāmanāmānaṃ vighneśaṃ pañcabindukam | paścimaṃ śrīdharaṃ vahniṃ bhuvanaṃ tadanantaram || 31.45 || krodhāgniṃ vāsudevaṃ ca vairājau dvau ca mandaram | paścimaṃ padmanābhaṃ ca māyā śirasamanvataḥ || 31.46 || mārutaṃ mādhavayutaṃ ṭhaṭhānto manurīritaḥ | kalaśaṃ mārutaṃ paścādudayaścā niruddhakam || 31.47 || bījaṃ muniśca dhanadaḥ chandaḥ paṅktiśca devatā | vanamālāparaṃ mantraṃ kathayāmi mahāphalam || 31.48 || brahmakośaṃ natiṃ kumbhaṃ mukhaṃ vighneśa mandarau | gopanaṃ pulahaṃ cādidevaṃ śaṅkhaṃ ca godhanam || 31.49 || mādhavaṃ sūdanaṃ vāyuṃ mṛgeśaṃ dakṣagopanau | caturgatiścādidevamanalaṃ saguhālayam || 31.50 || paścimaṃ vikramaparaṃ pracaṇḍaṃ pañcibindukam | dakṣaṃ dinakaraṃ cakṣurdvitīyaṃ śvetadīdhitim || 31.51 || dakṣadvayaṃ vāsudevaṃ tigmāṃśuṃ bandhuśīrṣakam | dviradāsyaṃ pañcabinduṃ śvetarociṣamādimat || 31.52 || amṛtaṃ vahniśirasaṃ kamalaṃ gopanāhvayam | mandaraṃ vaidharaṃ māyāṃ pañcamaṃ gajavāhanam || 31.53 || mādhavaṃ śvetadīdhiṃ ca kumbhaṃ bahulaśīrṣakam | vijayaṃ caikadṛṣṭiṃ ca varuṇaṃ pāṭalapriyam || 31.54 || caturgatiṃ sūdanaṃ ca mārutaṃ cādimattathā | caturthamṛtadhāmāna magniṃ ca śvasanaṃ punaḥ || 31.55 || brahmakośaparāṃ caiva bhadrapāṇiṃ ca padmajām | vijayaṃ praṇavādiṃ ca śvetadīdhitimabjaja || 31.56 || śaśāṅkaṃ padmanābhaṃ vai dharaṃ māyāmahādhanau | paścimaṃ vijayaṃ māyā śīrṣaṃ vighneśamirayet || 31.57 || vikramaṃ sūkṣmadṛṣṭiṃ ca gopanaṃ ca caturmukha | janmadhvaṃsaṃ ca kalaśaṃ pulahaṃ ca dviruccharet || 31.58 || pūrvavacca dvirabhyasya puṣṭibījamathoddharet | gopatiṃ gopanaṃ yaṣṭiṃ varuṇaṃ cādibindhukam || 31.59 || bhāskaraṃ bhuvanaṃ yiṣṭiṃ phaṭkāraṃ ca ṭhaṭhāntimam | piyīṣaṃ pavanaṃ brahmasādhanaṃ yaṣṭiśīrṣakam || 31.60 || bījametaccaturvaktra pradhānārṇāṅgakalpanā | bhavaścāsya muniśchando asyā uṣṇiśca devatā || 31.61 || dvibhujāṃ bālikāṃ pīnavakṣoruhavibhūṣitām | karaṇḍamakuṭopetāṃ bibhrāṇāṃ vanamālikām || 31.62 || darpaṇaṃ vāmahastena bibhrāṇāṃ dakṣiṇena tu | puṣpamañja likāṃ dvābhyāṃ dhyātvālakṣaṃ japenmanum || 31.63 || anyeṣāṃ bhūṣaṇānāṃ ca caturthyantaṃ samāhvayam | mantraṃ manontaṃ jānīyādbhījamādyaṃ prakalpayet || 31.64 || prabhāmanuṃ pravakṣyāmi yathāvadavadhāraya | udgīthamādiṃ natyantaṃ paścimaṃ tvṛtadhāmakam || 31.65 || bhallāyudhaṃ cādidevaṃ śvasanaṃ sūkṣmalocanam | acāṃ dvitīyaṃ śvetāṃśu kamalaṃ cādimattayā || 31.66 || pāvakaṃ cauṣadhaṃ padmapāṇiṃ vai rājamanvataḥ | mṛgeśaṃ janmavidhvaṃsaṃ brahmasādhanasaṃyutam || 31.67 || kakubhaṃ kalaśaṃ cādi devaṃ pulahamabjaja | oṅkāraṃ mādhavīmagniṃ māyāmastakabhūṣitam || 31.68 || pāṭalapriyamākāraṃ pītābhaṃ madhuvidhviṣam | śrīvatsamādiṃ vijayaṃ śaśāṅkaṃ viṣṇumastakam || 31.69 || mārtāṇḍamindumanalaṃ madhusūdanamārutau | śriyaḥ pratimathaikākṣaṃ gopanaṃ kamalodbhava || 31.70 || amṛtaṃ tvṛtadhāmānaṃ vijayaṃ kamalālayām | otadehaṃ subhadraṃ ca bandhumastakabhūṣitam || 31.71 || vijayaṃ gopanaṃ prāṇaṃ huṃphaṭkāraṃ ṭhaṭhāntakam | ādyarṇaṃ yaṣṇisahitaṃ bījamasyaprakīrtitam || 31.72 || ṛṣirbhāskara etasya paṅtkiśchandaśca devatā | prabhā japaśca mantrasya lakṣasaṅkhyaḥ prakīrtitaḥ || 31.73 || bhogāṃśca puṣkarān bhuktvāmantravinmantravaibhavāt | paraṃ padamavāpnoti dehatyāgena saṃśayaḥ || 31.74 || nigamādiṃ kaustubhaṃ ca gopanaṃ bindumaindavam | vikramaṃ vaidharaṃ puṇyaṃ rāmaṃ śuklasamāhvayam || 31.75 || vai rājamagni mākāraṃ sparśanaṃ viṣṇumastakam | satyantamuddharenmantramevamakṣasrajassudhīḥ || 31.76 || akṣamālādharaṃ dhyāyedvibhujaṃ sphaṭikaprabham | alaṅkṛtaṃ pītavastraṃ padmaviṣṭarasaṃsthitam || 31.77 || varadābhayadākāraṃ mantrasya ca japastathā | mantrī ca mahadāpnoti phalamatyantadurlabham || 31.78 || udgīthaṃ subhagaṃ śaṅkhamūrdhvayaṣṭimanantaram | dhanadaṃ ca hṛṣīkeśaṃ mandaraṃ brahmanādhanam || 31.79 || bahulaṃ caikanetraṃ ca pañcāntaṃ bandhumastakam | analaṃ gopanaṃ śaṅkhamacāmādiṃ natiṃ tataḥ || 31.80 || dhūpapātramanuḥ prokto ghaṇṭāmantraḥ pravakṣyate | āmnāyādiṃ kṣitidharaṃ hṛṣīkeśaṃ raviṃ tathā || 31.81 || guhālayaṃ ca nāsikyaṃ padmapāṇiṃ pracaṇḍakam | jhaṣamākāra saṃyuktaṃ caturgatinamaskṛtiḥ || 31.82 || kathitaśca manurbrahman dīpapātrasya kathyate | udgīthaṃ kakubhaṃ cādiṃ gadadhvaṃsama cāṃ mukham || 31.83 || pāvakaṃ vijayaṃ janmahantāraṃ brahmasādhanam | vairājaṃ vikramaparamanalaṃ ca guhālayam || 31.84 || paścimaṃ cādidevaṃ ca śvasanaṃ natiśīrṣakam | dīpapātrasya kathito manu ssaṃprati kathyate || 31.85 || brahmakośamukhaṃ brahman saptārṇaṃ tadanantaram | śaśāṅkaṃ śrīdhara dṛṣṭimādilakṣmīṃ hutāśanam || 31.86 || lambodaraṃ cādidevaṃ daraṃ viṣṇuṃ ca mādhavam | nabhomaṇimatho rāmaṃ pulahaṃ cādimattathā || 31.87 || vakratuṇḍaṃ vidhātāraṃ vakratuṇḍamacāṃ mukham | kamalaṃ tvṛtadhāmānaṃ yāntaṃ ca madhusūdhanam || 31.88 || musalaṃ gopanayutaṃ śvasanaṃ kakubhaṃ tataḥ | amṛtaṃ pītavarṇārṇaṃ huṃphaṭkāraṃ ṭhaṭhāntimam || 31.89 || śuklaṃ mukhaṃ sabinduṃ ca bījamevaṃ samuddharet | tāraṃ karālamākāraṃ pulahaṃ cādimattathā || 31.90 || vakratuṇḍaṃ vidhātāraṃ bahulaṃ madhuvidviṣam | ādiṃ caturgatiṃ huṃphaḍityādi hṛdayādiṣu || 31.91 || kālarudro'tha bhagavānṛṣiśchandaḥ prakīrtitaḥ | gāyatrī devatā cāsya hetirājassudarśanaḥ || 31.92 || japeddvādaśalakṣaṃ tu siddhayo mūlamantravat | āditassaptavarṇāṃśca pūrvoktān śaśinaṃ tathā || 31.93 || śrīdharaṃ vaidharaṃ viṣṇuṃ śrīvatsamanalaṃ tathā | bhadra hastādi devaṃ ca śaṅkhādiṃ ca caturmukha || 31.94 || sudarśanasya kathito dvādaśārṇātmako manuḥ | bījamaṅgaṃ yathāpūrvaṃ draṣṭā ca kapilasmsṛtaḥ || 31.95 || chando virāṭ devatā ca heti rājassudarśanaḥ | japho dvādaśalakṣaṃ ca dviṣaṭkākṣaravatphalam || 31.96 || āmnāyādiṃ ca natyantaṃ sudarśanapadaṃ tataḥ | caturthyantaṃ prayuñjīta phalamaṣṭākṣare yathā || 31.97 || ṛṣirbhavastathā cchando gāyatraṃ heti rāḍinaḥ | pūrvoditaṃ dviṣaṭkārṇaṃ mādhavī mādimuddharet || 31.98 || nabhomaṇiṃ cādidevaṃ vakratuṇḍa macāṃ mukham | karāla mṛtamagniṃ ca gopanaṃ kakubhaṃ tathā || 31.99 || acāṃ dvayaṃ gandhavahaṃ mukhaṃ dakṣaṃ caturmukha | gopatiṃ gopanamatho jṛmbhalaṃ cādimattathā || 31.100 || mahendraṃ yādasāṃ nāthaṃ dviradaṃ pannagādhipam | sparśanaṃ nṛhariṃ kumbhaṃ rāmaṃ subhagamanvataḥ || 31.101 || prācetasaṃ sayaṣṭiṃ ca śuklamādiṃ daraṃ tathā | amṛtaṃ bandhusahitaṃ dhanādhyakṣamapāṃ patim || 31.102 || nāsikyaṃ śaśinaṃ cādiṃ mārutaṃ mandaradvayam | mukhaṃ lakṣmīṃ tathai kākṣaṃ vasuṃ caiva guhālayam || 31.103 || sayaṣṭiṃ kuñjaramukhaṃ gopanaṃ śubhadaṃ daram | mādhavīṃ gopatiṃ caiva gopanaṃ kālanemijit || 31.104 || māhendraṃ gopanaṃ śaṅkhaṃ kakubhaṃ kumbhasaṃjñitam | pulahaṃ musalaṃ kumbhaṃ mahendraṃ bhuvanāhvayam || 31.105 || gadadhvaṃsaṃ hutavahaṃ vai rājaṃ mṛgavallabham | janmadhvaṃsaṃ śaśadharameṇaeśaṃ ca ṭhaṭhāntimam || 31.106 || bījamaṅgaṃ yathāpūrva mṛṣissyānnīlalohitaḥ | yaṣṭiśchandaśca kathito devatā hetirāḍasau || 31.107 || japellakṣatrayaṃ mantrī japasyāsya ca vaibhavāt | nigrahe'nugrahe śaktistambhavidveṣaṇādikṛt || 31.108 || calācalasamudrādiśoṣaṇaṃ kamsanaṃ tathā | tatkaṭākṣavinikṣepātsṛṣṭyādīnāṃ vidhirbhavet || 31.109 || sudarśanamahāmantraṃ vakṣyāmi caturāsana | mātṛkācakramālikhya samabhyarcya yathāvidhi || 31.110 || svīkṛtya dvādaśārṇāṃśca vakratuṇḍamacāṃ mukham | karālamagni sahitaṃ gopanaṃ mārutaṃ tataḥ || 31.111 || paścimaṃ pāvakaṃ khaḍgamanalaṃ ca kṛśānukam | vidhātāraṃ cādidevaṃ pulahaṃ madhusūdanam || 31.112 || daraṃ hutavahaṃ tārkṣyaṃ dvirvasuṃ ca samuddharet | pāṭalapriyāmākāraṃ daraṃ dhruvasamanvitam || 31.113 || lakṣmīṃ mukhaṃ ca vai rājamagniṃ bhuvanaśīrṣakam | dviradānanamākāraṃ kamalāṃ madhusūdanam || 31.114 || sparśanaṃ vaidharaṃ cādimanalaṃ vaidharaṃ tathā | amṛtaṃ cādidevaṃ ca mahendhraṃ ca samikaraṇam || 31.115 || śuklaṃ mukhaṃ bhāskaraṃ ca kamalaṃ vikramaṃ tathā | analaṃ sumukhaṃ viṣṇuṃ padmanābhavināyakau || 31.116 || janmadhvaṃsaṃ ca kalaśaṃ pulahaṃ bandhusaṃmitam | vairājaṃ śubhadaṃ rāmaṃ kharvadehaṃ hutāśanam || 31.117 || vaidharaṃ tvṛtadhāmānaṃ nṛhariṃ mṛgavallabham | pavitramṛtadhāmānaṃ mādhavaṃ bhujagaṃ tataḥ || 31.118 || caturgatiṃ tathā dṛṣṭiṃ cādidevaṃ hutāśanam | bhuvanaṃ caṇḍamatriṃ ca ūkāraṃ kamalodbhava || 31.119 || krodharūpaṃ dinamaṇiṃ vighneśaṃ madhusūdanam | ekākṣaṃ mandaraṃ padmaṃ vaidharaṃ gopatiṃ tathā || 31.120 || paścimaṃ vakratuṇḍaṃ ca khaḍgaṃ gopanamanvataḥ | bhūdharaṃ mārutaṃ sparśaṃ tṛtīyaṃ kakubhaṃ tathā || 31.121 || yāntaṃ ca vijayaṃ tvagnimākāraṃ śvetarociṣam | adiṃ daraṃ tathendraṃ ca vijayaṃ jvalanaṃ tathā || 31.122 || śrīdharaṃ ca gadadhvaṃsaṃ bhuvanaṃ ca hutāśanam | udayaṃ caturgatiṃ vighnanāyakaṃ tvekacakṣuṣam || 31.123 || svāhādhavaṃ gopanaṃ ca yaṣṭiṃ ca kamalālayām | vakratuṇḍaṃ cordhvalokaṃ pracaṇḍaṃ vasumastakam || 31.124 || mārutaṃ varuṇaṃ cāgniṃ paścimaṃ svāntamabjaja | pavitramṛtadhāmānaṃ mārutodayasaṃjñitau || 31.125 || viriñcavijayau cāgni devamandaraśrīdharau | mārutāt ṣaṣṭhamantraṃ ca padmāṃ vijaya mādimat || 31.126 || yaṣṭiṃ lakṣmyāstṛtīyaṃ ca śikhaṇḍaṃ brahmasādhanam | kheṭakaṃ mārutaṃ pāpahananaṃ pāvakaṃ tataḥ || 31.127 || śaśāṅkaṃ vikramaṃ cārtidaṇḍanaṃ vikramaṃ tathā | ardhenduśekharaṃ paścātpañjāntamṛtadhāma ca || 31.128 || nabhomaṇiṃ pavitraṃ ca pavanāntaṃ ca mandaram | gajānanaṃ ca vijayaṃ dahanaṃ binduśekharam || 31.129 || nīhāradīdhitiṃ yaṣṭiṃ sāntaṃ caivāgnisaptamam | mādhavīminduyāntau ca dakṣaṃ ca madhuvidviṣam || 31.130 || ardhendumindumākāraṃ mandaraṃ māyayāyutam | krodharūpaṃ hutavahaṃ bhuvanaṃ puṇyavikramau || 31.131 || yāntaṃ subhadramoṃkāraṃ musalaṃ dviradānanam | dhanadaṃ vikramaṃ sparśaṃ gopanaṃ ca caturgatim || 31.132 || vairājaṃ vāmanaṃ tārkṣyaṃ pracaṇḍaṃ śvetadīdhitim | vikramaṃ vaidharaṃ puṇyaṃ pracaṇḍaṃ kuñjarānanam || 31.133 || ekanetraṃ hutavahaṃ madhusūdanasaṃjñitam | yāntodayau śuklalokau bahulaṃ brahmasādhanam || 31.134 || saptārciśśrīdharaṃ tvindraṃ yaṣṭiṃ pañcāntakaṃ tathā | yāntaṃ cāgniṃ dvitīyaṃ ca mandaraṃ pavanadvayam || 31.135 || bhadrapāṇimathaikākṣaṃ yāntaṃ ca madhuvidviṣam | lambakukṣiṃ ca vijayaṃ śikhinaṃ mandaraṃ tathā || 31.136 || sarvarodhaṃ bhadrabāhuṃ mādhavaṃ kamalaṃ tataḥ | nāsikyaṃ kharvadehaṃ ca vakratuṇḍaṃ saroruham || 31.137 || yāntaṃ kuśeśayaṃ kumbhaṃ sumukhaṃ dvissamuddharet | otadehaṃ tathā diṃ ca śvasanaṃ vijayaṃ tathā || 31.138 || karālamagni vadanaṃ mukhaṃ pavakagopanau | nihāradīthitiṃ caiva caṣakaṃ havyavāhanam || 31.139 || vighneśaṃ gopanaṃ cāgniṃ madhusūdanamārutau | caṇḍaṃ hutavahaṃ rāmaṃ pulahaṃ bandhuśīrṣakam || 31.140 || sudhāmayamikāraṃ ca mahāndraṃ rāmaśīrṣakam | sparśāntaṃ vikramādhyaṃ ca natyantaṃ bandhu mastakam || 31.141 || khaḍgaṃ trivikraṃ pītavarṇābhaṃ ca trivikramam | mādhavīṃ sarvarodhaṃ ca vaidharaṃ mandaradvayam || 31.142 || yāntārṇāgnirathaṃ paścādyāntaṃ gopanamastakam | vihageśaṃ śvetarocirmukhaṃ hutavahaṃ tathā || 31.143 || śrīdharaṃ caikanayanaṃ paścimaṃ bandhumastakam | śrīvatsamādidevāntaṃ pracaṇḍaṃ kamalābhidham || 31.144 || athordhvalokaṃ śrīvatsaṃ mandharaṃ madhuvidviṣam | pracaṇḍaṃ puṇḍarīkākṣaṃ śubhadaṃ ca saroruham || 31.145 || vanaṃ gajamukhaṃ bandhuṃ bhuvanaṃ mṛgavallabham | amṛtaṃ caikanayanaṃ pañcabinduṃ sudhāmayam || 31.146 || vikramaṃ kuñjaramukhaṃ gopanaṃ dhūliketanam | karālaṃ janmavidhvasaṃ kuliśaṃ ca hutāśanam || 31.147 || śaśāṅkamādiṃ yāntaṃ ca varuṇaṃ pulahaṃ tathā | hṛṣīkeśaṃ tathaikākṣaṃ varuṇaṃ bandhuśīrṣakam || 31.148 || krodharūpaṃ gopatiṃ ca dāntaṃ mandaragopanau | śikhinaṃ sparśanaṃ cādiṃ ṣaṭkṛtvaḥ pulahaṃ kṣipet || 31.149 || jayaṃ sadāgatiṃ bandhuṃ piyūṣaṃ vikramābhidham | hiraṇyagarbhamanalaṃ mandaradvayamabjaja || 31.150 || puṇḍarīkākṣa magnyantaṃ vijayaṃ rāmaśīrṣakam | nabhomaṇiṃ cādidevamamṛtaṃ māyayā yutam || 31.151 || atriṃ ca dhanadaṃ kumbhaṃ dvayamardhendumādimat | hastivaktraṃ ca kamalamasalaṃ ca sudhāmayam || 31.152 || agniṃ ca gopanaṃ māntaṃ śrīdharaṃ subhagaṃ tathā | sparśatrayaṃ bṛhadbhānuṃ gopanaṃ sumukhaṃ tataḥ || 31.153 || mādhavīṃ vāsudevaṃ ca vaidharaṃ mādhavāhvayam | subhadraṃ candradhavalaṃ musalaṃ ca dviruccharet || 31.154 || brahmannanantaraṃ tasya mārutaṃ madhuvidviṣam | kumbhaṃ savikramaṃ lakṣmīṃ sudhādīdhitivikramau || 31.155 || krodharūpaṃ pracaṇḍaṃ ca bhuvanaṃ vakratuṇḍakam | karālaṃ śikhinaṃ dakṣaṃ bhadrahastaṃ tathodaram || 31.156 || oṣadhīśaṃ tathā dakṣaṃ pānakaṃ ca ṭhaṭhāntimam | bījamaṅgaṃ yathāpurvamṛṣirdakṣaḥ prajāpatiḥ || 31.157 || chando'ticchanda etasya devatā ca sudarśanaḥ | saptādhikā saptadiśca varṇānāṃ dve śate same || 31.158 || japena sidhyati manurlakṣadvādaśasaṅkhyayā | kṛṣṇapakṣe caturdaśyā mupoṣya prayatātmavān || 31.159 || niśīthe dṛḍhadhīrmantrīśmaśāne vā catuṣpathe | japedbhūtādayastasya pratyakṣāssarvakāmadāḥ || 31.160 || mahāsudarśanaṃ mantramaparaṃ kathayāmite | dviṣaṭkākṣaramuddhṛtya gopatiṃ mṛgavallabham || 31.161 || vairāṃja vikrama paramanalaṃ madhusūdanam | gadadhvaṃsamacāmādiṃ dakṣaṃ dinakarāhvayam || 31.162 || gopanaṃ dhṛtimantaṃ ca pulahaṃ paścimānanam | ṛtadhāmā dinamaṇiṃ pāvakaṃ sumukhaṃ tataḥ || 31.163 || amṛtaṃ kakubhaṃ padmanābhaṃ gopatimabjaja | subhagaṃ bandhuśirasaṃ pavitraṃ vijayaṃ tathā || 31.164 || caturgatiṃ devadattaṃ paścimaṃ bandhumastakam | pracaṇḍaṃ puṇḍarīkākṣaṃ gopanaṃ vaidharāhvayam || 31.165 || sarāmaṃ caikanetraṃ ca mārutaṃ brahmasādhanam | atriṃ caturgatiṃ śvetadīdhitaṃ ca svarādimat || 31.166 || vighneśadvitayaṃ paścānmāyāmastakamuddharet | subhadraṃ sūdanaṃ śaṅkhaṃ vaidharaṃ pañcabindukam || 31.167 || paścimaṃ caikanayanaṃ sūdanaṃ gadinaṃ tathā | bhadrabāhuṃ sarāmaṃ ca kakubhaṃ kumbha gopanau || 31.168 || māhendraṃ sūdanaṃ viśvarūpaṃ bhūdharamabjaja | śubhadaṃ vijayaṃ śuklaṃ gopanaṃ śvetadīdhitim || 31.169 || ṛtaṃ ca sūdanaṃ yāntaṃ devaraṃ mandarodayau | bhṛguṃ khaḍgadharau dvau ca mādhavaṃ bhuvanāhvayam || 31.170 || ākāraṃ vakratuṇḍaṃ ca vaidharaṃ śrīdharaṃ tathā | ugrātmānaṃ pavitraṃ ca padmanābhaṃ ca mādhavam || 31.171 || nṛhariṃ sūdanaṃ śuklaṃ bhuvanaṃ bahuladvayam | tārkṣyaṃ jhaṣaṃ gopanaṃ ca kamalaṃ bandhumastakam || 31.172 || vighneśaṃ vāmanaparaṃ subhadraṃ saguhālayam | ekanetraṃ cādidevaṃ paścimānanamabjaja || 31.173 || śuklaṃ dakṣaṃ sūdanaṃ ca yāntaṃ paśchimavaktrakam | ṛtadhāma tathā dakṣaṃ sarvarodhaṃ sapaścimam || 31.174 || vikramaṃ śubhadaṃ cādidevaṃ khaḍgadharaṃ tathā | caturgatiṃ vāsudevaṃ gadadhvaṃsaṃ savikramam || 31.175 || bhadrahastaṃ pañcabindubindumoṣadhīśaṃ karālakam | vighneśaṃ vaidharaṃ kumbhaṃ vikrāmaṇamanantaram || 31.176 || kuñjarānanamākāraṃ caturgatimacāṃ mukham | śikhinaṃ mānuṣeśaṃ ca nṛhariṃ sparśaṣoḍaśīm || 31.177 || ṛtadhāmotadehaṃ ca bhadra bāhumanantaram | acāṃ dvitīyaṃ dṛṣṭiṃ ca gadinaṃ padmanābhakam || 31.178 || mārtāṇḍaṃ sūdanaṃ vighnanāyakaṃ vijayaṃ tathā | padmanābhaṃ gopanaṃ ca śuklamādiṃ darāhvayam || 31.179 || tatsamaṣṭiṃ dviruccārya somamādiṃ sayaṣṭikam | bhāskaraṃ pāvakaṃ caiva dvirvaktavyaṃ tadakṣaram || 31.180 || pīyūṣaṃ vikramaṃ puṇyaṃ kalaśaṃ yaṣṭiśīrṣakam | śaśāṅkamādiṃ śaṅkhaṃ ca pūrvavatkamalodbhava || 31.181 || pīyūṣaṃ rāmaśirasaṃ sparśānāmapi ṣoḍaśam | ṛtaṃ ca sūdanaṃ śukla matriṃ caiva yathāpuram || 31.182 || tārkṣyadvayaṃ ca kamalāṃ vijayaṃ tvṛtadhāma ca | hṛṣīkeśaṃ tathā bhadradvayaṃ madhunighādanam || 31.183 || śrīvatsaṃ cādimanalaṃ śriyaḥ patimanantaram | pañchāntakaṃ padmanābhamekākṣaṃ mṛgavallabham || 31.184 || janmadhvaṃsaṃ śvetaraśmimeṇaeśaṃ dṛṣṭivāmanau | subhadraṃ bandhuśirasaṃ sparśānāṃ ṣoḍaśākṣaram || 31.185 || vikramaṃ caikaviṃśaṃ ca bandhuṃ tanmastakasthitam | sumukhaṃ pavanāhvānaṃ brhamasāvijayāhvayam || 31.186 || dahanaṃ bhadramamṛtaṃ matimantaṃ ca sūdanam | pracaṇḍaṃ gopanaṃ śuklaṃ bhuvanaṃ bahulaṃ tathā || 31.187 || bhallāyudhaṃ śrīdharaṃ ca musalaṃ pretanāyakam | mādhavaṃ vaidharaṃ vighnanāyakaṃ dvitīyaṃ tathā || 31.188 || acāṃ dvitīyaṃ pañcāntaṃ viṣkaṃbhaṃ dviradānanam | vikramaṃ mādhavīmagniṃ vāsudevaṃ caturmukha || 31.189 || vakratuṇḍaṃ mānuṣeśamaprameyaṃ vanasrajam | dharitrīṃ kamalākṣaṃ ca sūkṣmadṛgbandhumastakam || 31.190 || vighneśaṃ vaidharaṃ pretanāyakaṃ māyayāyutam | hairambaṃ vaidharaṃ cādiṃ paśchimaṃ tvṛtadhāmakam || 31.191 || vijayaṃ rāmaśirasaṃ bhāskaraṃ vijayāhvayam | atriṃ mṛgeśaṃ varuṇaṃ gopanaṃ śvetadīdhitim || 31.192 || śrīdharaṃ bahulaṃ pītaṃ jṛmbhalaṃ mohanāśanam | paścimaṃ bhuvanaṃ vighnanāyakadvitayaṃ tathā || 31.193 || acāṃ dvitīyaṃ kamalamādiṃ śaṅkhaṃ vināyakam | paścimaṃ bhuvanaṃ binduṃ śaśāṅkaṃ dviguṇaṃ tathā || 31.194 || bhadrabāhuṃ sarāmaṃ ca sudhādīdhitigopanau | yāntaṃ samiraṇaṃ cādiṃ paścimaṃ jātavedanam || 31.195 || amṛtaṃ vikramaparaṃ vaidharaṃ cānalaṃ tathā | gopanaṃ vijayaṃ vighnanāyakaṃ vijayāhvayam || 31.196 || ṛtavadhāmaṃ nalasijaṃ padmanābhaṃ pitāmaha | vairājaṃ śvasanaṃ cādidevaṃ bhallāyudhaṃ karam || 31.197 || śvasanaṃ praṇavādiṃ ca vighneśaṃ sarvavikramau | karālamṛtadhāmāntaṃ vijayaṃ dhanasaṃjñitam || 31.198 || svacchandhamathaṃ dṛṣṭiṃ ca caturgati manantaram | śaśāṅkaṃ pullanayanaṃ vāsudevaṃ ca kheṭakam || 31.199 || śaṅkhaṃ pulahamoṅkāraṃ mārtāṇḍaṃ paścimānam | krodhaṃ vanasrajaṃ bhūmiṃ nāsikyaṃ śvetadīdhitim || 31.200 || ṣoḍaśaṃ kapilaṃ bhānuṃ caturgatimanantaram | vidhātāraṃ tathā śailaṃ vijayaṃ kamalodbhava || 31.201 || acāṃ trayodaśaṃ cāgniṃ kamalaṃ candradīdhitim | vakratuṇḍaṃ cādidevaṃ śaṅkhaṃ pītamacāṃ mukham || 31.202 || pūrṇacandraṃ tathā dakṣaṃ bhuvanaṃ vaidharātmakam | padmanābhaṃ dhruvaṃ lakṣmīṃ brahmasādhanasaṃjñitam || 31.203 || krodharūpaṃ daraṃ cādiṃ mādhavaṃ gopatiṃ tathā | vikramaṃ mādhavaṃ bhānuṃ sarāmaṃ sūkṣmalocanam || 31.204 || gadadhvaṃsaṃ ca pīyūṣaṃ vighneśaṃ paścimānanam | acāṃ dvitīyaṃ śubhadaṃ sūdanaṃ yaṣṭiśīrṣakam || 31.205 || karālaṃ śrīdharaṃ lakṣmīṃ mṛgeśaṃ dviradānanam | padmapāṇiṃ bhūdharākhyaṃ dvayaṃ vaidharamādhavau || 31.206 || paścimaṃ pavanaṃ lakṣmīṃ brahmasādhanasaṃjñitam | krodharūpamacāmādiṃ sparśanaṃ dakṣagopanau || 31.207 || dhāntaṃ caturgatiṃ pāpahananaṃ bahulaṃ tathā | vakratuṇḍaṃ karālaṃ ca kakubhaṃ tvṛdhāma ca || 31.208 || bhadrabāhuṃ caladhvaṃsaṃ mṛgeśaṃ dṛṣṭimādimam | dviradānanayaṣṭiṃ ca analaṃ gopanāhvayam || 31.209 || sadhruvaṃ pulahaṃ binduṃ māhendraṃ madhusūdanam | ardhacandraṃ tathā candraṃ nāsikyaṃ taddviruddharet || 31.210 || śaśāṅkamṛtadhāmānaṃ sūdhanaṃ yaṣṭiśīrṣakam | tadvirabhyasya śītāṃśumarpitaṃ vasumastakam || 31.211 || pulahaṃ vāsudevākhyaṃ sraṣṭāraṃdviradānanam | vikramaṃ bahulaṃ brahman gopanaṃ bahulaṃ tathā || 31.212 || pracaṇḍaṃ janmavidhvaṃsaṃ vighneśaṃ ca tṛtīyakam | acāṃ dṛṣṭiṃ dvitīyāntaṃ bhadrabāhuṃ pavitrakam || 31.213 || ṛtaṃ ca kāra dviradaṃ cānanaṃ mandarāhvayam | pradyotanaṃ gopanaṃ ca śaśāṅkaṃ ca śriyaḥ patim || 31.214 || vaidharaṃ śubhadaṃ cāgniṃ śrīvatsaṃ brahmasādhanam | sumukhaṃ vikramaparaṃ vijayaṃ mukhamabjaja || 31.215 || atriṃ sarāmaṃ pañcāntaṃ subhagaṃ madhusūdanam | yaṣṭiṃ karālamākāraṃ caturgatimanantaram || 31.216 || apāṃ patiṃ śvetaraśmiṃ śriyaḥ patimataḥ param | stambaramānanaṃ māyāṃ kalaśaṃ dīptarociṣam || 31.217 || subhagaṃ gopanaṃ yāntaṃ gopanaṃ paścimānanam | hṛṣīkeśaṃ vasuṃ śaṅkhaṃ gopanaṃ dvitīyaṃ punaḥ || 31.218 || yaṣṭibījaṃ dviruccārya tigmadīdhiṃ pavitrakam | ṛtadhāmatathaikākṣaṃ vikramaṃ bahulāhvayam || 31.219 || gadadhvaṃsaṃ tathaikākṣaṃ vikramaṃ bahulāhvayam | guhālayaṃ pāpahanamamṛtaṃ madhuvidviṣam || 31.220 || rociśśriyaḥ patiṃ kāntaṃ vaidharaṃ mādhavaṃ tathā | pīyūṣamādiṃ kamala maśivaṃ dhanadāhvayam || 31.221 || ṛtadhāma tathai kākṣamacāmekadaśaṃ tathā | dviruddharetkāmabhījaṃ vaidharaṃ tūdayāhvayam || 31.222 || gadadhvaṃsaṃ tathai vāgni mastakasthaṃ pavitrakam | gopanaṃ vijayaṃ cādidevaṃ viṣkambhasaṃjñitam || 31.223 || tridaśākāramekāraṃ śvetāṃśu vikramaṃ tathā | gajavaktraṃ sūdanaṃ ca kapilākṣamanantaram || 31.224 || tṛtīyaṃ kakubhadvandvamastakaṃ vasuṃ punaḥ | janmadhvaṃsaṃ ca jalajaṃ sudhādīdhitivikramau || 31.225 || kalaśaṃ puruṣātmānaṃ gahanaṃ padmanābhakam | bhāskaraṃ sumukhaṃ brahman bhuvanaṃ vijayaṃ vasu || 31.226 || druhiṇaṃ tvṛtadhāmānaṃ bhūdharaṃ krodhanaṃ tataḥ | sparśānāṃ ṣoḍaśārṇaṃ ca kumbheśaṃ musalaṃ tataḥ || 31.227 || nihāradīdhitimacā mekadeśamataḥ param | caturgatiṃ bhadrahastaṃ vijayaṃ padmanābhakam || 31.228 || hairambaṃ gopanaṃ caiva gadinaṃ kaluṣāpaham | acāṃ dvitīyaṃ kamalāṃ gopanaṃ vittavardhanam || 31.229 || hariṇānanamāye dve kakubhaṃ varuṇāhvayam | jvalanaṃ mānuṣaghnaṃ ca vighneśaṃ gopanāhvayam || 31.230 || śrīvatsaṃ dviśadaṃ śuklamacāmādiṃ saroruham | brahman pañcāntakamataḥ dhṛtāvāsumataḥ param || 31.231 || vairājamagniṃ nṛhariṃ brahmasādhanasaṃjñitam | subhadraṃ sumukhaṃ kumbhaṃ mārutaṃ cotadehakam || 31.232 || dakṣaṃ dākṣāyaṇīkāntaṃ mandaraṃ pañcabindukam | dhūmadhvajaṃ pracaṇḍaṃ ca sūdanaṃ katṛtīyakam || 31.233 || harivaktraṃ rāmasaṃjñaṃ dṛṣṭivikramamabjaja | śubhadaṃ kapilaṃ hrasvaṃ bhadrahastaṃ samiraṇam || 31.234 || nihāradīdhitimacāmādiṃ kumbhaṃ hutāśanam | śuklamoṅkārasaṃyuktaṃ subhadraṃ madhusūdanam || 31.235 || sparśaṃ tṛtīyamanalaṃ vijayaṃ saptamiṃ kalām | vikramaṃ sūkṣmadṛṣṭiṃ ca śrīdharaṃ yādasāṃ patim || 31.236 || herambaṃ vāsudevaṃ ca bhadrahastaṃ ca mādhavīm | acāṃ dvitīyaṃ dṛṣṭiṃ ca kamalaṃ bahulaṃ tathā || 31.237 || sparśāntaṃ bhuvanaṃ cakraṃ bhṛguṃ kakubhasaṃjñitam | nabhomaṇiṃ vikramaṃ ca pāṭalaṃ madhuvidviṣam || 31.238 || bhallāyudhaṃ bandhu śīrṣaṃ vighneśaṃ vaidharāhvayam | vakratuṇḍamācāmādiṃ kamalaṃ pīṭhapūrvakam || 31.239 || gopanaṃ mānuṣaṃ caiva pulahaṃ bandhumastakam | otadehaṃ tathā pītaṃ janmadhvasaṃ trivikramam || 31.240 || gopatiṃ varuṇaṃ vighnanāyakaṃ tvṛtadhāmakam | ekākṣaṃ mārutaṃ cādidevaṃ bahulamastakam || 31.241 || pavanaṃ sūkṣmadṛk proktaṃ sūdanaṃ ca caturgatim | subhadraṃ ca bṛhadbhānuṃ gadinaṃ varuṇaṃ mukham || 31.242 || jayaṃ kumbheśamakhilamṛtaṃ bhuvanasaṃjñitam | dṛṣṭiṃ ca dhanadaṃ dakṣaṃ hṛṣīkeśaṃ jayāhvayam || 31.243 || śaśāṅkaṃ bhuvanaṃ cādiṃ kamalāmadrimastakam | vighneśaṃ bhuvanaṃ cādiṃ kamalāmadrimastakam | vighneśaṃ paścimaṃ bandhuṃ nāsikyaṃ gadinaṃ tathā || 31.244 || māhendraṃ śaśinaṃ devadattaṃ lakṣmīṃ śriyaḥpatim | pañcāntakaṃ padmanābhaṃ gopanaṃ vighnanāyakam || 31.245 || amṛtaṃ samiraṇamacāṃ dvitīyaṃ paścimānanam | vairājaṃ mādhavīmūrdhvalokeśaṃ vijayadvayam || 31.246 || bahulaṃ samiraṇaṃ devadattaṃ mandara gopane | gopanaṃ cauṣadhīśaṃ ca bhuvanaṃ vaidharāhvayam || 31.247 || śrīvatsamagniṃ vighneśaṃ gopanaṃ ca caturgatim | huṃphaṭkāraṃ ṭhaṭhāntaṃ ca manumevaṃ samuddharet || 31.248 || bījāṅgāni yathāpūrvamṛṣissyānnīlalohitaḥ | chandhaśca varivaṃsaṃjño devatā ca sudarśanaḥ || 31.249 || aṣṭalakṣaṃ japedbrahman pātāle divi vā bhuvi | gatinan pratihanyeta mantriṇo mantravaibhavāt || 31.250 || sudarśananṛsiṃhākhyaṃ mantraṃ brūmi caturmukha | udgīdhaṃ nṛhariṃ padmanābhāṃ saṅkarṣaṇāhvayam || 31.251 || nāsikyaṃ śuklamādiṃ ca gopatiṃ praṇavādi ca | nihāradīdhitaṃ padmanābhaṃ ca madhuvidviṣam || 31.252 || analaṃ kakubhaṃ kumbhaṃ gopanaṃ pulahātmakam | acāṃ dvitīyaṃ sparśāntaṃ sūdanaṃ pulahāhvayam || 31.253 || vikramaṃ kuñjaramukhaṃ mādhavaṃ tasya mastake | mārtāṇḍaṃ bhadrahastaṃ ca dviruccārya prabhākaram || 31.254 || śrīdharaṃ kapilākṣaṃ ca phaṭkāraṃ kheṭakīṃ tataḥ | ṭhaṭhāntamevaṃ kathitaṃ dvāviṃśatyakṣarātmakam || 31.255 || bījamaṅgāni coktāni chando gāyatramiritam || draṣṭā ca jamadagnissyāddhevatā ca sudarśanaḥ || 31.256 || sudarśanasya hṛdaye viṣṭhitaṃ nṛhariṃ haram | sphaṭikācalasaṅkāśaṃ paraśśatasaṭākulam || 31.257 || pralayāmbudanirghoṣagambhiragahanadhvanim | śajkhacakradharaṃ dvābhyāṃ karābhyāmitarau punaḥ || 31.258 || prasārya jānunorbhī maṃ nakhadambholibhīṣaṇau | vyatyastacaraṇadvandvamāsīnaṃ padmaviṣṭare || 31.259 || bhrukuṭīkuṭilaṃ yogapaṭṭikādṛḍhabandhakam | vyādāyavaktrakuharaṃ daṃṣṭriṇaṃ sphuṭitādharam || 31.260 || triṇetramakhilākalpakalpitaṃ brahmagarjitam | dhyāye devaṃ ca tanmantraṃ mantrī tarati durgatim || 31.261 || sakṛtsmaraṇamātreṇa yathābhilaṣitaṃ phalam | anyeṣu mantrakalpeṣu yaduktaṃ tatsamaśnute || 31.262 || vakṣyāmi pāñcajanyasya mantraṃ sarvārthasādhanam | udgīthamādau saptārṇānuddhṛtya tadanantaram || 31.263 || paścimaṃ bhuvanaṃ caṇḍaṃ puṇḍarīkaṃ hutāśanam | mahāmāyāṃ karālaṃ ca gopanaṃ pannagādhipam || 31.264 || sūdanaṃ ca tathā saṅkhaṃ kalaśaṃ madhusūdanam | mārutaṃ bhuvanāhvānaṃ mandaraṃ bhuvanaṃ tataḥ || 31.265 || kharvadehaṃ tathā cādidevaṃ śvasanamādimat | vaidharaṃ pañcabinduṃ ca paścimaṃ vijayaṃ tataḥ || 31.266 || yāntaṃ guhālayaṃ pāpahananaṃ madhuvidviṣam | śaṅkhaṃ lakṣmīṃ tathāyaṣṭiṃ kharvadehaṃ ca paścimam || 31.267 || ādidevaṃ mahendraṃ ca madhusūdanaśīrṣakam | vāyuṃ ṭhaṭhāntamuditamiti prokto manurmahān || 31.268 || śrīvatso yaṣṭirudgītho bījametatprakīrtitam | amuṣya sanako draṣṭā chandassyādbṛhatī manoḥ || 31.269 || devatā pāñcajanyaśca caturlakṣojapaḥ smṛtaḥ | ato'nyaṃ pāñcajanyasya mantraṃ śṛṇu caturmukha || 31.270 || saptārṇamuddharedādau paścimaṃ
