madhusūdanam | bhṛguṃ candhradharaṃ khaḍgadhavalaṃ kakubhāhvayam || 31.271 || gajavaktraṃ tathā nāyumādi devaṃ samiraṇam | paśchimaṃ saptamamacāṃ sumukhaṃ nigamādikam || 31.272 || pīyūṣamatriṃ subhagaṃ varuṇaṃ madhuvidviṣam | gajāsyamādidevaṃ ca śvasanaṃ śvetarociṣam || 31.273 || vaidharaṃ gopanaṃ cāpi gadadhvaṃsaṃ caturmukha | vairājaṃ vikramaṃ dakṣaṃ śrīdharaṃ tarkṣyavāhanam || 31.274 || gopanaṃ sparśanaṃ janmahantaraṃ salitādhipam | mahendramādiṃ jvalanaṃ tathācaṃ ṣaṣṭhipaścimau || 31.275 || gopanaṃ paścimaṃ gopaṃ pītavarṇaṃ madhudviṣam | śvasanaṃ ca ṭhaṭhāntaṃ ca manuritthamudāhṛtaḥ || 31.276 || jīmaṅgāni vaitasya devatā cāpi pūrvavat | viṣvaksena ṛṣiśchandassupratiṣṭhāpitāmaha || 31.277 || pañcalakṣajapenāsya sādhako mandravaibhavāt | atalādiṣu lokeṣu caranna pratihanyate || 31.278 || kiṃ pinardarmakāmārthamokṣāḥ kamalasambhava | saptārṇamagre govindaṃ gadinaṃ dṛṣṭisūdanau || 31.279 || caturgatiṃ cātivīraṃ bhallāyudhamacāṃ mukham | apāṃ patiṃ hutamahamukāraṃ paścimānanam || 31.280 || rāmaṃ pracaṇḍaṃ govindaṃ brahmasaṅkarṣaṇāvapi | mandaraṃ vāsudevāhvaṃ vaidharaṃ viṣṇumastakam || 31.281 || kuśeśayadhare vīrasenaṃ huṃphaṭ ṭhaṭhāntimam | iti kaumodakīmantramuddharedbījamasyatu || 31.282 || sparśadvitīyamardhendumetenaivāṅgakalpanā | ṛṣiḥ kṛṣṇastathā chandaḥ paṅtkiḥ kaumodakī punaḥ || 31.283 || devatā lakṣamantraśca javataspiddhido bhavet | ādāvuddhṛtya coṅkāraṃ gopanaṃ dṛṣṭivikramau || 31.284 || vairājaṃ mārutaṃ pāpahananaṃ vasumastakam | vairājaṃ bandhuśirasaṃ mādhavīṃ sūdanaṃ daram || 31.285 || pāṭalapriyamākāraṃ samiraṇamacāṃ mukham | yāntaṃ guhālayaṃ brahman paścimaṃ bandhumastakam || 31.286 || sumukhaṃ devadattaṃ ca huṃphaṭkāraṃ ṭhaṭhāntimam | nādaṃ pakāramākāramardhenduśirasaṃ punaḥ || 31.287 || bījaṃ prakalpayedbrahmannamanai pāṅgakalpanā | draṣṭā virañcaśchandaśca virāṭpadmo'dhidevatā || 31.288 || daśalakṣajapātsiddhirakhailaṃ prāpnuyānnaraḥ | iti padmamanuḥ prokto bījenānyāṅgakalpanā || 31.289 || śuklaṃ punarviṣṇu vahnipīyūṣaṃ gopanāhvayam | saptārṇāddharaṇātpaśchānmandaraṃ kamalāsana || 31.290 || śaśāṅkamādiṃ pulahaṃ gopanaṃ pavanaṃ punaḥ | jvalanaṃ gopanaṃ dakṣaṃ gopanaṃ kamalodbhava || 31.291 || caturgatiṃ ca bhuvanaṃ sumukhaṃ madhuvidviṣam | daraṃ mukhaṃ ṭhaṭhāntaṃ ca mantravinmantramuddharet || 31.292 || mandaraṃ bhuvanaṃ yaṣṭimitibījamidaṃ manoḥ | mudgasyādṛṣiśchando virāṇmandrasya devatā || 31.293 || musalaḥ pañcalakṣaṃ tu mantramasya pracakṣate | uddhṛtya saptavarṇāṃśca hairambaṃ madhusūdanam || 31.294 || gajahvamatriṃ kamalaṃ madhuśatruṃ caturgatim | viṣṇuṃ śuklaṃ punarviṣṇuṃ vahnipiyūṣagopanāḥ || 31.295 || śaśāṅkaṃ bhuvanaṃ vahniṃ śrīvatsaṃ brahmasādhanam | sumukhaṃ vikramaṃ cāpi vaidharaṃ vijayaṃ tathā || 31.296 || rāmaṃ pañcāntakaṃ puṇyaṃ gopanaṃ yaṣṭiśīrṣakam | pañcāntakaṃ gopanaṃ ca śvasanaṃ huṃkṛtiṃ tathā || 31.297 || phaṭkāraṃ svāhayā sārdhaṃ khaḍgasya gadito manuḥ | cakramantrasya bījaṃ syādṛṣiśśrīnidhirucyate || 31.298 || chando virāḍhadhipatiḥ khaḍgākhyo hetirāḍbhavet | lakṣatrayaṃ japenmantrī kāṅkṣitāṃ siddhimaśnute || 31.299 || saptārṇaṃ kalpayitvādau śrīvatsaṃ madhusūdanam | śārṅgahastaṃ gadadhvaṃsaṃ madhusūdana śīrṣakam || 31.300 || jvalanaṃ pavanādiṃ ca vahniṃ śuklamapāṃ patim | madhusūdanapūrṇendubhuvanaṃ havyavāhanam || 31.301 || pavitraṃ saptamamacāṃ śriyaṃ mandaramādimat | vighneśaṃ gopanaṃ śaṅkhaṃ mukhaṃ paścima śrīdharam || 31.302 || bahulaṃ bhuvanaṃ krodhaṃ trayodaśamacāṃ tathā | hutāśamekadṛṣṭīdvau mandaraṃ padmasambhava || 31.303 || pavitramṛtadhāmānaṃ vāyuṃ yaṣṭiṃ madhudviṣam | caturgatiṃ huṃkṛtiṃ ca phaṭkāraṃ ca ṭhaṭhāntimam || 31.304 || huṃphaḍantaṃ manuṃ kṛtvā bījamādyarṇamuddharet | ṛṣirhutānto mantrasya chandaśchando'dhidevatā || 31.305 || bāṇo japannaṣṭalakṣaṃ samare vijayī bhavet | brahmakośaṃ natiṃ sargaṃ kalātmā kamalāhvayam || 31.306 || mahendraṃ gopanaparaṃ śubhadaṃ madhuvidviṣam | śaśāṅkaṃ śrīdharaṃ vahniṃ varuṇaṃ bandhumastakam || 31.307 || vighneśamādidevaṃ ca śubhadaṃ gopanaṃ tathā | pavanaṃ kuṭāmaurvaṃ ca nāsikyaṃ bhāskaro manuḥ || 31.308 || yaṣṭiṃ huṅkāraphaṭkārau hutāntaṃ manumuddharet | pīyūṣamādimardhenduṃ bījaṃ cāmuṣya kalpayet || 31.309 || śatadṛgdṛṣṭavān mantraṃ mācchdo devatāpi ca | pañcalakṣaṃ japenmandraṃ vijayettarasā ripūn || 31.310 || udgīdhaṃ pāpahananaṃ gopanaṃ saddhruvaṃ manuḥ | paścimaṃ gopanaṃ lakṣmīmādidevasamiraṇau || 31.311 || natyantaṃ kalpayenmantramṛṣiḥ prācetasaḥ smṛtaḥ | chando virāḍadhipatiḥ paśo lakṣatrayaṃ japaḥ || 31.312 || brahmakośamacāmādiṃ nāsikyaṃ sarasīruham | bhuvanaṃ śubhadaṃ paścādādidevaṃ gadāgatim || 31.313 || natyantamirayenmantraṃ draṣṭā satyo virāṭpunaḥ | chando'ṅkuśo devatā syāllakṣatrayamimaṃ japet || 31.314 || praṇavādi caturthyantaṃ nāmadheyaṃ ṭhaṭhāntakam | anyeṣāmāyudhānāṃ ca mandrabījamathādimat || 31.315 || siddhayaśca yathāpūrvaṃ bhavanti japato'khilāḥ | ato vakṣye manuṃ brahman śūyatāṃ kathyate'dhunā || 31.316 || vaśyākarṣaṇa vidveṣa māraṇo ccāṭanādiṣu | śoṣaṇastambhanāveśa sarpākarṣaṇa karmasu || 31.317 || naṣṭāyanaviṣakṣepa samudrataraṇādiṣu | nabholaṅghana vāyvagni jalabhūmi praveśane || 31.318 || indrajālādividyāsu ṛṣīṇāṃ vijaye tathā | atītānāgatajñāne bhūtasaṃpanane tathā || 31.319 || devatā sannidhānādau sphoṭimūrṣyādikarmaṇi | evamādiṣu sādhyeṣu tathā nyeṣvapi sarmasu || 31.320 || iti mantraṃ prayuñjīta garutmantamanusmaret | saṭtārṇān pūrvamuddhṛtya gadinaṃ havyavāhanam || 31.321 || bhuvaṃ puṇḍarīkākṣaṃ gopanaṃ pavanaṃ punaḥ | paścimaṃ bhuvanaṃ vahniṃ śrīdharaṃ krodhavigraham || 31.322 || brahmasādhanavairājau jayamandarāmādimat | amṛtaṃ gopanaṃ cāpi gopatiṃ dviradānanam || 31.323 || ādidevaṃ nabhasvantaṃ analaṃ ca ramādharam | pracaṇḍaṃ kamalaṃ bhadrahastaṃ vāmanamastakam || 31.324 || śvasanaṃ rohiṇīśaṃ ca mṛgeśaṃ mānuṣeśvaram | gopana gadinaṃ paścātkamalāṃ bhuvanaṃ tathā || 31.325 || vāsudevaṃ pracaṇḍaṃ ca vikramaṃ vijayaṃ tathā | vai rājaṃ rāmasahitaṃ gadinaṃ mohanāśanam || 31.326 || acāṃ tṛtīyamardhenduṃ pañcāntakamadhudviṣau | mārutaṃ dhūmaketuṃ ca saptakṛtvassamuddharet || 31.327 || hṛṅkṛtiṃ phaṭkṛtiṃ svāhamotadehaṃ dhruvaṃ tathā | pulahaṃ saptakṛtvaśca huṃphaṭkāraṃ ṭhaṭhāntakam || 31.328 || tāraṃ varuṇagovindau vighneśamatha mādhavam | sparśā ntakamakāraṃ ca pañcakṛtvassadāgatim || 31.329 || ṣaṭkṛtvo varuṇaṃ cāpi huṃphaṭ svāhāvasānakam | nigamaṃ paścimaṃ kūṭaṃ vikramaṃ vighnugopanau || 31.330 || kakubhaṃ gopanaṃ cāpi ṣaṭkṛtvo mārutaṃ punaḥ | vyañjanārṇeṣu sarvatra sukhoccāraṇamicchatā || 31.331 || svarānuddharaṇe kalpyaṃ manuśśāstroktavartmanā | huṃphaṭsvāhāvasānaṃ ca gāruḍaṃ mantramuddharet || 31.332 || pañcāntakamanussvāraṃ bījametasya kalpayet | ādau suvarṇavacanaṃ vakratuṇḍagiraṃ punaḥ || 31.333 || mahāsuvarṇa ityevaṃ khageśvaraśirastathā | anantavīryavantākhyaṃ pakṣirājaṃ tathā ntimam || 31.334 || praṇavādi yaturathyanta natyantāni caturmukha | kalpayitvāṅgamandrāṇi ṣaḍbhiretairyathākramam || 31.335 || aṅgāni hṛdayādīni spṛśenmantravicakṣaṇaḥ | amuṣya kāśyapo draṣṭā chandaḥ paṅtkirnigadyate || 31.336 || devatā garuḍastasya japo lakṣatrayaṃ smṛtaḥ | adhastādvaṭavṛkṣasya sādhakassādhayenmanum || 31.337 || āmnāyādiṃ narahariṃ vāmanaṃ paścimānanam | vairājaṃ pāvakaṃ tāramiti pañcākṣaro manuḥ || 31.338 || ṛṣirmariciretasya garuḍo devatā tathā | chandaśca devī gāyatraṃ ṣaḍaṅgāni punassvayam || 31.339 || udgīdhaṃ kamalaṃ vāyuṃ vāsudevaṃ dhruvaṃ tathā | paścimaṃ bahulaṃ brahmasādhanaṃ yaṣṭimastakam || 31.340 || vighneśaṃ vikramaṃ vahniṃ mahāmāyāṃ dhruvaṃ punaḥ | puṣpabhadraṃ tathā pīṭhaṃ vāmanaṃ yaṣṭikaustubham || 31.341 || binduṃ kalaśacandrārdhau sūryārdhāndukalātmanaḥ | pannagādhipatiṃ bandhuṃ varuṇaṃ yādasāṃ mukham || 31.342 || hutāntamuddharenmantramiti gāruḍamuttamam | syādimaṃ jagatassākṣātpratyakṣaṃ pakṣipuñgavaḥ || 31.343 || brahmakāśamatho padmaṃ nāsikyaṃ bhūdharāhvayam | yaṣṭiṃ pāpasya hantaraṃ binduṃ kamalamandaram || 31.344 || ardhendukalaśaṃ binduṃ paścimaṃ pannagāśanam | vikramāgnimatho śatruṃ kakubhaṃ madhusūdanam || 31.345 || vāyuṃ svāhāntamityeva manyaṃ gāruḍamirayet | ākāśārohanaṃ siddhirjapādasya bhaviṣyati || 31.346 || evaṃ kṛtvādyamoṅkāra mādidevaṃ khapaścim | svacchandaṃ ca dvirucchārya gadinaṃ havyavāhanam || 31.347 || bhuvanaṃ medinīṃ ca dvirmandaraṃ madhusūdanam | vairājaṃ vipulaṃ paścādvāmanaṃ ca dvirīrayet || 31.348 || pavitraṃ padmakañjaṃ ca nāgendraṃ vāyumādimat | etādviḥkalpayitvātho gopanaṃ yaṣṭimantimam || 31.349 || tuṣṭibījārdhaśaśinaṃ ṭhaṭhāntaṃ kalpayenmanum | saptārṇānāditaḥ kṛtvā bhāskaraṃ havyavāhanam || 31.350 || gopanaṃ yaṣṭimārtāṇḍau havyavāhana vāmanau | candrardhau dvādaśātmānaṃ hṛṣīkeśamatho dhruvam || 31.351 || varuṇaṃ hṛdayāhlādaṃ dvandvaṃ kamalamādhavau | vairājaṃ śrīdharo bhūyaḥ pīṭhastu bhuvanadvayam || 31.352 || vijayaṃ śrīdharaṃ vahniṃ bhuvanaṃ punarīrayet | lokanetrordhvanāsikyaṃ karālaṃ brahmasādhanam || 31.353 || analaṃ yaṣṭimanilaṃ yaṣṭiṃ kumbho dhruvaṃ tathā | hutāntamiti sarvārthaṃ jānīyādgāruḍaṃ manum || 31.354 || saptārṇamuddṛtya punaḥ kalaśaṃ bandhumastakam | krodharūpaṃ pracaṇḍaṃ ca tridaśāhāramādhavau || 31.355 || candraṃ svāhāpatiṃ cāpi śaśinaṃ bahulaṃ tathā | mṛgāṅkaṃ śrīdharaṃ vahniṃ bhuvanaṃ dvi catuṣṭayam || 31.356 || bhānumatpulahadvandvaṃ huṃ phaḍantaṃ hutā ntimam | ityanyaṃ gāruḍaṃ mantramūhenmandravicakṣaṇaḥ || 31.357 || pavanena hutāśena mahendreṇa pracetasā | etaiścaturbiḥ pratyekaṃ kramavyastairviṣaṃ haret || 31.358 || samastraiḥ prātilomyena stambhanādi samācaret | vyāpinaṃ vighnurājaṃ ca dāmodaramatho dhruvam || 31.359 || evamādimiti brahman tyrakṣaraṃ manumuddharet | yainaiva sādhito mantraḥ yakṣarājopalakṣitaḥ || 31.360 || trīṇi tasya bhaviṣyanti bhuvanāni viśeṣatām | ādidvitīyaṃ bhuvanaṃ pañchāntamamṛtaṃ tathā || 31.361 || gadinaṃ śrīdharaṃ vahnimudayaṃ cādimambujam | vairājaṃ vikramaṃ svāhā aurvaṃ ca kamalāhvayam || 31.362 || bhuvanaṃ parvataṃ bandhuṃ māhendrādi śriyaṃ tathā | vikramaṃ tārkṣyavāhaṃ ca mṛgeśaṃ mandaraṃ tathā || 31.363 || ādisūryo gopanaṃ ca mandaraṃ bhuvanaṃ diśam | agniṃ mṛgādhipaṃ cāpi svāhākārāvasānikam || 31.364 || iti mudrāmanurbrahman kalpayedatha maṇḍalam | vistareṣu nirīkṣantāṃ teṣāṃ saṅkhyā na vidyate || 31.365 || ātmānaṃ cintayenmantrī garutmantamananyadhīḥ | atha dyānaṃ pravakṣyāmi pakṣirājasya padmaja || 31.366 || meruśṛṅganibhākāraṃ rukmapakṣatimaṇḍalam | vaiḍūryanīlavāsāgraṃ vakratuṇḍaṃ bhayaṅkaram || 31.367 || vajrakalpana khākāraṃ kalpitotkaṭikāsanam | snagambhūranirhradaṃ śilāghanabhujāntaram || 31.368 || anantakarṇābharaṇaṃ mūrdhni vāsukibhūṣaṇam | mahāpadmādaraṃ padmadāma veṣṭitabhūṣaṇam || 31.369 || mastake baddhakārkoṭaṃ kalābhoḥ kaṭiveṣṭitam | upavītakṛtenāpi saṅkhapātena bhūṣitam || 31.370 || jayena kulikenāpi kalpi tānaghamūpuram | dhanaṅjayābhinedhāna vijayena ca bhoginā || 31.371 || vāmadakṣiṇahastābhyāṃ bibhrāṇaṃ kalakadvayam | bālapallavatāmreṇa vāravāṇena śobhitam || 31.372 || udbhinnabhrukuṭībandhaṃ karaṇḍamukuṭaṃ tathā | pakṣavikṣepagambhīra kṛtordhvanayanabhramam || 31.373 || daṃṣṭrākarālavadanaṃ tāmravartulacakṣumam | itthaṃ dhyātvā garutmantamekatānena cetasā || 31.374 || sādhayetsādhanīyāni durlabhānyapi nātibhīḥ | yathāktaṃ japatomandramādityenyastacakṣuṣaḥ || 31.375 || ūrdhvabāhorbhaviṣyanti dāsā iva phaṇīśvarāḥ | viṣvaksenamanurbrahman kathyate sarvasiddhadaḥ || 31.376 || tāraṃ sudhāmayaṃ rāmaṃ krodharūpaṃ sudhāmayam | karālaṃ śaśinaṃ paścānmādhavaṃ kuñjarānanam || 31.377 || gopanaṃ mārutaṃ cāpi ṭhaṭhāntaṃ mantramuddharet | tāreṇa bindunā cāpi bījametasya kalpayet || 31.378 || etenai vāṅgamantrāṇi kalpyāni kamalāsana | viśvanāthamṛṣiṃ prāhurvirāṭchando nigadyate || 31.379 || devatā ca manostasya viṣvakseno mahābalaḥ | athyānyaḥ kalpito mantro viṣvaksenasya padmaja || 31.380 || udgīthaṃ bhadrapāṇiṃ ca mandaraṃ brahmasādhanam | subhadraṃ gadinaṃ kumbhaṃ sumukhāntaṃ samādhavam || 31.381 || sparśādiṃ bindusahitaṃ sadhruvaṃ kamalāsana | darāntaṃ gopanaṃ brahman dhanadaṃ rāmaśīrṣakam || 31.382 || paścimaṃ nigamādiṃ ca vai rājaṃ ca samāhvayam | khaḍgahastaṃ sarāmaṃ ca jayaṃ vasuvaraṃ tathā || 31.383 || subhadaṃ saroruhaṃ vairājaṃ vikramamastakam | padmapāṇiṃ bhadrapāṇiṃ pāśapāṇiṃ ca paścimam || 31.384 || sodayaṃ śatruhananaṃ mṛgeśaṃ vakratuṇḍakam | pracaṇḍaṃ puṇḍarīkākṣaṃ madhuśatruṃ caturgatim || 31.385 || khaḍgahastamacāmādiṃ pracaṇḍaṃ jhaṣamarpitam | subhadrāntaṃ madhudveṣiṃ vai rājaṃ dvirvasu param || 31.386 || acāṃ dvitīyaṃ subhagaṃ puṇḍarīkavidarbhitam | vaidharaṃ viṣṇusahitaṃ pracaṇḍaṃ savanālayam || 31.387 || śrīvatsaṃ sadhruvaṃ khaḍga hastaharaṃ tathā | kamalaṃ tvṛtadhāmaṃ ca subhagaṃ vasugopanau || 31.388 || caturgatimacāmādiṃ vaidharaṃ gopanaṃ tathā | vijayaṃ śvasanaṃ dattaṃ sūdanaṃ mṛgatāñchanam || 31.389 || samādhavaṃ da dhānaṃ ca kamalaṃ mādhavaṃ tataḥ | pītaṃ ca dhanadaṃ kumbhamarpitaṃ sadhruvaṃ punaḥ || 31.390 || kalānidhiṃ ca puradhamādi devaṃ caturgatim | vaidharaṃ varuṇaṃ māyāṃ kheṭakaṃ ca samuddharet || 31.391 || paścimaṃ padmanābhaṃ ca māvṛtaṃ śubhamālinīm | samandaraṃ darāntaṃ ca madhudveṣiṃ samantrajit || 31.392 || aindavaṃ katṛtīyaṃ ca saṃmataṃ māṭharābhidham | sundaraṃ vaidharaṃ pañca bindukaṃ bhadrakaṃ tathā || 31.393 || sparśeṣu ṣoḍaśaṃ padmanābhaṃ ca caturāsana | gopanaṃ caindavamatho caturgatimanantaram || 31.394 || bhāntaṃ madhudviṣaṃ yāntaṃ daraṃ ca dvissamuddharet | kadvitīyaṃ sūdanaṃ ca vaidharaṃ ca caturgatim || 31.395 || dvirvaktavyaṃ dinakaraṃ bhadrapāṇimanantaram | vaidharaṃ bhāskaraṃ cāpi paścimaṃ vakratuṇḍakam || 31.396 || mandaraṃ sarvarodhaṃ ca dvirgatīriti saṃmitam | gopatiṃ sumukhaṃ cāpi śubhadaṃ brahmasādhanam || 31.397 || krodhaṃ caturgatiṃ cāpi ādibījaṃ caturmukha | ādidevaṃ tathā kumbhaṃ saṃprasāraṇamakṣaram || 31.398 || śrīvatsaṃ puruṣātmānaṃ mantravikramaniṣṭhitam | varuṇaṃ śaṅkhamaparaṃ paścimaṃ padmanābhakam || 31.399 || subhadraṃ ca madhudveṣiṃ kuṃbhaṃ bhadrakaraṃ tathā | vaidharaṃ śubhadaṃ cāgniṃ caturgitamanantaram || 31.400 || huṅkāraṃ ca vaṣaṭkāramirayetkamalāsana | śubhadaṃ vāmanaparaṃ krodhaṃ cāgniṃ madhudviṣam || 31.401 || caturgatiṃ sūdanaṃ ca vakratuṇḍaṃ samiraṇam | mādhavīṃ vijayaṃ bhadrahastaṃ ca samataṃ punaḥ || 31.402 || vidhātāraṃ mṛgeśaṃ ca bhāgaṃ yāntaṃ savikramam | saroruhaṃ madhudveṣiṃ paścimaṃ rānuśīrṣakam || 31.403 || mahendramamṛtaṃ bandhuṃ katṛtīyaṃ mṛgaṃ tathā | bhāskaraṃ sūdanamatho śaṅkhaṃ khaḍgadharaṃ punaḥ || 31.404 || vairājaṃ sodayaṃ caiva katṛtīyaṃ vasuṃ param | dvitīyaṃ vāsudevaṃ ca tṛtīyaṃ bandhusaṃhitam || 31.405 || mādhavaṃ varuṇaṃ pārśvamedaraṃ daragopanau | caturgatiṃ khaḍgadharaṃ saṛtaṃ brahmasādhanam || 31.406 || sabinduṃ paścimaṃ caiva vācāṃ saptamasādhane | sadhruvaṃ cendhirābhījaṃ puṣṭibījaṃ sahuṃkṛtim || 31.407 || sudhārasaṃ caurvaparaṃ mādhavaṃ ca caturmukha | vauṣaṭkāraṃ tathā lakṣmīṃ darāntaṃ pañcabindukam || 31.408 || yāntaṃ ca sūdanaṃ māntaṃ śrīśabdaṃ bhadrapāṇinam | vikramaṃ pulahaṃ dhūliketanaṃ sūrinandanam || 31.409 || huṃkṛtiṃ vaidharaṃ bhānuṃ vighneśaṃ madhusūdanam | kharvadehaṃ sabandhuṃ ca pītaṃ bhallāyudhaṃ tathā || 31.410 || mādhavaṃ varuṇaṃ bhadrahastaṃ sargiṇamabjaja | pavitraṃ sūdanamatho vairājaṃ ca samiraṇam || 31.411 || oṃkārādi jayaṃ pītaṃ sūdanaṃ vidhuraṃ punaḥ | śrīdharaṃ māṇibhadraṃ ca dviradaṃ vikramaṃ tathā || 31.412 || vakratuṇḍadharaṃ binduṃ piyūṣaṃ rāmaśīrṣakam | atriṃ ca sūdanaṃ yāstaṃ mandaraṃ daravaidharau || 31.413 || dvayaṃ vasuśiraśśaṅkhaṃ kumbhaṃ vikramamastakam | pūrṇaṃ ghaṭaṃ sadhruvaṃ ca vaidharaṃ ca caturgatim || 31.414 || śuklaṃ ghaṭaṃ vahniparaṃ vaidharaṃ ca madhudviṣam | subhadraṃ madhuvidveṣaṃ sarasīruhasambhava || 31.415 || kapilākṣaṃ hutavahaṃ nṛsiṃhaṃ ca samuddaret | bījānyetadviruccārya śuklapītāntimākṣaram || 31.416 || śīrṣaṃ ca gopanaṃ caṇḍaṃ paścimaṃ jayatatparam | bhallāyudhaṃ mārutaṃ ca sargiṇaṃ caturāsana || 31.417 || kṛpākaṃ karīraṃ ca vasutacchirasaṃ tathā | subhadramūrdhvalokeśaṃ vijayaṃ saṃprasāraṇam || 31.418 || subhadraṃ puruṣātmānaṃ kalāntaṃ phaṭkṛtiṃ tathā | nigamādiṃ śaśadharaṃ mādhavaṃ vasumādhavam || 31.419 || bhallāyudhaṃ tathāsargaṃ phaṭkṛtiṃ dakṣamakṣaram | govatiṃ gopanaṃ kumbhaṃ vikramaṃ krodharūpiṇam || 31.420 || pracaṇḍaṃ sārdhamamṛtaṃ mādhavaṃ ghaṭavikramam | ugrātmānaṃ tathā kumbhaṃ kamalaṃ dvividhuṃtudam || 31.421 || dattaṃ bhadraṃ sūdanaṃ ca dakṣāntaṃ huṃphaḍantakam | svāhāvasānamityevaṃ viṣveksenamahāmanum || 31.422 || uddharedbījamasyātha tāraṃ kumbhaṃ manuṃ dhruvam | kalpayedamunaivāṅgamantraṃ mantravicakṣaṇaḥ || 31.423 || drupado dṛṣṭavānetacchando'ticchanda ucyate | viṣvakseno devatā ca japellakṣatrayaṃ punaḥ || 31.424 || etaṃ mahāmanuṃ brahman japatassiddhi kāṅkṣayā | surāsurebhyassarvebhyo bhayaṃ tasya praṇaśyati || 31.425 || athedānīṃ pravakṣyāmi tasyārādhanasaṃyutam | kalpayitvā mahāpadmaṃ dalairdvādaśabhiryutam || 31.426 || karṇikāyāṃ samāsīnaṃ sainānyaṃ samyagarcayet | viṣvaksena namaste'stu namo mṛtyubhayāpaha || 31.427 || namaḥ pāriṣa deśāya dhuryaya jagatāṃ namaḥ | carācarāṇāmadistvaṃ janma nāśo na vidyate || 31.428 || dhuramādhāya lokānāṃ tvayyeva puruṣottamaḥ | yoganidrā sukhavaśaśśete śeṣe manohare || 31.429 || ekāntināṃ tapobhakti prakarṣakṣīṇakarmaṇām | bhagavatprāptaye dvāradṛṣṭayastvāṃ prabhūtaye || 31.430 || brahmāṇamāhuḥ kalpādau pālane madhuvidviṣam | patiṃ paśūnāṃ saṃhāre jagatastasthuṣāmapi || 31.431 || pādena medinīṃ viśvāṃ madhyena paramambaram | nākaṃ mūrdhnā tvamākramyatiṣṭhasyeko jaganmayaḥ || 31.432 || tvaṃ bhūmistvamapāṃ sthānaṃ tejaśca tvaṃ samiraṇaḥ | ākāśastvaṃ tvāmiyante vibhūtirvāpya tiṣṭhati || 31.433 || tvameva bhāskaro bhūtvā viśvaṃ tapasi viṣṭapam | āhlādayasi tadbhūyassomo bhūtvākṛpā nidhiḥ || 31.434 || satvarūpasya te rūpe guṇāvanyo rajastamaḥ | śuklarūpe yathā rūpe śuklarūpasya vastunaḥ || 31.435 || tvāṃ sṛṣṭvā bhagavānādau bhaṅtkvā tairhetubhiḥ punaḥ | tvāṃ smṛtvā sattamaṃ paścātpumāneti tvadātmatām || 31.436 || vaibhave nijenaiva bhibhrāṇetvayi viṣṭapam | pitāmahassukhaṃ śeṣe śeṣe'śeṣajagatpatiḥ || 31.437 || ṛgbhiḥ prātastuvanti tvāṃ yajurbhirmadhyamedine | sāyāhne sāmabhiḥ puṇyaissūryātmānaṃ dvijātayaḥ || 31.438 || pravṛttihetuṃ viśvasya tvāmeva prakṛtiṃ viduḥ | pumāṃsamapyudāsīnaṃ tatsākṣiṇamakalmaṣam || 31.439 || na kiṅcidabhi rūpaṃ yadviśvaṃ te viṣṭavaṃ punaḥ | nāstite nāmadheyaṃ catvaṃ nāmāgniṃ suhṛdvidaḥ || 31.440 || saṅkhyā nāsti guṇānāṃ te tejasāmapi bhāsvataḥ | ṣaḍguṇā iti uktatvātprameyādīn pracakṣate || 31.441 || śaknoṣi budhyase viśvaṃ bhibharti navikārayam | īśiṣe dviṣato haṃsi tvameva bhuvanatrayam || 31.442 || hitaiṣī tvaṃ yathā svāmin bhaktānāṃ gatapāpmanām | tathā ca bāndhapāsteṣāṃ sākṣādātmāhikaṃ bahu || 31.443 || tvadāninavasindhūnāṃ dīdhitīnāmivāṃśumān | svāminnāmnāyamūlānāṃ vidyānāṃ prabhavo bhavān || 31.444 || na tu tiṣṭhanti śāstrāṇi bahuni kathayannapi | na ca tvadbhaktisārāṇāṃ kalyāṇāni vicintayan || 31.445 || bhave'smin duḥ khabahule tvāmāhuryogināṃ gatim | apāṃ śivānāmādhāramadhvagānāṃ vivāsinām || 31.446 || dhanyaṃ tava pradeśeṣu gatyantaramapaśyatām | nirvāpayasi nocecca tvaṃ kaṭākṣasudhārasaiḥ || 31.447 || duḥkhadāvāgni bhirdagdhā jantavastaṃ mahīmayāḥ | viśālavakṣasaṃ śyāmaṃ puṇḍarīkanibhekṣaṇam || 31.448 || sālākāracaturbāhuṃ tvā mahaṃ kharaṇaṃ vraje | cakravāka ivādityaṃ cātako vāridaṃ yathā || 31.449 || cakorā iva śītāṃśu mārtastvāmahayāśraye | etatpaṭhati yastotraṃ śrutibhissaṃsthitaṃ tvidam || 31.450 || prīyate tasya bhagavān senānīravilambitam | dadyācca sampadassarvāstasmaibhaktāya durlabhāḥ || 31.451 || iti śrīpāṅcarātre mahopaniṣadi pādmasaṃhitāyāṃ caryāpāde kirīṭādimandroddhāraṇaṃ nāma ekatriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ |
<4.32>
brahmā aihikāmuṣmikaṃ sarvaṃ mantraṃ saudarśanaṃ param | śuśrūṣorbhagavannadya rahasyamapi pāvanam || 32.1 || bhaktāya mahyaṃ dātavyaṃ praṇatāya yathātatham | śrībhagavān hanta te katha yiṣyāmi mantraṃ sarvārthasādhanam || 32.2 || yathārthanāma tenāyaṃ nākhyeyo yasya kasya cit | udgīthamuddharetpūrvaṃ candramādyaṃ nabhomaṇim || 32.3 || atriṃ sitadyutiṃ vahniṃ gopanaṃ jvalanaṃ mukham | ūṣmāṇamudayaṃ vīraṃ pullākṣaṃ viṣṇumastakam || 32.4 || hṛdayāhlādamityeva mantroddhāraścaturmukha | vahnimādimanusvāraṃ bījamuddhṛtya kalpayet || 32.5 || ṣaḍaṅgamanuvarṇānāmuddhāraḥ kathyate kramāt | aṅgatrayaṃ caturvaktra pūrvamāviṣkṛtaṃ mayā || 32.6 || caturthyantaṃ cakrapadamudgīthādi prayojayet | anantaraṃ sūryapadaṃ tadvibhakte ca tatpadam || 32.7 || pañcamaṃ ṣaṣṭhamapyaṅgaṃ padaṃ tattadvibhaktikam | uddhāryaṃ ca sāhasrādi jvālādhārādi pūrvakam || 32.8 || evamaṅgāni ṣaḍbrahmannuktāni gahanāni te | ahirbudhynomanordraṣṭā virāṭchandassudarśanaḥ || 32.9 || devatā munayaścātra pratyakṣaramathābjaja | vyāsaḥ kaṇvo nāradaśca vasiṣṭhaḥ paramo bhṛguḥ || 32.10 || atriṣṣaḍete draṣṭāraśchandāṃsyakṣaraśaśśṛṇu | uṣṇigbṛhatyau gāyatraṃ paṅtkiśca jagatī virāṭ || 32.11 || varṇāḥ kālāgnivarāṇābhāḥ kālāścaivahidevatāḥ | karayornyasya talayorubhayorakṣarāṇi ṣaṭ || 32.12 || prathamāntārṇaśiṣṭānāmaṅguṣṭhādiṣu parvasu | aṅgulīṣu kramādevamakṣaranyāsa īritaḥ || 32.13 || dehe ca mūrdhnicāsye ca hṛdaye guhyajānunoḥ | pādayornyasanīyāni kramānmantrākṣarāṇi ṣaṭ || 32.14 || śrīsudarśanagāyatrī maparāṃ na parājitām | vakṣyāmi tasyāścoddhāraḥ padaśaḥ kathyate'dhunā || 32.15 || udgīthādi caturthyantaṃ sudarśanapadaṃ tataḥ | vettiṃ luḍantamaparaṃ bahvarthaṃ pada mirayet || 32.16 || mahāpūrvaṃ cakrapadaṃ tadvibhakti rvibhūtijam | dhyāyantī padamuccārya pūrvavattiṅvibhūṣitam || 32.17 || tatpadaṃ cāsmadādeśo naḥ padaṃ ca dviśīrṣakam | prapūrvaṃ co dayāntaṃ ca padamityuddharenmanum || 32.18 || asya bījaṃ tu pūrvoktaṃ veditavyaṃ caturmukha | āśāsu daśasu sthāpya mantraṃ taccakramudrayā || 32.19 || tanmadhyesthitamātmānamagnijvālāparītavat | dhyāyet kṣitatale śuddhe sahasradalapaṅkaje || 32.20 || karṇikāyāṃ cakradharaṃ dvibhujaṃ vṛttalocanam | daṃṣṭrākarālavadanaṃ bhrukuṭīkuṭilekṣaṇam || 32.21 || mahodaraṃ mahākāyaṃ japākusamasannibham | karaṇḍamukuṭopetaṃ raktāmbaravibhūṣitam || 32.22 || dhārayantaṃ śikhāratne cakramekasamaprabham | nābhinemisamāyuktaṃ jvālāmaṇḍaladussaham || 32.23 || jvalat ṣaḍarasaṃyuktamayutārkasamaprabham | padmamevaṃ sthitaṃ dhāyettannābhau ca suvistṛte || 32.24 || cakrābhimānisaṃ devaṃ dvihastaṃ puruṣaṃsthitam | raktāmbaradharaṃ raktaṃ raktacandanapaṅkilam || 32.25 || karaṇḍamukuṭopetaṃ sarvākalpapariṣkṛtam | daṃṣṭrākarāvadanaṃ bhrukuṭīkuṭilānanam || 32.26 || udgirantaṃ hutavahaṃ kharaṇḍairmārutānukam | viṣphuliṅgān durviṣahānvisṛjantamanekaśaḥ || 32.27 || kāmarūpa sahasrebhyaḥ pralayāmbadanisvanam | tarjanaṃ vāmatarjanyā bibhrāṇaṃ dakṣiṇe kare || 32.28 || nipīḍitāṅgaliṃ śatruṃ praharanni vabhīṣaṇam | dahanniva ca netrābhyāṃ pibanniva mahodadhim || 32.29 || dhyātvaivamarcayedbhogairarghyādibhiratandritaḥ | siddhaye mantrarājasya puraścaryā yathoditā || 32.30 || deśe kāle ca mantrasya rūpaṃ saṅkhyā ca pūrvavat | khākakandaphalakṣīrasaktupiṇḍānna bhakṣaṇaḥ || 32.31 || toyaisparpaṇamagnau ca juhuyātsamidādibhiḥ | mandrassidhyati tasyaivaṃ kurvāṇasya yathāvidhi || 32.32 || siddhaiṃ ca sūcayatyasya svapne maṅgaladarśanam | prayuñjītatato mantraṃ śāntikādiṣu karmasu || 32.33 || ṣoḍaśastambhasaṃyuktaṃ kalpayedyāgaṇamaṇṭapam | sthāpayettatra vidhipatkumbhānāṃ pañcaviṃśatim || 32.34 || veṣṭitān sūtravastrādyai rdhānyarāśiṣu maṅgalān | eṣu dravyāṇi saṅgṛhya nyasetkamalasambhava || 32.35 || ghṛtamuṣṇodakaṃ ratnaṃ phaladoka manantaram | lohatoyaṃ marjānāmbho gandhāmbhaśācakṣatodakam || 32.36 || yapodakaṃ kramādheṣu kumbheṣu navasu kṣipet | pādyaṃ gulodakaṃ caiva dadhi cekṣurasaṃ tathā || 32.37 || arghyaṃ ca nālikerāmbhaḥ kṣīraṃ ca tadanantaram | sarvauṣadhibajalaṃ tadvadācāmaṃ maṅgalodakam || 32.38 || madhupūrvaṃ śāntivāri pañcagavyamanantaram | mūlodakaṃ kaṣāyāmbhaḥ pukṣpavāri caturmukha || 32.39 || dravyāṇye teṣu kumbheṣu bahiṣṭheṣu vinikṣipet | pratyekaṃ śatakṛtvaśca mandreṇai vābhimantrayet || 32.40 || kumbhe dravyāṇi nikṣipya cakrabjaṃ vartayettataḥ | tanmadhyemantrarājena yaṣṭavyaṃ tatsudarśanam || 32.41 || kuṇḍevṛtteca juhuyātsami dannādibhiḥ kramāt | hutvā niśāyāṃ mānunā prabhāte'rghyādibhiḥ kramāt || 32.42 || arcayitvā hetirājaṃ hutvāgnau samidādibhiḥ | bhūrjapatre likheccakraṃ nābhinemisamanvitam || 32.43 || ṣaḍaraṃ tatra pūrvādi kramāccaiva ṣaḍakṣaram | likhitvacchandasāmādi tanmadhyai sādhyanāma ca || 32.44 || hemasūcyālikheddravyairmiśritaiścandanādibhiḥ | candanadvayakāśmirarocanāguru mukhyakaiḥ || 32.45 || gandhadravyaissusaṃpiṣṭaiḥ paścāttāṃ bhūrjapatrikām | gulikāṃ kārayettāṃ ca śālitaṇḍularāśiṣu || 32.46 || adhivāsyā svahaṃ kumbhaissnāpayitvā yathāvidhi | bandhayettāṃ māturaṅgemandreṇānena mantravit || 32.47 || gulikābandhanenaiva muktorogādibhirnaraḥ | tejasvī bhavati kṣipraṃ tvacā mukto yathāragaḥ || 32.48 || jvalitasya bhavecchāntiḥ prasūnairnimbasambhavaiḥ | dūrvāṅkurāṃścūtadalaissiktairmadhupayoghṛtaiḥ || 32.49 || manunā juhuyādagnau saptarātramatantritaḥ | pratyehaṃ daśasāhasrasaṅkhyāyā rogisannidhau || 32.50 || abhiṣicya tathā kumbhai rogiṇaṃ cakravidyayā | badhvā ca gulikāṃ mantrīmocayejjvalitaṃ jvarāt || 32.51 || gobhūhiraṇyavastrādyairmantriṇaṃ toṣayettataḥ | brāhmaṇebhyo yathāśakti dadyādgokambalādikam || 32.52 || bhūtagrahi piśācādi pīḍitānāṃ tathā nṛṇām | śāntaye juhuyādagnau kiṃśukotthaissamicchataiḥ || 32.53 || triyahaṃ trisahasraiśca teṣāṃ badhvā śikhāṃ tataḥ | guggulūtthena dhūpena dhūpitān gṛhapīḍitān || 32.54 || tāḍayenmantrajaptena daṇḍena latayāpi vā | piśācādistato brūyānmuñchāmiti prapīḍitaḥ || 32.55 || śapathaṃ kārayitvātu śikhābandhaṃ ca mocayet | sthāpitaiḥ kalaśaiḥ paścānmantreṇa grahapīḍitam || 32.56 || snāpayedbandhayecchāpi gulikāmabhimantritām | tato vimucya terogāccheto vāgbhirupadravāt || 32.57 || tejasvī śatamāyuśca bhavenmantraprabhāvataḥ | nārīca durbhagā cakradhāraṇātsubhagā bhavet || 32.58 || vandhyā ca garbhiṇī sadyassuprasūssyādapapranūḥ | anṛtussyādṛtumatī vimukhā sumukhā bhavet || 32.59 || virahe saṅgatā bhartā bhavedacirakālataḥ | strīprasūḥ puṃprasūtiśca antanā stanamaṇḍitā || 32.60 || kumārapakṣipīḍādau bālānāṃ ca yathoditaiḥ | vidibhirmucyate duḥkhāllabhate cāyuruttamam || 32.61 || prāsādepi narendrasya brahmarakṣomukhairgṛhaiḥ | praveśe sati tanmadhye kumbhān ratnasamanvitān || 32.62 || sthāpayitvā yathāpūrvaṃ samidādyairatandritaḥ | mantreṇa juhuyānmantrī dvādaśāhan samāhitaḥ || 32.63 || pratyekaṃ daśasāhasrasaṅkhyāyā kamalāsana | tāmrapātre śilāyāṃ vā cakramālikhya tatpunaḥ || 32.64 || dhānyarāśiṣu saṃsthāpya niśāyāṃ prātarutthitaḥ | prāsādadvāri nikhaneddikṣu cāṣṭasu mudritam || 32.65 || prokṣayetkumbhutoyena gṛhaṃ sarvamaśeṣataḥ | palāyante grahassarve dūratassarvato mukhāḥ || 32.66 || tadraṣṭrepi na tiṣṭhanti sarvakālamasaṃśayam | prāsādavartinassarve jīvanti nirupadravāḥ || 32.67 || dhanadhānyasamṛddhiśca yathā dhanadavesmani | vastraśayyāsānādīnāṃ daṃśane mūṣikādibhiḥ || 32.68 || raktastrīdarśane vāpi keśānāṃ dahane tathā | akasmadgopurādīnāṃ dahane'śanipīḍite || 32.69 || niśi śakradhanurdarśe nivāte caityabhūruhaḥ | bhaṅge valmīkajanane dussvapne'nyatra tādṛśe || 32.70 || evamādau durnimittai śāntimetena kārayet | yajñavṛkṣasamidbhiśca homaḥ pūrvoktasaṅkhyayā || 32.71 || kuryācca śāntiṃ puṣṭyādikarmaṇā kamalāsana | kathyante tāni bahudhā nābhedaṃ yānti bhedataḥ || 32.72 || sarvābhyudayakarmāṇi caturaśreṣu kārayet | pauṣṭikaṃ padmakuṇḍeṣu śāntiṃ vṛtte sukhāvahaḥ || 32.73 || trikoṇe māraṇaṃ karma kuṇḍe cāpākṛtau punaḥ | uccāṭanaṃ yakṣakanyāsādhane koṇapañcake || 32.74 || ṣaḍaśre stambhanaṃ karma saptāśre mohanaṃ bhavet | vidveṣaṇaṃ navāśresyādaṣṭāśre māraṇaṃ vidhim || 32.75 || ekādaśāśre brahmādivaśīkaraṇamācaret | kuṇḍe daśāśre paśyādi devatātoṣaṇovidhiḥ || 32.76 || dvādaśāśreṣu puruṣaṃ vaikuṇṭhaṃ draṣṭumācaret | yonyākāre vivāhārthaṃ kanyārthaṃ kamalāsana || 32.77 || caturviṃśatyaṅgule syādvistārāyāmakalpanam | khātaṃ tāvadbhireva syātkuṇḍeṣu niyatiṃ śṛṇu || 32.78 || tadardhaṃ pādamathavā caturaṅgulameva vā | parito dvyaṅgulaṃ hitvā bahistisraśca vedikāḥ || 32.79 || kāryāstāsāṃ ca vistāraścaturaṅgulasaṃmitaḥ | tāvatye ponnatirbrahman kuṇḍasya dhanuṣaḥ punaḥ || 32.80 || aṅgulyā navatiṣṣaṭca jyā ca ṣaṭtriṃśadaṅgulā | śaṅkuṃ vidhāya tanmadhye daśāṅgulasamāyatam || 32.81 || bhrāmayetparitassūtraṃ kuṇḍaṃ tadvalayākṛtim | caturaśrasya kuṇṭasya vibhajetpañcadhā bhujam || 32.82 || dvau bhāgau bhujamekaṃ catriṃ śatpañcāthavā punaḥ | aṅgulīnāṃ bhavedeṣāṃ trikoṇāṅke bhujaḥ smṛtaḥ || 32.83 || kuṇḍe ṣaḍaśre ca bhujā aṣṭāṣṭaikādaśāṅgulāḥ | eko bhujaḥ pañcakoṇe viṃśatyaṅgulisaṃmitaḥ || 32.84 || saptāśre ca bhūjāyāmo yavaṣaṭkādhikaḥ punaḥ | tisraśca daśa cāṅgulyaḥ kuṇḍe tvaṣṭāśribhiryute || 32.85 || dvyadhikā daśa vā bhūmau daśāṃgulyaḥ prakīrtitāḥ | aṃgulyostu bhujāyāmo nalaskandāṃśa kīrtitaḥ || 32.86 || nāvāśrakuṇḍeṣu yavā pañcakoṇe bhujāyatiḥ | daśa cāṅgulayaḥ proktā daśāśre ca caturmukha || 32.87 || yavāḥ pañca bhujāyāmo nava cāṅgulayaḥ smṛtāḥ | ekādaśāśrekuṇḍe tu yavairaṣṭābhiranvitaḥ || 32.88 || aṣṭāvaṅgulayaḥ kuṇḍe dvādaśāśre bhujāyatiḥ | aṣṭādaśāṃgulā phroktā yonikuṇḍeṣu cāyatiḥ || 32.89 || aṣṭau ca catvāriṃśacca bhavedaṃgulayo'bjaja | gajoṣṭhasannibhā yoniryadvāśvatthadalopamā || 32.90 || kuṇḍā nyuktānyathedānīṃ śāntyādiḥ pratikalpyate | yatkuṇḍaṃ yasya kathitaṃ śāntyādestasya tadbhavet || 32.91 || aśvavāraṇaśālāsu cakrayantraṃ yathāvidhi | likhitvā tāmradārvādau niśāyāmadhivāsayet || 32.92 || sahaskarṛtaḥ kartapyo homaḥ kuṇḍe śubhe yataḥ | samidbhiryajña yogyābhiḥ sthāpayetkumbhamarcitam || 32.93 || atha prabhāte śālāyāṃ yantraṃ khanyānmahītale | prokṣayetkumbhatoyena gajānaśvān pṛthakpṛthak || 32.94 || saudarśanena mantreṇa puṇyāhaṃ pācayettathā | naśyanti vyādhayasteṣāṃ gajāśvānāṃ caturmukha || 32.95 || balaṃ syādadhikaṃ teṣāmiti saptāhamācaret | brāhmaṇebhyo dhanaṃ dadyā dyathāśakti ca dakṣiṇām || 32.96 || ūrjasvalamatho brahman gajāśvaṃjāyate bhṛśam | tathā ca pratyahaṃ homassyātsudarśanavidyayā || 32.97 || itthaṃ gomahiṣādīnāṃ rakṣāṃ kurvīta mandravit | purarakṣāmathabrahman pravakṣyāmi yathātatham || 32.98 || stambhaiṣṣoḍaśabhiryuktāṃ darbhamālā pariṣkṛtām | puramadhye prapāṃ kṛtvā juhuyātsarpiṣā punaḥ || 32.99 || pālāśībhissamidbhiśca dinānyekonaviṃśatiḥ | dikṣvāṣṭāsu tathā madhye purasya kamalāsana || 32.100 || khanyātsaudarśanaṃ yantraṃ sthāpayetkumbhamañjasā | toyena prokṣayedvidvānnagaraṃ cakravidyayā || 32.101 || ṛgbhiśca pāvamānībhiḥ praśastāryathākramam | puradvāreṣu saudheṣu maṇṭapeṣu mahībṛtām || 32.102 || sarvatra nikhanecchakraṃ juhuyā tsamidādibhiḥ | maraṇavyādhidurbhikṣajvarādivyādhayaḥ punaḥ || 32.103 || naśyanti balavantaśca bhavanti puravāsinaḥ | grāmamadhye tathā dikṣu vidikṣu caturāsana || 32.104 || śṛṅgāṭakeṣu sarveṣu nikhanedāyudhā dhipam | gṛhavetālarakṣāṃsi vyādha yaścajvarā dayaḥ || 32.105 || na bādhante puraṃ gramamapasmārādayastathā | na taskarabhayaṃ kiñchidakālamaraṇaṃ tathā || 32.106 || puruṣāyuṣavantassyurnarā dhānyadhanānvitāḥ | saubhāgyaṃ kāntirārogyaṃ tathā kulavipardhayaḥ || 32.107 || brahmavarcasa mityetadbrāhmaṇānāṃ bhaviṣyati | payasvinyo bhaviṣanti gāvaḥ pīnapayodharāḥ || 32.108 || tadrāṣṭreṣu manuṣyāṇāṃ bhadrameva bhaviṣyati | atha vakṣyāmi te brahman pannagānāṃ nivāraṇam || 32.109 || devālaye nadītīre nandanopavaneṣu vā | catustambhasamāyuktaṃ catustoraṇabhūṣitam || 32.110 || abhito darbhamālābhiśśobhitaṃ homa maṇḍalam | kṛtvā tasmi nnapāṃ kumbhān sthāpayitvā navāparān || 32.111 || prācyāṃ vedyāṃ punaḥ kuryātkuṇḍaṃ pūrvoktalakṣaṇam | yajedeteṣu kumbheṣu nava mūrtiryajetkramāt || 32.112 || nivedya pāyasaṃ tebhyaḥ paścātkuṇḍe hutāśanam | ādadītātha tāmreṇa tālamātraṃ bhujaṅgamam || 32.113 || prakalpya śeṣamantreṇa pratiṣṭāpya pitāmaha | tasmiṃścakraṃ likhettasya madhye matsyākṛtiṃ punaḥ || 32.114 || garuḍaṃ śaṅkhapālaṃ ca kṛṣṇamantraṃ ca veṣṭanam | tannāgayantraṃ kṣīreṇa ghṛtena madhunāpi ca || 32.115 || dadhnā śakṛdrasenāpi snāpayeccakravidyayā | puṣpagandhapradīpādyairupacāraistathāparaiḥ || 32.116 || iṣṭvā nāgaṃ svamantreṇa cakraṃ cakrasya vidyayā | kuṇḍamadhye punarnāgayantraṃ khanyādvicakṣaṇaḥ || 32.117 || tasya cottānarūpasya hutāśa muparisthitam | kṛtvā dadhnā ghṛtenāpi payasā madhunāpi vā || 32.118 || samidbhirbrahma vṛkṣasya juhuyānmantrakovidaḥ | sahasrakṛtvaḥ pratyekamatha gopayasokṣitaiḥ || 32.119 || nīvārabhāgaissaptāhaṃ juhuyādayutairapi | apo nastvitimantreṇa juhuyātsādhakottamaḥ || 32.120 || triṣvahassu vyatīteṣu parjanyo meghavāhanaḥ | dvāvayedavanīṃ kṛtsnāṃ bhūyopi salilodayaiḥ || 32.121 || ativṛṣṭi praśamanaṃ pravakṣyāmi caturmukha | viṅgalākāramātmānaṃ dhyātvā piyīṣabhāvitam || 32.122 || śūlavajra dharaṃ cāpi mantravi nmantrabhūṣaṇam | tailājyasiktai rjuhuyāllājanarṣapalāvaṇaiḥ || 32.123 || juhuyājjvalite vahnāvayutaṃ saptasāgarāt | vṛṣṭiśabdaṃ puraskṛtya stambhayeti padadvayam || 32.124 || prayoktavyamidaṃ brahmanmantrānte mandravedinā | atha śāmyati sā vṛṣṭirmahatī cakravidyayā || 32.125 || atha rāṣṭrapurādīnāṃ kṣobhaśāntiṃ tathā śṛṇu | akṣarāṣṭhagataṃ cakraṃ pratiṣṭhāpya yathāvidhi || 32.126 || pure rāṣṭre tathā khanyāttatkāṣṭhairjuhuyāttathā | sahasā kṣobhamāyānti vājivāraṇasaṃkulam || 32.127 || rāṣṭraṃ ca kṣubhitaṃ brahmannanavasthaṃ bhaviṣyati | yati śāntau matiṃ kuryāccakramudvāsya tatpunaḥ || 32.128 || snāpayedbhagavantaṃ ca sahaśrakalaśāmbabhiḥ | jhaḍityeva praśāntaṃ pyādduritaṃ purarāṣṭrayoḥ || 32.129 || rāṣṭrādilambhanaṃ te'dya pravakṣyāmi caturmukha | upetaṃ dalaṣaṭkoṇe karṇikākesarānvitam || 32.130 || cakrābjaṃ kārayedbhūmau medhyāyāṃ kamalāsana | tadbahirnābhivalayaṃ ṣaḍaraṃ tadbhahirlikhet || 32.131 || tadbahirnemivalaṃya jvālāmālā samanvitam | tadbahiḥ kalpayetpīṭhaṃ caturdvāra pariṣkṛtam || 32.132 || śobhopaśobhayuktaṃ ca kṛtvā maṇḍalamidṛśam | tasmin sudarśanaṃ brahman pūjayitvā yathāvidhi || 32.133 || samidbhirannai rāṅyaiścha hutvā mantraṃ prasīdatu | śṛṅge cakraṃ deharāṣṭraṃ deharāṣṭraṃ tathā dhanam || 32.134 || ityetāṃ pāvanīṃ gādhāṃ japānte prārthayanpaṭhet | atha tasya puraṃ rāṣṭraṃ grāmaṃ cakraṃ prayacchati || 32.135 || atha prabhaṣṭarājyānāṃ manujānāṃ yathā śriyaḥ | tathā vakṣyāmite brahmannuvāyaṃ cakravidyayā || 32.136 || antasthitasya padmasya syātpalāśacatuṣṭayam | athāṣṭau dvādaśa brahman ṣoḍaśātha catuṣṭayam || 32.137 || viṃśatiśca tathā triṃśaddvau krameṇa bahiśchadāḥ | iti ṣaḍvidha patrasya karṇikāyāṃ sudarśanam || 32.138 || yeṣvatho ṣaṭprakāreṣu palāśeṣu yathākramam | mūrtīścatasraḥ prathamaṃ tathāṣṭau dvyadhikā daśa || 32.139 || ṣoḍaśātha sahasraṃ ca viṃśatiśca pitāmaha | atha dvātriṃśatiṃ paścādantarāleṣu ṣaṭ svapi || 32.140 || yathākramaṃ bhūṣaṇāni śrīvatsaprabhṛtīnyatha | aṣṭau śaktīśśriyā sārdhaṃ cakrādiṃ homa maṇḍalam || 32.141 || kavīn saptādhikān pañca kumudādīnanantaram | indrādīnatha dikpālān pūjayenmantrakalpavit || 32.142 || samidbhirbhilvarūpābhistalaiḥ padmaistathā ghṛtaiḥ | sahasrakṛtvaḥ pratyekaṃ juhuyāccakravidyayā || 32.143 || itthaṃ gate saptarātre prātarutthāya mantravit | sthāpitaiḥ pañcaviṃśatyā kumbhaiśśālikṛtāsanaiḥ || 32.144 || ghṛtādipūritairbrahman cakravidyābhimantritaiḥ | rājyabhraṣṭaṃ mantrahīnaṃ danyubhiḥ paripīḍitam || 32.145 || rājānaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ vaiśyaṃ tathānyaṃ duritāhatam | abhiṣiṃcet smaran cakraṃ tanmantreṇa vidhānavit || 32.146 || tathā prakalpayetyantraṃ dāpayeddakṣiṇāṃ guroḥ | itthaṃ kṛte caturviktrasaubhāgyaṃ rājyalambhanam || 32.147 || dasyunāśo bhavedbhadraṃ syātsudarśanatejasā | ādāvante tathā brahman haṃsamantravatā punaḥ || 32.148 || nāśayeccakramantreṇa viṣaṃ sthāparajaṅgamam | atha saṅgrāmavijayaṃ vakṣyāmi kamalāsana || 32.149 || kṛpāṇe torame śaktau śareṣu valaye tathā | āyudheṣu tathānyeṣu lalāṭe vājihastinām || 32.150 || tathā dvaja paṭhānteṣu likhitvācakramaṇḍalam | praviśya samaraṃ bhīmaṃ ripūṇāṃ romaharṣaṇam || 32.151 || heṣitena turaṅgāṇāṃ bṛhmitena viṣāṇinām | harṣanādena yodhānāṃ rathanemisvanaistathā || 32.152 || turaṅgama khurakṣuṇḍaiḥ pārthivaiḥ pāṃsumaṇḍalaiḥ | tirohitanabhassūryaṃ kṛtāntasadanopamam || 32.153 || rudhirāsrāva saṃbhrāntaṃ vetālamithunodyatam | māṃsasaṅgrāha ṇoḍḍīnasahasraśyenasaṅkulam || 32.154 || jvālāmālāmayaṃ cakraṃ dhyāyan jitvā ripūnapi | akṣanāgapraharaṇairniṣkṛyetpṛtanāmukham || 32.155 || atha vā rājyasīmāsu śaṅkān khadirasambhavān | sthāpayeccakramentreṇa hutaśiṣṭaghṛtokṣitān || 32.156 || agniprakārarūpastena śakyaṃ prekṣituṃ paraiḥ | praveśe kampanaṃ brahman brahmavidyā prabhāvataḥ || 32.157 || yatra yatra bhayaṃ puṃsāṃ tatra tatrābhayaṃ bhavet | cakramadhyastamātmānaṃ dhyāyantaṃ kupitātmanaḥ || 32.158 || parvatārohaṇe'raṇye sāgaraplavanādiṣu | vyāghrasiṃhavarāhādi sannipātaiḥ khile pathi || 32.159 || gacchanna bhayamāpnoti cakramantramimaṃ japan | taṃ nacchindanti śastrāṇi na taṃ dahati pāpakaḥ || 32.160 || na cainaṃ kledayantyāpo yasyaiṣa hṛdaye manuḥ | brāhmaṇakṣatravaiśyānāṃ śūdrāṇāṃ kamalāsana || 32.161 || pratilomānulomānāṃ kuryātsaṃ vanasaṃ punaḥ | samidbhirbrahmavṛkṣāṇāmaśvatthavaṭavṛkṣayoḥ || 32.162 || plakṣodumbarajātīnā mapavargasya pāpake | homaṃ kuryādyathāsaṅkhyaṃ tathā tajjātiyoṣitām || 32.163 || brāhmaṇaśśriyamāpnoti homena śvetapaṅkajaiḥ | raktapadmairnarendrasya vaiśyasya śvetapāṭalaiḥ || 32.164 || śrīphalairāhutiṃ kurvan rāṣṭrasyādhipatirbhavet | aṅgena nyastamantreṇa yāṃ spṛśedaṅganāṃ naraḥ || 32.165 || tasya sā vaśamāyāti mṛtaṃ cāpyanugacchati | apamṛtyujayaṃ vakṣye yathātadavadhāraya || 32.166 || homaśālāgate kuṇḍe samya gādhāya paṅkajam | tasminnāvāhya deveśaṃ dūrvākāṇḍairyathokṣitaiḥ || 32.167 || juhuyātkoṭibhirmantrairyathāśaktyathavā punaḥ | iti māsadvayaṃ rakṣetpāvakaṃ niyatendhriyaḥ || 32.168 || homānte yadi bhūpālastulārohaṇamācaret | anyaścedātmanoyatsvaṃ dadyādbrāhmaṇasātprati || 32.169 || kalaśaiḥ pañcaviṃśatyā snāpayeccakravidyayā | evaṃ kṛte caturvaktra kālamṛtyuṃ jayennaraḥ || 32.170 || apamṛtyuḥ kathaṃ tasya tajjaye nāsti saṃśayaḥ| athavā kālamṛtyośca jayo pāyo'pagamyatām || 32.171 || niṣṭaissahasrasaṅkhyātaiḥ pratikṛtya pitāmaha | dvibhujaṃ puruṣākāraṃ bhrukuṭīkuṭilekṣaṇam || 32.172 || daṃṣṭrākarālavadanaṃ varāharudhirekṣaṇam | yaṣṭiṃ kareṇa savyena pāśaṃ vāmena bibhratam || 32.173 || prakṣālya pañcabhirgavaiḥ pañcopaniṣadā tathā | navakairabhiṣicyātha dhānyarāśiṣu nikṣipet || 32.174 || āvāhya paścādvyāhṛtyā pūjayitvāsvanāmabhiḥ | homamagnau prakurvīta samiccarughṛtairapi || 32.175 || ṛgbhiḥ kṛtā ntaliṅgābhirbrahman vyāhṛtibhi stathā | tataḥ prabhāte viprāya taṃ pumāṃsaṃ hiraṇmayam || 32.176 || pūtāya bhagavadbhaktyā pañcakālānuvartine | dāpayetkāla mṛtyuṃ ca jitvāsyātprāyaṣaṃ padam || 32.177 || atha māraṇametarhi śrūyitāṃ caturāsana | vivikte kalpayeddeśe homaśālāṃ vidhānavit || 32.178 || tanmadhye kalpayetkuṇṭacāryo dakṣimāṇāmukhaḥ | gṛhītvākṣasya phalakāṃ hastadvayasamāyatām || 32.179 || tadardhavistrṛtāṃ brahman ghanaṃ ca caturaṅgalam | tasyā likhitvā dveṣyasya vapuḥ pratyakṣasaṃmitam || 32.180 || pratikūle'tha nakṣatre riporaṣṭamarāśiṣu | kṛṣṇapakṣe viśeṣeṇa prakuryānmaraṇakriyām || 32.181 || prācyāṃ bhāge'tha kuṇḍasya ṣaḍaraṃ cakramālikhet | kṛṣṇasūtreralaṅkṛtya tasmin cakraṃ pratiṣṭhitam || 32.182 || kṛṣṇagandhaiḥ kṛṣṇapuṣpaiḥ pūjayet kṛṣṇavāribhiḥ | śmaśānādvā sunilayādvalmīkānmṛdamāharet || 32.183 || tāṃ ripoḥ pādadhūlībhirvyāmiśrāṃ kamalāsana | unmattarasamiśreṇa kharamūtreṇa peṣayet || 32.184 || viṣṭhayā vā mṛdā vāpi dveṣyasya pratiyātanām | tasyāṃ prāṇān pratiṣṭhāpya mantreṇānena mantravit || 32.185 || udgīthamaprameyaṃ ca mandaraṃ bhuvanaṃ tathā | krodhānilau paścimāsyaṃ hutāśaṃ madhusūdanam || 32.186 || pracaṇḍagopanau rāmaṃ bhāskaraṃ paścimānanam | namadhyaṃ gopanadvandvamamuṣyeti padaṃ punaḥ || 32.187 || jīvā iha sthitā śabdaṃ viṣṇudakṣodayāṃ stathā | krodharūpaṃ tapasyantaṃ sarvaśabdamanantaram || 32.188 || vikramaṃ vighnarājātrivahni bandhū ca gopanam | vanamālādharaṃ rāmaṃ pāṅmanaḥ kāya ityapi || 32.189 || atha māyā tṛtīyāntaṃ loḍantaṃ yāni yanmukham | svāhāvasānamuddhṛtya praṇavāntānikaṃ manum || 32.190 || tāṃ ca prāṇavatīṃ kuṇḍe khanyāmattānaśāyinīm | phalakāsthitamākāmanu lipya pātāmaha || 32.191 || pūrvoktayā mṛdā paścātprāṇinaṃ prāṇavidyayā | pādenākrāntahṛdayo roṣalohitalocanaḥ || 32.192 || sahasrakṛtvaścakrasya mantraṃ bhāṣeta mantravit | vṛṣavṛkṣaprarūḍhena śaṅkunā netrayorhṛdi || 32.193 || hastayoḥ pādayorguhyeśrotrayornāsikodare | anyeṣvapi pratīkeṣu vadhaṃ kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥ || 32.194 || tathā kṛte ripo statadgātraṃ hīnaṃ bhaviṣyati | atha kuṇḍeśmaśānāgniṃ nidadhīta pitāmaha || 32.195 || darbhaiḥ paristare dvedvāṃ dakṣiṇāpaścimonmukhān | paridhiṃ tadvadākīrya kṛtvā rākṣāṃ tathātmanaḥ || 32.196 || ṛtvigbhiṣṣoḍaśoddiṣṭairdvāreṣvadhyayane kṛte | brāhmaṇebhyo dhanaṃ datvā hetirājamanusmaran || 32.197 || akṣakāṣṭhapraklṛptābhyāṃ sruksruvābhyāṃ yathāvidhi | kṛṣṇapannagarājīva kṛṣṇotu kṣatajokṣitaiḥ || 32.198 || marīcaissarṣapai ryuktānaṣṭadhānyāṣṭadhānvitān | samidho'kṣasya juhuyātsahasraṃ prativāsaram || 32.199 || ripunakṣatra vṛkṣāṇāṃ samidhaśchāpi mantravit | mantrānte śatrunāmānaṃ mārayeti prakīrtayet || 32.200 || hotavyaṃ cāvamānena homaṃ kṛtvā dine dine | yāvadbhavati kṛtyāyā darśanaṃ jātavedasi || 32.201 || krameṇatāvajju huyādvāsarāvekaviṃśatim | phalakāmapi vedasthāṃ homadhūpena dhūpayet || 32.202 || aguruṃ guggulaṃ cāpi dhūpārtha manale dahet | atha saptasvatīteṣu divaseṣu pitāmaha || 32.203 || saptasvahassu madhye ca yathākramanumi jvarāḥ | ākrośo vedanā tīvrā gātrāṇāmavidheyatā || 32.204 || hikkā niśvāsavicchedo jihvāhānistathāripoḥ | bhavantihi prabhāvena cakramantrasya niścitam || 32.205 || iti dvisaptake'tīte divase'nantare punaḥ | madhyaretre kṛte home kṛtyā tasmādvibhāvasoḥ || 32.206 || triśūlabhīṣaṇairhastai ssaptabhistribhiraṅghribhiḥ | jihvayā raktavarṣiṇyā lelihānā nijaṃ mukham || 32.207 || udgirantī svanetrābhyāmājvasiktaṃ havirbhujam | narāsthimālāṃ bibhrāṇā purītatkatamekhalā || 32.208 || kapolakuṇḍalopetā prahasantī bhayānakam | daṇḍaṃ ghaṇṭāṃ tathā śūrpaṃ mārjanīṃ pāśamaṇḍalam || 32.209 || bibhratī lambamānābhyāṃ hastābhyāṃ muktamūrdhajā | adhirūḍhāparaskandhamandhakāranibhākṛtiḥ || 32.210 || sphuliṅgamaṇḍalastheva vimuktāṭopabhīṣaṇā | utthāya prāñjalirbhūtvā kiṃkaromiti bhāṣate || 32. 211 || abhidhāsyatyathācāryaḥ prāṇān hara riporiti | ādiṣṭā sā tathetyuktvā ripuṃ tasya mahātmanaḥ || 32.212 || api dūrasthitaṃ hatvā guruṃ punarupaiṣyati | atha pūrṇāhuṃtiṃ hutvā hotṛbhissaha mantravit || 32.213 || dvāviṃśe divaselakṣaṃ ṣaḍakṣaramimaṃ japet | tathāparājitaṃ mantraṃ nārasihmamanuṃ tathā || 32.214 || ghṛtādipūritaiḥ kumbhairviṃśatyā pañcabhiḥ punaḥ | ātmābhiṣekaṃ kurvīta cakramantrābhimantritaiḥ || 32.215 || enaso mucyate tasmāttathā śāntirbhaviṣyati | uccāṭanaṃ pravakṣyāmi yathāvatkamalāsana || 32.216 || nimbaduttūrapratrāṇāṃ śmaśānāṅgāramiśritaiḥ | rasairakṣasya kāṣṭhena dvihaste pretavāsasi || 32.217 || ṣaṭkoṇe nābhinemyajke maṇḍale kramaśolikhet | nāmadheyaṃ riporantaḥ procyayāme tha paścime || 32.218 || yakāraṃ bhuvanaṃ brahman jhakāraṃ bhuvanaṃ tathā | śiṣṭeṣu triṣu koṇeṣu tathoṣṭe maṇḍalādayaḥ || 32.219 || tadārūḍhaṃ ripuṃ cāpi kuṇaaḍe cāpākṛtau punaḥ | samidbhirniṃbavṛkṣasya tathā ca viṣabhūruhaḥ || 32.220 || juhuyādabhito vahnāvamṛtaṃ ploṣayan ripum | yatra dhvajaṃ taṃ badhnī yāducchrite caityapādape || 32.221 || ahobhirekaviṃśatyā ripustasya mahānapi | adhiṣṭānaṃ nijaṃ hitvā bhāryāputrādibhissaha || 32.222 || palāyate diganteṣu na kvacillabhate sthitim | atha vidveṣaṇaṃ brahman yathāvadavadhāraya || 32.223 || akṣapādapakāṣṭhena snigdhayorākṛtidvayoḥ | kṛtvā tayorlikhenmantraṃ nāmadheyaṃ tayorapi || 32.224 || vidveṣaya padopeta masṛjādhyāṅkṣa kārayoḥ | ākhumārjārayorbrahman tathā sarvamayūrayoḥ || 32.225 || tathānyeṣāṃ viruddhānāṃ tiraścāṃ pakṣiṇāmapi | niba dhya rajjumāyāmāṃ mūrdhajairmahiṣāśvayoḥ || 32.226 || tathā te akṛtī badhvā vyastayostukṛtaṃ mukham | apidadhyāttayorāsyaṃ japenmantraṃ ṣaḍakṣaram || 32.227 || kuṇḍe ca homaṃ kurvīta samidbhi rmṛtyubandhayoḥ | aṣṭottarasahasreṇa huyādagnau sudarśanam || 32.228 || yudhyeta snigdhayordvandvaṃ kākolūkādisaṃmitam | itthaṃ daśa svatīteṣu divaseṣu sa mantravit || 32.229 || apākṛṣyati dampatyo mamatvaṃ mitrayorapi | kṣīraisnāyāttayorbhūyaḥ prītarbhavati pūrvavat || 32.230 || athābhidhīyate brahman stambhanaṃ taṃ niśamyatām | śilātale likhitvātha catuṣkoṇa catuṣṭayam || 32.231 || teṣu pratyekamālikhya patrairdivyaiḥ pitāmaha | gṛhaṃ vāmanamantraṃ tamindukāntacatuṣṭayam || 32.232 || vajrāṅkamapi puṣpaistatpūjayetkanakaprabham | sthāpayitvā sthaṇḍile'sminnāsitvā mantramirayet || 32.233 || stambhayeti padaṃ cāpi juhuyādarkakhaṇḍikāḥ | stambhanaṃ syāt jhaḍityevaṃ vivāhe garbhalābhake || 32.234 || vādajalpavitaṇḍāsu kathāsvapi ca vādinām | vakṣyāmi skhalanaṃ brahman likhitvā pratiyātanām || 32.235 || dveṣyasyālayavaistalyā gomayāṅgāramiśritaiḥ | tadaṅgeṣu likhenmantraṃ tadbījena samanvitam || 32.236 || atha syācchaktihīnaṃ tu matidveṣasya dehinaḥ | atha te tāḍanaṃ vakṣye duttūrahayamārayoḥ || 32.237 || arkasya ca rase brahman śmaśānāṅgāramiśritaiḥ | likhetpratikṛtiṃ bilva kāṣṭhe pretasya vāsani || 32.238 || saṅkhakīlamathādhāya caturaṅgulasaṃmitam | aṅgāni tāḍaye ttasya tena kīlena mantravit || 32.239 || ṣaḍakṣarasya kurvīta nityaṃ japa matandritaḥ | dhanādihānistasya syānnyaste dveṣṭi sa mantravit || 32.240 || vaśīkāramahaṃ brahman bhūpatīnāṃ bravīmite | kuṣṭhakuṅgumasiddhārdhakarpūrāgurucandanaiḥ || 32.241 || gorocanānvitaiścāpi kusumbharajasā saha | bhūrjapatre likheccakraṃ ṣaḍareṣu ṣaḍakṣaram || 32.242 || tadbahirdvādaśāraṃ ca nābhinemisamanvitam | dvādaśākṣaramālikhya dvādaśāraṃ tato bahiḥ || 32.243 || aṣṭākṣareṇa mantreṇa haṃsamantreṇa cānvitam | tadbahirdvādaśajvālaṃ pāśāṅkuśamanudvayam || 32.244 || sādhyasya nāmadheyena praṇavenāntarāṅkitam | ābhiṣṣoḍaśabhirbrahman vidarbhitamanantaram || 32.245 || tadetadgulikāṃ kṛtvā padmasūtreṇa veṣṭitām | cakrābje vā sitāṃ kṛtvā pūjitāṃ kusumādibhiḥ || 32.246 || homaṃ padmākṛtaukuṇḍekṛtvā kusumasarpiṣā | dvādaśāhānikṛtvaivaṃ maṅgālyādīni sādhayet || 32.247 || rājadayo mukhaṃ tasya prekṣantevivaśā iva | tasya dūrātpalāyante kūśmāṇḍapramukhā grahāḥ || 32.248 || rasādala praveśaṃ te kathayāmi caturmukha | bilvadāruṃ samāsādya kusumbharajasā sudhīḥ || 32.249 || likhitvā ṣaḍaraṃ cakraṃ bahistasyātha mantravit | yathopadeśaṃ pātālaṃ pannagāsurasaṅkulam || 32.250 || likhetkṛtvā punaḥ kuṇḍaṃ tasminnādhāya pāvakam | juhuyānna ramāṃsena japenmantraṃ ca sarvaśaḥ || 32.251 || dvādaśāhena te paścātpāpālatalasaṃśrayāḥ | upasthāsyanti taṃ bhītā yuvatyaḥ kāmapīḍitāḥ || 32.252 || taṃ grahiṣyanti bhartāramahaṃ purvaṃ śucismitāḥ | pāṇibhirlolavalayaiḥ kāmayānāḥ priyaṃvadāḥ || 32.253 || rasāyanādi dāsyanti tasmai pātālavartine | tadbhakṣaṇena dīrghāyustābhissaha yathepsitam || 32.254 || raṃsyate ramyadeśeṣu yatra vā jāyate ruciḥ | khaḍgasya sādhanaṃ brahmannidānīṃ kathayāmite || 32.255 || aśvatthapatrā ntaritaṃ khaḍgaṃ śāstroktalakṣaṇam | spṛṣṭvā ṣaḍakṣaraṃ mantraṃ japeddhyātvā sudarśanam || 32.256 || atha khaḍgasya tāpasyātsayakṣyādīni jeṣyate | tasmin dhūmāyamāne tu gandharvādhipatirbhavet || 32.257 || tasmin jvālāmukhe brahman vidyādharapatirbhavet | gṛhītvā taṃ punaḥ khaḍgaṃ yatheṣṭaṃ lokamāpnuyāt || 32.258 || gomayenopalipte'tha śūnyāgāre pitāmaha | cakraṃ likhitvā sumanāssitapuṣpauralaṃkṛtam || 32.259 || vraṇahīnaṃ śavaṃ tasmin brāhmaṇasya nṛpasya vā | prācīna śirasaṃ kṛtvā māhiṣena ghṛtena tam || 32.260 || pādayormantravillimpedasahāyo'pramattadhīḥ | tadvakṣasi padaṃ kṛtvā mantrarājamidaṃ japet || 32.261 || pratyahaṃ juhuyādagnau samidbhi rvetrabhūruhaḥ | kṛte saṅkhyaṃ japenmantraṃ janahomaiḥ pitāmaha || 32.262 || utthāsyati śavaḥ prāṇī niśīthe kalpitāñjaliḥ | satasmai mandrasiddhāya vakti divyaṃ rasāyanam || 32.263 || pādukāmañjanaṃ khaḍgaṃ pradāsyati yathepsitam | yadidaṃ tena khaḍgena hatvā śnīyāttadāmiṣam || 32.264 || trailokya viṣayaṃ jñānaṃ lapsyate caturāsana | valīpalitahīnatvamamaratvaṃ ca setsyati || 32.265 || nidhānānyapi gūḍhāni pratyakṣamiva paśyati | rasaṃ vimṛjya pāṣāṇe likheccakraṃ ṣaḍakṣaram || 32.266 || rasaṃ nidhāya mūṣāyāṃ badhvādravyairyathocitaiḥ | kṛtvābhimantritraṃbrahman cakramantreṇa kalpavit || 32.267 || upayuñjīta medhāvī japeccāpi ṣaḍakṣaram | ārogyaṃ balamaiśvaryaṃ kālamṛtyuvyatikramam || 32.268 || vāgmitvaṃ buddhimatvaṃ ca rūpasaṃvananaṃ vayaḥ | sabhasthale gatiścāpi sākṣādiva garutmataḥ || 32.269 || ityādayo guṇāstasya bhaviṣyantina saṃśayaḥ | yathā na pādakhedassyāddūraṃ gatvāpi tacchruṇu || 32.270 || kākajaṅghāmupādāya kokilekṣaṇasaṃhitām | balāṃ moṭārasaisteṣāṃ saऱpuṅkharasānvitaiḥ || 32.271 || sarṣapasnehaṃsamiśraiścakramāntrābhimantritaiḥ | liptvā pādayutaṃ cakraṃ kṛtvāraṇyamahāpathe || 32.272 || yojanānāṃ sahasre dve na khedaṃ samavāpnuyāt | yakṣīsiddhiṃ pravakṣyāmi tāṃ likhet kṣauma pāsasi || 32.273 || nya grodhamāle tāṃ dhyātvā yakṣīvidyāṃ japedbadhaḥ | ārādhya guggulūtthena dhūpena kamalāsana || 32.274 || samidbhirvaṭavṛkṣasya tathāśoka karañjayoḥ | raktapadmaistilaiścāpi juhuyājjātavedasi || 32.275 || ekaviṃśati rātrānte kampate sa vaṭo muhuḥ | dṛḍhabuddhiḥ punaścāpi mantramevaṃ japedbudhaḥ || 32.276 || atha pratyakṣarūpā sā yakṣī kalyāṇalakṣaṇā | snigdheva jananī siddhiṃ tasmai datvā yathepsitām || 32.277 || amunaiva vidhānena yakṣā vaiśravaṇādayaḥ | pratyakṣabhūtā dāsyanti sādhakena vṛtaṃ varaṃ || 32.278 || yathā yathā'dhiko homo jape vā kamalodbhava | amuṣya cakramantrasya pañcakoṭiryathottaram || 32.279 || tathā tathā padānyetā nyavadhūyeta kilbiṣam | ādityānāṃ saśāṅkasya vasūnāṃ marutāmapi || 32.280 || aśvinorvāsavasyāpi manvādīnāṃ tapasvinām | rudrāṇāṃ brahmaṇaścāpi cakramantrasya vaibhāvta || 32.281 || sahasra koṭisaṅkhyena homena ca japena ca | tapasā cātitīvreṇa labhate vaiṣṇavaṃ padam || 32.282 || kiṃ bhūyasā pralāpena yatreṣṭaṃ yadbhaviṣyati | sa tena tena labhate pāpe bhyopi pramucyate || 32.283 || ityetatkathito brahman ṣaḍakṣaramahāmanoḥ | kalāssaṃgraharūpeṇa rahasyassarvasiddhidaḥ || 32.284 || iti śrīpāñcarātre mahopanidi pādmetantre caryāpāde sudarśanamahāmantra vaibhavo nāma dvātriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ |
<4.33>
brahmā athaupacārikān mantrān śuśrūṣe bhagavannaham | prayujyamānairyaiḥ prītirmahatī te bhaviṣyati || 33.1 || śrībhagavān brahmannārādhanāṅgāni mantrāṇyavahitaśśṛṇu | yāni śrutyantabhāgeṣu śṛṇvanti brahmavādinaḥ || 33.2 || brahmakośaṃ puraskṛtya kakubhaṃ brahmamastakam | vairājaṃ devaraṃ paścādekanetramṛgeśvarau || 33.3 || pavitrabhuvanau cāpi brahman caṇḍavanālayau | hutāśa vāmanau padmāgopanau vinatātmajam || 33.4 || vighneśaṃ mandaraṃ kāntaṃ kalātmā ca jayājayau | pīyūṣarāmau śrīkumbhau sūkṣmaṃ gopanapaścimau || 33.5 || varuṇaṃ bhadrahastāntaṃ vighneśaṃ pāṭalapriyam | aniruddhaṃ jayeṇeśau śuklaṃ jayamathodayam || 33.6 || bhāsvantamṛtadhāmānaṃ śatrudāhakavāmanau | padmādidevau śrīvatsaṃ dakṣaṃ bhāskaragopanau || 33.7 || pavitra bhuvanau vahnibhuvanau śatrudāhakam | paścimāsyaṃ makāraṃ ca hutāśanasudhārasau || 33.8 || antimaṃ kakubhaṃ kṛtvā jitantāmanumirayet | bhānuviṣṇudhruvaṃ bījaṃ brahmannetasya kalpayet || 33.9 || aṅgānyapyamunā kuryādṛṣissanake ucyate | chandho'nuṣṭuptathaitasya devatā puruṣottamaḥ || 33.10 || japo'mbutarpaṇaṃ homaṃ kṛtaṃ ṣoḍaśalakṣavat | dharmārthakāmamokṣārthān puṃsāṃ sarvaṃ prayacchati || 33.11 || pañcopaniṣadāṃ mantrānatha te katha yāmyaham | parameṣṭhī pumān viśvo nivṛttassarva eva hi || 33.12 || āmnāyādiṃ krodharūpaṃ saṅkarṣaṇagajānam | dakṣāniruddhau pāpaghna vahnigopanamārutān || 33.13 || pavitrapāpakau dakṣamādhavau padmasambhava | krodhakaustubha saṅkhādyairgopanaṃ jayamandarau || 33.14 || vighneśamādhavau cānte parameṣṭinamirayet | ṛṣirādityanāmāsya cchando gāyatra mucyate || 33.15 || devatā ca sadā viṣṇu rjapeddhvādaśalakṣavān | prathamaṃ praṇavaṃ kṛtvā dhūliketana govanau || 33.16 || vighneśa dvitayaṃ dakṣakalāntau paścimānanam | vahnyedidevau śaṅkhākhyaṃ paścimaṃ bhuvanaṃ tathā || 33.17 || pāvakaṃ bhuvanaṃ paścāccakraṃ dāhakagopanau | jayadakṣau bhadrapāṇī devadattau tathā ntimau || 33.18 || ityevaṃ pauruṣaṃ mantramirayenmantrakovidaḥ | ṛṣiṃ nāradamasyāhuśchando gāyatramīritam || 33.19 || devatā vāsudevaścha śṛṇu viśvamataḥ param | tārāgnigopanau dakṣabhadrapāṇī kalāntimau || 33.20 || pavitravahnyādidevān śaṅkhaṃ varuṇavikramau | śrīvatsakuṃbhau vijayamandarau vighnamādhavau || 33.21 || itīrito viśvamantraḥ punardraṣṭā bhṛgurmanoḥ | chando gāyatrametasya vācyassaṅkarṣaṇābhidhaḥ || 33.22 || udgīthakumbhādidevau vighneśadvayamastakam | mandaraṃ varuṇaṃ pāpahananaṃ vahnigopanau || 33.23 || vāyuṃ vighneśvaraṃ rāmaṃ pīyūṣaṃ vasumastakam | ekanetraṃ vāyumādidevān vairājamandarau || 33.24 || manuṣyeśaṃ mṛgeśānaṃ nivṛttimanurīritaḥ | ṛṣistu nāradaśchando gāyatraṃ pūrvamīritam || 33.25 || pradyumno devatā'nena nivṛttiṃ labhate pumān | praṇavaṃ pītavarṇābhaṃ gopanaṃ mānuṣeśvaram || 33.26 || mādhavīṃ sargiṇaṃ pāpahananaṃ vahnigopanau | caturgatiṃ kalātmānaṃ kumbhaṃ pāvakagopanau || 33.27 || vai rājamandarau syātā muddhārya caturāsana | gajāsyaṃ devadattāntaṃ sarvamantraṃ prakalpayet || 33.28 || uṣṇikchandaḥ punastvasya dṛṣṭāsyānnīlalohitaḥ | aniruddo devatā ca manavaḥ pañca kīrtitāḥ || 33.29 || pañcopaniṣadaḥ puṇyā stā etāścaturānana | mahāpātakanāśinyaḥ parākādi phalapradāḥ || 33.30 || etāssamyagadhīteyo vedāntānathavākhalān | tāvubhau sadṛśaumanye pañcabhūśśasya te'dhunā || 33.31 || prāyaścitteṣu homeṣu pratiṣṭhāprokṣaṇādiṣu | prayuñjīta pumānetāssarvapāpapraṇāśinīḥ || 33.32 || ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi śāntimantracatuṣṭayam | praṇavaṃ madhuhantāraṃ pavanaṃ madhusūdanam || 33.33 || bhāskaraṃ puruṣātmānaṃ gadivighneśamādhavān | bhallāyudhaṃ hṛṣī keśamagniṃ bhallāyudhodayam || 33.34 || kumbhaṃ mṛgāṅkapīyūṣau kamalānanamantimam | śuklaṃ kumbhamatho śatruṃ bhāskaraṃ gopanaṃ tathā || 33.35 || itīrayenmanuṃ brahman ṛṣisyāddevatā manoḥ | chando gāyatrametasya devatā tigmatejasaḥ || 33.36 || udgīthaṃ vijayaṃ kumbho vighneśātrirmṛgeśvarāḥ | piyūṣagopanau bhadraha stagopanayaṣṭayaḥ || 33.37 || jṛmbhalaṃ padmanābhaṃ ca bhānu madvijayonayaḥ | musali gopanaḥ paścā jjayaṃ kumbhaṃ ca mādhavam || 33.38 || netrotadehau sūryaśca śrīdharau vijayāvanau | śrīvighneśassubhadro'tha gadī varuṇamastakāḥ || 33.39 || vairājakumbhādidevā dakṣo madhunighādanaḥ | ādityarāmanāsikyacandra vāmanasargiṇaḥ || 33.40 || hutānta iti mantro'yamāhanīyaścaturmukha | ṛṣimasya bhṛguṃ prāhuśchando gāyatramityapi || 33.41 || hutāśano devatā ca devānāṃ prathamaṃ mukham | nigamādiṃ śriyaḥ kāntau vijayadvaya vikramau || 33.42 || krodhameghau pavitraṃ ca śrīdharaṃ pāvakodayau | ugrātmavahnīdyumaṇiranalaṃ bandhu mastakam || 33.43 || pavitraṃ bandhunāsikyaṃ gadinaṃ pulahaṃ tathā | dṛṣṭiṃ mṛgeśaṃ dyumaṇiṃ rāmo vaidharapāvakau || 33.44 || varuṇaṃ māyayā sākaṃ pracaṇḍaṃ pāṭalapriyaṃ | pavitradahanau vāyusvacchandhau ṭhaṭhapaśchimau || 33.45 || itthaṃ prakalpayenmantramṛṣirdhanada ucyate | chando gāyatrametasya devatā haripiṅgalaḥ || 33.46 || tāraṃ pavitraṃ vijayaṃ vighneśaṃ bhṛgugopanau | bhāskaraṃ puruṣātmānaṃ gadinaṃ vighnamādhavau || 33.47 || bhallāyudhahṛṣīkeśau vahniṃ bhallāyudhaṃ tathā | kumbhasaṃpuṭitaṃśuklaṃ candrapiyūṣagopanān || 33.48 || bhānumantamatho śatrumiti mantraṃ vivecayet | ṛṣirbṛhaspatistasya chandaḥ pūrvavadīritam || 33.49 || ādityo devatā hyevamuktaṃ mantracatuṣṭayam | yatramantraṃ kriyādravyahīnaṃ śāntyādikarmaṇi || 33.50 || tasminnetatprayuñjīta tathāyaṃ sādhako vidhiḥ | mantrāṇi te pravakṣyāmi tattvānāṃ pañcaviṃśateḥ || 33.51 || prayujyamānairyairviśvaṃ prāṇitiprāṇavarjitam | praṇavasyopari sparśānāhurvāmanamastakān || 33.52 || namontān prātilomyena yojayetpañcaviṃśatim | paraśabdaṃ caturthyantaṃ na teḥ paśchātprakalpayet || 33.53 || jīvaṃ dehaṃ tathā buddhirgarvaṃ paścānmanastathā | śabdasparśau tathā rūpaṃ raso gandhaśca pañcakam || 33.54 || etān pañcāpi viṣayān tanmantravacanodarān | śrotraṃ tvakca tathā netraṃ jihvā ghrāṇaṃ tataḥ param || 33.55 || vācaṃ pāṇiṃ tathā pādaṃ pāyūpasthaṃ pitāmaha | pṛthivīṃ prathamaṃ toyaṃ tejomārutamanvataḥ || 33.56 || pyoma cānte caturthyantai rātmaśabdaistatho ttaraiḥ | kṛtanāmānimān śabdānmantrarūpeṇa kalpayet || 33.57 || udgīthakṛtanāsikyau hutāśaṃ bindumastakam | kakubhaṃ gadinaṃ vāsudevaṃ vijayavā manau || 33.58 || vahniṃ guhālayaṃ cāpi pavitra madhusūdanau | caturgatiṃ manuṃ prāṇaṃ dīpārthaṃ manumirayet || 33.59 || tāraṃ sūryahṛṣīkeśayaṣṭayaḥ puṣṭibhījavān | meghabindū śuklarāmau ṛṣiḥ puṇyatrivikramau || 33.60 || indurguhālayaṃ paścājjayapāvakagopanāḥ | iti vāyurnatimatsyā dakṣasūtramanurmahān || 33.61 || tāraṃ śrīrāmakaumārapuruṣātmamṛgeśvarau | viṣṇuṃ paṃcāntakaṃ vahniṃ dhūmadhvajaguhālayau || 33.62 || pavitrabandhusumukhā mādhavaṃ prathamaṃ tathā | hutāśaṃ padmapāṇiṃca vāyuṃ vahniṃ guhālayam || 33.63 || paścimāsya madhośatruṃ śaṅkhaṃ ca natimastakam | ityarghyamantraṃ racayet atha pādyamanuṃ śṛṇu || 33.64 || tāraṃ gadidruvau cāpi gadadhvaṃsimṛgādhipau | paścimaṃ rāmaśirasaṃ vijayaṃ vahnipaśchimau || 33.65 || ekaviṃśaṃ padmanābhaṃ māyāṃ pavanapaṅkajau | vahniṃ dvitīyamanilaṃ pāpaghnaṃ madhusūdanam || 33.66 || vaidharaṃ mārutaṃ vahniṃ hṛṣīkeśo'tha paścimam | rāmaṃ sumukhasāraṅgau natyantaṃ mantramirayet || 33.67 || ādau vyāpiṃ śukla vahniṃ candrakumbhau jayānilau | mandaraṃ padmanābhaṃ ca vai rājāgniguhālayāḥ || 33.68 || pāpahantāramadveṣī vanamālī mṛgeśvarau | gopano vakratuṇḍaśca dakṣavighneśagopanāḥ || 33.69 || vairājadakṣau vighneśamādhavau natimastakam | ityacamana mantrassyādrūpādīni yathā ami || 33.70 || prathamaṃ cedapi manondho pāvānduritātmavān | rāmaṃ dṛṣṭimanusvāraṃ gadinaṃ viṣṇusaptamam || 33.71 || ādityagopanau caṇḍaṃ vahnijāyāvasānakam | ityetatkalpitaṃ mantraṃ pratibhoganivedanam || 33.72 || prayuñjīta prayogaṃ ca tasmātsādhāraṇo manuḥ | dviṣaṭkākṣaramudhṛtya śikhaṇḍipulahaṃ dhruvam || 33.73 || subhadrakuṃbhau vijayaśrīdharau dakṣamādhavau | pavitrabhuvanau krodhapaścimāna nagopanāḥ || 33.74 || ṭhaṭhāntamatha natyantaṃ manumitthaṃ prakalpayet | puṣpāñjalipradāneṣu niyuñjīta jitaṃ punaḥ || 33.75 || tāraśśuklaghaṭo yaṣṭiścandramā bhuvano nalaḥ | subhadravāyyautadehanatyanto manurīritaḥ || 33.76 || tenārādhana vastraṃ syādāpyāyanamupācaret | itthamārādhanāṅgāni mantrāṇi kathitāni te || 33.77 || idānīmaikān mantrān pravakṣyāmi manoharān | svīkṛtya saptavarṇāni rohiṇiśamapāṃpatim || 33.78 || pavitramānuṣeśanau gopanaṃ puṇyavikramau | paścimaṃ vijayaṃ vāyuṃ mādhavo varuṇānilau || 33.79 || vāsudevaṃ tathā dakṣaṃ gopanaṃ jayamandarau | vighneśamādhavau pāpahananaṃ pavanaṃ tathā || 33.80 || guhālayamatho yaṣṭiṃ sūryamūrdhvaṃ jagatpatim | yaṣṭiṃ kumbhaṃ jagatprāṇaṃ hṛṣīkeśaṃ tathā dhruvam || 33.81 || śvetāṃśuṃ varuṇaṃ binduṃ dvisūryaṃ vāmanaṃ dhruvam | ṭhaṭhāntikaṃ manuṃ brahmannīraye datha tārakam || 33.82 || natyantaṃ śuklavaruṇau paścimaṃ vikramaṃ jayam | bandhumagniṃ hṛṣīkeśaṃ paścimaṃ madhusūdanam || 33.83 || caturgatimacāmādiṃ māhendraṃ viṣṇupannagau | mandaraṃ vāmanaṃ paścātpaścimaṃ vijayānilau || 33.84 || devadattaṃ śriyaṃ vahniṃ mahāmāyāṃ mahābalām | hṛṣīkeśaṃ dhruvaṃ cāpi bījamāmreḍayedimam || 33.85 || pavitra manalaṃ caṇḍaṃ gopanaṃ dvivināyakam | vaidharaṃ madhuhantāraṃ vijayaṃ mandaraṃ tathā || 33.86 || bhadrahastaṃ mṛgeśaṃ ca ṭhaṭhāntaṃ mantramirayet | sindhudvīpo manordraṣṭā virāṭ chando nigadyate || 33.87 || svapnādipati retasya devatā paramaḥ pumān | hṛṣīkeśaṃ yaṣṭimantramirayenmantrakovidaḥ || 33.88 || uṣṇikchandaḥ punastasya devatā nṛharirhariḥ | tathā hi rasanāmāni mantraṃ pracakṣate || 33.89 || abhinnaviṭapaskandhaṃ spṛṣṭvā śvatthamimaṃ japet | ahobhissaptabhirmṛtyuṃ laṅghayetsaṃ yatendriyāḥ || 33.90 || athālyāyāsasādhyāni śṛṇu mantrāṇi padmaja | vyāpinaṃ puruṣātmānaṃ vāsudevaṃ napaścimam || 33.91 || rāmaṃ vighneśvaraṃ māyāmudgīdharahitānimān | dakṣādīśādidevānāmathābjaṃ supratiṣṭhitam || 33.92 || vāyuṃ padma mathośatruṃ śaṅkhavahnidhruvānapi | hutāntamuddharetka rṇagobhitiṃ mantramuttamam || 33.93 || japellakṣamimaṃ mantramuphoṣyaikādaśe hani | dvādaśyāmapi kuryāt strīṃ samunnatapayodharām || 33.94 || āvāhya tasyāṃ hutvā ca pūjayitvāca yoginīm | madhyarātre baliṃ datvā chindyāttāṃ pratiyātanām || 33.95 || bhūtaṃ bhavadbhaviṣyaṃ ca tasya vakṣyati yoginī | amnāyādiṃ vidhātāraṃ pracaṇḍaṃ vasumastakam || 33.96 || paścimaṃ vikramaṃ lakṣmīṃ gopanaṃ khaḍga dhāriṇam | savikramaṃ ghaṭaṃ cāgniṃ ghaṭaṃ ca dviradānanam || 33.97 || paṅkajaṃ vāruṇamatho sarasīruhasambhava | kakubhaṃ vahnimaparaṃ pīyūṣaṃ gopanaṃ tathā || 33.98 || jhaṣaṃ guhālayaṃ cāpi śaṅkhaṃ vahniṃ ca mandaram | śrīdharaṃ padmavairājaṃ gopanaṃ sūkṣmalocanam || 33.99 || vahniṃ pracaṇḍaṃ vighneśaṃ rāmaṃ mandarapāvakau | pītādidevau pulahaṃ yaṣṭiṃ padmaguhāntimau || 33.100 || ekanetraṃ śriyaṃ vahniṃ vāmanaṃ vahnimādhavau | mṛgeśabhāvasadbandhon vighnopahatikaṃ tathā || 33.101 || svacchandaṃ vijayaṃ vahniṃ vīrasenasaroruhau | ādidevaṃ tathā candraravidṛṣṭiśubhapradau || 33.102 || vahniṃ vināyakaṃ rāmaṃ dvirdakṣaṃ caturāsanam | pracaṇḍaḥ pāvako yaṣṭiḥ paścimāsyahutāśanau || 33.103 || piyūṣarāmasahitau śubhadaṃ vāyugopanau | vijayaṃ pañcabinduṃ ca vai rājaṃ madhusūdanam || 33.104 || gaṇeśagopanau paścādgadinaṃ vijayaṃ ghaṭam | ekadṛṣṭiṃ tathā vahniṃ mandaraṃ madhusūdanam || 33.105 || kuñjarānanaviṣṇvantau vighneśaṃ bandhumastakam | kakubhaṃ candradhavalaṃ gopanaṃ paścimānanam || 33.106 || caturgatiṃ ṭhaṭhopāntamiti mantraṃ prakalpayet | adhastānne travṛkṣanya japennetadatandritaḥ || 33.107 || naṣṭaṃ muṣṭiṃ cintanāṃ ca jānātyetatprasādataḥ | saptākṣaraṃ prakalpyādau varuṇaṃ gopanaṃ daram || 33.108 || piyūṣamādhavaṃ dakṣaṃ dṛṣṭivahnidaradvayam | paścimāgnimukhānetān dahanasyāntaroditān || 33.109 || sūrya rāmau pībatandho dviḥ prakalpyacatuṣṭayam | śuklaṃ yaṣṭivivasvantau vahniṃ svāhāvasānikam || 33.110 || ityambustambhanaṃ mantraṃ kalpayetkamalāsana | praṇavādiṃ vāsudevaṃ śubhadaṃ paṅka jaṃ tathā || 33.111 || māyāmabhyasya hantāraṃ phalahaṃ śaśinaṃ jayam | yaṣṭiṃ bhallāyudhaṃ cāpi vighneśaṃ rāmamastakam || 33.112 || satyantamudakastambhaṃ mantraṃ mantra vidīrayet | anayoḥ pūrvamantreṇa sthitavatsalite caret || 33.113 || uttareṇa tu sindhūnāṃ vegastambhaṃ samācaret | agnistambhanamantraṃ te kathayāmi yathātatham || 33.114 || saptākṣaraṃ kumbhavahniṃ bhuvanaṃ vanamālinam | gopanaṃ puruṣātmānaṃ trivahniṃ śaśalāñcanam || 33.115 || vairājabinduṃ hrasvāntaṃ caturgatimatho ṭhaṭham | ityagnistambhanaṃ mantraṃ sādhayetayutaṃ naraḥ || 33.116 || lohatailaṃ ghṛtaṃ kṣīraṃ paraśuṃ salilaṃ tathā | saptacaitāni saṃspṛśya śītaśchāgnirbhaviṣyati || 33.117 || udare paṅkajasyeva sukhamāsīta śruṣmaṇaḥ | saptākṣaraṃ caturthyantaṃ vidhṇuśabdaṃ caturmukha || 33.118 || pavitraṃ śrīhṛṣīkeśaṃ vighneśaṃ madhusūdanam | pradyumnaṃ pāpahananaṃ vijayaṃ vāyumādhavau || 33.119 || dṛṣṭiṃ mandaraṃ pātādviṣṭhaṭhāntaṃ mantramirayet | gavāṃ ca mahiṣāṇāṃ ca kuryādetena vaśyatām || 33.120 || ādau catustrivarṇāni dharapradaguhālayau | pavitravahnikamalaṃ sumukhaṃ vahnigopanau || 33.121 || vāyuṣaṭhānta ityeṣa vyālādidamano manuḥ | praṇave ṣaṣṭhaśabdādi sambudhyantaṃ piśācavat || 33.122 || ūrdhvalokeśa hananaṃ pāṣāṇeṣu ṭhaṭhomanuḥ | idaṃ hi japato mantraṃ ripumūrdhani tāḍayet || 33.123 || piśācarūpaṃ pratyakṣaṃ pāṣāṇairasthibhiśśavaiḥ | vyāpinaṃ gadinaṃ bhadrahastaṃ puṇyassaritphatim || 33.124 || vahniṃ hutāśaṃ viṣṇvantaṃ kakubhaṃ kumbhavikramau | śrīkumbhagopanān kumbhaṃ śaśāṅkaṃ brahmasādhanam || 33.125 || dvirmandaraṃ madhośśatruṃ subhadraṃ bandhumastakam | pitaṃ krodhana māyāmaṃ vijayaṃ gopanaṃ dhruvam || 33.126 || brahmāṇaṃ mānuṣeśānaṃ vāyuṃ gopanamastakam | binduṃ pavitra manalaṃ mārutaṃ pretanāyakam || 33.127 || svāhāvasānaṃ gāndharvaṃ mantramitthaṃ prakalpayet | atharvaṇamimaṃ mantraṃ pinākiśirasi sthitam || 33.128 || adhastātpārijātasya hemasiṃhāsanasthitam | āyāmi nībhirmālābhirdivyābhiśśobhivakṣasam || 33.129 || diṅnāgamadaliptāṅgaṃ divyābharaṇabhūṣitam | rūpayauvanayuktābhirvālavyajanapāṇibhiḥ || 33.130 || nityaṃ ṣoḍhasavarṣābhirutpalasnigdhadṛṣṭibhiḥ | mahākula prasūtābhirmadavihvala mūrtibhiḥ || 33.131 || adbhutabhrūvirāsābhiśśravaṇapriyagītibhiḥ | īṣadvi sraṃsivā sobhiraṃsavyukulamaulibhiḥ || 33.132 || stanāndolitahārābhiḥ kadalisubhagorubhiḥ | kuṭilālakamālābhiḥ kanyakābhirniṣevitam || 33.133 || kṛtāvadhānaṃ gīteṣu kinnarāṇāṃ muhurmuhuḥ | gandharvādhipatiṃ dhyāyanlakṣaṃ mantramimaṃ japet || 33.134 || athenamupatiṣṭhanai kulavatyovarāstriyaḥ | gandharvarājavacanādrūpa yauvanaśālinaḥ || 33.135 || athendrajālamantrasya svarūpaṃ kathayāmite | brahmakuṃbhau vīrasenau krodhaṃ sumukhavāruṇau || 33.136 || rāmaṃ dakṣaṃ madhośśatruṃ caturgatimṛgeśvarau | mohayatyatha rūpāṇi dviḥ pradarśayamastakam || 33.137 || huṅkāraṃ caturabhyastaṃ brahman kilikiliṃ tathā | ṛtadvayaṃ kumbharāmau pavitrānalavāmanān || 33.138 || vijayaṃ locane kṛtvā garbhadvitayamastakam | nānārūpāṇi māyedve dvirmantramitikalpayet || 33.139 || japena lakṣasaṅkhyena māyā pratyakṣasaṃgatā | yadyadiṣṭaṃ sādhakasya tattatkurvīta tatkṣaṇāt || 33.140 || brahmādyā devatāssarvā gaganasthāḥ pradarśayet | gahanaṃ medinīṃ kuryādyāminiṃ divasaṃ tathā || 33.141 || jīvantamapsuvihitaṃ prāṇapantaṃ tathā śavam | marupradeśaṃ vāriṇi śuṣyantaṃ payasāṃ nithim || 33.142 || ṣaḍrasaṃ vaiparītyena deśānapyayathātatham | pāṣāṇaistāḍayeddehe netrādyutpāṭanaṃ tathā || 33.143 || khalvāṭa keśasaṃrohaṃ yūnasthsaviratāṃ tathā | puṃsastrītvaṃ tathā strīṇāṃ pustvaṃ klībasya taddvayam || 33.144 || tayorvāklībatāṃ citraṃ śmaśrustanaviparyayam | gītaṃ śukla stathā gītā manyathā bhāvabhāginaḥ || 33.145 || agarbhiṇīṃ garbhiṇīṃ ca garbhiṇīṃ cāpyagarbhiṇīm | pādādibhaṅgasandhāne nabhaḥ kusumasambhavaḥ || 33.146 || acintitāni śailānāṃ patanāni yathepsitam | manuṣyādiṣu śṛṅgāṇi gaganārohaṇaṃ tathā || 33.147 || akāla raṇasaṃraṃbhān pratimākarṣaṇaṃ tathā | kaṭhinānāṃ dravībhāvaṃ dravatāṃ kaṭhinātmatām || 33.148 || adyāpi pralayāvasthāmunmajjana nimajjane | khaḍgādibhi rabhaṅgaṃ ca jaṅgamaṃ sthāvaraṃ tathā || 33.149 || ācetaneṣu caitanyaṃ cetaneṣu vicetanām | rūpadarśanamandhasya mūkasya madhurāṃ giram || 33.150 || śravaṇaṃ badhirasyāpi pajgorgamasamadbhutam | pradarśanaṃ vimānānāṃ bhuvi sūryendumaṇḍalam || 33.151 || śilāvarṣaṃ mahāghoraṃ rāhugrāsamaparvaṇi | etasthānapraviṣṭāni bhuvanāni caturdaśa || 33.152 || āsanasthasya patanaṃ tumulaṃ ca parasparam | pratīpagamanaṃ sindho rāsanaṃ havyavāhane || 33.153 || tatkṣaṇepi prarūḍhānāṃ vṛkṣāṇāṃ pallavaṃ phalam | secanaṃ havyavāhena jvalanaṃ vayasā tathā || 33.154 || madhyāhnasamaye jyotsnāṃdiṅmohaṃ vātasambramam | cittādidhātu saṅkṣobhaṃ pratyakṣasyāpyadarśanam || 33.155 || śailaśṛṅgā dyapatanā dgavyanasya pradarśanam | itthaṃ bhūtāni citrāṇi kuryānmāyānubhāvataḥ || 33.156 || idānīṃ saptayakṣīṇāṃ mantrāṇi katha yāmite | āgaccha sundarī svāhāvasānaṃ praṇavādimam || 33.157 || ityeṣa sundarī mantro mantrādeḥ kāryamācaret | praṇavaṃ prathamaṃ sarvaṃ mano hara namo ṭhaṭha || 33.158 || itthaṃ manoharī mantraḥ priyamiṣṭaṃ prayaccati | udgīthaṃ kanakaṃ brahman pakṣyate maidhunapriya || 33.159 || ṭhaṭhaḥ kanakavatyāssyānmantraḥ kāmukasiddhidaḥ | mamāgaccha caturvaktra kāmeśvari ṭhaṭhāntimam || 33.160 || iti kāmeśvarīmantraḥ sarvāṃ siddhiṃ prayacchati | āruhya śayanaṃ naktame kāki puṣpagandhavān || 33.161 || dhyāyetkāmeśvariṃ yakṣiṃ sā tasya bhavati priyā | yadānyāṃ kāmayenmantrī sā tasya vaśamācaret || 33.162 || svāhāntaḥ kathito mantro brahmātpāte ratipriye | pritā ratipriyā yakṣī sādhakasya prayacchati || 33.163 || divyānyodanavāsāṃsi kusumādyanulepanam | pādukāñjana khaḍgādīn bhāṣaṇāni rasāyanam || 33.164 || oṃ padmini ṭhaṭho mantraṃ padmini yasya devatā | oṃ śrīṃ hrīṃ dvayamāgaccha dvayaṃ yakṣi ṭhaṭhāntimam || 33.165 || praṇavadvitayaṃ puṣṭibījaṃ paśchānnati stathā | vātādidevau dakṣādyaṃ bandhuṃ vighneśamārutau || 33.166 || vīrasenamatho śuklaṃ kumbhaṃ vahniṃ ca paścimam | hṛṣīkeśaṃ jayaṃ kumbhaṃ śrīddhuvau kamalāsana || 33.167 || pañcabinduṃ ṭhaṭhāntaṃ ca yāminīmantramuddharet | etajjapena puruṣo vibhavaṃ labhate param || 33.168 || dvandvāni puṃsāṃ strīṇāṃ ca rahitānyapi yojayet | yadyadvastu tathānyeṣāṃ striyo vā puruṣo'pi vā || 33.169 || tāmbhūlaṃ kusumaṃ vāpi tadvānvahamupānayet | yasyaite manavassapta siddhāḥ puṃsaścaturmukha || 33.170 || yakṣyastasya bhaviṣyanti kiṅkayan iti devatāḥ | merumandharavindhyādiśikhareṣu yathātatham || 33.171 || sādhakaṃ ramayiṣyānti kalpaṃ bhogai ramānuṣaiḥ | brahman piśācamantrāṇi śruṇuṣva gadato mama || 33.172 || saptākṣarāṇi saptārkagopanāḥ kumbhavikramau | krodhapracaṇḍau varuṇamṛgeśau vipulastathā || 33.173 || dvikuṇḍasaspamisvāhā manureṣa prakīrtitaḥ | badni yādamunā brahmannāviṣṭasya śikhāṃ punaḥ || 33.174 || saptākṣaraṃ puraskṛtya caturthyaṃ viṣṇumastakam | gururbandhuḥpitā kāmo mandaraṃ vikramaṃ tathā || 33.175 || pulahaṃ vikramaṃ paśchādbhallāyudhaguhālayau | vai rājapāpahananau vijayaṃ bandhumastakam || 33.176 || hutāśagopanau brahman kakubhaṃ brahmasūdanau | pavitraśaṅkhau vijayaṃ māyāṃ svāhāvasānakam || 33.177 || itimantraṃ prakalpyātha balimetena dāpayet | pūrvaṃ mantradaśārṇāni mahendro rāmamastakaḥ || 33.178 || pavitra pāpanau pītagaupanau paścimānanau | vahnyantasūdanau vighnagopanau papanaṃ tathā || 33.179 || gadī hutavahassūryo vanamāli pitāmaha | mānaṃ śabda śirassvāhā gandhamantraḥ prakalpitaḥ || 33.180 || dvādaśārṇamukhaṃ pūrvaṃ vahniṃ sumukhavikramau | māhendravikramau bhānurdakṣaṃ vijayayordvayam || 33.181 || dvirvāriśabdaṃ kamalaṃ devadattaṃ vināyakam | svāhāntamirayenmantra māveśe viniyojayet || 33.182 || stambhe vā puruṣe vāpi payastenābhimantritam | vikṣipedatha bhūtāni stambha mapyāviśantitam || 33.183 || aṣṭākṣaramukhassūryo vahnirdiḥ kamalāsana | vyastau punastayorvahnāvubhayatra trivikramau || 33.184 || ādityarāmaṃ nāsikyaṃ ghaṭasaṃ vāvakapriyāḥ | yena sāgrahamantrasya piśācādibhayāvaham || 33.185 || bhūtapratikṛtiṃ kṛtvā śālipiṣṭairmahodarīm | bhitvā tīkṣṇena śastreṇa bhūtaṃ sākṣādbhaviṣyati || 33.186 || bhūtagrahapiśācādīnapasmāramathāpi vā | kūśmāṇḍayakṣagandharvabrahmarakṣassurāsurān || 33.187 || āveśayeddhareccāpi mantrairetaiścaturmukha | yadyadebhiraśakyaṃ syāttattatkuryādvicakṣaṇaḥ || 33.188 || sudarśanasya mantreṇa nārasihmena vā punaḥ | trailokyamohanenā pi sākṣā daṣṭākṣareṇa vā || 33.189 || iti mantraprabhāvaste kathitaḥ padmasambhana | caryā ca vidhivatproktā dharmakāmārthamuktidā || 33.190 || idaṃ hi pāvanaṃ śāstramadhīte yassamāhitaḥ | triṣvapyamuṣya lokeṣu jñeyamanyannavidyate || 33.191 || padma ityuktvā brahmaṇe śāntraṃ bhagavān bhūtabhāvanaḥ | vāsudevaḥ paraṃ brahmatatraivāntaradhīyata || 33.192 || atha vismayamānātmā brahmālokapitāmahaḥ | ajagāma svakaṃ lokaṃ stūyamāno maharṣibhiḥ || 33.193 || kapilāya dadau brahmāśāstrametanmaharṣaye | sa cāpi bhagavānmahyaṃ mayāte kathitaṃ punaḥ || 33.194 || tatpātāla midaṃ hitvā jambhūdvipamito vraja | himavatsarvate ramye samādhāya manaśśubham || 33.195 || ārādhaya hṛṣīkeśaṃ vidhānaiḥ pāñcakālikaiḥ | iti bruvāṇe padme tu labdhvā hṛṣṭena cetasā || 33.196 || ayogyājñānatimiraṃ śāstrāñjanaśalākayā | nivṛtya pātālatalātkṛtvā padmaṃ pradakṣiṇam || 33.197 || amuṣmin śailaśikhare devadārubhirāvṛte | mahābhāgavataiḥ puṇyaiḥ pañcarātraviśāradaiḥ || 33.198 || tapasvādhyāyanirataissevite paramarṣibhiḥ | hṛdayebhyassamāhṛtya hṛdayaṃ saṃyamādibhiḥ || 33.199 || arādhayāmi viśveśaṃ vāsudevaṃ jagadguram | anyamānīya tadvācā taṃ dhyāyanmanasā punaḥ || 33.200 || kālenārādhanaṃ kurvan bhajāmi parameśvaram | tvamapyārādhaya kṣipraṃ caturpyohamadhokṣajam || 33.201 || mayā te kathitaṃ śāstraṃ sāvadhānena kiṃ śrutam | idaṃ te nātapaskāya nābhaktāya kadācana || 33.202 || na cāśuśrūṣave vācyaṃ na ca māṃ yo bhyasūyati | tantrāṇāṃ caivaratnāni pañcāhuḥ paramarṣayaḥ || 33.203 || pādmaṃ sanatkumārākhyaṃ tathā paramasaṃhitā | padmodbhavaṃ ca māhendhraṃ kaṇvatantrāmṛtāni ca || 33.204 || tadā prabhṛti ye śiṣṭāstato haṃ himavattaṭe | ārādhayaṃ caturbāhuṃ niyataḥ puruṣottamam || 33.205 || bhavantopi yatātmāno bhaktimanto janārdane | kena vā kathitaṃ śāstramṛṣayaḥ kalmaṣāpaham || 33.206 || idaṃ mahopaniṣadaṃ śraddhadhānaśaśruṇoti yaḥ | sa yāti śāśvataṃ sthānaṃ duṣprāpamakṛtātmabhiḥ || 33.207 || yena māṃ prathamāmāna yathā padma gurorguruḥ | tenedaṃ śrīyate puṇyā matanotpadma saṃhitām || 33.208 || ṛṣayastaṃ bhavantopi bhagantu puruṣottamam | pradāsyati sa yuṣmabhya mapavargaṃ tapodhanāḥ || 33.209 || iti śrīpāñcarātre mahopaniṣadi pādmasaṃhitāyāṃ cāryāpāde samārādhanāṅga mantroddhāro nāma trayastriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ |
caryāpādassamāptaḥ |
samāptāceyaṃ saṃhitā |
